war: Ginsusurat namon ini basi mahingpit an aton kalipay.
en: We write this to make our joy complete.

war: Niyan amo ini an mensahe nga amon hinbatian tikang han iya Anak, nga karuyag namon ipahibaro ha iyo: kapawa an Dyos ngan waray gud kasisidman dida ha iya.
en: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

war: Sanglit kon masiring kita nga nahiusa na kita han Dyos, kundi nagpapadayon kita hin pag-ukoy ha kasisidman, nagbibinuwa kita ha pulong ngan ha buhat.
en: If we claim to have fellowship with him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live out the truth.

war: Kundi kon nag-uokoy kita ha kapawa-sugad nga aada hiya ha kapawa—may-ada naton minagburugto nga pagkaurosa ngan an dugo ni Jesus nga iya Anak naghugas han aton ngatanan nga sala.
en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

war: Kon masiring kita nga waray naton sala, naglilimbong la ngahaw kita ha aton kalugaringon, ngan waray gud dinhe ha aton an kamatuoran.
en: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

war: Kon sumiring kita nga waray kita makasala, ginpapahimuwa ta an Dyos, ngan waray dinhe ha aton an iya mga pulong.
en: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.

war: Ngan hi Cristo amo ngahaw an magpapasaylo han aton mga sala, diri la han aton mga sala kundi han mga sala liwat han ngatanan nga mga tawo.
en: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

war: Kon magtuman kita han mga sugo han Dyos, waray ruhaduha nga nakilala kita ha iya.
en: We know that we have come to know him if we keep his commands.

war: Kon may masiring, “Nakilala ako ha iya,” kundi diri nagtutuman han iya mga sugo, buwaon ito nga tawo ngan waray kamatuoran dida ha iya.
en: Whoever says, “I know him,” but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.

war: Kundi an nagtutuman han iya pulong amo an tawo nga may-ada hingpit nga paghigugma han Dyos. Tungod hini, waray ruhaduha nga aada kita ha iya:
en: But if anyone obeys his word, love for God is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him:

war: An nasiring nga aada hiya han Dyos kinahanglan mag-ukoy hiya hin kinabuhi nga sugad kan Jesu-Cristo.
en: Whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus did.

war: Aada pa gihapon ha kasisidman an bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot han iya bugto, bisan kon nasiring hiya nga aada na hiya ha kapawa.
en: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.

war: An bisan hin-o nga nahigugma han iya bugto mag-uokoy dida han kapawa, sanglit waray gud bisan ano dida ha iya nga mahihimo nga tinikangan hin pakasala han iba.
en: Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.

war: Kundi aada ha kasisidman an bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot han iya bugto; naglalakat hiya ha kasisidman ngan diri maaram kon tikain hiya, kay ginbuta man hiya han kasisidman.
en: But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness. They do not know where they are going, because the darkness has blinded them.

war: Nagsusurat ako ha iyo, mga anak ko, kay ginpasaylo na an iyo mga sala tungod han ngaran ni Cristo.
en: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.

war: Ayaw niyo higugmaa an kalibutan o bisan ano nga kanan kalibutan. Kon mahigugma kamo han kalibutan, diri kamo mahigugma han Amay.
en: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.

war: Magpapapas an kalibutan ngan an ngatanan nga inuungara han mga tawo; kundi an nagtutuman han kaburot-on han Dyos mabubuhi ha kadayonan.
en: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

war: Kundi iginbubo ha iyo ni Cristo an Espirito Santo, sanglit maaram kamo ngatanan han kamatuoran.
en: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

war: Sanglit nagsusurat ako ha iyo, diri tungod nga diri kamo maaram han kamatuoran, kundi tungod nga maaram kamo, ngan maaram liwat kamo nga waray buwa nga natikang han kamaturoan.
en: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.

war: Hin-o man ngay-an an buwaon? Amo adton nariwa nga hi Jesus amo an Cristo. Amo ini an Kaaway ni Cristo—sinasalikway niya an Amay ngan an Anak.
en: Who is the liar? It is whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a person is the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.

war: Kay bisan hin-o nga nasalikway han Anak nasalikway man han Amay; kundi bisan hin-o nga makarawat han Anak makarawat man liwat han Amay.
en: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

war: Ngan amo ini an iginsaad ni Cristo ngahaw nga ihahatag ha aton—an dayon nga kinabuhi.
en: And this is what he promised us—eternal life.

war: Nagsusurat ako hini ha iyo mahitungod hadton mga nagtatalinguha hin paglimbong ha iyo.
en: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

war: Tinuod, mga anak ko, pagpabilin kamo dida ha iya basi magmadasigon kita kon magpadayag na hiya, ngan diri kita tumago hin kaawod ha iya kon bumalik na hiya.
en: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.

war: Maaram kamo nga matadong hi Cristo, sanglit angay liwat hibaroan niyo nga an bisan hin-o nga nagbubuhat hin matadong anak han Diyos.
en: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.

war: An ngatanan nga may-ada hini nga paglaom kan Cristo, nagputli han ira kalugaringon, sugad nga putli hi Cristo.
en: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.

war: An nakasala nagtatalapas han balaod han Dyos kay sala an pagtalapas han balaod.
en: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.

war: Sayod kamo nga kinmanhi hi Cristo pagkuha han mga sala han mga tawo, ngan waray hiya sala.
en: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.

war: Sanglit diri nagpapadayon pagpinakasala an ngatanan nga aada kan Cristo; kundi an waray pa makakita ha iyo o waray pa makakilala ha iya nagpapadayon hin pagpinakasala.
en: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.

war: Ayaw kamo pagpalimbong, mga anak! An bisan hin-o nga nagbubuhat hin matadong, matadong sugad nga matadong man hi Cristo.
en: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

war: An bisan hin-o nga anak han Dyos diri nagpapadayon hin pagpinakasala, kay aada ha iya an kinaiya han Dyos; ngan tungod nga Amay na niya an Dyos, diri na hiya makakagpadayon hin pagpinakasala.
en: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot go on sinning, because they have been born of God.

war: Amo ini an hinbatian niyo nga mensahe tikang pa ha tinikangan: kinahanglan maghigugmaay kita.
en: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

war: Sanglit ayaw kamo hipausa, kabugtoan ko, kon pagdumtan kamo han mga tawo han kalibutan.
en: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

war: Maaram kita nga binayaan ta na an kamatayon ngan aada na kita han kinabuhi. Maaram kita hini kay nahigugma kita han aton kabugtoan. Aada pa ha kamatayon an bisan hin-o nga diri nahigugma.
en: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.

war: Parapamatay an bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot han iya bugto; ngan maaram kamo nga waray dayon nga kinabuhi an parapamatay.
en: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.

war: Amo ini an pagkilala naton kon ano an gugma: iginhatag ni Cristo an iya kinabuhi tungod ha aton. Sanglit angay man naton ihatag an aton kinabuhi tungod han aton kabugtoan.
en: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

war: Mga anak ko, kinahanglan diri la ha im-im ug wait an aton paghigugma; kinahanglan tinuod ini nga gugma kon igpakita dida hin mga mag-upay nga buhat.
en: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

war: Sanglit amo ini an paghibaro naton nga skop kita han kamatuoran, ngan may-ada naton pagsarig ha atubangan han Dyos.
en: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:

war: Kon paghukman kita han aton konsensya, maaram kita nga labaw han aton konsensya an Dyos nga maaram han ngatanan.
en: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.

war: Sanglit, hinigugma ko nga kasangkayan, kon diri kita paghukman han aton konsensya, may pagtapod naton ha atubangan han Dyos.
en: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God

war: Nakarawat kita tikang ha iya hin bisan ano nga aton pinangangaro, kay nagtutuman kita han iya mga sugo ngan nagbubuhat kita han nakakalipay ha iya.
en: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.

war: Amo ini an iya iginsusugo: nga tumoo kita han ngaran han iya Anak nga hi Jesu-Cristo, ngan maghigugmaay kita sugad han iginsugo ni Cristo ha aton.
en: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.

war: Hibabaroan niyo kon an Espiritu kanan Dyos dida hini nga paagi: an bisan hin-o nga magtug-an nga nahimo nga tawo hi Jesu-Cristo, may-ada Espiritu nga kanan Dyos.
en: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

war: Kundi an magdiwara hini mahitungod kan Jesus, waray Espiritu nga kanan Dyos. Tikang han Kaaway ni Cristo ini nga Espiritu. Hinbatian niyo nga maabot ini, ngan yana aanhi na ha kalibutan.
en: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.

war: Ini nga mga diri matuod nga manaragna naghihimangraw mahitungod han mga butang han kalibutan, ngan namamati ha ira an kalibutan, kay kanan kalibutan man hira.
en: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.

war: Hinigugma ko nga kasangkayan, maghigugmaay kita, kay natikang sa Dyos an gugma, sanglit anak han Dyos ngan nakilala han Dyos an bisan hin-o nga nahigugma.
en: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

war: Diri nakilala han Dyos an bisan hin-o nga diri nahigugma, kay gugma an Dyos.
en: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

war: Sugad hini an pagpakita han Dyos han iya gugma ha aton: ginsugo niya nganhi ha kalibutan an amo la nga iya Anak, basi magkaada kita kinabuhi pinaagi ha iya.
en: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

war: Amo ini an gugma: diri nga kita an naghigugma han Dyos, kundi nga an Dyos an naghigugma ha aton ngan nagsugo han iya Anak, basi pinaagi ha iya mapasaylo an aton mga sala.
en: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

war: Hinigugma ko nga kasangkayan, kon sugad hini an paghigugma han Dyos ha aton, kinahanglan maghigugmaay man kita.
en: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

war: Waray pa nakakita han Dyos; kon maghigugmaay kita, nag-uokoy an Dyos dinhe ha aton ngan nahihingpit an iya gugma dinhe ha aton.
en: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

war: Maaram kita nga diri kita magsasayop nga nag-uokoy kita dida han Dyos ngan nag-uokoy man an Dyos dinhe ha aton tungod kay ihinatag niya ha aton an iya Espiritu.
en: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

war: Ngan aton hinkit-an ngan iginsumat ha iba nga an Amay nagsugo han iya Anak nga magin Magtaralwas han kalibutan.
en: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

war: An bisan hin-o nga magpahayag nga hi Jesus amo an Anak han Dyos, nag-uokoy dida ha Dyos ngan nag-uokoy man an Dyos dida ha iya.
en: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they in God.

war: Ngan makilala ngan matoo kita han kanan Dyos paghigugma ha aton. Gugma an Dyos, ngan an bisan hin-o nga nag-uokoy dida han gugma nag-uokoy dida ha Dyos, ngan nag-uokoy man an Dyos dida ha iya.
en: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.

war: Ginhihingpit an gugma dinhe ha aton, basi diri kita mahadlok ha Adlaw han Paghukom; kay an aton kinabuhi dinhe hini nga kalibutan sugad man han kan Cristo.
en: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.

war: Nahigugma kita kay una an Dyos humigugma ha aton.
en: We love because he first loved us.

war: Sanglit amo ini an sugo nga iginhatag ni Cristo ha aton: kinahanglan nga adton nahigugma han Dyos humigugma man han iya bugto.
en: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.

war: Anak han Dyos adton natoo nga hi Jesus amo an Mesiyas; ngan adton nahigugma hin usa nga amay nahigugma man liwat han anak hini nga amay.
en: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.

war: Sugad hini an pagsabot naton nga nahigugma kita han mga anak han Dyos: kon nahigugma kita han Dyos ngan nagtutuman kita han iya mga sugo.
en: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

war: Kay an aton paghigugma han Dyos hisasabtan dida han aton pagtuman han iya mga sugo. Ngan diri gud makuri para ha aton an pagtuman han iya mga sugo,
en: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,

war: kay an tagsa nga anak han Dyos makakahimo hin pakadaog han kalibutan. Nakadaog kita han kalibutan pinaagi han aton pagtoo.
en: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

war: Hin-o ba an makakadaog han kalibutan? Adton natoo la nga hi Jesus amo an Anak han Dyos.
en: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

war: May-ada tulo nga mga saksi:
en: For there are three that testify:

war: an Espiritu, an tubig, ngan an dugo; ngan nagkakauruyon ini nga tulo ha ira pagkasaksi.
en: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.

war: Sanglit amo ini an pagsaksi: naghatag an Dyos ha aton han waray kataposan nga kinabuhi, ngan aada han iya Anak ini nga kinabuhi.
en: And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

war: May-ada hini nga kinabuhi adton anuokyan han Anak, ngan waray hini nga kinabuhi adton diri inuokyan han Anak han Dyos.
en: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

war: Nagsusurat ako ha iyo hini basi hibaroan niyo nga may-ada niyo kinabuhi nga waray kataposan—kamo nga natoo han ngaran han Anak han Dyos.
en: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.

war: Madasigon kita ha atubangan han Dyos kay maaram man kita nga namamati hiya kon nangangaro kita ha iya hin bisan ano nga uyon han iya kaburot-on.
en: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

war: Tungod nga maaram kita nga namamati hiya kon nangangaro kita ha iya, maaram liwat kita nga nahatag hiya han aton pinangangaro ha iya.
en: And if we know that he hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of him.

war: Sala an ngatanan nga maraot nga buhat, kundi may-ada sala nga diri nakakamatay.
en: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.

war: Maaram kita nga waray anak han Dyos nga nagpapadayon hin pagpinakasala, kay pinananalipdan hiya han Anak han Dyos, sanglit diri makakadaog ha iya an Yawa.
en: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the One who was born of God keeps them safe, and the evil one cannot harm them.

war: Maaram kita nga kanan Dyos na kita bisan kon ginahahadian han Yawa an bug-os nga kalibutan.
en: We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.

war: Mga anak, paglikay kamo han mga diri matuod nga kadiyosan.
en: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

war: Para ini ha iyo ngan pinaagi hin pagtoo pinananalipdan kamo han gahom han Dyos tungod han katalwasan nga andam nga igpapadayag ha kataposan nga panahon.
en: who through faith are shielded by God’s power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

war: Pagkalipay kamo tungod hini, bisan kon kinahanglan magmabidoon kamo anay hin madaliay yana, tungod hin damo kalain nga mga pagsulay nga iyo gin-aantos.
en: In all this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.

war: kay kinakarawat niyo an tuyo han iyo pagtoo, nga amo an katalwasan han iyo mga kalag.
en: for you are receiving the end result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

war: Nangita ngan nag-usisa hin maupay mahitungod hini nga katalwasan an mga manaragna; ngan nagtagna hira mahitungod hini nga upa nga ihahatag ha iyo han Dyos.
en: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,

war: Sanglit, andama an iyo mga hunahuna. Pag-ikmat ngan bug-osa an iyo paglaom dida han mga kaupayan nga ihahatag ha iyo kon igpadayag na hi Jesu-Cristo.
en: Therefore, with minds that are alert and fully sober, set your hope on the grace to be brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed at his coming.

war: Pagmasinugtanon kamo han Dyos, ngan ayaw itugot nga an iyo mga ungara hadto han mga tapang pa kamo amo an magbuot han iyo mga kinabuhi.
en: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.

war: Lugod, kinahanglan mabaraan kamo ha ngatanan nga iyo ginbubuhat, sugad gud nga baraan an Dyos nga nagtawag ha iyo.
en: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;

war: Nasiring an kasuratan, “Kinahanglan mabaraan kamo, kay baraan ako.”
en: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”

war: kundi ginlukat kamo pinaagi han hamili nga dugo ni Cristo nga iginhalad sugad hin kordero nga waray dum-it o buring.
en: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

war: Daan hiya ginpili han Dyos san-o himoon an kalibutan, ngan iginpadayag ha kataposan nga mga adlaw para han iyo kaupayan.
en: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.

war: Kay gin-anak liwat kamo, pinaagi han buhi ngan waray kataposan nga pulong han Dyos. Mga anak na kamo diri hin ginikanan nga may kamatayon, kundi hin ginikanan nga waray kamatayon.
en: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan, “Sugad hin banwa an ngatanan nga mga tawo, ngan sugad la han bukad ha kapatagan an ira katahom. Nalalaya an banwa, ngan narapdag an iya bukad,
en: For, “All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

war: kundi nagpapabilin ha kadayonan an pulong han Ginoo.” Amo ini an pulong nga gindara ha iyo han Maupay nga Sumat.
en: but the word of the Lord endures forever.” And this is the word that was preached to you.

war: Sanglit bayai niyo an ngatanan nga karat-an; waray na an pagbuwa, o pagkamalabyaw, o pangabugho, o pagyubit!
en: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.

war: Masugad unta kamo hin mga minasus-an, nga dayuday inuuhaw han lus-ay nga espirituhanon nga gatas, basi pag-inom niyo hini nga gatas tumubo kamo ngan matalwas.
en: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,

war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan, “Natilawan na niyo an pagkamaupay han Ginoo.”
en: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

war: Dangop kamo han Ginoo, an buhi nga bato nga ginsalikway han mga tawo, kundi ginmahal han Dyos.
en: As you come to him, the living Stone—rejected by humans but chosen by God and precious to him—

war: Mahal kaupay ini nga bato para ha iyo nga natoo kundi para han diri natoo: “An bato ngahaw nga iginsalikway han mga magtirindog nahimo lugod nga labi ka importante nga bato.”
en: Now to you who believe, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”

war: Hadto anay diri kamo mga tawo han Dyos, kundi yana mga tawo na kamo niya. Hadto anay diri kamo maaram han kalooy han Dyos, kundi yana nakarawat na niyo an iya kalooy.
en: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

war: Tungod han Ginoo, pagpasakop kamo ha ngatanan nga kagamhanan dinhe ha tuna: ha Emperador nga amo an gilalabawi nga magburuot,
en: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human authority: whether to the emperor, as the supreme authority,

war: ngan han mga gobernador nga amo an gintudlok niya hin pagkastigo han mga nagbubuhat hin maraot ngan pagpasidungog hadton mga nagbubuhat hin maupay.
en: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.

war: Kay amo ini an kaburot-on han Dyos: karuyag niya nga pinaagi han iyo maupay nga mga buhat kapugngan niyo an waray pulos nga yayaknon han mga buangbuang nga tawo.
en: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish people.

war: Pag-ukoy kamo sugad hin talwas nga mga tawo; kundi ayaw niyo gamita an iyo katalwasan nga pasangilan hin pagbuhat hin maraot, kundi pag-ukoy kamo sugad hin mga oripon han Dyos.
en: Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as God’s slaves.

war: Tahora an ngatanan nga mga tawo, higugmaa an iyo igkasi mga magtinuohon, kahadloki an Dyos, ngan tahora niyo an Emperador.
en: Show proper respect to everyone, love the family of believers, fear God, honor the emperor.

war: Pagpapakaupayon kamo han Dyos tungod hini, kon makailob kamo han mga pag-antos nga diri angay ha iyo kay maaram man kamo han iya kaburot-on.
en: For it is commendable if someone bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because they are conscious of God.

war: Gintawag kamo han Dyos tungod hini; kay nag-antos hi Cristo ngahaw tungod ha iyo, ngan ginbilinan kamo hin susbaranan, basi magsubad kamo ha iya.
en: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.

war: Waray hiya makasala ngan waray gud hiya magbuwa.
en: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth.”

war: Han pagpakaraota ha iya waray hiya bumulos; han pag-antos niya waray hiya manarhog, kundi naglaom la hiya han Dyos, an matadong nga Maghurukom.
en: When they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly.

war: Didto ha kros an aton mga sala gindara ni Cristo ha iya lawas, basi mamatay kita dida han sala ngan mabuhi kita nga matadong. Pinaagi han iya mga kasamdan nagkauupay kamo.
en: “He himself bore our sins” in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; “by his wounds you have been healed.”

war: Sugad kamo hin nagkawawara nga mga karnero; kundi yana iginbalik na kamo hin pagsunod han Magmarangno ngan Magbarantay han iyo mga kalag.
en: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

war: kay makita hira han kaputli ngan kabaraan han iyo kinabuhi.
en: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.

war: Kinahanglan an iyo kahusay diri ha gawas la nga rayandayan, sugad han pag-ayad han iyo buhok, o pagsul-ot hin mga alahas ngan mahal nga mga panapton.
en: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as elaborate hairstyles and the wearing of gold jewelry or fine clothes.

war: Lugod, tinguhaa an kahusay nga natikang ha sakob han iyo kinabuhi—an waray paglubad nga katahom hin malumo ngan mahilomon nga kinabuhi. Amo ini an gimamahali ha atubangan han Dyos.
en: Rather, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God’s sight.

war: Kay hin sugad nga paagi an mainampoon nga kababayen-an nga naglaom han Dyos han una nga panahon nagpahusay han ira kalugaringon, pinaagi hin pagpasakop nira han ira mga bana.
en: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to adorn themselves. They submitted themselves to their own husbands,

war: Amo man ini hi Sara; nagsugot hiya kan Abraham ngan nagtawag ha iya “Agaron ko.” Mga anak nga kababayen-an kamo niya yana kon magbuhat kamo hin mag-upay ngan diri kamo mahadlok hin bisan ano.
en: like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her lord. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not give way to fear.

war: Ha pagtapus: kinahanglan magkaada kamo hin pagkausa ha hunahuna ngan ha pagbati; maghigugmaay kamo sugad hin magburugto, ngan magmaloloy-on ngan magmapinaubsanon kamo nga duha.
en: Finally, all of you, be like-minded, be sympathetic, love one another, be compassionate and humble.

war: Ayaw bulsa an karat-an hin karat-an, o an pakaraot, hin pakaraot; kundi balosa hin kaupayan, kay kaupayan an iginsaad han Dyos han pagtawga niya ha iyo.
en: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult. On the contrary, repay evil with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan: “An karuyag magpahimulos han kinabuhi ngan karuyag kumita hin maupay nga mga panahon, kinahanglan diri na magyakan hin maraot, ngan umundang na pagbinuwa.
en: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from deceitful speech.

war: Kinahanglan bumaya hiya han maraot ngan magbuhat hin maupay; kinahanglan pangitaon niya an kalinaw ngan iya ini sundon.
en: They must turn from evil and do good; they must seek peace and pursue it.

war: Kay an Ginoo nagbabantay han mga magtadong, ngan dayuday pinamamatian an ira mga pag-ampo; kundi nasupak hiya han mga nagbubuhat hin maraot.”
en: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

war: Hin-o in maglalabot ha iyo kon tinguha niyo an pagbuhat hin maupay?
en: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?

war: Kundi bisan kon mag-antos kamo tungod hin pagbuhat hin maupay, pagkapalaran niyo! Ayaw kamo kahadlok han mga tawo, ngan ayaw kabaraka.
en: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear their threats ; do not be frightened.”

war: Kay mauruupay an pag-antos tungod hin pagbuhat hin maupay, kon amo an kaburot-on han Dyos, kay hin pagbuhat hin maraot.
en: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

war: ngan ha iya espirituhanon nga kahimtang kinmadto ngan nagwali hiya han mga binilanggo nga mga espiritu.
en: After being made alive, he went and made proclamation to the imprisoned spirits—

war: nga kinmadto na ha langit ngan aadto na ha tuo han Dyos, nga naghahadi na han ngatanan nga mga anghel ngan langitnon nga mga kagamhanan.
en: who has gone into heaven and is at God’s right hand—with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.

war: Tungod nga lawasnon nga pag-antos an gin-antos ni Cristo, kinahanglan maandam liwat kamo hin pag-antos; kay an hin-o man nga nag-aantos dinhe hini nga kinabuhi binmaya na hin pagpakasala.
en: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because whoever suffers in the body is done with sin.

war: Sanglit tikang yana, kinahanglan gamiton na niyo an salin han iyo tunan-on nga kinabuhi hin pagbuhat han kaburot-on han Dyos, diri han mga ungara hin tawo.
en: As a result, they do not live the rest of their earthly lives for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.

war: Ngan yana nahigugupong an mga diri natoo han Dyos nga diri na kamo naungay ha ira dida hin pagpatuyang han mahilas ngan waray pulos nga kinabuhi, sanglit ginyuyubit kamo nira.
en: They are surprised that you do not join them in their reckless, wild living, and they heap abuse on you.

war: Kundi mahatag hira sa Dyos hin katuhayan nga andam paghukom han mga buhi ngan han mga minatay.
en: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

war: Hiraniay na an kataposan han ngatanan nga mga butang. Kinahanglan mag-ikmat ngan magpugong kamo han iyo kalugaringon, basi makag-ampo kamo.
en: The end of all things is near. Therefore be alert and of sober mind so that you may pray.

war: Labaw han ngatanan, paghigugmaay kamo hin tinuod, kay natahob hin damo nga mga sala an gugma.
en: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

war: Pasak-a an makada ha iyo mga panimalay, hin waray pagngurutob.
en: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.

war: Hinigugma ko nga kasangkayan, ayaw hipausa han mapait nga pagsulay nga iyo gin-aantos, sugad nga talagsaon nga hinabo ha iyo.
en: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.

war: Lugod paglipay kamo nga nakakaangbit kamo han mga pag-antos ni Cristo, basi magmalipayon kamo kon ipadayag na an iya himaya.
en: But rejoice inasmuch as you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.

war: Palaran kamo kon pagyubiton kamo tungod kay mga sumusunod kamo ni Cristo; karuyag sidngon hini nga aada ha iyo an mahimayaon nga Espiritu, an Espiritu han Dyos.
en: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

war: Kon may-ada ha iyo mag-antos, diri tungod kay hiya parapatay hin tawo, o kawatan, o kriminal o makimasamok, o malabot han butang han iba.
en: If you suffer, it should not be as a murderer or thief or any other kind of criminal, or even as a meddler.

war: Kundi kon may mag-antos tungod han iya pagka-Cristiano, diri hiya maawod, kundi magpasalamat han Dyos nga nagdadara hiya han ngaran ni Cristo.
en: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.

war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan, “Makuri matalwas adton mag-upay nga mga tawo; sanglit ano man an mahinanabo hadton mga diri natoo han Dyos ngan makasasala?”
en: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”

war: Ayaw pagpakaladnganan ha ira mga igintapod ha iyo, kundi magin susbaranan kamo han panon.
en: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

war: Ngan kon magpadayag na an Labaw nga Magmarangno, makarawat kamo han mahimayaon nga pudongpudong nga diri malubad.
en: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

war: Sanglit pagpaubos kamo ha ubos han gahom han Dyos, basi pahitas-on kamo niya kon umabot na an iya iginsaad nga panahon.
en: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

war: Itubyan ha iya an ngatanan niyo nga mga kasungkuan, kay napaid hiya ha iyo.
en: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

war: Pag-ikmat ngan pagtagam kamo! Naglilibot-libot an Yawa nga iyo kaaway, sugad hin nagngungurob nga liyon nga nangingita hin iya tutukbon.
en: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.

war: Rig-ona an iyo pagtoo ngan atohi hiya, kay sayod kamo nga nag-aagi liwat hin amo ngahaw nga mga pag-antos an iyo igkasi mga magtinuohon ha bug-os nga kalibutan.
en: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is undergoing the same kind of sufferings.

war: Ha iya an gahom ha kadayonan! Amen.
en: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.

war: Nangungumosta ha iyo an iyo bugto nga singbahan ha Babilonia, nga pinili liwat han Dyos, ngan nangungumosta man hi Marcos nga akon anak.
en: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.

war: Pagharokay kamo hin Cristohanon nga paghigugma. Maada unta an kamurayaw ha iyo ngatanan nga sakop ni Cristo.
en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

war: May duha nga asawa ni Elcana, hira Ana ug Fenena. May mga anak hi Fenena, kundi waray hi Ana.
en: He had two wives; one was called Hannah and the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.

war: Kada paghalad ni Elcana, binabahinan niya hi Fenena ug an iya mga anak.
en: Whenever the day came for Elkanah to sacrifice, he would give portions of the meat to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.

war: Ngan bisan kon labis an iya paghigugma kan Ana, tinatagan niya hin usa la ka bahin, kay pagbuot man han Ginoo nga diri hiya mag-anak.
en: But to Hannah he gave a double portion because he loved her, and the Lord had closed her womb.

war: Masukot hiya pagtamayon ug pagpakaalohan ni Fenena, kay ginhimo hiya nga baw-as han Ginoo .
en: Because the Lord had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival kept provoking her in order to irritate her.

war: Nagpadayon ini tuigtuig; kada pagkakadto nira han balay han Ginoo , duro gud an pagpinaantosa ni Fenena kan Ana nga nagtatangis nala hiya ngan diri gud nakaon.
en: This went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the Lord , her rival provoked her till she wept and would not eat.

war: Naiha an pag-inampoon ni Ana ngadto han Ginoo ngan gin-ininaw ni Eli an iya mga im-im.
en: As she kept on praying to the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.

war: Hilom la an iya pag-ampo; nagkikiwa an iya mga im-im, kundi waray niya tingog nga hinbabatian. Sanglit nakahunahuna hi Eli nga hubog hi Ana,
en: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk

war: ngan ginsiring hiya, “Ayaw na pagpakahubog! Ayaw na pag-ininom ngan upaya na an imo panhunahuna!”
en: and said to her, “How long are you going to stay drunk? Put away your wine.”

war: Ayaw pakasiring nga maraot ako nga babaye. Nag-inampo ako hin sugad hini kay makalolooy an akon kahimtang.”
en: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief.”

war: Nagsiring hi Eli, “Lakat nga malinawon; ayaw na kaguol. Tagan ka unta han Dyos han Israel han imo pinangaro ha iya.”
en: Eli answered, “Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him.”

war: Binmaton hiya, “Magmaloloy-on ka unta ha akon.” Niyan linmakat hiya, kinmaon, ngan waray na pagmabidoon.
en: She said, “May your servant find favor in your eyes.” Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.

war: Nagburod hi Ana ngan nag-anak hin lalake. Iya ginngaranan nga Samuel, kay siring pa niya, “Gin-aro ko hiya han Ginoo .”
en: So in the course of time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, “Because I asked the Lord for him.”

war: Inmabot na liwat an turno ni Elcana ngan han iya panimalay hin pagkadto ha Silo hin paghalad ngadto han Ginoo han tinuig nga halad nga iya saad.
en: When her husband Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the Lord and to fulfill his vow,

war: Katapos pag-ihawa han baka, ira gindara an bata ngadto kan Eli.
en: When the bull had been sacrificed, they brought the boy to Eli,

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Ana, “Patabia daw ako; nahinumdom ka ba ha akon? Amo ako an babaye nga imo hinkit-an nga natindog dinhe, nga nag-inampo ngadto han Ginoo .
en: and she said to him, “Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the Lord .

war: Pinangaro ko ha iya ini nga bata, ngan pinamatian niya an akon pinangaro.
en: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.

war: Sanglit iginhahalad ko hiya han Ginoo . Samtang buhi pa hiya, magaalagad hiya han Ginoo .” Ngan didto nagsingba hira han Ginoo .
en: So now I give him to the Lord . For his whole life he will be given over to the Lord .” And he worshiped the Lord there.

war: “Waray tawo nga baraan nga sugad han Ginoo ; waray gud sugad ha iya, waray darangpan nga sugad han aton Dyos.
en: “There is no one holy like the Lord ; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

war: Hunonga na an iyo duro nga paghinambog; hiloma na an iyo mapinahitas-on nga mga pulong. Kay an Ginoo amo in usa nga Dyos nga maaram, ngan naghuhukom hiya han ngatanan nga buhat han mga tawo.
en: “Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.

war: Nababari an mga pana han kusgan nga mga sondalo, kundi nagmamakusog an mga magluya.
en: “The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.

war: Makakahimo an Ginoo hin pagpatay ngan hin paghatag liwat kinabuhi; pinapakadto niya an mga tawo ha kalibutan han mga patay, ngan ginkukuha liwat niya.
en: “The Lord brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.

war: Itinugot niya nga mapobre in pira nga mga tawo ngan mariko an iba; nga magpaubos in pipira ngan magamhanan an iba.
en: The Lord sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.

war: “Pinananalipdan niya an matinumanon nga mga tawo, kundi naaanaw ha kasisidman an mga magraot diri nagdadaog in tawo pinaagi han iya kalugaringon nga kusog.
en: He will guard the feet of his faithful servants, but the wicked will be silenced in the place of darkness. “It is not by strength that one prevails;

war: Katapos inmoli hi Elcana ngadto ha Rama; kundi pinmabilin an bata nga hi Samuel didto ha Silo, ngan nag-alagad hiya han Ginoo ha ubos han pagdumara ni Eli nga padi.
en: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the Lord under Eli the priest.

war: Mga bugoy an mga anak ni Eli. Waray nira pagtahod han Ginoo
en: Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they had no regard for the Lord .

war: Makalilisang ini nga sala han mga anak ni Eli ha atubangan han Ginoo , kay waray gud nira pagtahod han mga halad ngadto han Ginoo .
en: This sin of the young men was very great in the Lord ’s sight, for they were treating the Lord ’s offering with contempt.

war: Hini ngahaw nga panahon nagpadayon an bata nga Samuel hin pag-alagad han Ginoo nga nakakasul-ot hin usa nga sagrado nga lino nga tapis.
en: But Samuel was ministering before the Lord —a boy wearing a linen ephod.

war: Kada tuig naghihimo an iroy niya hin gutiay nga bado nga hilawig ngan gindadara ini niya ngadto kan Samuel kon naupod hiya han iya bana hin pagtuman han tinuig nga paghalad.
en: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

war: Ginpakaupay manggud han Ginoo hi Ana, ngan nag-anak hiya hin tulo pa nga kalalaken-an ngan hin duha nga kababayen-an. Tinmubo hi Samuel dida ha pag-alagad han Ginoo .
en: And the Lord was gracious to Hannah; she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .

war: Sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga iyo ginbubuhat ini nga mga butang? Nagsusumat ha akon an ngatanan hiunong han magraot nga iyo ginbubuhat.
en: So he said to them, “Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.

war: Ayaw na niyo pagbuhata ini, mga anak ko! Uraura ini hin kamaraot nga ginyiyinakan han mga tawo han Ginoo .
en: No, my sons; the report I hear spreading among the Lord ’s people is not good.

war: Nagpadayon hin pagtubo an bata nga Samuel ngan nakalipay gud hiya han Ginoo ngan han mga tawo.
en: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.

war: Pamati, maabot an panahon nga pamamatayon ko an ngatanan nga batan-on nga kalalaken-an han imo panimalay ngan han imo banay, basi waray lalake han imo panimalay nga malalagas.
en: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your priestly house, so that no one in it will reach old age,

war: Sasamokon ka ngan maaawa ka han ngatanan nga mga kaupayan nga akon ighahatag han iba nga mga tawo han Israel, kundi waray na malalagas dida han imo panimalay.
en: and you will see distress in my dwelling. Although good will be done to Israel, no one in your family line will ever reach old age.

war: Kon mamatay na ha amo ngahaw nga adlaw hi Ofni ug Pinehas nga imo duha nga anak magpapakita ini ha imo nga matutuman an ngatanan nga akon iginyakan.
en: “ ‘And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you—they will both die on the same day.

war: Usa ka gab-i hi Eli nga haros buta na nakaturog didto han iya kalugaringon nga kwarto;
en: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.

war: nakaturog man hi Samuel didto ha balay han Ginoo diin nakadto an baraan nga Kahon han Ginsaaran. Han maagahon pa, samtang naglalaga pa an pakaagahan nga suga,
en: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the house of the Lord , where the ark of God was.

war: nagtawag an Ginoo kan Samuel. Binmaton hiya, “Aadi ako!”
en: Then the Lord called Samuel. Samuel answered, “Here I am.”

war: Inmabot an Ginoo ngan tinmindog hiya didto, ngan nagtawag sugad han una, “Samuel! Samuel!” Binmaton hi Samuel, “Pagyakan; namamati an imo surugoon.”
en: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak, for your servant is listening.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “May adlaw nga may-ada ko makalilisang nga pagbubuhaton han mga tawo han Israel, nga mahahadlok gud an ngatanan nga makakabati hini.
en: And the Lord said to Samuel: “See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears about it tingle.

war: Dida hito nga adlaw tutumanon ko an ngatanan nakon nga mga pagtarhog kontra han panimalay ni Eli tikang ha tinikangan ngadto ha kataposan.
en: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family—from beginning to end.

war: Sanglit iginsumpa ko ini han panimalay ni Eli nga waray gud halad nga tinubod o bisan ano nga halad nga makakapara han mga lara hini nga makalilisang nga sala.”
en: Therefore I swore to the house of Eli, ‘The guilt of Eli’s house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ ”

war: Naghinigda hi Samuel ngada han pagkaaga; niyan binmuhat hiya ngan gin-abrehan niya an mga porta han balay han Ginoo . Nahadlok hiya hin pagsumat kan Eli mahitungod han panan-awon.
en: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the Lord . He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,

war: Gintawag hiya ni Eli, “Samuel, anak ko!” “Aadi ako,” binmaton hi Samuel.
en: but Eli called him and said, “Samuel, my son.” Samuel answered, “Here I am.”

war: Sanglit iginsumat ha iya ni Samuel an ngatanan; waray gud niya iginlirong nga bisan ano. Nagsiring hi Eli, “Amo hiya an Ginoo ; tutumanon niya an bisan ano nga maupay gud buhaton niya.”
en: So Samuel told him everything, hiding nothing from him. Then Eli said, “He is the Lord ; let him do what is good in his eyes.”

war: Samtang nagtubo hi Samuel, kaupod niya an Ginoo , ngan gintuman niya an ngatanan nga iginyakan ni Samuel.
en: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.

war: Sanglit nahibaro an ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel, tikang ha usa nga kataposan han tuna ngadto ha luyo, nga tinuod gud nga hi Samuel usa nga manaragna han Ginoo .
en: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the Lord .

war: Nagpadayon an Ginoo hin pagpadayag didto ha Silo, diin pinmakita ngan naghimangraw hiya kan Samuel. Ngan an ginhimangraw ni Samuel nahisangyaw ha bug-os nga Israel.
en: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.

war: Sinmulong an mga Filisteohanon, ngan katapos hin mapintas nga araway napirde nira an mga Israelita, ngan pinamatay nira in mga upat ka yukot ka tawo didto ha pag-awayan.
en: The Philistines deployed their forces to meet Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand of them on the battlefield.

war: Han pag-abot na han Kahon han Ginsaaran, naggogliat an mga Israelita, nag-aningal an ira tingog nga nabay-og an tuna.
en: When the ark of the Lord ’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.

war: nagkahahadlok hira ngan nagsiring, “Inmabot in usa nga diyos ngadto han ira kampo! Pirde na kita! Waray pa gud mahinabo ha aton in sugad hini!
en: the Philistines were afraid. “A god has come into the camp,” they said. “Oh no! Nothing like this has happened before.

war: Naagaw an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo , ngan pinamatay hira Ofni ug Pinehas nga mga anak ni Eli.
en: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.

war: Han pakabati ni Eli han aringasa, nagpakiana hiya, “Ano ini nga aringasa?” Nagdagmit an tawo ngadto kan Eli ngan ginsumatan hiya. (
en: Eli heard the outcry and asked, “What is the meaning of this uproar?” The man hurried over to Eli,

war: Hi Eli hini nga panahon 98 na an panuigon ngan haros buta na gud hiya.)
en: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes had failed so that he could not see.

war: Nagsiring an tawo, “Kinmalagiw ako ha pag-awayan ngan nagdinalagan la ako nganhi yana nga adlaw.” Nagpakiana ha iya hi Eli, “Ano man an nahinabo, anak ko?”
en: He told Eli, “I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day.” Eli asked, “What happened, my son?”

war: Han tikamaratay na hiya, ginsiring hiya han kababayen-an nga binmulig ha iya hin pagpaanak, “Ayaw kahadlok! May-ada ka na usa nga lalake!” Kundi waray la hiya mamati ngan waray bumaton.
en: As she was dying, the women attending her said, “Don’t despair; you have given birth to a son.” But she did not respond or pay any attention.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Binmaya na han Israel an himaya han Dyos, kay naagaw na an kanan Dyos Kahon han Ginsaaran.”
en: She said, “The Glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured.”

war: Katapos mabihag han mga Filisteohanon an Kahon han Ginsaaran, gindara ini nira tikang ha Ebenezer ngadto han ira syudad han Asdod.
en: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

war: Iginsulod ini nira han templo han ira diyos nga hi Dagon, ngan igintupad ini han ladawan ni Dagon.
en: Then they carried the ark into Dagon’s temple and set it beside Dagon.

war: Amo ito nga bisan yana nga adlaw linalakdan la ito nga dapit han kapadian ni Dagon ngan han ngatanan nga iya mga maniringba didto ha Asdod ngan diri gud hira natamak hito nga dapit.)
en: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon’s temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.

war: Ginkastigo han Ginoo an mga tawo han Asdod ngan iya ginhadlok hira. Iya ginkastigo hira ngan an mga tawo nga naukoy han higrani nga katunaan ngan pinapag-antos hira pinaagi hin mga hubag.
en: The Lord ’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity; he brought devastation on them and afflicted them with tumors.

war: Nagkamay-ada mga hubag bisan adton waray magkamamatay ngan naggogliat an mga tawo ha ira kadiyosan pangaro hin bulig.
en: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.

war: Katapos hin pito ka bulan nga nakadto ha Filistia an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo ,
en: When the ark of the Lord had been in Philistine territory seven months,

war: Gintuman nira an iginsiring ha ira: kinmuha hira hin duha nga baka ngan iginsangat ini ha karomata, ngan ginsadhan an mga nati didto han kamalig.
en: So they did this. They took two such cows and hitched them to the cart and penned up their calves.

war: Iginkarga nira an Kahon han Ginsaaran dida han karomata, upod an kahon nga ginsusudlan han bulawan nga mga modelo han mga yatot ngan mga hubag.
en: They placed the ark of the Lord on the cart and along with it the chest containing the gold rats and the models of the tumors.

war: Nag-aani hin trigo an mga tawo han Betsemes didto han kahamub-an ngan ha gilayon ira hinkit-an an Kahon han Ginsaaran, ngan tugob hira hin kalipay tungod han ira hinkit-an.
en: Now the people of Beth Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they rejoiced at the sight.

war: Kahuman nagkinita an lima nga kahadian nga Filisteohanon ngan inmoli hira ha Ekron hito ngahaw nga adlaw.
en: The five rulers of the Philistines saw all this and then returned that same day to Ekron.

war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga tawo han Betsemes, “Hin-o in makakatindog ha atubangan han Ginoo , hini nga baraan nga Dyos? Ngain ta hiya dadad-a basi mahibulag hiya ha aton?”
en: And the people of Beth Shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the Lord , this holy God? To whom will the ark go up from here?”

war: Nagpadara hira hin mga surugoon ngadto han mga tawo han Kiriat Jearim hin pagsiring, “Igin-uli na han mga Filisteohanon an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo . Lugsong kamo ngan kuhaa niyo ini.”
en: Then they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the Lord . Come down and take it up to your town.”

war: Didto an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo ha Kiriat Jearim mga kapin hin 20 ka tuig. Sulod hini nga panahon nag-ampo an ngatanan nga mga Israelita hin pakibulig han Ginoo .
en: The ark remained at Kiriath Jearim a long time—twenty years in all. Then all the people of Israel turned back to the Lord .

war: Sanglit iginsalikway han mga Israelita an ira mga diyosdiyos nga Baal ug Astarte, ngan an Ginoo an ira ginsingba.
en: So the Israelites put away their Baals and Ashtoreths, and served the Lord only.

war: Niyan pinakadto ha Mispa ni Samuel an ngatanan nga Israelita, ngan ginsiring hira, “Mag-aampo ako han Ginoo didto para ha iyo.”
en: Then Samuel said, “Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will intercede with the Lord for you.”

war: ngan ginsiring nira hi Samuel, “Ipadayon an imo pag-ampo han Ginoo nga aton Dyos basi talwason kita ha mga Filisteohanon.”
en: They said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the Lord our God for us, that he may rescue us from the hand of the Philistines.”

war: Nagkagawas an mga Israelita tikang ha Mispa ngan ginlanat nira an mga Filisteohanon tubtob ha Bitcar, ngan ira pinanmatay hira dida han dalan.
en: The men of Israel rushed out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, slaughtering them along the way to a point below Beth Kar.

war: Sanglit napirde an mga Filisteohanon, ngan waray itugot han Ginoo nga sulongon nira an katunaan han Israel samtang buhi pa hi Samuel.
en: So the Philistines were subdued and they stopped invading Israel’s territory. Throughout Samuel’s lifetime, the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines.

war: Namunoan han Israel hi Samuel samtang buhi pa hiya.
en: Samuel continued as Israel’s leader all the days of his life.

war: Kada tuig napakadto hiya ha Betel, Gilgal, ug Mispa, ngan didto hini nga mga dapit gintutuhay niya an mga kalipongan.
en: From year to year he went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.

war: Niyan, nauli hiya ngadto ha Rama, diin usa hiya nga maghurukom han mga Israelita. Didto ha Rama nagtindog hiya hin usa nga altar para han Ginoo .
en: But he always went back to Ramah, where his home was, and there he also held court for Israel. And he built an altar there to the Lord .

war: Han tigurang na hi Samuel, ginhimo niya an iya mga anak nga mga maghurukom didto ha Israel.
en: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as Israel’s leaders.

war: Joel an ngaran han magurang nga anak ngan Abia an manghod; mga maghurukom hira didto ha Berseba.
en: The name of his firstborn was Joel and the name of his second was Abijah, and they served at Beersheba.

war: Kundi waray hira magsunod han mga susbaran han ira amay; asay la nira tuyo an panalapi, sanglit nakarawat hira hin mga hukip, ngan diri hira taptap magtuhay hin mga kalipongan.
en: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain and accepted bribes and perverted justice.

war: Niyan nagtirok an ngatanan nga mga pangulo han Israel, kinmadto hira kan Samuel didto ha Rama,
en: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.

war: Nakabido kan Samuel an ira pangaro hin hadi; sanglit nag-ampo hiya han Ginoo ,
en: But when they said, “Give us a king to lead us,” this displeased Samuel; so he prayed to the Lord .

war: ngan nagsiring an Ginoo , “Pamatii an ngatanan nga pinangaro ha imo han mga tawo. Diri ikaw an ira ginsasalikway kundi hi ako.
en: And the Lord told him: “Listen to all that the people are saying to you; it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected me as their king.

war: Sanglit pamatii hira, kundi pahimatngoni gud hira hin maupay ngan pagsaysayi hira kon uunanhon han ira kahadian hin pagdumara ha ira.”
en: Now listen to them; but warn them solemnly and let them know what the king who will reign over them will claim as his rights.”

war: An ngatanan nga tugon ha iya han Ginoo iginsumat ni Samuel ngadto han mga tawo nga naaro ha iya hin hadi.
en: Samuel told all the words of the Lord to the people who were asking him for a king.

war: Maghihimo an iyo mga anak nga kababayen-an hin iya mga pahamot, ngan magbubuhat nga iya mga paraluto ngan mga parahudno.
en: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.

war: Kukuhaon niya an iyo gimamag-upayi nga mga uma, mga urubasan, ngan mga kaolibohan, ngan ighahatag ini niya ngadto han iya mga opisyal.
en: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his attendants.

war: Kukuhaon niya an ikanapulo nga bahin han iyo mga pagkaon ngan han iyo mga ubas para han iya mga opisyal han palasyo ngan iba pa nga mga opisyal.
en: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your vintage and give it to his officials and attendants.

war: Kukuhaon niya an iyo mga surugoon, ngan an iyo gimamag-upayi nga kabakahan ngan kaasnohan, ngan magbubuhat ini hira para ha iya.
en: Your male and female servants and the best of your cattle and donkeys he will take for his own use.

war: Kukuhaon niya ha iyo an ikanapulo nga bahin han iyo mga panon, ngan mahihimo kamo ngahaw nga iya mga oripon.
en: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.

war: Kon umabot na ito nga panahon, mangurutob kamo tungod han iyo hadi nga kamo ngahaw an nagpili, kundi diri pamamatian han Ginoo an iyo mga sumbong.”
en: When that day comes, you will cry out for relief from the king you have chosen, but the Lord will not answer you in that day.”

war: Waray la bumali kan Samuel an mga tawo, kundi nagsiring hira, “Diri! Karuyag gud namon in usa nga hadi,
en: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. “No!” they said. “We want a king over us.

war: basi masugad kami han iba nga mga nasod, nga may-ada namon kalugaringon nga hadi nga mamumuno ha amon, ngan mangungulo ha amon ha pag-awayan.”
en: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to lead us and to go out before us and fight our battles.”

war: Pinamatian ni Samuel an ngatanan nga ira iginsiring ngan linmakat hiya ngan ginsumatan niya an Ginoo .
en: When Samuel heard all that the people said, he repeated it before the Lord .

war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “Buhata an ira karuyag ngan tagi hira hin usa nga hadi.” Katapos ginpaoli ni Samuel an ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel.
en: The Lord answered, “Listen to them and give them a king.” Then Samuel said to the Israelites, “Everyone go back to your own town.”

war: Nagsarang in mga asno ni Cis, sanglit nagsiring hiya kan Saul, “Paupda ha imo in usa han mga surugoon ngan pamilnga an mga asno.”
en: Now the donkeys belonging to Saul’s father Kish were lost, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants with you and go and look for the donkeys.”

war: Binmaton an surugoon, “May-ada ako usa nga sensilyo nga salapi. Ihahatag ko ini ha iya, ngan susumatan kita niya kon hain ta hiaagii ini.”
en: The servant answered him again. “Look,” he said, “I have a quarter of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God so that he will tell us what way to take.”

war: Dida han adlaw han waray pa aabot hi Saul, nagsiring na an Ginoo kan Samuel,
en: Now the day before Saul came, the Lord had revealed this to Samuel:

war: Han paghikit-i ni Samuel kan Saul, nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Amo ini an tawo nga akon iginsumat ha imo. Hiya an maghahadi han akon mga tawo.”
en: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the Lord said to him, “This is the man I spoke to you about; he will govern my people.”

war: Niyan gindaop ni Saul hi Samuel nga nakada hirani han ganghaan, ngan nagpakiana hiya “Sumati daw ako, hain ba pag-uokoy an paratigo?”
en: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”

war: Nagsiring hi Samuel han paraluto, “Dad-a ngadi an karne nga akon iginpalain ha imo hin pagluto.”
en: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the piece of meat I gave you, the one I told you to lay aside.”

war: Linmugsong hira ngadto han bungto tikang han dapit hin pagsingba. Gin-andaman nira hi Saul hin higdaan didto han atop,
en: After they came down from the high place to the town, Samuel talked with Saul on the roof of his house.

war: ngan didto hiya kinmaturog. Han maagahon pa gintawag ni Samuel hi Saul, “Bangon na. Magpapagikan ako ha imo.” Binmangon hi Saul, ngan nagbunyog hira nga duha ngadto han kalsada.
en: They rose about daybreak, and Samuel called to Saul on the roof, “Get ready, and I will send you on your way.” When Saul got ready, he and Samuel went outside together.

war: Makikighimangraw hira ha imo ngan ihahatag ha imo in duha ka bug-os nga tinapay ngan imo ini kakarawton.
en: They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from them.

war: Ha gilayon gagamhan ka han espiritu han Ginoo , ngan maapi ka han ira sarayaw ngan gogliat, ngan maiiba ka na nga tawo.
en: The Spirit of the Lord will come powerfully upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be changed into a different person.

war: Kon mahinabo na ini nga mga butang, buhata an bisan ano nga ipapagbuhat ha imo han Dyos.
en: Once these signs are fulfilled, do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.

war: Han pagbaya na ni Saul kan Samuel, ginbag-o han Dyos an kasingkasing ni Saul. Ngan nahinabo hito nga adlaw an ngatanan nga iginsumat ha iya ni Samuel.
en: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul’s heart, and all these signs were fulfilled that day.

war: Han pag-abot na ha Gabaa ni Saul ngan han iya surugoon, gintapo hiya hin usa ka hugpo hin mga manaragna. Ha gilayon gingamhan hiya han espiritu han Dyos ngan nanagna hiya upod ha ira.
en: When he and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a procession of prophets met him; the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he joined in their prophesying.

war: Han katapos ni Saul hin pagpanagna, kinmadto hiya han altar didto han pungtod.
en: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the high place.

war: Pinmakiana an bata ni Saul, “Ngan ano man an iya iginsumat ha iyo?”
en: Saul’s uncle said, “Tell me what Samuel said to you.”

war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Ginsumatan kami nga hin-agian na an mga hayop,”—kundi waray niya pagsumati an iya bata han iginsiring ni Samuel hiunong han iya pagkahimo nga hadi.
en: Saul replied, “He assured us that the donkeys had been found.” But he did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.

war: Gintawag ni Samuel an mga tawo didto ha Mispa basi magtirok ha atubangan han Ginoo,
en: Samuel summoned the people of Israel to the Lord at Mizpah

war: Niyan ginpadaop ni Samuel an kada tribo, ngan ginpili han Ginoo an tribo ni Benjamin.
en: When Samuel had all Israel come forward by tribes, the tribe of Benjamin was taken by lot.

war: nagpakiana hira han Ginoo , “May-ada pa ba iba?” Binmaton an Ginoo , “Aadto hi Saul, natago ha luyo han mga pinutos.”
en: So they inquired further of the Lord , “Has the man come here yet?” And the Lord said, “Yes, he has hidden himself among the supplies.”

war: Sanglit nagdadlagan hira ngan ira gindara hi Saul ha atubangan han mga tawo. Ngan han pagtukdaw, dayag kaupay nga hitaas hiya kay an iba tubtob la ha iya sugbong.
en: They ran and brought him out, and as he stood among the people he was a head taller than any of the others.

war: Nagsiring hi Samuel han mga tawo, “Iini an tawo nga ginpili han Ginoo ! Waray gud usa dinhe ha aton nga masugad ha iya!” Nanggogliat an ngatanan nga mga tawo, “Mabuhi an hadi!”
en: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see the man the Lord has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.” Then the people shouted, “Long live the king!”

war: Inmoli liwat hi Saul ngadto ha Gabaa. Binmunyog ha iya in pipira nga gamhanan nga mga tawo kanay mga kasingkasing ginbantad han Ginoo .
en: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, accompanied by valiant men whose hearts God had touched.

war: Inmabot an mga surugoon ha Gabaa diin nag-ukoy hi Saul. Han pagsumati nira han mga tawo hiunong han nahinabo, nagtangis hira tungod hin kahulop.
en: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and reported these terms to the people, they all wept aloud.

war: Han pakabati hini ni Saul, napakada ha iya an espiritu han Dyos, ngan duro gud an iya kasina.
en: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he burned with anger.

war: Gintirok hira ni Saul didto ha Bezek: may-ada 300,000 tikang ha Israel ngan 30,000 tikang ha Juda.
en: When Saul mustered them at Bezek, the men of Israel numbered three hundred thousand and those of Judah thirty thousand.

war: ngan nagsiring hira kan Nahas, “Buwas matubyan kami ha imo, ngan buhata an imo karuyag ha amon.”
en: They said to the Ammonites, “Tomorrow we will surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you like.”

war: Niyan nagsiring an mga tawo han Israel kan Samuel, “Hain na an mga tawo nga nagsiring nga diri angay maghadi ha aton hi Saul? Igtubyan hira ha amon ngan pamamatayon namon hira.”
en: The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it that asked, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Turn these men over to us so that we may put them to death.”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Saul, “Waray tawo nga papatayon yana nga adlaw, kay amo ini an adlaw nga gintalwas han Ginoo an Israel.”
en: But Saul said, “No one will be put to death today, for this day the Lord has rescued Israel.”

war: Ngan nagsiring ha ira hi Samuel, “Pakadto kita ngatanan ha Gilgal ngan hin makausa pa igsangyaw ta hi Saul nga aton hadi.”
en: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingship.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Samuel han mga tawo han Israel, “Gintuman ko na an iyo ginhangyo ha akon. Iginhatag ko ha iyo in usa nga hadi nga mamumuno ha iyo,
en: Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to everything you said to me and have set a king over you.

war: Binmaton an mga tawo, “Waray ka maglimbong o magraogdaog ha amon, waray ka ginkuha ha amon nga bisan ano.”
en: “You have not cheated or oppressed us,” they replied. “You have not taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Samuel, “An Ginoo amo an nagpili kanda Moises ug Aaron, ngan amo hiya an nagdara han iyo kaapoy-apoyan tikang ha Ehipto.
en: Then Samuel said to the people, “It is the Lord who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your ancestors up out of Egypt.

war: Ngan ginpadara han Ginoo hi Gideon, sunod hi Barak, sunod hi Jefte, ngan ha kataposan hi ako. Gintalwas kamo namon ha iyo mga kaaway, ngan nag-ukoy kamo hin waray kataragman.
en: Then the Lord sent Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hands of your enemies all around you, so that you lived in safety.

war: “Yana iini na an hadi nga iyo ginpili; gin-aro hiya niyo, ngan yana iginhatag na hiya han Ginoo ngada ha iyo.
en: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you asked for; see, the Lord has set a king over you.

war: Sanglit tindog kamo dida han iyo hinmumutangan ngan makita kamo han magpaaramdok nga butang nga bubuhaton han Ginoo .
en: “Now then, stand still and see this great thing the Lord is about to do before your eyes!

war: Sanglit nag-ampo hi Samuel, ngan hito ngahaw nga adlaw nagpadara an Ginoo hin dalugdog ug uran. Niyan nahadlok an ngatanan nga mga tawo han Ginoo ngan kan Samuel,
en: Then Samuel called on the Lord , and that same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the Lord and of Samuel.

war: Ayaw na kamo pagsunod hin diri matuod nga kadiyosan; diri ini makakabulig o makakatalwas ha iyo, kay diri ini matuod.
en: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.

war: Nagsumpa an Ginoo nga diri kamo igsasalikway niya, kay naglarang na hiya hin paghimo ha iyo nga iya kalugaringon nga mga tawo.
en: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people, because the Lord was pleased to make you his own.

war: Sugta niyo an Ginoo ngan alagda hiya niyo nga matinumanon ngan ha bug-os nga kinasingkasing. Hinumdomi an dagko nga mga butang nga iya ginbuhat para ha iyo.
en: But be sure to fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.

war: Kundi kon magpadayon kamo hin pagpinakasala, pagpupuohon kamo ngan an iyo hadi.”
en: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will perish.”

war: tinmabok an iba han salog Jordan ngadto han katunaan han Gad ug Galaad. Nakadto pa hi Saul ha Gilgal. Nangungurog hin kahadlok an mga tawo nga kaupod niya.
en: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.

war: Naghinulat hiya kan Samuel sulod hin pito ka adlaw, sumala han tugon ni Samuel ha iya, kundi waray gihapon umabot hi Samuel ngadto ha Gilgal. Nagtikang na hin pagbaya kan Saul an mga tawo,
en: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul’s men began to scatter.

war: sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Dad-a niyo ngadi ha akon an mga halad nga tinubod ngan an mga halad hin pagkadait.” Naghalad hiya,
en: So he said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings.” And Saul offered up the burnt offering.

war: ngan han tikahuruman na hiya, inmabot hi Samuel. Ginmawas hi Saul hin pagtapo ha iya,
en: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.

war: Nagkampo hira Saul, Jonatan nga iya anak, ngan an iya mga tawo didto ha Geba, didto han katunaan ni Benjamin; nakadto ha Micmas an kampo han mga Filisteohanon.
en: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Mikmash.

war: Tikang han ira kampo sinmulong in tulo ka hugpo nga mga sondalo nga Filisteohanon; nagtipakadto an usa ka hugpo ha Ofra, didto han katunaan han Sual,
en: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,

war: nagtipakadto in lain nga hugpo ha Betoron, ngan an ikatulo nagtipakadto han pag-ultan nga natangbo han Kahamub-an han Zeboim ngan han kamingawan.
en: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboyim facing the wilderness.

war: Napakadto ha mga Filisteohanon an mga Israelita kon nagpapabaid hira han ira mga arado, mga piko, mga parakol, ngan mga garab;
en: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plow points, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.

war: usa la ka salapi an bayad hin pagbaid hin parakol ngan hin pag-ayad hin tugsok, ngan duha la ka salapi an bayad hin pagbaid hin arado o piko.)
en: The price was two-thirds of a shekel for sharpening plow points and mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening forks and axes and for repointing goads.

war: Nagpadara an mga Filisteohanon hin usa nga hugpo hin mga sondalo hin pagpanalipod han Aragian han Micmas.
en: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Mikmash.

war: nga nagkampo didto ha sirong hin kahoy nga granada ha Migron nga diri harayo tikang ha Gabaa; may upod niya nga mga 600 ka tawo.
en: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,

war: Nakadto an usa ha amihanan nga naatubang han Micmas, ngan an ikaduha ha timogan nga naatubang han Geba.
en: One cliff stood to the north toward Mikmash, the other to the south toward Geba.

war: Binmaton an batan-on, “Upod ako ha imo bisan ano an imo karuyag pagbuhaton.”
en: “Do all that you have in mind,” his armor-bearer said. “Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.”

war: “Maupay,” nagsiring hi Jonatan. “Matabok ngan mapakita kita han mga Filisteohanon.
en: Jonathan said, “Come on, then; we will cross over toward them and let them see us.

war: Kon pahulaton kita nira ngan dumaop hira ha aton, magpapabilin la kita dida han aton hinmumutangan.
en: If they say to us, ‘Wait there until we come to you,’ we will stay where we are and not go up to them.

war: Kundi kon padaopon kita nira, makadto kita, kay usa ini nga tigaman nga iginhatag ha aton han Ginoo an pagdarag-an kontra ha ira.”
en: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the Lord has given them into our hands.”

war: Dida hito nga syahan nga pamatay, mga baynte ka tawo an pinamatay nira Jonatan ngan han batan-on nga lalake, dida la hin haligutay la nga dapit.
en: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

war: Hinkit-an han nagbabantay nga mga tawo ni Saul didto ha Gabaa, didto han katunaan han Benjamin, nga nagdadalagan an mga Filisteohanon tungod hin kalisang.
en: Saul’s lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.

war: “Dad-a nganhi an efod,” ginsiring ni Saul hi Ahias nga padi. (Hito nga adlaw gindadara ini ni Ahias ha atubangan han mga tawo han Israel.)
en: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the ark of God.” (At that time it was with the Israelites.)

war: Niyan ginsulong niya ngan han iya mga tawo an mga Filisteohanon nga nag-uurugnay na hin pag-araway tungod han ira kalisang.
en: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.

war: May pipira nga mga Hebreo nga dapig anay han mga Filisteohanon nga yana binmunyog ha ira ngadto han kampo, nagbalhin ngahaw han ira pagdapig ngan tinmampo na liwat hira kanda Saul ug Jonatan.
en: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

war: Nakig-away gud hira unhan pa han Betaben. Gintalwas han Ginoo an Israel hito nga adlaw.
en: So on that day the Lord saved Israel, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.

war: Napasingadto hira ngatanan hin usa nga kagurangan ngan nakaagi hira hin dugos ha ngatanan nga dapit.
en: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.

war: Luob hin dugos an kagurangan, kundi waray tawo nga kinmaon hini kay nahadlok hira ngatanan han panhimaraot nga ginsiring ni Saul.
en: When they went into the woods, they saw the honey oozing out; yet no one put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.

war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Nakasamok la han mga tawo an ginbuhat han akon amay! Kitaa hin kamaupay na han akon pagbati nga kinmaon ako hin dugos!
en: Jonathan said, “My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.

war: Mauruupay pa gud unta kon kinmaon an aton mga tawo han pagkaon nga ira nakuha yana nga adlaw han pagpirdeha nira han kaaway. Hunahunaa daw damo pa unta nga mga Filisteohanon an ira mapapatay!”
en: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?”

war: Hito nga adlaw ginpirde han mga Israelita an mga Filisteohanon dida han ira pakig-away tikang ha Micmas ngadto ha Aiyalon. Hini nga takna magluya na hin duro tungod hin gutom an mga Israelita,
en: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Mikmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.

war: sanglit nag-aragaw hira pagkuha han ira natikas ha ira mga kaaway, kinmuha hira hin mga karnero ngan hin mga baka, gin-ihaw ini nira dayon, ngan ginkaon an karne nga may-ada pa dugo.
en: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.

war: Nagtindog hi Saul hin altar ngadto han Ginoo , syahan ini nga altar nga iya gintindog.
en: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first time he had done this.

war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi Saul han Dyos, “Susulongon ko ba an mga Filisteohanon? Padadag-on mo ba kami?” Kundi waray bumaton an Dyos hito nga adlaw.
en: So Saul asked God, “Shall I go down and pursue the Philistines? Will you give them into Israel’s hand?” But God did not answer him that day.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Saul han mga pangulo han mga tawo, “Kadi kamo ngan panginanoa ta kon ano nga sala an nabuhat yana nga adlaw.
en: Saul therefore said, “Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Saul, “Pilia kon hi ako ba o hi Jonatan nga akon anak.” Ngan hi Jonatan an salaan.
en: Saul said, “Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son.” And Jonathan was taken.

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Saul, “Patayon unta ako han Dyos kon diri ta ikaw patayon!”
en: Saul said, “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan.”

war: Katapos hito hinmunong hi Saul hin pagbukod han mga Filisteohanon, ngan inmoli hira ngadto han ira kalugaringon nga katunaan.
en: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.

war: Maisog hiya hin pakig-away ngan ginpirde niya an mga Amalekanhon. Gintalwas niya an mga Israelita tikang han ngatanan nga nagtikas ha ira.
en: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.

war: An iya asawa amo hi Ahinoam nga anak ni Ahimaas. An kapitan han iya kasondalohan amo hi Abner nga iya patod, nga anak ni Ner nga iya bata.
en: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of Saul’s army was Abner son of Ner, and Ner was Saul’s uncle.

war: Mga anak ni Abiel hira Cis nga amay ni Saul, ug Ner nga amay ni Abner.
en: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.

war: Nagsiring hi Samuel kan Saul, “Amo ako an ginsugo han Ginoo hin pagdihog ha imo nga hadi han iya mga tawo, an mga Israelita. Pamatii yana an igsisiring han Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum.
en: Samuel said to Saul, “I am the one the Lord sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the Lord .

war: Kakastigohon niya an mga tawo han Amalek kay pinakiawayan han ira mga ginikanan an mga Israelita han paggawas hini nira ha Ehipto.
en: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.

war: Gintirok ni Saul ngan iya ginpanginano an iya kasondalohan didto ha Talem: may-ada 200,000 nga mga sondalo tikang ha Israel ngan 10,000 tikang ha Juda.
en: So Saul summoned the men and mustered them at Telaim—two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand from Judah.

war: Niyan kinmadto hiya ngan an iya mga tawo han syudad han Amalek, ngan gimnama hira didto hin usa nga walog.
en: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.

war: Ginpirde ni Saul an mga Amalekanhon, ha iya pakig-away tikang ha Habila ngadto ha Sur ha sinirangan han Ehipto.
en: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt.

war: Ginbihag niya nga buhi hi Agag nga hadi han mga Amalekanhon, ngan pinamatay niya an ngatanan nga mga tawo.
en: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.

war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Samuel,
en: Then the word of the Lord came to Samuel:

war: Kinmadto hi Samuel kan Saul. Ginsiring ni Saul hi Samuel, “Bendisyonan ka unta han Ginoo , Samuel! Gintuman ko an sugo han Ginoo .”
en: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, “The Lord bless you! I have carried out the Lord ’s instructions.”

war: Pinmakiana hi Samuel, “Kay ano man nga hinbabatian ko in mga pag-ininga hin mga baka ngan pag-iniyak hin mga karnero?”
en: But Samuel said, “What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?”

war: “Igo na,” nagsiring hi Samuel, “ngan igsusumat ko ha imo an iginsiring ha akon han Ginoo kagab-i.” “Sumati ako,” nagsiring hi Saul.
en: “Enough!” Samuel said to Saul. “Let me tell you what the Lord said to me last night.” “Tell me,” Saul replied.

war: Binmaton hi Samuel, “Bisan kon gin-iisip mo nga gutiay ka la nga pagkatawo, amo ikaw an pangulo han mga tribo han Israel. Gindihogan ka han Ginoo nga hadi han Israel,
en: Samuel said, “Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.

war: ngan ginsugo ka niya hin pagpuo hito nga magraot nga Amalekanhon. Ginsugo ka niya hin pagpatay ha ira ngatanan.
en: And he sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; wage war against them until you have wiped them out.’

war: Kay ano man nga waray ka magsugot ha iya? Kay ano nga nagdagmit ka la hin pag-agaw han tinikas, ngan pagbuhat han diri nakakalipay han Ginoo ?”
