en: Why did you not obey the Lord ? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the Lord ?”

war: Kundi waray pataya han akon mga tawo an gimamaupayi nga mga karnero ngan mga baka nga ira nabihag; ira gindara lugod ini nganhi ha Gilgal basi ighalad han Ginoo nga imo Dyos.”
en: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the Lord your God at Gilgal.”

war: “Tinuod, nakasala ako,” binmaton hi Saul. “Akon ginsupak an sugo han Ginoo ngan an imo mga tugon. Nahadlok ako han akon mga tawo ngan tinugotan ko hira pagbuhat han ira karuyag.
en: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned. I violated the Lord ’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the men and so I gave in to them.

war: Kundi yana nakikimalooy ako ha imo, pasayloa an akon sala ngan bunyog gad ha akon hin pagbalik ngadto ha Gilgal, basi makagsingba ako han Ginoo .”
en: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord .”

war: “Diri ako mabunyog ha imo,” binmaton hi Samuel. “Iginsikway mo an sugo han Ginoo , ngan iginsikway ka man niya nga hadi han Israel.”
en: But Samuel said to him, “I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you as king over Israel!”

war: Niyan tinmalikod hi Samuel hin pagbaya, kundi hinkaptan ni Saul an iya bado, ngan nagisi ini.
en: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Samuel, “Yana nga adlaw gin-agaw han Ginoo ha imo an ginhadian han Israel, ngan iginhatag ini hin usa ka tawo nga mauruupay ha imo.
en: Samuel said to him, “The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors—to one better than you.

war: Diri nagbubuwa o nagbabalhin han iya hunahuna an harangdon nga Dyos han Israel. Diri hiya tawo—diri hiya nagbabalhin han iya hunahuna.”
en: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being, that he should change his mind.”

war: Sanglit binmunyog ha iya hi Samuel ngadto ha Gilgal, ngan nagsingba hi Saul han Ginoo .
en: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord .

war: Katapos kinmadto hi Samuel ha Rama ngan inmoli hi Saul ngadto ha Gabaa.
en: Then Samuel left for Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.

war: Dapita hi Isai hin paghalad, ngan susumatan ko ikaw kon ano an imo bubuhaton. Didihogan mo nga hadi an akon igsumat ha imo.”
en: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You are to anoint for me the one I indicate.”

war: Han pag-abot nira, hinkit-an ni Samuel hi Eliab nga anak ni Isai ngan naghunahuna hiya, “Amo gud ada ini nga tawo nga natindog dinhe ha atubangan han Ginoo an iya ginpili.”
en: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, “Surely the Lord ’s anointed stands here before the Lord .”

war: Niyan gintawag ni Isai an iya anak nga hi Abinadab ngan gindara hiya ha atubangan ni Samuel. Kundi nagsiring hi Samuel, “Diri, waray liwat hiya pagpilia han Ginoo .”
en: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, “The Lord has not chosen this one either.”

war: Niyan gindara ni Isai hi Sama. Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Diri, waray liwat hiya pagpilia han Ginoo .”
en: Jesse then had Shammah pass by, but Samuel said, “Nor has the Lord chosen this one.”

war: Ha sugad hini nga paagi gindara ni Isai ha atubangan ni Samuel an pito han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an. Ngan nagsiring ha iya hi Samuel, “Diri, waray usa hini ha ira nga ginpili han Ginoo .”
en: Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel said to him, “The Lord has not chosen these.”

war: Sanglit ginpasugoan hiya ni Isai. Usa hiya nga gwapo, maupay an panlawas nga batan-on nga lalake, ngan maanyag an iya mga mata. Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Samuel, “Amo ini hiya—dihogi hiya!”
en: So he sent for him and had him brought in. He was glowing with health and had a fine appearance and handsome features. Then the Lord said, “Rise and anoint him; this is the one.”

war: Binmaya kan Saul an espiritu han Ginoo , ngan ginsakit hiya hin usa nga maraot nga espiritu nga iginpadara han Ginoo .
en: Now the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an iya mga surugoon, “Maaram kami nga ginsasakit ka hin usa nga maraot nga espiritu nga iginpadara han Dyos.
en: Saul’s attendants said to him, “See, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.

war: Ginsugo hira ni Saul, “Igbiling ako hin usa ka tawo nga maupay magtukar ngan dad-a hiya nganhi ha akon.”
en: So Saul said to his attendants, “Find someone who plays well and bring him to me.”

war: Sanglit nagpadara hi Saul hin mga surugoon ngadto kan Isai hin pagsiring, “Ipadara ha akon hi David nga imo anak nga nagmamangno han mga karnero.”
en: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, “Send me your son David, who is with the sheep.”

war: Ginpadara ni Isai hi David ngadto kan Saul, ngan nagdara hi David hin usa nga nati nga kanding, usa nga asno nga kargado hin tinapay, ngan hin usa nga supot nga anit nga puno hin bino.
en: So Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them with his son David to Saul.

war: Kinmadto hi David kan Saul ngan nag-alagad hi David ha iya. Naruyagan hiya ni Saul ngan ginpili hiya nga paradara han iya mga hinganiban.
en: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much, and David became one of his armor-bearers.

war: Niyan nagpatugon hi Saul kan Isai: “Naruruyag ako kan David. Tugoti hiya hin pag-alagad didi ha akon.”
en: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, “Allow David to remain in my service, for I am pleased with him.”

war: Nagtirok liwat hira Saul ngan an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Kahamub-an han Ela, diin nag-andam hira hin pakig-away han mga Filisteohanon.
en: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah and drew up their battle line to meet the Philistines.

war: Nagkatirok an mga Filisteohanon didto hin usa nga pungtod ngan an mga Israelita didto hin lain nga pungtod, ngan nabubutnga nira in usa nga kahamub-an.
en: The Philistines occupied one hill and the Israelites another, with the valley between them.

war: ngan nakakasul-ot hiya hin tumbaga nga panalipod ha lawas, nga natimbang hin mga 50 ka kilo, ngan hin tumbaga nga helmet.
en: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore a coat of scale armor of bronze weighing five thousand shekels ;

war: May-ada niya polinas nga tumbaga ngan nakakadara hiya hin usa nga bronse nga bangkaw nga ikinakabilay niya ha iya sugbong.
en: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.

war: An iya bangkaw sugad kadako han likosan hin usa nga hablonan, ngan pito ka kilo an kabug-at han puthaw nga uloulo hini. Nag-uuna ha iya an nagdadara han iya taming.
en: His spear shaft was like a weaver’s rod, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. His shield bearer went ahead of him.

war: Yana inaayat ko an kasondalohan han Israel. Pagpili kamo hin usa ka tawo nga igpapaaway ha akon!”
en: Then the Philistine said, “This day I defy the armies of Israel! Give me a man and let us fight each other.”

war: Han pakabati hini ni Saul ngan han iya mga tawo nagkahadlok hira hin duro.
en: On hearing the Philistine’s words, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and terrified.

war: Hi David an gimamanghori nga anak. Samtang upod ni Saul an tulo nga gimamagorangi nga kabugtoan,
en: David was the youngest. The three oldest followed Saul,

war: dayuday nag-inuulian hi David ngadto ha Betlehem hin pagmangno han mga karnero han iya amay.
en: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

war: Waray hunong hin pangayat hi Goliat han mga Israelita kada aga ngan gab-i sulod hin kwarenta ka adlaw.
en: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening and took his stand.

war: Aadto ha kahamub-an han Ela hira Hadi Saul, an imo kabugtoan, ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nga nakikig-away han mga Filisteohanon.”
en: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines.”

war: Nag-asdangay an Filisteohanon ngan Israelita nga mga kasondalohan. Andam na hira nga duha hin pakig-away.
en: Israel and the Philistines were drawing up their lines facing each other.

war: Iginbilin ni David an pagkaon didto han opisyal nga tinaporan han mga higamit, dinmalagan hiya ngadto han dapit han pag-awayan, kinmadto han iya kabugtoan, ngan nakighimangraw hiya ha ira.
en: David left his things with the keeper of supplies, ran to the battle lines and asked his brothers how they were.

war: Han paghikit-i la han mga Israelita kan Goliat, nagdadlagan hira tungod hin kahadlok.
en: Whenever the Israelites saw the man, they all fled from him in great fear.

war: Ira ginsumatan hiya kon ano an ihahatag han tawo nga makakamatay kan Goliat.
en: They repeated to him what they had been saying and told him, “This is what will be done for the man who kills him.”

war: “Kay ano gud an akon ginbuhat?” nagpakiana hi David. “Diri ba ako makakahimo hin pagpakiana?”
en: “Now what have I done?” said David. “Can’t I even speak?”

war: Kinmadto hiya hin pagpakiana hin lain nga tawo ngan amo la gihapon an baton han mga tawo.
en: He then turned away to someone else and brought up the same matter, and the men answered him as before.

war: Hinbatian hin pipira ka tawo an iginsiring ni David ngan ginsumatan nira hi Saul, ngan iginpatawag hiya ni Saul.
en: What David said was overheard and reported to Saul, and Saul sent for him.

war: Nagsiring hi David kan Saul, “Harangdon nga Hadi, waray tawo nga kinahanglan mahadlok hini nga Filisteohanon! Ako an makadto ngan makikig-away ha iya.”
en: David said to Saul, “Let no one lose heart on account of this Philistine; your servant will go and fight him.”

war: linalanat ko dayon ini, inaaway ko, ngan inaagaw ko an nati. Ngan kon inaatubang ako han liyon o lubo, pinipitlok ko ini ngan tinutubal ko ngada han kamatay.
en: I went after it, struck it and rescued the sheep from its mouth. When it turned on me, I seized it by its hair, struck it and killed it.

war: Nakamatay na ako hin mga liyon ngan hin mga lubo, ngan pagbubuhaton ko in sugad hini ngadto hini nga pagano nga Filisteohanon nga nangayat han kasondalohan han buhi nga Dyos.
en: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.

war: Iginpasul-ot niya kan David an iya kalugaringon nga hinganiban: bronse nga helmet nga iya ikinalo kan David, ngan hin bado nga hinganiban.
en: Then Saul dressed David in his own tunic. He put a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.

war: Nagtikang pagdaop hi Goliat ngadto kan David, nga nag-uuna ha iya an paradara han iya taming. Nagtipahirani na hiya,
en: Meanwhile, the Philistine, with his shield bearer in front of him, kept coming closer to David.

war: tubtob nga hinkit-an niya hin maupay hi David. Gintamay niya hi David kay usa la hiya nga bata nga mahusay pagkit-on.
en: He looked David over and saw that he was little more than a boy, glowing with health and handsome, and he despised him.

war: Nagsiring hiya kan David, “Ano an gamit hito nga tungkod? Usa ba ako nga ayam ha imo paghunahuna?” Ngan gintunglo niya hi David pinaagi han iya diyos.
en: He said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?” And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

war: “Kadi na,” gin-ayat niya hi David, “ngan itutubong ko an imo lawas ha katamsihan ngan kamanampan basi nira kaonon!”
en: “Come here,” he said, “and I’ll give your flesh to the birds and the wild animals!”

war: Dinmasmag hi Goliat kan David, ngan dinmalagan dayon hi David hin pagtapo ha iya.
en: As the Philistine moved closer to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.

war: Sanglit, bisan waray usa nga espada, ginpirde ngan ginpatay ni David hi Goliat pinaagi la hin usa nga labyog ngan hin usa nga bato!
en: So David triumphed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone; without a sword in his hand he struck down the Philistine and killed him.

war: Han pagbalik na han mga Israelita tikang han paglanat nira han mga Filisteohanon, pinanikasan nira an kampo han mga Filisteohanon.
en: When the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.

war: Ginkuha ni David an ulo ni Goliat ngan gindara ini ngadto ha Jerusalem, kundi iya ginhimos an mga hinganiban ni Goliat didto han iya kalugaringon nga tulda.
en: David took the Philistine’s head and brought it to Jerusalem; he put the Philistine’s weapons in his own tent.

war: Nagsugo hi Saul, “Kadtoa ngan usisaha.”
en: The king said, “Find out whose son this young man is.”

war: Sanglit han pagbalik ni David ngadto han kampo katapos niya pagpataya kan Goliat, gindara hiya ni Abner ngadto kan Saul. Nakakabitbit pa hi David han ulo ni Goliat.
en: As soon as David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with David still holding the Philistine’s head.

war: Ginpakianhan hiya ni Saul, “Batan-on, kanay ka anak?” Binmaton hi David, “Amo ako an anak ni Isai nga imo surugoon nga taga-Betlehem.”
en: “Whose son are you, young man?” Saul asked him. David said, “I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem.”

war: Nahuman an hiruhimangraw nira Saul ug David. Katapos naruyag hin duro kan David hi Jonatan nga anak nga lalake ni Saul. Ginhigugma hi David ni Jonatan sugad han iya paghigugma ha iya ngahaw.
en: After David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.

war: Tikang hadto nga adlaw ginhawiran ni Saul hi David ngan waray na hiya paulia.
en: From that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return home to his family.

war: Nagsumpa hi Jonatan hin dayon nga pakigsangkay kan David, tungod han iya dako nga paghigugma ha iya.
en: And Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

war: Ginhugkas niya an panapton nga iya iginsusul-ot ngan iginhatag ini kan David, upod liwat an iya hinganiban, ngan an iya espada, pana, ug paha.
en: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.

war: Dida han ira pagsaurog nagkanta an kababayen-an, “Nakamatay hi Saul hin yinukot, kundi hi David hin tinag napulo ka yukot.”
en: As they danced, they sang: “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.”

war: Sanglit tikang hito nga adlaw maabugho ngan matinahapon na hiya kan David.
en: And from that time on Saul kept a close eye on David.

war: Naghunahuna hi Saul, “Itataod ko hiya ha bungbong,” ngan iya ginbangkaw hi David makaduha, kundi nakakalikay dayon hi David.
en: and he hurled it, saying to himself, “I’ll pin David to the wall.” But David eluded him twice.

war: Nahadlok hi Saul kan David kay upod na kan David an Ginoo ngan ginbayaan na hiya.
en: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with David but had departed from Saul.

war: Sanglit ginpaiwas hiya ni Saul ngan ginhimo hiya nga kapitan hin usa ka yukot nga mga tawo. Ginmandoan ni David an iya mga tawo ha didto pag-awayan,
en: So he sent David away from him and gave him command over a thousand men, and David led the troops in their campaigns.

war: ngan nagmainuswagon hiya ha ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat, kay upod ha iya an Ginoo .
en: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.

war: Hinkit-an ni Saul an pag-uswag ni David ngan nagdugang an iya kahadlok ha iya.
en: When Saul saw how successful he was, he was afraid of him.

war: Kundi hinmigugma kan David an ngatanan didto ha Israel ug Juda, kay mainuswagon gud hiya nga pangulo.
en: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he led them in their campaigns.

war: Binmaton hi David, “Hin-o man ako ngan ano gud an akon panimalay nga magin umagad ako han hadi?”
en: But David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my family or my clan in Israel, that I should become the king’s son-in-law?”

war: Kundi ha pag-abot na han panahon nga ipapaasawa na unta hi Merab kan David, iginpaasawa lugod hiya kan Adriel, nga taga-Mehola.
en: So when the time came for Merab, Saul’s daughter, to be given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.

war: Kundi nahigugma kan David hi Mical nga anak liwat ni Saul, ngan nalipay hi Saul han paghibaro niya hini.
en: Now Saul’s daughter Michal was in love with David, and when they told Saul about it, he was pleased.

war: Ginsumatan hi Saul han mga opisyal han iginsiring hi David,
en: When Saul’s servants told him what David had said,

war: Iginsumat kan David han mga opisyal ni Saul an iginsiring ni Saul, ngan nakalipay kan David nga hiya an magigin umagad han hadi. San-o umabot an adlaw han kasal,
en: When the attendants told David these things, he was pleased to become the king’s son-in-law. So before the allotted time elapsed,

war: Nakasabot gud hi Saul nga upod kan David an Ginoo ngan nahigugma liwat ha iya hi Mical nga iya anak.
en: When Saul realized that the Lord was with David and that his daughter Michal loved David,

war: Sanglit nagdugang an iya kahadlok kan David, ngan iya kaaway hi David samtang buhi pa hiya.
en: Saul became still more afraid of him, and he remained his enemy the rest of his days.

war: Ginsumatan ni Saul hi Jonatan nga iya anak ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga opisyal nga nakahunahuna hiya hin pagpatay kan David. Kundi nahigugma hin duro hi Jonatan kan David,
en: Saul told his son Jonathan and all the attendants to kill David. But Jonathan had taken a great liking to David

war: Makadto ako ngan uupdan ko an akon amay didto han uma nga imo tinatagoan, ngan makikighimangraw ako ha iya hiunong ha imo. Susumatan ta na la ikaw kon ano an akon hibaroan.”
en: I will go out and stand with my father in the field where you are. I’ll speak to him about you and will tell you what I find out.”

war: Pinamatian ni Saul an ginsiring ni Jonatan ngan nagsumpa hiya ha ngaran han Ginoo nga diri niya papatayon hi David.
en: Saul listened to Jonathan and took this oath: “As surely as the Lord lives, David will not be put to death.”

war: Sanglit gintawag ni Jonatan hi David ngan ginsumatan niya han ngatanan; niyan iya gindara hi David ngadto kan Saul ngan nag-alagad hi David han hadi sugad han iya ginbuhat han una.
en: So Jonathan called David and told him the whole conversation. He brought him to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.

war: May-ada na liwat araway kontra han mga Filisteohanon. Ginsulong hira ni David ngan damo an iya pinamatay sanglit nangalagiw an mga Filisteohanon.
en: Once more war broke out, and David went out and fought the Philistines. He struck them with such force that they fled before him.

war: Ginpalusad hi David ni Mical ha bintana, ngan dinmalagan ngan kinmalagiw hiya.
en: So Michal let David down through a window, and he fled and escaped.

war: Niyan kinuha ni Mical an diyosdiyos han panimalay, iginhigda ini niya dida han higdaan, ginpaolon ini hin ulonan nga hinimo hin barahibo hin kanding, ngan gintahoban.
en: Then Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed, covering it with a garment and putting some goats’ hair at the head.

war: Han pag-abot na han mga tawo ni Saul pagkuha kan David, ginsumatan hira ni Mical nga masakit hiya.
en: When Saul sent the men to capture David, Michal said, “He is ill.”

war: Kundi ginpabalik hira ni Saul. Ginsugo hira, “Dad-a hiya nganhi dida ha iya higdaan ngan papatayon ko hiya.”
en: Then Saul sent the men back to see David and told them, “Bring him up to me in his bed so that I may kill him.”

war: Sinmakob hira ngan ira hin-agian didto han higdaan an diyosdiyos han balay ngan an ulonan nga barahibo hin kanding nga inoonlan.
en: But when the men entered, there was the idol in the bed, and at the head was some goats’ hair.

war: Ginsumatan hi Saul nga nakadto hi David ha Naiot didto ha Rama,
en: Word came to Saul: “David is in Naioth at Ramah”;

war: Nagsiring hi Jonatan, “Tutumanon ko an bisan ano nga imo karuyag.”
en: Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do for you.”

war: Kon sumiring hiya, ‘Maupay man,’ waray kahadlokan ko; kundi kon masina hiya, hibabaroan mo nga magtitinguha gud hiya hin pagpatay ha akon.
en: If he says, ‘Very well,’ then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you can be sure that he is determined to harm me.

war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Ayaw gad paghunahuna hin sugad! Kon hinbaroan ko la nga may tuyo an akon amay hin pagpatay ha imo, diri ko ba ikaw pagsusumatan?”
en: “Never!” Jonathan said. “If I had the least inkling that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn’t I tell you?”

war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi David, “Hin-o man in magpapahibaro ha akon kon mangisog an imo amay hin pagbaton ha imo?”
en: David asked, “Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?”

war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Tana, pakadto kita ha kaumhan.” Sanglit kinmadto hira,
en: “Come,” Jonathan said, “let’s go out into the field.” So they went there together.

war: Ngan kon buhion pa ako, tumana gad an imo iginsumpa ngan unongi ako; kundi kon mamatay ako,
en: But show me unfailing kindness like the Lord ’s kindness as long as I live, so that I may not be killed,

war: igpakita an amo ngahaw nga imo pagmahal han akon panimalay ha kadayonan. Ngan kon pagpuohon na han Ginoo an ngatanan mo nga kaaway,
en: and do not ever cut off your kindness from my family—not even when the Lord has cut off every one of David’s enemies from the face of the earth.”

war: diri la unta gihapon mabungkag an aton ginsaaran. Kon mabungkag ini, kakastigohon ka han Ginoo .”
en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, “May the Lord call David’s enemies to account.”

war: Ha makausa pa ginpasaad ni Jonatan hi David hin paghigugma ha iya, kay ginhigugma ni Jonatan hi David sugad han iya paghigugma ha iya ngahaw.
en: And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of love for him, because he loved him as he loved himself.

war: Niyan nagsiring ha iya hi Jonatan, “Tungod nga Pyesta man han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan buwas, iiliwon ka kon waray ka didto han pangaon.
en: Then Jonathan said to David, “Tomorrow is the New Moon feast. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

war: Ha pagkasangbuwas labi na gud nga iiliwon ka; sanglit pakadto han dapit nga gintagoan mo han una, ngan tago ha luyo han tinambak nga mga bato didto.
en: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid when this trouble began, and wait by the stone Ezel.

war: Niyan mapana ako ngan pupontingon ko ito nga dapit hin makatulo.
en: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a target.

war: Kundi kon sidngon ko hiya, ‘Aadto an mga pana ha imo luyo,’ lakat dayon, kay ginpapalakat ka han Ginoo .
en: But if I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then you must go, because the Lord has sent you away.

war: Mahitungod han ginsaaran naton, an Ginoo an maaram nga tutumanon ta ini ha kadayonan.”
en: And about the matter you and I discussed—remember, the Lord is witness between you and me forever.”

war: Sanglit tinmago hi David didto han uma. Dida han Pyesta na han Bag-o nga Subang han Bulan, kinmadto hi Hadi Saul hin pagkaon,
en: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon feast came, the king sat down to eat.

war: kundi waray la mag-aringasa hi Saul hito nga adlaw, kay naghunahuna hiya, “May nahinabo ha iya, ngan diri pa hiya malinis sumala han seremonyas.”
en: Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, “Something must have happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean.”

war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Nagsarit hiya ha akon nga makadto hiya ha Betlehem. Nagsiring hiya,
en: Jonathan answered, “David earnestly asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem.

war: Binmaton hi Jonatan, “Kay ano nga papatayon hiya? Ano an iya nabuhat?”
en: “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?” Jonathan asked his father.

war: Dida hito, ginbangkaw ni Saul hi Jonatan hin pagpatay ha iya, ngan sinmabot hi Jonatan nga tuyo gud ni Saul hin pagpatay kan David.
en: But Saul hurled his spear at him to kill him. Then Jonathan knew that his father intended to kill David.

war: Han pagkaaga kinmadto hi Jonatan ha uma hin pakigkita kan David, sumala han ira sabot. Ginpaupod niya in usa nga bata nga lalake,
en: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for his meeting with David. He had a small boy with him,

war: ngan ginsiring niya, “Dalagan ngan pamilnga an mga pana nga akon iginpunting.” Dinmalagan an bata ngan ipinunting ni Jonatan an pana ha unhan niya.
en: and he said to the boy, “Run and find the arrows I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

war: Han pag-abot han bata ngadto han dapit nga nahulogan han pana, ginmoliat hi Jonatan, “Aadto pa ha unhan an pana!
en: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan’s arrow had fallen, Jonathan called out after him, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”

war: Ayaw pagtinukdaw la dida! Dali!” Ginpurot han bata an pana ngan iginbalik ini ngadto han iya agaron,
en: Then he shouted, “Hurry! Go quickly! Don’t stop!” The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.

war: nga waray gud hiya kalibutan han karuyag sidngon; hi Jonatan ngan hi David la an maaram.
en: (The boy knew nothing about all this; only Jonathan and David knew.)

war: Iginhatag ni Jonatan an iya mga hinganiban ngadto han bata ngan ginpauli niya ngadto ha bungto.
en: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said, “Go, carry them back to town.”

war: Kinmadto hi David kan Ahimelec nga padi didto ha Nob. Ginmawas hi Ahimelec nga nangungurog hin pagtapo ha iya ngan nagpakiana, “Kay ano nga usa ka man la nga nakanhi?”
en: David went to Nob, to Ahimelek the priest. Ahimelek trembled when he met him, and asked, “Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?”

war: Sanglit yana ano man nga pagkaon an aada ha imo? Tagi ako hin lima ka bug-os nga tinapay o bisan ano nga aada ha imo.”
en: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever you can find.”

war: Nagsiring an padi, “Waray ko ordinaryo nga tinapay, kundi tinapay la nga ginhalad na ha altar; ihahatag ko ini kon waray yana makighilawas an imo mga tawo.”
en: But the priest answered David, “I don’t have any ordinary bread on hand; however, there is some consecrated bread here—provided the men have kept themselves from women.”

war: Sanglit linmakat hi David. Pinalagiw hiya kan Saul, ngan kinmadto hiya kan Hadi Aquis han Gat.
en: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.

war: Gintirotimbang ni David ini nga ira mga pulong, ngan nahadlok hiya hin duro kan Hadi Aquis.
en: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish king of Gath.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Aquis han iya mga opisyal, “Kitaa daw! Tuyaw ini nga tawo! Kay ano nga gindara hiya niyo nganhi ha akon!
en: Achish said to his servants, “Look at the man! He is insane! Why bring him to me?

war: Kinukulangan pa ba ako hin mga tuyaw? Kay ano nga gindad-an ako niyo hin usa pa nga nakakasamok ha akon pinaagi han iya tinuyaw nga mga panggawi dinhe pa gud han akon kalugaringon nga balay?”
en: Am I so short of madmen that you have to bring this fellow here to carry on like this in front of me? Must this man come into my house?”

war: Sanglit ibinilin ni David an iya mga kag-anak upod han hadi han Moab, ngan nag-ukoy hira didto samtang tinmago hi David didto han lungib.
en: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.

war: Niyan kinmadto kan David hi Gad nga manaragna ngan nagsiring, “Ayaw pag-ukoy dinhe; pakadto dayon han tuna han Juda.” Sanglit linmakat hi David ngan kinmadto hiya ha kagurangan han Haret.
en: But the prophet Gad said to David, “Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah.” So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.

war: Natindog didto hi Doeg nga taga-Edumea upod han mga opisyal ni Saul, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Hinkit-an ko hi David didto ha Nob han pagkadto niya kan Ahimelec nga anak ni Ahitub.
en: But Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul’s officials, said, “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelek son of Ahitub at Nob.

war: Nagpakiana hi Ahimelec han Ginoo kon ano an angay pagbuhaton ni David, ngan katapos, gintagan niya hi David hin pagkaon ngan han espada ni Goliat nga Filisteohanon.”
en: Ahimelek inquired of the Lord for him; he also gave him provisions and the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

war: Sanglit iginpakuha ni Hadi Saul hi Ahimelec nga padi ngan an ngatanan niya nga kauropdan nga kapadian didto ha Nob. Kinmadto ini hira ha iya.
en: Then the king sent for the priest Ahimelek son of Ahitub and all the men of his family, who were the priests at Nob, and they all came to the king.

war: Nagsiring hi Saul kan Ahimelec, “Pamati, Ahimelec!” “Namamati ako ha imo,” binmaton hiya.
en: Saul said, “Listen now, son of Ahitub.” “Yes, my lord,” he answered.

war: Nagsiring an hadi, “Ahimelec, kinahanglan mamatay ka ngan an ngatanan mo nga kauropdan!”
en: But the king said, “You will surely die, Ahimelek, you and your whole family.”

war: Kundi nakapalagiw hi Abiatar nga usa han mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Ahimelec, ngan kinmadto hiya ngan tinmampo kan David.
en: But one son of Ahimelek son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled to join David.

war: Iginsumat niya kan David an pagpataya ni Saul han kapadian han Ginoo .
en: He told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .

war: Pabilin ha akon ngan ayaw kahadlok. Karuyag ni Saul hin pagpatay ha aton nga duha, kundi waray mahinanabo ha imo samtang upod ka ha akon.”
en: Stay with me; don’t be afraid. The man who wants to kill you is trying to kill me too. You will be safe with me.”

war: Hinbatian ni David nga ginsusulong han mga Filisteohanon an bungto han Keila ngan gintikas nira an bag-o pa la nga mga inani nga trigo.
en: When David was told, “Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are looting the threshing floors,”

war: Sanglit pinmakiana na liwat hi David han Ginoo , ngan nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Kadtoa ngan sulonga an Keila, kay padadag-on ko ikaw kontra han mga Filisteohanon.”
en: Once again David inquired of the Lord , and the Lord answered him, “Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand.”

war: Han pagkalagiw ni Abiatar nga anak ni Ahimelec ngan pagtampo niya kan David didto ha Keila, gindara niya an efod.
en: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelek had brought the ephod down with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)

war: Sanglit gin-andam ni Saul an iya kasondalohan hin pagsulong han Keila, ngan paglikos kan David ngan han iya mga tawo.
en: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

war: Han paghibaro ni David nga nag-andam hi Saul hin pagsulong ha iya, nagsiring hiya kan Abiatar nga padi, “Dad-a nganhi an efod.”
en: When David learned that Saul was plotting against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hi David, “O Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, hinbatian ko nga nag-andam na hi Saul hin pagkanhi ha Keila ngan pagbungkag hini nga bungto tungod ha akon nga imo surugoon.
en: David said, “ Lord , God of Israel, your servant has heard definitely that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town on account of me.

war: Nagpakiana na liwat hi David, “Ngan igtutubyan ba han mga umurokoy han Keila ako ngan an akon mga tawo ngadto kan Saul?” “Igtutubyan kamo,” binmaton an Ginoo .
en: Again David asked, “Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men to Saul?” And the Lord said, “They will.”

war: Nagtinago hi David didto han sagkahon nga tuna ha kamingawan hirani ha Zif. Nagpadayon hi Saul hin pagbiling ha iya, kundi waray han Dyos igtubyan hi David ha iya.
en: David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hills of the Desert of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God did not give David into his hands.

war: Nahibaro hi David nga ginmawas hi Saul hin pagpatay ha iya. Nakadto hi David ha Hores, didto han kamingawan hirani han Zif.
en: While David was at Horesh in the Desert of Ziph, he learned that Saul had come out to take his life.

war: Didto kinmadto ha iya hi Jonatan ngan gin-aghat hiya upod an mga pagpatapod han mga pagpanalipod han Dyos,
en: And Saul’s son Jonathan went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God.

war: Nagsinumpaay hira nga duha hin pagpadig-on han ira kamagsangkay. Nagpabilin hi David didto ha Hores, ngan inmoli hi Jonatan.
en: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord . Then Jonathan went home, but David remained at Horesh.

war: Maaram kami, Harangdon nga Hadi, nga karuyag gud nimo bihagon hi David sanglit pakadi han amon katunaan ngan tatalinguhaon namon nga madakop hiya.”
en: Now, Your Majesty, come down whenever it pleases you to do so, and we will be responsible for giving him into your hands.”

war: Binmaton hi Saul, “Bendisyonan unta kamo han Ginoo kag malooy man kamo ha akon!
en: Saul replied, “The Lord bless you for your concern for me.

war: Kadto na, ngan kitaa pa gud niyo; usisaha kon hain gud hiya ngan kon hin-o an nakakita ha iya didto. May nagsumat ha akon nga listo ini hiya.
en: Go and get more information. Find out where David usually goes and who has seen him there. They tell me he is very crafty.

war: Hito manta nga takna inmabot in usa nga surugoon ngan nagsiring kan Saul, “Balik gud dayon! Sinusulong han mga Filisteohanon an nasod!”
en: a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Come quickly! The Philistines are raiding the land.”

war: Sanglit inmundang hi Saul hin paglanat kan David ngan kinmadto hiya hin pakig-away han mga Filisteohanon. Sanglit ginngaranan ito nga dapit nga Pungtod hin Pagkabulag.
en: Then Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why they call this place Sela Hammahlekoth.

war: Linmakat hi David ngan kinmadto hiya han katunaan han Engadi, diin nagtinago hiya.
en: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

war: Han pagbalik ni Saul tikang han pakig-away niya han mga Filisteohanon, nasumatan hiya nga nakadto hi David han kamingawan hirani han Engadi.
en: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, “David is in the Desert of En Gedi.”

war: Kundi kahuman hini, nagbasol hi David,
en: Afterward, David was conscience-stricken for having cut off a corner of his robe.

war: ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga tinmoo ka man hin mga sumat hin mga tawo nga nasiring nga may-ada ako maraot nga nahuhunahunaan ha imo?
en: He said to Saul, “Why do you listen when men say, ‘David is bent on harming you’?

war: Maghukom unta ha aton an Ginoo kon hin-o ha aton an sayop! Kastigohon ka unta tungod han imo pagkontraha ha akon, kay diri gud ako magdadaot ha imo.
en: May the Lord judge between you and me. And may the Lord avenge the wrongs you have done to me, but my hand will not touch you.

war: Maaram ka man han daan nga darawhonon, ‘Magraot la nga mga tawo an nagbubuhat hin maraot.’ Sanglit diri ko ikaw pagdadaoton.
en: As the old saying goes, ‘From evildoers come evil deeds,’ so my hand will not touch you.

war: Hin-o an gin-iiparatay han hadi han Israel? Hin-o an iya ginbubukod! Usa nga patay nga ayam, usa nga purgas?
en: “Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Who are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?

war: An Ginoo amo an maghuhukom, ngan hiya an magbubuot kon hin-o ha aton an sayop. Hiya unta an manalipod ha akon, ngan magtalwas ha akon ha imo mga kamot!”
en: May the Lord be our judge and decide between us. May he consider my cause and uphold it; may he vindicate me by delivering me from your hand.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hiya kan David, “Matadong ka, ngan sayop ako. Maupay an imo mga ginbuhat ha akon, samtang ginbuhat ko in dako nga sayop ha imo!
en: “You are more righteous than I,” he said. “You have treated me well, but I have treated you badly.

war: Yana nga adlaw nagpakita ka han imo pagkamaupay ha akon, kay waray mo ako pataya, bisan kon igintubyan ako han Ginoo ha imo gahom.
en: You have just now told me about the good you did to me; the Lord delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.

war: Kon in usa ka tawo makadakop han iya kaaway, bubuhian pa niya? Bendisyonan ka unta han Ginoo tungod han imo ginbuhat ha akon yana nga adlaw!
en: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him get away unharmed? May the Lord reward you well for the way you treated me today.

war: Yana maaram ako nga ikaw an magigin hadi han Israel, nga magpapadayon an ginhadian ha ubos han imo pagdumara.
en: I know that you will surely be king and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.

war: Kundi pagsaad ha akon ha ngaran han Ginoo nga imo tatalwason an akon mga tulin, basi diri gud hingalimtan an ngaran ko ngan han akon panimalay.”
en: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not kill off my descendants or wipe out my name from my father’s family.”

war: Nagsumpa hi David nga iya ini tutumanon. Niyan inmoli hi Saul, ngan binmalik hi David ngan an iya mga tawo ngadto han ira taragoan.
en: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

war: ngan hinbaroan ini ni David nga nakadto ha kamingawan,
en: While David was in the wilderness, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.

war: sanglit nagsugo hiya hin napulo nga mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an hin pagkadto ha Carmelo, pamiling kan Nabal, ngan pangumosta ha iya.
en: So he sent ten young men and said to them, “Go up to Nabal at Carmel and greet him in my name.

war: Iginhatag han mga tawo ni David ini nga mensahe kan Nabal ha ngaran ni David, ngan hinmulat hira kon ano an igsisiring ha ira.
en: When David’s men arrived, they gave Nabal this message in David’s name. Then they waited.

war: Ha katapos-taposan, binmaton hi Nabal, “Hi David? Hin-o hiya? Waray pa gud ako makabati hiunong ha iya! Puno an tuna hin kalagiw nga mga oripon yana nga mga adlaw!
en: Nabal answered David’s servants, “Who is this David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants are breaking away from their masters these days.

war: Binmalik an iya mga tawo ngadto kan David ngan ginsumatan hiya han iginsiring ni Nabal.
en: David’s men turned around and went back. When they arrived, they reported every word.

war: Kundi maupay gud hira ha amon; waray gud kami paglabti nira, ngan ha bug-os nga panahon nga kaupod kami ha ira didto han kaumhan, waray gud nakawat han amon mga ginmamangnoan.
en: Yet these men were very good to us. They did not mistreat us, and the whole time we were out in the fields near them nothing was missing.

war: Ginpanalipdan kami nira adlaw gab-i ha bug-os nga panahon nga kaupod kami nira hin pagmangno han amon mga panon.
en: Night and day they were a wall around us the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.

war: Niyan nagsiring hiya han mga surugoon, “Pag-una kamo ngan masunod ako ha iyo.” Kundi waray la niya sumati an iya bana.
en: Then she told her servants, “Go on ahead; I’ll follow you.” But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

war: Nakakasakay hiya han iya asno ngan dida hin linilikdoan hin usa nga pungtod ha gilayon nagkatapo hira ngan hi David ug an iya mga tawo nga tipakada ha iya.
en: As she came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, there were David and his men descending toward her, and she met them.

war: Patayon unta ako han Dyos kon diri ko pamatayon an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo nga diri pa maaaga!”
en: May God deal with David, be it ever so severely, if by morning I leave alive one male of all who belong to him!”

war: Han paghikit-i la ni Abigail kan David, hinmaw-as hiya dayon ngan hinmapa hiya ha tuna,
en: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed down before David with her face to the ground.

war: Karawata gad ini nga regalo nga akon gindara ha imo, ngan ighatag ini ngadto han imo mga tawo.
en: And let this gift, which your servant has brought to my lord, be given to the men who follow you.

war: Ngan kon tumanon na han Ginoo an ngatanan nga mag-upay nga mga butang nga iginsaad niya ha imo, ngan himoon ka na nga hadi han Israel,
en: When the Lord has fulfilled for my lord every good thing he promised concerning him and has appointed him ruler over Israel,

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi David, “Dayawon an Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, nga nagsugo ha imo yana nga adlaw hin pagtapo ha akon!
en: David said to Abigail, “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.

war: Niyan, han kahawhawi na ha iya, iginsumat ha iya ni Abigail an ngatanan. Inatake hiya hin tigda nga sakit ngan naparalisis hiya.
en: Then in the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all these things, and his heart failed him and he became like a stone.

war: Paglabay hin mga napulo ka adlaw, ginhampak han Ginoo hi Nabal ngan namatay.
en: About ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal and he died.

war: Hinmapa ha tuna hi Abigail ngan nagsiring, “Surugoon ako niya ngan andam ako hin panmusa han iya mga surugoon.”
en: She bowed down with her face to the ground and said, “I am your servant and am ready to serve you and wash the feet of my lord’s servants.”

war: Binmuhat hiya dayon ngan sinmakay han iya asno. Binmunyog hiya han mga surugoon ni David, ngan gin-updan hiya han iya lima nga mga surugoon nga kababayen-an, ngan gin-asawa hiya ni David.
en: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and, attended by her five female servants, went with David’s messengers and became his wife.

war: Pinangasawa liwat ni David hi Ahinoam nga taga-Jezrael ngan yana nahimo liwat hi Abigail nga iya asawa.
en: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.

war: Hito manta nga panahon ginkuha ni Saul hi Mical nga iya anak nga asawa anay ni David, ngan iginpaasawa kan Palti nga anak ni Lais, nga taga bungto han Galim.
en: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Paltiel son of Laish, who was from Gallim.

war: May inmabot nga mga tawo nga taga-Zif ngadto kan Saul didto ha Gabaa ngan ginsumatan hiya nga aadto hi David natago ha Bukid han Haquila, ha ligid han kamingawan han Juda.
en: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding on the hill of Hakilah, which faces Jeshimon?”

war: Kinmadto dayon hi Saul han kamingawan han Zif upod in tulo ka yukot han gimamaupayi nga mga sondalo hin pamiling kan David.
en: So Saul went down to the Desert of Ziph, with his three thousand select Israelite troops, to search there for David.

war: nagsugo hiya hin mga mag-irinaw ngan hinbaroan niya nga tinuod nakadto hi Saul.
en: he sent out scouts and learned that Saul had definitely arrived.

war: Kundi nagsiring hi David, “Ayaw hiya pagpataya! Kakastigohon manta han Ginoo an bisan hin-o nga magpatay han iya pinili nga hadi.”
en: But David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him! Who can lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed and be guiltless?

war: Nagpadayon hi David, “Ha ngaran han buhi nga Ginoo , maaram ako nga an Ginoo ngahaw amo an magpapatay kan Saul, kon umabot na an iya panahon, pinaagi hin sakit, o hin kamatay ha pag-awayan.
en: As surely as the Lord lives,” he said, “the Lord himself will strike him, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.

war: Niyan tinmabok hi David ngadto ha luyo han kahamub-an ha bawbaw han pungtod, nga hirayo na ha ira,
en: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the hill some distance away; there was a wide space between them.

war: ngan ginoliatan niya an kasondalohan ni Saul ngan hi Abner, “Abner! Nakakabati ka ba ha akon!” Nagpakiana hi Abner, “Hin-o ito nga naggiginoliat ngan nagpupukaw han hadi?”
en: He called out to the army and to Abner son of Ner, “Aren’t you going to answer me, Abner?” Abner replied, “Who are you who calls to the king?”

war: Kinmilala hi Saul han tingog ni David, ngan nagpakiana, “David, hi ikaw ba, anak ko?” “Oo, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hi David.
en: Saul recognized David’s voice and said, “Is that your voice, David my son?” David replied, “Yes it is, my lord the king.”

war: Ngan nagsiring pa hiya, “Kay ano, Harangdon nga Hadi nga ginbubukod mo ako nga imo surugoon? Ano gud an akon nabuhat? Ano an akon sala?
en: And he added, “Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

war: Binmaton hi David, “Aadi an imo bangkaw, Harangdon nga Hadi. Pakadia hin pagkuha hini in usa han imo mga tawo.
en: “Here is the king’s spear,” David answered. “Let one of your young men come over and get it.

war: Sanglit kinmadto dayon hi David ngan an iya 600 nga mga tawo kan Aquis nga hadi han Gat, nga anak ni Maoc.
en: So David and the six hundred men with him left and went over to Achish son of Maok king of Gath.

war: Han paghibaro ni Saul nga pinmalagiw na hi David ngadto ha Gat, inmundang hiya hin pagpinamiling ha iya.
en: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.

war: Sanglit iginhatag ha iya ni Aquis an bungto han Siclag, ngan tungod hini gintag-iya an Siclag han kahadian han Juda tikang pa hadto.
en: So on that day Achish gave him Ziklag, and it has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.

war: Naukoy hi David didto ha Filistia sulod hin 16 ka bulan.
en: David lived in Philistine territory a year and four months.

war: Nagkatirok an Filisteohanon nga mga sondalo ngan nagkampo hira hirani han bungto han Sunem; gintirok man ni Saul an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira didto han bukid han Gilboa.
en: The Philistines assembled and came and set up camp at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and set up camp at Gilboa.

war: Han paghikit-i ni Saul han Filisteohanon nga kasondalohan nahadlok hiya hin duro,
en: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid; terror filled his heart.

war: sanglit nagpakiana hiya han Ginoo kon ano an iya pagbubuhaton. Kundi waray gud pamatii hiya han Ginoo , bisan pinaagi hin mga inop, o hin paggamit hin Urim ug Tumim, o hin mga manaragna.
en: He inquired of the Lord , but the Lord did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.

war: Niyan nagsumpa hi Saul ngan nagsiring, “Ha ngaran han buhi nga Ginoo nagsasaad ako nga diri ka kakastigohon tungod hini nga imo ginbubuhat.”
en: Saul swore to her by the Lord , “As surely as the Lord lives, you will not be punished for this.”

war: Nagpakiana an babaye, “Hin-o man an akon tatawgon para ha imo?” “Hi Samuel,” binmaton hiya.
en: Then the woman asked, “Whom shall I bring up for you?” “Bring up Samuel,” he said.

war: Han pakakita la han babaye kan Samuel, kinmurinit hiya ngan nagsiring kan Saul, “Kay ano nga ginlimbongan mo ako? Amo ka hi Hadi Saul!”
en: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out at the top of her voice and said to Saul, “Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!”

war: “Ayaw kahadlok!” nagsiring ha iya an hadi. “Ano an imo hinkit-an?” Binmaton hiya, “Hinkit-an ko in usa nga espiritu nga nagawas tikang han tuna.”
en: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid. What do you see?” The woman said, “I see a ghostly figure coming up out of the earth.”

war: Nagsiring hi Samuel, “Kay ano nga nagsangpit ka ha akon kon ginbayaan ka na man han Ginoo ngan kaaway mo na hiya?
en: Samuel said, “Why do you consult me, now that the Lord has departed from you and become your enemy?

war: Ginbuhat ha imo han Ginoo an iya iginsumat ha imo pinaagi ha akon: ginkuha niya an ginhadian ha imo ngan iginhatag ini ngadto kan David.
en: The Lord has done what he predicted through me. The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hands and given it to one of your neighbors—to David.

war: Ginsupak mo an sugo han Ginoo ngan waray mo pagpuoha an mga Amalekanhon ngan an ngatanan nga ira mga butang. Amo ini an ginbubuhat han Ginoo ha imo yana.
en: Because you did not obey the Lord or carry out his fierce wrath against the Amalekites, the Lord has done this to you today.

war: Ha kadagmitan nag-ihaw an babaye hin usa nga pinatambok niya nga nati nga baka. Niyan kinmuha hiya hin harina, ginmasa ini ngan naghimo hin tinapay nga waray patubo.
en: The woman had a fattened calf at the house, which she butchered at once. She took some flour, kneaded it and baked bread without yeast.

war: Igindurot niya an pagkaon ha atubangan ni Saul ngan han iya mga opisyal, ngan nangaon hira. Ngan linmakat hira hito ngahaw nga gab-i.
en: Then she set it before Saul and his men, and they ate. That same night they got up and left.

war: Gintirok han mga Filisteohanon an ngatanan nira nga mga sondalo didto ha Afec, samtang nagkampo an mga Israelita didto han burabod ha Kahamub-an han Jezrael.
en: The Philistines gathered all their forces at Aphek, and Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.

war: Nagkagawas an lima nga kahadian nga Filisteohanon, upod an ira mga hugpo hin tinaggatos ngan hin tinagyukot nga mga tawo; nakadto ha orhe hi David ngan han iya mga tawo, kaupod hi Hadi Aquis.
en: As the Philistine rulers marched with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men were marching at the rear with Achish.

war: Labot pa, amo ini hi David nga ginkanta han kababayen-an han nagsasarayaw hira, ‘Nakamatay hi Saul hin yinukot, kundi nakamatay hi David hin tinagnapulo ka yukot.’”
en: Isn’t this the David they sang about in their dances: “ ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”

war: Sanglit uli nala anay ha maupay nga paglakat, ngan ayaw pagbuhat hin bisan ano nga makakapabido ha ira.”
en: Now turn back and go in peace; do nothing to displease the Philistine rulers.”

war: Sanglit, David, buwas han aga, ha pagpawa gudla, pagkabuhat kamo hin sayo ngan pagkalakat kamo ngatanan nga binmaya kan Saul ngan kinmanhi ha akon.”
en: Now get up early, along with your master’s servants who have come with you, and leave in the morning as soon as it is light.”

war: Sanglit sayo pa han pagkaaga nagkalakat hira David ngan an iya mga tawo hin pagbalik ngadto ha Filistia, ngan nagpadayon an mga Filisteohanon ngadto ha Jezrael.
en: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

war: Paglabay hin duha ka adlaw inmabot hi David ngan an iya mga tawo ha Siclag. Ginsulong han mga Amalekanhon an timogan han Juda ngan han Siclag. Ginsunog nira an bungto,
en: David and his men reached Ziklag on the third day. Now the Amalekites had raided the Negev and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it,

war: ngan ginbihag an ngatanan nga kababayen-an; waray nira ginpatay nga tawo, kundi gindara nira an ngatanan.
en: and had taken captive the women and everyone else in it, both young and old. They killed none of them, but carried them off as they went on their way.

war: Nagtangis hira David ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan waray hira umundang ngada han panluya nira.
en: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.

war: Ginbihag bisan an duha nga asawa ni David, hira Ahinoam ug Abigail.
en: David’s two wives had been captured—Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

war: Nagsiring hi David kan Abiatar nga padi, nga anak ni Ahimelec, “Dad-a ha akon an efod.” Ngan gindara ini ni Abiatar ngadto ha iya.
en: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelek, “Bring me the ephod.” Abiathar brought it to him,

war: Sanglit nagkalakat hira David ngan han iya 600 nga mga tawo. Pag-abot nira ha Sapa han Besor, nagpabilin didto an iba ha ira.
en: David and the six hundred men with him came to the Besor Valley, where some stayed behind.

war: Nagpadayon hi David han iya paglanat upod an 400 na la nga mga tawo kay uraura na hin kamaluya an 200 nga mga tawo hin pagtabok han sapa, sanglit pinmabilin hira.
en: Two hundred of them were too exhausted to cross the valley, but David and the other four hundred continued the pursuit.

war: Hin-agian han mga tawo nga kaupod ni David in usa nga lalakehay nga Ehiptohanon didto ha kaumhan ngan gindara hiya ngadto kan David. Ginpakaon ngan ginpainom hiya nira,
en: They found an Egyptian in a field and brought him to David. They gave him water to drink and food to eat—

war: Ginsulong namon an katunaan han mga Cretanhon didto han timogan nga dapit han Juda ngan an katunaan han banay ni Caleb, ngan ginsulong namon an Siclag.”
en: We raided the Negev of the Kerethites, some territory belonging to Judah and the Negev of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag.”

war: Nabawi ni David an ngatanan nga mga tawo ngan an ngatanan nga natikas han mga Amalekanhon, upod an iya duha nga asawa.
en: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.

war: Waray gud kulang bisan usa; nabawi ni David an ngatanan nga mga anak han iya mga tawo, ngan an ngatanan nga tinikas han mga Amalekanhon.
en: Nothing was missing: young or old, boy or girl, plunder or anything else they had taken. David brought everything back.

war: Nabawi liwat niya an ngatanan nga mga panon hin kakarnerohan ngan kabakahan; ginpauna ha ira an ngatanan nga kabakahan ngan nagsiring hira, “Kan David ini!”
en: He took all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, saying, “This is David’s plunder.”

war: Ginhimo ini ni David nga usa nga balaod, ngan ginsunod ini han mga Israelita tikang hadto.
en: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.

war: Iginpadara ini niya ngadto han mga tawo han Betel, ngadto han mga tawo han Rama didto han timogan nga bahin han Juda, ngan ngadto han mga tawo han mga bungto han Jatir,
en: David sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;

war: Aroer, Sifmot, Estemoa,
en: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa

war: ug Racal; ha banay ni Jerameel, ha mga Kenitanhon;
en: and Rakal; to those in the towns of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites;

war: ngan ha mga tawo han mga bungto han Horma, Borasan, Atac,
en: to those in Hormah, Bor Ashan, Athak

war: ug Hebron. Iginpadara ini niya ha ngatanan nga mga dapit nga nahingadtoan niya ngan han iya mga tawo.
en: and Hebron; and to those in all the other places where he and his men had roamed.

war: Kundi hin-abutan hira han mga Filisteohanon, ngan ginpatay hira Jonatan, Abinadab, ug Malquisua, an tulo nga mga anak ni Saul.
en: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.

war: Naalikosan hi Saul han iya mga kaaway, ngan naigo hiya hin mga pana ngan grabe an iya mga samad.
en: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him critically.

war: Hinkit-an han batan-on nga patay na hi Saul, sanglit nag-unay liwat hiya han iya kalugaringon nga espada ngan namatay hiya upod kan Saul.
en: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died with him.

war: Amo ini an kaagi han kamatay ni Saul, han iya tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan han batan-on nga lalake; nagkamamatay hito nga adlaw an ngatanan nga mga tawo ni Saul.
en: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together that same day.

war: Niyan iginbutang nira an mga hinganiban ni Saul didto han templo han diyosa nga hi Astarte, ngan iginraysang nira an iya lawas ngadto han pader han syudad han Betsan.
en: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

war: Han paghibaro la han mga tawo han Jabes didto ha Galaad han ginbuhat han mga Filisteohanon kan Saul,
en: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

war: Katapos ginkuha nira an mga tul-an ngan iginlubong ini didto han bungto han Jabes ha puno han kahoy nga tuog ngan nagpuasa hira sulod hin pito ka adlaw.
en: Then they took their bones and buried them under a tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

war: Tikang kan Pablo, Silas ug Timoteo— Ngadto han mga kaapi han singbahan ha Tesalonica, nga mga sakop han Dyos nga Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo: Maiyo unta an grasya ngan an kamurayaw.
en: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

war: Dayuday nagpapasalamat kami han Dyos tungod ha iyo ngatanan, ngan dayuday ilinalakip kamo namon dida ha amon mga pag-ampo.
en: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.

war: Kabugtoan, maaram kami nga an Dyos nahigugma ha iyo ngan ginpili kamo nga magin iya kalugaringon.
en: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you,

war: Ginsubad niyo kami ngan an Ginoo; ngan bisan kon nag-antos gud kamo, ginkarawat niyo gihapon an mensahe, upod an kalipay nga natikang han Espiritu Santo.
en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you welcomed the message in the midst of severe suffering with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.

war: Sanglit nahimo kamo nga susbaranan han ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon ha Macedonia ngan ha Acaya.
en: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

war: Kabugtoan, maaram kamo ngahaw nga waray makawang an amon pagduaw ha iyo.
en: You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not without results.

war: Diri sayop an amon pagwali ug diri maraot an amon hangyo ha iyo, ngan waray kami maglimbong bisan kan kanay.
en: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.

war: Maaram na man kamo nga waray kami pakada hin pag-ulog-ulog ha iyo, ngan waray kami gamit hin mga pulong nga basi la katabonan an amon kahalot. An Dyos amo an amon saksi!
en: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed—God is our witness.

war: Waray kami pagtinguha nga pagdayawon kami han mga tawo, ma tikang ha iyo o ma tikang han iba,
en: We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or anyone else, even though as apostles of Christ we could have asserted our authority.

war: Kamo ug an Dyos amo an mga saksi, nga an amon panggawi ngada ha iyo nga mga magtinuohon putli, matadong, ngan waray sadang ikasuson.
en: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.

war: Sayod man kamo nga gintagad namon an tagsa ha iyo sugad gud han pagtagad hin usa nga amay han iya mga anak.
en: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,

war: Gindasig ngan ginliaw kamo namon, ngan ginsagdonan kamo namon pag-ukoy hin kinabuhi nga nakakalipay han Dyos nga amo an nagtatawag ha iyo basi kamo makaangbit han iya Ginhadian ngan himaya.
en: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.

war: nga nagpatay han Ginoo nga Jesus ngan han mga manaragna, ngan amo liwat an nagbukod ha amon. Diri gud hira nakakalipay han Dyos! Mga kaaway hira han ngatanan nga mga tawo!
en: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to everyone

war: Karuyag namon bumalik ha iyo. Nagtinguha ako, hi Pablo, pagbalik ngada ha iyo diri la makausa, kundi gin-ulang kami ni Satanas.
en: For we wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, did, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.

war: Kay kamo gudla an amon paglaom, an amon kalipay, ngan an hinungdan han amon pagparayaw han amon pagdarag-an ha atubangan han aton Ginoo nga Jesus kon bumalik na hiya.
en: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?

war: Kamo gud an amon sadang iparayaw ngan ikalipay!
en: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.

war: Sanglit han waray na kami makakailob hini nga kamingaw, nagpabilin kami la ha Atenas,
en: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.

war: basi waray usa ha iyo in magtalaw tungod hini nga mga pagpakurii ha aton. Maaram kamo ngahaw nga ini nga pagpakurii ha aton kanan Dyos ini kaburut-on.
en: so that no one would be unsettled by these trials. For you know quite well that we are destined for them.

war: Kay han nakada pa kami ha iyo, ginsumatan kamo namon ngadaan nga pagpapakurian gud kita; ngan sumala han iyo nahibaroan, amo gud ini an nahinabo.
en: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.

war: Sanglit, kabugtoan, ha butnga han amon mga kakurian ngan pag-antos, nadasig kami tungod han iyo pagtoo,
en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.

war: kay yana nakakaginhawa na kami hin maupay kay marig-on an iyo pagtindog dida ha pag-alagad han Ginoo.
en: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.

war: Yana makakagpasalamat na kami han Dyos tungod ha iyo. Nagpapasalamat kami tungod han amon kalipay ha atubangan han amon Dyos tungod ha iyo.
en: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in the presence of our God because of you?

war: Kinasingkasing an amon pangamuyo ha iya adlaw-gab-i, nga magkirigta kita ngan makahatag kami han ginkikinahanglan han iyo pagtoo.
en: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.

war: Ihatag unta ha amon han aton Dyos ngan Amay ngan han aton Ginoo nga Jesus an higayon hin pagduaw ha iyo!
en: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.

war: Patuboon unta han Ginoo an iyo paghigugmaay ha iyo ngahaw ngan ha ngatanan nga mga tawo, ngan masugad unta ito kadako han amon paghigugma ha iyo.
en: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

war: Kay maaram na man kamo han mga tugon nga iginhatag namon ha iyo, pinaagi han pagburot-an han Ginoo nga Jesus.
en: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

war: Amo ini an kaburut-on han Dyos ha iyo: karuyag niya nga magbaraan ngan magkalikay gud kamo han kalaw-ayan.
en: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;

war: Kinahanglan mahibaro an tagsa ha iyo nga mga lalake hin pagdumara hin asawa ha baraan ngan dungganan nga paagi,
en: that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable,

war: nga diri inupdan hin malaw-ay nga ungara, sugad han ginbubuhat han mga tawo nga diri nakilala han Dyos.
en: not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;

war: Gintawag kita han Dyos basi mag-ukoy kita dida hin kinabuhi nga baraan, diri ha kalaw-ayan.
en: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

war: Sanglit, kon hin-o in magsalikway hini nga pagturon-an, diri nagsasalikway hin tawo, kundi han Dyos nga nahatag ha iyo han iya Espiritu Santo.
en: Therefore, anyone who rejects this instruction does not reject a human being but God, the very God who gives you his Holy Spirit.

war: Waray na kinahanglan hin pagsurat pa ha iyo mahitungod hin paghigugma han iyo igkasi matinuohon. Igintutdo na ha iyo han Dyos kon uunanhon niyo paggihigugmaay.
en: Now about your love for one another we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.

war: Ngan ginbuhat na ini niyo ha ngatanan nga kabugtoan ha bug-os nga Macedonia. Sanglit, kabugtoan, nahangyo kami ha iyo nga malarolabaw pa an iyo paggihigugmaay.
en: And in fact, you do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so more and more,

war: Tinguhaa niyo an pag-ukoy hin malinawon, pagpanimangno han iyo kalugaringon nga panginabuhi, sugad han iginsiring namon ha iyo hadto.
en: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,

war: Dida hini nga paagi, tatahoron kamo hadton diri mga magtinuohon ngan diri na kamo matapod bisan kan kanay han iyo mga kinahanglanon.
en: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.

war: Kabugtoan, karuyag namon nga mahibaroan niyo an kamatuoran mahitungod han mga nagkamatay na, basi diri kamo magmabidoon, sugad hadton mga tawo nga waray paglaom.
en: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope.

war: Natoo kita nga namatay hi Jesus ngan nabanhaw liwat. Sanglit natoo man kita nga pagbabanhawon han Dyos upod kan Jesus adton ngatanan nga nagkamatay nga natoo ha iya.
en: For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.

war: Niyan, babayawon upod ha ira ngadto ha mga dampog kita nga mga buhi pa hadto nga panahon, pagtapo han Ginoo didto ha panganuron, ngan diri na kita mahibubulag han Ginoo.
en: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

war: Sanglit, pagdinasigay kamo tungod hini nga mga pulong.
en: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

war: Kabugtoan, waray na kinahanglan nga magsurat pa ako ha iyo mahitungod han mga takna ngan mga panahon, kon san-o mahinanabo ini nga mga butang.
en: Now, brothers and sisters, about times and dates we do not need to write to you,

war: Kay maaram gud kamo ngahaw nga maabot an Adlaw han Ginoo sugad hin pag-abot hin kawatan ha kagab-ihon.
en: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

war: Kundi, kabugtoan, diri na kamo aada ha kasisidman, sanglit diri na kamo hikakalitan hito nga Adlaw nga maabot sugad hin kawatan.
en: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.

war: Kamo ngatanan nga mga tawo nga sakop han kapawa, ngan sakop han adlaw; diri kita sakop han kagab-ihon o han kasisidman.
en: You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

war: Sanglit kinahanglan diri kita mangaturog sugad han iba; kundi kinahanglan mag-agma kita ngan magmalinaw an panhunahuna.
en: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be awake and sober.

war: Batasan han mga tawo an pagkaturog ngan paghubog ha gab-i.
en: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

war: Waray kita pilia han Dyos basi mag-antos han iya kapungot, kundi basi angkonon naton an katalwasan pinaagi han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo,
en: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

war: nga nagpakamatay para ha aton, basi mag-ukoy kita upod ha iya, buhi o patay kita ha pagbalik niya.
en: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.

war: Tungod hini nga hinungdan, pagdinasigay ngan pagbinuligay kamo sugad gud han iyo binubuhat yana.
en: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

war: Kabugtoan, nahangyo kami ha iyo nga tahoron niyo hin kaangayan adton mga nagbubuhat dida ha iyo, hira nga ginpile han Ginoo pagmando ngan pagtutdo ha iyo.
en: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to acknowledge those who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.

war: Timangnoa niyo hira upod an gidadakoi nga pagtahod ngan paghigugma, tungod han buruhaton nga ira gintutuman. Magmalinawon unta an tagsatagsa ha iyo.
en: Hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.

war: Nag-aaghat kami ha iyo, kabugtoan: sagdoni an mga hubya, dasiga an mga awdanon, buligi an mga magluya, ngan ipakita ha ngatanan an iyo kamailobon.
en: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.

war: Ayaw niyo bulsa hin maraot an nagbubuhat hin maraot, kundi tinguhaa niyo nga an pagbuhat hin maupay hiagoman han tagsa tagsa ngan ha ngatanan nga mga tawo.
en: Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong, but always strive to do what is good for each other and for everyone else.

war: Dayuday pagmalipayon kamo,
en: Rejoice always,

war: pag-ampo ha ngatanan nga panahon,
en: pray continually,

war: pagpasalamat kamo han bisan ano nga nadangat ha iyo. Amo ini an karuyag han Dyos ha iyo, han iyo kinabuhi ha pag-alagad kan Cristo Jesus.
en: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

war: Ayaw niyo pagpugngi an Espiritu Santo.
en: Do not quench the Spirit.

war: Ayaw niyo pagtamaya an dyosnon nga mga mensahe.
en: Do not treat prophecies with contempt

war: Sarihi an ngatanan nga mga butang: tipigi an maupay
en: but test them all; hold on to what is good,

war: ngan likayi an ngatanan nga karat-an.
en: reject every kind of evil.

war: Bubuhaton ito niya nga nagtatawag ha iyo, kay matinumanon hiya.
en: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

war: Kabugtoan, ig-ampo liwat kami niyo.
en: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

war: Ipangumosta kami han ngatanan nga kabugtoan hin minagburugto nga harok.
en: Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.

war: Nag-aaghat ako ha iyo, ha pagburut-an han Ginoo, nga basahon niyo ini nga surat ha ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon.
en: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.

war: An grasya han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo maada unta ha iyo.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

war: Tikang kan Pablo nga apostol ni Cristo Jesus tungod han pagbuot han Dyos nga aton Magtaralwas ngan ni Cristo Jesus nga aton paglaom—
en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

war: Ngadto kan Timoteo nga akon matuod nga anak ha pagtoo: An Dyos nga aton Amay ngan hi Cristo Jesus nga aton Ginoo maghatag unta han gugma, kalooy, ngan kamurayaw ha imo!
en: To Timothy my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

war: An tuyo hini nga sugo amo an pagpukaw han gugma nga natikang hin putli nga kasingkasing, malinis nga panhunahuna, ngan tinuod nga pagtoo.
en: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.

war: May mga tawo nga binmulag na ngan nawara ha ira mga dalan tungod hin binuang nga larulantugi.
en: Some have departed from these and have turned to meaningless talk.

war: Karuyag nira magin magturutdo han balaod han Dyos, kundi diri nira hinsasabtan an ira kalugaringon nga mga pulong o an mga butang nga ira ginhihimangraw upod in dako nga pagtapod.
en: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not know what they are talking about or what they so confidently affirm.

war: Sayod kita nga maupay an Balaod kon gamiton hin igo ngan angay nga paagi.
en: We know that the law is good if one uses it properly.

war: Hin-aagian ito nga pagturon-an dida han Maupay nga Sumat nga igintapod ha akon hin pagpasangyaw, an Maupay nga Sumat nga tikang han mahimayaon ngan darayawon nga Dyos.
en: that conforms to the gospel concerning the glory of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.

war: Nagpapasalamat ako kan Cristo Jesus nga aton Ginoo, nga naghatag ha akon hin kusog para han akon buruhaton, tungod nga gintungdan ngan gin-isip ako niya nga takos mag-alagad ha iya,
en: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength, that he considered me trustworthy, appointing me to his service.

war: bisan kon ginpakaraot, ginpakurian, ngan gintamay ko hiya hadto anay. Kundi nalooy an Dyos ha akon kay waray pa ako hadto pagtoo ngan waray ako sabot han akon ginbuhat.
en: Even though I was once a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man, I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and unbelief.

war: Ngan igin-ipis ha akon han Ginoo an iya hura nga grasya ngan iginhatag ha akon an pagtoo ngan gugma nga aton naaangkon pinaagi hin pakig-usa kan Cristo Jesus.
en: The grace of our Lord was poured out on me abundantly, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

war: Matuod ini nga mga pulong nga angay ta karawaton ngan tuohan hin hingpit: kinmanhi ha kalibutan hi Cristo Jesus hin pagtalwas han mga makasasala. Ako an labi nga kamaraot ha ira,
en: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the worst.

war: Ngadto han dayon nga Hadi, waray kamatayon ngan diri kinikita, han amo la nga Dyos—ha iya an kadungganan ngan an pagdayaw hin waray kataposan. Amen.
en: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

war: Ipadayon an imo pagtoo ngan malinis nga konsyensya. May mga tawo nga waray mamati han ira konsensya, ngan napakyas an ira pagtoo.
en: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and so have suffered shipwreck with regard to the faith.

war: Nahiupod ha ira hira Himeneo ug Alejandro, nga akon na igintubyan ngadto han gahom ni Satanas, basi katutdoan hira hin diri na pagpakaraot han Dyos.
en: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.

war: Sanglit, una ha ngatanan, nag-aaghat ako nga ihalad niyo ngadto sa Dyos an mga pangamuyo, mga pag-ampo, ngan mga pagpasalamat para han ngatanan nga mga tawo;
en: I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people—

war: para han mga hadi ngan han ngatanan nga iba nga mga pamunoan, basi mag-ukoy kita hin mamingaw ngan malinawon nga kinabuhi, dida ha pag-alagad han Dyos ha matadong nga pamatasan.
en: for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.

war: Maupay ngan nakakalipay ini han Dyos nga aton Magtaralwas,
en: This is good, and pleases God our Savior,

war: nga naruruyag nga matalwas an ngatanan nga mahibaro han kamatuoran.
en: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

war: Kay uusa la an Dyos, ngan uusa la an makakag-usa han Dyos nga han mga tawo; amo ini hi Cristo Jesus
en: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

war: Amo ini an hinungdan nga ginsugo ako nga apostol ngan magturutdo han mga Hentil, hin pagsangyaw han mensahe han pagtoo ngan kamatuoran. Nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, diri ako nagbubuwa!
en: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am telling the truth, I am not lying—and a true and faithful teacher of the Gentiles.

war: Karuyag ko nga mag-ampo an kalalaken-an ha ngatanan nga dapit, kalalaken-an nga hinalad ngadto han Dyos, nga binayaw an ira mga kamot ha pag-ampo hin waray kasina o pagkaaway-away.
en: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or disputing.

war: kundi hin mag-upay nga mga panggawi nga angay hin kababayen-an nga mainampoon.
en: but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.

war: Kinahanglan nga mahibaro an kababayen-an hin hilom ngan hingpit nga pagpaubos.
en: A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.

war: Diri ako natugot nga an kababayen-an magtutdo o maagaron han kalalaken-an; kinahanglan humilom la hira.
en: I do not permit a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; she must be quiet.

war: Kay una paghimoon hi Adan, san-o hi Eva.
en: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

war: Ngan diri hi Adan kundi hi Eva, an babaye, an ginlimbongan ngan nagtalapas han sugo han Dyos.
en: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and became a sinner.

war: Kundi matatalwas an babaye pinaagi hin kamay-ada anak, kon magpadayon hiya hin pagtoo, paghigugma, ngan pagkaputli, upod an kaligdong.
en: But women will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith, love and holiness with propriety.

war: Matuod ini nga darahunon: kon karuyag in tawo pagpangulo hin singbahan, naungara hiya hin maupay gud nga buruhaton.
en: Here is a trustworthy saying: Whoever aspires to be an overseer desires a noble task.

war: kinahanglan diri hiya parahubog o maisog nga tawo, kundi mapuanguron ngan diri makiawayon; kinahanglan diri hiya makisalapi;
en: not given to drunkenness, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.

war: kinahanglan nakakagdumara hiya hin maupay han iya kalugaringon nga panimalay, ngan nakakapasunod hiya han iya mga anak hin pagsugot ug pagtahod ha iya.
en: He must manage his own family well and see that his children obey him, and he must do so in a manner worthy of full respect.

war: Kay kon diri hiya maaram magdumara han iya kalugaringon nga panimalay, uunanhon man hin pakagmangno niya han singbahan han Dyos?
en: (If anyone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God’s church?)

war: Kinahanglan nga hamtong na hiya ha pagtoo, basi diri hiya pumarayaw ngan paghukman hiya ha karat-an sugad han Yawa.
en: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same judgment as the devil.

war: Kinahanglan tawo hiya nga tinatahod han iba nga mga tawo nga diri sakop han singbahan, basi diri hiya maalohan ngan mahulog ha bitik han Yawa.
en: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil’s trap.

war: Kinahanglan liwat nga tangkod ngan may maupay nga pamatasan an mga kabulig han singbahan; kinahanglan diri gud hira maghubog kon mainom hira hin bino, ngan diri halot;
en: In the same way, deacons are to be worthy of respect, sincere, not indulging in much wine, and not pursuing dishonest gain.

war: kinahanglan nga pagtumanon nira an iginpadayag nga kamatuoran han pagtoo, upod in limpyo nga konsensya.
en: They must keep hold of the deep truths of the faith with a clear conscience.

war: Kinahanglan sarihan hira anay, ngan kon makapasar hira hini makakahimo na hira hin pag-alagad ha singbahan.
en: They must first be tested; and then if there is nothing against them, let them serve as deacons.

war: Kinahanglan liwat maupay an pamatasan han ira mga asawa, ngan diri maglibak; kinahanglan buotan ngan tangkod hira ha ngatanan nga butang.
en: In the same way, the women are to be worthy of respect, not malicious talkers but temperate and trustworthy in everything.

war: Kinahanglan usa la an asawa han kabulig han singbahan, ngan maupay magdumara han iya mga anak ngan panimalay.
en: A deacon must be faithful to his wife and must manage his children and his household well.

war: Adton may maupay nga buhat nakakaangkon hin maupay nga dungog, ngan nakakaghimangraw hin waray kahadlok hiunong han ira pagtoo kan Cristo Jesus.
en: Those who have served well gain an excellent standing and great assurance in their faith in Christ Jesus.

war: Samtang ginsusurat ko ini ha imo, naglalaom ako hin diri maiha hin pagkada ngan pagkigkita ha imo.
en: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,

war: Gintututdo ini nga mga pagturon-an hin maglimbong nga mga tawo nga buwaon kanay konsensya patay na sugad hin naogtang pinaagi hin binangga nga puthaw.
en: Such teachings come through hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared as with a hot iron.

war: Maupay an nga-tanan nga ginhimo han Dyos; waray bisan usa nga igsalikway, kundi angay karawaton an ngatanan inupdan hin pagpasalamat;
en: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,

war: kay pinaagi han pulong han Dyos ngan han pag-ampo, kinakarawat ini han Dyos.
