war: Amo ini an mga anak nga natawo didto ha Jerusalem: hira Samua, Sobab, Natan, Solomon,
en: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

war: Ibaar, Elisua, Nefeg, Jafia,
en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

war: Elisama, Eliada, ug Elifelet.
en: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.

war: Nagkaabot ngadto ha Kahamub-an han Refaim an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan ini.
en: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

war: Han pangalagiw han mga Filisteohanon, ginbayaan nira didto an ira mga diyosdiyos, ngan gindara ini ni David ngan han iya mga tawo.
en: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them off.

war: Niyan binmalik ngadto ha Kahamub-an han Refaim an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan na liwat ini.
en: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

war: Ginpakianhan na liwat ni David an Ginoo nga nagbaton, “Ayaw hira pagsulonga tikang dinhe, kundi libota ngan sulonga hira ha luyo, hirani han mga kahoy nga balsamo.
en: so David inquired of the Lord , and he answered, “Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.

war: Gintuman ni David an iginsugo han Ginoo , ngan nakatabog hiya han mga Filisteohanon tikang ha Gabaon tubtob gud ngadto ha Gezer.
en: So David did as the Lord commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

war: Gintirok na liwat ni David an gimamag-upayi nga mga sondalo didto ha Israel, nga inmabot ngatanan hin 30,000 nga kalalaken-an,
en: David again brought together all the able young men of Israel—thirty thousand.

war: nga nag-uuna han karomata hi Ahio.
en: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.

war: Han pag-abot na nira han giriokan nga dapit han Nacon, natumba an mga baka ngan nagguguyod han karomata, ngan kinaptan dayon ni Uza an Kahon han Ginsaaran.
en: When they came to the threshing floor of Nakon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.

war: sanglit tikang hadto gintawag nga Perez Uza adto nga dapit. Napungot hi David kay ginkastigo han Ginoo , ha iya kasina, hi Uza.
en: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

war: Niyan nahadlok han Ginoo hi David ngan nagsiring hiya, “Uunanhon ko yana pakadara han Kahon han Ginsaaran?”
en: David was afraid of the Lord that day and said, “How can the ark of the Lord ever come to me?”

war: Sanglit naglarang hiya nga diri na la dad-on an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngadto ha Jerusalem; linmiko lugod hiya ngan gindara ini ngadto han balay ni Obed Edom nga taga syudad han Gat.
en: He was not willing to take the ark of the Lord to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

war: Nagpabilin ini didto hin pito ka bulan, ngan ginbendisyonan han Ginoo hi Obed Edom ngan an iya panimalay.
en: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months, and the Lord blessed him and his entire household.

war: Nagsinayaw hi David, tugob hin kalipay, ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo , nga nakakatapis la hiya hin dugnit nga lino.
en: Wearing a linen ephod, David was dancing before the Lord with all his might,

war: Sanglit gindara niya ngan han ngatanan nga mga Israelita an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngadto ha Jerusalem inupdan hin rugyaw ngan tunog hin mga trompeta.
en: while he and all Israel were bringing up the ark of the Lord with shouts and the sound of trumpets.

war: Han kahuman niya paghalad, ginbendisyonan niya an mga tawo ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum,
en: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord Almighty.

war: Waray gud mag-anak hi Mical nga anak ni Saul, asta nga namatay.
en: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.

war: Madig-on na an kamutangan ni Hadi David didto han iya palasyo, ngan gintalwas na hiya han Ginoo han ngatanan niya nga mga kaaway.
en: After the king was settled in his palace and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him,

war: Niyan nagsiring an hadi kan Natan, “Nag-uokoy ako dida hin balay nga hinimo hin mga kahoy nga sidro, kundi aada la hin tulda an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Dyos!”
en: he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.”

war: Binmaton hi Natan, “Buhata an imo ginhuhunahuna, kay aada ha imo an Ginoo .”
en: Nathan replied to the king, “Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the Lord is with you.”

war: Kundi hito nga gab-i nagsiring an Ginoo kan Natan,
en: But that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:

war: “Kadtoa ngan sumati hi David, an akon surugoon, nga nasiring ako ha iya, ‘Diri ikaw an magtitindog hin templo nga akon uokyan.
en: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?

war: Hiya amo an magtitindog hin templo para ha akon, ngan tatalinguhaon ko nga maghadi an iya katulinan ha kadayonan.
en: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

war: Magigin amay ako niya ngan magigin anak ko hiya. Kon makasayop hiya, kakastigohon ko hiya sugad hin pagkastigo han iya anak hin usa nga amay.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with a rod wielded by men, with floggings inflicted by human hands.

war: Kundi diri ko kukuhaon ha iya an akon tambulig, sugad han akon ginbuhat kan Saul nga akon ginkuha basi mahimo ka nga hadi.
en: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.

war: Dayuday magkakamay-ada mga tulin ngan magpapadayon an imo ginhadian. Diri gud matatapos an paghadi han imo katulinan.’”
en: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me ; your throne will be established forever.’ ”

war: Iginsumat ni Natan kan David an ngatanan nga iginpadayag ha iya han Dyos.
en: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.

war: Niyan sinmulod hi David han Tulda han Ginoo , linmingkod, ngan nag-ampo hiya, “Diri ako takus, bisan ngani an akon panimalay han imo na ginbuhat ha akon, O Ginoo nga Dyos .
en: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: “Who am I, Sovereign Lord , and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

war: Ano pa in akon igsisiring ha imo! Nakilala ka ha akon nga imo surugoon.
en: “What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Sovereign Lord .

war: Imo ini kaburot-on ngan paglarang hin pagbuhat hini; ginbuhat mo ini ngatanan nga dagko nga mga butang basi makagtutdo ka ha akon.
en: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.

war: Hin pagkagamhanan nimo, O Ginoo nga Dyos ! Waray gud masugad ha imo; maaram gud kami nga ikaw la an Dyos.
en: “How great you are, Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

war: Ginhimo mo nga imo kalugaringon nga nasod an Israel ha kadayonan, ngan ikaw, O Ginoo , nahimo nga ira Dyos.
en: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.

war: “Ngan yana, O Ginoo nga Dyos , tumana ha ngatanan nga panahon an iginsaad mo mahitungod ha akon ngan han akon katulinan, ngan tumana an imo iginsiring nga imo bubuhaton.
en: “And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,

war: Mababantogan ka hin duro, ngan masiring ha kadayonan an mga tawo, ‘An Ginoo nga Labi Kamakagarahum amo an Dyos han Israel.’ Ngan imo ipapadayon ha ngatanan nga panahon an akon katulinan.
en: so that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty is God over Israel!’ And the house of your servant David will be established in your sight.

war: “Ngan yana, O Ginoo nga Dyos , ikaw amo an Dyos; dayuday nagtutuman ka han imo mga saad, ngan imo ginhimo ha akon ini nga makaaramdok nga saad.
en: Sovereign Lord , you are God! Your covenant is trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.

war: Waray kaiha ginsulong na liwat ni David an mga Filisteohanon, ginpirde hira, ngan waray na hin pagdumara han ira tuna.
en: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.

war: Nagpadara hin kasondalohan an mga Siriahanon han Damasco hin pagbulig kan Hadi Hadadeser; pinakiawayan hira ni David ngan pinamatay in 22,000 ka tawo.
en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

war: Gin-agaw ni David an bulawan nga mga taming nga dara han mga opisyal ni Hadadeser ngadto ha Jerusalem.
en: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

war: Ginkuha liwat niya in kadam-an nga mga bronse tikang ha Beta ug Berotai nga mga syudad nga ginhahadian ni Hadadeser.
en: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

war: Hinbatian ni Hadi Toi han Hamat nga ginpirde ni David an ngatanan nga kasondalohan ni Hadadeser.
en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,

war: Iginhalad ini ni Hadi David nga garamiton hin pagsingba upod han salapi ug bulawan nga iya nakuha didto han mga nasod nga iya napirde—
en: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:

war: an Edumea, Moab, Filistia, ug Amalek—sugad man hin bahin han naagaw niya kan Hadadeser.
en: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

war: Labi nga nabantogan hi David han pagbalik niya tikang hin pamatay hin 18,000 nga mga Edomitanhon didto ha Kahamub-an han Asin.
en: And David became famous after he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

war: Naghadi hi David han bug-os nga Israel, ngan gintalinguha niya nga dayuday nga maupay an iya pagdumara ngan waray pinalabi nga iya mga tawo.
en: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

war: Hi Joab kanay iroy amo hi Seruia amo an pangulo han kasondalohan; hi Josafat nga anak ni Ahilud amo an tinaporan han mga sinurat;
en: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

war: hira Sadoc nga anak ni Ahitob ngan hi Ahimelec nga anak ni Abiatar amo an kapadian; hi Seraias amo an sekretaryo han korte;
en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;

war: hi Benaia nga anak ni Joiada amo an tinaporan han mga gwardya ni David; ngan kapadian liwat an mga anak ni David.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.

war: Usa ka adlaw nagpakiana hi David, “May-ada pa ba nahibilin han panimalay ni Saul? Kon may-ada, karuyag ko magpakita hin kalooy ha iya tungod kan Jonatan.”
en: David asked, “Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

war: “Hain man hiya?” pinmakiana an hadi. Binmaton hi Siba, “Aadto hiya han balay ni Maquir nga anak ni Amiel didto ha Lodebar.”
en: “Where is he?” the king asked. Ziba answered, “He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar.”

war: Sanglit iginpakuha ini nga tawo ni Hadi David.
en: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.

war: Yinmukbo liwat hi Mefiboset ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga magmamaupay ka hin duro ha akon nga sugad man la ako hin patay nga ayam?”
en: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should notice a dead dog like me?”

war: Niyan gintawag han hadi hi Siba nga surugoon ni Saul ngan ginsiring, “Akon ihinahatag kan Mefiboset nga apo han imo agaron an ngatanan nga gintag-iya ni Saul ngan han iya panimalay.
en: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, “I have given your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.

war: May batan-on nga anak nga lalake hi Mefiboset nga ginngaranan kan Mica. Nahimo nga mga surugoon ni Mefiboset an ngatanan nga kaapi han panimalay ni Siba.
en: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mika, and all the members of Ziba’s household were servants of Mephibosheth.

war: Sanglit nag-ukoy didto ha Jerusalem hi Mefiboset nga piay an duha nga tiil, nga dayuday kasaro han hadi.
en: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table; he was lame in both feet.

war: Waray kaiha namatay hi Hadi Nahas han Amon ngan hi Hanun nga iya anak an naghadi.
en: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.

war: Gindakop ni Hanun an mga sinugo ni David, gintusaran an luyo nga katunga han ira mga bungot, gintabasan ha may hawak an ira mga panapton, ngan ginpalakat hira.
en: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.

war: Hinbaroan ini ni David ngan ginsugo niya hi Joab hin pagsulong ha ira upod an ngatanan nga kasondalohan.
en: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.

war: Iginbutang niya an iba han iya kasondalohan ha ubos han pagdumara ni Abisai nga iya bugto, nga ginpaatubang ini hira han mga Amonitanhon.
en: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.

war: Pagmakusog ngan pagmaisog! Pakig-away kita hin maupay tungod han aton mga tawo ngan tungod han mga syudad han aton Dyos. Ngan matuman unta an kaburot-on han Ginoo !”
en: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight.”

war: Sinmulong hin pakig-away hi Joab ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan nangalagiw an mga Siriahanon.
en: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

war: Han pakakita han mga Siriahanon nga ginpirde na hira han mga Israelita, gintirok nira an ngatanan nira nga kasondalohan.
en: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.

war: Sanglit nagsugo hi David hin pagpanginano kon hin-o hiya, ngan hinbaroan nga hi Batseba hiya nga anak ni Eliam ngan asawa ni Urias nga Hiteohanon.
en: and David sent someone to find out about her. The man said, “She is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.”

war: Waray kaiha nakasabot hiya nga burod na hiya ngan ginsumatan niya hi David.
en: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, “I am pregnant.”

war: Ginpatugonan ni David hi Joab, “Pakadia ha akon hi Urias nga Hiteohanon.” Sanglit gindara ni Joab hi Urias ngadto kan David.
en: So David sent this word to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” And Joab sent him to David.

war: Han pag-abot ni Urias, ginpakianhan hiya ni David han kahimtang ni Joab ngan han mga sondalo, ngan kon ano na an araway.
en: When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were and how the war was going.

war: Katapos nagsiring hiya kan Urias, “Uli na ngan pahuway anay.” Linmakat hi Urias ngan ginpalanatan hiya hin regalo ni David.
en: Then David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

war: Kundi waray umuli hi Urias; kinmaturog la lugod hiya didto han ganghaan han palasyo tampo han mga gwardya han hadi.
en: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master’s servants and did not go down to his house.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi David, “Kon sugad, pabilin na la dinhe yana nga adlaw ngan pababalikon ko ikaw buwas.” Sanglit nagpabilin hi Urias didto ha Jerusalem hito nga adlaw ngan han pagkabuwas.
en: Then David said to him, “Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back.” So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.

war: Han pagkaaga nagsurat hi David kan Joab ngan iginpadara ini kan Urias.
en: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.

war: Iginsurat niya: “Ikadto ha atubangan hi Urias diin makusog hin duro an araway; ngan isol ikaw ngan pabay-i hiya nga mamatay.”
en: In it he wrote, “Put Uriah out in front where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die.”

war: Sanglit han ginlilibotan ni Joab an syudad, ikinadto niya hi Urias hin dapit nga iya hinsabtan nga makusog an kaaway.
en: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.

war: Nagkagawas han syudad an kaaway nga kasondalohan, ngan pinakiawayan an kasondalohan ni Joab; may nagkamatay han mga opisyal ni David ngan namatay liwat hi Urias.
en: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David’s army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.

war: Niyan nagpadara hi Joab ngadto kan David hin sumat hiunong han away,
en: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.

war: ngan iya gintugon an sinugo, “Katapos mo pagsumati kan David han ngatanan hiunong han araway,
en: He instructed the messenger: “When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,

war: bangin masina hiya ngan pumakiana ha imo, ‘Kay ano hin paghirani niyo hin duro han syudad hin pakig-away ha ira? Diri ba kamo maaram nga magamit hira hin mga pana tikang han pader?
en: the king’s anger may flare up, and he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn’t you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?

war: Sanglit kinmadto kan David an sinugo ngan ginsumatan niya hi David han iginsugo ha iya ni Joab.
en: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.

war: Niyan ginpamana kami nira tikang han pader, ngan nagkamatay in pira nga mga opisyal han Imo Kaharangdon; namatay liwat hi Urias nga imo opisyal.”
en: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.”

war: Han paghibaro la ni Batseba nga namatay na an iya bana, nagmasulob-on hiya tungod han iya bana.
en: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.

war: Ginpakadto han Ginoo kan David hi Natan, an manaragna. Nagsiring hi Natan kan David, “May duha ka tawo nga nag-ukoy didto hin usa nga bungto; riko an usa ngan pobre an ikaduha.
en: The Lord sent Nathan to David. When he came to him, he said, “There were two men in a certain town, one rich and the other poor.

war: Damo an mga baka ngan mga karnero han riko,
en: The rich man had a very large number of sheep and cattle,

war: Nasina hin duro hi David kontra han riko ngan nagsiring, “Nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han buhi nga Ginoo nga angay mamatay an tawo nga nagbuhat hini!
en: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan, “As surely as the Lord lives, the man who did this must die!

war: Kinahanglan pagbaydan niya hin upat ka pilo an iya kinuha, tungod han pagbuhat niya hin sugad kamabangis nga butang.”
en: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity.”

war: Sanglit mapatay hin makalilisang nga kamatayon in pira han imo mga panimalay ha kada katulinan, kay imo ako ginsupak ngan gin-agaw mo an asawa ni Urias.
en: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.’

war: Imo ini gintago nga sala, kundi ipabubuhat ko ini ha kapaw-an han adlaw, ha atubangan han bug-os nga Israel.’”
en: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’ ”

war: Nagsiring hi David, “Nakasala ako kontra han Ginoo .” Binmaton hi Natan, “Pinapasaylo ka han Ginoo ; diri ka mapatay.
en: Then David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the Lord .” Nathan replied, “The Lord has taken away your sin. You are not going to die.

war: Kundi tungod kay nagpasipara ka han Ginoo han pagbuhat mo hini, mapatay an imo anak.”
en: But because by doing this you have shown utter contempt for the Lord , the son born to you will die.”

war: Katapos inmoli hi Natan. Ginbuot han Ginoo nga masakit hin grabe an bata nga igin-anak kan David han asawa ni Urias.
en: After Nathan had gone home, the Lord struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne to David, and he became ill.

war: Nag-ampo hi David hin pakimalooy han Dyos nga mag-upay an bata. Nagpuasa hiya ngan kada gab-i nasulod hiya ngadto han iya kwarto ngan nahigda hiya ha salog ha bug-os nga gab-i.
en: David pleaded with God for the child. He fasted and spent the nights lying in sackcloth on the ground.

war: Kinmadto ha iya an mga opisyal han iya palasyo ngan ginpabuhat hiya nira, kundi dinmiri hiya ngan waray gud kumaon upod ha ira.
en: The elders of his household stood beside him to get him up from the ground, but he refused, and he would not eat any food with them.

war: “Oo,” binmaton hi David, “nagpuasa ngan nagtangis ako han buhi pa hiya. Naghunahuna ako nga bangin malooy ha akon an Ginoo ngan diri itugot nga mamatay an bata.
en: He answered, “While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept. I thought, ‘Who knows? The Lord may be gracious to me and let the child live.’

war: Kundi yana nga patay na hiya, kay ano nga magpupuasa pa ako? May gahom ba ako pagbuhi han bata? May adlaw nga mapakadto ako ha iya, kundi diri na gud hiya makakabalik nganhi ha akon.”
en: But now that he is dead, why should I go on fasting? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

war: ngan ginsugo hi Natan nga manaragna nga pagngaranan nga Jedidia an bata, kay ginhigugma hiya han Ginoo .
en: and because the Lord loved him, he sent word through Nathan the prophet to name him Jedidiah.

war: Nagpadayon hi Joab pakig-away kontra han Raba nga kapital nga syudad han Amon, ngan gutiay na gud la marikopo ini.
en: Meanwhile Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal citadel.

war: Nagsugo hiya hin mga tawo hin pagsumat kan David: “Ginsulong ko an Raba ngan nakuha ko an kinukuhaan han syudad hin tubig.
en: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, “I have fought against Rabbah and taken its water supply.

war: Yana tiroka an iba han imo kasondalohan, sulonga an syudad, ngan ikaw ngahaw in paglugaring hin pagsulong, kay diri ko karuyag nga angkonon an dungog hin pakarikopo han syudad.”
en: Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture it. Otherwise I will take the city, and it will be named after me.”

war: Sanglit gintirok ni David an iya kasondalohan, kinmadto ha Raba, ginsulong, ngan nakuha niya an syudad.
en: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.

war: May mahusay nga bugto nga babaye hi Absalon nga anak ni David. Hi Tamar an ngaran hini nga babaye. Nahigugma ha iya hi Amnon nga lain nga anak ni David.
en: In the course of time, Amnon son of David fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of Absalom son of David.

war: Kundi may-ada hi Amnon sangkay nga listo. Hi Jonadab an iya ngaran ngan anak hiya ni Sama nga bugto ni David.
en: Now Amnon had an adviser named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.

war: Sanglit ginpatugonan ni David hi Tamar nga nakadto ha palasyo nga sidngon: “Pakadto han balay ni Amnon ngan andami hiya hin pagkaon.”
en: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: “Go to the house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him.”

war: Han igindudurot na niya an torta kinaptan hiya ni Amnon ngan sidngon, “Dirig ha akon!”
en: But when she took it to him to eat, he grabbed her and said, “Come to bed with me, my sister.”

war: “Ayaw,” nagsiring hiya. “Ayaw gad ako pagpirita hin pagbuhat hin sugad kamakaarawod nga butang! Maraot gud ito!
en: “No, my brother!” she said to him. “Don’t force me! Such a thing should not be done in Israel! Don’t do this wicked thing.

war: Kundi waray la hiya mamati kan Tamar; ngan tungod nga makurukusog man hi Amnon ha iya, linupigan ngan ginlugos hiya.
en: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.

war: “Diri ako,” binmaton hiya. “Larolabaw pa nga sala an pagpaiwas ha akon kay han imo pa gud la ginbuhat yana ha akon!” Kundi waray la pamati ha iya hi Amnon;
en: “No!” she said to him. “Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me.” But he refused to listen to her.

war: gintawag niya an iya kalugaringon nga surugoon ngan ginsiring, “Kuhaa ini nga babaye ha akon atubangan. Pagawsa hiya ngan trangkahi an porta!”
en: He called his personal servant and said, “Get this woman out of my sight and bolt the door after her.”

war: Ginsabragan niya hin agbon an iya ulo, ginggisi an iya bado nga hilaba, ngan linmakat hiya nga nagtitinangis nga tinatakpo han iya kamot an iya bayhon.
en: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the ornate robe she was wearing. She put her hands on her head and went away, weeping aloud as she went.

war: Han paghibaroi ni David han nahinabo, napungot hiya hin duro.
en: When King David heard all this, he was furious.

war: Ngan napungot hin duro hi Absalon kan Amnon tungod han paglugosa niya kan Tamar nga iya bugto, sanglit waray na gud hiya bisan pakighimangraw ha iya.
en: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad; he hated Amnon because he had disgraced his sister Tamar.

war: Paglabay hin duha ka tuig, ginpaarotan ni Absalon an iya mga karnero didto ha Baalhazor nga hirani han bungto han Efraim, ngan gindapit niya an ngatanan nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an han hadi.
en: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal Hazor near the border of Ephraim, he invited all the king’s sons to come there.

war: Kinmadto hiya kan Hadi David ngan nagsiring, “Harangdon nga hadi, ginpapaarotan ko an akon mga karnero. Pakadto gad ikaw ngan an imo mga opisyal hin pagduyog han mga kalipay.”
en: Absalom went to the king and said, “Your servant has had shearers come. Will the king and his attendants please join me?”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Absalon, “Kon diri man, tugoti gad pagkadto bisan na la hi Amnon nga akon bugto.” “Kay ano nga makadto hiya?” pinmakiana an hadi.
en: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon come with us.” The king asked him, “Why should he go with you?”

war: Han nagtitipauli na hira, nasumatan hi David: “Ginpatay ni Absalon an ngatanan nga imo mga anak nga kalalaken-an—waray gud nahisalin ha ira!”
en: While they were on their way, the report came to David: “Absalom has struck down all the king’s sons; not one of them is left.”

war: Tinmindog an hadi, ginggisi tungod hin kabido an iya panapton, ngan natumba ha tuna. Ginggisi liwat an ira mga panapton han kaupod niya nga iya mga surugoon.
en: The king stood up, tore his clothes and lay down on the ground; and all his attendants stood by with their clothes torn.

war: Sanglit ayaw pagtuod han sumat nga patay na an ngatanan mo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an; hi Amnon la an ginpatay.”
en: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king’s sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jonadab kan David, “Amo ito an imo mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga tikanhi, sumala han akon iginsiring.”
en: Jonadab said to the king, “See, the king’s sons have come; it has happened just as your servant said.”

war: Kundi han kahuman niya hin kamasulob-on tungod han kamatay ni Amnon, nahidlaw hiya hin duro kan Absalon.
en: And King David longed to go to Absalom, for he was consoled concerning Amnon’s death.

war: Hinbaroan ni Joab nga anak ni Seruia nga nahihidlaw hin duro hi Hadi David kan Absalon,
en: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that the king’s heart longed for Absalom.

war: Niyan kadtoa an hadi ngan sidnga hiya han akon igsisiring ha imo.” Katapos ginsumatan hiya ni Joab han iya igyayakan han hadi.
en: Then go to the king and speak these words to him.” And Joab put the words in her mouth.

war: Nasingadto han hadi an babaye, hinmapa hiya ha tuna ha paghatag hin katalahuran, ngan nagsiring, “Buligi gad ako, Harangdon nga Hadi!”
en: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell with her face to the ground to pay him honor, and she said, “Help me, Your Majesty!”

war: “Ano an imo karuyag?” ginpakianhan hiya. Binmaton hiya, “Pobre ako nga balo. Patay na an akon bana.
en: The king asked her, “What is troubling you?” She said, “I am a widow; my husband is dead.

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Uli nala, ngan akon ini paninimangnoon.”
en: The king said to the woman, “Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf.”

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Harangdon nga Hadi, bisan ano an imo buhaton, aangkonon ko ngan han akon panimalay an kabasolan; diri hidadarahigan han sala ikaw ngan an hadianon nga panimalay.”
en: But the woman from Tekoa said to him, “Let my lord the king pardon me and my family, and let the king and his throne be without guilt.”

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Kon may magtarhog ha imo, dad-a hiya nganhi ha akon ngan diri ka na gud pagsasamokon niya.”
en: The king replied, “If anyone says anything to you, bring them to me, and they will not bother you again.”

war: Nagsiring an babaye, “Alayon, Harangdon nga Hadi, tugoti gad ako pagyakan hin makausa nala.” “Sigi,” binmaton hiya.
en: Then the woman said, “Let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” “Speak,” he replied.

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Mapakiana ako ha imo, ngan kinahanglan sumatan mo ako han bug-os nga kamatuoran.” “Pakianhi ako, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hiya.
en: Then the king said to the woman, “Don’t keep from me the answer to what I am going to ask you.” “Let my lord the king speak,” the woman said.

war: Waray pag-iha nagsiring an hadi kan Joab, “Naglarang na ako hin pagbuhat han imo karuyag. Kadtoa ngan kuhaa an batan-on nga hi Absalon ngan ibalik hiya nganhi.”
en: The king said to Joab, “Very well, I will do it. Go, bring back the young man Absalom.”

war: Niyan binmuhat hiya ngan kinmadto ha Gesur, ngan iginbalik hi Absalon ngadto ha Jerusalem.
en: Then Joab went to Geshur and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.

war: Waray na malabaw hin kabantogan ha bug-os nga Israel tungod han iya kagwapo kay kan Absalon; waray hiya karat-an tikang han iya alimpoporo ngadto han iya rapadapa.
en: In all Israel there was not a man so highly praised for his handsome appearance as Absalom. From the top of his head to the sole of his foot there was no blemish in him.

war: May tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an hi Absalon, ngan usa nga babaye nga ginngaranan kan Tamar, mahusay hin duro nga babaye.
en: Three sons and a daughter were born to Absalom. His daughter’s name was Tamar, and she became a beautiful woman.

war: Nag-ukoy hi Absalon hin duha ka tuig didto ha Jerusalem ngan waray hiya igkakita han hadi.
en: Absalom lived two years in Jerusalem without seeing the king’s face.

war: Niyan ginpasugoan niya hi Joab nga makadto hiya han hadi basi kabuligan hiya; kundi dinmiri hi Joab. Ginpasugoan na liwat hiya ni Absalon, kundi dinmiri gihapon hi Joab.
en: Then Absalom sent for Joab in order to send him to the king, but Joab refused to come to him. So he sent a second time, but he refused to come.

war: Kinmadto dayon hi Joab han balay ni Absalon ngan nagpakiana, “Kay ano nga ginsunog han imo mga surugoon an akon uma?”
en: Then Joab did go to Absalom’s house, and he said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

war: Katapos hini, nag-andam hi Absalon para ha iya ngahaw hin usa nga karuwahe ngan hin mga kabayo ngan hin 50 nga mga sondalo nga mag-uupodupod ha iya.
en: In the course of time, Absalom provided himself with a chariot and horses and with fifty men to run ahead of him.

war: nagsiring hi Absalon, “Tinuod, may katadungan ka, kundi waray natindog para han hadi nga mamamati han imo sumbong.”
en: Then Absalom would say to him, “Look, your claims are valid and proper, but there is no representative of the king to hear you.”

war: Ngan sinusumpayan pa niya, “Kon maghurukom pa unta ako! Kon may madangop ha akon nga may kalipongan o sumbong, pamamatian ko hiya ngan ihahatag ko ha iya an katadungan.”
en: And Absalom would add, “If only I were appointed judge in the land! Then everyone who has a complaint or case could come to me and I would see that they receive justice.”

war: Kon may nadaop kan Absalon nga tawo ngan nayukbo ha iya atubangan, idinuduhol dayon niya an iya kamot, kinakaptan, ngan hinahadkan niya an tawo.
en: Also, whenever anyone approached him to bow down before him, Absalom would reach out his hand, take hold of him and kiss him.

war: Ginbuhat ini ni Absalon ha ngatanan nga Israelita nga nadangop han hadi hin pagpatuhay, sanglit nalukmay ni Absalon in damo nga mga Israelita.
en: Absalom behaved in this way toward all the Israelites who came to the king asking for justice, and so he stole the hearts of the people of Israel.

war: Katapos hin upat ka tuig, nagsiring hi Absalon kan Hadi David, “Tugoti ako hin pagkadto ha Hebron basi makatuman ako han akon iginsaad han Ginoo .
en: At the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, “Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow I made to the Lord .

war: “Maupay na la nga imo paglakat,” nagsiring an hadi. Sanglit kinmadto ha Hebron hi Absalon.
en: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he went to Hebron.

war: May-ada duha ka gatos nga mga tawo nga inmupod kan Absalon, tikang ha Jerusalem nga mga dinapit niya ngan waray hira kalibutan han nahunahunaan ni Absalon.
en: Two hundred men from Jerusalem had accompanied Absalom. They had been invited as guests and went quite innocently, knowing nothing about the matter.

war: Nagsumat kan David an usa nga ginsugo, “Damo na nga mga Israelita an inmapi kan Absalon.”
en: A messenger came and told David, “The hearts of the people of Israel are with Absalom.”

war: “Oo, Harangdon nga Hadi,” binmaton hira. “Andam kami pagbuhat han bisan ano nga imo igsiring ha amon.”
en: The king’s officials answered him, “Your servants are ready to do whatever our lord the king chooses.”

war: Sanglit linmakat an hadi nga upod an ngatanan niya nga panimalay ngan mga opisyal, gawas la hin napulo nga mga aruasawa nga iya ginbilin hin panimangno han palasyo.
en: The king set out, with his entire household following him; but he left ten concubines to take care of the palace.

war: Han nabaya na han syudad an hadi ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga tawo, hinmapit hira dida han kataposan nga balay.
en: So the king set out, with all the people following him, and they halted at the edge of the city.

war: Tinmindog tupad ha iya an ngatanan nga iya mga opisyal samtang nalabay ha iya atubangan an hadianon nga mga gwardya. Linmabay liwat an 600 nga mga sondalo nga sinmunod ha iya tikang ha Gat,
en: All his men marched past him, along with all the Kerethites and Pelethites; and all the six hundred Gittites who had accompanied him from Gath marched before the king.

war: “Kon sugad, maupay,” binmaton hi David. “Upod ha akon.” Sanglit inmupod hi Itai, dara an iya mga tawo ngan an ira mga sakop.
en: David said to Ittai, “Go ahead, march on.” So Ittai the Gittite marched on with all his men and the families that were with him.

war: Kundi kon diri na hiya nalilipay ha akon—ada, buhaton na la niya ha akon an iya karuyag.”
en: But if he says, ‘I am not pleased with you,’ then I am ready; let him do to me whatever seems good to him.”

war: Aadto ako, mahulat ha mga tarabukan han salog didto ha kamingawan ngada han pakakarawat ko hin sumat tikang ha imo.”
en: I will wait at the fords in the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

war: Sanglit iginbalik ngadto ha Jerusalem nira Sadoc ug Abiatar an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngan nagpabilin hira didto.
en: So Zadok and Abiathar took the ark of God back to Jerusalem and stayed there.

war: Han kasumati kan David nga tinmampo na hi Ahitofel kan Absalon, nag-ampo hiya, “O Ginoo , himoa gad nga waray kapulsanan an mga sagdon ni Ahitofel!”
en: Now David had been told, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” So David prayed, “ Lord , turn Ahithophel’s counsel into foolishness.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi David, “Diri ka makakabulig ha akon kon umupod ka ha akon,
en: David said to him, “If you go with me, you will be a burden to me.

war: Aadto liwat hira Sadoc ug Abiatar nga mga padi; sumati hira han ngatanan nga imo hibabatian didto han palasyo han Gad.
en: Won’t the priests Zadok and Abiathar be there with you? Tell them anything you hear in the king’s palace.

war: Sanglit binmalik ngadto han syudad hi Husai nga sangkay ni David, dida han tisakob na hi Absalon han syudad.
en: So Hushai, David’s confidant, arrived at Jerusalem as Absalom was entering the city.

war: Ginbato ni Simei hi David ngan an iya mga opisyal, bisan kon ginlilibotan hi David han iya mga tawo ngan han iya mga gwardya.
en: He pelted David and all the king’s officials with stones, though all the troops and the special guard were on David’s right and left.

war: Ginbinuyayaw hiya ni Simei ngan ginsiring, “Iwas! Iwas! Parapamatay! Kriminal!
en: As he cursed, Shimei said, “Get out, get out, you murderer, you scoundrel!

war: Manggad na la hikit-an han Ginoo an akon kasakitan ngan tagan ako hin mga kaupayan nga liwan han iya pagtunglo ha akon.”
en: It may be that the Lord will look upon my misery and restore to me his covenant blessing instead of his curse today.”

war: Kinapoy hin duro hi David ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo han pag-abot nira han Jordan, ngan pinmahuway hira didto.
en: The king and all the people with him arrived at their destination exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.

war: Sinmulod ha Jerusalem hi Absalon ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nga tinmampo ha iya, ngan upod nira hi Ahitofel.
en: Meanwhile, Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.

war: Han pagkakita la nira Absalon ug Husai, an sinarigan nga sangkay ni David, ginmoliat hi Husai, “Mabuhi an hadi! Mabuhi an hadi!”
en: Then Hushai the Arkite, David’s confidant, went to Absalom and said to him, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

war: Pinmakiana ha iya hi Absalon, “Amo ba ini an imo pag-ugop kan David nga imo sangkay? Kay ano nga waray ka umupod ha iya?”
en: Absalom said to Hushai, “So this is the love you show your friend? If he’s your friend, why didn’t you go with him?”

war: Binmaton hi Husai, “Uunanhon ko man? Maupod ako han tawo nga ginpili han Ginoo , ngan han ngatanan nga mga Israelita. Magpapabilin ako ha imo.
en: Hushai said to Absalom, “No, the one chosen by the Lord , by these people, and by all the men of Israel—his I will be, and I will remain with him.

war: Labot pa, hin-o pa man an akon pag-aalagdon, kon diri an anak han akon agaron? Sugad nga nag-alagad ako han imo amay, mag-aalagad man ako ha imo.”
en: Furthermore, whom should I serve? Should I not serve the son? Just as I served your father, so I will serve you.”

war: Niyan inatubang ni Absalon hi Ahitofel ngan ginsiring, “Yana nga aanhi na kita, ano an imo sadang isagdon ha akon?”
en: Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give us your advice. What should we do?”

war: Sanglit nagtulda hira didto han atop han palasyo para kan Absalon, ngan ha atubangan han ngatanan sinmulod hi Absalon hin pakighilawas han mga aruasawa han iya amay.
en: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Ahitofel kan Absalon, “Tugoti ako hin pagpili hin 12,000 nga mga tawo, ngan lalanaton ko hi David niyan nga gab-i.
en: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “I would choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.

war: Susulongon ko hiya samtang binubutlaw ngan kinakapoy hiya. Kakalasan hiya, ngan mangangalagiw an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo. An hadi la an akon papatayon,
en: I would attack him while he is weary and weak. I would strike him with terror, and then all the people with him will flee. I would strike down only the king

war: Daw nakalipay ini nga sagdon kan Absalon ngan han ngatanan nga mga punoan nga Israelita.
en: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.

war: Nagsiring hi Absalon, “Tawaga liwat hi Husai, ngan pamatii ta kon ano man an iya igsisiring.”
en: But Absalom said, “Summon also Hushai the Arkite, so we can hear what he has to say as well.”

war: Han pag-abot ni Husai, ginsiring hiya ni Absalon, “Amo ini an iginsagdon ha amon ni Ahitofel; susundon ba namon ini? Kon diri, sumati kami kon ano an angay buhaton.”
en: When Hushai came to him, Absalom said, “Ahithophel has given this advice. Should we do what he says? If not, give us your opinion.”

war: Binmaton hi Husai, “Diri maupay an iginsagdon ha iyo yana ni Ahitofel.
en: Hushai replied to Absalom, “The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.

war: Gintahoban han asawa han tawo an ganggang han atabay; ngan ginbularan niya hin trigo, basi waray makasabot.
en: His wife took a covering and spread it out over the opening of the well and scattered grain over it. No one knew anything about it.

war: Sanglit tinmabok han Jordan hira David ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan han pagkamaagahon didto na hira ngatanan ha tabok han Jordan.
en: So David and all the people with him set out and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, no one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

war: Nakadto na hi David han bungto han Mahanaim han pakatabok han Jordan ni Absalon ngan han iya mga tawo. (
en: David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.

war: Nagkampo didto han tuna han Galaad hi Absalon ngan an iya mga tawo.
en: The Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.

war: Gintirok ni Hadi David an ngatanan nga iya mga tawo, ginbahinbahin ini hira ngadto hin mga hugpo nga tinagyukot ngan tinaggatos, ngan ginbutangan hin mga opisyal nga magmamando ha ira.
en: David mustered the men who were with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

war: Ginmawas ngadto han kapatagan an kasondalohan ni David ngan pinakiawayan an mga Israelita didto ha Kagurangan han Efraim.
en: David’s army marched out of the city to fight Israel, and the battle took place in the forest of Ephraim.

war: Pinirde han mga tawo ni David an mga Israelita; makalilisang adto nga pagkapirde, ngan 20,000 nga mga tawo an nagkamatay hito nga adlaw.
en: There Israel’s troops were routed by David’s men, and the casualties that day were great—twenty thousand men.

war: Nagsarang an araway didto han kapatagan, ngan darudamo nga mga tawo an nagkamatay didto ha kagurangan kay han nagkamatay didto ha pag-awayan.
en: The battle spread out over the whole countryside, and the forest swallowed up more men that day than the sword.

war: Hinkit-an hiya hin usa han mga tawo ni David ngan nagsumat dayon kan Joab, “Hinkit-an ko nga nabitay hi Absalon didto hin kahoy nga tuog!”
en: When one of the men saw what had happened, he told Joab, “I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree.”

war: Kundi kon ginsupak ko an hadi ngan ginpatay ko hi Absalon, hibabaroan ini gihapon han hadi, kay hinbabaroan niya an ngatanan—ngan diri ka ada mananalipod ha akon.”
en: And if I had put my life in jeopardy —and nothing is hidden from the king—you would have kept your distance from me.”

war: Niyan dinmaop kan Absalon in napulo han mga sondalo ni Joab, ngan ginhuman nira an pagpatay kan Absalon.
en: And ten of Joab’s armor-bearers surrounded Absalom, struck him and killed him.

war: Nagpatrompeta hi Joab pagpaundang han araway, ngan binmalik an iya kasondalohan tikang han pagbukod han mga Israelita.
en: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped pursuing Israel, for Joab halted them.

war: Niyan nagsiring kan Joab hi Ahimaas nga anak ni Sadoc, “Tugoti ako pagdalagan ngadto han hadi dara an maupay nga sumat nga gintalwas hiya han Ginoo tikang ha iya mga kaaway.”
en: Now Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, “Let me run and take the news to the king that the Lord has vindicated him by delivering him from the hand of his enemies.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hiya ngadto han iya oripon nga Sudanhon, “Kadto na ngan sumati an hadi han imo hinkit-an.” Yinmukbo an oripon ngan dinmalagan.
en: Then Joab said to a Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen.” The Cushite bowed down before Joab and ran off.

war: Ginmoliat hiya ngadto ha ubos pagsumat han hadi, ngan nagsiring an hadi, “Kon usa la hiya, maupay nga sumat an iya dara.” Nagtikahirani na hiya han porta.
en: The watchman called out to the king and reported it. The king said, “If he is alone, he must have good news.” And the runner came closer and closer.

war: “Tukdaw anay didto,” ginsiring hiya han hadi, sanglit kinmadto hiya ngan hinmulat.
en: The king said, “Stand aside and wait here.” So he stepped aside and stood there.

war: Ginsumatan hi Joab nga nagtangis ngan nagmabidoon tungod kan Absalon hi Hadi David.
en: Joab was told, “The king is weeping and mourning for Absalom.”

war: Sanglit nahimo nga kabidoan han ngatanan nga kasondalohan ni David an kalipay han pagdarag-an hito nga adlaw, kay hinbatian nira nga mabidoon an hadi tungod han iya anak.
en: And for the whole army the victory that day was turned into mourning, because on that day the troops heard it said, “The king is grieving for his son.”

war: Mamingaw la hira nga binmalik ngadto han syudad, sugad hin mga sondalo nga naaawod kay kinmalagiw hira ha pag-awayan.
en: The men stole into the city that day as men steal in who are ashamed when they flee from battle.

war: Tinahoban han hadi an iya nawong ngan nagtinangis hin dako nga tingog, “Ay anak ko! Akon anak nga Absalon! Absalon nga akon anak!”
en: The king covered his face and cried aloud, “O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!”

war: Gindihogan ta hi Absalon nga aton hadi, kundi ginpatay hiya didto ha pag-awayan. Sanglit kay ano nga waray man nagtitinguha hin pagpabalik kan Hadi David?”
en: and Absalom, whom we anointed to rule over us, has died in battle. So why do you say nothing about bringing the king back?”

war: Kamo an akon kauropdan nga akon mga kadugo; kay ano nga kamo in mauorhe hin pagpabalik ha akon?”
en: You are my relatives, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to bring back the king?’

war: Nakakabig an mga pulong ni David han hingpit nga pag-ugop han ngatanan nga mga tawo han Juda, ngan ira ginpatugonan hi David nga bumalik na hiya upod an ngatanan niya nga mga opisyal.
en: He won over the hearts of the men of Judah so that they were all of one mind. They sent word to the king, “Return, you and all your men.”

war: Dida han pagbalik niya, ginsugat an hadi didto han Salog Jordan han mga tawo han Juda nga kinmadto ha Gilgal hin pagbunyog kan David han pagtabok niya han salog.
en: Then the king returned and went as far as the Jordan. Now the men of Judah had come to Gilgal to go out and meet the king and bring him across the Jordan.

war: Ha amo nga takna nagdagmit ngadto ha Jordan hin pagsugot kan Hadi David hi Simei nga Benjaminhon, nga anak ni Gera nga taga-Bahurim.
en: Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

war: Maaram ako nga nakasala ako, sanglit gintalinguha ko nga ako an masyahan tikang han mga tribo ha amihanan hin pagsugot han Imo Kaharangdon yana nga adlaw.”
en: For I your servant know that I have sinned, but today I have come here as the first from the tribes of Joseph to come down and meet my lord the king.”

war: Sinmagbang hi Abisai nga anak ni Seruia, “Kinahanglan patayon hi Simei, kay ginpakaraot niya an hadi nga ginpili han Ginoo .”
en: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this? He cursed the Lord ’s anointed.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Simei, “Nagsusumpa ako ha imo nga diri ka papatayon.”
en: So the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die.” And the king promised him on oath.

war: Han pag-abot ni Mefiboset tikang ha Jerusalem hin pagsugat han hadi, nagsiring ha iya an hadi, “Mefiboset, kay ano nga waray ka umupod ha akon?”
en: When he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

war: Ginbuwaan ka niya hiunong ha akon, Harangdon nga Hadi, kundi sugad ka hin anghel han Dyos, sanglit buhata an matadong ha imo.
en: And he has slandered your servant to my lord the king. My lord the king is like an angel of God; so do whatever you wish.

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Diri na kinahanglan nga magyakan ka pa. Naglarang na ako nga magbabahin kamo ngan hi Siba han mga hiagi ni Saul.”
en: The king said to him, “Why say more? I order you and Ziba to divide the land.”

war: Binmaton hi Mefiboset, “Ihatag na la ini ngatanan kan Siba. Igo na ha akon nga nakauli an Imo Kaharangdon nga waray maraot nga nahinabo ha imo.”
en: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Let him take everything, now that my lord the king has returned home safely.”

war: Linmugsong liwat tikang ha Rogelim hi Barzilai nga taga-Galaad basi makaupod hiya han hadi hin pagtabok han Jordan.
en: Barzillai the Gileadite also came down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan with the king and to send him on his way from there.

war: Lagas na hin duro hi Barzilai nga 80 na an iya panuigon. Riko hiya hin duro ngan gintagan niya an hadi hin pagkaon han nag-uokoy pa hiya didto ha Mahanaim.
en: Now Barzillai was very old, eighty years of age. He had provided for the king during his stay in Mahanaim, for he was a very wealthy man.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an hadi, “Upod ha akon ngadto ha Jerusalem ngan pagmamangnoan ko ikaw.”
en: The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me and stay with me in Jerusalem, and I will provide for you.”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Barzilai, “Kay ano nga maupod pa ako han Imo Kaharangdon ngadto ha Jerusalem? Diri na maiha inin akon kinabuhi.
en: But Barzillai answered the king, “How many more years will I live, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?

war: Diri ako angay hin sugad ka dako nga balos. Sanglit mabunyog la ako ha imo ngadto ha uruunhan han Jordan.
en: Your servant will cross over the Jordan with the king for a short distance, but why should the king reward me in this way?

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Dadad-on ko hiya ngan bubuhaton ko ha iya an bisan ano nga imo karuyag. Ngan bubuhaton ko para ha imo an bisan ano nga imo pangaroan.”
en: The king said, “Kimham shall cross over with me, and I will do for him whatever you wish. And anything you desire from me I will do for you.”

war: Ngan tinmabok han Jordan hi David ngan an iya mga tawo. Hinadkan niya hi Barzilai ngan ginbendisyonan hiya; katapos, inmoli hi Barzilai.
en: So all the people crossed the Jordan, and then the king crossed over. The king kissed Barzillai and bid him farewell, and Barzillai returned to his home.

war: Han pakatabok na han hadi nga binunyogan han ngatanan nga mga tawo han Juda ngan katunga han mga tawo han Israel, nagpadayon hiya ngadto ha Gilgal ngan inmupod ha iya hi Quimam.
en: When the king crossed over to Gilgal, Kimham crossed with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel had taken the king over.

war: Nagsiring an hadi kan Amasa, “Tiroka an mga tawo han Juda ngan balik nganhi sangbuwas upod ha ira.”
en: Then the king said to Amasa, “Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself.”

war: Linmakat hi Amasa hin pagtirok ha ira, kundi waray hira bumalik han adlaw nga igintalaan han hadi.
en: But when Amasa went to summon Judah, he took longer than the time the king had set for him.

war: Sanglit linmakat tikang ha Jerusalem upod kan Abisai an mga tawo ni Joab, an mga gwardya han hadi, ngan an ngatanan nga iba nga mga sondalo hin paglanat kan Seba.
en: So Joab’s men and the Kerethites and Pelethites and all the mighty warriors went out under the command of Abishai. They marched out from Jerusalem to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.

war: Nagsiring hi Joab kan Amasa, “Kumosta ka, sangkay ko?” ngan kinaptan an iya bungot han tuo niya nga kamot basi hadkan hiya.
en: Joab said to Amasa, “How are you, my brother?” Then Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

war: Tinmindog ha ligid han lawas ni Amasa in usa han mga tawo ni Joab ngan ginmoliat, “Sumunod kan Joab an ngatanan nga naugop kan Joab ug David!”
en: One of Joab’s men stood beside Amasa and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!”

war: Han waray na an lawas dida ha dalan, sinmunod na kan Joab an ngatanan hin paglanat kan Seba.
en: After Amasa had been removed from the road, everyone went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.

war: May-ada makinaadmananon nga babaye didto han syudad nga naggoliat tikang han pader. “Pamati! Pamati! Pakanhia hi Joab—karuyag ko makighimangraw ha iya.”
en: a wise woman called from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come here so I can speak to him.”

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Hadto nga mga adlaw nasiring hira, ‘Pakadto ngan pangaro hin sagdon han syudad han Abel ngan matutuhay dayon’—ngan amo gud ito an ira ginbuhat.
en: She continued, “Long ago they used to say, ‘Get your answer at Abel,’ and that settled it.

war: Bantogan ini nga amon syudad; makisasangkayon ngan diri masamok an mga tawo han syudad. Kay ano nga gin-iiburungkag mo ini? Karuyag ba nimo gub-on an kanan Dyos syudad?”
en: We are the peaceful and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why do you want to swallow up the Lord ’s inheritance?”

war: “Diri gud,” binmaton hi Joab. “Diri gud ako magruruba o magbubungkag han iyo syudad!
en: “Far be it from me!” Joab replied, “Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!

war: Hi Joab amo an labaw nga pangulo han kasondalohan han Israel; hi Benaias nga anak ni Joiada amo an puno han mga gwardya ni David;
en: Joab was over Israel’s entire army; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites;

war: hi Adoram amo an tinaporan han inoripon nga trabaho; hi Josafat nga anak ni Ahilud amo an tinaporan han mga sinurat;
en: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

war: hi Seva amo an sekretaryo han palasyo; hira Sadoc ug Abiatar amo an mga padi,
en: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

war: ngan usa liwat han kan David kapadian amo hi Ira nga taga bungto han Jair.
en: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.

war: Binmaton hira, “Karuyag ni Saul nga mapuo kami, ngan waray mahibilin nga buhi ha amon bisan diin dinhe ha Israel.
en: They answered the king, “As for the man who destroyed us and plotted against us so that we have been decimated and have no place anywhere in Israel,

war: Kundi tungod han pagsumpaay nira David ngan hi Jonatan waray ig-upod ni David hi Mefiboset nga anak ni Jonatan, nga apo ni Saul.
en: The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the Lord between David and Jonathan son of Saul.

war: Han paghibaroi ni David han ginbuhat ni Rizpa,
en: When David was told what Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Saul’s concubine, had done,

war: Ginkuha ni David an mga tul-an nira Saul ug Jonatan ngan gintirok liwat an mga tul-an han pito nga mga tawo nga ginbitay.
en: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there, and the bones of those who had been killed and exposed were gathered up.

war: Nakig-away na liwat an Israel kontra han mga Filisteohanon, ngan inmupod hi David han iya mga tawo hin pakig-away ha ira. Ginul-an hi David dida han usa han mga araway.
en: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.

war: Katapos hini, may away na liwat didto ha Gob kontra han mga Filisteohanon, diin nakamatay hi Sibecai nga taga-Husa hin higante nga ginngaranan kan Saf.
en: In the course of time, there was another battle with the Philistines, at Gob. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.

war: Gin-ayat niya an mga Israelita ngan ginpatay hiya ni Jonatan nga anak ni Sama nga bugto ni David.
en: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.

war: Mga tulin ini nga upat nga nagkamatay han mga higante han Gat, ngan ginpatay hira ni David ngan han iya mga tawo.
en: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

war: Ginhimangraw ni David ngadto han Ginoo an mga pulong hini nga kanta dida han adlaw han pagtalwasa ha iya han Ginoo ha mga kamot ni Saul ngan han iba nga mga kaaway niya:
en: David sang to the Lord the words of this song when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

war: Akon bato, akon kota an Ginoo ngan hiya ha akon nagbawi.
en: He said: “The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;

war: Natawag ako han Ginoo , takos hiya han akon pagdayeg. Ginggawas ako ha mga kasamokan.
en: “I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and have been saved from my enemies.

war: An mga balod han kamatayon nakalumos ha akon. An mga baha han akon kapukan nakadaog ha akon.
en: The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

war: An mga pisi han kamatayon nakahikog ha akon. An mga bitik han kamatayon nakapalisang ha akon.
en: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

war: Ha akon kakurian, ginsangpit ko an Ginoo ; gintawag ko an akon Dyos. Ha iya templo namati hiya ha akon, ngan an akon pangaraba dinmangat ha iya durunggan.
en: “In my distress I called to the Lord ; I called out to my God. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came to his ears.

war: Nabay-og ug nangurog an tuna; nabantad an patukoranan han langit. Kinmurog kay nasina hiya.
en: The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.

war: Ha iya irong inmusbok in aso, ha iya baba, inmulyab in kalayo. Naglalahinggab nga mga baga nagawas tikang ha iya.
en: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

war: Binuksan niya an kalangitan, ngan tuna an iya linusaran, upod in mga dampog nga maitom ha iya mga tiil nailarom.
en: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

war: An anghel an iya sinasakyan, hataas an iya linolupdan. Masukot hiya hikit-an, ha bawbaw han kahanginan.
en: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

war: Tabon niya an kasisidman, mga dampog hin tubig hiya ginugup-an.
en: He made darkness his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.

war: Mga baga nga naglalahinggab, hin kalayo naulyab.
en: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.

war: An Ginoo ginmoliat ha kalangitan, han Gihahataasi in tingog hinbatian.
en: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

war: Tungod han iya pana hira nagsarang, han kikidlat hira nanadlagan.
en: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

war: Nagmara an salad han kadagatan, patukoranan han tuna nabuksan. Kay han Ginoo nasinahan ug an kaaway iya gindumtan.
en: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of breath from his nostrils.

war: Ginggawad ako niya ngan ginggawas ha katubigan ngan ako natalwas.
en: “He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

war: Tikang han mga kaaway gintalwas ako han mga nagdudumot nga mga tawo. Waray ako makaato, kay makusog hira hin duro.
en: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

war: Ginsulong ako takna nga kakurian, kundi han Ginoo ako ginsalipdan.
en: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.

war: Gin-agaw ako niya ha kataragman; tungod kay ako iya nalilipayan.
en: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

war: An Ginoo nabalos kay ako matadong; ginpakaupay ako kay di' masupakon.
en: “The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

war: Balaod han Ginoo ako masugtanon, han Dyos di' ako masinupilon.
en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.

war: Gintuman ko an mga balaod niya, iya mga sugo waray ko pagsupaka.
en: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

war: Maaram gud hiya nga diri ako salaan, nga nadiri ako pagbuhat hin karat-an.
en: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

war: Sanglit nabalos kay ako matadong, sayod hiya nga diri ako masupakon.
en: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.

war: Matinumanon ka hadton diri malingo, hadto waray sayop, maupay ka hin duro.
en: “To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

war: Maputli ka hadton putli ha hunahuna, ngan maisog ka hadton makasasala.
en: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

war: Gintatalwas mo an mapinaubsanon, ginpapaubos an mapinahitas-on.
en: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.

war: Ikaw, O Ginoo , an akon kapawa; an kasisidman ko imo pinapara.
en: You, Lord , are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.

war: Kusog hin pakiaway ha akon imo hinatag, ngan gahom hin mga panalipod pagbungkag.
en: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.

war: Ini nga Dyos hingpit an iya binuhatan, iya mga pulong katataporan! Taming hiya han ngatanan nga karuyag niya panalipdan.
en: “As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.

war: An Ginoo gudla an Dyos, hin-o pa man? An Dyos gudla amo an aton darangpan.
en: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?

war: Ini nga Dyos madig-on ko nga arayopan, an akon dalan nga waray kataragman.
en: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

war: Diri magsasayop an akon mga pitad, sugad han bugsok ha bukid paglakat.
en: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

war: Hin pag-away iya ako gintutdoan, hin pagpana akon gin-adman.
en: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

war: O Ginoo , imo ako ginpanalipdan; Han imo tambulig ako nagamhanan.
en: You make your saving help my shield; your help has made me great.

war: Waray mo itugot nga ako mabihag, nga ako mapukan, ha imo mahibulag.
en: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.

war: Ginlanat, ginpirde an kaaway nakon; ha ira pagbungkag waray ako humunong.
en: “I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

war: Gintumba ko hira, diri na mabangon; tumba nga pirdedo ha tiilan nakon.
en: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

war: Hatag ha akon kusog ha pag-awayan, Ha akon kaaway, akon pagdarag-an.
en: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.

war: Mga kaaway ko pinalagiw ha akon; an nagdumot ha akon maupay pagpuohon.
en: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

war: Hin tambulig hira nangingita, kundi waray nakakatalwas ha ira. Han Ginoo hira nangaraba, kundi waray hira niya batona.
en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.

war: Akon gindudugmok hira ngatanan, tapotapo an ira dinangatan. Akon hira gintatamaktamakan, sugad hin lapok ha kadalanan.
en: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.

war: Ha nasupil imo ako ginbawi, ngan han kanasoran ako imo ginpahadi. An diri ko kilala nga mga katawhan nahimo nga akon mga ginsakopan.
en: “You have delivered me from the attacks of the peoples; you have preserved me as the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,

war: Mga lumalangyaw ha akon nahapa, nasugot gud dayon kon nabati hira.
en: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

war: Nangurog hin kahadlok mga lumalangyaw, paggawas ha kota, kay hira nagtalaw.
en: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

war: Buhi gud ha kadayonan an Ginoo ! Pagdayawon hiya nga akon bato! Isangyaw niyo an iya pagkagamhanan, han kusgan nga Dyos nga akon katalwasan!
en: “The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!

war: Akon pagdarag-an iya ginhatag, akon kaaway iya ginbihag. Akon nasakop an mga tawo,
en: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,

war: ngan ha kaaway natalwas ako. Ginpapadaog mo ako, Ginoo , kontra han ngatanan mga kaaway ko. Ngan imo akon ginpanalipdan han magpintas nga katawhan.
en: who sets me free from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.

war: Sanglit ikaw an akon dadayawon, ngan ha imo akon kakantahon. An mga pagdayaw ha imo la ngaran, ha butnga gud hadton mga kanasoran.
en: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.

war: Adton iya hadi han Dyos tinatagan hin dagko kaupay mga pagdarag-an. Han iya ginpili, David, katulinan, napakita hin gugma nga kadayonan.
en: “He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”

war: Naghihimangraw pinaagi ha akon an Espiritu han Ginoo ; aanhi han akon mga im-im an iya mensahe.
en: “The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

war: Naghimangraw an Dyos han Israel; nagsiring ha akon an mananalipod han Israel: “An hadi nga naghahadi hin matadong, nga naghahadi hin matinahoron han Dyos,
en: The God of Israel spoke, the Rock of Israel said to me: ‘When one rules over people in righteousness, when he rules in the fear of God,

war: sugad han adlaw nga nasirang dida hin waray dampog nga kaagahon, han adlaw nga nagpaturok han kabanwaan katapos hin uran.”
en: he is like the light of morning at sunrise on a cloudless morning, like the brightness after rain that brings grass from the earth.’

war: Kundi sugad la hin mga tunok nga waray gamit an diri nakilala hin Dyos nga mga tawo. Kinahanglan nga hinapinan an kamot kon makapot ha ira.
en: But evil men are all to be cast aside like thorns, which are not gathered with the hand.

war: Kinahanglan puthaw an imo garamiton o bangkaw, tinuod gud an ira kaugtang ha kalayo.
en: Whoever touches thorns uses a tool of iron or the shaft of a spear; they are burned up where they lie.”

war: kundi tinindogan hin madig-on ni Sama an uma, iya ini ginpanalipdan, ngan pinamatay an mga Filisteohanon. Hito nga adlaw nagdaog hin dako nga pagdarag-an an Ginoo .
en: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field. He defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.

war: Hito nga panahon nakadto hi David hin usa nga pungtod nga pinaderan, ngan narikopohan an Betlehem hin hugpo hin mga Filisteohanon.
en: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

war: Nahidlaw hi David ngan nagsiring, “Maupay unta kon may magdara ha akon in tubig tikang han atabay ha ligid han ganghaan han Betlehem.”
en: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”

war: Hiya an labi kabantogan han “An Traynta,” ngan nahimo nga ira pangulo, kundi diri hiya sugad kabantogan han “An Tutulo.”
en: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

war: Amo ini an maisog nga mga binuhatan ni Benaias, an usa han hugpo han “An Traynta.”
en: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.

war: Bantogan hiya ha sakob han ira hugpo, kundi diri hiya sugad ka bantogan han mga kaapi han hugpo han “An Tutulo.” Iginbutang hiya ni David nga tinaporan han iya kalugaringon nga mga gwardya.
en: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

war: Dida hin lain nga higayon nasina han Israel an Ginoo , ngan gin-aghat niya hi David hin pagsamok ha ira. Nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Kadtoa ngan ihapa an mga tawo han Israel ug Juda.”
en: Again the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, “Go and take a census of Israel and Judah.”

war: Tinmabok hira han Jordan ngan nagkampo didto ha timogan han Aroer nga syudad ha butnga han kahamub-an, didto han katunaan han Gad. Tikang didto nagtipaamihan hira ngadto ha Jazer,
en: After crossing the Jordan, they camped near Aroer, south of the town in the gorge, and then went through Gad and on to Jazer.

war: ngan nagpadayon ngadto ha Galaad, ngan ngadto ha Cades, didto han Hiteohanon nga katunaan. Katapos kinmadto hira ha Dan, ngan tikang ha Dan nagtipakatundan hira ngadto ha Sidon.
en: They went to Gilead and the region of Tahtim Hodshi, and on to Dan Jaan and around toward Sidon.

war: Sanglit katapos hin siyam ka bulan ngan hin 20 ka adlaw binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem kahuman nira sudoya an bug-os nga nasod.
en: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

war: Iginsumat nira kan David an kadamo han kalalaken-an nga makakahimo hin pagsondalo: 800,000 didto ha Israel ngan 500,000 didto ha Juda.
en: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to the king: In Israel there were eight hundred thousand able-bodied men who could handle a sword, and in Judah five hundred thousand.

war: Hito ngahaw nga adlaw kinmadto kan David hi Gad ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Sagka ngadto ha giriokan ni Arauna ngan pagtindog hin altar para han Ginoo .”
en: On that day Gad went to David and said to him, “Go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

war: Gintuman ni David an sugo han Ginoo ngan kinmadto hiya sumala han iginsiring ha iya ni Gad.
en: So David went up, as the Lord had commanded through Gad.

war: Tinmamod hi Arauna ngan iya hinkit-an nga nasagka tipakada ha iya hi David ngan an iya mga opisyal. Hinmapa hiya ha atubangan ni David,
en: When Araunah looked and saw the king and his officials coming toward him, he went out and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.

war: Iginhatag ini ngatanan han hadi ni Arauna ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Karawaton unta han Ginoo nga imo Dyos an imo halad.”
en: Your Majesty, Araunah gives all this to the king.” Araunah also said to him, “May the Lord your God accept you.”

war: Tikang kan Pablo, Silas ug Timoteo— Ngadto han mga kaapi han singbahan ha Tesalonica, nga sakop han Dyos nga aton Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo:
en: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

war: Tagan unta kamo han Dyos Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo han grasya ngan kamurayaw.
en: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

war: Amo ini an pagsari han matadong nga paghukom han Dyos, kay tungod hini ngatanan, mahihimo kamo nga takos han iya Ginhadian ngan tungod hini nag-aantos kamo.
en: All this is evidence that God’s judgment is right, and as a result you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

war: Bubuhaton han Dyos an matadong: papapag-antoson niya an mga nagpapaantos ha iyo,
en: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you

war: ngan papapahuwayon kamo nga nag-aantos ngan sugad man kami. Bubuhaton niya ini kon umabot na an Ginoo nga Jesus tikang ha langit, inupdan han iya gamhanan nga mga anghel,
en: and give relief to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.

war: upod ini nagdidilaab nga kalayo, pagsirot hadton diri nakilala han Dyos, ngan hadton diri nagtutuman han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod han aton Ginoo nga Jesus.
en: He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

war: Mag-aantos hira han sirot han dayon nga pagkalaglag, bulag hira han Ginoo ngan han iya langitnon nga gahom,
en: They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might

war: Dida hini nga paagi, makarawat an ngaran han aton Ginoo nga Jesus hin kadungganan tikang ha iyo, ngan kamo tikang ha iya, pinaagi han grasya han aton Dyos ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.
en: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

war: Mahitungod na man han pagkanhi han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo ngan han aton pagkatirok hin pagtapo ha iya; nangangamuyo ako ha iyo, kabugtoan,
en: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,

war: Diri ba kamo nahinunumdom? Ginsumatan ko kamo hini ngatanan samtang nakada pa ako ha iyo.
en: Don’t you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?

war: Kundi may nakakapugong pa nga mahinabo ini yana, ngan maaram kamo kon ano ito. Sanglit ha igo nga panahon, mapakita an Usa nga Yawan-on.
en: And now you know what is holding him back, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

war: An tinago nga gahom han Usa nga Yawan-on nagbubuhat na kundi diri magpapadayon ini nga mahinanabo tubtob nga makuha an nagpupugong hito.
en: For the secret power of lawlessness is already at work; but the one who now holds it back will continue to do so till he is taken out of the way.

war: Makanhi an Yawan-on nga may gahom ni Satanas, ngan magbubuhat han ngatanan nga mga diri matuod nga milagro, ngan mga orosahon,
en: The coming of the lawless one will be in accordance with how Satan works. He will use all sorts of displays of power through signs and wonders that serve the lie,

war: ngan magamit han ngatanan nga panlimbong ngadto hadton mga magkakawawara. Mawawara hira kay waray nira karawta ngan higugmaa an kamatuoran nga makakatalwas ha ira.
en: and all the ways that wickedness deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.

war: Tungod hini itinugot han Dyos nga kalimbongan hira ngan tumoo hira han mga buwa,
en: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie

war: basi paghukman ha karat-an an ngatanan nga waray tumoo han kamatuoran, kundi nagpatakas la hin pagpinakasala.
en: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.

war: Gintawag kamo han Dyos ngada hini, pinaagi han Maupay nga Sumat nga iginwali namon ha iyo. Gintawag kamo niya basi makaangkon kamo han usa nga bahin han himaya han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.
en: He called you to this through our gospel, that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

war: Sanglit, kabugtoan, pagpabilin kamo nga marig-on ngan ugopi niyo adton mga kamatuoran nga igintutdo namon ha iyo pinaagi han amon pagwali ngan han amon surat.
en: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

war: Ha kataposan, kabugtoan, pag-ampo kamo para ha amon, basi an mensahe han Ginoo magmadali hin paghisangyaw ngan tagan hin kadungganan sugad gud han nahinabo dida ha iyo.
en: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the message of the Lord may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was with you.

war: Pag-ampo liwat kamo nga talwason han Dyos kami tikang han yawan-on ngan magraot nga mga tawo. Kay diri ngatanan nga mga tawo natoo han mensahe.
en: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, for not everyone has faith.

war: Kundi katataporan an Ginoo. Paririg-unon kamo niya ngan pananalipdan kamo han mga karat-an han Yawa.
en: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

war: Ngan tungod han Ginoo nasarig kami ha iyo; nakakaseguro kami nga magbubuhat ngan magpapadayon kamo hin pagbuhat han amon iginsusugo ha iyo.
en: We have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we command.

war: Hinaot unta nga bantaron han Ginoo an iyo mga kasingkasing hin paghigugma han Dyos, ngan hin pag-ilob nga ginhatag ni Cristo.
en: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

war: Maaram kamo ngahaw nga kinahanglan niyo buhaton an amon ginbuhat. Diri kami mga hubya han nakada pa kami ha iyo.
en: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,

war: Waray kami kumarawat hini bulig bisan kan kanay nga waray namon pagbayari. Lugod, nagtrabaho ngan nagkabudlay kami adlaw-gab-i, basi diri kami makasagipo hin bisan hin-o ha iyo.
en: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. On the contrary, we worked night and day, laboring and toiling so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

war: Ginbuhat namon ini, diri tungod nga waray kami katungod pangaro hin bulig para ha amon, kundi gihimo ini namon basi magin susbaranan kami niyo.
en: We did this, not because we do not have the right to such help, but in order to offer ourselves as a model for you to imitate.

war: Han nakada pa kami ha iyo, ginsumatan kamo namon: “Adton diri magbudlay, diri pakaonon.”
en: For even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: “The one who is unwilling to work shall not eat.”

war: Nasiring kami hini, kay nasumatan kami nga may mga tawo dida ha iyo nga naghihinubya, nga waray binubuhat kon diri an paghilabot han buruhaton han iba.
en: We hear that some among you are idle and disruptive. They are not busy; they are busybodies.

war: Kundi, kabugtoan, kinahanglan diri kamo gul-an hin pagbuhat han maupay.
en: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.

war: Kon may-ada dida ha iyo diri masugot han mensahe nga amon iginsusugo dida hini nga surat, tigamni ito nga tawo ngan ayaw na gagari hiya, basi makaawod hiya.
en: Take special note of anyone who does not obey our instruction in this letter. Do not associate with them, in order that they may feel ashamed.

war: Kundi ayaw isipa hiya nga kaaway; lugod, sagdoni hiya sugad hin usa nga bugto.
en: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.

war: Tagan unta kamo hin kamurayaw, ha ngatanan nga panahon nga ha ngatanan nga paagi, han Ginoo ngahaw nga amo an aton burabod han kamurayaw. Maada unta an Ginoo ha iyo ngatanan.
en: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

war: Ako, hi Pablo, amo gud an nagsusurat hini nga pangumosta. Amo ini an pagpirma ko han ngatanan nga surat, ngan amo ini an akon pagsurat.
en: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.

war: Maada unta ha iyo ngatanan an grasya han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

war: Tikang kan Pablo nga apostol ni Cristo Jesus tungod han pagbuot han Dyos, nga ginsugo pagpasangyaw han iginsaad nga kinabuhi, nga aton naangkon pinaagi hini pakig-usa kan Cristo Jesus—
