en: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.

war: Ginsumatan niya hira han nahinabo ngan ginpakadto hira ha Jope.
en: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.

war: Han pagkabuwas, samtang hirani na ha Jope an mga ginsugo, hi Pedro na man sinmaka ha atop han balay han tikaurudto hin pag-ampo.
en: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

war: Ginutom hiya ngan karuyag kumaon. Samtang gin-aandam an pagkaon, nakakita hiya hin panan-awon.
en: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

war: Hinkit-an niya nga nabuksan an langit ngan may nagtitiubos nga pareho hin halapad nga taklap nga hinigtan ha upat nga mga kanto, nga igintutunton ha tuna.
en: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

war: Nakada sulod hini an ngatanan nga mga mananap nga naglalakat ngan nagkakamang, ngan ihalas nga katamsihan.
en: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.

war: May tingog nga nagsiring ha iya, “Tindog, Pedro; pag-ihaw ngan kaon!”
en: Then a voice told him, “Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Pedro, “Diri gad ako, Ginoo! Kay waray pa gud ako kumaon hin bisan ano nga kinikilala nga mahugaw o diri malinis sugad han amon gintutuohan.”
en: “Surely not, Lord!” Peter replied. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”

war: Nagyakan liwat an tingog ha iya, “Ayaw paghunahunaa nga mahugaw an bisan ano nga ginsiring na han Dyos nga malinis.”
en: The voice spoke to him a second time, “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”

war: Nahinabo ini makatulo, ngan kahuman, iginbalik an iya hinkit-an ngadto ha langit.
en: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.

war: Nagsangpit hira ngan nagpakiana, “May sumasaka ba dinhe nga ginngangaranan kan Simon Pedro?”
en: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.

war: Ginpapainoino pa ni Pedro an karuyag sidngon han panan-awon han pagsiring ha iya han Espiritu, “Hahani in tulo ka tawo nga nagbibiling ha imo.
en: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Simon, three men are looking for you.

war: Sanglit lusad ngan ayaw pag-alang hin pag-upod ha ira kay akon hira ginsugo.”
en: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them.”

war: Sanglit linmusad hi Pedro ngan ginsiring an mga tawo, “Ako an iyo ginbibiling. Kay ano nga kinmanhi kamo?”
en: Peter went down and said to the men, “I’m the one you’re looking for. Why have you come?”

war: Ginpauswag ni Pedro an mga tawo, ngan didto hira pakaturoga hito nga gab-i. Han pagkabuwas nag-andam hiya ngan inmupod ha ira. Binmunyog liwat ha iya in pira nga mga magtinuohon ha Jope.
en: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.

war: Han pagkasunod nga adlaw inmabot hiya ha Cesarea diin naghulat ha iya hi Cornelio upod in mga kaurupdan ngan suok nga kasangkayan nga iya gindapit.
en: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

war: Han tisakob na hi Pedro, gintapo hiya ni Cornelio nga linmuhod ngan yimukbo ha iya atubangan.
en: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.

war: Kundi ginpabuhat hiya ni Pedro ngan ginsiring, “Tindog; tawo la ako pareho man ha imo.”
en: But Peter made him get up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”

war: Nakighinimangraw hi Pedro kan Cornelio samtang nasulod hiya han balay diin hinkit-an niya in damo nga mga tawo nga nagkatirok.
en: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.

war: Sanglit han pagpasugoi nimo ha akon, kinmanhi ako hin waray baribad. Napakiana ako yana ha imo, ‘Kay ano nga ginpakanhi mo ako?’”
en: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?”

war: ngan nagsiring: ‘Cornelio! Pinamatian han Dyos an imo mga pag-ampo ngan nahinumdoman an imo mga buhat ha kalooy.
en: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.

war: Ipakuha didto ha Jope in usa ka tawo nga Simon Pedro an ngaran. Aadto hiya nalungon kan Simon nga paratina hin anit, nga an balay aada ha ligid han dagat.’
en: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.’

war: Nagtikang hi Pedro hin pamulong, “Hinsasabtan ko na yana nga matuod gud man nga waray han Dyos pinalabi.
en: Then Peter began to speak: “I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism

war: Kinakarawat niya an may kahadlok ha iya ngan nagbubuhat han matadong, bisan kon ano nga tulin hin katawhan hiya.
en: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.

war: Maaram kamo han mensahe nga iginhatag niya ha mga tawo han Israel, nga amo an pagpasangyaw han Maupay nga Sumat han kamurayaw pinaagi kan Jesu-Cristo, an Ginoo han ngatanan.
en: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

war: Maaram kamo han dako nga nahinabo ha bug-os nga tuna han Israel, nga nagtikang ha Galilea kahuman han pagwali ni Juan han iya mensahe mahitungod hin pagbunyag.
en: You know what has happened throughout the province of Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached—

war: Mga saksi kami han ngatanan nga ginbuhat niya ha tuna han Israel ngan didto ha Jerusalem. Ginpatay hiya nira pinaagi hin pagraysangan ha iya ha kros.
en: “We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a cross,

war: Kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos ha ikatulo ka adlaw, ngan pinmakita hiya,
en: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.

war: diri ha ngatanan nga mga tawo kundi ha amon la nga mga saksi, nga ginpili ngadaan han Dyos. Amo kami an kinmaon ngan inminom upod ha iya kahuman niya kabanhaw.
en: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen—by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

war: Ngan ginsugo kami niya hin pagwali ha mga tawo han Maupay nga Sumat, ngan pagpamatuod nga amo hiya an gintudlok han Dyos nga maghurukom han mga buhi ngan han mga minatay.
en: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.

war: Naghimangraw mahitungod ha iya an ngatanan nga mga manaragna nga nasiring nga an ngatanan nga natoo ha iya pasasayloon han ira mga sala pinaagi han gahom han iya ngaran.”
en: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.”

war: Samtang nagyayakan pa hi Pedro, kinmunsad an Espiritu Santo ngada han ngatanan nga namamati han iya mensahe.
en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.

war: Nanhipausa an mga magtinuohon nga Judiyo nga tikang ha Jope nga inmupod kan Pedro, nga iginbubo liwat han Dyos an iya hatag nga Espiritu Santo ngada han mga Hentil.
en: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles.

war: Kay hinbatian nira an mga Hentil nga nagyayakan na hin lain nga mga pinulongan ngan nagdadayaw han pagkaharangdon han Dyos. Nagyakan hi Pedro,
en: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,

war: “Kinmarawat han Espiritu Santo ini nga mga tawo sugad gud han aton pagkarawat. May-ada pa ba makakagpugong nga kabunyagan hira hin tubig?”
en: “Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have.”

war: Sanglit nagsugo hi Pedro nga bunyagan hira ha ngaran hi Jesu-Cristo. Ngan naghangyo hira nga magpabilin hiya dida ha ira hin pira pa ka adlaw.
en: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.

war: Nahibaroan han mga apostoles ngan han mga magtinuohon ha bug-os nga Judea nga an mga Hentil kinmarawat liwat han pulong han Dyos.
en: The apostles and the believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

war: Han pagkadto ni Pedro ha Jerusalem, ginsusnan hiya han hugpo han mga Judiyo nga karuyag torion an mga Hentil, sugad han ira gintutuohan. Nagsiring hira,
en: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him

war: “Kay ano nga nakig-usa ka hadton diri tinori nga mga Hentil ngan nakigsaro ka pa ngani ha ira?”
en: and said, “You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them.”

war: Sanglit iginsaysay ha ira hin tukib ni Pedro an nahinabo tikang gud ha tinikangan:
en: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:

war: Gin-usisa ko an sulod hini, ngan hinkit-an ko in mga hayop, mga mananap nga naglalakat ngan nagkakamang, ngan mga ihalas nga katamsihan.
en: I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles and birds.

war: Niyan nakabati ako hin tingog nga nagsiring ha akon, ‘Pedro, tindog; pag-ihaw ngan kaon!’
en: Then I heard a voice telling me, ‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’

war: Kundi nagsiring ako, ‘Diri gud ako, Ginoo! Kay waray pa gud nakasulod ha akon baba nga mahugaw o diri malinis nga pagkaon.’
en: “I replied, ‘Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

war: Nagyakan liwat an tingog tikang ha langit, ‘Ayaw paghunahunaa nga mahugaw in bisan ano nga ginsiring na han Dyos nga malinis.’
en: “The voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’

war: Nahinabo ini makatulo ngan kahuman, iginbalik an akon hinkit-an ngadto ha langit.
en: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.

war: Hito manta nga takna inmabot ha balay nga akon sinak-an in tulo ka tawo nga ginsugo tikang ha Cesarea.
en: “Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

war: Magyayakan hiya ha iyo hin mga pulong nga makakatalwas ha imo ngan han bug-os mo nga panimalay.’
en: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’

war: Ngan han pagtikang ko na hin pagyakan, kinmunsad ha ira an Espiritu Santo sugad gud han pagkunsad ha aton hadto han Espiritu Santo.
en: “As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.

war: Niyan nahinumdom ako han iginsiring han Ginoo, ‘Nagbunyag hin tubig hi Juan, kundi pagbubunyagan kamo han Espiritu Santo.’
en: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’

war: Han pakabati nira hini, inmokoy an ira pagsuson ngan gindayaw nira an Dyos hin pagsiring, “Kon sugad, naghatag liwat an Dyos ngadto han mga Hentil hin higayon hin pagbasol basi hira mabuhi!”
en: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, “So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life.”

war: Nakada ha ira an gahom han Ginoo, ngan tinmoo in damo kaupay nga mga tawo, ngan nakabig hira ngadto ha Ginoo.
en: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

war: Inmabot ha singbahan ha Jerusalem an sumat mahitungod hini, sanglit ginsugo nira hi Bernabe ngadto ha Antioquia.
en: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

war: Buotan nga tawo hi Bernabe, nga puno han Espiritu Santo ngan hin pagtoo. Sanglit damo nga mga tawo in nakabig ngadto ha Ginoo.
en: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

war: Niyan kinmadto hi Bernabe ha Tarso hin pagbiling kan Saulo.
en: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,

war: Hadto nga panahon inmabot ha Antioquia in mga manaragna nga tikang ha Jerusalem.
en: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

war: Nagkauruyon an mga magtinuohon nga magpapadara an tagsa ha ira, sugad han iya mahihimo, basi makabulig han ira igkasi mga magtinuohon nga nag-uokoy ha tuna han Judea.
en: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea.

war: Ginbuhat nira ini, ngan ginpadara nira an kwarta kanda Bernabe ug Saulo ngadto han mga katigurangan han singbahan.
en: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.

war: Hini nga panahon nagtikang hi Hadi Herodes hin pagpakurii in pira nga mga kaapi han singbahan.
en: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.

war: Iginpapatay niya pinaagi hin espada hi Santiago nga bugto ni Juan.
en: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

war: Han pakakita niya nga nakalipay ini han mga Judiyo, nagpadayon hiya ngan iginpadakop liwat hi Pedro. (Nahinabo ini ha panahon han Pyesta han Tinapay nga Waray Patubo.)
en: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

war: Sanglit ginsulod hi Pedro ha bilanggoan kundi an mga tawo han singbahan nagpadayon han ira mainiton nga pag-ampo ngadto ha Dyos tungod ha iya.
en: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for him.

war: Sinmunod ha iya hi Pedro hin paggawas han bilanggoan. Kundi diri hiya maaram kon tinuod ba an ginbubuhat han anghel; hunahuna niya nga usa la adto nga panan-awon.
en: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.

war: Han kasayod niya han iya kamutangan, kinmadto hiya ha balay ni Maria nga iroy ni Juan Marcos diin nagkatirok in damo nga mga tawo nga nag-aampo.
en: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.

war: Nagtuktok hi Pedro han portahan ha gawas, ngan kinmadto in usa nga surugoon nga Roda an ngaran hin panginano.
en: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.

war: Kinilala niya an tingog ni Pedro, ngan tungod ha dako niya nga kalipay, dinmalagan hiya hin pagbalik, nga waray kaabrehi an porta, ngan nagsumat hiya nga nakadto ha gawas hi Pedro.
en: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, “Peter is at the door!”

war: “Nalilipong ka ba?” ginsiring hiya nira. Kundi nagdig-on gud hiya nga matuod an iya ginyakan. Sanglit binmaton hira, “An anghel adto niya.”
en: “You’re out of your mind,” they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”

war: Nagpadayon hin pagtuktok hi Pedro, ngan han pag-abrehi na nira han porta ngan han pakakita nira ha iya, nahipausa hira.
en: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.

war: Han pagkaaga na duro an kalisang han mga gwardya kon ano an nahinabo kan Pedro.
en: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

war: Dida hin usa nga gintalaan nga adlaw nagsul-ot hi Herodes han iya hadianon nga biste, linmingkod han iya trono, ngan namulong ha mga tawo.
en: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.

war: Naggoliat an mga tawo, “Diri ini tawo nga nagyayakan, kundi usa nga diyos!”
en: They shouted, “This is the voice of a god, not of a man.”

war: Ginhampak dayon hi Herodes han anghel han Ginoo kay waray niya pasidunggi an Dyos. Ginkaon hiya hin mga ulod ngan namatay.
en: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.

war: Nagpadayon hin paglurab ngan pagtubo an pulong han Dyos.
en: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.

war: Nakahuman hira Bernabe ug Saulo han ira buruhaton ngan binmalik hira tikang ha Jerusalem nga dara nira hi Juan Marcos.
en: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.

war: Nagpuasa ngan nag-ampo hira, iginpandong an ira mga kamot kanda Bernabe ug Saulo, ngan ginpagikan hira.
en: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.

war: Tungod nga ginsugo man han Espiritu Santo hira Bernabe ug Saulo, kinmadto hira ha Seleucia ngan tikang didto nagsakay hira ngadto ha puro han Cipre.
en: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.

war: Han pag-abot nira ha Salamina, nagwali hira han pulong han Dyos didto han mga sinagoga han mga Judiyo. Upod nira hi Juan Marcos nga ira kabulig.
en: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.

war: Ginluob nira hin paglatas an puro tubtob ngadto ha Papos, diin iginkita nira in salamangkero nga ginngangaranan kan Bar-Jesus; usa hiya nga Judiyo nga napakamanaragna.
en: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,

war: Sangkay hiya ni Sergio Paulo, an Gobernador han puro, nga usa ka tawo nga maaram. Iginpatawag han Gobernador hira Bernabe ug Saulo, kay karuyag niya mamati han pulong han Dyos.
en: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

war: Kundi gin-ulang hira ni Elimas nga salamangkero (ini an iya ngaran ha Griego); gintinguha niya nga mahibulag han pagtoo an Gobernador.
en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

war: Niyan hi Saulo—nga kinikilala liwat nga Pablo, nga puno han Espiritu Santo, sinmiplat hiya han salamangkero,
en: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,

war: Han pakakita han Gobernador hini nga nahinabo, tinmoo hiya tungod nga duro an iya paghipausa han pagturon-an mahitungod han Ginoo.
en: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

war: Tikang ha Papos nagsakay hira Pablo ngan han iya mga kaupod, ngan inmabot hira ha Perga, nga usa nga syudad ha Panfilya, kundi binayaan hira ni Juan Marcos nga inmoli ngadto ha Jerusalem.
en: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.

war: Tikang ha Perga nagpadayon hira ngadto ha Antioquia han Pisidia, ngan ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway sinmulod hira han sinagoga ngan linmingkod.
en: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.

war: Tinmindog hi Pablo ngan nagsenyas hiya ha ira nga maghilom, ngan namulong hiya: “Mga igkasi ko Israelita ngan ngatanan nga mga Hentil nga hahani nga nagsisingba han Dyos: pamatii ako!
en: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: “Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!

war: ngan sulod hin 40 ka tuig gin-ilob niya hira didto ha kamingawan.
en: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;

war: Ginbungkag niya in pito nga mga nasod didto ha tuna han Canaan, ngan ginhatag ini ha ira ngan ginpatag-iya hira hini nga tuna.
en: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.

war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan sulod hin mga 450 ka tuig. “Kahuman hini, gintagan niya hira hin mga maghurukom tubtob han panahon ni manaragna Samuel.
en: All this took about 450 years. “After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.

war: Ngan han pag-aro na nira hin hadi, iginhatag ha ira han Dyos hi Saulo nga anak ni Cis, tikang han tribo ni Benjamin basi maghadi ha ira hin 40 ka tuig.
en: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.

war: Hi Jesus nga tulin ni David amo an ginhimo han Dyos nga Magtaralwas han katawhan han Israel sumala han iya iginsaad.
en: “From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.

war: Han waray pa magtikang hi Jesus han iya buruhaton, nagwali na hi Juan ha ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel nga kinahanglan magbasol hira ngan magpabunyag.
en: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.

war: “Mga igkasi ko Israelita nga mga tulin ni Abraham, ngan kamo ngatanan nga mga Hentil nga nagsisingba han Dyos: amo kita an ginpadad-an hini nga mensahe han katalwasan!
en: “Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.

war: Ngan bisan kon waray nira hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya ha kamatayon, pinangaro nira kan Pilato nga patayon hiya.
en: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.

war: Ngan kahuman nira pagtumana an ngatanan nga ginhimangraw han Kasuratan mahitungod ha iya, gintanggal hiya nira ha kros ngan iginlubong.
en: When they had carried out all that was written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.

war: Kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos,
en: But God raised him from the dead,

war: ngan sulod hin damo nga mga adlaw nagpakita hiya hadton mga inmupod ha iya tikang ha Galilea ngadto ha Jerusalem. Mga saksi na hira niya yana ngadto ha katawhan han Israel.
en: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.

war: Sumala han iya isinisiring ha lain nga bahin han Kasuratan, ‘Diri ka matugot nga madunot ha lubnganan an imo baraan nga surugoon.’
en: So it is also stated elsewhere: “ ‘You will not let your holy one see decay.’

war: Gintuman ni David ha iya panahon an katuyoanan han Dyos, ngan niyan namatay hiya, iginlubong tampo han iya mga kaapoy-apoyan, ngan nadunot.
en: “Now when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his ancestors and his body decayed.

war: Kundi waray ini mahinabo nga pagkadunot ngadto han ginbanhaw han Dyos.
en: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.

war: Sanglit pagbantay kamo basi diri mahinabo ha iyo an iginsiring han mga manaragna:
en: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:

war: Han pagguwa na nira Pablo ug Bernabe han sinagoga, ginhangyo hira han mga tawo nga bumalik han sunod nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway ngan pagsumatan hira mahitungod hin iba pa hini nga mga butang.
en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.

war: Han pagkasunod nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway an haros ngatanan nga mga tawo han bungto kinmadto pamati han pulong han Ginoo.
en: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

war: Han pakakita han mga Judiyo han damo nga mga tawo, napungot hira ngan tinmipa hira han iginyakan ni Pablo ngan ginpakaalohan pa nira hiya.
en: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.

war: Kay amo ini an sugo nga iginhatag ha amon han Ginoo: ‘Iginbutang ko ikaw nga magin kapawa han mga Hentil, basi matalwas an bug-os nga kalibutan.’”
en: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: “ ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ ”

war: Nalipay an mga Hentil han pakabati nira hini, ngan gindayaw nira an mensahe han Ginoo, ngan adton mga ginpili para han dayon nga kinabuhi nahimo nga mga magtinuohon.
en: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

war: Naglurab an pulong han Ginoo ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hito nga tuna.
en: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.

war: Ginpaspas han mga Apostoles an tapotapo han ira mga tiil nga tigaman han ira pagriwa, ngan nagpadayon hira ngadto ha Iconio.
en: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.

war: Duro an kalipay han mga magtinuohon ha Antioquia, ngan napuno hira han Espiritu Santo.
en: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

war: Kundi an mga Hentil gintukso han mga Judiyo nga diri natoo, sanglit nasina hira han mga magtinuohon.
en: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.

war: Nabahin an mga tawo han syudad: may inmugop han mga Judiyo ngan may-ada man liwat inmugop han mga apostoles.
en: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.

war: Niyan nagkauroyon in pira han mga Hentil ngan han mga Judiyo, upod an ira mga pangulo, hin pagdarahog han mga apostoles ngan hin pagbato ha ira.
en: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.

war: Han paghibaro hini han mga apostoles, nangalagiw hira ngadto ha Listra ngan ha Derbe nga mga syudad ha Licaonia, ngan ngadto han kahigrani nga katunaan.
en: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,

war: Didto iginwali nira an Maupay nga Sumat.
en: where they continued to preach the gospel.

war: Didto ha Listra may-ada tawo nga lulid nga piay tikang han iya katawo ngan waray gud hiya makalakat.
en: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been that way from birth and had never walked.

war: Nalingkod hiya didto pamati han mga pulong ni Pablo. Hinkit-an ni Pablo nga natoo hiya ngan mahihimo hin kaupay, sanglit tinutokan niya an lulid,
en: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed

war: ngan ginsiring ha dako nga tingog, “Tadong hin pagtindog!” Linmukso an tawo ngan naglinakatlakat.
en: and called out, “Stand up on your feet!” At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.

war: Han pakakita han mga tawo han ginbuhat ni Pablo, naggogliat hira ha ira yinaknan nga Licaonyanhon, “An kadiyosan nahimo nga pareho hin mga tawo ngan linmusad nganhi ha aton!”
en: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, “The gods have come down to us in human form!”

war: Ginngaranan nira hin Seus hi Bernabe ngan Herme hi Pablo, kay hiya man an parayakan.
en: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.

war: Han paghibaro nira Bernabe ug Pablo han ira karuyag pagbuhaton, ginggisi nira an ira mga panapton. Nagdadlagan hira ngadto ha butnga han mga tawo ngan naggoliat,
en: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:

war: Hadto nga mga panahon pinasagdan la niya an ngatanan nga mga katawhan hin pagtuman han ira karuyag.
en: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.

war: Kundi bisan pa kahuman nira pamulong, nagkuri la gihapon an mga apostoles hin pagpugong han mga tawo hin pagdara hin mga halad ngadto ha ira.
en: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.

war: Kundi han pag-alirongi ha iya han mga magtinuohon, binmuhat hiya ngan binmalik ngadto ha bungto. Han pagkabuwas hiya ngan hi Bernabe kinmadto ha Derbe.
en: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.

war: Iginwali nira Pablo ug Bernabe an Maupay nga Sumat didto ha Derbe, ngan damo an ira nakabig. Niyan binmalik hira ngadto ha Listra ug Iconio ngan nagpadayon ngadto ha Antioquia ha Pisidia.
en: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,

war: Ha kada singbahan nagtudlok hira hin mga katigurangan, ngan upod an mga pag-ampo ngan pagpuasa, igintubyan hira ngadto han Ginoo nga ira sinasarigan.
en: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

war: Kahuman nira maglatas han katunaan han Pisidia, inmabot hira ha Pamfilya.
en: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,

war: Iginwali nira an mensahe didto ha Perga, ngan katapos linmugsong hira ngadto ha Atalia.
en: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

war: Tikang didto nagsakay hira pagbalik ngadto ha Antioquia, diin didto igintubyan hira ngadto han mahigugmaon nga pagmangno han grasya han Dyos para han buruhaton nga yana ira na natuman.
en: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.

war: Didto nagpabilin hira hin maiha upod han mga magtinuohon.
en: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.

war: Han pag-abot nira ha Jerusalem, ginkarawat hira han singbahan, han mga apostoles, ngan han mga katigurangan, nga ira ginsumatan mahitungod han ngatanan nga ginbuhat han Dyos pinaagi ha ira.
en: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders, to whom they reported everything God had done through them.

war: Nagkatirok an mga apostoles ngan an mga katigurangan hin pagtuhay hini nga kasamok.
en: The apostles and elders met to consider this question.

war: Ngan nagpadayag an Dyos nga sayod han kasingkasing han mga tawo, han iya pagkarawat han mga Hentil pinaagi hin paghatag ha ira han Espiritu Santo sugad han paghatag niya ha aton.
en: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.

war: Waray ginpalabi han Dyos ha aton ngan ha ira; ginpasaylo niya an ira mga sala kay tinmoo man hira.
en: He did not discriminate between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.

war: Diri ito amo! Natoo kami nga hira, sugad ha aton, natatalwas pinaagi han grasya han Ginoo nga Jesus.”
en: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”

war: Katapos nira pagyakan, nagsiring liwat hi Santiago: “Kabugtoan, pamatii ako niyo.
en: When they finished, James spoke up. “Brothers,” he said, “listen to me.

war: Kahuman pa la igsaysay hi Simon hiunong han syahan nga pagpakita han Dyos han iya paghigugma han mga Hentil, pinaagi hin pagkuha tikang ha ira hin kalugaringon niya nga mga tawo.
en: Simon has described to us how God first intervened to choose a people for his name from the Gentiles.

war: Nahauyon ini han mga pulong han mga manaragna sumala han siring han Kasuratan:
en: The words of the prophets are in agreement with this, as it is written:

war: ‘Kahuman hini mabalik ako, nasiring an Ginoo, ngan titindogon ko an napukan nga balay ni David. Ibabalik ko an mga nagkaruruba, ngan padidig-onon ko na liwat ini.
en: “ ‘After this I will return and rebuild David’s fallen tent. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,

war: Sanglit magbibiling han Ginoo an iba nga katawhan, ngan an ngatanan nga mga Hentil nga gintawag ko nga akon kalugaringon.
en: that the rest of mankind may seek the Lord, even all the Gentiles who bear my name, says the Lord, who does these things’ —

war: Amo ini an siring han Ginoo nga nagpadayag hini hadto pa nga panahon.’
en: things known from long ago.

war: “Ha akon nga bahin,” nagpadayon hi Santiago, “diri naton pagsamokon an mga Hentil nga nadangop han Dyos.
en: “It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.

war: Kay tikang pa han una nga mga panahon pirme ginbabasa an Balaod ni Moises ha mga sinagoga ha kada Adlaw nga Iparahuway, ngan iginwawali an iya mga pulong ha kada bungto.”
en: For the law of Moses has been preached in every city from the earliest times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.”

war: Nakabati kami nga may-ada mga tawo tikang han amon hugpo, nga kinmada ngan nakasamok ha iyo pinaagi han ira mga ginpamulong, bisan kon waray namon hira pagsugoa hin pagbuhat hini.
en: We have heard that some went out from us without our authorization and disturbed you, troubling your minds by what they said.

war: Sanglit nagkatirok kami ngan nagkaurosa hin pagpili hin mga tawo nga susugoon namon ngada ha iyo. Maupod hira han aton hinigugma nga kasangkayan, hira Bernabe ug Pablo,
en: So we all agreed to choose some men and send them to you with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul—

war: nga nagtubyan han ira kinabuhi tungod hin pagsirbe han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.
en: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

war: Nagsusugo kami ngada ha iyo kanda Judas ug Silas nga amo an magsusumat ha iyo han mga butang nga iginsurat namon ha iyo.
en: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to confirm by word of mouth what we are writing.

war: Minaupay ini namon ngan han Espiritu Santo nga diri na kamo butangan hin lain pa nga paras-anon labot hini nga kinahanglanon nga mga turumanon:
en: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond the following requirements:

war: Ginpagikan nira an mga ginsugo ngan kinmadto hira ha Antioquia; diin gintirok nira an bug-os nga hugpo han mga magtinuohon, ngan iginhatag ha ira an surat.
en: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they gathered the church together and delivered the letter.

war: Han pakabasa han mga tawo han surat, nalipay gud hira tungod han mensahe nga nakapadasig.
en: The people read it and were glad for its encouraging message.

war: Nagyakan hin maiha ngadto han mga kabugtoan hira Judas ug Silas nga mga manaragna liwat, ngan nakapakusog ngan nakapadasig ini ha ira.
en: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the believers.

war: Kahuman nira magpabilin didto hin halipot nga panahon, ginpagikan hira nga malinawon han kabugtoan; ngan binmalik hira ngadto han mga nagsugo ha ira. (
en: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the believers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.

war: Nagpabilin hira Pablo ug Bernabe ha Antioquia. Kaupod in damo nga iba pa nga mga tawo nagtutdo ngan nagwali hira han pulong han Ginoo.
en: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.

war: Karuyag ni Bernabe nga ig-upod gihapon nira hi Juan Marcos.
en: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,

war: Kundi naghunahuna hi Pablo nga diri maupay nga umupod ha ira in usa nga binmaya ha ira didto ha Pamfilya ngan waray magpadayon hin pagtapos han ira buruhaton.
en: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.

war: Nagkamay-ada hira mapaso nga lantugi, sanglit nagkabulag hira. Igin-upod ni Bernabe hi Marcos ngan nagsakay hira ngadto ha Cipre;
en: They had such a sharp disagreement that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,

war: samtang ginpili ni Pablo hi Silas, ngan ginmikan hira nga igintubyan han kabugtoan ngadto ha grasya han Ginoo.
en: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the grace of the Lord.

war: Kinmadto hira ha Siria ug Cilicia ngan ginparig-on niya ang mga singbahan.
en: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

war: Inmabot hi Pablo ngadto ha Derbe ug Listra. May-ada didto usa nga tinun-an nga Timoteo an ngaran. Anak hiya hin babaye nga matinuohon nga Judiyo, kundi Griego an amay niya.
en: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was Jewish and a believer but whose father was a Greek.

war: Dinayaw hi Timoteo han ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon ha Listra ug Iconio.
en: The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.

war: Sanglit nagmarig-on an pagtoo han mga singbahan ngan pirme hira nadudugangan kada adlaw.
en: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.

war: Naglatas hira han katunaan han Frigia ngan han Galacia, kay gindid-an hira han Espiritu Santo hin pagwali han mensahe didto ha lalawigan han Asia.
en: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.

war: Han pag-abot nira ngadto han atbang nga pag-ultan han Misia, nakahunahuna hira hin pagkadto ha lalawigan han Bitinia, kundi waray hira tugoti han Espiritu ni Jesus.
en: When they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not allow them to.

war: Sanglit linabyan la nira an Misia ngan linmugsong hira ngadto ha Troas.
en: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.

war: Tikang ha Troas nagsakay kami hin pagtabok ngadto ha Samotrasia, ngan han pagkabuwas, ngadto ha Neapolis.
en: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day we went on to Neapolis.

war: Ginsunod niya hi Pablo ngan kami nga naggogoliat, “Mga surugoon ini nga mga tawo han Gilalabawi nga Dyos! Iginsasangyaw nira ha iyo an mensahe han katalwasan!”
en: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved.”

war: Han pakasabot han mga agaron han babayehay nga waray na hira higayon hin panalapi, gindakop nira hira Pablo ug Silas ngan gindara ngadto ha atubangan han mga punoan.
en: When her owners realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.

war: Ginpaatubang ini hira han mga punoan nga Romano, ngan nagsiring hira, “Mga Judiyo ini nga nagsasamok han aton syudad.
en: They brought them before the magistrates and said, “These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar

war: Nagtututdo hira hin mga pamatasan nga nasupak han aton balaod; diri kita makakahimo hin pagkarawat o pagtuman hini kay Romano kita.”
en: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice.”

war: Binmulig an mga tawo hin paghampak ha ira; ginggisi ngan ginlubas han mga punoan an mga panapton nira Pablo ug Silas, ngan iginpalatob hira.
en: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten with rods.

war: Kahuman hin duro nga paghampak, iginsulod hira ha prisohan ngan ginsugo an gwardya han prisohan nga pagbantayan gud hira hin maupay.
en: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.

war: Han pakakarawat hini nga sugo, iginsulod hira han gwardya ha bartolina ngan ginpandogan an ira mga tiil.
en: When he received these orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.

war: Han harapit na magkatutnga an kagab-ihon, hira Pablo ug Silas nag-iinampo ngan nagkikinanta hin mga pagdayaw han Dyos, ngan nagpipinamati ha ira an iba nga mga priso.
en: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.

war: Tigda la nga linminog hin duro kakusog, nga nakabay-og han bug-os nga prisohan. Hito manta nga takna naabre an mga porta ngan natangtang an mga kadena han ngatanan nga mga priso.
en: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.

war: Kundi ginmoliat hi Pablo, “Ayaw pag-unay! Aadi kami ngatanan!”
en: But Paul shouted, “Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!”

war: Nag-aro hin suga an gwardya han prisohan, nagdagmit pagsulod, ngan hinmapa nga nangungurog ha tiilan nira Pablo ug Silas.
en: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

war: Ngan igingawas hira ngan nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Mga mano, ano an kinahanglan ko pagbuhaton basi matalwas ako?”
en: He then brought them out and asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

war: Binmaton hira, “Too han Ginoo nga Jesus, ngan matatalwas ka—ikaw, pati an imo panimalay.”
en: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household.”

war: Niyan iginwali nira an pulong han Ginoo ha iya ngan han ngatanan nga sakop han iya balay.
en: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.

war: Hito manta nga takna han gab-i gindara hira han gwardya ngan ginhugasan an ira mga samad; ngan ginbunyagan dayon hiya ngan an bug-os niya nga panimalay.
en: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his household were baptized.

war: Kahuman ginpauswag niya hira Pablo ug Silas ngadto han iya balay ngan gindurotan hira hin pagkaon. Malipayon na hiya ngan an iya panimalay kay tinmoo na man hira han Dyos.
en: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God—he and his whole household.

war: Han pagkaaga na, nagsugo an mga punoan nga Romano hin mga polis nga buhian na hira Pablo ug Silas.
en: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: “Release those men.”

war: Sanglit ginsumatan han gwardya hira Pablo ug Silas nga ginpapabuhian na hira han mga punoan ngan makakagawas na hira han prisohan.
en: The jailer told Paul, “The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace.”

war: Iginsumat ini han mga polis ngadto han mga punoan nga Romano, ngan han pakabati nira nga mga Romano ngay-an hira Pablo ug Silas, nagkahadlok hira.
en: The officers reported this to the magistrates, and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were alarmed.

war: Sanglit kinmadto hira ha prisohan ngan nangaro hira hin pasaylo kanda Pablo ug Silas. Ginpagawas hira han prisohan ngan ginhangyo nga bumaya na hira han syudad.
en: They came to appease them and escorted them from the prison, requesting them to leave the city.

war: Ginmawas han prisohan hira Pablo ug Silas ngan napakadto han balay ni Lydia. Didto iginkita nira an mga magtinuohon, ira gindasig hira hin mga pulong, ngan kahuman, ginmikan hira.
en: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house, where they met with the brothers and sisters and encouraged them. Then they left.

war: Naglatas hira han Ampipolis ug Apolonia ngan inmabot hira ha Tesalonica, diin may-ada sinagoga han mga Judiyo.
en: When Paul and his companions had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

war: Sugad han iya nababatasan, sinmulod hi Pablo han sinagoga. Sulod hin tulo ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway nakiglantugi hiya didto han mga tawo, pinasikad han Kasuratan.
en: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

war: Nakabig in pira nga mga Judiyo ngan inmupod hira kanda Pablo ug Silas, sugad man in damo nga mga Griego nga mainampoon han Dyos, ngan damo han mga kinikilala nga kababayen-an.
en: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women.

war: ngan gintago hira ni Jason ha iya balay. Gintatalapas nira ngatanan an mga balaod han Emperador; nasiring hira nga may lain pa nga hadi nga ginngangaranan kan Jesus.”
en: and Jason has welcomed them into his house. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, one called Jesus.”

war: Pinaagi hini nga mga paggoliat nagkasaramok an mga tawo ngan an mga punoan han syudad.
en: When they heard this, the crowd and the city officials were thrown into turmoil.

war: Han kapyansahi na kan Jason ngan han iya mga kaupod, ginbuhian hira han mga punoan.
en: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.

war: Han pagkagab-i na ginpagikan han mga magtinuohon ngadto ha Berea hira Pablo ug Silas. Han pag-abot nira didto, sinmulod hira han sinagoga han mga Judiyo.
en: As soon as it was night, the believers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.

war: Damo ha ira in tinmuo; upod in kadam-an nga Griego nga kababayen-an nga kinikilala han bungto, ngan hin mga kalalaken-an.
en: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of prominent Greek women and many Greek men.

war: Kundi han pakabati han mga Judiyo ha Tesalonica nga nagwali liwat hi Pablo han pulong han Dyos didto ha Berea, kinmadto hira hin pagtukso ngan pagribok han mga tawo.
en: But when the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, some of them went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.

war: Ginpalakat dayon hi Pablo han mga magtinuohon ngadto ha baybayon, kundi nagpabilin ha Berea hira Silas ug Timoteo.
en: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed at Berea.

war: Samtang naghuhulat hi Pablo didto ha Atenas kanda Silas ug Timoteo, dako gud an iya kabaraka han pakakita niya nga puno hin mga diyosdiyos an syudad.
en: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.

war: Sanglit nakiglantugi hiya didto ha sinagoga han mga Judiyo ngan mga Hentil nga magsingbahon han Dyos. Nakiglantugi liwat hiya adlaw-adlaw han mga tawo nga napakadto han taboan.
en: So he reasoned in the synagogue with both Jews and God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.

war: Sanglit ginkuha nira hi Pablo ngan gindara ngadto ha atubangan han hukmanan han Areopago ngan nagsiring hira, “Karuyag namon mahibaro hini nga bag-o nga pagturon-an nga imo igintututdo.
en: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, “May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?

war: Nahipapausa kami hini nga mga butang nga imo igintututdo, sanglit karuyag namon mahibaroan an ira kahulogan.” (
en: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we would like to know what they mean.”

war: Kay an ngatanan nga taga-Atenas ngan an mga lumalangyaw nga nag-uokoy didto waray iba nga binubuhat kundi an pagsinumat ngan pagpinamati hin bag-o nga mga butang.)
en: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)

war: Sanglit tinmindog hi Pablo ha atubangan han hukmanan han Areopago ngan nagsiring, “Mga taga-Atenas, nakikita nga makidyos kamo.
en: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: “People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.

war: An Dyos nga naghimo han kalibutan ngan han ngatanan dinhe ha kalibutan, amo an Ginoo han langit ngan han tuna, ngan diri nag-uokoy hiya dida hin mga templo nga hinimo hin tawo.
en: “The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.

war: Ginbuhat niya ini basi magbiling hira han Dyos, ha paglaom nga hiaagian hiya dida han mga butang nga ginhimo para ha ira. Diri hirayo an Dyos ha tagsa-tagsa ha aton;
en: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.

war: sumala han iginsiring: ‘Dida ha iya kita nabubuhi, nagkikiwa, ngan aanhi ha kalibutan.’ Sugad ito han iginsiring hin pira han iyo mga parasiday: ‘Mga anak man liwat kita niya.’
en: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’

war: Tungod nga mga anak man kita han Dyos, diri kita maghunahuna nga an kinaiya han Dyos sugad hin bulawan o salapi o bato nga ginporma nga ladawan pinaagi han kabatiran han tawo.
en: “Therefore since we are God’s offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone—an image made by human design and skill.

war: Hadto han diri pa nakilala ha iya an mga tawo, ginpabay-an la han Dyos an mga butang, kundi yana iginsugo na niya nga magbasol hira han ira mga sala.
en: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.

war: Han pakabati nira kan Pablo nga nagyakan mahitungod han pagkabanhaw, nagbiaybiay ha iya in pira ha ira, kundi nagsiring an iba, “Karuyag namon mamati liwat ha imo mahitungod hini nga butang.”
en: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them sneered, but others said, “We want to hear you again on this subject.”

war: Ngan binmaya hi Pablo han katirok.
en: At that, Paul left the Council.

war: May-ada mga tawo nga inmupod ha iya ngan tinmoo; usa ha ira amo hi Dionisio nga sakop han hukmanan, ngan usa nga babaye nga ginngangaranan kan Damaris, ngan hin iba pa.
en: Some of the people became followers of Paul and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus, also a woman named Damaris, and a number of others.

war: Katapos hini, ginmikan hi Pablo tikang ha Atenas ngan nagpadayon ngadto ha Corinto.
en: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

war: ngan tungod nga pareho man an ira pakabuhi linmungon hiya ha ira ngan nakig-usa ha ira hin trabaho, kay pareho man hira parahimo hin tulda.
en: and because he was a tentmaker as they were, he stayed and worked with them.

war: Ha kada Adlaw nga Iparahuway nakiglantugi hiya didto ha sinagoga basi makabig niya in mga Judiyo ngan mga Griego.
en: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.

war: Han pag-abot nira Silas ug Timoteo tikang ha Macedonia, gingamit ni Pablo an iya bug-os nga panahon hin pagwali han mensahe hin pagpamatuod ha mga Judiyo nga hi Jesus amo an Cristo.
en: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.

war: Sanglit binayaan niya hira ngan napakadto hin pag-ukoy ha balay hin usa nga Hentil nga ginngangaranan kan Tito Justo nga masingbahon han Dyos. Sapit la han sinagoga an iya balay.
en: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.

war: Usa hadto ka gab-i nagkamay-ada panan-awon hi Pablo diin nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Ayaw kahadlok! Ipadayon an imo pagwali ngan ayaw kahulop,
en: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.

war: kay upod ako ha imo. Waray maglalabot ha imo kay damo an akon mga tawo dinhe hini nga syudad.”
en: For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city.”

war: Sanglit nagpabilin didto hi Pablo hin usa ka tuig ngan unom ka bulan ngan gintutdoan niya an mga tawo han pulong han Dyos.
en: So Paul stayed in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching them the word of God.

war: Han gobernador na han Acaya hi Galio nga Romano, nagkaurosa an mga Judiyo hin pagdakop kan Pablo ngan gindara hiya ngadto ha hukmanan.
en: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews of Corinth made a united attack on Paul and brought him to the place of judgment.

war: Nagsiring hira, “Ini nga tawo naghuhugay han mga tawo hin pagsingba han Dyos hin paagi nga nasupak han balaod!”
en: “This man,” they charged, “is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law.”

war: Ngan iya ginpagawas hira han hukmanan.
en: So he drove them off.

war: Gindakop nira hi Sostenes nga pangulo han sinagoga ngan ginhampak nira ha atubangan han hukmanan. Kundi waray gud la hi Galio pakaalantad.
en: Then the crowd there turned on Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the proconsul; and Gallio showed no concern whatever.

war: Inmabot hira ha Efeso diin binayaan ni Pablo hira Priscila ug Aquila. Kinmadto hiya ha sinagoga ngan nakiglantugi han mga Judiyo.
en: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

war: Ginhangyo hiya han mga tawo nga magpabilin hiya hin mairoiha upod ha ira, kundi waray hiya tumangdo.
en: When they asked him to spend more time with them, he declined.

war: Lugod ginsiring niya hira han nagikan na hiya, “Mabalik ako ha iyo kon tugotan ako han Dyos.” Ngan ginmikan hiya tikang ha Efeso.
en: But as he left, he promised, “I will come back if it is God’s will.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

war: Han paghaw-as niya ha Cesarea, sinmagka hiya ngadto ha Jerusalem ngan nangumosta han singbahan, ngan kahuman, kinmadto hiya ha Antioquia.
en: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.

war: Katapos niya magpabilin hin halipot nga panahon didto, linmakat hiya. Nagsudoy hiya han katunaan han Galacia ug Frigia, ngan ginparig-on niya an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon.
en: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.

war: Inmabot ha Efeso in usa nga Judiyo nga ginngangaranan kan Apolo nga natawo ha Alejandria. Maupay hiya mamulong ngan batid hiya han Kasuratan.
en: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was a learned man, with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.

war: Tungod han marig-on niya nga pakiglantugi, gindaog niya an mga Judiyo ha atubangan han mga tawo, pinaagi hin pagpamatuod niya tikang ha Kasuratan nga hi Jesus amo an Cristo.
en: For he vigorously refuted his Jewish opponents in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.

war: Samtang nakadto hi Apolo ha Corinto, naglatas hi Pablo han lalawigan ngan inmabot hiya ha Efeso. Didto iginkita hiya hin mga tinun-an,
en: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples

war: ngan iya ginpakianhan hira, “Kinmarawat ba kamo han Espiritu Santo han pagkarawat niyo han pagtoo?” Binmaton hira, “Waray ngani kami makabati nga may-ada Espiritu Santo.”
en: and asked them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They answered, “No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

war: “Kon sugad, ano man nga pagbunyag an iyo kinarawat?” nagpakiana hi Pablo. Ngan nagbaton hira nga an bunyag ni Juan.
en: So Paul asked, “Then what baptism did you receive?” “John’s baptism,” they replied.

war: Han pakabati nira hini, ginbunyagan hira ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Jesus.
en: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

war: Ginpandongan hira ni Pablo han iya mga kamot ngan kinunsaran hira han Espiritu Santo. Nagyakan hira hin magkalainlain nga mga pinulongan ngan nagpasangyaw liwat han mensahe han Dyos.
en: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.

war: May mga 12 ka tawo hira ngatanan.
en: There were about twelve men in all.

war: Kinmadto hi Pablo ha sinagoga, ngan sulod hin tulo ka bulan namulong hiya hin waray kahadlok ngadto han mga tawo. Nakiglantugi hiya ha ira mahitungod han Ginhadian han Dyos.
en: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.

war: Nagpadayon ini hin duha ka tuig, sanglit nagpakabati han pulong han Ginoo an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga Judiyo ngan mga Hentil nga nag-ukoy didto ha lalawigan han Asia.
en: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.

war: Ginbuhat han Dyos in talagsaon nga mga milagro pinaagi kan Pablo.
en: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,

war: Bisan ngani an mga panyo ngan mga tapis nga ginamit ni Pablo gindadara ngadto han mga magsakit ngan nauupay an ira mga sakit, ngan naiwas ha ira an magraot nga mga espiritu.
en: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.

war: Nagbubuhat hini an pito nga magburugto nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Esceva nga usa nga Gilalabawi nga Padi han mga Judiyo.
en: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.

war: Kundi nagsiring ha ira an maraot nga espiritu, “Nakilala ako kan Jesus ngan nakilala liwat ako kan Pablo; kundi baga hin-o gud kamo?”
en: One day the evil spirit answered them, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?”

war: An tawo nga may-ada maraot nga espiritu dinmasmag ha ira, ngan tungod han kakusog niya, ginlupigan hira. Tikang han iya balay nagdadlagan hira ngatanan nga mga samad ngan mga lubas na.
en: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.

war: Nagpakabati mahitungod hini an ngatanan nga mga Judiyo ngan mga Hentil nga nag-uokoy ha Efeso. Nagkahahadlok hira ngatanan ngan ginpasidunggan nira an ngaran han Ginoo nga Jesus.
en: When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.

war: Nagkaabot in damo nga mga bag-o pa nga nakabig ngan nagtug-an ini hira hin dayag han ira nabuhat nga diwata.
en: Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done.

war: Tungod hini nagpadayon hin paglurab ngan pagmadinaogon an makusog nga pulong han Dyos.
en: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.

war: Sanglit ginpakadto niya ha Macedonia hira Timoteo ug Erasto nga duha han iya mga kabulig, samtang nga nagpabilin la hiya anay didto ha lalawigan han Asia.
en: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.

war: Nahinabo hadto nga panahon in dako nga kasamok ha Efeso tungod han Dalan han Ginoo.
en: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.

war: Sanglit gintirok niya hira ngatanan nga mga platero ngan ginsiring hira, “Kasangkayan, maaram man kamo nga an aton manggad natikang hini nga pakabuhi.
en: He called them together, along with the workers in related trades, and said: “You know, my friends, that we receive a good income from this business.

war: Han pakabati la han mga tawo hini nga mga pulong, napungot gud hira ngan nagtikang hin paggogliat, “Gamhanan hi Artemis han mga taga-Efeso!”
en: When they heard this, they were furious and began shouting: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

war: Karuyag unta ni Pablo nga kumadto hiya ha atubangan han mga tawo, kundi waray hiya tugoti han mga magtinuohon.
en: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.

war: Ginpatugonan liwat hiya han mga opisyal han lalawigan nga iya kasangkayan nga diri gud hiya magpakita ha entablado.
en: Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, sent him a message begging him not to venture into the theater.

war: Nagtikadako an karigumok han katirok; may hin gogliat la an mga tawo hin lainlain nga mga butang kay an kadam-an ha ira diri ngani maaram kay ano nga nagkatirok hira.
en: The assembly was in confusion: Some were shouting one thing, some another. Most of the people did not even know why they were there.

war: Kundi han pakasabot nira nga Judiyo hiya, nagdurungan hira hin paggogliat sulod hin duha ka oras: “Gamhanan hi Artemis han mga taga-Efeso!”
en: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

war: Waray makakariwa hini nga mga butang. Sanglit kinahanglan magmingaw kamo ngan ayaw kamo pagdalidali hin pagpatukso.
en: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to calm down and not do anything rash.

war: Iyo gindara nganhi ini nga mga tawo bisan kon waray hira manikas hin mga templo o magpasipara hin pagpanamastamas han aton diyosa.
en: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.

war: Kundi kon may-ada pa iba nga iyo karuyag tuhayon, pagtutuhayon ini dida han katirok han mga bungtuhanon sumala han balaod.
en: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.

war: Katapos mamulong an sekretaryo, ginpauli niya an mga tawo.
en: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.

war: Han kahuman na han kasamok, gintirok ni Pablo an mga magtinuohon, ngan upod in mga pulong hin pagpadasig, nanamilit hiya ha ira. Ngan ginmikan hiya ngan napakadto ha Macedonia.
en: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said goodbye and set out for Macedonia.

war: Ginlatas niya adto nga mga dapit ngan gindasig niya an mga magtinuohon didto. Niyan inmabot hiya ha Acaya
en: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,

war: Nag-una hira ngan naghulat ha amon didto ha Troas.
en: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.

war: Damo in mga suga ha igbaw nga kwarto han balay nga ginkakatirokan namon.
en: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.

war: Kundi linmusad hi Pablo, kinulban niya hiya, ginhangkopan, ngan nagsiring, “Ayaw kamo kabaraka, buhi pa hiya!”
en: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”

war: Ngan binmalik hiya ngadto ha igbaw, nagpinitpinit han tinapay, ngan nakigsasaro ha ira. Kahuman hin maiha nga pamulong ni Pablo ha ira, tubtob han pagpunias han adlaw, linmakat hiya.
en: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.

war: Igin-oli nira nga buhi an batan-on ngan nalipay gud hira.
en: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.

war: Nag-una kami paggikan ngan nagsakay kami ngadto ha Ason, diin aagion ngan pasasakyon namon hi Pablo. Amo ini an iya tugon ha amon kay nagbabaktas la hiya ngadto.
en: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had made this arrangement because he was going there on foot.

war: Han pagkakita na namon didto ha Ason, ginpasakay hiya namon ngan nagpadayon kami ngadto ha Mitilene.
en: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.

war: Tikang didto nagsakay kami, ngan han pagkabuwas dinmuong kami ha atbang han Quio. Han pagkasunod nga adlaw nakaabot kami ha Samos, ngan han pagkasunod pa gud nga adlaw dinmuong kami ha Mileto.
en: The next day we set sail from there and arrived off Chios. The day after that we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day arrived at Miletus.

war: Tikang ha Mileto nagpatugon hi Pablo ha mga katigurangan han singbahan ha Efeso nga makigkita hira ha iya.
en: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.

war: Han pag-abot nira, ginsiring hira ni Pablo, “Sayod kamo han akon pakig-urosa ha iyo ha bug-os nga panahon tikang han syahan nga adlaw han akon pag-abot ha lalawigan han Asia.
en: When they arrived, he said to them: “You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I came into the province of Asia.

war: Sayod man kamo nga waray ko iglirong ha iyo an bisan ano nga sadang makabulig ha iyo dida han akon pagwali ngan pagtutdo ha iyo ha gawas ngan ha sakob han iyo mga balay.
en: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.

war: Iginpahimangno ko ha mga Judiyo ngan sugad man ha mga Hentil nga kinahanglan magbasol hira han ira mga sala ngan bumalik sa Dyos, ngan tumoo hira han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.
en: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.

war: Ngan yana, ha pagsugot han sugo han Espiritu Santo, makadto ako ha Jerusalem ngan diri ako maaram kon ano an akon dadangatan.
en: “And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.

war: Maaram la ako nga nagpasidaan ha akon an Espiritu Santo nga an pagkapriso ngan mga pag-antos hin kakurian naghuhulat ha akon ha kada syudad.
en: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit warns me that prison and hardships are facing me.

war: “Nasahid ko kamo ngatanan hin paglibota hin pagwali han Ginhadian han Dyos. Ngan yana maaram ako nga waray ha iyo makakakita na ha akon.
en: “Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.

war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo hini gud nga adlaw nga kon may-ada diri matalwas ha iyo, ayaw ako niyo pagbasola.
en: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of any of you.

war: Kay waray ko igdiwara ha iyo an bug-os nga katuyoan han Dyos; waray ako gintago ha iyo.
en: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.

war: Maaram ako nga kon tumalikod na ako, maabot in mga tawo nga sugad hin magbangis nga mga mananap, nga magpapasarang han panon.
en: I know that after I leave, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.

war: Maabot an panahon nga may-ada mga tawo tikang han iyo kalugaringon nga hugpo, nga magbibinuwa basi la mahimulag an mga magtinuohon ngan magsunod ha ira.
en: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.

war: Sanglit pag-ikmat kamo ngan panumdom kamo nga sulod hin tulo ka tuig waray ako humunong hin pagtutdo ha iyo ngatanan adlaw gab-i upod in damo nga mga luha.
en: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.

war: Waray ako maipa han kanan iba salapi, bulawan, o panapton.
en: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.

war: Sayod kamo ngahaw nga pinaagi hini nga akon mga kamot nagkabudlay ako hin pagpangita han ngatanan nga ginkinahanglan ko ngan han akon mga kaupod.
en: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.

war: Han kahuman pagyakan ni Pablo, nagkaluhod hira ngan nag-ampo.
en: When Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.

war: Hira ngatanan nanangis, hinmangkop kan Pablo ngan ginhagkan hiya.
en: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.

war: Mabidoon gud hira tungod han pagsiring niya nga diri na gud hira igkikita ha iya. Sanglit gin-updan hiya nira ngadto ha sakayan hin pagpagikan ha iya.
en: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

war: Katapos namon makapanamilit ha ira, ginmikan kami. Ha amon pagsakay ginrumbo namon an Cos; han pagkabuwas inmabot kami ha Rodas, ngan tikang didto dinmuong kami ha Patara.
en: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Kos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.

war: Nakakita kami didto hin sakayan nga tipakadto ha Fenicia, sanglit sinmakay kami ngan nagpadayon.
en: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, went on board and set sail.

war: Han pag-abot namon ha dapit diin natatan-aw na an Cipre, nagpadayon kami tipatimogan hini ngadto ha Siria. Hinmaw-as kami ha Tiro diin nagdiskarga an sakayan han mga kargamento.
en: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.

war: Iginkakita kami didto hin mga magtinuohon ngan nagpabilin kami upod ha ira hin usa ka semana. Pinaagi han pag-agda han Espiritu, ginsiring nira hi Pablo nga diri hiya kumadto ha Jerusalem.
en: We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.

war: Ngan han pakapanamilit na namon ngatanan, sinmakay kami han sakayan ngan nangoli hira.
en: After saying goodbye to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.

war: Tikang ha Tiro nagpadayon an amon pagsakay ngadto ha Tolemaida diin nakigkita kami han mga magtinuohon didto ngan nagpabilin kami upod ha ira hin usa ka adlaw.
en: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed with them for a day.

war: May-ada niya upat nga mga anak nga kababayen-an nga mga manaragna.
en: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

war: Samtang nakadto kami hin mga pira na ka adlaw, inmabot tikang ha Judea in usa nga manaragna nga hi Agabo.
en: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

war: Han pakabati namon hini, kami ngan an iba nga mga tawo naghangyo kan Pablo nga diri hiya kumadto ha Jerusalem.
en: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.

war: Waray gud kami makawaring han iya panhunahuna, sanglit inmukoy na la kami ngan magsiring, “Matuman unta an kaburot-on han Ginoo.”
en: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”

war: Katapos hin pira ka adlaw didto, nag-andam kami han amon mga darad-on ngan kinmadto kami ha Jerusalem.
en: After this, we started on our way up to Jerusalem.

war: Inmupod ha amon in mga tinun-an nga taga-Cesarea ngan gindara kami ngadto han balay ni Mnason nga amon sasak-an. Taga-Cipre hi Mnason ngan usa hiya han mga una nga mga magtinuohon.
en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.

war: Han pag-abot namon ha Jerusalem, nagkarawat ha amon hin malipayon an mga magtinuohon.
en: When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us warmly.

war: Han pagkabuwas binmunyog hi Pablo ha amon pakigkita kan Santiago, ngan nakadto liwat an ngatanan nga mga katigurangan han singbahan.
en: The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James, and all the elders were present.

war: Pinangumosta hira ni Pablo ngan iginsaysay ha ira hin tukib an ngatanan nga ginbuhat han Dyos ha mga Hentil pinaagi ha iya.
en: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.

war: Mahibabaro gud hira nga hahani ka na. Sanglit ano man an angay pagbuhaton?
en: What shall we do? They will certainly hear that you have come,

war: Buhata an amon isisiring ha imo. May-ada dinhe upat ka tawo nga may-ada mga panaad.
en: so do what we tell you. There are four men with us who have made a vow.

war: Iginyakan nira ini kay hinkit-an nira hi Trofimo nga taga-Efeso nga upod ni Pablo dida ha syudad, ngan naghunahuna hira nga gindara hiya ni Pablo ngadto han Templo.)
en: (They had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with Paul and assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.)

war: Narigumok an bug-os nga syudad ngan nagdurungan pagdasmag kan Pablo an mga tawo, gindakop hiya, ngan gindanas ha gawas han Templo, ngan ginsadhan dayon an mga porta han Templo.
en: The whole city was aroused, and the people came running from all directions. Seizing Paul, they dragged him from the temple, and immediately the gates were shut.

war: Gin-iiparatay na hi Pablo han mga tawo, kundi nasumatan an kapitan han mga sondalo nga Romano nga nariribok an bug-os nga Jerusalem.
en: While they were trying to kill him, news reached the commander of the Roman troops that the whole city of Jerusalem was in an uproar.

war: Dinmaop kan Pablo an kapitan, gindakop hiya, ngan iginpagapos hiya hin duha nga kadena. Niyan nagpakiana an kapitan, “Hin-o ini nga tawo, ngan ano an iya ginbuhat?”
en: The commander came up and arrested him and ordered him to be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.

war: Inmabot hira tubtob la ha may hagdanan, kundi napirit hira hin pagpas-an ha iya kay duro na gud an kasamok han mga tawo.
en: When Paul reached the steps, the violence of the mob was so great he had to be carried by the soldiers.

war: Ginsusunod hiya han mga tawo nga naggogoliat, “Pataya hiya!”
en: The crowd that followed kept shouting, “Get rid of him!”

war: Han gindadara na nira hi Pablo ha sulod han kwartel, nagyakan hiya ngadto han kapitan, “Makahimo ba ako hin paghimangraw ha imo?” Nagpakiana an kapitan, “Maaram ka ba hin Griego?
en: As the soldiers were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, “May I say something to you?” “Do you speak Greek?” he replied.

war: Kon sugad diri ka ngay-an amo an taga-Ehipto nga ha diri pa la maiha nagtikang hin kasamok ngan nagdara ngadto han kamingawan hin upat ka yukot nga armado nga mga rebelde?”
en: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists out into the wilderness some time ago?”

war: Nagbaton hi Pablo, “Usa ako nga Judiyo nga natawo ha Tarso han Cilicia, nga tuninungnong hin dako nga syudad. Tugoti ako hin pagyakan ngadto han mga tawo.”
en: Paul answered, “I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Please let me speak to the people.”

war: “Kabugtoan ngan mga ginikanan, pamatii niyo an akon panalipod nga akon bubuhaton ha iyo atubangan!”
en: “Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense.”

war: Han pakabati nira nga nagyayakan hiya ha pinulongan nga Hebreo, labi na nga nagmingaw hira; ngan nagpadayon hi Pablo:
en: When they heard him speak to them in Aramaic, they became very quiet. Then Paul said:

war: Ginpakurian ko tubtob ha kamatayon an mga tawo nga nagsusunod hini nga Dalan. Gindakop ko in kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an ngan iginpapriso ko hira.
en: I persecuted the followers of this Way to their death, arresting both men and women and throwing them into prison,

war: “Han tikaurudto na ngan han haraniay na ako ha Damasco, kalit la nga kinmidlat in masilaw nga kapawa tikang ha langit, nga nakalukop ha akon.
en: “About noon as I came near Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.

war: Ngan natumba ako ha tuna ngan binmati ako hin usa nga tingog nga nasiring ha akon, ‘Saulo, Saulo, kay ano nga ginpapakurian mo ako?’
en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul! Saul! Why do you persecute me?’

war: ‘Hin-o ka, Ginoo?’ binmaton ako. Nagsiring hiya ha akon, ‘Hi Jesus ako nga taga-Nazaret nga ginpapakurian mo.’
en: “ ‘Who are you, Lord?’ I asked. “ ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ he replied.

war: Nakakita han kapawa an mga kaupod ko, kundi waray hira makabati han tingog nga nagyakan ha akon.
en: My companions saw the light, but they did not understand the voice of him who was speaking to me.

war: Nagpakiana ako, ‘Ano man an pagbubuhaton ko, Ginoo?’ Ngan an Ginoo nagsiring ha akon, ‘Buhat ngan pakadto ha Damasco ngan didto pagsusumatan ka han ngatanan nga igpapabuhat ha imo han Dyos.’
en: “ ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ I asked. “ ‘Get up,’ the Lord said, ‘and go into Damascus. There you will be told all that you have been assigned to do.’

war: Nabuta ako tungod han masilaw nga kapawa, sanglit gintugwayan na la ako han akon mga kaupod ngadto ha Damasco.
en: My companions led me by the hand into Damascus, because the brilliance of the light had blinded me.

war: “May-ada usa ka tawo nga ginngangaranan kan Ananias, tawo nga matinumanon han aton Balaod ngan tinahod kaupay han ngatanan nga mga Judiyo ngan nag-uukoy ini hiya didto ha Damasco.
en: “A man named Ananias came to see me. He was a devout observer of the law and highly respected by all the Jews living there.

war: Dinmaop hiya ha akon, tinmindog sapit ha akon, ngan nagsiring, ‘Bugto Saulo, makakakita ka na.’ Hito manta nga takna nakakita na liwat ako ngan tinmutok ako ha iya.
en: He stood beside me and said, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ And at that very moment I was able to see him.

war: Nagsiring hiya, ‘An Dyos han aton kaapoy-apoyan nagpili ha imo basi makasabot ka han iya kaburot-on, makakita ka han iya matadong nga Surugoon, ngan makabati ka han iya tingog.
en: “Then he said: ‘The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One and to hear words from his mouth.

war: Kay magigin saksi ka para ha iya hin pagpasangyaw ha ngatanan nga mga tawo han imo hinkit-an ngan hinbatian.
en: You will be his witness to all people of what you have seen and heard.

war: Ngan yana ano pa an imo ginhuhulat? Buhat ngan magpabunyag ka, basi mahugasan ka han imo mga sala pinaagi hin pagtawag ha iya ngaran.’
en: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized and wash your sins away, calling on his name.’

war: “Binmalik ako ha Jerusalem ngan samtang nag-aampo ako didto han Templo, nagkamay-ada ako usa nga panan-awon
en: “When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance

war: diin hinkit-an ko an Ginoo nga nagsiring ha akon, ‘Pagdali ngan bayai ha kadagmitan an Jerusalem kay diri an mga tawo dinhe makarawat han imo pagkasaksi ha akon.’
en: and saw the Lord speaking to me. ‘Quick!’ he said. ‘Leave Jerusalem immediately, because the people here will not accept your testimony about me.’

war: Binmaton ako, ‘Ginoo, nasayod ngahaw hira nga kinmadto ako ha ira mga sinagoga ngan gindakop ngan ginkastigo ko adton mga natoo ha imo.
en: “ ‘Lord,’ I replied, ‘these people know that I went from one synagogue to another to imprison and beat those who believe in you.

war: Ngan han pagpataya han imo saksi nga hi Esteban, nakadto ako ngan inmuyon ako han pagpataya ha iya, ngan ginbantayan ko an mga panapton han mga nagpatay ha iya.’
en: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and guarding the clothes of those who were killing him.’

war: Ngan nagsiring ha akon an Ginoo, ‘Lakat kay susugoon ko ikaw ha higrayo nga mga dapit, ngadto han mga Hentil.’”
en: “Then the Lord said to me, ‘Go; I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’ ”

war: Dinhe la tubtob an pamati han mga tawo kan Pablo ngan nagtikang hira hin paggogliat. Makusog an ira tingog hin pagsiring, “Kuhaa hiya! Pataya hiya! Diri hiya angay mabuhi!”
en: The crowd listened to Paul until he said this. Then they raised their voices and shouted, “Rid the earth of him! He’s not fit to live!”

war: Naggogogliat hira, iginbabarabad an ira mga panapton, ngan iginsasabrag ha igbaw an tapotapo.
en: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air,

war: Han pakabati hini han opisyal, kinmadto hiya han kapitan ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Ano ini nga karuyag mo pagbuhaton? Ito nga tawo tuminungnong nga Romano!”
en: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and reported it. “What are you going to do?” he asked. “This man is a Roman citizen.”

war: Sanglit kinmadto an kapitan kan Pablo ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Sumati ako, tuminungnong ka ba nga Romano?” “Oo,” binmaton hi Pablo.
en: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes, I am,” he answered.

war: Nagsiring an kapitan, “Pinalit ko hin damo nga kwarta an akon pagkatuminungnong nga Romano.” Binmaton hi Pablo, “Kundi natawo ako nga Romano.”
en: Then the commander said, “I had to pay a lot of money for my citizenship.” “But I was born a citizen,” Paul replied.
