en: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

war: Nalipay an Dyos han iya hinkit-an. Ngan ginlain niya han kasisidman an kapawa,
en: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.

war: ngan ginngaranan niya nga “Adlaw” an kapawa ug “Gab-i” an kasisidman. Linmabay an kagab-ihon ngan inmabot an aga—amo adto an syahan nga adlaw.
en: God called the light “day,” and the darkness he called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.

war: Ginngaranan niya nga “Langit” an panganoron. Linmabay an kagab-ihon ngan inmabot an aga—amo adto an ikaduha nga adlaw.
en: God called the vault “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.

war: Niyan nagsiring an Dyos, “An katubigan ha ubos han langit magtirok ngadto hin usa nga dapit basi pumakita an kamad-an,”—ngan natuman ini.
en: And God said, “Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear.” And it was so.

war: Ginngaranan niya nga “Tuna” an kamad-an, ngan “Dagat” an nagtirok nga katubigan. Ngan nalipay an Dyos han iya hinkit-an.
en: God called the dry ground “land,” and the gathered waters he called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.

war: Linmabay an kagab-ihon ngan inmabot an aga—amo adto an ikatulo nga adlaw.
en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.

war: masiga ini hira didto ha langit basi makahatag ha tuna hin kapawa”—ngan natuman ini.
en: and let them be lights in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth.” And it was so.

war: Iginbutang niya an mga suga didto ha langit basi makalamrag han tuna,
en: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth,

war: makapawa ha bug-os nga adlaw ug gab-i, ngan basi malain han kasisidman an kapawa. Ngan nalipay an Dyos han iya hinkit-an.
en: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.

war: Linmabay an kagab-ihon ngan inmabot an aga—amo adto an ikaupat nga adlaw.
en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.

war: Niyan nagsiring an Dyos, “Malukop hin magkalainlain nga buhi nga mga binuhat an katubigan, ngan maluob hin katamsihan an kahanginan.”
en: And God said, “Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky.”

war: Linmabay an kagab-ihon ngan inmabot an aga—amo adto an ikalima nga adlaw.
en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.

war: Sanglit gintuha han Dyos an tawo, nga ginhimo hiya nga sugad ha iya ngahaw. Nagtuha hiya hin lalake ug babaye,
en: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

war: Nakita han Dyos an ngatanan nga iya ginhimo ngan nalipay hiya hin duro. Linmabay an kagab-ihon ngan inmabot an aga—amo adto an ikaunom nga adlaw.
en: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

war: Sanglit nahuman an bug-os nga kalibutan ngan an mga butang ha kalangitan.
en: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.

war: Dida han ikapito ka adlaw, nahuman han Dyos an iya mga gintuha, ngan pinmahuway hiya.
en: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.

war: Ginbendisyonan niya an ikapito nga adlaw ngan ginlain niya ini sugad nga usa nga talagsaon nga adlaw, kay hito nga adlaw nahuman niya an iya pagtuha ngan hinmunong na hiya hin pagtuha.
en: Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.

war: Ngan amo ini an paagi han pagtuhaa han bug-os nga kalibutan ngan han ngatanan nga aada ha langit. Han paghimoa han Ginoo nga Dyos han bug-os nga kalibutan,
en: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, when the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.

war: waray pa mga tanom dida han tuna ngan waray pa naturok nga mga binhe, kay waray pa man hiya magpadara hin uran, ngan waray pa tawo nga nag-uuma han tuna.
en: Now no shrub had yet appeared on the earth and no plant had yet sprung up, for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no one to work the ground,

war: Kundi naawas in tubig tikang ha ilarom han tuna ngan amo an nagtutubig han tuna.
en: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

war: Niyan kinmuha an Ginoo nga Dyos hin tuna ngan naghimo hiya hin tawo; gininhawaan niya an irong han tawo ngan nabuhi an tawo.
en: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

war: Niyan nagbutang an Ginoo nga Dyos hin usa nga tanaman didto ha Eden, didto ha Sinirangan, ngan didto iginbutang niya an tawo nga iya ginhimo.
en: Now the Lord God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed.

war: Naawas in usa nga salog didto ha Eden ngan nagtutubig han tanaman; ha unhan han Eden nagsasanga ini ngan nahihimo nga upat nga mga salog.
en: A river watering the garden flowed from Eden; from there it was separated into four headwaters.

war: An syahan nga salog amo an Pison; naawas ini palibot han katunaan han Havila. (
en: The name of the first is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.

war: Aadto hiaagii an puraw nga bulawan ngan an talagsaon liwat nga pahamot ngan mahal nga mga bato.)
en: (The gold of that land is good; aromatic resin and onyx are also there.)

war: An ikaduha nga salog amo an Gihon; naawas ini palibot han katunaan han Cus.
en: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the entire land of Cush.

war: An ikatulo nga salog amo an Tigris nga naawas ha sinirangan han Asiria, ngan an ikaupat nga salog amo an Eufrates.
en: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Ashur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

war: Niyan iginbutang han Ginoo nga Dyos an tawo didto han Tanaman han Eden basi niya pag-umhon ngan pagbantayan.
en: The Lord God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.

war: Ginsiring hiya han Dyos, “Makakakaon ka han bunga han bisan ano nga kahoy dinhe ha tanaman,
en: And the Lord God commanded the man, “You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;

war: labot han kahoy nga nahatag hin pakasabot han maupay ngan han maraot. Kinahanglan diri ka kumaon han bunga hito nga kahoy; kon kumaon ka hito, mapatay ka hito manta nga adlaw.”
en: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die.”

war: Niyan nagsiring an Ginoo nga Dyos, “Diri maupay nga mag-usaan la an tawo. Maghihimo ako hin angay niya nga kaupod-upod nga mabulig ha iya.”
en: The Lord God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.”

war: Niyan dida han pagkaturog han tawo ginpahimuok hiya han Ginoo nga Dyos, ngan samtang hinmumuokan hiya, kinuha han Dyos in usa han mga gusok han tawo ngan ginputos ini hin unod.
en: So the Lord God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man’s ribs and then closed up the place with flesh.

war: Ginhimo niya in usa nga babaye tikang han gusok nga ginkuha niya tikang han lalake, ngan gindara niya an babaye ngadto han lalake.
en: Then the Lord God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.

war: Sanglit amo ini an hinungdan nga an lalake kinahanglan bumaya han amay ug iroy niya ngan makigtampo han iya asawa, ngan hira nga duha uusa na la.
en: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.

war: Mga hubo-lubas nga duha an lalake ngan an babaye, kundi waray hira pagkaawod.
en: Adam and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.

war: Binmaton an babaye, “Makakakaon kami han bunga hin bisan ano nga kahoy dinhe han tanaman,
en: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees in the garden,

war: labot han kahoy nga aada ha butnga han tanaman. Gindid-an kami han Dyos hin pagkaon han bunga hito nga kahoy, o bisan pagkamkam hito; kon amon ini pagbuhaton, mapatay kami.”
en: but God did say, ‘You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.’ ”

war: Binmaton an halas, “Buwa ito; diri kamo mapatay.
en: “You will not certainly die,” the serpent said to the woman.

war: Ginsiring ito han Dyos kay maaram hiya nga kon kumaon kamo han bunga, masusugad kamo han Dyos, ngan makakasabot kamo han maupay ngan han maraot.”
en: “For God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

war: Han pakakaon gudla nira hini, nahibaro hira ngan nakasabot nga mga hubo hira; sanglit naghimo hira hin tapis hin mga dahon hin igos basi katabonan an ira lawas.
en: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.

war: Kundi gintawag han Ginoo nga Dyos an lalake, “Hain ka?”
en: But the Lord God called to the man, “Where are you?”

war: Binmaton hiya, “Hinbatian ko ikaw dinhe han tanaman; nahadlok ako ngan tinmago ako ha imo, kay hubo ako.”
en: He answered, “I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid.”

war: “Hin-o an nagsumat ha imo nga hubo ka?” nagpakiana an Dyos. “Kinmaon ka ba han bunga nga igindiri ko ha imo?”
en: And he said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

war: Binmaton an lalake, “Gintagan ako han babaye nga imo iginbutang dinhe nga kaupod nakon, ngan kinmaon ako.”
en: The man said, “The woman you put here with me—she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

war: Ginpakianhan han Ginoo nga Dyos an babaye, “Kay ano nga ginbuhat mo ini?” Binmaton hiya, “Ginlimbongan ako han halas hin pagkaon hini.”
en: Then the Lord God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

war: Hihimoon ko nga magkaaway kamo—hi ikaw ngan han babaye; dayuday magkaaway an iya ngan an imo mga tulin. An iya mga tulin amo an madugmok han imo ulo, ngan pagtutukbon man nimo an iya tikod.”
en: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”

war: Maturok ha tuna in katungkan ngan kasapinitan, ngan an imo kakaonon amo an mga tanom ha kapatagan.
en: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.

war: Ginngaranan ni Adan an iya asawa nga Eva kay amo hiya an iroy han ngatanan nga mga tawo.
en: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.

war: Ngan naghimo an Ginoo nga Dyos hin mga panapton nga anit hin mananap para kan Adan ngan han iya asawa, ngan iya ginbadoan hira.
en: The Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.

war: Sanglit ginpaiwas hiya han Ginoo nga Dyos tikang han Tanaman han Eden ngan ginpapag-uma hiya han tuna nga ginhimo ha iya.
en: So the Lord God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

war: Ngan nag-anak liwat hi Eva hin lain nga lalake, hi Abel. Nahimo hi Abel nga usa nga magmarangno hin mga karnero, kundi parauma hi Cain.
en: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.

war: Usa ka adlaw nagdara hi Cain hin mga abot han iya inani ngan iya iginhalad ini ngadto han Ginoo .
en: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord .

war: kundi iginsikway niya hi Cain ngan an iya halad. Napungot hin duro hi Cain ngan nagkuriot hiya hin kasina.
en: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

war: Niyan nagsiring an Ginoo kan Cain, “Kay ano nga nasisina ka? Kay ano nga nagkukuriot ka?
en: Then the Lord said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Cain kan Abel nga iya bugto, “Tana, pakadto kita didto ha kaumhan.” Han nakadto na hira han kaumhan, dinasmagan ni Cain an iya bugto ngan ginpatay niya.
en: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let’s go out to the field.” While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

war: Pinmakiana kan Cain an Ginoo , “Hain na hi Abel nga imo bugto?” Binmaton hiya, “Ambot. Ako ba an magmarangno han akon bugto?”
en: Then the Lord said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I don’t know,” he replied. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”

war: Niyan nagsiring an Ginoo , “Kay ano nga ginbuhat mo ini nga makangingirhat nga butang? Nagoliat ngadi ha akon tikang ha tuna an dugo han imo bugto sugad hin goliat hin pagbulos.
en: The Lord said, “What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground.

war: Yana gagabaan ka ngan diri ka na makakag-uma han tuna nga hinumban han dugo han imo bugto ngan an tuna daw binmuka han iya baba basi makausop han dugo han imo bugto nga imo ginpatay.
en: Now you are under a curse and driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

war: Kon mag-uma ka, diri mahatag hin bisan ano nga abot an tuna; maglilinayawlayaw ka nga waray himangkaagan ug urokyan ha bawbaw han tuna.”
en: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its crops for you. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth.”

war: Ngan ginsiring ni Cain an Ginoo , “Makuri ko ini maantos nga kastigo.
en: Cain said to the Lord , “My punishment is more than I can bear.

war: Ngan pinmahirayo hi Cain han Ginoo ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto hin usa nga tuna nga ginngaranan nga Nod ha sinirangan han Eden.
en: So Cain went out from the Lord ’s presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

war: Nag-anak hin usa nga lalake hira Cain ngan han iya asawa, ngan ginngaranan hiya nga Enoc. Niyan nagtindog hi Cain hin syudad ngan isinangay ini han iya anak.
en: Cain made love to his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.

war: May-ada usa nga anak nga lalake hi Enoc nga ginngaranan nga Irad nga amo an amay ni Mehujael nga amay ni Matusael nga amay ni Lamec.
en: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.

war: May duha nga mga asawa hi Lamec: hira Ada ug Zila.
en: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.

war: Nag-anak hi Ada kan Jabal nga amo an ginikanan hadton mga magmarangno hin kahayopan ngan nag-uokoy dida hin mga tulda.
en: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.

war: An iya bugto amo hi Jubal nga ginikanan han ngatanan nga mga musikero nga nagtutukar han arpa ngan han plauta.
en: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and pipes.

war: Nag-anak hi Zila kan Tubal-cain nga maghirimo hin magkalainlain nga mga garamiton tikang hin bronse ug puthaw. Hi Naama amo an babaye nga bugto ni Tubal-cain.
en: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.

war: Kon pito nga kinabuhi an iginbabayad para hin pagpatay kan Cain, setentay siete nga kinabuhi an igbabayad kon pagpatayon ako.”
en: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times.”

war: May-ada usa nga anak nga lalake hi Set nga ginngaranan niya nga Enos. Amo adto an panahon nga nagtikang an mga tawo hin pagsangpit ngan pagsingba han baraan nga ngaran han Ginoo .
en: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the Lord .

war: Amo ini an lista han mga tulin ni Adan. (Han pagtuhaa han Dyos han mga tawo, iya ginhimo hira nga ladawan han Dyos.
en: This is the written account of Adam’s family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God.

war: Iya gintuha hira nga lalake ug babaye, ginbendisyonan hira, ngan ginngaranan hira nga “Tawo”.)
en: He created them male and female and blessed them. And he named them “Mankind” when they were created.

war: Han 130 na an panuigon ni Adan, nagkamay-ada hiya usa nga anak nga lalake nga supo gud ha iya, ngan iya ginngaranan nga Set.
en: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.

war: Kahuman katawo ni Set, nabuhi pa hi Adan hin 800 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 930.
en: Altogether, Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.

war: Han 105 na hi Set, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Enos,
en: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.

war: ngan nabuhi pa hi Set hin 807 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 912.
en: Altogether, Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.

war: Han 90 na hi Enos, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Kenan,
en: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.

war: ngan nabuhi pa hi Enos hin 815 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 905.
en: Altogether, Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.

war: Han 70 na hi Kenan, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Mahalalel,
en: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.

war: ngan nabuhi pa hi Kenan hin 840 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 910.
en: Altogether, Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.

war: Han 65 na hi Mahalalel, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Jared,
en: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.

war: ngan nabuhi pa hi Mahalalel hin 830 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 895.
en: Altogether, Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.

war: Han 162 na hi Jared, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Enoc,
en: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.

war: ngan nabuhi pa hi Jared hin 800 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 962.
en: Altogether, Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.

war: Han 65 na hi Enoc, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Matusalem.
en: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.

war: Kahuman katawo ni Matusalem, hi Enoc nag-ataman han Dyos sulod hin 300 ka tuig, ngan nagkamay-ada hiya iba pa nga mga anak.
en: After he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked faithfully with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Nakaabot hiya hin panuigon nga 365.
en: Altogether, Enoch lived a total of 365 years.

war: Nag-ataman hiya han Dyos ha bug-os niya nga kinabuhi ngan katapos waray na hikit-i hiya, kay ginkuha hiya han Dyos.
en: Enoch walked faithfully with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.

war: Han 187 na hi Matusalem, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Lamec,
en: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.

war: ngan nabuhi pa hi Matusalem hin 782 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 969.
en: Altogether, Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.

war: Han 182 na hi Lamec, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake,
en: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.

war: Nabuhi pa hi Lamec hin 595 ka tuig. May-ada pa hiya iba nga mga anak,
en: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 777.
en: Altogether, Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.

war: Han pag-abot ni Noe hin panuigon nga 500, nagkamay-ada hiya tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an: hira Sem, Ham, ug Jafet.
en: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.

war: Hadto nga panahon nagdamo na an mga tawo ha bug-os nga kalibutan, ngan may-ada nira mga anak nga kababayen-an.
en: When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,

war: Hinkit-an hin pira nga mga langitnon nga binuhat nga maghusay ini nga kababayen-an, sanglit pinangasawa nira an ira naruyagan.
en: the sons of God saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.

war: Niyan nagsiring an Ginoo , “Diri ako matugot nga mabuhi hin kadayonan an mga tawo kay may-ada nira kamatayon. Tikang yana diri na hira mabubuhi kapin hin 120 ka tuig.”
en: Then the Lord said, “My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal ; their days will be a hundred and twenty years.”

war: Han pakasabot han Ginoo nga uraura na hin kamagraot an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha tuna, ngan dayuday mangil-ad an ira mga panhunahuna,
en: The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time.

war: nagbasol hiya nga iya ginhimo hira ngan iginbutang hira dinhe han tuna. Dako gud an iya pagbasol,
en: The Lord regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled.

war: Kundi hi Noe nakalipay han Ginoo .
en: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord .

war: kundi magraot gud an ngatanan nga iba nga mga tawo ha atubangan han Dyos, ngan nakaluob na an ira kamaraot ha ngatanan nga dapit.
en: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight and was full of violence.

war: Kinmita an Dyos han kalibutan ngan hinsabotan niya nga maraot gud ini, kay diri na matadong an kinabuhi han ngatanan nga mga tawo.
en: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.

war: Nagsiring an Dyos kan Noe, “Karuyag ko na gud pagpuo han ngatanan nga mga tawo. Pagpupuohon ko hira, kay puno na an kalibutan han ira magraot nga mga binuhatan.
en: So God said to Noah, “I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.

war: Paghimo hin arka para ha imo ngahaw tikang hin pinili nga kahoy; himoi ini hin mga kwarto, ngan buliha ini hin alkitran ha sulod ngan ha gawas.
en: So make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in it and coat it with pitch inside and out.

war: Himoa ini nga 133 ka metros an kahilaba, 22 ka metros an kahiluag, ngan 13 ka metros an kahitaas.
en: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.

war: Magpapadara ako hin lunop dinhe han tuna basi mapuo an ngatanan nga buhi nga mga binuhat. Magkakamatay an ngatanan dinhe ha tuna,
en: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.

war: kundi maghihimo ako ha imo hin ginsabotan. Sulod ikaw ngadto han arka upod an imo asawa, an imo mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan an ira kaasaw-an.
en: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

war: Pagdara han ngatanan nga magkalainlain nga pagkaon para ha imo ngan para ha ira.”
en: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them.”

war: Ginbuhat ni Noe an ngatanan nga iginsugo han Dyos.
en: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.

war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Noe, “Sulod ngadto han arka upod an imo bug-os nga panimalay. Hinkit-an ko nga ikaw gudla dinhe ha bug-os nga kalibutan an matadong nga tawo.
en: The Lord then said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

war: Pagdara hin pito ka padis han tagsa nga mananap nga malinis para hin paghalad kundi usa la ka padis han tagsa nga mananap nga mahugaw.
en: Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,

war: Pagdara liwat hin pito ka padis han tagsa nga tamsi. Buhata ini basi mabuhi an tagsa nga mananap ug tamsi ngan diri hira mapuo dinhe han tuna.
en: and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.

war: Kahuman hin pito ka adlaw tikang yana, pauuranon ko hin waray hunong sulod hin 40 ka adlaw ug gab-i, basi mapuo an ngatanan nga buhi nga mga binuhat nga akon ginhimo.”
en: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made.”

war: Ngan gintuman ni Noe an ngatanan nga iginsugo han Dyos.
en: And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.

war: Unom ka gatos na an panuigon ni Noe han paglunopi han tuna.
en: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.

war: Sinmulod ngadto han arka hi Noe ngan an iya asawa ngan an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngan an ira kaasaw-an basi diri hira mamatay han lunop.
en: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

war: 8-9 Sinmulod ngadto han arka sumala han iginsugo han Dyos in lalaki ngan babayi han tagsa nga mananap ug tamsi, magin malinis ini o diri.
en: male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, as God had commanded Noah.

war: Paglabay hin pito ka adlaw, inmabot an lunop.
en: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.

war: ngan inmuranos ha tuna sulod hin 40 ka adlaw ug gab-i.
en: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

war: Hito ngahaw nga adlaw, sinmulod ngadto han arka hi Noe ngan an iya asawa upod an tulo nira nga mga anak, hira Sem, Ham, ug Jafet ngan an ira kaasaw-an.
en: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.

war: Inmupod kan Noe ngadto han arka in usa nga lalaki ngan usa nga babayi han tagsa nga buhi nga binuhat,
en: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.

war: sumala han iginsugo han Dyos. Ngan ginsadhan han Ginoo an porta han arka.
en: The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord shut him in.

war: Nagpadayon an lunop sulod hin kwarenta ka adlaw, ngan hinmilarom an tubig hin pagpalutaw han sakayan.
en: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.

war: Nagtikahilarom an tubig, ngan igin-anod-anod an sakayan ha bawbaw han tubig.
en: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.

war: Hinmilarom gud an tubig ngan linmapwas han labi ka higtaas nga kabukiran.
en: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.

war: Nagpadayon hin pagtubo an tubig tubtob nga inmabot ini hin mga pito ka metros an kahilarom ha bawbaw han pungkay han kabukiran.
en: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of more than fifteen cubits.

war: Nagkamatay an tagsa nga buhi nga binuhat ha tuna—an tagsa nga tamsi, tagsa nga mananap, ngan tagsa nga tawo.
en: Every living thing that moved on land perished—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.

war: Nagkamatay an ngatanan nga buhi dinhe ha tuna.
en: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.

war: Waray magtikang hin paghubas an tubig sulod hin 150 ka adlaw.
en: The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

war: Ginsadhan an mga burabod han katubigan ha kahiladman han tuna ngan an mga ganghaan han uran didto ha langit. Inmukoy an uran,
en: Now the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens had been closed, and the rain had stopped falling from the sky.

war: ngan naghinayhinay hin paghubas an tubig sulod hin 150 ka adlaw.
en: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,

war: Dida han ika 17 nga adlaw han ikapito nga bulan nahisangya an arka didto hin usa nga bukid didto han kabukiran han Ararat.
en: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

war: Nagpadayon hin paghubas an tubig, ngan dida han syahan nga adlaw han ika 10 nga bulan pinmakita an mga pungkay han kabukiran.
en: The waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.

war: Katapos hin 40 ka adlaw ginbuksan ni Noe in usa nga bintana
en: After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark

war: ngan ginpagawas in usa nga uwak. Waray ini bumalik, kundi naglinupadlupad la ini tubtob han paghubas na gud han tubig.
en: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.

war: Hito ngahaw nga takna ginpagawas ni Noe in usa nga sarapati hin pagkita kon hinmubas na an tubig,
en: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.

war: Naghulat hiya hin pito pa ka adlaw ngan ginpagawas na liwat an sarapati.
en: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.

war: Binmalik ini ha iya han pagkagab-i nga nakakabanga hin lapyo pa nga dahon hin olibo. Sanglit nakasabot hi Noe nga hinmubas na an tubig.
en: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.

war: Niyan naghulat hiya hin pito pa ka adlaw ngan ginpagawas na liwat niya an sarapati; hini nga takna, waray na ini bumalik.
en: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.

war: Dida han ika 27 nga adlaw han ikaduha nga bulan, mamara na gud an tuna.
en: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.

war: Nagsiring an Dyos kan Noe,
en: Then God said to Noah,

war: “Gawas na han arka upod an imo asawa, an imo mga anak, ngan an ira kaasaw-an.
en: “Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.

war: Sanglit ginmawas han arka hi Noe upod an iya asawa, an iya mga anak, ngan an ira kaasaw-an.
en: So Noah came out, together with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.

war: Nagkagawas han arka an ngatanan nga kamanampan ug katamsihan nga burunyog dida han tagsa nira nga panon.
en: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds—everything that moves on land—came out of the ark, one kind after another.

war: Samtang aada pa an kalibutan, magkakamay-ada panahon hin pagtanom ngan panahon hin pag-ani. Dayuday magkakamay-ada kathagkot ngan katsirak, kathuraw ngan kat-uran, kaadlawon ngan kagab-ihon.”
en: “As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease.”

war: Ginbendisyonan han Dyos hi Noe ngan an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngan ginsiring niya, “Magdamo unta an iyo mga anak, basi makaluob an iyo mga tulin han bug-os nga tuna.
en: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, “Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.

war: Yana iyo na makakaon ini nga mga mananap sugad man an mga utanon; ihinahatag ko ini ngatanan para hin pagkaon niyo.
en: Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.

war: Kinahanglan diri niyo pagkaonon an karne nga dugoan pa; igindidiri ko ini kay aada han dugo an kinabuhi.
en: “But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.

war: Ginhimo an tawo nga sugad han Dyos, sanglit pagpapatayon man han iya igkasi-tawo an bisan hin-o nga magpatay hin tawo.
en: “Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind.

war: “Kinahanglan magkamay-ada kamo damo nga mga anak, basi makaluob an iyo mga tulin han bug-os nga tuna.”
en: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it.”

war: Nagsiring an Dyos kan Noe ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an,
en: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:

war: “Ginhihimo ko yana an akon ginsaaran ha iyo ngan ha iyo mga tulin,
en: “I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you

war: ngan ha ngatanan nga buhi nga mga binuhat—ha ngatanan nga katamsihan ngan ngatanan nga kamanampan—ha ngatanan nga ginmawas tikang han arka upod ha iyo.
en: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you—every living creature on earth.

war: Sugad nga tigaman han akon dayon nga ginsaaran nga akon ginhihimo ha iyo ngan ha ngatanan nga buhi nga mga binuhat,
en: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:

war: ibinubutang ko an akon balangaw didto han mga dampog. Magigin tigaman ini han akon ginsaaran nga akon ginhimo han kalibutan.
en: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

war: Ha kada pagtitirok hin mga dampog ha langit, ngan nagpapakita an balangaw,
en: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,

war: Amo ito an tigaman han saad nga akon ginhihimo ngadto han ngatanan nga buhi nga mga binuhat.”
en: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth.”

war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Noe nga nagkagawas han arka amo hira Sem, Ham, ug Jafet. (Amo hi Ham an amay ni Canaan.)
en: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)

war: Ini nga tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Noe amo an ginikanan han ngatanan nga mga tawo ha tuna.
en: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the whole earth.

war: Hi Noe nga usa nga parauma, amo an syahan nga tawo nga nag-uma hin urubasan.
en: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.

war: Katapos niya pag-inom han bino, nahubog hiya, naglubas han iya panapton, ngan hinmigda nga hubo didto han iya tulda.
en: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.

war: Han pakakita ni Ham nga amay ni Canaan, nga hubo an iya amay, ginmawas hiya ngan ginsumatan niya an iya duha nga kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an.
en: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked and told his two brothers outside.

war: Han kahawhawi na kan Noe ngan han paghibaro niya han ginbuhat ha iya han iya puto nga lalake,
en: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,

war: nagsiring hiya, “Higabaan unta hi Canaan! Maooripon hiya han iya kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an.
en: he said, “Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers.”

war: Pagdayawon an Ginoo nga Dyos ni Sem! Magigin oripon ni Sem hi Canaan.
en: He also said, “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.

war: Pagpadamoon unta han Dyos hi Jafet! Mag-ukoy unta an iya mga tulin upod han mga tawo ni Sem! Magigin oripon ni Jafet hi Canaan.”
en: May God extend Japheth’s territory; may Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be the slave of Japheth.”

war: Katapos han lunop, nabuhi pa hi Noe hin 350 ka tuig,
en: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.

war: ngan namatay hiya ha panuigon nga 950.
en: Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin han mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Noe, nga hira Sem, Ham, ug Jafet. Katapos han lunop nagkamay-ada mga anak nga kalalaken-an ini nga tulo nga mga anak.
en: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.

war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Jafet: hira Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Mesec, ug Tiras, amo an ginikanan han mga tawo nga nagdadara han ira mga ngaran.
en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.

war: An mga anak ni Gomer amo hira Askenaz, Rifat, ug Togarma.
en: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

war: An mga anak ni Javan amo hira Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim, ug Dodanim;
en: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.

war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Ham: hira Cus, Ehipto, Libya, ug Canaan—amo an mga ginikanan han mga tawo nga nagdadara han ira mga ngaran.
en: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.

war: An mga anak ni Cus amo hira Saba, Habila, Sabata, Raama, ug Sabteca. An mga anak ni Raama amo hira Saba ug Dedan.
en: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

war: May-ada hi Cus anak nga lalake nga ginngaranan nga Nimrod nga nagin syahan nga gamhanan han kalibutan.
en: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth.

war: Tungod han bulig han Ginoo usa hiya nga dako nga parapanganop, ngan sanglit nasiring an mga tawo, “Himoon ka unta han Ginoo nga sugad kan Nimrod nga maupay nga parapanganop.”
en: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord ; that is why it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord .”

war: Ha tinikangan sakop niya an ginhadian han Babilon, Erec, ug Accad; sakop ini nga tulo han Babilonia.
en: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Uruk, Akkad and Kalneh, in Shinar.

war: Tikang didto hito nga tuna kinmadto hi Nimrod ha Asiria ngan gintindog an mga syudad han Ninive, Rehobot-ir, Cala,
en: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah

war: ug Resen nga nabubutnga han Ninive ngan han dako nga syudad han Cala.
en: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah—which is the great city.

war: An mga tulin ni Ehipto amo an mga tawo han Lydia, Anam, Lehab, Naftu,
en: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

war: Patrus, Caslu, ngan han Creta, diin tinmikang an mga Filisteohanon.
en: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Canaan: hira Sidon, nga suhag, ug Het, amo an mga ginikanan han mga tawo nga nagdadara han ira mga ngaran.
en: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

war: Ginikanan liwat hi Canaan han mga Jebuseohanon, mga Amoreohanon, mga Girgaseohanon,
en: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

war: mga Hibeohanon, mga Arkeohanon, mga Sineohanon,
en: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

war: mga Arbadeohanon, mga Semareohanon, ngan mga Hamateohanon. Nagsarang an magkalainlain nga mga tribo han mga Canaanhon,
en: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Ham, nga nag-ukoy didto han magkalainlain nira nga mga tribo ngan mga nasod nga nagyayakan an tagsa nga hugpo han kalugaringon niya nga pinulongan.
en: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

war: Hi Sem nga magurang nga bugto nga lalake ni Jafet amo an ginikanan han ngatanan nga mga Hebreohanon.
en: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.

war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Sem: hira Elam, Asur, Arfacsad, Lud, ug Aram, amo an mga ginikanan han mga tawo nga nagdadara han ira mga ngaran.
en: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.

war: An mga tulin ni Aram amo an mga tawo han Hus, Hul, Geter, ug Mosec.
en: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.

war: Hi Arfacsad amo an amay ni Sela nga amay ni Eber.
en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.

war: May-ada duha nga mga anak nga lalake ni Eber: ginngaranan an usa nga Peleg, kay nagkabahinbahin an mga tawo han kalibutan sulod han iya panahon; ngan ginngaranan an ikaduha nga Joctan.
en: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

war: An mga tulin ni Joctan amo an mga tawo han Almodad, Selef, Asarmot, Jera,
en: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

war: Adoram, Usal, Dicla,
en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

war: Hebal, Abimael, Saba,
en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

war: Ofir, Habila, ug Jobab. Tinmikang kan Joctan hira ngatanan.
en: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

war: An tuna nga ira gin-ukyan inmabot tikang ha Mesa ngadto ha Sefar didto han sinirangan nga sagkahon nga katunaan.
en: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Sem, nga nag-uokoy didto han magkalainlain nira nga mga tribo ngan mga nasod nga nagyayakan an tagsa nga hugpo han kalugaringon niya nga pinulongan.
en: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

war: Ha syahan may-ada usa la nga pinulongan an mga tawo ha bug-os nga kalibutan ngan waray kalainan an mga pulong nga ira ginagamit.
en: Now the whole world had one language and a common speech.

war: Samtang nagtitipakadto hira ha sinirangan, nahingadto hira ha kapatagan didto ha Babilonia ngan didto hira pag-ukoy.
en: As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.

war: Niyan linmusad an Ginoo hin pagkita han syudad ngan han lantawan nga gintindog hito nga mga tawo,
en: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.

war: Lusad kita ngan guponga ta an ira pinulongan basi diri hira magkasarabot.”
en: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other.”

war: Sanglit ginpasarang han Ginoo hira ngatanan ha bug-os nga tuna ngan ginpaukoy nira an pagtindog han syudad.
en: So the Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

war: Gintawag nga Babilon an syudad, kay didto gingupong han Ginoo an pinulongan han ngatanan nga mga tawo, ngan ginpasarang hira ha bug-os nga tuna.
en: That is why it was called Babel —because there the Lord confused the language of the whole world. From there the Lord scattered them over the face of the whole earth.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Sem. Duha ka tuig katapos han lunop, han 100 na an panuigon ni Sem, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Arfacsad.
en: This is the account of Shem’s family line. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.

war: Katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 500 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 35 na an panuigon ni Arfacsad, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Sela;
en: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 403 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 30 na an panuigon ni Sela, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Eber;
en: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 403 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 34 na an panuigon ni Eber, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Peleg;
en: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 430 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 30 na an panuigon ni Peleg, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Reu;
en: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 209 ka tuig, ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 32 na an panuigon ni Reu, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Serug;
en: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 207 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 30 na an panuigon ni Serug, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Nahor;
en: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 200 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 29 na an panuigon ni Nahor, nagkamay-ada hiya anak nga lalake nga hi Tera;
en: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.

war: katapos hito nabuhi pa hiya hin 119 ka tuig ngan nagkamay-ada iba nga mga anak.
en: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.

war: Han 70 na an panuigon ni Tera, nagin amay hiya nira Abram, Nahor, ug Haran.
en: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Tera nga amay nira Abram, Nahor, ug Haran. Hi Haran amo an amay ni Lot,
en: This is the account of Terah’s family line. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.

war: ngan namatay hi Haran didto han iya natawhan nga bungto han Ur didto ha Babilonia samtang buhi pa an amay niya.
en: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.

war: Nangasawa hi Abram kan Sarai, ngan nangasawa hi Nahor kan Milca nga babaye nga anak ni Haran nga amay liwat ni Isca.
en: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milkah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milkah and Iskah.

war: Waray mag-anak hi Sarai.
en: Now Sarai was childless because she was not able to conceive.

war: Didto namatay hi Tera ha panuigon nga 205.
en: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Harran.

war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Abram, “Bayai an imo nasod, an imo kaurupdan, ngan an panimalay han imo amay, ngan pakadto hin usa nga tuna nga igtututdo ko ha imo.
en: The Lord had said to Abram, “Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land I will show you.

war: Pagpapakaupayon ko adton mga magpapakaupay ha imo, Kundi pagtutunglohon ko adton mga magpapanhimaraot ha imo. Ngan pinaagi ha imo pagpapakaupayon ko an ngatanan nga mga nasod.”
en: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you.”

war: Han 75 na an panuigon ni Abram, ginmikan hiya tikang ha Haran, sumala han iginsiring ha iya han Ginoo ngan inmupod ha iya hi Lot.
en: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Harran.

war: ginlatas ni Abram an tuna tubtob nga inmabot hiya ngadto han baraan nga kahoy han More, an baraan nga dapit didto ha Siquem. (Hito nga panahon nag-uokoy pa didto han tuna an mga Canaanhon.)
en: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.

war: Niyan nagpadayon hiya tikang ha usa ngadto han sunod nga dapit, tipakadto han timogan nga bahin han Canaan.
en: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.

war: Kundi nagkamay-ada gutom didto ha Canaan, ngan nagrabe gud ini, sanglit nagtipatimogan pa hi Abram ngadto ha Ehipto, hin pag-ukoy didto hin madaliay.
en: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.

war: Han naitarabok na hiya han pag-ultan ngadto ha Ehipto, nagsiring hiya kan Sarai nga iya asawa, “Mahusay ka nga babaye.
en: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “I know what a beautiful woman you are.

war: Kon hikit-an ka han mga Ehiptohanon, maghuhunahuna gud hira nga akon ka asawa, sanglit papatayon ako nira ngan tutugotan ka nga mabuhi.
en: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.

war: Sumati hira nga bugto ko ikaw; ngan tungod ha imo, diri ako nira paglalabtan ngan uupayon an ira pagdara ha akon.”
en: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you.”

war: Han pagtabok na niya han pag-ultan ngadto ha Ehipto, hinkit-an manggud han mga Ehiptohanon an iya asawa.
en: When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.

war: Hinkit-an hi Sarai hin pira han mga opisyal han palasyo, ngan ginsumatan an hadi han pagkamahusay ni Sarai. Sanglit gindara hi Sarai ngadto han palasyo han hadi.
en: And when Pharaoh’s officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.

war: Tungod ha iya, gin-ataman hin maupay han hadi hi Abram ngan gintagan hiya hin mga panon hin mga karnero, mga kanding, mga baka, mga asno, mga oripon, ngan mga kamelyo.
en: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.

war: Kundi tungod nga ginkuha man han hadi hi Sarai, ginpadad-an han Ginoo hin makaharadlok nga sakit an hadi ngan an mga tawo han iya palasyo.
en: But the Lord inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram’s wife Sarai.

war: Niyan ginpasugoan han hadi hi Abram ngan ginpakianhan hiya, “Ano ini nga imo ginbuhat ha akon? Kay ano nga waray mo ako pagsumati nga asawa mo hiya?
en: So Pharaoh summoned Abram. “What have you done to me?” he said. “Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?

war: Kay ano hin pagsiring mo nga bugto mo la hiya, ngan tinmugot ka nga kuhaon ko hiya sugad nga akon asawa? Iini an imo asawa; dad-a hiya ngan iwas kamo dinhe!”
en: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”

war: Nagsugo an hadi han iya mga tawo, sanglit ginkuha nira hi Abram ngan ginpagawas hiya han nasod upod an iya asawa ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi.
en: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.

war: Tikang ha Ehipto, nagtipaamihanan hi Abram, ngadto han timogan nga bahin han Canaan, upod an iya asawa ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi, ngan inmupod ha iya hi Lot.
en: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.

war: Riko hin duro hi Abram hin mga karnero, mga kanding, ngan mga baka, sugad man hin salapi ug bulawan.
en: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.

war: ngan gintindogan niya hin usa nga altar. Didto nagsingba hiya han Ginoo .
en: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the Lord .

war: May-ada liwat hi Lot mga karnero, mga kanding, ngan mga baka, ngan may-ada liwat niya kalugaringon nga panimalay ngan mga surugoon.
en: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.

war: Sanglit diri na igo an tuna nga panabsaban para ha ira nga duha kay damo hin duro an ira kamanampan.
en: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Abram kan Lot, “Mag-uropod la kita ngan diri angay mag-aruaraway an imo mga tawo kontra han akon mga tawo.
en: So Abram said to Lot, “Let’s not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.

war: Sanglit pagbulag kita. Pagpili han tuna nga imo naruruyagan. Pakadto ikaw hin usa nga dapit, ngan mapakadto ako hin lain nga dapit.”
en: Is not the whole land before you? Let’s part company. If you go to the left, I’ll go to the right; if you go to the right, I’ll go to the left.”

war: Sanglit ginpili ni Lot para ha iya ngahaw an bug-os nga Kahamub-an han Jordan ngan binmalhin hiya tipakadto ha sinirangan. Amo ito an paagi han ira pagkabulag.
en: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out toward the east. The two men parted company:

war: Nagpabilin hi Abram didto ha tuna han Canaan, ngan nag-ukoy hi Lot didto han mga syudad ha kahamub-an ngan nagkampo hiya ha hirani han Sodoma,
en: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.

war: kanay mga tawo magraot ngan dagko nga mga magpakasasala kontra han Ginoo .
en: Now the people of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the Lord .

war: Ighahatag ko ha imo ngan han imo mga tulin an ngatanan nga tuna nga matatan-aw han imo mga mata, ngan pagtatag-iyahon ini niyo ha kadayonan.
en: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.

war: Tatagan ko ikaw hin damo hin duro nga mga tulin nga waray tawo nga makakaihap ha ira ngatanan; masusugad ini hin pag-ihap han tagsa nga tapotapo han tuna.
en: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.

war: Yana, kadto na ngan tan-awa an bug-os nga tuna, kay ighahatag ko ini ngatanan ha imo.”
en: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you.”

war: Sanglit ginbalhin ni Abram an iya kampo ngan nag-ukoy hiya ha hirani han baraan nga kakahoyan han Mamre didto ha Hebron, ngan didto nagtindog hiya hin usa nga altar ngadto han Ginoo .
en: So Abram went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he pitched his tents. There he built an altar to the Lord .

war: Nagkasarabot ini nga lima nga kahadian ngan gin-urosa nira an ira kasondalohan didto ha Kahamub-an han Sidim nga amo na yana an Dagat nga Patay.
en: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Dead Sea Valley).

war: Gin-oripon hira ni Cedorlaomer sulod hin 12 ka tuig, kundi sinmupil hira ha iya dida han ika-13 nga tuig.
en: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

war: ngan an mga Horitanhon didto han kabukiran han Edom. Ira ginlanat hira tubtob ha Elparan, didto ha sidsid han kamingawan.
en: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.

war: Niyan gin-andam han kahadian han Sodoma, Gomora, Adma, Seboiim, ug Bela an ira mga kasondalohan para hin away didto ha Kahamub-an han Sidim ngan nakig-away hira
en: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboyim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim

war: kontra han kahadian han Elam, Goiim, Babilonia, ug Elasar, upat nga kahadian kontra hin lima.
en: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goyim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.

war: Ginkuha han upat nga kahadian an ngatanan nga mga butang didto ha Sodoma ug Gomora, lakip an pagkaon, ngan nagkalakat hira.
en: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.

war: Didto ha Sodoma pag-ukoy hi Lot nga umangkon ni Abram, sanglit gindara hiya nira upod an ngatanan niya nga mga manggad.
en: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.

war: Gin-upat niya ka hugpo an iya mga tawo, ginsulong ha gab-i an kaaway ngan ira ginpirde hira. Iya ginlanat an mga kaaway tubtob ha Hoba nga amihanan han Damasco,
en: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

war: ngan ginbawi niya an ngatanan nga tinikas. Nabawi liwat niya an iya umangkon nga lalake nga hi Lot ngan an iya mga manggad, upod an kababayen-an ngan an iba pa nga mga bihag.
en: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.

war: Ngan nagdara hin tinapay ngan hin bino ngadto kan Abram hi Melquisedec nga amo an hadi han Salem ngan usa liwat nga padi han Gihahataasi nga Dyos.
en: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,

war: Ginbendisyonan ni Melquisedec hi Abram ngan nagsiring, “Bendisyonan unta hi Abram han Gihahataasi nga Dyos nga naghimo han langit ug tuna!
en: and he blessed Abram, saying, “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

war: Nagsiring kan Abram an hadi han Sodoma, “Imo na an mga naagaw, kundi ibalik ha akon an ngatanan ko nga mga tawo.”
en: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself.”

war: Binmaton hi Abram, “Nagsusumpa ako ha atubangan han Ginoo nga Gihahataasi nga Dyos, nga Maghirimo han langit ug tuna,
en: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, “With raised hand I have sworn an oath to the Lord , God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

war: nga diri ako magtitipig hin bisan ano nga imo, diri bisan inulang o sintas hin sapatos. Niyan diri ka gud makakasiring, ‘Ako an nagpariko kan Abram’.
en: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the strap of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, ‘I made Abram rich.’

war: Diri ako makuha hin bisan ano para ha akon ngahaw. Kakarawton ko la an ginggamit han akon mga tawo. Kundi pakuhaa han ira bahin an akon mga kadapig nga hira Aner, Escol, ug Mamre.”
en: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me—to Aner, Eshkol and Mamre. Let them have their share.”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Abram, “O Ginoo nga Dyos , ano man nga kaupayan an akon makukuha han imo balos, kay waray ko man mga anak? Amo la hi Eliezer nga taga-Damasco an akon manurunod.
en: But Abram said, “Sovereign Lord , what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

war: Waray mo ako tagi hin mga anak, ngan usa han akon mga oripon an manununod han akon hiagi.”
en: And Abram said, “You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir.”

war: Niyan hinbatian na liwat niya an Ginoo , “Diri manununod han imo mga hiagi ini hi Eliezer nga oripon; an imo kalugaringon nga anak nga lalake amo an imo magigin manurunod.”
en: Then the word of the Lord came to him: “This man will not be your heir, but a son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir.”

war: Gindara hiya han Ginoo ngadto ha gawas ngan ginsiring, “Tan-awa daw an langit ngan ihapa an mga bitoon; magkakamay-ada ka sugad hito ka damo nga mga tulin.”
en: He took him outside and said, “Look up at the sky and count the stars—if indeed you can count them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your offspring be.”

war: Tinmapod hi Abram han Ginoo ngan tungod hini nalipay ha iya an Ginoo ngan ginkarawat hiya.
en: Abram believed the Lord , and he credited it to him as righteousness.

war: Niyan nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Amo ako an Ginoo nga nagdara ha imo tikang ha Ur didto ha Babilonia, ngan ihahatag ko ha imo ini nga tuna sugad nga imo na kalugaringon.”
en: He also said to him, “I am the Lord , who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it.”

war: Kundi pinmakiana hi Abram, “Ginoo nga Dyos, uunanhon ko hin paghibaro nga ako an magtatag-iya hini?”
en: But Abram said, “Sovereign Lord , how can I know that I will gain possession of it?”

war: Gindara ni Abram an mga mananap ngadto ha Dyos, ginpamikas ini, ngan ginturutugbang an mga pinikas ha duha ka rumbay; kundi waray niya pagpikasa an mga tamsi.
en: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.

war: Kon nahugdon an mga manaol ngada han mga patay nga lawas, gintatabog ini ni Abram.
en: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.

war: Han tikaturunod na an adlaw, nangaturog ngan nahimuok hi Abram. Inalpan hiya hin dako nga kahadlok nga nalisang hiya.
en: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.

war: Kundi pagkakastigohon ko an nasod nga mag-ooripon ha ira, ngan kon bumaya na hira hito nga nag-oripon ha ira nga tuna, magdadara hira hin damo nga mga manggad.
en: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.

war: Ha imo nga bahin malalagas ka hin duro, mapatay ka nga murayaw, ngan iglulubong ka.
en: You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace and be buried at a good old age.

war: lakip an katunaan han mga Kinitanhon, mga Kinizitanhon, mga Kadmonitanhon,
en: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,

war: mga Hiteohanon, mga Periseohanon, mga Refaim,
en: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,

war: mga Amoreohanon, mga Canaanhon, mga Girgaseohanon, ngan han mga Jebuseohanon.”
en: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites.”

war: Waray mag-anak hi Sarai nga asawa ni Abram. Kundi may-ada hi Sarai usa nga Ehiptohanon nga oripon nga babaye nga ginngaranan nga Agar,
en: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian slave named Hagar;

war: Nakighilawas hi Abram kan Agar ngan nagburod hiya. Han pakasabot niya nga burod na hiya, nagmapinahitas-on hiya ngan gintamay niya hi Sarai.
en: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.

war: Gintapo hi Agar han anghel han Ginoo didto hin usa nga burabod ha kamingawan dida han dalan tipakadto ha Sur,
en: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.

war: ngan ginsiring hiya, “Agar nga oripon ni Sarai, tikang ka diin ngan tipakain ka?” Binmaton hiya, “Napalagiw ako tikang han akon agaron nga babaye.”
en: And he said, “Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?” “I’m running away from my mistress Sarai,” she answered.

war: Nagsiring an anghel, “Balik ngadto ha iya ngan paoripon ha iya.”
en: Then the angel of the Lord told her, “Go back to your mistress and submit to her.”

war: Niyan nagsiring pa hiya, “Tatagan ko ikaw hin damo hin duro nga mga tulin nga waray tawo nga makakaihap ha ira.
en: The angel added, “I will increase your descendants so much that they will be too numerous to count.”

war: Kundi masusugad hin ihalas nga asno an imo anak; makontra hiya han tagsatagsa ngan kokontrahon man hiya han tagsatagsa. Mag-uokoy hiya nga hirayo han ngatanan niya nga kauropdan.”
en: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”

war: Sanglit ginngaranan han mga tawo an atabay ha butnga han Cades ngan han Bered nga “An Atabay han Buhi nga Nakita ha Akon.”
en: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi ; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.

war: Nag-anak hi Agar hin usa nga lalaki ngan ginngaranan hiya ni Abram nga Ismael.
en: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.

war: An panuigon ni Abram hito nga panahon 86 na.
en: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.

war: Maghihimo ako ha imo hin ginsaaran ngan tatagan ko ikaw hin damo nga mga tulin.”
en: Then I will make my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers.”

war: Hinmapa hi Abram, ngan nagsiring an Dyos,
en: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,

war: “Amo ini an ginsaaran nga akon hihimoon ha imo: nagsasaad ako nga mahihimo ka nga ginikanan hin damo nga mga nasod.
en: “As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.

war: Diri na Abram an imo ngaran, kundi Abraham na, kay hihimoon ko ikaw nga ginikanan hin damo nga mga nasod.
en: No longer will you be called Abram ; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

war: Tatagan ko ikaw hin damo nga mga tulin, ngan magigin hadi in pira ha ira. Magkakamay-ada ka damo hin duro nga mga tulin nga mahihimo hira nga mga nasod.
en: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.

war: Nagsiring an Dyos kan Abraham, “Kinahanglan umabuyon ka liwat hin pagtuman han aton ginsaaran, ikaw ngan an imo mga tulin ha tidaraon nga mga katulinan.
en: Then God said to Abraham, “As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.

war: Kinahanglan umabuyon ka ngan an imo mga tulin hin pagtori han tagsa nga lalake dida ha iyo.
en: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.

war: Kinahanglan pagtorion an kada usa, ngan mahihimo ini nga lawasnon nga tigaman hin pagpakita nga waray kataposan an aton ginsaaran.
en: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.

war: Diri na pag-iisipon nga sakop han akon mga tawo an bisan hin-o nga lalake nga diri pagtorion, kay waray hiya magtuman han aton ginsaaran.”
en: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”

war: Nagsiring an Dyos kan Abraham, “Ayaw na pagtawgon nga Sarai an imo asawa; tikang yana Sara na an iya ngaran.
en: God also said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.

war: Ginpakianhan niya an Dyos, “Kay ano nga diri na la hi Ismael an himoon nga sumurunod ha akon?”
en: And Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!”

war: Kundi pagtutumanon ko an akon ginsaaran dida kan Isaac nga imo anak nga lalake, nga ig-aanak ni Sara ha sugad hini nga panahon han sunod nga tuig.”
en: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year.”

war: Han kahuman paghimangraw han Dyos kan Abraham, iya binayaan hiya.
en: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.

war: An panuigon ni Abraham 99 na han pagtoria ha iya,
en: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,

war: ngan 13 na an panuigon ni Ismael nga iya anak.
en: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;

war: Gintori hira nga duha hito manta nga adlaw,
en: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that very day.

war: upod an ngatanan nga mga oripon ni Abraham.
en: And every male in Abraham’s household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.

war: Pinmakita an Ginoo kan Abraham didto han baraan nga kakahoyan han Mamre. Han nalingkod hi Abraham dida han porta han iya tulda ha takna nga naudtohan an adlaw,
en: The Lord appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.

war: ngan nagsiring, “Mga mano, ayaw gad kamo pagpadayon han iyo paglakat, kundi hapit kamo anay madaliay; andam ako hin pagsirbe ha iyo.
en: He said, “If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.

war: Tugoti ako hin pagkuha hin tubig para hin panhimsaw niyo; makakapahuway kamo dinhe ha lindong hini nga kahoy.
en: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.

war: Nagdagmit hi Abraham ngadto han tulda ngan nagsiring kan Sara, “Dali kuha han gimamaupayi mo nga harina ngan paghimo hin tinapay.”
en: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. “Quick,” he said, “get three seahs of the finest flour and knead it and bake some bread.”

war: Niyan dinmalagan hiya ngadto han turil ngan ginpili in usa nga nati nga baka nga bata pa ngan matambok, ngan iginhatag ini ngadto hin usa nga surugoon nga nagdagmit hin pag-andam hini.
en: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.

war: Kinmuha hi Abraham hin kisiyo, gatas, ngan han karne, ngan igindurot ini pagkaon ngadto han mga tawo. Didto ha sirong han kahoy, hiya gud an nagsirbe ha ira, ngan nangaon hira.
en: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.

war: Niyan pinmakiana kan Abraham an mga tawo, “Hain man hi Sara nga imo asawa?” “Aadto hiya ha sakob han tulda,” binmaton hiya.
en: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked him. “There, in the tent,” he said.

war: Lagas na hin duro hira Abraham ug Sara, ngan hinmunong na an ikinabulan nga regla ni Sara.
en: Abraham and Sarah were already very old, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.

war: Sanglit nahipatawa hi Sara ha iya la ngahaw ngan nagsiring, “Yana nga lagas ngan laos na ako, maruruyag pa ba ako hin pakighilawas? Ngan labot pa, lagas na liwat hin duro an akon bana.”
en: So Sarah laughed to herself as she thought, “After I am worn out and my lord is old, will I now have this pleasure?”

war: Niyan nagpakiana kan Abraham an Ginoo , “Kay ano nga nahipatawa ngan nagsiring man hi Sara, ‘Mag-aanak pa ba ako nga lagas na man ako hin duro?’
en: Then the Lord said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child, now that I am old?’

war: May-ada ba butang nga diri mahihimo han Ginoo ? Sumala han akon iginsiring, siyam ka bulan tikang yana mabalik ako ngan mag-aanak hi Sara hin lalake.”
en: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son.”

war: Iginlirong ini ni Sara kay nahadlok hiya. Nagsiring hiya, “Waray ako tumawa.” Binmaton an Ginoo , “Ayaw na la paglirong, matuod nga tinmawa ka.”
en: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, “I did not laugh.” But he said, “Yes, you did laugh.”

war: Niyan nagkalakat an mga tawo ngan kinmadto hira hin usa nga dapit nga hintatamdan nira an Sodoma, ngan binmunyog ha ira hi Abraham hin pagpagikan ha ira.
en: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.

war: Ngan nagsiring ha iya la ngahaw an Ginoo , “Diri ko pagtatagoon kan Abraham an akon nahuhunahunaan hin pagbuhat.
en: Then the Lord said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?

war: Mahihimo nga dako ngan gamhanan nga nasod an iya mga tulin, ngan pinaagi ha iya pagbebendisyonan ko an ngatanan nga mga nasod.
en: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.

war: Niyan nagsiring an Ginoo kan Abraham, “May-ada magpakaharadlok nga mga sumbong kontra han Sodoma ug Gomora, ngan dako na hin duro an ira sala.
en: Then the Lord said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous

war: Kinahanglan lumusad ako hin pag-usisa kon matuod ba o diri an mga sumbong nga akon hinbatian.”
en: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know.”

war: Niyan nagkalakat an duha ka tawo ngan nagtipakadto ha Sodoma, kundi pinmabilin an Ginoo upod kan Abraham.
en: The men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the Lord .

war: Gindaop ni Abraham an Ginoo ngan ginpakianhan, “Tinuod ba nga pagpupuohon mo an mga waray sala upod han mga salaan?
en: Then Abraham approached him and said: “Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

war: Kon may-ada 50 nga magtadong nga mga tawo didto han syudad, pagpupuohon ba nimo an bug-os nga syudad? Diri mo ba pasasayloon an syudad basi matalwas an 50?
en: What if there are fifty righteous people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people in it?

war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “Kon hiagian ko didto ha Sodoma in 50 nga magtadong nga mga tawo, pasasayloon ko an bug-os nga syudad tungod ha ira.”
en: The Lord said, “If I find fifty righteous people in the city of Sodom, I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

war: Nagyakan liwat hi Abraham, “Pasayloa intawon, O Ginoo , an akon pagpangahas hin pagpadayon hin pakighimangraw ha imo. Tawo man la ako, ngan waray ko gud katungod hin pagyakan hin bisan ano.
en: Then Abraham spoke up again: “Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, though I am nothing but dust and ashes,

war: Nagyakan na liwat hi Abraham, “Bangin may-ada la 40.” Binmaton hiya, “Diri ko pagbubungkagon an syudad kon may-ada 40.”
en: Once again he spoke to him, “What if only forty are found there?” He said, “For the sake of forty, I will not do it.”

war: Katapos niya makighimangraw kan Abraham, linmakat an Ginoo , ngan inmoli hi Abraham.
en: When the Lord had finished speaking with Abraham, he left, and Abraham returned home.

war: Han waray pa mangangaturog an mga bisita, ginpalibotan han mga kalalaken-an han Sodoma an balay. Nakadto an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an han syudad, mga batan-on ngan mga tigurang.
en: Before they had gone to bed, all the men from every part of the city of Sodom—both young and old—surrounded the house.

war: Ginmawas hi Lot ngan ginsadhan an porta ha luyo niya.
en: Lot went outside to meet them and shut the door behind him

war: Iya ginsiring hira, “Kasangkayan, nakikimalooy ako ha iyo, ayaw gad pagbuhata niyo in sugad kamaraot nga butang!
en: and said, “No, my friends. Don’t do this wicked thing.

war: Kundi ginkaptan han duha nga tawo hi Lot, ngan ginbutong hiya ngadto ha sakob, ngan ginsadhan an porta.
en: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.

war: Niyan ginbuta an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an didto ha gawas, sanglit waray na hira makakatultol han porta.
en: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.

war: kay pagbubungkagon namon ini nga dapit. Hinbatian han Ginoo an magpakalilisang nga mga sumbong kontra hini nga mga tawo ngan ginsugo kami hin pagbungkag han Sodoma.”
en: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the Lord against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it.”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Lot, “Kon mahimo, diri gad kami makadto hito nga dapit.
en: But Lot said to them, “No, my lords, please!

war: Nakita ka ba ito nga gutiay nga bungto? Hirani la ito. Tugoti ako hin pagkadto—nakita ka man nga gutiay la ito nga dapit—ngan magagawas ako han kataragman.”
en: Look, here is a town near enough to run to, and it is small. Let me flee to it—it is very small, isn’t it? Then my life will be spared.”

war: Binmaton hiya, “Sigi, kadto na. Diri ko pagbubungkagon ito nga bungto.
en: He said to him, “Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.

war: Dali! Dalagan! Waray ko mahihimo hin pagbungkag tubtob han imo pag-abot didto.” Tungod nga gintawag ini ni Lot nga gutiay, ginngaranan an bungto nga Zoar.
en: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it.” (That is why the town was called Zoar. )

war: Nasirang na an adlaw han pag-abot ni Lot ngadto ha Zoar.
en: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.

war: Ha gilayon ginpauranan han Ginoo an mga syudad han Sodoma ug Gomora hin nagkakalayo nga asufre,
en: Then the Lord rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the Lord out of the heavens.

war: ngan ginbungkag ini ngan an bug-os nga kahamub-an, upod an ngatanan nga mga tawo didto, ngan an ngatanan nga naturok dida han tuna.
en: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, destroying all those living in the cities—and also the vegetation in the land.

war: Kundi linmingi an asawa ni Lot ngan nahimo hiya nga harigi nga asin.
en: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

war: Timprano pa han pagkaaga nagdagmit hi Abraham ngadto han dapit nga iya gintukdawan ha atubangan han Ginoo .
en: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the Lord .

war: Ginlantaw niya an Sodoma ug Gomora ngan an bug-os nga kahamub-an, ngan hinkit-an niya in aso nga nag-usbok tikang han tuna, nga sugad hin aso nga tikang hin usa nga dako hin duro nga hudno.
en: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.

war: Tana, paghubga ta an aton amay basi makadirig kita ha iya ngan magkamay-ada kita mga anak pinaagi ha iya.”
en: Let’s get our father to drink wine and then sleep with him and preserve our family line through our father.”

war: Hito nga gab-i ginpainom nira hin bino an ira amay, ngan nakighilawas ha iya an magurang nga anak nga babaye. Kundi uraura hiya hin ka hubog nga waray hiya makasabot hini.
en: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and slept with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

war: Sanglit hito nga gab-i ira ginhubog hiya, ngan nakighilawas ha iya an manghod nga anak. Hubog na liwat hiya hin duro sanglit waray gud hiya makasabot hini.
en: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

war: Dida hini nga paagi nagburod an duha nga mga anak nga kababayen-an ni Lot, pinaagi han ira kalugaringon nga amay.
en: So both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.

war: Nag-anak hin lalake an magurang nga babaye ngan iya ginngaranan nga Moab. Amo hiya an ginikanan han yana nga mga Moabitanhon.
en: The older daughter had a son, and she named him Moab ; he is the father of the Moabites of today.

war: Nag-anak liwat hin lalake an manghod ngan iya ginngaranan nga Benami. Amo hiya an ginikanan han yana nga mga Amonitanhon.
en: The younger daughter also had a son, and she named him Ben-Ammi ; he is the father of the Ammonites of today.

war: Binmalhin hi Abraham tikang ha Mamre ngadto han timogan nga dapit han Canaan, ngan nag-ukoy hiya ha butnga han Cades ug Sur. Niyan, samtang nag-uokoy hiya didto ha Gerar,
en: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,

war: nagsiring hiya nga bugto la niya hi Sara nga iya asawa. Sanglit ginpakuha ni Hadi Abimelec hi Sara ngadto ha iya.
en: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” Then Abimelek king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.

war: Usa ka gab-i pinmakita an Dyos kan Abimelec dida hin usa nga inop ngan nagsiring, “Mapatay ka, kay ginkuha mo ini nga babaye; inasaw-an na hiya.”
