en: But God came to Abimelek in a dream one night and said to him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman.”

war: Kundi waray pa makighilawas kan Sara hi Abimelec, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Ginoo, waray ko sala! Papatayon mo ba ako ngan an akon mga tawo?
en: Now Abimelek had not gone near her, so he said, “Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?

war: Timprano pa han pagkaaga gintawag ni Abimelec an ngatanan niya nga mga opisyal ngan ginsumatan hira kon ano an nahinabo, ngan nagkahahadlok gud hira.
en: Early the next morning Abimelek summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.

war: Kay ano nga imo man ini ginbuhat?”
en: And Abimelek asked Abraham, “What was your reason for doing this?”

war: Binmaton hi Abraham, “An akon hunahuna nga waray ha iyo dinhe nahadlok han Dyos, ngan nga pagpapatayon ako nira basi la makuha nira an akon asawa.
en: Abraham replied, “I said to myself, ‘There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’

war: Tinuod gud nga bugto ko hiya nga babaye. Bugto ko hiya ha amay, kundi diri ha iroy, ngan pinangasawa ko hiya.
en: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.

war: Niyan ibinalik ni Abimelec hi Sara ngadto kan Abraham ngan gintagan pa hiya ni Abimelec hin mga karnero, mga baka, ngan hin mga oripon.
en: Then Abimelek brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.

war: Nagsiring hiya kan Abraham, “Iini an bug-os ko nga katunaan. Pag-ukoy bisan diin an imo karuyag.”
en: And Abimelek said, “My land is before you; live wherever you like.”

war: Ginbendisyonan han Ginoo hi Sara sumala han iya iginsaad,
en: Now the Lord was gracious to Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did for Sarah what he had promised.

war: ngan nagburod hiya ngan nag-anak hin lalake bisan kon lagas na hi Abraham. Natawo an bata dida han panahon nga igintalaan han Dyos.
en: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.

war: Ginngaranan hiya ni Abraham nga Isaac.
en: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.

war: Han walo na ka adlaw an iya edad, gintori hiya ni Abraham sumala han iginsugo han Dyos.
en: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.

war: Ang panuigon ni Abraham 100 na an han katawo ni Isaac.
en: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

war: Nagsiring hi Sara, “Gindad-an ako han Dyos hin kalipay ngan pagtawa. Maduyog ha akon hin pagtawa an ngatanan nga makakabati hiunong hini.”
en: Sarah said, “God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me.”

war: Ngan nagpadayon hiya, “Hin-o in magsisiring kan Abraham nga magpapasuso pa hi Sara hin kabataan? Kundi nag-anak kami hin usa nga lalake dida han lagas na hiya.”
en: And she added, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”

war: Tinmubo an bata, ngan dida han adlaw han kalutas niya, naghatag hi Abraham hin dako nga panagtawo.
en: The child grew and was weaned, and on the day Isaac was weaned Abraham held a great feast.

war: Usa ka adlaw, nag-uuyag hi Ismael nga anak nira Abraham ug Agar nga Ehiptohanon, ngan hi Isaac nga anak ni Sara.
en: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,

war: Nakapaguol ini hin duro kan Abraham, kay anak man liwat niya hi Ismael.
en: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son.

war: Tatagan ko liwat hin damo nga mga anak hi Ismael, an anak han oripon nga babaye, basi mahimo hira nga usa nga nasod, kay anak mo liwat hiya.”
en: I will make the son of the slave into a nation also, because he is your offspring.”

war: Han kaubos na han tubig, ginbayaan niya an bata ha sirong hin usa nga tanaman
en: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.

war: Buhat, kadtoa, purota hiya, ngan pag-liawa hiya. Hihimoon ko in usa nga dako nga nasod tikang han iya mga tulin.”
en: Lift the boy up and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.”

war: Niyan ginpakita han Dyos kan Agar in usa nga atabay. Kinmadto hiya ngan ginpuno hin tubig an supot nga anit ngan ginpainom an bata.
en: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.

war: Kaupod an Dyos han bata samtang nagtutubo hiya; nag-ukoy hiya didto ha kamingawan han Paran ngan nahimo hiya nga batid nga parapanganop.
en: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.

war: Nakaagi an iroy niya hin Ehiptohanon nga asawa para ha iya.
en: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.

war: Hito nga panahon, inmupod hi Abimelec kan Picol nga kapitan han iya kasondalohan, ngan nagsiring kan Abraham, “Kaupod nimo an Dyos ha ngatanan nga imo binubuhat.
en: At that time Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, “God is with you in everything you do.

war: Nagsiring hi Abraham, “Nagsaad ako.”
en: Abraham said, “I swear it.”

war: Nagsumbong hi Abraham kan Abimelec hiunong hin usa nga atabay nga gin-agaw han mga surugoon ni Abimelec.
en: Then Abraham complained to Abimelek about a well of water that Abimelek’s servants had seized.

war: Nagsiring hi Abimelec, “Diri ako maaram kon hin-o an nagbuhat hini. Waray mo man ako pagsumati hiunong hini, ngan syahan pa ini nga akon pakabati hini.”
en: But Abimelek said, “I don’t know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today.”

war: Niyan gintagan ni Abraham hi Abimelec hin mga karnero, ngan mga baka, ngan naghimo hira nga duha hin ginsabotan.
en: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelek, and the two men made a treaty.

war: Ginlain ni Abraham in pito nga mga nati nga karnero tikang han iya panon,
en: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,

war: ngan pinmakiana ha iya hi Abimelec, “Kay ano nga ginbuhat mo ito?”
en: and Abimelek asked Abraham, “What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?”

war: Binmaton hi Abraham, “Karawta ini nga pito nga mga nati nga karnero. Pinaagi hini, kinakarawat mo nga amo ako an nag-ukab hini nga atabay.”
en: He replied, “Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well.”

war: Sanglit gintawag an dapit nga Berseba kay didto pagsumpa hira nga duha.
en: So that place was called Beersheba, because the two men swore an oath there.

war: Katapos nira maghimo hini nga ginsabotan didto ha Berseba, binmalik hira Abimelec ug Picol ngadto ha Filistia.
en: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.

war: Niyan nagtanom hi Abraham hin kahoy nga tamarindo didto ha Berseba ngan nagsingba hiya han Ginoo nga Waray Kataposan nga Dyos.
en: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord , the Eternal God.

war: Nag-ukoy hi Abraham didto ha Filistia sulod hin maiha nga panahon.
en: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.

war: Waray pag-iha ginsarihan han Dyos hi Abraham. Gintawag hiya han Dyos, “Abraham!” Binmaton hi Abraham, “Oo, aadi ako namamati.”
en: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.

war: Dida han ikatulo ka adlaw hinkit-an ni Abraham an dapit tikang ha hirayo.
en: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

war: Niyan ginsiring niya an mga surugoon, “Pabilin kamo dinhe upod an asno. Makadto ako ngan an bata ngan magsisingba kami, ngan katapos mabalik kami nganhi ha iyo.”
en: He said to his servants, “Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you.”

war: Ginpadara ni Abraham kan Isaac an sungo para han halad nga tinubod, ngan nagdara hi Abraham hin kutsilyo ngan hin mga baga hin pagharing han kalayo. Samtang naglalakat hira,
en: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,

war: Binmaton hi Abraham, “An Dyos ngahaw an mahatag hin usa nga nati nga karnero.” Ngan nagpadayon hira hin pagkalakat.
en: Abraham answered, “God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two of them went on together.

war: Niyan pinurot ni Abraham an kutsilyo hin pagpatay han iya anak.
en: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.

war: Kundi nagtawag ha iya tikang ha langit an anghel han Ginoo , “Abraham, Abraham!” Binmaton hiya, “Oo, aadi ako.”
en: But the angel of the Lord called out to him from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.

war: Ginngaranan ni Abraham adto nga dapit nga “Nahatag an Ginoo .” Ngan bisan yana nga adlaw nasiring pa in mga tawo, “Nahatag hiya didto han bukid han Ginoo .”
en: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”

war: Nagtawag hin ikaduha kan Abraham an anghel han Ginoo tikang ha langit,
en: The angel of the Lord called to Abraham from heaven a second time

war: An ngatanan nga kanasoran mahangyo nga pagbendisyonan ko hira sugad han akon pagbendisyon han imo mga tulin—kay imo ginsugot an akon sugo.”
en: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me.”

war: Binmalik hi Abraham ngadto han iya mga surugoon, ngan nagburunyog hira ngadto ha Berseba, diin pag-ukoy hi Abraham.
en: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.

war: Paglabay hin panahon hinbaroan ni Abraham nga nag-anak hira Milca ug Nahor nga iya bugto hin walo nga mga anak:
en: Some time later Abraham was told, “Milkah is also a mother; she has borne sons to your brother Nahor:

war: hira Uz nga suhag, Buz nga iya bugto nga lalake, Kemuel nga amay ni Aram,
en: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),

war: Cesed, Hazo, Pildas, Jidlaf, ug Betuel
en: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel.”

war: nga amay ni Rebecca. Igin-anak nira Milca ug Nahor nga bugto ni Abraham ini nga walo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an.
en: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milkah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.

war: Nag-anak hi Reuma nga aruasawa ni Nahor kanda Teba, Gaham, Tahas, ug Maaca.
en: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maakah.

war: Nakaabot hi Sara hin panuigon nga 127.
en: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.

war: Namatay hiya didto ha Hebron ha tuna han Canaan, ngan nagmasulob-on hi Abraham tungod han iya kamatay.
en: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.

war: Binayaan ni Abraham an dapit nga hinahayaran han lawas han iya asawa, kinmadto hiya han mga Hiteohanon, ngan nagsiring,
en: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,

war: “Usa ako nga lumalangyaw nga nag-uokoy dinhe ha iyo; papalita ako hin tuna, basi didto ko iglubngan an akon asawa.”
en: “I am a foreigner and stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead.”

war: Binmaton hira,
en: The Hittites replied to Abraham,

war: Niyan yinmukbo hi Abraham ha atubangan nira,
en: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.

war: Nalingkod hi Efron upod han iba nga mga Hiteohanon dida han tirokan nga dapit didto han ulpotan han syudad. Binmaton hiya nga hinbabatian han tagsatagsa nga nakadto,
en: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.

war: Kundi yinmukbo hi Abraham ha atubangan han mga Hiteohanon,
en: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land

war: Binmaton hi Efron,
en: Ephron answered Abraham,

war: “Mano, mapapalit ini nga tuna hin 400 la ka bug-os nga salapi, kundi ano gud ito para ha aton? Iglubong nala didto an imo asawa.”
en: “Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”

war: Inmuyon hini an ngatanan nga mga Hiteohanon nga nakadto hadto nga miting nga hi Abraham amo na an tag-iya han tuna.
en: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.

war: Niyan iginlubong ni Abraham hi Sara nga iya asawa didto hito nga lungib ha tuna han Canaan.
en: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.

war: Sanglit nakatag-iya hi Abraham han uma ngan han lungib dida hini nga hadto anay gintag-iya han mga Hiteohanon, para hin usa nga lubnganan nga tuna.
en: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.

war: Yana lagas na hin duro hi Abraham, ngan ginpakaupay hiya han Ginoo ha ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat.
en: Abraham was now very old, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya gimamagurangi nga surugoon, nga tinaporan han ngatanan niya nga manggad, “Igbutang an imo kamot ha butnga han akon mga paa ngan pagsumpa.
en: He said to the senior servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, “Put your hand under my thigh.

war: Karuyag ko nga magsumpa ka ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Dyos han langit ug tuna, nga diri ka magpipili hin asawa para han akon anak nga lalake tikang han mga tawo dinhe ha Canaan.
en: I want you to swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am living,

war: Kinahanglan bumalik ka ngadto han nasod nga akon natawhan, ngan kuha hin asawa tikang han akon kauropdan para kan Isaac nga akon anak.”
en: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac.”

war: Binmaton hi Abraham, “Ayaw gud pagdad-a ngadto an akon anak!
en: “Make sure that you do not take my son back there,” Abraham said.

war: Kon diri maruyag an babaye hin pag-upod ha imo, mahigagawas ka hini nga saad. Kundi kinahanglan diri mo gud pagdad-on ngadto an akon anak bisan ano an mahinabo.”
en: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”

war: Sanglit iginbutang han surugoon an iya kamot ha butnga han mga paa ni Abraham nga iya agaron, ngan nagsumpa hiya hin pagtuman han iginsiring ni Abraham.
en: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.

war: Han pag-abot niya, iya pinapanluob an mga kamelyo hirani han atabay ka gawas han syudad. Kulopay na adto nga amo ini an takna nga igaralog han kababayen-an.
en: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.

war: Aanhi ako dinhe han atabay diin magkakaabot an kadaragan-an han syudad hin pag-alog hin tubig.
en: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.

war: Waray pa ngani hiya pakakahuman hin pag-ampo, naabot man hi Rebecca nga nakakapas-an hin tibod. Anak hiya ni Betuel nga anak han bugto ni Abraham, hi Nahor ngan hi Milca nga iya asawa.
en: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milkah, who was the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.

war: Matahom hiya hin duro nga daragita ngan uray pa. Linmugsong hiya ngadto han atabay, ginpuno an iya tibod, ngan binmalik.
en: The woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever slept with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.

war: Dinmalagan an surugoon hin pagtapo ha iya ngan sumiring, “Paimna gad ako tikang han imo tibod.”
en: The servant hurried to meet her and said, “Please give me a little water from your jar.”

war: Nagsiring an daragita, “Inom, mano,” ngan pinalos dayon an tibod tikang han iya sugbong ngan kinaptan ini samtang nainom an surugoon.
en: “Drink, my lord,” she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.

war: Han pakainom na han surugoon, nagsiring an daragita, “Magdadara liwat ako hin tubig para han imo mga kamelyo ngan paiimnon ko hira ngada han pagtakas nira.”
en: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I’ll draw water for your camels too, until they have had enough to drink.”

war: Gin-ininaw la hin hilom han tawo an daragita hin pagkita kon ginpauswag ba hiya han Ginoo .
en: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Pagsumati gad ako kon hin-o an imo tatay. May-ada ba kwarto didto han iya balay nga sadang kahuronan ko ngan han akon mga tawo yana nga gab-i?”
en: Then he asked, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”

war: Binmaton hiya, “An akon amay amo hi Betuel nga anak ni Nahor ngan hi Milca.
en: She answered him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor.”

war: Damo in uhot ngan banwa nga tubong didto han amon balay, ngan may-ada didto dapit para ha iyo.”
en: And she added, “We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night.”

war: Niyan linmuhod an tawo ngan nagsingba han Ginoo .
en: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the Lord ,

war: Dinmalagan an daragita ngadto han balay han iya nanay ngan iginsumat an ngatanan nga nahinabo.
en: The young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.

war: Niyan may-ada hi Rebecca lalake nga bugto nga ginngaranan nga Laban, ngan dinmalagan hiya ngadto ha gawas hin pagkadto han atabay diin nakadto an surugoon ni Abraham.
en: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.

war: Han gindudurot na an pagkaon, nagsiring an tawo, “Diri ako makaon kon diri ko igsumat anay an kinahanglan ko igyakan.” Nagsiring hi Laban, “Ayaw paghialang, pagyakan.”
en: Then food was set before him, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say.” “Then tell us,” Laban said.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Amo ako an surugoon ni Abraham.
en: So he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

war: Nag-anak hi Sara nga asawa han akon agaron hin usa nga lalake bisan kon lagas na hiya. Iginhatag ha iya han akon agaron an ngatanan nga iya hiagi ug manggad.
en: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.

war: Pakadto lugod han mga tawo han akon amay, ngadto han akon kauropdan, ngan didto pagpili hin asawa para han akon anak!’
en: but go to my father’s family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.’

war: Ngan ginpakianhan ko an akon agaron, ‘Ano man kon diri umupod ha akon an babaye?’
en: “Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’

war: May usa gudla nga paagi nga mahigagawas ka han imo sumpa: kon kumadto ka han akon kauropdan ngan kon pagdirion ka nira, niyan mahigagawas ka han imo sumpa.’
en: You will be released from my oath if, when you go to my clan, they refuse to give her to you—then you will be released from my oath.’

war: Kon paimnon ako niya ngan magdara liwat hiya hin tubig para han akon mga kamelyo, maamo unta hiya an imo ginpili sugad nga asawa para han anak han akon agaron.’
en: and if she says to me, “Drink, and I’ll draw water for your camels too,” let her be the one the Lord has chosen for my master’s son.’

war: Pinalos dayon niya an iya tibod tikang han iya sugbong ngan sumiring, ‘Inom ngan paiimnon ko liwat an imo mga kamelyo!’ Sanglit inminom ako ngan pinainom niya an mga kamelyo.
en: “She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too.’ So I drank, and she watered the camels also.

war: Binmaton hira Laban ug Betuel, “Tungod nga natikang man ini han Ginoo , waray namon hini mahihimo.
en: Laban and Bethuel answered, “This is from the Lord ; we can say nothing to you one way or the other.

war: Iini hi Rebecca; dad-a hiya ngan pagkalakat kamo. Himoa hiya nga asawa han anak han imo agaron, sumala han iginsiring han Ginoo ngahaw.”
en: Here is Rebekah; take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, as the Lord has directed.”

war: Han pakabati hini han surugoon ni Abraham, hinmapa hiya ngan nagsingba han Ginoo .
en: When Abraham’s servant heard what they said, he bowed down to the ground before the Lord .

war: Kundi nagsiring an surugoon, “Ayaw na kami paghawiri. Ginpauswag han Ginoo an akon paglakat; pabalika na ako ngadto han akon agaron.”
en: But he said to them, “Do not detain me, now that the Lord has granted success to my journey. Send me on my way so I may go to my master.”

war: Binmaton hira, “Tawaga ta an daragita ngan pakianhi ta kon ano an igsisiring niya.”
en: Then they said, “Let’s call the young woman and ask her about it.”

war: Sanglit gintawag nira hi Rebecca ngan ginpakianhan, “Karuyag mo ba umupod hini nga tawo?” “Oo,” binmaton hiya.
en: So they called Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man?” “I will go,” she said.

war: Sanglit tinugotan nira hi Rebecca ngan an tigurang nga surugoon nga babaye han panimalay hin pag-upod han surugoon ni Abraham ngan han iya mga tawo.
en: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.

war: Niyan nag-andam hi Rebecca ngan an iya kadaragan-an ngan sinmakay hira han mga kamelyo hin pag-upod han surugoon ni Abraham, ngan nagkalakat hira ngatanan.
en: Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.

war: Kinmadto hi Isaac ha kamingawan han “An-Atabay-han Buhi-nga-Uusa-nga-Nakita-ha-Akon,” ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto han timogan nga dapit han Canaan.
en: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.

war: Ginmawas hiya dida han kulopay na hin pagsudoy han kaumhan, ngan hinkit-an niya in tiabot nga mga kamelyo.
en: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.

war: Han pakakita ni Rebecca kan Isaac, binmawas hiya han iya kamelyo,
en: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel

war: Ginsumatan han surugoon hi Isaac han ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat.
en: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.

war: Nangasawa hi Abraham hin lain nga babaye nga ginngaranan nga Ketura.
en: Abraham had taken another wife, whose name was Keturah.

war: Nag-anak hira ngan hi Abraham kanda Zimran, Jocsan, Medan, Midian, Isbac, ug Sua.
en: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.

war: Hi Jocsan amo an amay nira Seba ug Dedan, ngan an mga tulin ni Dedan amo an mga Asurim, an mga Letusim, ngan an mga Leumin.
en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Ashurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.

war: An mga anak ni Midian amo hira Efa, Efer, Hanoc, Abida, ug Eldaa. Ini hira ngatanan amo an mga tulin ni Ketura.
en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

war: Iginhatag ni Abraham an ngatanan nga iya hiagi ngadto kan Isaac.
en: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.

war: 7-8 Namatay hi Abraham nga lagas na kaupay ha panuigon nga 175.
en: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.

war: Iginlubong hiya nira Isaac ug Ismael nga iya mga anak didto han lungib han Macpela, didto han uma ha sinirangan han Mamre, nga gintag-iya anay ni Efron nga anak ni Zoar nga Hiteohanon.
en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,

war: Amo ini an uma nga ginpalit ni Abraham tikang han mga Hiteohanon. Iginlubong didto nga duha hira Abraham ug Sara nga iya asawa.
en: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.

war: Han kamatay na ni Abraham, ginbendisyonan han Dyos hi Isaac nga iya anak, nga nag-ukoy ha hirani han atabay nga ginngaranan “An-Atabay-han Buhi-nga-Nakita-ha-Akon.”
en: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.

war: Hi Ismael nga anak nira Abraham ngan hi Agar nga Ehiptohanon nga oripon ni Sara,
en: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Sarah’s slave, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.

war: nagkamay-ada han nasunod nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, nga iginlista ha pagkasunodsunod han ira katawo: hira Nebaiot, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
en: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

war: Misma, Duma, Masa,
en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

war: Hadad, Tema, Jetor, Nafis, ug Kedema.
en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.

war: Amo hira an ginikanan hin dose nga mga tribo, ngan iginsangay han ira mga ngaran an mga kabaryohan ngan mga karampohan nga ihinatag ha ira.
en: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.

war: An panuigon ni Ismael han iya kamatay 137 na.
en: Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.

war: Amo ini an susumaton ni Isaac nga anak ni Abraham.
en: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,

war: An panuigon ni Isaac 40 na an han pangasawa niya kan Rebecca nga anak ni Betuel, (nga taga-Aramea ha Mesopotamia) ngan bugto ni Laban.
en: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.

war: Tungod nga waray man mga anak hi Rebecca, nag-ampo hi Isaac ngadto han Ginoo para ha iya. Ginbaton han Ginoo an iya pag-ampo, ngan nagburod hi Rebecca.
en: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was childless. The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

war: Inmabot kan Rebecca an iya panahon hin pag-anak, ngan nag-anak hiya hin karuha nga kalalaken-an.
en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

war: Mapula an syahan, ngan barahiboon an bug-os niya nga lawas, sanglit ginngaranan hiya nga Esau.
en: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.

war: Ginpalabi ni Isaac hi Esau, kay nalipay hiya hin pagkaon han mga pinanganopan nga gin-ihaw niya, kundi ginpalabi ni Rebecca hi Jacob.
en: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

war: Usa ka adlaw samtang naglalaga hi Jacob hin monggos, inmabot hi Esau tikang hin pagpanganop. Ginugutom hiya,
en: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.

war: ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jacob, “Ginugutom ako; tagi ako hito nga mapula nga linaga.” (Amo ito nga ginngaranan hiya nga Edom.)
en: He said to Jacob, “Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I’m famished!” (That is why he was also called Edom. )

war: Binmaton hi Jacob, “Ighahatag ko ini ha imo kon ighatag mo ha akon an imo mga katungod hin pagkasuhag nga anak.”
en: Jacob replied, “First sell me your birthright.”

war: Nagsiring hi Esau, “Sigi, mapatay na ako hin gutom; ano nga kaupayan an mahihimo ha akon han akon mga katungod?”
en: “Look, I am about to die,” Esau said. “What good is the birthright to me?”

war: Binmaton hi Jacob, “Pagsumpa anay nga ighahatag mo ha akon an imo mga katungod.” Nagsumpa hi Esau ngan iginhatag niya kan Jacob an iya mga katungod.
en: But Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.

war: May-ada lain nga gutom didto han tuna labot han nahiuna dida han panahon ni Abraham. Kinmadto hi Isaac kan Abimelec nga hadi han mga Filisteohanon, didto ha Gerar.
en: Now there was a famine in the land—besides the previous famine in Abraham’s time—and Isaac went to Abimelek king of the Philistines in Gerar.

war: Pinmakita kan Isaac an Ginoo ngan nagsiring, “Ayaw pagkadto ha Ehipto; pabilin dinhe hini nga tuna nga ginpaukyan ko ha imo.
en: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.

war: Pagpapakaupayon ko ikaw kay ginsugot ako ni Abraham, ngan gintuman niya an ngatanan nakon nga mga balaod ngan mga sugo.”
en: because Abraham obeyed me and did everything I required of him, keeping my commands, my decrees and my instructions.”

war: Sanglit nag-ukoy hi Isaac didto ha Gerar.
en: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.

war: Han maiha na didto hi Isaac, tinmangbo hi hadi Abimelec ha iya bintana ngan hinkit-an hi Isaac ngan hi Rebecca nga nagkakarinyo.
en: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.

war: Nagsiring hi Abimelec, “Ano ini nga imo ginbuhat ha amon? Bangin sayonan la in usa han akon mga sakop hin pakigdirig han imo asawa, ngan ikaw ngahaw an pagbabasolon tungod han amon sala.”
en: Then Abimelek said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”

war: Ginpahimatngonan ni Abimelec an ngatanan nga mga tawo: “Pagpapatayon an bisan hin-o nga maglabot hini nga tawo o han iya asawa.”
en: So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: “Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.”

war: Nagpugas hi Isaac didto hito nga tuna, ngan hito nga tuig nag-ani hiya hin 100 ka pilo han iya iginpugas, kay ginpakaupay hiya han Ginoo .
en: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.

war: Nagpadayon hiya hin pagkamainauswagon ngan nahimo hiya nga manggaranon hin duro nga tawo.
en: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.

war: Tungod nga nagdamo an iya panon hin mga karnero ug mga baka, ngan damo an iya mga surugoon, naawa ha iya an mga Filisteohanon.
en: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.

war: Sanglit gintak-opan nira an ngatanan nga mga atabay nga gin-ukab han mga surugoon ni Abraham nga amay niya, han buhi pa hi Abraham.
en: So all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Abimelec kan Isaac, “Gawas na kamo han amon nasod. Labi ka na hin gamhanan kay ha amon.”
en: Then Abimelek said to Isaac, “Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us.”

war: Sanglit linmakat hi Isaac, ngan nagkampo hiya didto ha Kahamub-an han Gerar, diin didto la anay hiya pag-ukoy.
en: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar, where he settled.

war: Nag-ukab an mga surugoon ni Isaac hin usa nga atabay didto han kahamub-an ngan hin-agian nira in tubig.
en: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.

war: Linmakat hi Isaac ngan kinmadto ha Berseba.
en: From there he went up to Beersheba.

war: Nagtindog hi Isaac hin usa nga altar didto ngan nagsingba hiya han Ginoo . Katapos nagkampo hiya didto, ngan nag-ukab an iya mga surugoon hin lain nga atabay.
en: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord . There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.

war: Inmabot hin pakigkita kan Isaac hi Abimelec tikang ha Gerar upod hi Ahuzat nga iya magsaragdon ngan hi Ficol nga kapitan han iya kasondalohan.
en: Meanwhile, Abimelek had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.

war: Sanglit pinmakiana hi Isaac, “Kay ano nga kinmanhi kamo yana hin pakigkita ha akon, nga waray man kamo pakigsangkay ha akon hadto ngan iyo pa ngani ako ginpaiwas han iyo nasod?”
en: Isaac asked them, “Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?”

war: Binmaton hira, “Yana maaram na kami nga upod ha imo an Ginoo , ngan naghuhunahuna kami nga kinahanglan magkamay-ada naton ginsumpaan nga ginsaaran. Karuyag namon nga magsaad ka
en: They answered, “We saw clearly that the Lord was with you; so we said, ‘There ought to be a sworn agreement between us’—between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you

war: Nag-andam hi Isaac hin panagtawo para ha ira ngan nangaon ngan nag-irignom hira.
en: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

war: Timprano pa han pagkaaga, nagsaad an tagsa nga tawo ngan ginparig-on ini pinaagi hin sumpa. Nagpagikan ha ira hi Isaac, ngan nagburublig hira nga mga magsarangkay na.
en: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they went away peacefully.

war: Dida hito nga adlaw inmabot an mga surugoon ni Isaac ngan ginsumatan hiya hiunong han atabay nga ira gin-ukab. Nagsiring hira, “Hin-agian namon in tubig.”
en: That day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, “We’ve found water!”

war: Ginngaranan niya nga Seba (karuyag sidngon Sumpa) an atabay. Tungod hini ginngaranan an syudad nga Berseba asta ngada yana.
en: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.

war: Han 40 na an panuigon ni Esau, nangasawa hiya hin duha nga Hititanhon nga kababayen-an: hira Judit nga anak ni Beeri, ngan hi Basemat nga anak ni Elon.
en: When Esau was forty years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and also Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.

war: Ini nga mga asawa ni Esau nakahatag hin kaguol ug kasubo kanda Isaac ug Rebecca.
en: They were a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

war: Nagsiring hi Isaac, “Nakita ka nga lagas na ako ngan bangin diri na maiha mapatay na ako.
en: Isaac said, “I am now an old man and don’t know the day of my death.

war: Kuhaa an imo pana, pakadto ha kaumhan, ngan panganop para ha akon.
en: Now then, get your equipment—your quiver and bow—and go out to the open country to hunt some wild game for me.

war: Igluto ako han marasa nga pagkaon nga akon ayon ngan igdurot ha akon. Katapos ko pagkaon, ighahatag ko ha imo an akon kataposan nga bendisyon san-o ako mamatay.”
en: Prepare me the kind of tasty food I like and bring it to me to eat, so that I may give you my blessing before I die.”

war: Samtang nagyayakan hi Isaac kan Esau, nagpipinamati hi Rebecca. Sanglit han paggawas ni Esau hin pagpanganop,
en: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back,

war: ginsiring niya hi Jacob, “Hinbatian ko pala hi imo tatay nga nagsiring kan Esau,
en: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau,

war: ‘Dad-i ako han imo pinanmanwaan ngan lutoa ini para ha akon. Katapos ko kaon, ighahatag ko ha imo an akon bendisyon ha atubangan han Ginoo san-o ako mamatay.’
en: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the Lord before I die.’

war: Yana anak ko,” nagpadayon hi Rebecca, “pamati ha akon, ngan buhata an akon igtutugon ha imo.
en: Now, my son, listen carefully and do what I tell you:

war: Pakadto han panon ngan pilia in duha nga magtambok nga nati nga mga kanding, basi makagluto ako han sura nga ayon gud ni imo tatay.
en: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it.

war: Dadad-on mo ini ngadto ha iya, ngan ighahatag niya ha imo an iya bendisyon nga diri pa hiya mapatay.”
en: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies.”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jacob kan iya nanay, “Maaram ka man nga barahiboon nga tawo hi Esau, kundi mahamis an akon panit.
en: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “But my brother Esau is a hairy man while I have smooth skin.

war: Bangin hikapon ako han akon tatay ngan hisabtan niya nga ginlilimbongan ko hiya; bangin lugod higabaan ako ngan diri kabendisyonan.”
en: What if my father touches me? I would appear to be tricking him and would bring down a curse on myself rather than a blessing.”

war: Binmaton hi iya nanay, “Mahingadi unta ha akon an gaba kontra ha imo, anak ko. Sugta la an akon iginsiring ha imo ngan kadtoa ngan kuhaa para ha akon an mga kanding.”
en: His mother said to him, “My son, let the curse fall on me. Just do what I say; go and get them for me.”

war: Sanglit ginkuha niya an mga kanding, ngan gindara ini ngadto kan iya nanay. Ginluto ni iya nanay an marasa nga pagkaon nga ayon gud ni iya tatay.
en: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.

war: Niyan kinuha ni Rebecca an gimamaupayi nga panapton ni Esau, nga ginhimos niya didto han balay, ngan iginsul-ot ini kan Jacob.
en: Then Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau her older son, which she had in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob.

war: Ginputos niya an mga butkon ni Jacob han mga anit han kanding ngan an waray barahibo nga bahin han iya liog.
en: She also covered his hands and the smooth part of his neck with the goatskins.

war: Iginhatag niya kan Jacob an marasa nga pagkaon upod an tinapay nga iya ginhimo.
en: Then she handed to her son Jacob the tasty food and the bread she had made.

war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jacob kan iya tatay ngan nagsiring, “Tatay!” “Oo,” binmaton hi Isaac. “Hin-o ka ba nga akon anak?”
en: He went to his father and said, “My father.” “Yes, my son,” he answered. “Who is it?”

war: Binmaton hi Jacob, “Hi Esau ako nga suhag mo nga anak. Ginbuhat ko an iginsiring mo ha akon. Lingkod ngan kaon kan akon pinanmanwaan nga akon dara ha imo, basi makagbendisyon ka ha akon.”
en: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing.”

war: Nagsiring hi Isaac, “Gin-unan-o mo hin madagmit nga pakadakop, anak ko?” Binmaton hi Jacob, “Ginbuligan ako han Ginoo nga imo Dyos.”
en: Isaac asked his son, “How did you find it so quickly, my son?” “The Lord your God gave me success,” he replied.

war: Nagsiring hi Isaac kan Jacob, “Duruduok daw ngadi basi makahikap ako ha imo. Tinuod ba nga hi Esau ka?”
en: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not.”

war: Dinmuok hi Jacob ngadto kan iya tatay nga hinmikap ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Sugad han tingog ni Jacob an imo tingog, kundi sugad han mga butkon ni Esau an imo mga butkon.”
en: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

war: Waray hiya kumilala kan Jacob, kay barahiboon an iya mga butkon sugad ha kan Esau. Han mahatag na unta hiya han iya bendisyon kan Jacob,
en: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him.

war: pinmakiana anay hiya, “Tinuod ba nga hi Esau ka?” “Amo ako,” binmaton hiya.
en: “Are you really my son Esau?” he asked. “I am,” he replied.

war: Katapos nagsiring ha iya hi iya tatay, “Duruduok ngadi ngan hadki ako, anak.”
en: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Come here, my son, and kiss me.”

war: Tagan ka unta han Dyos hin tun-og tikang ha langit ngan himoon nga maglangbo an imo kaumhan! Tagan ka unta niya hin damo gud nga mga pagkaon ug bino!
en: May God give you heaven’s dew and earth’s richness— an abundance of grain and new wine.

war: “Hin-o ka ba?” pinmakiana hi Isaac. “Hi Esau ako nga imo suhag nga anak,” binmaton hiya.
en: His father Isaac asked him, “Who are you?” “I am your son,” he answered, “your firstborn, Esau.”

war: Han pakabati hini ni Esau, ginmuliat hiya hin pagtangis ngan nagsiring, “Tatay, tagi man liwat ako han imo bendisyon!”
en: When Esau heard his father’s words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me—me too, my father!”

war: Binmaton hi Isaac, “Kinmanhi an imo bugto ngan ginlimbongan ako. Gin-agaw niya an imo bendisyon.”
en: But he said, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Esau hin pakimalooy han iya amay, “Uusa ba gudla an imo bendisyon, tatay? Bendisyoni gad liwat ako, tatay!” Ngan nagtangis hiya.
en: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.

war: Niyan nagsiring ha iya hi Isaac, “Waray tun-og tikang ha langit nga para ha imo. Waray maglangbo nga kaumhan nga para ha imo.
en: His father Isaac answered him, “Your dwelling will be away from the earth’s richness, away from the dew of heaven above.

war: Mabubuhi ka pinaagi han imo espada, Kundi magigin oripon ka han imo bugto. Kundi kon umato ka, Mahigagawas ka han iya gahom.”
en: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck.”

war: Yana, anak, buhata an akon igtutugon ha imo. Pakadto dayon kan Laban nga akon bugto nga lalake didto ha Haran.
en: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Harran.

war: Pagpabilin anay didto ha iya tubtob han paghagkot han kasina han imo bugto,
en: Stay with him for a while until your brother’s fury subsides.

war: Gintawag ni Isaac hi Jacob, ngan ginsiring, “Ayaw pangasawa hin babaye nga Canaanhon.
en: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. Then he commanded him: “Do not marry a Canaanite woman.

war: Pakadto lugod ha Mesopotamia, ngadto han balay ni Betuel nga imo apoy, ngan pangasawa hin usa han kababayen-an didto, usa han babaye nga mga anak ni Laban nga imo bata.
en: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

war: Pagbendisyonan unta han Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum an imo pag-asawa ngan tagan unta kamo hin damo nga mga anak, basi mahimo ka nga amay hin damo nga kanasoran!
en: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.

war: Pagbendisyonan ka unta niya ngan an imo mga tulin sugad han iya pagbendisyon kan Abraham, ngan makagtag-iya ka unta hini nga tuna nga imo gin-ukyan, ngan iginhatag han Dyos kan Abraham!”
en: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”

war: Ginpakadto ni Isaac ha Mesopotamia hi Jacob, ngadto kan Laban nga anak ni Betuel nga taga Aramea, ngan bugto ni Rebecca nga iroy nira Jacob ug Esau.
en: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.

war: Hinbaroan niya nga sinmugot hi Jacob kanda iya tatay ug nanay, ngan kinmadto hiya ha Mesopotamia.
en: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

war: Sanglit nahisabtan ni Esau nga waray maruyag hi Isaac nga iya amay han kababayen-an nga Canaanhon.
en: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;

war: Sanglit kinmadto hiya kan Ismael nga anak ni Abraham, ngan pinangasawa niya an anak ni Ismael nga hi Mahalat nga bugto nga babaye ni Nebaiot.
en: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.

war: Binmaya hi Jacob han Berseba ngan linmakat hiya tipakadto ha Haran.
en: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Harran.

war: Nag-inop hiya nga hinkit-an niya in usa nga hagdan nga naabot tikang ha tuna ngadto ha langit, nga may mga anghel nga nagsisinakalusad dida hini nga hagdan.
en: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

war: Nagmata hi Jacob ngan nagsiring, “Aanhi dinhe an Ginoo ! Aanhi hiya dinhe hini nga dapit, ngan diri ngani ako maaram hini!”
en: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, “Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it.”

war: Nahadlok hiya ngan nagsiring, “Hin kamakaaramdok hini nga dapit! An balay gud ini han Dyos; an ganghaan gud ini ngadto ha langit.”
en: He was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven.”

war: Ginngaranan niya nga Betel an dapit. (Kinikilala nga Luz hadto anay ini nga bungto.)
en: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.

war: Niyan nagsumpa hi Jacob ngadto han Ginoo : “Kon mag-upod ka ha akon ngan panalipdan mo ako hini nga akon paglakaton, ngan tagan mo ako hin pagkaon ngan panapton,
en: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear

war: ngan kon makabalik ako nga talwas ngadto han balay han akon amay, niyan magigin Dyos ko gud ikaw.
en: so that I return safely to my father’s household, then the Lord will be my God

war: Ini nga bato nga hinumdoman nga akon gintindog, mahihimo nga usa nga dapit diin pagsisingbahon ka, ngan ighahatag ko ha imo an ikanapulo nga bahin han ngatanan nga imo ighatag ha akon.”
en: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Jacob han iya paglakaton ngan nagtipakadto hiya han tuna ha Sinirangan.
en: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.

war: Ginpakianhan ni Jacob an mga magmarangno hin mga karnero, “Kasangkayan ko, taga diin kamo?” “Taga-Haran,” binmaton hira.
en: Jacob asked the shepherds, “My brothers, where are you from?” “We’re from Harran,” they replied.

war: Nagpakiana hiya, “Nakilala ba kamo kan Laban nga anak ni Nahor?” “Oo, nakilala kami,” binmaton hira.
en: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, Nahor’s grandson?” “Yes, we know him,” they answered.

war: “Kumusta man hiya?” nagpakiana hiya. “Maupay man,” binmaton hira. “Tan-awa, aadi hi Raquel nga iya anak nga babaye upod an iya panon.”
en: Then Jacob asked them, “Is he well?” “Yes, he is,” they said, “and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob, “Tungod nga adlaw pa man adi ngan diri pa panahon hin pagpasulod han mga panon, kay ano nga diri niyo paimnon ini ngan igbalik ngahaw ngadto han panabsaban?”
en: “Look,” he said, “the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”

war: Binmaton hira, “Diri kami makakahimo hito tubtob nga aanhi na an ngatanan nga mga panon ngan kinaliding na an bato; niyan paiimnon na namon an mga panon.”
en: “We can’t,” they replied, “until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.”

war: Samtang nakikighimangraw pa ha ira hi Jacob, inmabot hi Raquel upod an panon.
en: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherd.

war: Kahuman ginhadkan niya hi Raquel ngan nagtangis hiya tungod hin kalipay.
en: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.

war: Iya ginsumatan hiya, “Uropod ako ni imo tatay; anak ako ni Rebecca.” Dinmalagan dayon hi Raquel hin pagsumat kan iya tatay;
en: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.

war: nagsiring hi Laban, “Matuod gud nga akon ka kalugaringon nga unod ug dugo.” Nagpabilin didto hi Jacob sulod hin usa ka bulan.
en: Then Laban said to him, “You are my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,

war: Nagsiring hi Laban kan Jacob, “Tungod la nga urupod ta ikaw, diri angay nga magbudlay ka hin waray la suhol. Ano man an imo karuyag nga suhol?”
en: Laban said to him, “Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”

war: May-ada hi Laban duha nga mga anak nga kababayen-an; ginngaranan nga Lea an magurang ngan Raquel an manghod.
en: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

war: Maghusay an mga mata ni Lea kundi maupay an tindog han lawas hi Raquel ngan matahum hiya.
en: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.

war: Naghigugma hi Jacob kan Raquel, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Magtratrabaho ako para ha imo sulod hin pito ka tuig, kon ipaaasawa mo ha akon hi Raquel.”
en: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, “I’ll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel.”

war: Binmaton hi Laban, “Gabay ko pa hiya ighatag ha imo kay ngadto hin iba nga tawo; pabilin dinhe upod ha akon.”
en: Laban said, “It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me.”

war: Nagtrabaho hi Jacob hin pito ka tuig basi maasawa niya hi Raquel, nga daw sugad hin pira la ka adlaw an panahon para ha iya, kay naghigugma man hiya kan Raquel.
en: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jacob kan Laban, “Tapos na an igintalaan mo panahon; ipaasawa na ha akon an imo anak.”
en: Then Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to make love to her.”

war: Sanglit naghatag hi Laban hin kombite hin pagkasal ngan gindapit niya an ngatanan.
en: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.

war: Kundi hito nga gab-i, diri hi Raquel, kundi hi Lea an gindara ni Laban ngadto kan Jacob ngan nakighilawas ha iya hi Jacob.
en: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.

war: (Iginhatag ni Laban kan Lea nga iya anak nga babaye hi Zilpa nga iya oripon nga babaye sugad nga iya surugoon.)
en: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.

war: Binmaton hi Laban, “Diri ini batasan dinhe nga ipaasawa an manghod nga anak nga babaye una han magurang.
en: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.

war: Hulata ngada han katapos han usa ka semana nga pagsalin-urog han pagkasal, ngan ighahatag ko ha imo hi Raquel, kon magtrabaho ka para ha akon sulod hin lain nga pito ka tuig.”
en: Finish this daughter’s bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work.”

war: Tinmangdo hi Jacob, ngan han katapos na han usa ka semana nga pagsalin-urog han pagkasal, iginhatag ni Laban hi Raquel nga babaye kan Jacob sugad nga iya asawa.
en: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.

war: (Iginhatag ni Laban kan Raquel nga iya anak nga babaye hi Bilha nga iya oripon nga babaye sugad nga iya surugoon.)
en: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.

war: Nakighilawas liwat hi Jacob kan Raquel, ngan iya ginhigugma hiya labaw pa kan Lea. Ngan nagtrabaho hi Jacob para kan Laban hin lain nga pito pa ka tuig.
en: Jacob made love to Rachel also, and his love for Rachel was greater than his love for Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.

war: Han paghikit-i han Ginoo nga diri hinihigugma ni Jacob hi Lea, ginhimo niya nga mag-anak hi Lea, kundi nga magpabilin nga waray anak hi Raquel.
en: When the Lord saw that Leah was not loved, he enabled her to conceive, but Rachel remained childless.

war: Kundi waray gud mag-anak hira Raquel ngan hi Jacob, sanglit naawa hi Raquel han iya bugto nga babaye, ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jacob, “Tagi ako hin mga anak kay kon diri, mapatay ako.”
en: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, “Give me children, or I’ll die!”

war: Nasina hi Jacob kan Raquel ngan nagsiring, “Diri ako makakaliwan han Dyos. Amo hiya an nagpupugong ha imo hin pagkamay-ada mga anak.”
en: Jacob became angry with her and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?”

war: Nagsiring hi Raquel kan Jacob, “Iini hi Bilha nga akon oripon nga babaye; pakighilawas ha iya, basi mag-anak hiya para ha akon. Dida hini nga paagi mahihimo ako nga iroy pinaagi ha iya.”
en: Then she said, “Here is Bilhah, my servant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and I too can build a family through her.”

war: Sanglit iginhatag niya hi Bilha ngadto han iya bana, ngan nakighilawas ha iya hi Jacob.
en: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,

war: Nagburod hi Bilha ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin usa nga lalake.
en: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

war: Nagsiring hi Raquel, “Naghukom an Dyos ugop ha akon. Pinanmatian niya an akon pag-ampo, ngan tinagan ako hin usa nga anak nga lalake”; sanglit ginngaranan hiya nga Dan.
en: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son.” Because of this she named him Dan.

war: Nagburod liwat hi Bilha ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin ikaduha nga lalake.
en: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

war: Nagsiring hi Raquel, “Nakig-away ako hin makuri nga pakig-away kontra han akon bugto nga babaye, kundi nagdaog ako”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya nga Neftali.
en: Then Rachel said, “I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won.” So she named him Naphtali.

war: Han pakasabot ni Lea nga inmukoy na hiya hin pag-anak, iginhatag niya hi Zilpa nga iya oripon nga babaye ngadto kan Jacob sugad nga iya asawa.
en: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

war: Niyan nag-anak hira Zilpa ngan hi Jacob hin usa nga lalake.
en: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

war: Nagsiring hi Lea, “Nagin palaran ako”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya nga Gad.
en: Then Leah said, “What good fortune!” So she named him Gad.

war: Nag-anak liwat hira Zilpa ngan hi Jacob hin usa pa nga lalake,
en: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

war: ngan nagsiring hi Lea, “Hin pagkamalipayon ko! Yana tatawgon na ako nga malipayon han kababayen-an”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya hin Aser.
en: Then Leah said, “How happy I am! The women will call me happy.” So she named him Asher.

war: Ginbaton han Dyos an pag-ampo ni Lea, ngan nagburod hiya, ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin ikalima nga lalake.
en: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

war: Nagsiring hi Lea, “Ginbalos ako han Dyos kay iginhatag ko an akon oripon ngadto han akon bana”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya nga Isacar.
en: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.

war: Nagburod na liwat hi Lea ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin ikaunom nga anak nga lalake.
en: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

war: Ha orhe na nag-anak hiya hin usa nga babaye nga iya ginngaranan nga Dina.
en: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

war: Niyan nahinumdom an Dyos kan Raquel; binmaton niya an iya pag-ampo ngan ginhimo niya nga magkamay-ada hiya mga anak.
en: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.

war: Nagburod hiya ngan nag-anak hin usa nga lalake. Nagsiring hiya, “Ginkuha han Dyos an akon kaarawdan pinaagi hin pagtagi ha akon hin usa nga anak nga lalake.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, “God has taken away my disgrace.”

war: Tagan pa unta ako han Ginoo hin lain pa nga anak nga lalake”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya nga Jose.
en: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the Lord add to me another son.”

war: Han katawo na ni Jose, nagsiring hi Jacob kan Laban, “Palakta na ako basi makauli ako.
en: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Laban, “Tugoti ako hin pagsiring hini: hinbaroan ko pinaagi hin patagna nga ginpakaupay ako han Ginoo tungod ha imo.
en: But Laban said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you.”

war: Sumati ako han imo mga suhol ngan pagbabaydan ko ini.”
en: He added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”

war: Binmaton hi Jacob, “Maaram ka man han akon pangabudlay para ha imo ngan han pagdamo han imo mga panon ka ubos han akon pagmangno.
en: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.

war: Binmaton hi Laban, “Nauyon ako. Bubuhaton ta sumala han imo siring.”
en: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”

war: ngan hinmirayo hira tikang kan Jacob upod ini nga panon ngadto hin dapit nga tulo ka adlaw nga paglakaton an kahirayo. Ginmangnoan ni Jacob an nahisalin han mga panon ni Laban.
en: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban’s flocks.

war: Kinmuha hi Jacob hin lapyo pa nga mga sanga hin alamo, abelyana, ngan kastanyo nga mga kahoy ngan ginpanitan niya in bahin han mga sanga sanglit baga may-ada busag nga mga samay pagkit-on.
en: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.

war: Sanglit kon nagbuburod an mga kanding ha atubangan han mga sanga, nag-aanak ini hin mga kanding nga tagiptipon, burikbutik, ngan kabang.
en: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.

war: Dida hini nga paagi nagriko hin duro hi Jacob. Damo an iya mga panon, mga oripon, mga kamelyo, ngan mga asno.
en: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

war: Hinsabtan liwat ni Jacob nga diri na makisasangkayon ha iya hi Laban sugad han una.
en: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.

war: Niyan nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “Balik ngadto ha tuna han imo mga ginikanan ngan ngadto han imo mga kauropdan. Maupod ako ha imo.”
en: Then the Lord said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

war: Sanglit nagpatugon hi Jacob ngadto kanda Raquel ug Lea nga tapoon hiya nira didto han uma diin nakadto an iya mga panon.
en: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Hinkit-an ko nga diri na gud makisasangkayon ha akon an iyo tatay sugad han una; kundi nagin kaupod ko la gihapon an Dyos han akon amay.
en: He said to them, “I see that your father’s attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.

war: Maaram man kamo nga duha nga nagkabudlay ako ha bug-os ko nga kusog para han iyo amay.
en: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,

war: Kundi ginlimbongan ako niya, ngan makanapulo na pagliwatliwata an akon suhol. Kundi waray tumugot an Dyos nga pagdaoton ako niya.
en: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.

war: Ginkuha han Dyos in mga panon tikang han iyo amay ngan iginhatag ini ha akon.”
en: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.

war: Naghimangraw ha akon dida han akon inop an anghel han Dyos ngan nagsiring, ‘Jacob!’ Binmaton ako, ‘Aadi akon.’
en: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’

war: Binmaton kan Jacob hira Raquel ug Lea, “Waray na gud namon masusunod han amon amay.
en: Then Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father’s estate?

war: Gindudumara kami niya sugad na la hin mga lumalangyaw. Iginbaligya kami niya ngan yana nagasto na niya an ngatanan nga kwarta nga iginbayad ha iya para ha amon.
en: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.

war: Ini ngatanan nga mga manggad nga ginkuha han Dyos tikang han amon amay, amon ini ngan han amon mga anak. Buhata an bisan ano nga iginsiring ha imo han Dyos.”
en: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you.”

war: Linmakat hi Laban hin pag-arot han iya mga karnero, ngan han waray hiya didto ha balay, kinawat ni Raquel an kadiyosan han panimalay nga gintag-iya han iya amay.
en: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household gods.

war: Ginlipat ni Jacob hi Laban pinaagi hin diri niya pagpahibaroa ha iya nga tilakat hiya.
en: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.

war: Gindara niya an ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi ngan binmaya hiya hin kadagmitan. Tinmabok hiya han Salog Eufrates ngan nagtipakadto hiya han sagkahon nga tuna han Galaad.
en: So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.

war: Paglabay hin tulo ka adlaw ginsumatan hi Laban nga pinmalagiw hi Jacob.
en: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

war: Igin-upod ni Laban an iya mga tawo ngan ginlanat hi Jacob sulod hin pito ka adlaw tubtob nga hin-abotan niya hi Jacob didto han sagkahon nga tuna han Galaad.
en: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

war: Hito nga gab-i pinmakita an Dyos kan Laban dida hin usa nga inop ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Paghinay ngan ayaw gud pagpasipad-i hi Jacob hin bisan ano nga paagi.”
en: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, “Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.”

war: Nagkampo hi Jacob didto hin usa nga bukid, ngan nagkampo hi Laban upod an iya mga tawo didto han sagkahon nga tuna han Galaad.
en: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.

war: Nagsiring hi Laban kan Jacob, “Kay ano nga ginlimbongan mo ako ngan gindara mo an akon mga anak nga kababayen-an sugad hin kababayen-an nga nabihag ha pag-awayan?
en: Then Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You’ve deceived me, and you’ve carried off my daughters like captives in war.

war: Waray mo ngani ako pahadka na man la hin panamilit han akon mga apo nga mga anak nga kababayen-an. Patuyaw ini nga imo ginbuhat!
en: You didn’t even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You have done a foolish thing.

war: Maaram ako nga binmaya ka kay nahihidlaw ka na gud hin pag-uli, kundi kay ano nga ginkawat mo an akon kadiyosan?”
en: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father’s household. But why did you steal my gods?”

war: Binmaton hi Jacob, “Nahadlok ako, kay bangin mo pagbawion ha akon an imo mga anak kababayen-an.
en: Jacob answered Laban, “I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.

war: Makadamo ako pag-antos han kapaso han adlaw, ngan han kahagkot han gab-i. Waray ko maupay nga pagkaturog.
en: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.

war: andam ako hin pakigsabot ha imo. Pagtambak kita hin mga bato hin pagpahinumdom ha aton hini nga aton ginsabotan.”
en: Come now, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us.”

war: Sanglit kinmuha hi Jacob hin usa nga bato ngan igintindog ini sugad nga usa nga hinumdoman.
en: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.

war: Ginsiring niya an iya mga tawo hin pagtirok hin mga bato ngan ira pagtambakon ini. Niyan nangaon hira ha ligid han tinambak nga mga bato.
en: He said to his relatives, “Gather some stones.” So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.

war: Ginngaranan ini ni Laban nga Jagar-sahaduta, samtang ginngaranan ini ni Jacob nga Galeed.
en: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

war: Nagsiring hi Laban kan Jacob, “Magigin usa nga saksi ini nga tinambak nga mga bato para ha aton nga duha.” Amo ini nga ginngaranan nga Galeed ito nga dapit.
en: Laban said, “This heap is a witness between you and me today.” That is why it was called Galeed.

war: Nagsiring liwat hi Laban, “Magbantay unta ha aton an Ginoo samtang nagkakabulag kita.” Sanglit ginngaranan liwat nga Mispa ini nga dapit.
en: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, “May the Lord keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.

war: Iini an mga bato nga akon gintambak ha butnga naton, ngan iini an bato nga hinumdoman.
en: Laban also said to Jacob, “Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.

war: Maghuhukom ha aton an Dyos ni Abraham ngan an Dyos ni Nahor.” Niyan nagsumpa hi Jacob hin pagtuman hini nga saad ha ngaran han Dyos nga ginsingba ni Isaac nga iya amay.
en: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” So Jacob took an oath in the name of the Fear of his father Isaac.

war: Temprano pa han pagkaaga ginhadkan ni Laban hin pagpanamilit an iya mga apo ngan an iya mga anak nga kababayen-an ngan inmoli hiya.
en: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.

war: Han nagpapadayon hin paglakat hi Jacob, tinmapo ha iya in mga anghel.
en: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

war: Han paghikit-i niya ha ira, nagsiring hiya, “Kampo ini ha Dyos;” sanglit ginngaranan niya nga Mahanaim an dapit.
en: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is the camp of God!” So he named that place Mahanaim.

war: Nagpauna hi Jacob hin mga surugoon ngadto kan Esau nga iya bugto didto ha tuna han Edumea.
en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

war: Naghunahuna hiya, “Kon umabot hi Esau ngan sulongon an syahan nga hugpo, bangin makapalagiw pa an ikaduha.”
en: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape.”

war: Hinumdomi nga nagsaad ka nga pagbebendisyonan mo ako ngan tatagan mo ako hin damo gud nga mga tulin nga diri maiihap, nga sugad kadamo han mga baras ha baybayon.”
en: But you have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.’ ”

war: Gintugon niya an syahan nga surugoon, “Kon igkatapo ka kan Esau nga akon bugto ngan magpakiana hiya, ‘Hin-o an imo agaron? Tikain ka man? Kanay ini kahayopan nga nag-uuna ha imo?’
en: He instructed the one in the lead: “When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘Who do you belong to, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?’

war: kinahanglan bumaton ka, ‘Kan Jacob ini nga imo surugoon. Iya iginpapadara ini nga usa nga regalo ngadto kan Esau nga iya agaron. Aadi hi Jacob ngahaw nasunod ha amon.’”
en: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.’ ”

war: Iya ginpauna ha iya an mga regalo, ngan nagpalabay hiya hito nga gab-i didto han kampo.
en: So Jacob’s gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.

war: Binmangon hi Jacob hito manta nga gab-i, gindara an iya duha nga mga asawa, an iya duha nga mga aruasawa, ngan an iya onse nga mga anak, ngan tinmabok hira han Salog han Jaboc.
en: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two female servants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.

war: Katapos niya pagpataboka ha ira, iya liwat gindara ngadto ha tabok an ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi,
en: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.

war: kundi pinmabilin hiya nga nag-uusaan la. Niyan inmabot in usa ka tawo ngan nakigdulong ha iya tubtob gud han pagpunias han adlaw.
en: So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak.

war: Han pakasabot han tawo nga waray man hiya pakakadaog, gin-igo niya an pig-i ni Jacob ngan nalisa ini.
en: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.

war: Nagsiring an tawo, “Buhii na ako kay mapawa na.” “Diri ko ikaw bubuhian kon diri mo ako pagbendisyonan,” binmaton hi Jacob.
en: Then the man said, “Let me go, for it is daybreak.” But Jacob replied, “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”

war: “Ano an imo ngaran?” pinmakiana an tawo. “Jacob,” binmaton hiya.
en: The man asked him, “What is your name?” “Jacob,” he answered.

war: Nagsiring an tawo, “Diri na Jacob an imo ngaran. Nakigdulong ka han Dyos ngan han mga tawo, ngan nagdaog ka; sanglit Israel na an imo ngaran.”
en: Then the man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob, “Yana pagsumati ako han imo ngaran.” Kundi binmaton hiya, “Kay ano nga karuyag mo mahibaro han akon ngaran?” Ngan ginbendisyonan niya hi Jacob.
en: Jacob said, “Please tell me your name.” But he replied, “Why do you ask my name?” Then he blessed him there.

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob, “Iginkaatubang ko gud an Dyos ngan buhi pa man gihapon ako;” sanglit iya ginngaranan nga Peniel adto nga dapit.
en: So Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, “It is because I saw God face to face, and yet my life was spared.”

war: Nasirang na an adlaw han pagtalikod ni Jacob han Peniel, ngan nag-iingka hiya tungod han kaigo han iya pig-i.
en: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.

war: Ginpauna niya an mga aruasawa ngan an ira mga anak; sunod hi Lea ngan an iya mga anak, ngan ha orhe na hira Raquel ug Jose.
en: He put the female servants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.

war: Nag-una ha ira hi Jacob ngan hinmapa hiya ha tuna hin makapito han tikaharani na hiya han iya bugto.
en: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

war: Kundi dinmalagan hi Esau hin pagtapo ha iya, ginggakos, ngan ginhadkan hiya. Nagtangis hira nga duha.
en: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

war: Niyan dinmaop an mga aruasawa upod an ira mga anak ngan yinmukbo hira.
en: Then the female servants and their children approached and bowed down.

war: Niyan dinmaop hi Lea ngan an iya mga anak, ngan ha kataposan dinmaop hira Jose ug Raquel ngan yinmukbo liwat hira.
en: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.

war: Pinmakiana hi Esau, “Ano man adto nga una nga hugpo nga akon iginkatapo? Ano man an karuyag sidngon hadto?” Binmaton hi Jacob, “Akon adto hatag nga pahalipay ha imo.”
en: Esau asked, “What’s the meaning of all these flocks and herds I met?” “To find favor in your eyes, my lord,” he said.

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Esau, “Bugto ko, igo na kadamo an akon hiagi; tipigi na la an imo.”
en: But Esau said, “I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself.”

war: Nagsiring hi Esau, “Pag-andam kita ngan pagkalakat. Mag-uuna ako ha imo.”
en: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way; I’ll accompany you.”

war: Sanglit hito nga adlaw ginmikan hi Esau hin pagbalik ngadto ha Edom.
en: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.

war: Kundi kinmadto hi Jacob ha Sucot diin nagbalay hiya para ha iya ngahaw ngan naghimo hin mga sirongan para han iya mga baka. Sanglit ginngaranan nga Sucot an dapit.
en: Jacob, however, went to Sukkoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Sukkoth.

war: Ginpalit niya adto nga bahin han uma hin 100 ka bug-os nga salapi tikang han mga tulin ni Hamor nga amay ni Siquem.
en: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.

war: Nagtindog hiya hin usa nga altar didto ngan ginngaranan ini nga El, an Dyos han Israel.
en: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.

war: Usa ka adlaw kinmadto hi Dina nga anak nga babaye nira Jacob ug Lea hin pagbisita hin mga kababayen-an nga taga-Canaan.
en: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.

war: Han paghikit-i kan Dina ni Siquem nga anak ni Hamor nga Hibeohanon, nga amo an punoan hito nga tuna, gindara ngan ginlugos hiya.
en: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and raped her.

war: Kundi hinusayan hi Siquem kan Dina sanglit hinmigugma hiya ha iya ngan gintalinguha niya nga paghigugmaon hiya ni Dina.
en: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob; he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.

war: Ginsiring niya an iya amay, “Karuyag ko asawahon ini nga babaye.”
en: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as my wife.”

war: Ginmawas hi Hamor nga amay ni Siquem, hin pakighimangraw kan Jacob,
en: Then Shechem’s father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.

war: Paghimo kita hin ginsabotan nga basi makahimo hin pangasawa an amon ngan han iyo mga tawo.
en: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.

war: Niyan makakag-ukoy kamo upod ha amon dinhe han amon tuna: makakag-ukoy kamo bisan diin an iyo karuyag, makakagpakabuhi kamo hin waray kaulangan, ngan makakagtag-iya kamo hin mga hiagi.”
en: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Siquem ngadto han amay ngan kabugtoan ni Dina, “Ighatag gad ha akon ini nga pabor, ngan tatagan ko kamo han bisan ano nga iyo karuyag.
en: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.

war: Tungod nga ginpasipad-an man ni Siquem hi Dina nga bugto nira, ginbaton han mga anak ni Jacob hi Siquem ngan hi Hamor nga iya amay hin malimbong nga paagi.
en: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob’s sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.

war: Nagsiring ha ira an mga anak ni Jacob, “Diri kami makakatugot han amon bugto nga babaye nga pangasaw-on hin usa ka tawo nga diri tinori; makaarawod ito para ha amon.
en: They said to them, “We can’t do such a thing; we can’t give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.

war: Makakatangdo la kami kon magsugad kamo ha amon, pinaagi hin pagtori han ngatanan niyo nga kalalaken-an.
en: We will enter into an agreement with you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.

war: Niyan matangdo kami nga mag-aragsawa an aton mga tawo. Mag-uokoy kami tampo ha iyo ngan magigin-usa na la kita nga katawhan.
en: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We’ll settle among you and become one people with you.

war: Kundi kon diri niyo pagtumanon ini nga pagtori; dadad-on namon hi Dina ngan malakat kami.”
en: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we’ll take our sister and go.”

war: Nakalipay ini nga ira mga pulong kan Hamor ngan kan Siquem nga iya anak,
en: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.

war: ngan waray na maglangan an batan-on nga lalake hin pagtuman han iginsiring, kay nahigugma man hiya han babaye nga anak ni Jacob. Hi Siquem amo an labi ka tinahod nga kaapi han iya panimalay.
en: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father’s family, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.

war: Kinmadto hi Hamor ngan hi Siquem nga iya anak han dapit nga tirokan didto han ganghaan han bungto ngan nakighimangraw hira han ira mga igkasi taghimungto:
en: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to the men of their city.

war: Ighahatag nira ha aton an ngatanan nira nga kahayupan ngan an ngatanan nga ira mga hiagi. Sanglit uyoni ta la hira ngan makakag-ukoy hira dinhe ha aton.”
en: Won’t their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us agree to their terms, and they will settle among us.”

war: Inmuyon an ngatanan nga mga tuminungnong han syudad han kan Hamor ug Siquem iginsumat ha ira, ngan gintori an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an.
en: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.

war: lakip hi Hamor ngan hi Siquem nga iya anak. Niyan ginkuha nira hi Dina tikang han balay ni Siquem, ngan nagkalakat hira.
en: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem’s house and left.

war: Katapos han panmatay, gintikasan an syudad han iba nga mga anak ni Jacob hin pagbulos tungod han paglugosa han ira bugto nga babaye.
en: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.

war: Gindara nira an mga panon, an mga baka, an mga asno, ngan an ngatanan didto han syudad ngan didto han kaumhan.
en: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.

war: Gindara nira an ngatanan nga mga manggad, ginbihag an ngatanan nga kababayen-an ngan kabataan, ngan gindara an ngatanan nga mga butang didto han kabablayan.
en: They carried off all their wealth and all their women and children, taking as plunder everything in the houses.

war: Kundi binmaton hira, “Diri kami makakatugot nga pagsusugaron la hin usa nga maraot nga babaye an amon bugto.”
en: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”

war: Han pagkalakat na nira Jacob ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an, inalpan hin dako nga kahadlok an mga tawo han higrani nga mga bungto, ngan waray hira maglanat ha ira.
en: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell on the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.

war: Inmabot hi Jacob upod an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo ngadto ha Luz nga kinikilala na yana nga Betel, didto ha tuna han Canaan.
en: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.

war: Nagtindog hiya didto hin usa nga altar, ngan ginngaranan an dapit nga para han Dyos han Betel, kay didto pinmakita ha iya an Dyos han napalagiw hiya tikang han iya bugto.
en: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.

war: Namatay hi Debora nga yaya ni Rebecca, ngan iginlubong hiya ha sirong han kahoy nga tuog ha timogan nga dapit han Betel. Sanglit ginngaranan an dapit nga “Tuog hin Pagtangis.”
en: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak outside Bethel. So it was named Allon Bakuth.

war: Han pagbalik ni Jacob tikang ha Mesopotamia, pinmakita na liwat ha iya an Dyos, ngan ginbendisyonan hiya.
en: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an Dyos, “Jacob an imo ngaran, kundi tikang yana Israel na ngaran nimo.” Sanglit ginngaranan hiya han Dyos nga Israel.
