en: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. ” So he named him Israel.

war: Ngan nagsiring ha iya an Dyos, “Amo ako an Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum. Magdadamo an imo mga anak. Magtitikang ha imo in kanasoran ngan magigin ginikanan ka hin kahadian.
en: And God said to him, “I am God Almighty ; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.

war: Ighahatag ko ha imo an tuna nga iginhatag ko kan Abraham ngan kan Isaac, ngan ighahatag ko liwat ini ngadto han imo mga tulin nga masunod ha imo.”
en: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”

war: Niyan binayaan hiya han Dyos.
en: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.

war: Ginngaranan niya nga Betel ini nga dapit.
en: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.

war: Binmaya han Betel hi Jacob ngan an iya panimalay, ngan han hirayo pa hira tikang ha Efrata, inmabot an panahon han pag-anak ni Raquel, ngan ginkurian hiya.
en: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.

war: Dida han ginkukurian na gud hiya, nagsiring ha iya an partira, “Ayaw kahadlok, Raquel, kay lalake na liwat ini nga imo anak.”
en: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, “Don’t despair, for you have another son.”

war: Kundi tikamaratay na hiya ginngaranan niya nga Benoni an iya anak, kundi ginngaranan hiya nga Benjamin han iya amay.
en: As she breathed her last—for she was dying—she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.

war: Han kamatay ni Raquel, iginlubong hiya ha ligid han dalan tipakadto ha Efrata nga kinikilala na yana nga Betlehem.
en: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

war: Nagtindog hi Jacob hin usa nga bato nga hinumdoman didto, ngan ngada yana nga adlaw nahimo ini nga tigaman han linubngan kan Raquel.
en: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel’s tomb.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jacob ngan nagkampo hiya didto han luyo nga dapit han lantawan han Eder.
en: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.

war: An mga anak ni Lea amo hira Ruben (an suhag nga lalake ni Jacob), Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isacar, ug Zabulon.
en: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.

war: An mga anak ni Raquel amo hira Jose ug Benjamin.
en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

war: An mga anak ni Bilha nga oripon ni Raquel amo hira Dan ug Neftali.
en: The sons of Rachel’s servant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.

war: An mga anak ni Zilpa nga oripon ni Lea amo hira Gad ug Aser. Didto ha Mesopotamia katawo ini nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an.
en: The sons of Leah’s servant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

war: Kinmadto hi Jacob han iya amay nga hi Isaac didto ha Mamre nga hirani han Hebron, diin nag-ukoy hira Abraham ug Isaac.
en: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

war: Nakaabot hi Isaac hin panuigon nga 180,
en: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.

war: ngan namatay hiya nga lagas na kaupay, ngan iginlubong hiya nira Esau ug Jacob nga iya mga anak.
en: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Esau nga gintawag liwat nga Edom.
en: This is the account of the family line of Esau (that is, Edom).

war: Nangasawa hi Esau hin kababayen-an nga Canaanhon; hira Ada nga anak ni Elon nga Hiteohanon; Oholibama nga anak ni Ana nga anak nga lalake ni Zibeon nga Hibeohanon;
en: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite—

war: ug Basemat nga anak nga babaye ni Ismael, ngan bugto ni Nebaiot.
en: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

war: Nag-anak hi Ada kan Elifas; nag-anak hi Basemat kan Reuel;
en: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,

war: ngan nag-anak hi Oholibama kanda Jeus, Jalam, ug Core. Natawo ini ngatanan nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Esau didto han tuna han Canaan.
en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.

war: Sanglit nag-ukoy hi Esau didto han sagkahon nga tuna han Edom.
en: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Esau nga ginikanan han mga Edomitanhon.
en: This is the account of the family line of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.

war: Igin-anak nira Esau ug Oholibama nga babaye nga anak ni Ana nga anak ni Zibeon, in tulo nga kalalaken-an: hira Jeus, Jalam, ug Core.
en: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

war: Amo ini an mga tribo nga tinmikang kan Esau. Hi Elifas nga suhag nga lalake ni Esau amo an ginikanan han nasunod nga mga tribo: nira Teman, Omar, Sefo, Kenaz,
en: These were the chiefs among Esau’s descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

war: Core, Gatam, ug Amalec. Mga tulin ini ngatanan ni Ada nga asawa ni Esau.
en: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.

war: Tinmikang kan Esau ini ngatanan nga mga tribo.
en: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.

war: Hi Lotan amo an ginikanan han mga banay nira Hadi ug Homam. (May-ada hi Lotan usa nga bugto nga babaye nga ginngaranan nga Timna.)
en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

war: Amo hi Sobal an ginikanan han mga banay nira Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo, ug Onam.
en: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

war: 25-26 Amo hi Ana an amay ni Dison nga amo an ginikanan han mga banay nira Hamran, Esban, Itran, ug Queran. May-ada liwat babaye nga anak hi Ana, nga ginngaranan nga Oholibama.
en: The sons of Dishon : Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

war: Hi Eser amo an ginikanan han mga banay nira Bilhan, Saavan ug Jacan.
en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.

war: Hi Disan amo an ginikanan han mga banay nira Hus ug Aran.
en: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

war: 29-30 Amo ini an Horitanhon nga mga tribo didto ha tuna han Edom: nira Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser, ug Disan.
en: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jacob hin pag-ukoy didto ha tuna han Canaan nga gin-ukyan han iya amay,
en: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.

war: Ginhigugma ni Jacob hi Jose labaw han ngatanan niya nga mga anak, kay natawo ha iya hi Jose han lagas na hiya. Iginhimo hiya han iya amay hin hilawig nga bado nga may higlaba nga mga pako.
en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made an ornate robe for him.

war: Han pakakita han iya kabugtoan nga ginhigugma han ira amay hi Jose labaw han iya paghigugma ha ira, napungot gud hira han ira bugto, ngan puno hin kasina an ira pakighimangraw ha iya.
en: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.

war: Usa ka panahon nag-inop hi Jose, ngan han pagsumati niya han iya kabugtoan hiunong han inop, dinmugang la lugod hira hin kapungot ha iya.
en: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Pamatii daw niyo an akon inop.
en: He said to them, “Listen to this dream I had:

war: Naawa ha iya an kabugtoan ni Jose, kundi ginpainoino han iya amay ini ngatanan nga mga butang.
en: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.

war: Usa ka adlaw han paghingadto ha Siquem han kabugtoan ni Jose hin pagmangno han panon han ira amay,
en: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father’s flocks near Shechem,

war: nagsiring hi Jacob kan Jose, “Karuyag ko nga kumadto ka ha Siquem diin nagmamangno han panon an imo kabugtoan.” Binmaton hi Jose, “Andam ako.”
en: and Israel said to Joseph, “As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them.” “Very well,” he replied.

war: ngan nagsinudoysudoy hiya didto han kaumhan. Hinkit-an hiya hin usa ka tawo ngan ginpakianhan hiya, “Ano an imo ginbibiling?”
en: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, “What are you looking for?”

war: Binmaton hiya, “Nagbibiling ako han akon kabugtoan nga nagmamangno han ira panon. Makakagsumat ka ba ha akon kon hain hira?”
en: He replied, “I’m looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?”

war: Nagsiring an tawo, “Nagkalakat na hira. Hinbatian ko hira nga nagsiring nga tipakadto hira ha Dotan.” Sanglit ginlanat ni Jose an iya kabugtoan ngan hin-agian hira didto ha Dotan.
en: “They have moved on from here,” the man answered. “I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ ” So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.

war: Han hirayo pa hiya, hinkit-an na hiya han iya kabugtoan ngan san-o hiya makaabot ngadto ha ira, daan na hira naghunahuna hin maraot kontra ha iya ngan nagsarabot hira hin pagpatay ha iya.
en: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.

war: Naggipasiringsiring hira, “Iini na an parainop.
en: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to each other.

war: Hinbatian hira ni Ruben ngan nagtalinguha hi Ruben hin pagtalwas kan Jose. “Ayaw ta hiya pagpataya,” nagsiring hiya.
en: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. “Let’s not take his life,” he said.

war: Han pag-abot ni Jose ngadto han iya kabugtoan, ginlubasan hiya han iya halawig nga bado nga hilaba an mga pako.
en: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the ornate robe he was wearing—

war: Niyan gintalo hiya nira ngan iginlabog hiya ngadto han atabay nga mamara.
en: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. The cistern was empty; there was no water in it.

war: Nagsiring hi Juda ngadto han iya kabugtoan, “Ano an aton makukuha kon pagpatayon ta an aton bugto ngan iglirong ta an iya pagkamatay?
en: Judah said to his brothers, “What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?

war: Igbaligya ta lugod hiya ngadto hini nga mga Ismaelita. Ayaw ta hiya paglabti kay ha tinuod gud, aton man hiya bugto, ngan aton kasumpay hin tinae.” Inmuyon an iya kabugtoan,
en: Come, let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood.” His brothers agreed.

war: Han pagbalik na ni Ruben ngadto han atabay ngan han pakakita niya nga waray na didto hi Jose, ginggisi niya an iya panapton tungod hin kabido.
en: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.

war: Binmalik hiya ngadto han iya kabugtoan ngan nagsiring, “Waray na didto an bata! Ano daw la an akon pagbubuhaton?”
en: He went back to his brothers and said, “The boy isn’t there! Where can I turn now?”

war: Niyan nag-ihaw hira hin usa nga kanding ngan igintublob nira dida han dugo hini an hilawig nga bado ni Jose.
en: Then they got Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.

war: Kinilala ini han ira amay ngan nagsiring, “Oo, iya ini! Ginpatay daw hiya hin ihalas nga mananap. Ginhunothunot daw hi Jose nga akon anak!”
en: He recognized it and said, “It is my son’s robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces.”

war: Ginggisi ni Jacob an iya panapton tungod hin kabido ngan nagbado hiya hin sako. Nagmabidoon hiya hin maiha para han iya anak.
en: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.

war: Hito nga panahon didto ha Ehipto, iginbaligya han mga Midianitanhon hi Jose ngadto kan Potifar nga usa han mga opisyal han hadi, nga amo an kapitan han mga gwardya han palasyo.
en: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard.

war: Hito nga panahon binayaan ni Juda an iya kabugtoan ngan linmungon kan Hira nga taga bungto han Adullam.
en: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.

war: Didto iginkita hi Juda hin usa nga babaye nga Canaanhon kanay amay ginngaranan nga Sua. Pinangasawa niya an babaye
en: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and made love to her;

war: ngan nag-anak hira hin usa nga lalake nga ginngaranan niya nga Er.
en: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.

war: Nagburod liwat an babaye ngan nag-anak hin usa pa nga lalake ngan ginngaranan niya nga Onan.
en: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.

war: Nag-anak na liwat hiya hin usa nga lalake ngan ginngaranan niya nga Sela. Nakadto hi Juda ha Aczib han katawo han bata.
en: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.

war: Para kan Er nga iya suhag nga lalake kinmuha hi Juda hin usa nga asawa kanay ngaran amo hi Tamar.
en: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

war: Maraot an ginawian ni Er ngan nakapabido ini han Ginoo , sanglit ginpatay hiya han Ginoo .
en: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.

war: Nakapabido han Ginoo an iya ginbuhat, ngan ginpatay liwat hiya han Ginoo .
en: What he did was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death also.

war: May nagsumat kan Tamar nga tikadto ha Timna an iya ugangan nga lalake hin pag-arot han iya mga karnero.
en: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,”

war: Han paghikit-i ni Juda kan Tamar, nakahunahuna hiya nga usa hiya nga mahugaw nga babaye, kay tinahoban man an iya bayhon.
en: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

war: Binmaton hiya, “Padadad-an ko ikaw hin usa nga nati nga kanding tikang han akon panon.” Nagsiring hiya, “Sigi, kon tatagan mo ako hin garantiya ngada han pagpadara mo han kanding.”
en: “I’ll send you a young goat from my flock,” he said. “Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?” she asked.

war: Inmoli hi Tamar, ginhukas an iya panyo, ngan iginbalik niya hin pagsul-ot an iya mga panapton hin balo.
en: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow’s clothes again.

war: Ginpakadto ni Juda hi Hira nga iya sangkay hin pagdara han kanding ngan paglukat han garantiya tikang han babaye, kundi waray hi Tira pakaagi han babaye.
en: Meanwhile Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite in order to get his pledge back from the woman, but he did not find her.

war: Binmalik hiya ngadto kan Juda ngan nagsiring, “Waray ako makaagi han babaye. Nagsiring an mga tawo didto nga waray man maraot nga babaye didto tikang ha tinikangan.”
en: So he went back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, ‘There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here.’ ”

war: Nagsiring hi Juda, “Patipigi nala ha iya adto nga mga butang. Diri ta karuyag nga pagtinawaan kita han mga tawo. Nagtalinguha gud ako hin pagbayad ha iya, kundi waray ka man pakaagi ha iya.”
en: Then Judah said, “Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn’t find her.”

war: Han pag-abot na han panahon ha iya pag-anak, hinbaroan nga karuha an iya ig-aanak.
en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

war: Han nagbabati na hiya, iginawas in usa nga kamot han usa han karuha; kinaptan ini han partira, ginhigtan hin pula nga inulang, ngan nagsiring, “Amo ini an syahan matawo.”
en: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, “This one came out first.”

war: Niyan natawo an iya bugto nga may pula nga inulang ha iya kamot, ngan ginngaranan hiya nga Sera.
en: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out. And he was named Zerah.

war: Nakada kan Jose an Ginoo ngan ginhimo hiya nga mainuswagon. Nag-ukoy hiya didto han balay han iya agaron nga Ehiptohanon,
en: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.

war: nga nakakita nga nakada kan Jose an Ginoo nga naghimo ha iya nga mainuswagon ha ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat.
en: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,

war: Waray pag-iha nagtikang hin kaipa kan Jose an asawa han iya agaron ngan ginhangyo hi Jose nga makighilawas ha iya.
en: and after a while his master’s wife took notice of Joseph and said, “Come to bed with me!”

war: Bisan kon ginhangyo niya hi Jose adlaw-adlaw, waray gud umalagad hi Jose hin pakighilawas ha iya.
en: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.

war: Kundi usa ka adlaw, han pagsulod ni Jose han balay hin pagtuman han iya buruhaton, waray gud didto bisan usa han mga surugoon han balay.
en: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.

war: Han paghikit-i han babaye nga binayaan ni Jose an iya hilawig nga bado ngan dinmalagan ha gawas han balay,
en: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,

war: Han pakabati la niya han akon paggoliat, binayaan niya an iya hilawig nga bado dinhe ha akon ngan dinmalagan hiya ha gawas.”
en: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”

war: Ginhimos niya an hilawig nga bado ni Jose tubtob han pag-uli han agaron ni Jose.
en: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.

war: Niyan ginsumatan niya an agaron han amo manta nga sumat: “Sinmulod han akon kwarto ngan ginpasipad-an ako hito nga oripon nga Hebreohanon nga imo gindara nganhi.
en: Then she told him this story: “That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.

war: Kundi han paggoliat ko dinmalagan hiya ha gawas, nga binayaan niya an iya hilawig nga bado dinhe ha akon.”
en: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”

war: Napungot hin duro an agaron ni Jose
en: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, “This is how your slave treated me,” he burned with anger.

war: ngan iginpadakop hiya ngan iginsulod ha prisohan han mga binilanggo han hadi, ngan didto nagpabilin hiya.
en: Joseph’s master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,

war: Kundi nakada kan Jose an Ginoo ngan ginbendisyonan hiya, sanglit nalipay ha iya an gwardya han prisohan.
en: the Lord was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.

war: Iginbutang niya hi Jose nga tinaporan han ngatanan nga mga priso ngan ginhimo hiya nga may kaakohan han ngatanan nga ginbubuhat didto han prisohan.
en: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.

war: Waray na manginlabot an gwardya han prisohan han bisan ano nga ginbubuhat ni Jose, kay nakada man kan Jose an Ginoo , ngan ginhimo hiya nga mainuswagon dida han ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat.
en: The warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph’s care, because the Lord was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.

war: Paglabay hin panahon nakatalapas han hadi han Ehipto an iya tinaporan han bino ngan an iya labaw nga parahimo hin tinapay.
en: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.

war: Nasina hiya hini nga duha nga mga opisyal,
en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,

war: ngan ginpriso hira didto han balay han kapitan han gwardya, didto han amo manta nga dapit nga ginbutangan kan Jose.
en: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.

war: Nag-iha hira didto han prisohan, ngan ginhimo han kapitan hi Jose nga ira surugoon.
en: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he attended them. After they had been in custody for some time,

war: Han pagkadtoa ha ira ni Jose dida han aga, hinkit-an niya nga masulob-on hira.
en: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.

war: Nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga masulob-on kamo hin duro pagkit-on yana adlaw?”
en: So he asked Pharaoh’s officials who were in custody with him in his master’s house, “Why do you look so sad today?”

war: Sanglit nagsiring an tinaporan han bino, “Dida han akon inop may-ada usa ka puno hin ubas ha akon atubangan
en: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream. He said to him, “In my dream I saw a vine in front of me,

war: nga may-ada tulo nga mga sanga. Kahuman gud la panaringsing hini, nanmunga ini ngan nagkahihinog an mga ubas.
en: and on the vine were three branches. As soon as it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters ripened into grapes.

war: Kinakaptan ko an kupa han hadi; sanglit kinuha ko an mga bunga han ubas ngan ginpuga ko ini ngadto han kupa, ngan iginhatag ko ini ha iya.”
en: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into Pharaoh’s cup and put the cup in his hand.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jose, “Amo ini an kahulogan hini: an tulo nga mga sanga amo an tulo ka adlaw.
en: “This is what it means,” Joseph said to him. “The three branches are three days.

war: Kundi hinumdomi gad ako kon maghingaupay ka na, ngan malooy ka unta hin paghinabi ha akon ngadto han hadi ngan buligan ako hin paggawas dinhe hini nga prisohan.
en: But when all goes well with you, remember me and show me kindness; mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison.

war: Ha tinuod gud, ginkawat la ako pagdad-a nganhi tikang han tuna han mga Hebreohanon, ngan bisan pa dinhe ha Ehipto waray ko ginbuhat nga bisan ano nga sadang pasikaran han akon kapriso.”
en: I was forcibly carried off from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing to deserve being put in a dungeon.”

war: Didto han bawbaw nga basket nakadto an magkalainlain nga hinudno nga mga pagkaon nga para han hadi, ngan ginkikinaon ini han katamsihan.”
en: In the top basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.”

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Amo ini an kahulogan: an tulo nga mga basket amo an tulo ka adlaw.
en: “This is what it means,” Joseph said. “The three baskets are three days.

war: Tulo nala ka adlaw bubuhian ka na han hadi—ngan papupugotan ka niya! Niyan iya pagbibitayon an imo lawas dida hin usa nga palo ngan pangangaonon han katamsihan an imo unod.”
en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and impale your body on a pole. And the birds will eat away your flesh.”

war: Iginbalik niya an tinaporan han bino ngadto han iya una nga katungdanan,
en: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again put the cup into Pharaoh’s hand—

war: kundi iya iginpapatay an labaw nga parahimo hin tinapay. Natuman an ngatanan sugad gud han iginsiring ni Jose.
en: but he impaled the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation.

war: Kundi waray nagud hinumdomi hi Jose han tinaporan han bino—iya hinkalimtan na gud la hiya.
en: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.

war: Paglabay hin duha ka tuig nag-inop an hadi han Ehipto nga natukdaw hiya ha ligid han Salog han Nilo.
en: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,

war: Nanagka tikang han salog in pito nga mga baka nga magtambok ngan maglibsog ngan nagtikang ini panabsab han mga banwa.
en: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.

war: ngan pinangaon han pito nga maggasaay nga mga baka an pito nga magtambok nga mga baka. Onina nagmata an hadi.
en: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.

war: Nahingaturog liwat hiya ngan nag-inop hin ikaduha. Nagbuswak dida hin usa la nga lawas hin trigo in pito nga mga uhay nga maglibsog ngan magtimgas.
en: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.

war: Niyan binmuswak liwat in pito nga lain nga mga uhay hin trigo nga mga kuyapi ngan mga apa tungod han mapaso nga hangin,
en: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—thin and scorched by the east wind.

war: ngan ginlam-oy han kuyapi ngan apa nga mga uhay an pito nga mga uhay nga magtimgas. Nagmata an hadi ngan nakasabot hiya nga usa la adto nga inop.
en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.

war: Niyan nagsiring han hadi an tinaporan han bino, “Kinahanglan magtug-an ako yana nga adlaw nga nakasayop ako.
en: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.

war: Hadto, nasinahan mo an labaw nga parahimo hin tinapay ngan hi ako, ngan iginpapriso mo kami didto han balay han kapitan han gwardya.
en: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.

war: Usa ka gab-i nag-inop an kada usa ha amon ngan may-ada magkalain nga mga kahulogan an mga inop.
en: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

war: Natuman ini sumala gud han iya iginsiring: iginbalik mo ako ngadto han akon katungdanan, kundi ginpapatay mo an labaw nga parahimo hin tinapay.”
en: And things turned out exactly as he interpreted them to us: I was restored to my position, and the other man was impaled.”

war: Ginpasugoan han hadi hi Jose, ngan gindara hiya hin kadagmitan tikang han prisohan. Katapos niya magbarbas ngan magliwan, kinmadto hiya ha atubangan han hadi.
en: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was quickly brought from the dungeon. When he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came before Pharaoh.

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Diri ako makakahimo, Harangdon nga Hadi, kundi mahatag an Dyos hin maupay nga paghubad.”
en: “I cannot do it,” Joseph replied to Pharaoh, “but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires.”

war: Kinaon han maggasaay nga mga baka an magtambok nga mga baka,
en: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.

war: kundi waray gud nahibaro hini, kay maggasa man la gihapon hira pagkit-on sugad han una. Niyan nagmata ako.
en: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.

war: Nag-inop liwat ako nga hinkit-an ko in pito nga mga uhay hin trigo nga maglibsog ngan magtimgas nga nanbuswak dida hin usa la nga tanom.
en: “In my dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.

war: Niyan binmuswak in pito nga mga uhay hin trigo nga mga kuyapi ngan apa tungod han mapaso nga hangin.
en: After them, seven other heads sprouted—withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.

war: Ginlam-oy han kuyapi nga mga uhay an mga magtimgas. Iginsumat ko ini nga mga inop ngadto han mga salamangkero, kundi waray gud usa ha ira nga nakagsaysay han mga inop.”
en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none of them could explain it to me.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jose han hadi, “Waray kalainan an kahulogan han duha nga mga inop; iginsumat ha imo han Dyos kon ano an iya pagbubuhaton.
en: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

war: Pito ka tuig hin kahuraan an kahulogan han pito nga magtambok nga mga baka, ngan an pito nga magtimgas nga mga uhay hin trigo.
en: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.

war: Amo gud ini sumala han akon iginsumat ha imo—iginpakita ha imo han Dyos kon ano an iya pagbubuhaton.
en: “It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

war: Magkakamay-ada pito ka tuig nga kahuraan ha bug-os nga tuna han Ehipto.
en: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,

war: Katapos hito, magkakamay-ada pito ka tuig nga gutom, ngan hingangalimtan an ngatanan nga mag-upay nga katuigan, kay pinaagi han gutom mawawarayan gud an bug-os nga tuna.
en: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.

war: Hingangalimtan gud an panahon hin kahuraan kay makalilisang an masunod nga gutom.
en: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.

war: An pagduhaa hini nga imo inop, nangangahulogan nga ginlarang na gud ini han Dyos, ngan nga pagtutumanon manta ini niya ha diri na maiha.
en: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.

war: “Yana kinahanglan magpili ka hin tawo nga makinaadmananon ngan maaram ngan igbutang mo hiya nga tinaporan han nasod.
en: “And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.

war: Kinahanglan magtudlok ka liwat hin iba nga mga opisyal nga magdudumara han nasod nga makuhaa an ika-lima ka bahin han mga abot, sulod han pito ka tuig nga kahuraan.
en: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

war: Magigin andam ini nga pagkaon para han nasod sulod han pito ka tuig nga gutom nga tiarabot dinhe ha Ehipto, basi diri gugutomon an mga tawo.”
en: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine.”

war: Gin-abuyonan han hadi ngan han iya mga opisyal ini nga larang,
en: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.

war: ngan nagsiring ha ira an hadi, “Diri na gud kita makakaagi hin mauruupay nga tawo kay kan Jose nga usa nga tawo nga may espiritu han Dyos dida ha iya.”
en: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God ?”

war: Nagsiring an hadi kan Jose, “Iginpakita han Dyos ngada ha imo ini ngatanan, sanglit may-ada gud nimo darudako nga kinaadman ug kaaram kay han bisan hin-o.
en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.

war: Igbubutang ko ikaw nga tinaporan han akon nasod ngan magsusugot han imo mga sugo an ngatanan nga akon mga tawo. Mag-iikaduha ka gud ha akon hin kagamhanan.
en: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you.”

war: Yana gintutudlok ko ikaw nga gobernador han bug-os nga Ehipto.”
en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya an hadi, “Amo ako an hadi—ngan waray tawo ha bug-os nga Ehipto nga makakagbuhat hin bisan ano, kon waray nimo pagtugot.”
en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt.”

war: Sulod han pito ka tuig nga kahuraan naghatag an tuna hin damo gud nga mga abot.
en: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.

war: May-ada damo hin duro nga mga liniso nga hinmunong nala hi Jose hin pagtinakos hini—pareho ini han baras ha baybayon.
en: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.

war: Han waray pa aabot an mga tuig han gutom, nagkamay-ada hira Jose ug Asemat duha nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an.
en: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

war: Nagsiring hi Jose, “Ginpakalimot ako han Dyos han ngatanan ko nga mga pag-antos ngan han bug-os nga panimalay han akon amay”; sanglit ginngaranan niya nga Manases an iya suhag nga lalake.
en: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, “It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father’s household.”

war: Nagsiring liwat hiya, “Gintagan ako han Dyos hin mga anak didto han tuna han akon kakurian”; sanglit ginngaranan niya nga Efraim an iya ikaduha nga anak nga lalake.
en: The second son he named Ephraim and said, “It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.”

war: Natapos an pito ka tuig nga kahuraan nga ginpahimulosan han tuna han Ehipto,
en: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,

war: ngan nagtikang an pito ka tuig nga gutom, sumala han iginsiring ni Jose. May-ada gutom didto han iba nga mga nasod, kundi may-ada pagkaon ha bug-os nga Ehipto.
en: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food.

war: Nagtikagrabi na an gutom ngan nagsarang na ini ha bug-os nga nasod, sanglit ginbuksan ni Jose an ngatanan nga mga kamalig nga hirimosan ngan ginbaligyaan hin trigo an mga Ehiptohanon.
en: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.

war: Inmabot ha Ehipto in mga tawo tikang ha bug-os nga kalibutan hin pagpalit hin trigo kan Jose, kay grabi na gud an gutom ha ngatanan nga mga dapit.
en: And all the world came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere.

war: Han paghibaro ni Jacob nga may-ada baligya nga trigo didto ha Ehipto, ginsiring niya an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an, “Kay ano nga diri lugod kamo magmalahimo?
en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why do you just keep looking at each other?”

war: Hinbatian ko nga may baligya nga trigo didto ha Ehipto; kadto ngan palit kamo basi diri kita mamatay hin gutom.”
en: He continued, “I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die.”

war: Sanglit kinmadto an kan Jose napulo nga kabugtoan ha amay hin pagpalit hin trigo didto ha Ehipto,
en: Then ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

war: kundi waray pagpaupda ha ira ni Jacob an tunay nga bugto ni Jose nga hi Benjamin, kay nahadlok hiya nga bangin may mahinabo ha iya.
en: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.

war: Nagkaabot an mga anak ni Jacob upod hin iba nga mga tawo hin pagpalit hin trigo, kay gutom na didto ha tuna han Canaan.
en: So Israel’s sons were among those who went to buy grain, for there was famine in the land of Canaan also.

war: Kinmilala hi Jose han iya kabugtoan, kundi waray hira kumilala ha iya.
en: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.

war: Nahinumdom hiya han iya mga inop mahitungod ha ira, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Mga espiya kamo; kinmanhi kamo hin pag-inaw kon hain an maluya nga dapit han amon nasod.”
en: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected.”

war: Binmaton hira, “Diri gad, ginoo. Kinmanhi kami sugad nga imo mga oripon, hin pagpalit hin pagkaon.
en: “No, my lord,” they answered. “Your servants have come to buy food.

war: Magburugto kami ngatanan. Diri gad kami mga espiya, ginoo, tangkod kami nga mga tawo.”
en: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies.”

war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jose, “Diri! Kinmanhi kamo hin pag-inaw kon hain an maluya nga dapit han amon nasod.”
en: “No!” he said to them. “You have come to see where our land is unprotected.”

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Sumala han akon iginsiring, mga espiya gud kamo.
en: Joseph said to them, “It is just as I told you: You are spies!

war: Amo ini an paagi hin pagsari ha iyo: nagsusumpa ako pinaagi han ngaran han hadi nga diri gud kamo mabaya dinhe kon diri kumanhi anay an iyo gimamanghori nga bugto.
en: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.

war: Katapos hito, iya ginpriso hira sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.
en: And he put them all in custody for three days.

war: Dida han ikatulo ka adlaw, nagsiring ha ira hi Jose, “Tawo ako nga may pagkahadlok han Dyos, ngan tatalwason ko an iyo mga kinabuhi, kundi may-ada niyo pagtutuman-on.
en: On the third day, Joseph said to them, “Do this and you will live, for I fear God:

war: Ngan kinahanglan pagdad-on niyo nganhi ha akon an iyo gimamanghori nga bugto nga lalake. Magpapakita ini nga nagsumat kamo han kamatuoran, ngan diri ko kamo pamamatayon.” Inmabuyon hira hini,
en: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die.” This they proceeded to do.

war: Nagsiring hi Ruben, “Ginsiring ko kamo nga diri ta paglabtan an bata, kundi waray man kamo bumali. Sanglit yana sinusuktan na kita tungod han iya kamatayon.”
en: Reuben replied, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn’t listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood.”

war: Nasayoran ni Jose an ira iginsiring, kundi waray hira makasabot, kay nakigkarukayakan hira ha iya pinaagi hin parahubad.
en: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.

war: Binayaan hira ni Jose ngan nagtangis hiya. Han pakahimo na liwat niya hin pagyakan binmalik hiya, ginkuha niya hi Simeon, ngan ginpagapos hiya ha atubangan nira.
en: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then came back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.

war: Ginkargahan han kabugtoan an ira mga asno han trigo nga ira ginpalit, ngan nagkalakat hira.
en: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.

war: Didto han dapit nga ginpalabyan nira han gab-i, nag-abre han iya sako an usa ha ira hin pagtubong han iya asno, ngan hin-agian niya an iya kwarta dida han ganggang han iya sako.
en: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.

war: Han pag-abot nira ngadto kan Jacob nga ira amay didto ha Canaan, ira ginsumatan hiya han ngatanan nga nahinabo ha ira:
en: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them. They said,

war: “Gin-isgan kami han gobernador han Ehipto ngan ginpasangilan kami nga mga espiya kontra han iya nasod.
en: “The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.

war: Binmaton kami, ‘Diri gad kami mga espiya, mga tangkod la kami nga mga tawo.
en: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.

war: Dose kami ngatanan nga magburugto, nga mga anak hin usa la nga amay. Patay na an usa nga bugto ngan aadto pa ha Canaan an gimamanghori, upod han amon amay.’
en: We were twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in Canaan.’

war: Nagsiring ha ira an ira tatay, “Karuyag ba niya nga mawara an ngatanan ko nga mga anak? Waray na hi Jose; waray na hi Simeon; ngan yana karuyag niyo kuhaon hi Benjamin. Ako amo an mag-aantos!”
en: Their father Jacob said to them, “You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!”

war: Nagsiring hi Ruben ngadto han iya amay, “Kon diri ko igbalik ha imo hi Benjamin, pataya an akon duha nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an. Igtapod hiya ha akon ngan igbabalik ko hiya.”
en: Then Reuben said to his father, “You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back.”

war: Nagtikagrabi an gutom didto ha Canaan,
en: Now the famine was still severe in the land.

war: ngan han kaubos na han ngatanan nga trigo nga ira gindara tikang ha Ehipto, nagsiring hi Jacob ha iya mga anak, “Balik kamo ngadto ngan palit hin gutiay nga pagkaon para ha aton.”
en: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Juda, “Ginpahimatngonan gud kami han tawo nga diri hiya makarawat ha amon kon diri upod namon an amon bugto.
en: But Judah said to him, “The man warned us solemnly, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’

war: Kon tumugot ka nga umupod ha amon an amon bugto, makadto kami ngan mapalit hin pagkaon para ha imo.
en: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

war: Kon diri ka tumugot, diri kami makadto, kay nagsiring ha amon an tawo nga diri gud kami kakarawaton niya gawas kon upod ha amon an amon bugto.”
en: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’ ”

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob, “Kay ano hin pagdad-i niyo ha akon hin damo nga kakurian pinaagi hin pagsumat han tawo nga may-ada pa niyo iba nga bugto?”
en: Israel asked, “Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?”

war: Nagsiring hi Juda ha iya amay, “Paupda ha akon an bata, ngan magkakalakat kami dayon, basi waray ha aton mamamatay hin gutom.
en: Then Judah said to Israel his father, “Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.

war: Kon waray pa kami paghinulat hin maiha, ngada yana makaduha na unta kami pakabalik.”
en: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice.”

war: Pagdara liwat kamo hin duble kadamo nga kwarta, kay kinahanglan igbalik niyo an kwarta nga iginbutang dida ha ganggang han iyo mga sako. Bangin usa la ini nga kalipat.
en: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.

war: Dad-a an iyo bugto, ngan balik kamo dayon.
en: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.

war: Sanglit gindara han magburugto an mga regalo ngan duble kadamo nga kwarta, ngan ginmikan hira para ha Ehipto upod hi Benjamin. Didto pinmakita hira kan Jose.
en: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.

war: Ginbuhat han surugoon sumala han iginsugo ha iya, ngan gindara an magburugto ngadto han balay ni Jose.
en: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph’s house.

war: Sanglit dida han porta han balay, nagsiring hira ngadto han surugoon nga tinaporan,
en: So they went up to Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

war: “Kon mahimo, mano, kinmanhi kami hadto makausa hin pagpalit hin pagkaon.
en: “We beg your pardon, our lord,” they said, “we came down here the first time to buy food.

war: Nagdara liwat kami hin darudamo pa nga kwarta nga igpapalit hin dugang nga pagkaon. Diri kami maaram kon hin-o an nag-uli han amon mga kwarta ngadto han amon mga sako.”
en: We have also brought additional silver with us to buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our sacks.”

war: Gindara han surugoon an magburugto ngadto han balay. Iya gintagan hira hin tubig basi makagpanhimsaw hira, ngan gintubongan niya an ira mga asno.
en: The steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet and provided fodder for their donkeys.

war: Gin-andam nira an ira mga regalo nga ighahatag nira kan Jose kon umabot hiya dida han udto, kay ginsumatan man hira nga makikigsaro hiya ha iya.
en: They prepared their gifts for Joseph’s arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there.

war: Han pag-abot la ni Jose ha balay, gindara nira an regalo ngadto ha iya, ngan nanhapa hira ha iya atubangan.
en: When Joseph came home, they presented to him the gifts they had brought into the house, and they bowed down before him to the ground.

war: Nangumosta hiya ha ira hiunong han ira panlawas ngan katapos nagsiring, “Kumosta man an iyo tatay nga iyo iginsumat ha akon? Buhi pa ba hiya ngan maupay ba an iya panlawas?”
en: He asked them how they were, and then he said, “How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?”

war: Binmaton hira, “Buhi pa ngan maupay man gihapon an amon amay nga imo ubos nga surugoon.” Ngan nanluhod ngan nanyukbo hira ha iya atubangan.
en: They replied, “Your servant our father is still alive and well.” And they bowed down, prostrating themselves before him.

war: Niyan binmaya hi Jose hin kadagmitan kay tugob na gud an iya kasingkasing hin kalooy para han iya bugto. Nag-iitarangis na hiya, sanglit sinmulod hiya han iya kwarto ngan nagtangis.
en: Deeply moved at the sight of his brother, Joseph hurried out and looked for a place to weep. He went into his private room and wept there.

war: Katapos niya maghiramos, ginmawas hiya nga ginpupugngan niya an iya kalugaringon ngan nagsugo hiya nga magdurot na han pagkaon.
en: After he had washed his face, he came out and, controlling himself, said, “Serve the food.”

war: Igsulod ha ganggang han sako han gimamanghori nga bugto an akon kupa nga salapi upod han kwarta nga palit han iya trigo.” Gintuman niya sumala han iginsugo ha iya.
en: Then put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain.” And he did as Joseph said.

war: Timprano pa han pagkaaga, ginpalakat an magburugto dara an ira mga asno.
en: As morning dawned, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.

war: Han paghiabti ha ira han surugoon, iginyakan niya ha ira ini ngahaw nga mga pulong.
en: When he caught up with them, he repeated these words to them.

war: Ira ginbaton hiya, “Ano an karuyag mo sidngon, mano, hin pagyakan mo hin sugad hini? Nagsusumpa kami nga waray gud namon pagbuhata in sugad nga butang.
en: But they said to him, “Why does my lord say such things? Far be it from your servants to do anything like that!

war: Kon hiagian in usa ha amon nga may-ada hini nga kupa, kinahanglan pagpatayon hiya, ngan magigin mga oripon nimo kami ngatanan.”
en: If any of your servants is found to have it, he will die; and the rest of us will become my lord’s slaves.”

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Nauyon ako; kundi hiya la nga nakadara han kupa an magigin akon oripon, ngan mahigagawas-kamo ngatanan han kataragman.”
en: “Very well, then,” he said, “let it be as you say. Whoever is found to have it will become my slave; the rest of you will be free from blame.”

war: Sanglit ginhaw-as dayon nira ha tuna an ira mga sako, ngan ginbukas an sako han kada tawo.
en: Each of them quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.

war: Gin-usisa hin maupay han surugoon ni Jose tikang han gimamagurangi ngadto han gimamanghori, ngan hin-agian an kupa didto han sako ni Benjamin.
en: Then the steward proceeded to search, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest. And the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

war: Ginggisi han magburugto an ira mga panapton tungod hin kabidoan, iginkargahan han mga asno an ira mga sako, ngan binmalik hira ngadto han syudad.
en: At this, they tore their clothes. Then they all loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.

war: Han pag-abot nira Juda ngan han iya kabugtoan ngadto han balay ni Jose, nakadto pa hiya. Nanyukbo hira ha atubangan niya,
en: Joseph was still in the house when Judah and his brothers came in, and they threw themselves to the ground before him.

war: ngan nagsiring hi Jose, “Ano an iyo ginbuhat? Diri ba kamo maaram nga mahibabaroan an iyo ginbubuhat hin usa ka tawo nga sugad ha akon, pinaagi hin pagtag-na?”
en: Joseph said to them, “What is this you have done? Don’t you know that a man like me can find things out by divination?”

war: Ginpakianhan mo kami, ‘May-ada ba niyo amay, o lain nga bugto nga lalake?’
en: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’

war: Ginsiring mo kami hin pagdara ha iya nganhi basi makakita ka ha iya,
en: “Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.’

war: ngan binmaton kami nga diri makakabaya han iya amay an bata; kon buhaton niya ini mapatay an iya amay.
en: And we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.’

war: Niyan nagsiring ka, ‘Diri kamo kakarawaton ha akon atubangan gawas kon umupod ha iyo an iyo gimamanghori nga bugto.’
en: But you told your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’

war: “Han pagbalik namon ngadto han amon amay, amon hiya ginsumatan han imo iginsiring.
en: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.

war: Niyan ginpabalik kami niya ngan ginpapalit hin pagkaon.
en: “Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy a little more food.’

war: Nagsiring ha amon an amon amay, ‘Maaram man kamo nga duha la nga mga anak nga lalake an igin-anak namon ngan hi Raquel nga akon asawa.
en: “Your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

war: Binayaan na ako han usa ha ira. Bangin ginpikaspikas hiya hin magpintas nga mga mananap, kay waray ko na man hiya hikit-i tikang hiya lumakat.
en: One of them went away from me, and I said, “He has surely been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.

war: Kon kuhaon niyo ini nga usa tikang ha akon yana, ngan may-ada mahinabo ha iya makakamatay ha akon an kabidoan nga iyo bubuhaton ha akon kay lagas na ako.’”
en: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.’

war: Uunanhon ko hin pakabalik ngadto han akon amay kon diri ko upod an bata? Diri ako mailob hin pagkita hini nga karat-an nga maabot han akon tatay.”
en: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? No! Do not let me see the misery that would come on my father.”

war: Nagtangis hiya upod in makusog nga mga pagbakho nga hinbatian hiya han mga Ehiptohanon, ngan gindara an sumat ngadto han palasyo han hadi.
en: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household heard about it.

war: Nagsiring hi Jose ngadto han iya kabugtoan, “Amo ako hi Jose. Buhi pa ba an akon amay?” Kundi han pakabati hini han iya kabugtoan, nahadlok hira hin duro nga waray hira pakabaton.
en: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Is my father still living?” But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.

war: Niyan nagsiring ha ira hi Jose, “Alayon duok kamo ngadi.” Dinmuok hira ngan nagsiring hiya, “Amo ako hi Jose nga iyo bugto nga iginbaligya niyo nganhi ha Ehipto.
en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Come close to me.” When they had done so, he said, “I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!

war: Ikaduha pala ka tuig ini nga gutom dinhe ha tuna; may-ada lilima pa ka tuig nga mawawaray pag-arado o pag-ani.
en: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will be no plowing and reaping.

war: Ginpauna ako ha iyo han Dyos hin pagtalwas ha iyo ha sugad hini nga urosahon nga paagi ngan pagsiguro nga mabuhi kamo ngan an iyo mga tulin.
en: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

war: Kon aadto ka na ha Gosen, makakagmangno ako ha iyo. May lilima pa ka tuig nga gutom; ngan diri ko karuyag nga panggutomon ikaw, an imo panimalay, ngan an imo mga hayop.’”
en: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.’

war: Nagpadayon hi Jose, “Yana nakakakita kamo ngatanan, ngan ikaw liwat Benjamin nga amo gud ako hi Jose.
en: “You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.

war: Sumati an akon tatay nga gamhanan na ako dinhe ha Ehipto ngan sumati hiya hiunong han ngatanan nga iyo hinkit-an. Niyan pagdagmit kamo ngan dad-a hiya nganhi.”
en: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”

war: Ginhangkopan niya hi Benjamin nga iya bugto ngan nagtangis hira nga duha; nagtangis liwat hi Benjamin samtang ginggagakos niya hi Jose.
en: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.

war: Ngan samtang nagtitinangis pa hi Jose, ginhangkopan niya an kada usa han iya kabugtoan ngan ginhagkan hira. Katapos hito, nakighimangraw na ha iya an iya kabugtoan.
en: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.

war: Han pag-abot han sumat ngadto ha palasyo nga nagkaabot an kabugtoan ni Jose, nalipay an hadi ngan an iya mga opisyal.
en: When the news reached Pharaoh’s palace that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.

war: Nagsiring an hadi kan Jose, “Sidnga an imo kabugtoan nga kargahan an ira mga hayop ngan bumalik hira ngadto han tuna han Canaan.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,

war: Ipakuha ha ira an ira amay ngan an ira mga panimalay, ngan pabalika hira nganhi. Ighahatag ko ha ira an gimamaupayi nga tuna dinhe ha Ehipto, ngan mahuhura hira hin pagkaon.
en: and bring your father and your families back to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you can enjoy the fat of the land.’

war: Diri hira angay mabaraka hin pagbaya han ira mga butang; magtatag-iya hira han gimamaupayi dinhe han bug-os nga tuna han Ehipto.”
en: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.’ ”

war: Gintuman han mga anak ni Jacob sumala han iginsiring ha ira. Gintagan hira ni Jose hin mga karomata ngan pagkaon para han ira paglalaktan sumala han iginsugo han hadi.
en: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.

war: Gintagan liwat niya hin liliwanan nga panapton an kada usa ha ira, kundi gintagan niya hi Benjamin hin tulo ka gatos ka bug-os nga salapi ngan lima nga liliwanan nga mga panapton.
en: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

war: Ginpagikan niya an iya kabugtoan ngan han nalakat na hira, gintugon niya hira, “Ayaw kamo pag-aruaraway dida han dalan.”
en: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, “Don’t quarrel on the way!”

war: Ginmawas hira han Ehipto ngan nangoli hira ngadto kan Jacob nga ira amay didto ha Canaan.
en: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

war: Ira ginsumatan hiya, “Buhi pa hi Jose! Amo hiya an punoan han bug-os nga Ehipto!” Nahitingala hi Jacob, ngan waray gud hiya anay tutuod ha ira.
en: They told him, “Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt.” Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Buhi pa hi Jose nga akon anak! Amo la ini an akon pinangangaro. Kinahanglan kumadto ako ngan hikit-an ko hiya san-o ako mamatay.”
en: And Israel said, “I’m convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

war: Namutos ni Jacob han ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi ngan kinmadto hiya ha Berseba, diin naghalad hiya hin mga halad nga tinubod ngadto han Dyos ni Isaac nga iya amay.
en: So Israel set out with all that was his, and when he reached Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

war: Naghimangraw ha iya an Dyos dida hin usa nga panan-awon ha gab-i ngan nagtawag, “Jacob, Jacob!” Binmaton hiya, “Oo, aadi ako.”
en: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, “Jacob! Jacob!” “Here I am,” he replied.

war: “Amo ako an Dyos nga Dyos han imo amay,” nagsiring an Dyos. “Ayaw kahadlok hin pagkadto ha Ehipto; didto hihimoon ko nga dako nga nasod an imo mga tulin.
en: “I am God, the God of your father,” he said. “Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.

war: Maupod ako ha imo ngadto ha Ehipto ngan igbabalik ko an imo mga tulin nganhi hini nga tuna. Aada ha imo kagiliran hi Jose kon mamatay ka.”
en: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph’s own hand will close your eyes.”

war: Gindara nira an ira mga hayop ngan an mga hiagi nga naangkon nira didto ha Canaan, ngan kinmadto hira ha Ehipto. Ginpaupod ni Jacob an ngatanan niya nga mga tulin:
en: So Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt, taking with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan.

war: Amo ini an mga kaapi han panimalay ni Jacob nga inmupod ha iya ngadto ha Ehipto: an gimamagurangi nga anak ni Jacob nga hi Ruben,
en: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.

war: ngan an mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Ruben: hira Hanoc, Falu, Hesron, ug Carmi.
en: The sons of Reuben: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.

war: Hi Simeon ngan an iya mga anak: hira Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jaquin, Zohar, ug Saul nga anak hin babaye nga Canaanhon.
en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

war: Hi Levi ngan an iya mga anak: hira Gerson, Coat, ug Merari.
en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

war: Hi Isacar ngan an iya mga anak: hira Tola, Pua, Jasub, ug Simron.
en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.

war: Hi Zabulon ngan an iya mga anak: hira Sered, Elon, ug Jaleel.
en: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.

war: Hi Gad ngan an iya mga anak: hira Sifeon, Hagi, Suni, Ezbon, Eri, Arod, ug Areli.
en: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.

war: Hi Aser ngan an iya mga anak: hira Jimna, Isva, Isvi, Beria, ug hi Sera nga ira bugto nga babaye. Hira Heber ug Malkiel nga mga anak ni Beria.
en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.

war: Amo ini nga 16 an mga tulin nira Jacob ug Zilpa nga oripon nga babaye nga iginhatag ni Laban kan Lea nga iya anak.
en: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.

war: Nag-anak hira Raquel ug Jacob hin duha nga lalake: hira Jose ug Benjamin.
en: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

war: May duha nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an hi Jose didto ha Ehipto: hira Manases ug Efraim, pinaagi kan Asenat nga anak ni Potifera nga padi didto ha Heliopolis.
en: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

war: Hira Bela, Bequer, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim, ug Ard nga mga anak ni Benjamin.
en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.

war: Amo ini nga 14 an mga tulin nira Jacob ug Raquel.
en: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob—fourteen in all.

war: Hi Dan ngan hi Husim nga iya anak.
en: The son of Dan: Hushim.

war: Hi Neftali ngan an iya mga anak: hira Jazeel, Guni, Jezer, ug Silem.
en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.

war: Amo ini nga pito an mga tulin nira Jacob ug Bilha nga oripon nga babaye nga iginhatag ni Laban kan Raquel nga iya anak.
en: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.

war: Sesenta y seis ka tawo ngatanan an mga tulin ni Jacob nga kinmadto ha Ehipto, waray labot han kaasaw-an han iya mga anak.
en: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob—those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons’ wives—numbered sixty-six persons.

war: Natawo kan Jose didto ha Ehipto in duha nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan naabot hin 70 ka tawo ngatanan han panimalay ni Jacob an kinmadto ha Ehipto.
en: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.

war: Ginpauna ni Jacob hi Juda hin paghangyo kan Jose nga tapoon hira didto ha Gosen. Han pag-abot la nira,
en: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob kan Jose, “Andam na ako hin kamatay, yana nga hinkit-an ko na ikaw ngan maaram na ako nga buhi ka pa ngay-an.”
en: Israel said to Joseph, “Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive.”

war: Kon tawgon kamo han hadi ngan magpakiana kon ano an iyo pagpakabuhi,
en: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’

war: Niyan iginpakilala niya han hadi an iya kabugtoan.
en: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.

war: Ginpakianhan hira han hadi, “Ano an iyo pakabuhi?” Binmaton hira, “Magmarangno kami hin kahayopan, sugad han amon kaapoy-apoyan.
en: Pharaoh asked the brothers, “What is your occupation?” “Your servants are shepherds,” they replied to Pharaoh, “just as our fathers were.”

war: Nagsiring an hadi kan Jose, “Yana nga nagkaabot na an imo amay ngan an imo kabugtoan,
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Your father and your brothers have come to you,

war: Niyan gindara ni Jose hi Jacob nga iya amay ngan iginpakilala hiya han hadi. Ginbendisyonan ni Jacob an hadi,
en: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,

war: ngan ginpakianhan hiya han hadi, “Pira na an imo panuigon?”
en: Pharaoh asked him, “How old are you?”

war: Ginbendisyonan ni Jacob hin panamilit an hadi, ngan linmakat hiya.
en: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.

war: Naghatag hi Jose hin pagkaon para han iya amay, han iya kabugtoan, ngan han ngatanan nga sakop han panimalay han iya amay, lakip an mga kabataan.
en: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their children.

war: Grabe na hin duro an gutom nga waray na gud pagkaon bisan diin ngan nagtikaluya na tungod hin kagutom an mga tawo han Ehipto ug Canaan.
en: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.

war: Samtang namamalit an mga tawo hin liniso, gintirok ni Jose an ngatanan nga kwarta ngan gindara ini niya ngadto han palasyo.
en: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh’s palace.

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Dad-a an iyo mga baka; babalyoon ko ini hin pagkaon kon waray na niyo kwarta.”
en: “Then bring your livestock,” said Joseph. “I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone.”

war: Ginhimo ni Jose nga mga oripon an mga tawo tikang ha usa ngadto ha luyo nga kataposan han Ehipto.
en: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.

war: Nagsiring hi Jose ha mga tawo, “Hinkit-an niyo nga ginpalit ko na kamo ngan an iyo mga tuna para han hadi. Iini in binhe para hin pagpugas didto han iyo kaumhan.
en: Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.

war: Binmaton hira, “Gintalwas mo an amon mga kinabuhi; kinalooyan mo kami, ngan mga oripon kami han hadi.”
en: “You have saved our lives,” they said. “May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh.”

war: Nag-ukoy an mga Israelita didto ha Ehipto, didto han katunaan han Gosen, diin nagriko hira ngan nagdamo an ira mga anak.
en: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.

war: Nag-ukoy hi Jacob didto ha Ehipto hin 17 ka tuig, tubtob han pag-abot hin 147 an iya panuigon.
en: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob, “Pagsumpa nga pagbubuhaton mo ini.” Nagsumpa hi Jose, ngan nagpasalamat han Dyos hi Jacob dida han iya higdaan.
en: “Swear to me,” he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

war: Han pagsumati la kan Jacob nga inmabot hi Jose hin pakigkita ha iya, naniguro hiya hin paglingkod dida han higdaan.
en: When Jacob was told, “Your son Joseph has come to you,” Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob kan Jose, “Pinmakita ha akon an Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum didto ha Luz, didto ha tuna han Canaan, ngan ginbendisyonan ako.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me

war: Kon may-ada pa nimo iba nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, diri hira pag-iisipon nga akon; maaangkon nira an ira panurundon pinaagi kanda Efraim ug Manases.
en: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.

war: Han paghikit-i la ni Jacob han mga anak ni Jose, nagpakiana hiya, “Hira hin-o ini?”
en: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Amo ini an akon mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga ginhatag han Dyos ha akon dinhe ha Ehipto.” Nagsiring hi Jacob, “Dad-a hira ngadi ha akon, basi pagbendisyonan ko hira.”
en: “They are the sons God has given me here,” Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, “Bring them to me so I may bless them.”

war: Harap na hi Jacob tungod han iya panuigon ngan diri na hiya nakita hin maupay. Gindara ni Jose an kabataan ngadto ha iya ngan iya ginhangkopan ngan ginhadkan hira.
en: Now Israel’s eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.

war: Nagsiring hi Jacob kan Jose, “Waray na gud ako paghunahuna nga igkita ko pa ikaw, kundi yana ginpakita pa ngani ako han Dyos han imo mga anak.”
en: Israel said to Joseph, “I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too.”

war: Niyan ginkuha ni Jose tikang han mga paa ni Jacob an mga bata, ngan hinmapa hi Jose ha atubangan ni Jacob.
en: Then Joseph removed them from Israel’s knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.

war: Ginsiring niya an iya tatay, “Diri amo ito, tatay. Amo ini an magurang nga bata; igpandong ha iya ulo an imo tuo nga kamot.”
en: Joseph said to him, “No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jacob kan Jose, “Sayod ka nga diri maiha mapatay na ako, kundi maupod ha imo an Dyos ngan igbabalik ka niya ngadto han tuna han imo kaapoy-apoyan.
en: Then Israel said to Joseph, “I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.

war: Ihinahatag ko ha imo ngan diri ngadto han imo kabugtoan an Siquem, ito nga malangbo nga tuna nga akon naagaw tikang han mga Amoreohanon pinaagi han akon espada ngan han akon pana.”
en: And to you I give one more ridge of land than to your brothers, the ridge I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow.”

war: Gintawag ni Jacob an iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngan ginsiring, “Pag-alirong kamo ha akon, ngan pagsusumatan ko kamo han mahinanabo ha iyo ha tiarabot nga panahon:
en: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: “Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.

war: “Pag-alirong ngan pamati kamo mga anak ni Jacob. Pamati kan Israel nga iyo amay.
en: “Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.

war: “Ruben nga akon suhag, amo ikaw an akon kusog, Ngan an syahan nga anak han akon pagkabatan-on, An labi hin ka parayawnon ngan labi hin ka makusog han ngatanan ko nga mga anak.
en: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.

war: Sugad ka hin nahaganas nga baha, Kundi diri ka mahihimo nga labi hin ka gamhanan, Kay nakighilawas ka han akon aruasawa, Ngan ginhugawan mo an higdaan han imo amay.
en: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father’s bed, onto my couch and defiled it.

war: “Magbugto hira Simeon ug Levi. Ginagamit nira hin paglupig an ira mga hinganiban.
en: “Simeon and Levi are brothers— their swords are weapons of violence.

war: “Juda, pagdadayawon ka han imo kabugtoan. Kinakaptan mo ha liog an imo mga kaaway. Mayukbo ha imo atubangan an imo kabugtoan.
en: “Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons will bow down to you.

war: Sugad hin liyon hi Juda, Nga napatay han iya natutukob ngan nabalik ngadto han iya pahuwayan, Ngan didto naunat ngan naluob. Waray gud nagpapasipara hin pagsamok ha iya.
en: You are a lion’s cub, Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse him?

war: Kakaptan ni Juda an hadianon nga tungkod, Ngan dayuday maghahadi an iya mga tulin. Magdadara ha iya hin halad an kanasoran Ngan mayukbo hin pagsugot ha iya atubangan.
en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his.

war: Magpula an iya mga mata tungod hin pag-ininom hin bino, Magbusag an iya mga ngipon tungod hin pag-ininom hin gatas.
en: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.

war: “Mag-uokoy ha ligid han dagat hi Zabulon. Magigin dunggoanan hin mga sakayan an iya baybayon. Maabot ha Sidon an iya katunaan.
en: “Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.

war: “Pareho la hin asno hi Isacar Nga naunat hin pagluob ha butnga han mga magbug-at nga mga dara han asno.
en: “Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down among the sheep pens.

war: Tungod nga nakita man hiya nga maupay an dapit nga pahuwayan Ngan makalilipay an tuna, Sanglit nakaob hiya hin pagdara han karga, Ngan napipirit hiya hin pagtrabaho sugad hin oripon.
en: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.

war: “Mahihinto nga pangulo han iya katawhan hi Dan. Masusugad hira han iba nga mga tribo han Israel.
en: “Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

war: Magigin usa nga halas hi Dan dida ha ligid han dalan, Usa nga malara nga halas ha ligid han aragian, Nga natukob han tikod han kabayo, Sanglit nahuhulog ha luyo an nangangabayo.
en: Dan will be a snake by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.

war: “Naghuhulat ako han imo pagtalwas, O Ginoo .
en: “I look for your deliverance, Lord .

war: “Pagsusulongon hi Gad hin hugpo hin mga tikasan, Kundi aasdangon ngan lalanaton niya hira.
en: “Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.

war: “Mabunga hin magrasa nga pagkaon an tuna ni Aser. Mahatag hiya hin pagkaon nga angay para hin usa nga hadi.
en: “Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.

war: “Usa nga layaw nga bugsok hi Neftali, Nga nag-aanak hin magtahom nga mga nati.
en: “Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

war: “Sugad hi Jose hin ihalas nga asno ha ligid hin burabod, Sugad hin mailayat nga nati hin kabayo ha ligid hin pungtod.
en: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.

war: Sinusulong hiya hin waray kalooy han iya mga kaaway, Ngan ginlalanat hiya han ira mga pana.
en: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.

war: “Sugad hin mapintas nga lubo hi Benjamin. Pinapatay an iya tinutukob ngan kinakaon adlaw gab-i.”
en: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”

war: Amo ini an dose nga mga tribo han Israel. Amo liwat ini an ginhimangraw han ira amay han pagpanamilit niya han tagsa niya nga anak.
en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.

war: didto ha Macpela ha sinirangan nga dapit han Mamre ha tuna han Canaan. Ginpalit ni Abraham kan Efron nga Hiteohanon ini nga lungib ngan uma para hin lubnganan.
en: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.

war: Amo ito an ginlubngan nira kan Abraham ngan kan Sara nga iya asawa; amo ito an ira ginlubngan kan Isaac ngan kan Rebecca nga iya asawa; ngan amo ito an akon ginlubngan kan Lea.
en: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.

war: Ginpalit tikang han mga Hiteohanon an uma ngan an lungib nga aada hini. Iglubong ako niyo didto.”
en: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. ”

war: Han katapos ni Jacob pagtugon han iya mga anak, hinmigda hiya ngan namatay.
en: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.

war: Hinangkopan dayon ni Jose an iya amay ngan nagtinangis nga naghihinarok han iya bayhon.
en: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.

war: Niyan nagsugo hi Jose hin pagembalsamar han lawas han iya amay.
en: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,

war: Inmabot hini hin kwarenta ka adlaw nga amo an nahigaraan nga panahon hin pag-embalsamar. Nagmabidoon an mga Ehiptohanon sulod hin 70 ka adlaw para han amay ni Jose.
en: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Kadto na ngan iglubong an imo amay sumala han imo iginsumpa.”
en: Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”

war: Binmunyog liwat ha iya in mga tawo nga mga dikaruwahe, ngan mga dikabayo; dako hin duro adto nga hugpo.
en: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.

war: Sanglit ginbuhat han mga anak ni Jacob sumala han iginsugo niya ha ira;
en: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:

war: Katapos iglubong ni Jose an iya amay, binmalik hiya ngadto ha Ehipto upod an iya kabugtoan ngan an ngatanan nga inmupod ha iya han paglubong.
en: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.

war: Sanglit nagpadara hira kan Jose hini nga mensahe: “Han waray pa kamamatay an aton amay,
en: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Your father left these instructions before he died:

war: Niyan nagkaabot an iya kabugtoan ngahaw ngan nanhapa ha iya atubangan. Nagsiring hira, “Aanhi kami ha imo atubangan sugad nga imo mga oripon.”
en: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. “We are your slaves,” they said.

war: Kundi nagsiring ha ira hi Jose, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Diri ako makakahimo hin pagsaliwan han Dyos.
en: But Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

war: Waray niyo sadang kahadlokan. Pagmamangnoan ko kamo ngan an iyo mga anak.” Sanglit iya ginpasarig hira pinaagi hin maloloy-on nga mga pulong nga nakabantad han ira mga kasingkasing.
en: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children.” And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jose hin pag-ukoy didto ha Ehipto upod han panimalay han iya amay; 110 na an iya panuigon han kamatay niya.
en: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years

war: Nahiabot pa hiya han mga anak ngan mga apo ni Efraim. Nahiabot pa liwat hiya hin pagkarawat ngadto han iya panimalay han mga anak ni Maquir nga anak ni Manases.
en: and saw the third generation of Ephraim’s children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph’s knees.

war: Niyan ginhangyo ni Jose an iya mga tawo hin pagsumpa. Nagsiring hiya, “Pagsaari ako niyo nga kon pagdad-on na kamo han Dyos ngadto hito nga tuna, pagdadad-on man niyo ngadto an akon lawas.”
en: And Joseph made the Israelites swear an oath and said, “God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”

war: Sanglit namatay hi Jose didto ha Ehipto ha panuigon nga 110. Ira gin-embalsamar an iya lawas, ngan iginsulod ini dida hin usa nga lungon.
en: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.

war: Han naglabay nga panahon nagyakan an Dyos ngadto han aton mga kaapoy-apoyan pinaagi han mga manaragna ha makadamo ug magkalainlain nga mga paagi.
en: In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

war: Ginhimo an Anak nga larulabaw gud kay han mga anghel, sugad nga larulabaw gud an ngaran nga iginhatag ha iya han Dyos kay han ira mga ngaran.
en: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.

war: Han harapit na ipadara han Dyos an iya suhag nganhi ha kalibutan, nagsiring hiya, “Kinahanglan magsingba ha iya an ngatanan nga mga anghel han Dyos.”
en: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, “Let all God’s angels worship him.”

war: Amo ini an ginsiring han Dyos hiunong han mga anghel: “Ginhihimo han Dyos sugad hin mga hangin an iya mga anghel, ngan sugad hin mga laga hin kalayo an iya mga surugoon.”
en: In speaking of the angels he says, “He makes his angels spirits, and his servants flames of fire.”

war: Kundi mahitungod han Anak, nagsiring an Dyos: “Magpapadayon han kagihaponan an imo trono, O Dyos! Naghahadi ka han imo mga tawo pinaagi hin katadongan.
en: But about the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

war: Nalilipay ka han matadong ngan nagdudumot ka han maraot, sanglit ginpili ka han Dyos, an imo Dyos, ngan ginlipay ka hin kadungganan nga labaw pa gud han iginhatag ha imo mga kaupod.”
en: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.”

war: Nagsiring pa an Dyos, “Ikaw, Ginoo, ha tinikangan, an naghimo han tuna ngan pinaagi han imo kalugaringon nga mga kamot ginhimo mo an kalangitan.
en: He also says, “In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

war: Maaanaw hira ngatanan, kundi magpapabilin ka; madadaan hira ngatanan sugad hin mga panapton.
en: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

war: Lulukoton mo hira sugad hin bado, ngan pagliliwanan hira sugad hin mga panapton. Kundi dayuday amo ka gud la gihapon ngan an imo kinabuhi waray kataposan.”
