en: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the stone images and escaped to Seirah.

war: Hito nga adlaw pinamatay nira in mga 10,000 han gimamag-upayi nga mga sondalo nga Moabita; waray gud ha ira nakakalagiw.
en: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not one escaped.

war: Hito nga adlaw ginpirde han mga Israelita an Moab, ngan nagkamay-ada kalinaw didto han tuna sulod hin 80 ka tuig.
en: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.

war: An sunod nga maghurukom amo hi Samgar nga anak ni Anat. Gintalwas liwat niya an Israel pinaagi hin pagpatay hin 600 nga mga Filisteohanon pinaagi hin iturugsok hin irong hin baka.
en: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.

war: Han kamatay ni Ehud, nakasala na liwat han Ginoo an mga tawo han Israel.
en: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , now that Ehud was dead.

war: Sanglit itinugot han Ginoo nga mabihag hira ni Jabin, usa nga Canaanhon nga hadi nga naghadi ha syudad han Hasor. An pangulo han iya kasondalohan amo hi Sisera nga nag-ukoy didto ha Haroset.
en: So the Lord sold them into the hands of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. Sisera, the commander of his army, was based in Harosheth Haggoyim.

war: Hadto nga panahon an maghurukom han Israel amo hi Debora, nga asawa ni Lapidot, ngan usa hiya nga manaragna.
en: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

war: Niyan binmaton hi Barac, “Makadto ako kon umupod ka ha akon, kundi kon diri ka umupod, diri man ako makadto.”
en: Barak said to her, “If you go with me, I will go; but if you don’t go with me, I won’t go.”

war: Gintawag ni Barac ngadto ha Cades an mga tribo nira Zabulon ug Neftali, ngan sinmunod ha iya in 10,000 nga mga tawo. Inmupod ha iya hi Debora.
en: There Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali, and ten thousand men went up under his command. Deborah also went up with him.

war: Han paghibaro ni Sisera nga sinmagka hi Barac han Bukid Tabor,
en: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,

war: gintirok niya an iya 900 nga puthaw nga mga karuwahe ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo, ngan ginpadara hira tikang ha Haroset ngadto han Salog Cison.
en: Sisera summoned from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River all his men and his nine hundred chariots fitted with iron.

war: Kinmalagiw hi Sisera ngadto han tulda ni Jael nga asawa ni Heber nga Kenitanhon, kay sangkay man han panimalay ni Heber hi Hadi Jabin han Hasor.
en: Sisera, meanwhile, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was an alliance between Jabin king of Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.

war: Niyan ginsiring niya hi Jael, “Tindog didto ha porta han tulda, ngan kon may umabot ngan pumakiana ha imo kon may tawo dinhe, sidnga nga waray.”
en: “Stand in the doorway of the tent,” he told her. “If someone comes by and asks you, ‘Is anyone in there?’ say ‘No.’ ”

war: Hito nga adlaw ginpadaog han Dyos an mga Israelita kontra kan Jabin nga Canaanhon nga Hadi.
en: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.

war: Ginpakurian gud hiya nira ngada han kamatay niya.
en: And the hand of the Israelites pressed harder and harder against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.

war: Hito nga adlaw ginkanta nira Debora ug Barac ini nga kanta:
en: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:

war: Dayawa an Ginoo ! Nagtinguha hin pakig-away an mga Israelita; binmulig nga malipayon an mga tawo.
en: “When the princes in Israel take the lead, when the people willingly offer themselves— praise the Lord !

war: Pamati, kamo nga kahadian! Pamati, kamo nga mga punoan! Magkakanta ngan magtotokar ako ngadto han Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel.
en: “Hear this, you kings! Listen, you rulers! I, even I, will sing to the Lord ; I will praise the Lord , the God of Israel, in song.

war: O Ginoo , han pagbaya mo han kabukiran han Seir, han paggawas mo tikang han katunaan han Edumea, nabay-og an tuna ngan inmuran tikang ha langit. Oo, nahuwad in tubig tikang han kadampogan.
en: “When you, Lord , went out from Seir, when you marched from the land of Edom, the earth shook, the heavens poured, the clouds poured down water.

war: Nangurog an kabukiran ha atubangan han Ginoo han Sinai, ha atubangan han Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel.
en: The mountains quaked before the Lord , the One of Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel.

war: Ha mga adlaw ni Samgar nga anak ni Anat, ha mga adlaw ni Jael, waray na mga magbaraktas nga nagtalabok han tuna, ngan ginamit han mga naglalakaton an diri baraktasan nga mga dalan.
en: “In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were abandoned; travelers took to winding paths.

war: Binayaan na an mga bungto han Israel, O Debora; pinasagdan na la ini ngada han imo pag-abot, han imo pag-abot nga sugad hin usa nga iroy para han Israel.
en: Villagers in Israel would not fight; they held back until I, Deborah, arose, until I arose, a mother in Israel.

war: Niyan nagkamay-ada araway didto han tuna han paggapil han mga Israelita hin bag-o nga kadiyosan. Han 40,000 nga mga tawo ha Israel, may-ada ba ha ira nagdara hin taming o bangkaw?
en: God chose new leaders when war came to the city gates, but not a shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel.

war: Naduyog an akon kasingkasing han mga pangulo han Israel, han mga tawo nga binmulig nga malipayon. Dayawa an Ginoo !
en: My heart is with Israel’s princes, with the willing volunteers among the people. Praise the Lord !

war: Igsumat ini, kamo nga nasakay hin busag nga mga asno, nga nasakay ha mga montora, ngan kamo nga kinahanglan magbaktas bisan pumakain kamo.
en: “You who ride on white donkeys, sitting on your saddle blankets, and you who walk along the road, consider

war: Pag-una, Debora, pag-una! Pag-una! Pagkanta! Pag-una! Padayon, Barac nga anak ni Abinoam, dad-a an imo mga bihag!
en: ‘Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, break out in song! Arise, Barak! Take captive your captives, son of Abinoam.’

war: Niyan linmugsong an mga magtinumanon ngadto han ira mga pangulo; kinmadto ha iya an mga tawo han Ginoo nga andam hin pakig-away.
en: “The remnant of the nobles came down; the people of the Lord came down to me against the mighty.

war: Kay ano nga nagpabilen man hira upod han mga karnero? Hin pamati han mga magmarangno nga nagtatawag han mga panon? Oo, nabahin an tribo ni Ruben; waray hira magkaarasya hin pagkanhi.
en: Why did you stay among the sheep pens to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.

war: Kundi an mga tawo han Zabulon ug Neftali nag-unong han ira mga kinabuhi didto han pag-awayan.
en: The people of Zebulun risked their very lives; so did Naphtali on the terraced fields.

war: Didto ha Tanac, ha ligid han sapa han Megido, nagkaabot ngan nag-araway an kahadian; nag-araway an kahadian han Canaan, kundi waray hira natikas nga salapi.
en: “Kings came, they fought, the kings of Canaan fought. At Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo, they took no plunder of silver.

war: Nakig-away an kabitun-an tikang ha langit; han paglatas hini han kalangitan, nakig-away ini kontra kan Sisera.
en: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

war: Gin-anod hira hin usa nga baha didto han Cison— han masulog hin duro nga Salog Cison. Magbabaktas ako, magpapadayon hin pagbaktas ngan mangungusog ako.
en: The river Kishon swept them away, the age-old river, the river Kishon. March on, my soul; be strong!

war: Niyan nagkaabot an mga kabayo nga nagdadadlagan, nga an ira mga tiil nagbabandok han tuna.
en: Then thundered the horses’ hooves— galloping, galloping go his mighty steeds.

war: An labi ka palaran han kababayen-an amo hi Jael, nga asawa ni Heber nga Kenitanhon— an labi ka palaran han kababayen-an nga nag-uokoy ha mga tulda.
en: “Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, most blessed of tent-dwelling women.

war: Nangaro hin tubig hi Sisera, kundi tinagan hiya hin gatas; gindad-an hiya hin keso dida hin mahusay nga makaong.
en: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl fit for nobles she brought him curdled milk.

war: Nahipaluhod hiya, natumba ngan nahipahigda ngan ginsipitan han tiil ni Jael. Ha tiilan ni Jael nahipaluhod hiya ngan natumba; natumba hiya nga patay ha tuna.
en: At her feet he sank, he fell; there he lay. At her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell—dead.

war: Ginbaton hiya han iya mag-aram nga kababayen-an, ngan hiya la an binmaton han iya kalugaringon.
en: The wisest of her ladies answer her; indeed, she keeps saying to herself,

war: Nakasala na liwat han Ginoo an mga tawo han Israel, sanglit nasakop hira han mga tawo han Madian sulod hin pito ka tuig.
en: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , and for seven years he gave them into the hands of the Midianites.

war: Makurukusog an mga Madianitanhon kay han Israel, ngan nanago an mga tawo han Israel ha mga lungib ngan ha mga dapit didto han kapungtoran.
en: Because the power of Midian was so oppressive, the Israelites prepared shelters for themselves in mountain clefts, caves and strongholds.

war: Kada pagtatanom han mga Israelita, sinusulong hira han mga Madianitanhon upod an mga Amalekanhon ngan an mga tribo ha kamingawan.
en: Whenever the Israelites planted their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites and other eastern peoples invaded the country.

war: ngan waray mahihimo han Israel hin pagkontra ha ira.
en: Midian so impoverished the Israelites that they cried out to the Lord for help.

war: Niyan nagtawag an mga tawo han Israel ngadto han Ginoo hin pakibulig kontra han mga Madianitanhon.
en: When the Israelites cried out to the Lord because of Midian,

war: Pinmakita ha iya didto an anghel han Ginoo ngan nagsiring, “Aada ha imo an Ginoo , ikaw nga maisog ngan kusgan nga tawo!”
en: When the angel of the Lord appeared to Gideon, he said, “The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.”

war: Niyan ginsugo hiya han Ginoo , “Lakat ngan gamita an bug-os mo nga kusog ngan talwasa an Israel ha mga Madianitanhon. Ako ngahaw an nagsusugo ha imo.”
en: The Lord turned to him and said, “Go in the strength you have and save Israel out of Midian’s hand. Am I not sending you?”

war: Binmaton hi Gideon, “Kundi, Ginoo , uunanhon ko hin pakatalwas han Israel? An akon banay amo an giluluyahi dida han tribo ni Manases, ngan ako an giuubosi nga sakop han akon panimalay.”
en: “Pardon me, my lord,” Gideon replied, “but how can I save Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my family.”

war: Nagbaton an Ginoo , “Makakahimo ka hini kay bubuligan ko ikaw. Dudugmokon mo an mga Madianitanhon sugad kamasayon hin pagdugmok mo hin usa la hira ka tawo.”
en: The Lord answered, “I will be with you, and you will strike down all the Midianites, leaving none alive.”

war: Binmaton hi Gideon, “Kon nalilipay ka ha akon, tagi ako hin tigaman nga ikaw amo an Ginoo .
en: Gideon replied, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, give me a sign that it is really you talking to me.

war: Ayaw gad anay paglakat ngada han pagduroti ko ha imo hin usa nga halad nga pagkaon.” Nagsiring hiya, “Mahulat ako ngada han imo pagbalik.”
en: Please do not go away until I come back and bring my offering and set it before you.” And the Lord said, “I will wait until you return.”

war: Ginsiring hiya han anghel, “Ibutang an karne ngan an tinapay ha bawbaw hini nga bato, ngan ipisa an sabaw ngada hini nga bato.” Gintuman ini ni Gideon.
en: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened bread, place them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” And Gideon did so.

war: Niyan nakasabot hi Gideon nga anghel han Ginoo adto nga iya hinkit-an, ngan nagsiring hiya ha dako nga kahadlok, “O Ginoo nga Dyos! Hinkit-an ko gud an imo anghel ngan nagkaatubang gud kami!”
en: When Gideon realized that it was the angel of the Lord , he exclaimed, “Alas, Sovereign Lord ! I have seen the angel of the Lord face to face!”

war: Kundi nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “An kamurayaw maada ha imo! Ayaw kahadlok. Diri ka mapatay.”
en: But the Lord said to him, “Peace! Do not be afraid. You are not going to die.”

war: Naggiparupakiana hira, “Hin-o an nagbuhat hini?” Gin-usisa nira ngan hinbaroan nga hi Gideon nga anak ni Joas amo an nagbuhat hini.
en: They asked each other, “Who did this?” When they carefully investigated, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did it.”

war: Tikang hadto kinilala hi Gideon nga Jerobaal, kay nagsiring man hi Joas, “Maglugaring hi Baal hin pagpanalipod ha iya ngahaw, kay altar adto niya nga ginruba.”
en: So because Gideon broke down Baal’s altar, they gave him the name Jerub-Baal that day, saying, “Let Baal contend with him.”

war: Niyan nagtitirok an ngatanan nga mga Madianitanhon, mga Amalekanhon, ngan an mga tribo ha kamingawan, tinmabok hira han Salog Jordan ngan nagkampo didto han Kahamub-an Jezrael.
en: Now all the Midianites, Amalekites and other eastern peoples joined forces and crossed over the Jordan and camped in the Valley of Jezreel.

war: Sinmakob kan Gideon an espiritu han Ginoo , ngan nagtrompeta hiya hin pagtawag han kalalaken-an han banay ni Abiezer nga sumunod ha iya.
en: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet, summoning the Abiezrites to follow him.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Gideon ngadto han Dyos, “Nagsiring ka nga gagamiton mo ako hin pagtalwas han Israel.
en: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand as you have promised—

war: Hito nga gab-i ginbuhat han Dyos an iya ginhangyo han Ginoo . Han pagkaaga na, mamara an barahibo han karnero, kundi mahulos hin tun-og an tuna.
en: That night God did so. Only the fleece was dry; all the ground was covered with dew.

war: May-ada 300 nga mga tawo nga nagsalod hin tubig ha ira mga kamot ngan ginlaklak ini; linmuhod an ngatanan nga iba hin pag-inom.
en: Three hundred of them drank from cupped hands, lapping like dogs. All the rest got down on their knees to drink.

war: Hito nga gab-i ginsugo hi Gideon han Ginoo , “Buhat ngan sulonga an kampo, ipadadaog ko ini ha imo.
en: During that night the Lord said to Gideon, “Get up, go down against the camp, because I am going to give it into your hands.

war: Kundi kon nahahadlok ka hin pagsulong, lugsong ngadto han kampo upod hi Pura nga imo surugoon.
en: If you are afraid to attack, go down to the camp with your servant Purah

war: Iya ginsiring hira, “Kon umabot ako ha ligid han kampo, paginawia ako niyo, ngan subara niyo an akon bubuhaton.
en: “Watch me,” he told them. “Follow my lead. When I get to the edge of the camp, do exactly as I do.

war: Kon magpatunog hin trompeta ako ngan han akon hugpo, amo gihapon an iyo buhata palibot han kampo ngan goliat kamo, ‘Para han Ginoo ngan para kan Gideon!’”
en: When I and all who are with me blow our trumpets, then from all around the camp blow yours and shout, ‘For the Lord and for Gideon.’ ”

war: Tinmindog an kada tawo ha iya dapit palibot han kampo, ngan nagdadlagan upod an pagsinggit an ngatanan nga kaaway nga kasondalohan.
en: While each man held his position around the camp, all the Midianites ran, crying out as they fled.

war: Niyan gintawag in mga tawo tikang han mga tribo nira Neftali, Aser, ug han duha nga bahin han Manases, ngan ira ginbukod an mga Madianitanhon.
en: Israelites from Naphtali, Asher and all Manasseh were called out, and they pursued the Midianites.

war: Hini nga panahon nakaabot ngan nakatabok na han Salog Jordan hi Gideon ngan an iya tulo ka gatos nga mga tawo. Kinakapoy na hira, kundi nagpapadayon gihapon hin pagbukod han ira mga kaaway.
en: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit, came to the Jordan and crossed it.

war: Kundi nagsiring an mga pangulo han Socot, “Kay ano nga tatagan namon hin pagkaon an imo kasondalohan? Waray pa ngani nimo mabihag hira Zeba ug Zalmuna.”
en: But the officials of Sukkoth said, “Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your troops?”

war: Nagpadayon hi Gideon ngadto ha Penuel ngan naghangyo gihapon han mga tawo didto hin pagkaon, kundi iginhatag han mga tawo han Penuel in sugad nga baton han mga tawo han Socot.
en: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Sukkoth had.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Mabalik ako nga waray ako maano, ngan kon bumalik na ako, rurumpagon ko ini nga torre!”
en: So he said to the men of Peniel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Gideon didto han dalan ha ligid han kamingawan nga sinirangan han Noba ug Jogbeha, ngan ginpakalasan hin pagsulong an kasondalohan.
en: Gideon went up by the route of the nomads east of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the unsuspecting army.

war: Namalagiw hira Zeba ug Zalmuna nga mga hadi nga Madianitanhon, kundi iya ginbukod ngan ginbihag hira, ngan nakapalisang ini han ngatanan nira nga kasondalohan.
en: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, fled, but he pursued them and captured them, routing their entire army.

war: Han nabalik na hi Gideon tikang han pag-awayan pinaagi han Agianan han Hares,
en: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.

war: ginbihag niya in usa nga batan-on nga lalake nga taga-Socot ngan ginpakianhan hiya nira. Iginsurat hini nga batan-on para kan Gideon an mga ngaran han 77 nga dumagko nga mga tawo han Socot.
en: He caught a young man of Sukkoth and questioned him, and the young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven officials of Sukkoth, the elders of the town.

war: Niyan kinmuha hiya hin mga tunok ngan mga sapinit tikang ha kamingawan ngan ginggamit ini hin pagkastigo han mga pangulo han Socot.
en: He took the elders of the town and taught the men of Sukkoth a lesson by punishing them with desert thorns and briers.

war: Iya liwat ginrumpag an torre didto ha Penuel ngan pinamatay an kalalaken-an hito nga syudad.
en: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.

war: Nagsiring hi Gideon, “Mga kabugtoan ko hira kay mga anak han akon kalugaringon nga iroy. Nagsusumpa ako nga kon waray niyo pamataya hira, diri ko unta kamo pamamatayon.”
en: Gideon replied, “Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the Lord lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you.”

war: Niyan ginsiring niya hi Jeter nga suhag niya nga lalake, “Hala, pamataya hira!” Kundi waray an bata humulbot han iya espada. Nag-alang hiya kay bata pa hiya.
en: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, “Kill them!” But Jether did not draw his sword, because he was only a boy and was afraid.

war: Katapos, nagsiring kan Gideon an mga Israelita, “Ikaw na an amon pangulo—ikaw ngan an imo mga tulin nga masunod ha imo. Gintalwas mo kami ha mga Madianitanhon.”
en: The Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you, your son and your grandson—because you have saved us from the hand of Midian.”

war: Binmaton hi Gideon, “Diri ako o an akon anak an iyo mga pangulo. An Ginoo amo an iyo pangulo.”
en: But Gideon told them, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you. The Lord will rule over you.”

war: Binmaton an mga tawo, “Malilipay kami hin paghatag hini ha imo.” Nagbitad hira hin dugnit ngan iginbutang dida hini han kada usa an mga ariyos nga iya ginkuha.
en: They answered, “We’ll be glad to give them.” So they spread out a garment, and each of them threw a ring from his plunder onto it.

war: Sanglit ginpirde han mga Israelita an Madian ngan diri na ini hira kinahahadlokan. Nagkamay-ada kalinaw an tuna sulod hin 40 ka tuig, tubtob han kamatay ni Gideon.
en: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon’s lifetime, the land had peace forty years.

war: Binmalik hi Gideon ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga balay ngan didto hiya nag-ukoy.
en: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.

war: May-ada hiya 70 nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, kay damo an iya asawa.
en: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.

war: May-ada liwat hiya babaye didto ha Sequim; nag-anak ini hiya hin lalake ngan ginngaranan niya nga Abimelec.
en: His concubine, who lived in Shechem, also bore him a son, whom he named Abimelek.

war: Namatay hi Gideon nga anak ni Joas ha hitaas na gud nga panuigon ngan iginlubong hiya didto han lubnganan ni Joas nga iya amay ha Ofra nga bungto han banay ni Abiezer.
en: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

war: Han kamatay na ni Gideon, waray na liwat magmatinumanon han Dyos an mga tawo han Israel ngan ginsingba nira an mga Baal. Ginhimo nira nga ira diyos hi Baal-han-Ginsabotan,
en: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god

war: ngan waray na hira mag-alagad han Ginoo nga ira Dyos nga nagtalwas ha ira ha ngatanan nira nga mga kaaway nga hirani la ha ira.
en: and did not remember the Lord their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.

war: Bungalos hira han panimalay ni Gideon ngan hinngalimtan nira an ngatanan nga kaupayan nga iya nabuhat para han Israel.
en: They also failed to show any loyalty to the family of Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) in spite of all the good things he had done for them.

war: Kinmadto hi Abimelec nga anak ni Gideon ha bungto han Siquem nga gin-ukyan han ngatanan nga kaurupdan han iroy niya, ngan
en: Abimelek son of Jerub-Baal went to his mother’s brothers in Shechem and said to them and to all his mother’s clan,

war: Ira gintagan hiya hin 70 ka bug-os nga salapi tikang han templo hi Baal-han-Ginsabotan, ngan ginamit niya ini nga kwarta hin pagsuhol hin mga bugoy basi tumampo ha iya.
en: They gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, and Abimelek used it to hire reckless scoundrels, who became his followers.

war: Niyan nagtitirok an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha Siquem ug Betmilo ngan kinmadto hira han baraan nga kahoy nga tuog didto ha Siquem diin ginhimo nira nga hadi hi Abimelec.
en: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelek king.

war: Usa hadto ka panahon nagkagawas an kakahoyan hin pagpili hin ira hadi. Ginsiring nira an kahoy nga olibo, ‘Paghadii kami.’
en: One day the trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Be our king.’

war: Binmaton an kahoy nga olibo, ‘Basi ako makaghadi ha iyo, babayaan ko daw an paghimo han akon lana nga ginagamit hin pagpasidungog hin kadiyosan ngan mga tawo.’
en: “But the olive tree answered, ‘Should I give up my oil, by which both gods and humans are honored, to hold sway over the trees?’

war: Niyan ginsiring han kakahoyan an kahoy nga igos, ‘Kadi ngan paghadii kami.’
en: “Next, the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and be our king.’

war: Kundi binmaton an kahoy nga igos, ‘Basi ako makaghadi ha iyo, diri na daw ako makakahatag han akon magrasa ngan magtam-is nga mga bunga.’
en: “But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I give up my fruit, so good and sweet, to hold sway over the trees?’

war: Sanglit ginsiring han kakahoyan an ubas, ‘Kadi ngan paghadii kami.’
en: “Then the trees said to the vine, ‘Come and be our king.’

war: Kundi binmaton an ubas, ‘Basi makaghadi ako ha iyo, uundangon ko daw an paghatag hin bino nga nakakalipay hin kadiyosan ngan mga tawo.’
en: “But the vine answered, ‘Should I give up my wine, which cheers both gods and humans, to hold sway over the trees?’

war: Sanglit ginsiring han ngatanan nga kakahoyan an tunukon nga kahoy, ‘Kadi ngan paghadii kami.’
en: “Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king.’

war: Hinumdomi nga nakig-away para ha iyo an akon amay. Igin-unong niya an iya kinabuhi hin pagtalwas ha iyo tikang han mga Madianitanhon.
en: Remember that my father fought for you and risked his life to rescue you from the hand of Midian.

war: Sanglit yana, kon kinasingkasing ngan tinuod an iyo ginbuhat kan Gideon ngan han iya panimalay yana nga adlaw, pagkalipay kamo upod kan Abimelec ngan maglipay hiya upod ha iyo.
en: So have you acted honorably and in good faith toward Jerub-Baal and his family today? If you have, may Abimelek be your joy, and may you be his, too!

war: Niyan tungod han iya kahadlok kan Abimelec nga iya bugto, kinmalagiw hi Jotam ngan didto nag-ukoy ha Beer.
en: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.

war: Naghadi han Israel hi Abimelec sulod hin tulo ka tuig.
en: After Abimelek had governed Israel three years,

war: Niyan itinugot han Dyos nga magkaaway hi Abimelec ngan an mga tawo han Siquem; sanglit inmato hira kan Abimelec.
en: God stirred up animosity between Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem so that they acted treacherously against Abimelek.

war: Niyan inmabot ha Siquem hi Gaal nga anak ni Ebed kaupod an iya kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an, ngan tinmapod ha iya an mga tawo han Siquem.
en: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.

war: Kon ako pa unta an nagpapangulo hini nga mga tawo! Papatayon ko hi Abimelec! Sisidngon ko hiya, ‘Dugangi an imo kasondalohan, gawas, ngan pakig-away!’”
en: If only this people were under my command! Then I would get rid of him. I would say to Abimelek, ‘Call out your whole army!’ ”

war: Nasina hi Zebul nga pangulo han syudad han pagsumati ha iya han ginsiring ni Gaal.
en: When Zebul the governor of the city heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, he was very angry.

war: Sanglit yana, kinahanglan lumakat ka ha gab-i, ikaw ngan an imo mga tawo ngan tumago kamo ha kaumhan.
en: Now then, during the night you and your men should come and lie in wait in the fields.

war: Sanglit nagkalakat ha gab-i hi Abimelec ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo ngan tinmago hira ha gawas han Siquem ug gin-upat ka hugpo an iya mga tawo.
en: So Abimelek and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.

war: Han pakakita ni Abimelec ngan han iya mga tawo nga ginmawas hi Gaal ngan tinmindog ha ganghaan han syudad, binmuhat hira tikang han ira tinatagoan nga mga dapit.
en: Now Gaal son of Ebed had gone out and was standing at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelek and his troops came out from their hiding place.

war: Gin-unhan ni Gaal hin paggawas an mga tawo han Siquem ngan nakig-away hira kan Abimelec.
en: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.

war: Ginlanat hi Gaal ni Abimelec ngan pinmalagiw hi Gaal. Damo an nagkasasamad bisan didto han ganghaan han syudad.
en: Abimelek chased him all the way to the entrance of the gate, and many were killed as they fled.

war: Nag-ukoy hi Abimelec didto ha Aruma ngan ginpaiwas ni Zebul hi Gaal ngan an iya kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an, ha Siquem, basi diri na hira makag-ukoy didto.
en: Then Abimelek stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his clan out of Shechem.

war: Han pagkabuwas hinbaroan ni Abimelec nga naglarang an mga tawo han Siquem hin paggawas ngadto ha kaumhan,
en: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek.

war: Nagpadayon an araway ha bug-os nga adlaw. Ginrikopohan ni Abimelec an syudad, pinamatay an mga tawo hini, ginwakay ini, ngan gintahoban hin asin an tuna.
en: All that day Abimelek pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.

war: Han pakabati hiunong hini han ngatanan nga dumagko nga mga tawo nga nakadto han arayopan didto ha Siquem, inmayop hira didto han arayopan han templo ni Baal-han-Ginsabotan.
en: On hearing this, the citizens in the tower of Shechem went into the stronghold of the temple of El-Berith.

war: Ginsumatan hi Abimelec nga nagtitirok hira didto,
en: When Abimelek heard that they had assembled there,

war: Niyan kinmadto ha Tebez hi Abimelec, ginpalibotan niya ang syudad, ngan iya nabihag.
en: Next Abimelek went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.

war: Han pag-abot ni Abimelec hin pagsulong han torre, kinmadto hiya ha porta hin pagsurit han torre.
en: Abimelek went to the tower and attacked it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,

war: Kundi ginhulogan hiya hin usa nga babaye hin gilingan nga bato ngan nabasag an iya ulo.
en: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.

war: Han paghikit-i han mga Israelita nga patay na hi Abimelec, nanguli hira ngatanan.
en: When the Israelites saw that Abimelek was dead, they went home.

war: Sanglit amo ini nga ginbulos han Dyos hi Abimelec tungod han sala nga iya ginbuhat kontra han iya amay han pagpataya niya han 70 nga iya kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an.
en: Thus God repaid the wickedness that Abimelek had done to his father by murdering his seventy brothers.

war: Ginpaantos liwat han Dyos an mga tawo han Siquem tungod han ira pagkamaraot, sumala han iginsiring ni Jotam nga anak ni Gideon, han pagtungloha niya ha ira.
en: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.

war: Pangulo hiya han Israel sulod hin 23 ka tuig. Katapos namatay hiya ngan ginlubong didto ha Samir.
en: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.

war: Katapos ni Tola inmabot hi Jair nga taga-Galaad. Nangulo hiya han Israel sulod hin 22 ka tuig.
en: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.

war: Namatay hi Jair ngan iginlubong didto ha Camon.
en: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.

war: Sanglit nasina han mga Israelita an Ginoo , ngan ginpasakop hira han mga Filisteohanon ngan han mga Amonitanhon.
en: he became angry with them. He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites,

war: Tinmabok pa ngani han Jordan an mga Amonitanhon hin pakig-away han mga tribo han Juda, Benjamin, ug Efraim. Makuri an kamutangan han Israel.
en: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim; Israel was in great distress.

war: Niyan nagsangpit han Ginoo an mga Israelita ngan nagsiring, “Nakasala kami kontra ha imo kay ginsalikway ka namon nga amon Dyos ngan ginsingba namon an mga Baal.”
en: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord , “We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals.”

war: Ginhatag ha ira han Ginoo ini nga baton: “Hadto nga panahon ginraogdaog kamo han mga Ehiptohanon, mga Amoreohanon, mga Amonitanhon, mga Filisteohanon,
en: The Lord replied, “When the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,

war: mga Sidonianhon, mga Amalekanhon, nga han mga Moanitanhon, ngan nagtawag kamo ha akon. Waray ko ba kamo pagtalwasa tikang ha ira?
en: the Sidonians, the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you and you cried to me for help, did I not save you from their hands?

war: Kundi iyo ako gihapon ginbayaan ngan ginsingba niyo an iba nga kadiyosan, sanglit diri ko na kamo pagtatalwason liwat.
en: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.

war: Kadto ngan tawga niyo an kadiyosan nga iyo ginpili. Hira an patalwasa ha iyo kon magkukuri kamo.”
en: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you when you are in trouble!”

war: Kundi nagsiring ha Ginoo an mga tawo han Israel, “Nakasala kami. Buhata an imo karuyag, kundi talwasa gad kami yana nga adlaw.”
en: But the Israelites said to the Lord , “We have sinned. Do with us whatever you think best, but please rescue us now.”

war: Sanglit iginsikway nira an ira langyaw nga kadiyosan ngan gin-alagad nira an Ginoo ; ngan iginmasakit han Ginoo tungod han kakurian han Israel.
en: Then they got rid of the foreign gods among them and served the Lord . And he could bear Israel’s misery no longer.

war: Niyan nag-andam hin pakig-away an kasondalohan nga Amonitanhon ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Galaad. Nagtitirok an mga tawo han Israel ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Mizpa ha Galaad.
en: When the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.

war: Hi Jefte an maisog nga sondalo nga taga-Galaad amo an anak hin usa nga mahugaw nga babaye. Hi Galaad nga iya amay
en: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. His father was Gilead; his mother was a prostitute.

war: Pinmalagiw hi Jefte tikang han iya kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto han tuna han Tob. Didto nakakabig hiya hin mga bugoy ngan nagsudoysudoy hira upod ha iya.
en: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where a gang of scoundrels gathered around him and followed him.

war: Linmabay anay in panahon san-o makig-away an mga Amonitanhon kontra han Israel.
en: Some time later, when the Ammonites were fighting against Israel,

war: Han paghinabo hini, kinmadto an mga pangulo han Galaad hin pagpabalik kan Jefte tikang ha tuna han Tob.
en: the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.

war: Ginsiring hiya nira, “Kadi ngan pagpangulohi kami basi makaaway kami kontra han mga Amonitanhon.”
en: “Come,” they said, “be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites.”

war: Binmaton hira, “Nauyon kami. An Ginoo amo an aton testigo.”
en: The elders of Gilead replied, “The Lord is our witness; we will certainly do as you say.”

war: Niyan nagsugo hi Jefte hin mga magsarangyaw ngadto han hadi han Amon hin pagsiring, “Ano in iyo pakiaway ha amon? Kay ano nga ginsulong niyo an akon nasod?”
en: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king with the question: “What do you have against me that you have attacked my country?”

war: Ginpabalik ni Jefte in mga magsarangyaw ngadto han hadi han Amon
en: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,

war: dara ini nga baton: “Diri ini matuod nga ginkuha han Israel an tuna han Moab o an tuna han Amon.
en: saying: “This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.

war: Amo ini an nahinabo: han pagbaya han mga Israelita han Ehipto, nagbaktas hira han kamingawan ngadto han dagat han Aqaba ngan inmabot hira ha Cades.
en: But when they came up out of Egypt, Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea and on to Kadesh.

war: Kundi waray tumugot hi Sihon nga pagbuhaton ini han Israel. Iya lugod gintirok an ngatanan niya nga kasondalohan, nagkampo hira didto ha Jahaz, ngan ginsulong an Israel.
en: Sihon, however, did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. He mustered all his troops and encamped at Jahaz and fought with Israel.

war: Sanglit an Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel amo an nagpaiwas han mga Amoreohanon para han mga Israelita nga iya mga tawo.
en: “Now since the Lord , the God of Israel, has driven the Amorites out before his people Israel, what right have you to take it over?

war: Nagtitinguha ka ba hin pagbawi hini? Iyoha na la an bisan ano nga iginhatag ha imo ni Camos nga iyo diyos. Kundi aangkonon namon an ngatanan nga ginkuha han Ginoo nga amon Dyos para ha amon.
en: Will you not take what your god Chemosh gives you? Likewise, whatever the Lord our God has given us, we will possess.

war: Naghuhunahuna ka ba nga mauruupay ka pa kay kan Balac nga anak ni Sefor, nga hadi han Moab? Waray gud hiya umato han Israel, diri ba? Nakig-away ba hiya kontra ha amon?
en: Are you any better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever quarrel with Israel or fight with them?

war: Kundi waray gud bumali an hadi han Amon hini nga mensahe tikang kan Jefte.
en: The king of Ammon, however, paid no attention to the message Jephthah sent him.

war: Niyan kinmunsad ngada kan Jefte an Espiritu han Ginoo . Nagbaktas hiya han Galaad ug Manases ngan binmalik ngadto ha Mispa didto ha Galaad ngan nagpadayon ngadto ha Amon.
en: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah. He crossed Gilead and Manasseh, passed through Mizpah of Gilead, and from there he advanced against the Ammonites.

war: Nagsaad han Ginoo hi Jefte: “Kon padag-on mo ako han mga Amonitanhon,
en: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord : “If you give the Ammonites into my hands,

war: Sanglit tinmabok han salog hi Jefte hin pakig-away han mga Amonitanhon, ngan ginpadaog hiya han Ginoo .
en: Then Jephthah went over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave them into his hands.

war: nga nagawas an kababayen-an nga Israelita sulod hin upat ka adlaw ha kada tuig hin pagmabidoon tungod han anak nga babaye ni Jefte nga taga-Galaad.
en: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.

war: Kundi ginsiring hira ni Jefte, “May dako nga pagkabalingkot nakon ngan an akon mga tawo kontra han mga Amonitanhon. Gintawag ko man ngani kamo, kundi waray ako niyo pagtalwasa tikang ha ira.
en: Jephthah answered, “I and my people were engaged in a great struggle with the Ammonites, and although I called, you didn’t save me out of their hands.

war: Nangulo hi Jefte han Israel sulod hin unom ka tuig. Katapos namatay hiya ngan iginlubong didto han iya natawhan nga bungto ha Galaad.
en: Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in a town in Gilead.

war: Sunod kan Jefte nangulo han Israel hi Ibzan nga taga-Betlehem.
en: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.

war: katapos namatay hiya ngan iginlubong didto ha Betlehem.
en: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

war: Sunod kan Ibzan nangulo han Israel hi Elon nga taga-Zabulon sulod hin napulo ka tuig.
en: After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel ten years.

war: Katapos namatay hiya ngan iginlubong didto ha Ayalon, ha katunaan han Zabulon.
en: Then Elon died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

war: Sunod kan Elon nangulo han Israel hi Abdon nga anak ni Ilel nga taga-Faraton.
en: After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel.

war: May-ada hiya 40 nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ngan hin 30 nga mga apo nga kalalaken-an nga may-ada 70 nga mga sarakyan nga asno. Nangulo hi Abdon han Israel sulod hin walo ka tuig,
en: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He led Israel eight years.

war: katapos namatay hiya ngan iginlubong didto ha Faraton, ha katunaan han Efraim, didto han sagkahon nga nasod han mga Amalekanhon.
en: Then Abdon son of Hillel died and was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

war: Nakasala na liwat han Ginoo an mga Israelita ngan itinugot han Ginoo nga maghadi ha ira an mga Filisteohanon sulod hin 40 ka tuig.
en: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , so the Lord delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

war: Hito nga panahon may-ada usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan kan Manoa nga taga bungto han Zora. Sakop hiya han tribo ni Dan. Baw-as an iya asawa ngan waray gud mag-anak.
en: A certain man of Zorah, named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, had a wife who was childless, unable to give birth.

war: Pinmakita an anghel han Ginoo han babaye ngan nagsiring, “Waray ka gud mag-anak, kundi diri maiha magbuburod ka ngan mag-aanak hin lalake.
en: The angel of the Lord appeared to her and said, “You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.

war: Ayaw gud pag-inom hin bino o irimnon nga makahurobog o pagkaon hin bisan ano nga igindidiri nga pagkaon;
en: Now see to it that you drink no wine or other fermented drink and that you do not eat anything unclean.

war: Gintuman han Dyos an hangyo ni Manoa ngan binmalik an iya anghel ngadto han babaye samtang nalingkod ini hiya didto han uma. Diri upod niya hi Manoa nga iya bana,
en: God heard Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was out in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.

war: sanglit dinmalagan hiya dayon ngan ginsiring an iya bana, “Kitaa! Pinmakita na liwat ha akon an tawo nga kinmanhi ha akon hadton usa ka adlaw.”
en: The woman hurried to tell her husband, “He’s here! The man who appeared to me the other day!”

war: Binmuhat hi Manoa ngan sinmunod han iya asawa. Kinmadto hiya han tawo ngan nagpakiana, “Ikaw ba an tawo nga nakighimangraw han akon asawa?” “Oo,” binmaton hiya.
en: Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he said, “Are you the man who talked to my wife?” “I am,” he said.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Manoa, “Ta yana, kon matuman na an imo mga pulong, ano man an kinahanglan buhaton namon han bata? Ano nga kinabuhi an kinahanglan niya pagsundon?”
en: So Manoah asked him, “When your words are fulfilled, what is to be the rule that governs the boy’s life and work?”

war: Binmaton an anghel han Ginoo , “Kinahanglan buhaton han imo asawa an ngatanan nga akon iginsiring ha iya.
en: The angel of the Lord answered, “Your wife must do all that I have told her.

war: Binmaton hi Manoa, “Sumati kami han imo ngaran, basi makagpasidungog kami ha imo kon matuman na an imo mga pulong.”
en: Then Manoah inquired of the angel of the Lord , “What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes true?”

war: Pinmakiana an anghel, “Kay ano nga karuyag niyo mahibaro han akon ngaran? Makatitingala ini nga ngaran.”
en: He replied, “Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding. ”

war: Ginsiring ni Manoa an iya asawa, “Mamamatay gud kita kay kinita kita han Dyos!”
en: “We are doomed to die!” he said to his wife. “We have seen God!”

war: Nag-anak hin lalake an asawa ni Manoa ngan ginngaranan niya nga Samson. Tinmubo an bata ngan ginbendisyonan hiya han Ginoo .
en: The woman gave birth to a boy and named him Samson. He grew and the Lord blessed him,

war: Ngan nagtikang an espiritu han Ginoo hin pagpakusog ha iya samtang nakadto hiya ha butnga han Zora ug Estaol didto han kampo ni Dan.
en: and the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him while he was in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

war: Usa ka adlaw linmugsong hi Samson ngadto ha Timna diin hinkit-an niya in usa nga babaye nga Filisteohanon.
en: Samson went down to Timnah and saw there a young Philistine woman.

war: Sanglit linmugsong hi Samson ngadto ha Timna upod an iya amay ug iroy. Han nagbabaktas hira han mga urubasan didto, hinbatian ni Samson in ngurob hin usa nga batan-on nga liyon.
en: Samson went down to Timnah together with his father and mother. As they approached the vineyards of Timnah, suddenly a young lion came roaring toward him.

war: Niyan kinmadto hiya ngan nakighimangraw hiya han babaye ngan naruyagan niya an babaye.
en: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and he liked her.

war: Kinmadto an iya amay ha balay han babaye ngan didto naghatag hi Samson hin panagtawo. Batasan ini han mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an didto.
en: Now his father went down to see the woman. And there Samson held a feast, as was customary for young men.

war: Han pakakita ha iya han mga Filisteohanon, nagsugo hira hin 30 nga mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an hin pagpaupod ha iya.
en: When the people saw him, they chose thirty men to be his companions.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Tikang han nakaon ginmawas in karaonon; Tikang han makusog ginmawas in matam-is.” Paglabay hin tulo ka adlaw waray pa gihapon hira pakakasupat han tirigohon.
en: He replied, “Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet.” For three days they could not give the answer.

war: ngan iginhatag an iya asawa ngadto han tawo nga iya abay dida han pagkasal.
en: And Samson’s wife was given to one of his companions who had attended him at the feast.

war: Nagsiring hi Samson, “Hini nga higayon diri na ako manginginlabot han akon bubuhaton han mga Filisteohanon!”
en: Samson said to them, “This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them.”

war: Sanglit linmakat hiya ngan nagdakop hin tulo ka gatos nga mga miro. Ginpadispadis niya paghigti an mga ikog han mga miro ngan gintaoran niya hin mga sulo dida han mga hinigtan.
en: So he went out and caught three hundred foxes and tied them tail to tail in pairs. He then fastened a torch to every pair of tails,

war: Ginsiring hira ni Samson, “Amo ngay-an ini an iyo ginbubuhat! Nagsusumpa ako nga diri ako maundang tubtob han pakabulos ko ha iyo!”
en: Samson said to them, “Since you’ve acted like this, I swear that I won’t stop until I get my revenge on you.”

war: Iya ginsulong hira hin waray kalooy ngan ginpatay in damo ha ira. Katapos kinmadto hiya ngan nagpabilin didto han lungib ha pangpang han kababto-an han Etam.
en: He attacked them viciously and slaughtered many of them. Then he went down and stayed in a cave in the rock of Etam.

war: Nagkaabot an mga Filisteohanon ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Juda. Ginsulong nira an bungto han Lehi.
en: The Philistines went up and camped in Judah, spreading out near Lehi.

war: Nagpakiana ha ira an mga tawo han Juda, “Kay ano nga ginsulong kami niyo?” Binmaton hira, “Kinmanhi kami hin pagbihag kan Samson ngan pagbulos ha iya han ginbuhat niya ha amon.”
en: The people of Judah asked, “Why have you come to fight us?” “We have come to take Samson prisoner,” they answered, “to do to him as he did to us.”

war: Niyan hin-agian niya in tul-an nga sulang hin asno nga bag-o pa la nga namatay. Iya ginpurot, ngan pinaagi hini ginpatay niya in 1,000 nga mga tawo.
en: Finding a fresh jawbone of a donkey, he grabbed it and struck down a thousand men.

war: Sanglit nagkanta hi Samson, “Pinaagi hin usa nga tul-an nga sulang hin asno; pinatay ko in usa ka yukot nga mga tawo; Pinaagi hin tul-an nga sulang hin asno hira ginpurupundok ko.”
en: Then Samson said, “With a donkey’s jawbone I have made donkeys of them. With a donkey’s jawbone I have killed a thousand men.”

war: Katapos hito iginlabog niya an tul-an nga sulang. Ginngaranan nga Ramat-lehi an dapit diin ini nahinabo.
en: When he finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was called Ramath Lehi.

war: Ginpangulohan ni Samson an Israel sulod hin 20 ka tuig samtang an mga Filisteohanon naghahadi han tuna.
en: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

war: Usa ka adlaw kinmadto hi Samson han Filisteohanon nga syudad han Gasa, diin iginkakita hiya hin usa nga maraot in bantog nga babaye ngan nakighilawas hiya hini nga babaye.
en: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute. He went in to spend the night with her.

war: Katapos hini hinmigugma hi Samson hin usa nga babaye nga ginngaranan kan Dalila nga nag-ukoy didto ha Kahamub-an han Sorec.
en: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Dalila kan Samson, “Sumati gad ako kon ano an nakakapakusog hin duro ha imo. Kon may tawo nga karuyag maggapos ngan magbihag ha imo, uunanhon niya hin pagbuhat hini?”
en: So Delilah said to Samson, “Tell me the secret of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued.”

war: Binmaton hi Samson, “Kon gaposon ako nira hin pito nga bag-o pa nga mga higot hin pana, nga diri pa uga, magmamaluya ako sugad han iba.”
en: Samson answered her, “If anyone ties me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, I’ll become as weak as any other man.”

war: Sanglit gindad-an hi Dalila han kahadian nga Filisteohanon hin pito nga bag-o pa nga mga higot hin pana, nga diri uga, ngan ginggapos ni Dalila hi Samson.
en: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she tied him with them.

war: Ginsiring ni Dalila hi Samson, “Kitaa, imo la ako ginlulurong ngan diri ka nagsusumat han kamatuoran. Sumati gad ako kon uunanhon hin paggapos ha imo.”
en: Then Delilah said to Samson, “You have made a fool of me; you lied to me. Come now, tell me how you can be tied.”

war: Ginsiring hiya ni Samson, “Kon gaposon ako nira hin bag-o pa nga mga pisi nga waray pa gud gamita, magmamaluya ako sugad han iba.”
en: He said, “If anyone ties me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I’ll become as weak as any other man.”

war: Waray hunong an iya pagpinakiana ha iya adlaw-adlaw. Inuyaman ngan ginul-an na hi Samson han duro nga iya pagsinamok hiunong hini,
en: With such nagging she prodded him day after day until he was sick to death of it.

war: Kundi nagtikang na liwat hin pagtubo an iya buhok.
en: But the hair on his head began to grow again after it had been shaved.

war: Ginsiring ni Samson an bata nga nagtutugway ha iya, “Pakapta ako han mga harigi nga nahawid han balay. Karuyag ko sumandig dida han mga harigi.”
en: Samson said to the servant who held his hand, “Put me where I can feel the pillars that support the temple, so that I may lean against them.”

war: May-ada hadto usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan kan Miqueas, nga nag-ukoy didto han sagkahon nga nasod han Efraim.
en: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim

war: Waray hadi didto ha Israel hito nga panahon; nagbuhat an kada tawo han bisan ano nga iya karuyag.
en: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.

war: Hito ngahaw nga panahon may-ada usa nga batan-on nga Levita nga nag-ukoy anay didto han bungto han Betlehem ha Juda.
en: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,

war: Ginpakianhan hiya ni Miqueas, “Taga diin ka?” Binmaton hiya, “Usa ako nga Levita nga taga-Betlehem han Juda. Namimiling ako hin dapit nga akon uokyan.”
en: Micah asked him, “Where are you from?” “I’m a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah,” he said, “and I’m looking for a place to stay.”

war: Inmuyon an batan-on nga Levita hin pagpabilin upod kan Miqueas ngan nahimo hiya nga sugad hin usa han iya mga anak.
en: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man became like one of his sons to him.

war: Gintudlok hiya nga padi ni Miqueas ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto han balay ni Miqueas.
en: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.

war: Nagsiring hi Miqueas, “Yana nga may-ada ko na Levita nga akon padi, maaram ako nga pagpapakaupayon na ako han Ginoo .”
en: And Micah said, “Now I know that the Lord will be good to me, since this Levite has become my priest.”

war: Binmaton hiya, “May-ada kami ginkasabotan ngan hi Miqueas nga nagsusuhol ha akon ha pag-alagad ko nga padi para ha iya.”
en: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, “He has hired me and I am his priest.”

war: Nagsiring hira ha iya, “Alayon hin pagpakiana han Dyos kon magmamainuswagon ba kami han amon paglakaton.”
en: Then they said to him, “Please inquire of God to learn whether our journey will be successful.”

war: Binmaton an padi, “Waray niyo sadang kabarak-an. Ginmamangnoan kamo han Ginoo dida hini nga iyo paglakaton.”
en: The priest answered them, “Go in peace. Your journey has the Lord ’s approval.”

war: Han pagbalik na han lima nga kalalaken-an ngadto ha Sora ug Estaol, ginpakianhan hira han ira igkasi mga taga nasod kon ano an ira hinkit-an.
en: When they returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their fellow Danites asked them, “How did you find things?”

war: Sanglit linmakat tikang ha Sora ug Estaol in 600 nga kalalaken-an nga sakop han tribo ni Dan, nga andam hin pakig-away.
en: Then six hundred men of the Danites, armed for battle, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.

war: Sinmagka hira ngan nagkampo ha katundan han Kiriat Jearim han Juda. Amo ito nga gintatawag la gihapon ini nga dapit nga Kampo ni Dan.
en: On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.

war: Tikang didto nagpadayon hira ngan inmabot hira ha balay ni Miqueas didto han sagkahon nga nasod han Efraim.
en: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.

war: Sanglit sinmulod hira ngadto han balay hi Miqueas, nga inuokyan han batan-on nga Levita, ngan pinangumosta nira an Levita.
en: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah’s place and greeted him.

war: Hini nga takna nagkatukdaw didto ha ganghaan an 600 nga Danitanhon nga mga sondalo nga andam hin pakig-away.
en: The six hundred Danites, armed for battle, stood at the entrance of the gate.

war: Nakalipay ini han padi, sanglit kinuha niya an baraan nga mga butang ngan inmupod hiya ha ira.
en: The priest was very pleased. He took the ephod, the household gods and the idol and went along with the people.

war: Binmalik hira ngan nagkalakat hira. Nag-una ha ira an ira kabataan, ira kabakahan, ngan an ira mga higamit.
en: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.

war: Hirayo na an ira ginlaktan tikang han balay nga tawagon ni Miqueas an iya mga kahigrani para hin pakig-away. Hin-abtan nira an mga Danitanhon,
en: When they had gone some distance from Micah’s house, the men who lived near Micah were called together and overtook the Danites.

war: ngan gingoliatan hira. Linmingi an mga Danitanhon ngan ginpakianhan hi Miqueas, “Ano ini? Kay ano nga upod man nimo ini nga mag-aringasa nga mga tawo?”
en: As they shouted after them, the Danites turned and said to Micah, “What’s the matter with you that you called out your men to fight?”

war: Binmaton hi Miqueas, “Kay ano nga nasiring kamo, ‘Ano ini?’ Ginkuha niyo an akon padi ngan an kadiyosan nga akon ginhimo ngan nagkalakat kamo! Ano pa man an nahibilin ha akon?”
en: He replied, “You took the gods I made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you ask, ‘What’s the matter with you?’ ”

war: Niyan nagpadayon hin pagkalakat an mga Danitanhon. Hinsabotan ni Miqueas nga makusog hira ngan diri hiya makakaato, sanglit binmalik na la hiya ngan inmoli.
en: So the Danites went their way, and Micah, seeing that they were too strong for him, turned around and went back home.

war: Ginliwanan nira an ngaran nga Lais. Ginngaranan nira hin Dan, kay amo ini an ngaran han ira ginikanan nga anak ni Jacob.
en: They named it Dan after their ancestor Dan, who was born to Israel—though the city used to be called Laish.

war: Nagpabilin didto an diyosdiyos ni Miqueas samtang nakadto pa ha Silo an Tulda diin ginsingba an Dyos.
en: They continued to use the idol Micah had made, all the time the house of God was in Shiloh.

war: Kundi nasina ha iya an babaye ngan inmoli hiya ngadto han balay han iya amay didto ha Betlehem, ngan nagpabilin ini hiya didto hin upat ka bulan.
en: But she was unfaithful to him. She left him and went back to her parents’ home in Bethlehem, Judah. After she had been there four months,

war: Ginhawiran hiya han amay, sanglit nagpabilin hiya sulod hin tulo ka adlaw. Didto an magtiayon pangaon ngan pagpalabay han mga gab-i.
en: His father-in-law, the woman’s father, prevailed on him to stay; so he remained with him three days, eating and drinking, and sleeping there.

war: Sanglit nagkalingkod, nangaon, ngan nag-inom an Levita ug an amay han babaye. Niyan ginsiring hiya han amay han babaye, “Pagpalabay gad anay han gab-i dinhe ngan pagpakalipay ikaw.”
en: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the woman’s father said, “Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself.”

war: Binmuhat an Levita hin pag-ilalakat, kundi ginhawiran hiya han amay, sanglit ginpalabay na liwat niya an gab-i didto.
en: And when the man got up to go, his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.

war: Sanglit linabyan la nira an Jebus ngan nagpadayon hira. Tunod na an adlaw han pag-abot nira ha Gabaa didto han katunaan han tribo ni Benjamin.
en: So they went on, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.

war: Hinkit-an hira han tigurang nga nakada la hira ha plasa han syudad ngan ginpakianhan hiya, “Tikang kamo diin? Tikain man kamo?”
en: When he looked and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

war: Nagsiring an tigurang, “Dayon kamo ha akon balay! Mamangnoan ko kamo; ayaw kamo pagpalabay han gab-i dinhe ha plasa.”
en: “You are welcome at my house,” the old man said. “Let me supply whatever you need. Only don’t spend the night in the square.”

war: Sanglit gindara hira ngadto han iya balay ngan gintubongan an ira mga asno. Namusa an iya mga dinapit ngan nangaon hira.
en: So he took him into his house and fed his donkeys. After they had washed their feet, they had something to eat and drink.

war: Han maagahon pa nagisaraka an babaye kundi natumba dida ha porta han balay han tigurang, diin nakadto an iya bana. Ngan ginagahan an babaye dida ha porta han balay.
en: At daybreak the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, fell down at the door and lay there until daylight.

war: Nagtambong an mga pangulo han ngatanan nga mga tribo han Israel didto hini nga katirok han mga tawo han Dyos, ngan may 400,000 nga mga sondalo.
en: The leaders of all the people of the tribes of Israel took their places in the assembly of God’s people, four hundred thousand men armed with swords.

war: Binmaton an Levita kanay aruasawa ginpatay, “Kinmadto ako ngan an akon aruasawa ha Gabaa didto han katunaan han Benjamin hin pagpalabay han gab-i.
en: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, said, “I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.

war: Mga Israelita kamo ngatanan nga aanhi. Ano an aton bubuhaton mahitungod hini?”
en: Now, all you Israelites, speak up and tell me what you have decided to do.”

war: Nagkaurosa an ngatanan nga mga tawo hin pagsiring, “Waray bisan usa ha aton nga maoli bisan kon tulda o balay an iya inuokyan.
en: All the men rose up together as one, saying, “None of us will go home. No, not one of us will return to his house.

war: Amo ini an aton bubuhaton: magriripa kita ngan magpipili hin mga tawo nga masulong han Gabaa.
en: But now this is what we’ll do to Gibeah: We’ll go up against it in the order decided by casting lots.

war: Sanglit nagkatirok an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an didto ha Israel ngan usa la an ira tuyo—pagsulong han bungto.
en: So all the Israelites got together and united as one against the city.

war: Nagsugo an mga tribo han Israel hin mga magsarangyaw ngadto han bug-os nga katunaan han Benjamin hin pagsiring, “Ano ini nga kasal-anan nga iyo ginbuhat?
en: The tribes of Israel sent messengers throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What about this awful crime that was committed among you?

war: Nagkaabot hira ha Gabaa tikang han ngatanan nga mga syudad han Benjamin hin pakig-away han iba nga mga tawo han Israel.
en: From their towns they came together at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.

war: Labot han tribo ni Benjamin, nagtirok an mga Israelita hin 400,000 nga tinutdoan nga mga sondalo.
en: Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand swordsmen, all of them fit for battle.

war: Sanglit han pagkaaga nagkalakat an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira hirani han syudad han Gabaa.
en: The next morning the Israelites got up and pitched camp near Gibeah.

war: Kinmadto hira hin pagsulong han kasondalohan han Benjamin, ngan iginbutang an ira mga sondalo ha dapit nga naatubang han syudad.
en: The Israelites went out to fight the Benjamites and took up battle positions against them at Gibeah.

war: Ginmawas han syudad an kasondalohan han Benjamin ngan waray pa ngani katunod an adlaw, nakamatay na hira hin 22,000 nga mga sondalo nga Israelita.
en: The Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down twenty-two thousand Israelites on the battlefield that day.

war: Ginsulong nira hin ika duha an kasondalohan han Benjamin.
en: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.

war: Ngan ha ikaduha na nga paggawas han mga Benjaminhon tikang ha Gabaa, ira pinamatay in 18,000 nga tinutdoan nga mga sondalo nga Israelita.
en: This time, when the Benjamites came out from Gibeah to oppose them, they cut down another eighteen thousand Israelites, all of them armed with swords.

war: Sanglit ginpatago han mga Israelita an iba han mga sondalo palibot han Gabaa.
en: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.

war: Niyan ha ikatulo na ka adlaw ginsulong nira an kasondalohan han Benjamin ngan gin-atag nira ha pakig-away an ira mga sondalo nga naatubang han Gabaa, sugad han ira ginbuhat han una.
en: They went up against the Benjamites on the third day and took up positions against Gibeah as they had done before.

war: Ginsulong an Gabaa hin 10,000 nga mga sondalo nga pinili hin maupay tikang han bug-os nga Israel, ngan mapintas gud an araway. Waray pakasabot an mga Benjaminhon nga gin-iiburungkag na hira.
en: Then ten thousand of Israel’s able young men made a frontal attack on Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that the Benjamites did not realize how near disaster was.

war: Nagdadlagan dayon ini nga mga tawo tipakadto ha Gabaa; nagsarang hira didto ha sakob han syudad ngan pinamatay nira an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga nakadto.
en: Those who had been in ambush made a sudden dash into Gibeah, spread out and put the whole city to the sword.

war: Nagsarabot pinaagi hin sinyal an kadak-an han kasondalohan nga Israelita ngan an nanago nga mga tawo. Kon hikit-an nira in dako nga dampog hin aso nga nagtitipaigbaw tikang han bungto,
en: The Israelites had arranged with the ambush that they should send up a great cloud of smoke from the city,

war: Niyan nanmalik an mga Israelita ngan nagkalilisang an mga Benjaminhon, kay nakasabot hira nga gin-iiburungkag na hira.
en: Then the Israelites counterattacked, and the Benjamites were terrified, because they realized that disaster had come on them.

war: Nabitik han mga Israelita an kaaway, ngan ginbukod nira hin waray paghunong tubtob hin dapit han sinirangan han Gabaa, nga namamatay ha ira samtang ginlalanat hira.
en: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them and easily overran them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.

war: Pinamatay in 18,000 han gimamag-upayi nga Benjaminhon nga mga sondalo.
en: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.

war: Hito nga adlaw 25,000 ngatanan nga mga Benjaminhon an pinamatay—mag-isog nga mga sondalo hira ngatanan.
en: On that day twenty-five thousand Benjamite swordsmen fell, all of them valiant fighters.

war: Kundi 600 nga mga tawo an nakakalagiw ngadto han kaumhan, ngadto ha Bato han Rimon, ngan nagpabilin hira didto hin upat ka bulan.
en: But six hundred of them turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.

war: Han pagkatirok han mga Israelita didto ha Mispa, nagsumpa hira han Ginoo : “Waray ha amon matugot hin usa nga Benjaminhon nga mangasawa hin usa han amon anak nga babaye.”
en: The men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: “Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite.”

war: Sanglit kinmadto ha Betel an mga tawo han Israel ngan didto nagkalingkod hira ha atubangan han Dyos ngada han pagkagab-i. Nagtinangis hira kay tugob hira hin kabido.
en: The people went to Bethel, where they sat before God until evening, raising their voices and weeping bitterly.

war: “O Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel, kay ano nga nahinabo ini? Kay ano nga haros na mapara ha Israel an tribo ni Benjamin?”
en: “ Lord , God of Israel,” they cried, “why has this happened to Israel? Why should one tribe be missing from Israel today?”

war: Temprano pa han pagkaaga nagkabuhat an mga tawo ngan nagtindog hin altar. Naghalad hira hin mga halad hin pagkaurosa ngan hin mga halad nga tinubod.
en: Early the next day the people built an altar and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.

war: Nabido an mga tawo han Israel tungod han ira kabugtoan nga mga Benjaminhon ngan nagsiring, “Yana nga adlaw nawad-an an Israel hin usa han iya mga tribo.
en: Now the Israelites grieved for the tribe of Benjamin, their fellow Israelites. “Today one tribe is cut off from Israel,” they said.

war: Han pagpakiana nira kon may-ada hugpo tikang han mga tribo han Israel nga waray makadto han katirok didto ha Mispa, hinbaroan nira nga waray usa nga taga-Habes didto ha Galaad nga kinmadto;
en: Then they asked, “Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to assemble before the Lord at Mizpah?” They discovered that no one from Jabesh Gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.

war: han pagpundoka han mga tawo waray didto taga-Habes.
en: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.

war: Pamataya an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an ngan an ngatanan nga kababayen-an nga diri na uray.”
en: “This is what you are to do,” they said. “Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin.”

war: Niyan nagpatugon an bug-os nga bungto ngadto han mga Benjaminhon nga nakadto ha Bato ni Rimon ngan andam hira hin pagtapos na han araway.
en: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.

war: Binmalik an mga Benjaminhon, ngan iginhatag ha ira han iba nga mga Israelita an taga-Habes nga kababayen-an nga waray nira pamataya. Kundi an kadamo waray makasukol ha ira.
en: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.

war: Nabido an mga tawo tungod han mga Benjaminhon kay ginbungkag han Ginoo an pagkaurosa han mga tribo han Israel.
en: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.

war: Kinahanglan diri mawad-an an Israel hin usa han iya dose nga mga tribo. Kinahanglan mangita kita hin paagi nga mabuhi an tribo ni Benjamin,
en: The Benjamite survivors must have heirs,” they said, “so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.

war: Ginsiring nira an mga Benjaminhon, “Pakadto ngan panago kamo didto han mga urubasan
en: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, “Go and hide in the vineyards

war: Waray hadi didto ha Israel hadto nga panahon. Nagbuhat an kada tawo han bisan ano nga iya karuyag.
en: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.

war: Han waray pa himoa an kalibutan, nakada na an Pulong. Kausa han Dyos an Pulong, ngan Dyos gud an Pulong.
en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

war: Tikang pa ha tinikangan kausa na han Dyos an Pulong.
en: He was with God in the beginning.

war: Gintuha han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga butang pinaagi han Pulong, sanglit waray nahimo nga bisan usa han ngatanan nga mga binuhat, nga diri pinaagi ha iya.
en: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.

war: Dida han Pulong nakada an kinabuhi, ngan an kinabuhi amo an kapawa han mga tawo.
en: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.

war: An kapawa naglamrag dida han kasisidman, ngan an kasisidman waray gud makaparong ha iya.
en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

war: May-ada tawo nga Juan an ngaran nga ginsugo han Dyos
en: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.

war: hin pagsumat han mga tawo mahitungod han kapawa, basi an ngatanan makabati han mensahe ngan tumoo.
en: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.

war: Diri hiya amo an kapawa; kinmanhi hiya hin pagsumat mahitungod han kapawa.
en: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.

war: Amo ini an matuod nga kapawa—an kapawa nga nakanhi ha kalibutan ngan nakalamrag han ngatanan nga katawhan.
en: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.

war: An Pulong dinhe na ha kalibutan, ngan bisan kon an kalibutan ginhimo han Dyos pinaagi ha iya, kundi waray kumilala ha iya an kalibutan.
en: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.

war: Kinmanhi hiya han iya kalugaringon nga tuna, kundi waray hiya karawata han iya kalugaringon nga katawhan.
en: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.

war: May-ada kinmarawat ngan tinmoo ha iya sanglit ihinatag ha ira an katungod hin pagka anak han Dyos.
en: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—

war: Nahimo hira nga mga anak han Dyos diri hin natural nga paagi, an karuyag sidngon diri pinaagi hin tawo nga amay; an Dyos ngahaw amo an ira Amay.
en: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband’s will, but born of God.

war: Nahimo nga tawo an Pulong, ngan puno hin grasya ngan kamatuoran, nag-ukoy dinhe ha aton. Hinkit-an naton an iya himaya—an himaya nga kinarawat niya ha iya pagka bugtong nga Anak han Dyos Amay.
en: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

war: Gintagan kita ngatanan hin kaupayan tikang han kahingpitan han iya grasya, nga naghahatag ha aton hin sunodsunod nga mga kaupayan.
en: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

war: Ginhatag han Dyos an Balaod pinaagi kan Moises; kundi inmabot an grasya ngan kamatuoran pinaagi kan Jesu-Cristo.
en: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

war: Waray pa gud nakakita han Dyos. Kundi an bugtong nga Anak, nga Dyos, ngan kausa han Amay, amo an nagpakilala ha iya.
en: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.

war: Nagsugo an mga punoan nga Judiyo didto ha Jerusalem hin kapadian ngan mga Levita hin pagpakiana kan Juan kon hin-o hiya.
en: Now this was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.

war: Waray hiya maglirong, kundi nagsumat hin waray lipodlipod, “Diri ako an Mesiyas.”
en: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, “I am not the Messiah.”

war: Nagpakiana liwat hira, “Hin-o ka man ngay-an? Hi Elias ka ba?” “Diri, diri ako hiya,” nagbaton hi Juan. “Ikaw ba an Manaragna?” nagpadayon hin pagpakiana hira. “Diri,” nagbaton liwat hiya.
en: They asked him, “Then who are you? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hira ha iya, “Sumati kami kon hin-o ka basi may igsumat namon han nagsugo ha amon. Ano man an imo ikasisiring mahitungod ha imo ngahaw?”
en: Finally they said, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

war: Binmaton hi Juan pinaagi han paghinabe niya han siring ni Isaias, an manaragna: “Amo ako ini: ‘An tingog hin usa nga naggogoliat didto han kamingawan: Tadonga an dalan nga aagian han Ginoo!’”
en: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, “I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ ”

war: An mga tawo nga ginsugo han mga Parisiyo
en: Now the Pharisees who had been sent

war: nagpakiana kan Juan, “Kay ano nga nagbubunyag ka man, kon diri ka man ngay-an an Mesiyas, o hi Elias, o an Manaragna?”
en: questioned him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”

war: Binmaton hi Juan, “Nagbubunyag ako hin tubig, kundi may usa dida ha iyo nga diri niyo kinikilala.
en: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands one you do not know.

war: Masunod hiya ha akon, kundi diri ngani ako takos bisan hin paghukas han iya sandalyas.”
en: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”

war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan didto ha Betania, sinirangan nga dapit han Salog han Jordan, diin namumunyag hi Juan.
en: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

war: Pagkabuwas, hinkit-an ni Juan hi Jesus nga tikada ha iya, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Kitaa, iini an Kordero han Dyos, nga nagkukuha han sala han kalibutan!
en: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

war: Amo ini hiya an akon hinnabihan han akon pagsiring, ‘May tawo nga masunod ha akon nga larulabaw ha akon, kay nakada na hiya han waray pa ako katatawo.’
en: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’

war: Waray ako makakilala ha iya, kundi kinmanhi ako nga namumunyag hin tubig, basi ipakilala ko hiya ngadto han mga tawo han Israel.”
en: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel.”

war: Amo ini an pagpamatuod ni Juan: “Hinkit-an ko an Espiritu nga nakunsad sugad hin sarapati nga tikang ha langit ngan hinmugdon ha iya.
en: Then John gave this testimony: “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.

war: Akon ito hinkit-an, ngan nagsusumat ako ha iyo nga hiya amo an Anak han Dyos.”
en: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One.”

war: Han pagkasunod nga adlaw didto na liwat hi Juan upod in duha niya nga mga tinun-an.
en: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.

war: Han pakakita niya kan Jesus nga nalabay, nagsiring hiya, “Kitaa, iini an Kordero han Dyos!”
en: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”

war: Nakabati an duha niya nga mga tinun-an han iya pagsiring hini, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.
en: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.

war: Usa han duha nga nakabati kan Juan ngan binmunyog kan Jesus, amo hi Andres nga bugto ni Simon Pedro.
en: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.

war: Hin-agian dayon ni Andres hi Simon nga iya bugto ngan ginsumatan niya, “Hin-agian namon an Mesiyas.” (“Cristo” an kahulogan hini nga pulong.)
en: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, “We have found the Messiah” (that is, the Christ).

war: Pagkabuwas naghunahuna hi Jesus hin pagkadto ha Galilea. Hin-agian niya hi Felipe ngan ginsiring niya, “Upod ha akon!” (
en: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, “Follow me.”

war: Taga-Betsaida ini hi Felipe, ngan amo liwat an bungto nira Andres ug Pedro.)
en: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.

war: Nagpakiana hi Natanael, “May-ada ba maupay nga matikang ha Nazaret?” “Tana, ngan kitaa,” nagbaton hi Felipe.
en: “Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.

war: Han paghikit-i ni Jesus kan Natanael nga nadaop ha iya, naghinabi hiya ha iya, “Iini in tinuod nga taga-Israel, waray gud sadang isuson ha iya.”
en: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, “Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”

war: Nagpakiana hi Natanael ha iya, “Ano hin pakakilala mo ha akon?” Binmaton hi Jesus, “Hinkit-an ko ikaw han nakadto ka ha sirong han kahoy nga igos, han waray ka pa tatawga ni Felipe.”
en: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you.”

war: Nagsiring hi Natanael, “Magturutdo, ikaw an Anak han Dyos, ikaw an Hadi han Israel!”
en: Then Nathanael declared, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira ngatanan, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: Hikikit-an niyo an langit nga binuksan, ngan masaka-lusad dida han Anak han Tawo an mga anghel han Dyos!”
en: He then added, “Very truly I tell you, you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’ the Son of Man.”

war: Paghagos hin duha ka adlaw, nagkaada kasal didto ha bungto han Cana, ha Galilea. Nakadto an iroy ni Jesus.
en: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,

war: Gindapit liwat ngadto hini nga pagkasal hi Jesus, pati an iya mga tinun-an.
en: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.

war: Han kaubos na han bino, ginsiring hi Jesus han iroy niya, “Waray na hira bino.”
en: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no more wine.”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Babaye, ayaw ako pagbut-i han akon bubuhaton. Waray pa abot an akon panahon.”
en: “Woman, why do you involve me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”

war: Gintugon han iroy ni Jesus an mga surugoon, “Buhata gud an bisan ano nga igsugo niya ha iyo.”
en: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”

war: May mga turumanon han ira tuluohan an mga Judiyo mahitungod hin panhugas, sanglit tungod hini, may mga tadyaw nga inandam didto, nga masulod hin mga 20 ngadto ha 30 ka galon an kada usa.
en: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.

war: Ginsiring ni Jesus an mga surugoon, “Pun-a niyo hin tubig ini nga mga tadyaw.” Ginpuno nira ini tubtob ha ganggang,
en: Jesus said to the servants, “Fill the jars with water” ; so they filled them to the brim.

war: ngan ginsiring hira niya, “Sarok na kamo han tubig, ngan dad-a ngadto han tinaporan han kombite.” Gindara nira ngadto han tinaporan,
en: Then he told them, “Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,

war: Ginbuhat ni Jesus ini nga syahan han iya mga milagro didto ha Cana, ha Galilea. Iginpadayag niya didto an iya gahom, ngan tinmoo ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.
en: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

war: Katapos hini, napakadto ha Capernaum hi Jesus, an iroy ngan an kabugtoan niya, pati an iya mga tinun-an, ngan nagpabilin hira didto hin pira ka adlaw.
en: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.

war: Hiraniay na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo, sanglit napakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.
en: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

war: Hinkit-an niya didto ha Templo an mga tawo nga nagbabaligya hin mga baka, mga karnero, ngan mga sarapati, ngan an mga parabalyo hin kwarta nga nanlilingkod sapit han ira mga lamesa.
en: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.

war: Ngan ginsugo niya an mga parabaligya han mga sarapati, “Kuhaa niyo ini dinhe! Ayaw niyo paghimoa nga taboan an balay han akon Amay!”
en: To those who sold doves he said, “Get these out of here! Stop turning my Father’s house into a market!”

war: Nahinumdom an iya mga tinun-an nga nasiring an kasuratan, “An akon tinuod nga pagmahal han imo balay, O Dyos, naglalaga ha akon kasingkasing sugad hin kalayo!”
en: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for your house will consume me.”

war: Gin-ayat hi Jesus han mga punoan nga Judiyo, “Ano nga milagro an ipakikita mo ha amon hin pagpasabot nga may-ada ka katungod hin pagbuhat hini?”
en: The Jews then responded to him, “What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Bungkaga niyo ini nga balay han Dyos ngan titindogon ko liwat sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.”
en: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”

war: “Kwarentay seis ka tuig an pagtindog hini nga templo, ngan titindogon mo ini sulod la hin tulo ka adlaw?” nagpakiana hira.
en: They replied, “It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?”

war: Kundi an Templo nga karuyag sidngon ni Jesus, amo an iya lawas.
en: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.

war: Sanglit han kabanhaw na niya, nahinumdom an iya mga tinun-an hini nga iya ginyakan, ngan tinmoo hira han kasuratan ngan han mga pulong nga iginsiring ni Jesus.
