en: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.

war: Samtang nakadto ha Jerusalem hi Jesus, ha panahon han Pyesta han Paglabay, damo in tinmoo ha iya, han pakakita nira han nabuhat niya nga mga milagro.
en: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.

war: Kundi waray tumagya ha ira hi Jesus, kay sayod hiya kaupay han ngatanan nga mga tawo.
en: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.

war: Waray na kinahanglan nga sumatan pa hiya mahitungod han mga tawo, kay daan hiya sayod kon ano an aada ha ira mga kasingkasing.
en: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.

war: May-ada tawo nga Nicodemo an ngaran, usa nga pangulo han mga Judiyo, nga sakop han hugpo han mga Parisiyo.
en: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko ikaw hin tinuod: waray tawo nga makakakita han Ginhadian han Dyos, labot kon matawo na liwat hiya.”
en: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again. ”

war: Nagpakiana hi Nicodemo, “Uunanhon hin usa nga tigurang na hin katawo na liwat? Diri na gud hiya makakabalik ha tagoangkan han iroy niya, ngan ig-anak hin ikaduha!”
en: “How can someone be born when they are old?” Nicodemus asked. “Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be born!”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko ikaw hin tinuod: waray tawo nga makakasulod han Ginhadian han Dyos labot kon matawo hiya pinaagi hin tubig ngan han Espiritu.
en: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.

war: Tikang hin mga kag-anak an lawasnon nga pagkatawo; kundi tikang han Espiritu an espirituhanon nga pagkatawo.
en: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

war: Ayaw hipausa nga nasiring ako ha imo, ‘Kinahanglan matawo na liwat kamo ngatanan!’
en: You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’

war: “Uunanhon man ini?” nagpakiana hi Nicodemo.
en: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Bantogan ka nga magturutdo ha Israel, ngan diri ka ba nakakasabot hini?
en: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and do you not understand these things?

war: Susumatan ko ikaw hin tinuod: nagyayakan kami han amon hinbabaroan ngan nagsusumat kami han amon hinkit-an, kundi waray ha iyo naruruyag hin pagkarawat han amon mensahe.
en: Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.

war: Ngan waray pagud nakasaka ha langit labot han Anak han Tawo nga linmusad tikang ha langit!”
en: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.

war: Sugad nga gin-isa ni Moises didto ha kamingawan an halas nga bronse, kinahanglan man liwat nga isahon an Anak han Tawo hin sugad nga paagi,
en: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

war: basi makaangkon han dayon nga kinabuhi an ngatanan nga natoo ha iya.
en: that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”

war: Kay waray magsugo an Dyos han iya Anak nganhi hin paghukom han kalibutan, kundi hin pagtalawas han kalibutan.
en: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.

war: Diri ginhuhukman an bisan hin-o nga nasarig han Anak, kundi ginhukman na an bisan hin-o nga diri nasarig, kay waray hiya sumarig han bugtong nga Anak han Dyos.
en: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.

war: Amo ini an paagi han paghukom: inmabot an kapawa ha kalibutan, kundi ginpalabi han mga tawo an kasisidman kay han kapawa, kay nagbubuhat man hira hin maraot.
en: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.

war: Nadiri han kapawa, an bisan hin-o nga nagbubuhat hin karat-an, ngan nalikay han kapawa, kay diri hiya naruruyag nga hikit-an an iya magraot nga mga buhat.
en: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.

war: Kundi napakita ha kapaw-an an bisan hin-o nga nagbubuhat hin matadong, basi hikit-an nga nagsusugot hiya han Dyos.
en: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.

war: Katapos hini napakadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha lalawigan han Judea. Nagpabilin hiya didto kaupod nira sulod hin pira ka adlaw ngan nanmunyag hiya.
en: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.

war: Nanmumunyag liwat hi Juan didto ha Enon, nga hirani ha Salim, kay damo an tubig didto. Napakadto an mga tawo kan Juan ngan iya ginbubunyagan hira. (
en: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.

war: Waray pa hadto kapriso hi Juan.)
en: (This was before John was put in prison.)

war: May mga tinun-an ni Juan nga nakiglantugi hin usa nga Judiyo mahitungod hin turumanon han tuluohan bahin hin paglinis.
en: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.

war: Nagbaton hi Juan, “Waray maaangkon in bisan hin-o labot kon ihatag ito ha iya han Dyos.
en: To this John replied, “A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.

war: Kamo ngahaw an akon mga saksi nga nagsiring ako, ‘Diri ako amo an Mesiyas, kundi ginsugo ako una ha iya.’
en: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’

war: Kinahanglan magtikadungganan hiya, samtang magtikaubos ako.”
en: He must become greater; I must become less.”

war: Labaw han ngatanan hiya nga tikang ha igbaw; hiya nga tikang ha tuna kanan tuna ngan naghihimangraw mahitungod han tunan-on nga mga butang. Labaw han ngatanan hiya nga tikang ha langit.
en: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.

war: Nagsusumat hiya han iya hinkit-an ngan hinbatian, kundi waray nakarawat han iya mensahe.
en: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

war: Bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han iya mensahe, nagpapamatuod nga kasasarigan an Dyos.
en: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.

war: Naghihimangraw han mga pulong han Dyos an ginsugo han Dyos, kay ihinahatag ha iya han Dyos an kahingpitan han iya Espiritu.
en: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

war: Nahigugma an Amay han iya Anak ngan igintapod ha iya gahom an ngatanan nga mga butang.
en: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.

war: May dayon nga kinabuhi an nasarig han Anak; kundi an nalaris han Anak diri gud makakaangkon han kinabuhi, ngan magpapabilin ha iya ha kadayonan an kapungot han Dyos.
en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.

war: Nakabati an mga Parisiyo nga darudamo an mga tinun-an nga nakabig ngan nabunyagan ni Jesus kay ni Juan. (
en: Now Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John—

war: Ha tinuod diri hi Jesus ngahaw an nanmunyag, kundi an iya la mga tinun-an.)
en: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.

war: Han paghibaro ni Jesus hini, binmaya anay hiya han Judea, ngan binmalik ngadto ha Galilea.
en: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.

war: Maagi gud hiya ha Samaria kon makadto hiya ha Galilea.
en: Now he had to go through Samaria.

war: Inmabot hiya ha Sicar, usa nga bungto ha Samaria, nga hirani han tuna nga iginhatag ni Jacob kan Jose nga iya anak.
en: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

war: Nakadto an atabay ni Jacob. Tungod han kakapoy han pagbaktas, linmingkod hi Jesus ha ligid han atabay, kay tikaurudto na.
en: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.

war: 7-8 Napakadto ha bungto an iya mga tinun-an hin pagpalit hin pagkaon. May inmabot nga usa nga Samaritana hin pag-alog, ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Paimna gad ako.”
en: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)

war: Nagsiring an babaye, “Hain ka man kukuha hito nga tubig, kay waray ka man ikarabo, ngan hilarom an atabay?
en: “Sir,” the woman said, “you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?

war: Hi Jacob nga amon ginikanan an naghatag ha amon hini nga atabay, ngan nanginom hini hira ngatanan: hiya, an iya mga anak, ngan an iya mga hayop. Labaw ka pa ba kan Jacob?”
en: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Uuhawon la gihapon an bisan hin-o nga mainom hini nga tubig,
en: Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,

war: Nagsiring an babaye, “Tagi gad ako hini nga tubig, basi diri na ako uhawon, ngan diri na ako magbinalikbalik nganhi hin pag-alog.”
en: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water so that I won’t get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Kadto na, tawaga an imo bana ngan balik nganhi.”
en: He told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”

war: “Waray ako asawa,” nagsiring an babaye. Binmaton hi Jesus, “Tama an imo siring nga waray ka bana,
en: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, “You are right when you say you have no husband.

war: kay lima na an imo iginkaasawa, ngan diri mo bana iton iginkakalungon mo yana. Matuod gud an imo siring.”
en: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true.”

war: “Naabat ako nga usa ka nga manaragna,” nagsiring an babaye.
en: “Sir,” the woman said, “I can see that you are a prophet.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Babaye, tuod na la ha akon: maabot an panahon nga diri na an mga tawo magsisingba han Amay dinhe hini nga bukid o didto ha Jerusalem.
en: “Woman,” Jesus replied, “believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

war: Diri kamo nga mga Samaritano maaram kon hin-o an iyo ginsisingba; maaram kami nga mga Judiyo han amon ginsisingba, kay natikang ha mga Judiyo an katalwasan.
en: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.

war: Espiritu an Dyos, ngan kinahanglan magsingba ha espiritu ngan ha kamatuoran an mga nagsisingba ha iya.”
en: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”

war: Nagsiring an babaye ha iya, “Maaram ako nga maabot an Mesiyas, nga gintatawag nga Cristo. Kon umabot na hiya, susumatan kita niya han ngatanan nga mga butang.”
en: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ako amo hiya, ako nga nakikighimangraw ha imo.”
en: Then Jesus declared, “I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”

war: Binayaan han babaye an iya tibod ngan binmalik ngadto ha bungto. Nagsiring hiya ha mga tawo didto,
en: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,

war: “Tana, kitaa niyo an tawo nga nagsumat ha akon han ngatanan nga akon nabuhat. Amo na ba hiya an Mesiyas?”
en: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?”

war: Sanglit binayaan nira an bungto ngan napakadto hira kan Jesus.
en: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.

war: Hito ngahaw nga takna naghinangyo an mga tinun-an kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, kaon na!”
en: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, “Rabbi, eat something.”

war: Kundi nagbaton hiya, “May-ada ako pagkaon nga waray niyo hibabaroi.”
en: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”

war: Sanglit may hin parupakiana an mga tinun-an, “May-ada ba nagdul-ong ha iya hin pagkaon?”
en: Then his disciples said to each other, “Could someone have brought him food?”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “An akon pagkaon amo an pagtuman han kaburot-on han nagsugo ha akon ngan paghuman han iya ipinapagbuhat ha akon.
en: “My food,” said Jesus, “is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

war: Sinusuholan an mag-arani ngan gintitirok niya an mga inani para han dayon nga kinabuhi, basi magkaurosa hin pagkalipay an magtaranom ngan an mag-arani.
en: Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.

war: Matuod an darahunon, ‘Usa an nagtatanom, iba an nag-aani.’
en: Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.

war: Ginsugo ko kamo hin pag-ani dida hin uma nga waray niyo pagkabudlayi; iba in nagkabudlay hito, ngan kamo an nagpapahimulos han ira ginkabudlayan.”
en: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor.”

war: Tinmoo kan Jesus in damo han mga Samaritano hito nga bungto kay nagsiring an babaye, “Ginsumatan ako niya han ngatanan nga akon nabuhat.”
en: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”

war: Sanglit han pag-abot han mga Samaritano, naghangyo hira ha iya nga magpabilin hiya dida ha ira. Ngan nagpabilin didto hi Jesus hin duha ka adlaw.
en: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.

war: Damo pa in tinmoo tungod han iya mensahe,
en: And because of his words many more became believers.

war: Katapos hin duha ka adlaw didto, linmakat hi Jesus ngan pinmakadto ha Galilea.
en: After the two days he left for Galilee.

war: Hiya ngahaw an nagsiring, “Diri tinutuod an manaragna dida han iya kalugaringon nga tuna.”
en: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha Cana, ha Galilea, diin ginhimo niya nga bino an tubig. May-ada didto usa nga opisyal han bungto nga may anak nga lalake nga masakit didto ha Capernaum.
en: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Waray gud ha iyo matoo labot kon hikit-an niyo in dagko nga mga orosahon.”
en: “Unless you people see signs and wonders,” Jesus told him, “you will never believe.”

war: Nagbaton an opisyal, “Tana gad, upod ha akon nga diri pa napatay an akon anak.”
en: The royal official said, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

war: Ginasiring hiya ni Jesus, “Kadto na, mabubuhi an imo anak.” Tinmoo an tawo han mga pulong ni Jesus ngan linmakat hiya.
en: “Go,” Jesus replied, “your son will live.” The man took Jesus at his word and departed.

war: Dida ha dalan, han tipauli hiya, ginsugat hiya han iya mga surugoon upod an sumat nga buhi an iya anak.
en: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.

war: Ginpakianhan niya hira kon ano nga oras nahiolian an iya anak. Nagbaton hira, “Nalunasan hiya han iya hiranat kakulop han ala una.”
en: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, “Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him.”

war: Nahinumdom an amay nga amo gud nga takna an pagsiring ni Jesus ha iya, “Mabubuhi na an imo anak.” Sanglit, tinmoo hiya ngan an bug-os niya nga panimalay.
en: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, “Your son will live.” So he and his whole household believed.

war: Amo ini an ikaduha nga milagro nga ginbuhat ni Jesus han pag-abot niya ha Galilea tikang ha Judea.
en: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.

war: Katapos hini, nagpyesta an mga Judiyo ngan napakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.
en: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.

war: Didto ha Jerusalem, hirani han Portahan han mga karnero, may usa nga linaw nga parigoan, nga may lima nga mga balkon. Betsata an ngaran hini ha Hebreohanon.
en: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.

war: Nakada hini nga mga balkon in damo nga mga magsakit—mga buta, mga piay, ngan mga lulid. [Naghuhulat hira nga bumantad an tubig,
en: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.

war: May didto usa nga tawo nga 38 ka tuig na an iya kasakit.
en: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.

war: Hinkit-an hiya nga nahigda didto, ngan maaram hi Jesus nga maiha na hin duro an kasakit han tawo; sanglit ginsiring hiya, “Karuyag mo ba mag-upay?”
en: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to get well?”

war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan, ngan lakat.”
en: Then Jesus said to him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”

war: Naupay dayon an tawo; gindara niya an iya higdaan, ngan linmakat. Nahinabo ini ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway,
en: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,

war: sanglit ginsiring han mga punoan nga Judiyo an tawo nga naupay, “Adlaw nga Iparahuway yana, ngan supak ha aton Balaod an pagdara han imo higdaan.”
en: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, “It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat.”

war: Binmaton hiya, “Ginsiring ako han tawo nga nagtambal ha akon, ‘Dad-a an imo higdaan ngan lakat.’”
en: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ ”

war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Hin-o ini nga tawo nga nagsugo ha imo hin pagdara han imo higdaan ngan lakat?”
en: So they asked him, “Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?”

war: Kundi waray makakilala an natambal nga tawo kon hin-o an nagtambal ha iya, kay nasalipdan hi Jesus han damo nga mga tawo nga nakadto didto han iya paggawas.
en: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.

war: Katapos hini, iginkatapo hiya ni Jesus didto han Templo ngan ginsiring hiya, “Kitaa maupay ka na; bayai na an imo sala, kay bangin lugod labaw pa kamaraot an mahinabo ha imo.”
en: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”

war: Ngan linmakat an tawo ngan iya ginsumatan an mga punoan nga Judiyo nga hi Jesus an nagtambal ha iya.
en: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him well.

war: Tungod hini nagtikang hira pagdumot kan Jesus, kay ginbuhat niya ini nga pagtambal ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Dayuday nagbubuhat an akon Amay, sanglit kinahanglan liwat magbuhat ako.”
en: In his defense Jesus said to them, “My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”

war: Sugad nga ginbabanhaw han Amay an mga minatay ngan tinatagan hira hin kinabuhi, ha amo man nga paagi, nahatag an Anak hin kinabuhi hadton iya karuyag tagan.
en: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.

war: Diri na maghuhukom an Amay bisan kan kanay. Iginhatag na niya ngadto han iya Anak an bug-os nga katungod hin paghukom,
en: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,

war: basi magpasidungog han Anak an ngatanan, sugad han ira pagpasidungog han Amay. Bisan hin-o nga diri nagpapasidungog han Anak, diri man nagpapasidungog han Amay nga amo an nagsugo ha iya.
en: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.

war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: Tiarabot an panahon, ngan inmabot na ini—nga makakabati an mga minatay han tingog han Anak han Dyos, ngan mabubuhi adton makabati hini nga tingog.
en: Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.

war: Sugad nga an Amay, ha iya ngahaw, amo an tinikangan han kinabuhi, ha sugad man nga paagi, ginhimo niya an iya Anak nga magin tinikangan han kinabuhi.
en: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.

war: Ngan iginhatag ngadto han Anak an katungod hin paghukom, kay Anak han Tawo man hiya.
en: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.

war: Ayaw kamo hipausa hini; tiarabot an panahon nga makakabati han iya tingog an ngatanan nga mga minatay ha lubnganan,
en: “Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice

war: ngan magkakaguwa hira han ira mga lubnganan; mabangon ngan mabubuhi adton nagbuhat hin mag-upay, ngan mabangon ngan pagsisirotan adton nagbuhat hin magraot.
en: and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.

war: “Kon magsaksi ako ha akon la ngahaw, diri angay karawaton sugad nga tinuod nga pruyba an akon iginsiring.
en: “If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.

war: Kundi may-ada usa labot ha akon, nga nagsasaksi para ha akon, ngan maaram ako nga matuod an iginsisiring niya mahitungod ha akon.
en: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.

war: Ginpadara niyo an iyo mga sinugo ngadto kan Juan, ngan nagyakan hiya ha ngaran han kamatuoran.
en: “You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.

war: Diri nga nagkikinahanglan ako hin kanan tawo pagsaksi; ginsusumat ko la ini, basi matalwas unta kamo.
en: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.

war: Sugad hi Juan hin suga nga naglalaga ngan malamrag, ngan naruyag kamo ha usa ka dali hin pagpahimulos han iya kapawa.
en: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.

war: Ngan nagsasaksi liwat para ha akon an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon. Waray gud niyo hibatii an iya tingog, o hikit-i an iya nawong;
en: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,

war: ngan waray niyo tipigi ha iyo mga kasingkasing an iya mensahe, kay diri man kamo natoo han ginsugo niya.
en: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.

war: Nag-aaram kamo han Kasuratan kay naghuhunahuna kamo nga hiaagian niyo dida ha ira an dayon nga kinabuhi. Ngan nagpapamatuod ini hira ngahaw mahitungod ha akon!
en: You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,

war: Kundi diri niyo karuyag kumadi ha akon basi maangkon niyo an kinabuhi.
en: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.

war: “Diri ako nag-uungara nga dayawon ako hin mga tawo.
en: “I do not accept glory from human beings,

war: Kundi nakilala ako ha iyo; maaram ako nga waray kamo gugma para han Dyos ha iyo mga kasingkasing.
en: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.

war: Kinmanhi ako ha ngaran han akon Amay, kundi waray kamo kumarawat ha akon. Kon may kumanhi ha iya la kalugaringon nga ngaran, kakarawaton lugod hiya niyo.
en: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.

war: Karuyag niyo an paggidayawdayaw, kundi waray lugod niyo pagtinguhaa an pagdayaw nga natikang ha usa la nga Dyos: sanglit uunanhon hin pakatuo niyo?
en: How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God ?

war: Kundi ayaw kamo paghunahuna nga isusumbong ko kamo ngadto han akon Amay. Hi Moises, nga amo an iyo ginlaoman, hiya an magsusumbong ha iyo.
en: “But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.

war: Kon tinuod nga natoo kamo kan Moises, matoo unta kamo ha akon, kay nagsurat hiya mahitungod ha akon.
en: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.

war: Kundi tungod nga diri man kamo natoo han iya iginsurat, uunanhon hin pakatoo niyo han akon iginsiring?”
en: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?”

war: Katapos hini, binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea (o Lanaw han Tiberias).
en: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),

war: Nagsunod ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo, kay hinkit-an nira an iya mga milagro hin panambal han mga magsakit.
en: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.

war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan linmingkod upod an iya mga tinun-an.
en: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.

war: Hirani na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo.
en: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.

war: Ginsiring ini niya hin pagsari kan Felipe; ha tinuod, maaram hiya nga daan kon ano an iya bubuhaton.)
en: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.

war: Binmaton hi Felipe, “Bisan talagudti la an ipanhatag ha kada usa, magkikinahanglan gud ini ngatanan hin kapin hin kanan P400.00 nga tinapay.”
en: Philip answered him, “It would take more than half a year’s wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!”

war: Nagsiring hi Andres nga bugto ni Simon Pedro, nga usa han iya mga tinun-an,
en: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,

war: “May-ada dinhe lalakehay nga may lima ka bug-os nga sebada nga tinapay ngan hin duha nga isda. Kundi ano man la ini para hin sugad kadamo nga mga tawo?”
en: “Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Papanlingkora an mga tawo.” (Banwaon adto nga dapit.) Sanglit nagkalingkod an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga maabot hin harani lima ka yukot an kalalaken-an.
en: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).

war: Han busog na hira ngatanan, ginsiring niya an iya tinun-an, “Tiroka niyo an mga nanhisalin, basi waray makarag.”
en: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted.”

war: Sanglit gintirok nira an ngatanan, ngan napuno nira in dose nga basket han mga nanhisalin tikang ha lima ka bug-os nga tinapay nga pinangaon han mga tawo.
en: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

war: Nagsiring an mga tawo didto nga nagpakakita hini nga ginbuhat ni Jesus, “Amo na gud ini an Manaragna nga mapakanhi ha kalibutan!”
en: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, “Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”

war: Nakasabot hi Jesus nga tidaraop na hira hin pagkuha ha iya ngan pipiriton hiya basi himoon hiya nga hadi nira. Sanglit kinmadto na liwat hiya, nga nag-uusaan la, ha kapungtoran.
en: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.

war: Han tipagsisirom na, nanlugsong an iya mga tinun-an ngadto han lanaw.
en: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,

war: Sinmakay hira hin sakayan, ngan binmalik pagtabok han lanaw tipakadto ha Capernaum. Nagab-ihan hira, kundi waray pa aabot hi Jesus.
en: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

war: Hini nga takna nagmadlos, ngan nagmabalod hin duro.
en: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.

war: Nakapalawod na an mga tinun-an hin mga lima o unom ka kilometro, han paghikit-i nira kan Jesus nga naglalakat ha bawbaw han tubig, nagtitikahirani han sakayan, ngan duro gud an ira kahadlok.
en: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Ako ini, ayaw kamo kahadlok!”
en: But he said to them, “It is I; don’t be afraid.”

war: Nalipay hira pagpasakay ha iya; ngan dinmuong hira dayon ha dapit nga ira kinakadtoan.
en: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.

war: May iba nga mga sakayan nga tikang ha Tiberias dinmuong hirani han dapit nga pinangaonan han tinapay katapos magpasalamat an Ginoo.
en: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

war: Pakakita han mga tawo nga waray didto hi Jesus o an iya mga tinun-an, sinmakay hira hin mga sakayan ngan kinmadto ha Capernaum hin pagbiling ha iya.
en: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.

war: Han paghiagii kan Jesus han mga tawo didto ha tabok han lanaw, nagsiring hira ha iya, “Magturutdo, kakan-o ka pa abot nganhi?”
en: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”

war: Sanglit nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Ano man an sadang namon buhaton basi makatuman kami han mga ipinapagbuhat ha amon han Dyos?”
en: Then they asked him, “What must we do to do the works God requires?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ini an karuyag han Dyos ipabuhat ha iyo: sarig kamo han iya ginsugo.”
en: Jesus answered, “The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”

war: Nagpakiana liwat hira, “Ano nga tigaman han imo gahom an imo bubuhaton basi namon hikit-an, ngan sumarig kami ha imo? Ano man an bubuhaton mo?
en: So they asked him, “What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?

war: Nangaon han mana didto ha kamingawan an amon mga ginikanan, sumala han siring han kasuratan: ‘Gintagan hira niya hin tinapay nga tikang ha langit.’”
en: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”

war: Kay an pagkaon nga ihinahatag han Dyos amo hiya nga linmusad tikang ha langit, ngan nahatag hin kinabuhi ha kalibutan.”
en: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”

war: Ngan naghangyo hira ha iya, “Dayuday tagi kami hini nga pagkaon.”
en: “Sir,” they said, “always give us this bread.”

war: Nagsumat hi Jesus ha ira, “Ako amo an pagkaon nga nahatag han kinabuhi. An napakadi ha akon diri na gud gugutomon; ngan an nasarig ha akon diri na gud uuhawon.
en: Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

war: Ginsiring ko na kamo nga bisan kon hinkit-an ako niyo, diri la gihapon kamo natoo ha akon.
en: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.

war: Napakadi ha akon an bisan hin-o nga itinutubyan ha akon han Amay. Diri ko gud isasalikway an bisan hin-o nga mapakadi ha akon,
en: All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.

war: kay linmusad ako tikang ha langit diri pagtuman han akon kalugaringon nga kaburot-on, kundi han kaburot-on han nagsugo ha akon.
en: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.

war: Karuyag han nagpadara ha akon nga buhaton ko ini: nga waray mawara hin bisan usa han ngatanan nga iya igintubyan ha akon, kundi nga banhawon ko hira ngatanan ha kataposan nga adlaw.
en: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.

war: Kay amo ini an karuyag han akon Amay: nga makaangkon han dayon nga kinabuhi an ngatanan nga nakilala han Anak ngan natoo ha iya; ngan babanhawon ko hira ha kataposan nga adlaw.”
en: For my Father’s will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.”

war: Nagtikang pagnginurutob kontra kan Jesus an mga Judiyo, kay nagsiring man hiya, “Ako an pagkaon nga linmusad tikang ha langit.”
en: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”

war: Sanglit nagsiring hira, “Diri ba ini hi Jesus nga anak ni Jose? Nakilala kita han iya mga kag-anak; kay ano nga nasiring man hiya yana nga linmusad hiya tikang ha langit?”
en: They said, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, ‘I came down from heaven’ ?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo pagnginurutob.
en: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus answered.

war: Waray makakakadi ha akon labot kon kabigon hiya ngadi ha akon han Amay nga nagsugo ha akon; ngan babanhawon ko hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.
en: “No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.

war: Nagsurat an mga manaragna, ‘Tututdoan han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga tawo.’ An ngatanan nga namamati han Amay ngan nahibabaro tikang ha iya napakadi ha akon.
en: It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.

war: Diri karuyag sidngon hini nga may-ada na nakakita han Amay; hiya la nga tikang han Dyos an nakakita han Amay.
en: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.

war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod; may-ada na dayon nga kinabuhi adton natoo.
en: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.

war: Amo ako an pagkaon nga nahatag han kinabuhi.
en: I am the bread of life.

war: Nangaon han mana didto ha kamingawan an iyo mga ginikanan, kundi nagkamatay hira.
en: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.

war: Kundi diri na mamamatay an nakaon han pagkaon nga tikang ha langit.
en: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.

war: Amo ini an nakatikang hin mapaso nga lantugi han mga Judiyo. Nagpakiana hira, “Uunanhon hini nga tawo pakahatag ha aton han iya unod basi kaonon ta?”
en: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: mawawaray kamo kinabuhi ha iyo ngahaw kon diri kamo kumaon han unod han Anak han Tawo ngan uminom han iya dugo.
en: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.

war: May-ada dayon nga kinabuhi an makaon han akon unod ngan mainom han akon dugo, ngan babanhawon ko hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.
en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.

war: Kay tinuod gud nga pagkaon an akon unod, ngan tinuod gud nga irimnon an akon dugo.
en: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.

war: An nakaon han akon unod ngan nainom han akon dugo aadi ha akon ngan aada ako ha iya.
en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.

war: Ginsugo ako han buhi nga Amay, ngan tungod ha iya buhi liwat ako. Ha amo man nga paagi, buhi liwat tungod ha akon an nakaon ha akon.
en: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.

war: Ginsiring ini ni Jesus samtang nagtutdo hiya didto han sinagoga ha Capernaum.
en: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

war: Nakabati hini in damo han iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Makuri hin duro matugkad ini nga pagturon-an. Hin-o in makakasantop hini?”
en: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, “This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?”

war: Bisan kon waray nagsumat, nahibaroan ni Jesus nga nagnginginurutob an iya mga tinun-an mahitungod hini: sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nakapaluya ba ini han iyo pagtoo ha akon?
en: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, “Does this offend you?

war: Niyan, ano daw la kon mahibalik an iyo pagtoo kon kumita na kamo han Anak han Tawo nga masaka ngadto han dapit nga iya anay inokyan?
en: Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!

war: An Espiritu han Dyos an nahatag hin kinabuhi; diri gud ito mahihimo hin gahom nga lawasnon. Espiritu ngan kinabuhi an iginhimangraw ko ha iyo nga mga pulong.
en: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.

war: Kundi may pira ha iyo nga diri natoo ha akon.” (Tikang pa ha tinikangan, maaram na nga daan hi Jesus kon hin-o an diri natoo, ngan kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya.)
en: Yet there are some of you who do not believe.” For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.

war: Ngan nagsiring pa hiya, “Amo gud ini an hinungdan nga nagsiring ako ha iyo, nga waray gud makakadaop ha akon labot kon itugot han Amay nga mahimo ito niya.”
en: He went on to say, “This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them.”

war: Tungod hini, binmulag in damo han iya mga tinun-an ngan waray na bumunyog ha iya.
en: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.

war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi Jesus han dose nga mga tinun-an, “Ngan kamo karuyag ba liwat niyo hin pagbaya ha akon?”
en: “You do not want to leave too, do you?” Jesus asked the Twelve.

war: Binmaton ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain pa man kami kakadto, Ginoo? Ikaw an may mga pulong nga nahatag han dayon nga kinabuhi.
en: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

war: Ngan yana natoo ngan maaram kami nga amo ka an Baraan nga tikang sa Dyos.”
en: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.”

war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Diri ba dose kamo nga akon ginpili? Kundi yawa an usa ha iyo!”
en: Then Jesus replied, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”

war: Naghinabi hiya mahitungod kan Judas, an anak ni Simon Iscariote, kay amo hiya an maglilingo kan Jesus, bisan kon usa hiya han dose nga mga tinun-an.
en: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)

war: Katapos hini, nagsudoy hi Jesus ha Galilea. Waray hiya maruyag pagsudoy ha Judea, kay gin-iiparatay hiya didto han mga punoan nga Judiyo.
en: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.

war: Hirani na an kanan Judiyo Pyesta han mga Tabernakulo,
en: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,

war: sanglit nagsiring kan Jesus an iya kabugtoan, “Bayai ini nga dapit ngan pakadto ha Judea, basi hikit-an han imo mga tinun-an an imo mga ginbubuhat.
en: Jesus’ brothers said to him, “Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.

war: Kon karuyag hin tawo nga kilal-on hiya hin maupay, ipapadayag niya an iya ginbubuhat. Tungod nga nagbubuhat ka man hini nga mga butang, pagpakilala ha bug-os nga kalibutan!” (
en: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world.”

war: Waray pagtoo ha iya bisan ngani an iya kabugtoan.)
en: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Waray pa umabot an akon igo nga panahon, kundi pirme igo ha iyo an ngatanan nga panahon.
en: Therefore Jesus told them, “My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.

war: Diri makakagdumot an kalibutan ha iyo, kundi nagdudumot ito ha akon, kay waray hunong an akon pagpamatuod nga maraot an iya mga paagi.
en: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.

war: Kamo na la in pasingadto ha pyesta; diri ako makadto hini nga pyesta; kay waray pa umabot an akon igo nga panahon.”
en: You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”

war: Iginyakan ini niya ha ira, ngan nagpabilin hiya ha Galilea.
en: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.

war: Pinmaorhe hi Jesus han iya kabugtoan hin pagkadto ha pyesta; waray hiya magpadayag, kundi hilit la an iya pagkadto.
en: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.

war: Nagpinamiling ha iya an mga Judiyo didto han pyesta ngan nagpinakiana hira kon hain hiya.
en: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, “Where is he?”

war: May hin huringhuring han mga tawo mahitungod ha iya. May nagsiring, “Maupay hiya nga tawo.” Nagsiring an iba, “Diri, ginlilipatlipat la niya an mga tawo.”
en: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others replied, “No, he deceives the people.”

war: Kundi tungod han ira kahadlok han mga punoan nga Judiyo, waray tawo nga ginmahom hin paghimangraw mahitungod ha iya.
en: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.

war: Han nagkakatunga na an ira pagsaurog han pyesta, pinmakadto hi Jesus ha Templo ngan nagtutdo.
en: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.

war: Nanhipausa an mga Judiyo ngan nagsiring, “Gin-unan-o hini nga tawo pakaangkon hin dako nga kinaadman, nga waray man ngani hiya makasulod hin eskwilahan?”
en: The Jews there were amazed and asked, “How did this man get such learning without having been taught?”

war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Diri akon pagturon-an an igintututdo ko, kundi tikang sa Dyos nga nagsugo ha akon.
en: Jesus answered, “My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.

war: Adton karuyag magtuman han ipinapagtuman han Dyos, mahibabaro kon an akon igintututdo tikang ba sa Dyos o tikang ba ha akon la kalugaringon nga pagburot-an.
en: Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.

war: Waray ba ighatag ha iyo ni Moises an Balaod? Kundi waray usa ha iyo nga nagtutuman han Balaod. Kay ano nga gin-iiparatay man ako niyo?”
en: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?”

war: Nagbaton an mga tawo, “May-ada ka gud yawa! Hin-o ngani an nag-iiparatay ha imo?”
en: “You are demon-possessed,” the crowd answered. “Who is trying to kill you?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Usa pa la nga milagro an akon ginbuhat, ngan nahipausa na kamo ngatanan.
en: Jesus said to them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.

war: Tungod nga nagsugo hi Moises nga turion an iyo mga anak nga lalake (bisan diri hi Moises kundi an iyo mga ginikanan an nagtikang hito), nagtuturi kamo hin bata ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.

war: Paghukom kamo sumala han tinuod nga lagda; ayaw na paghukom dara la han iyo hinkit-an.”
en: Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”

war: Nagsiring in pira nga mga tawo ha Jerusalem, “Diri ba ini an tawo nga gin-iiparatay nira?
en: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?

war: Kitaa, nagyiyinakan hiya ha kadaygan, ngan waray na lugod nagyayakan hin pagriwa ha iya! Tungod ba ito nga maaram na gud an mga punoan nga amo na hiya an Mesiyas?
en: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?

war: Kundi kon umabot na an Mesiyas, waray mahibabaro kon diin hiya tikang. Kundi maaram kita ngatanan kon diin tikang ini nga tawo.”
en: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from.”

war: Nakilala ako ha iya, kay tikang ako ha iya, ngan hiya an nagsugo ha akon.”
en: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”

war: Ngan gin-idarakop hiya nira, kundi waray naglabot ha iya, kay waray pa man umabot an iya takna.
en: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

war: Kundi tinmoo ha iya in damo nga mga tawo, ngan nagsiring, “Kon umabot an Mesiyas, magbubuhat ba hiya hin labaw pa nga mga milagro kay han nabuhat hini nga tawo?”
en: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, “When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?”

war: Nakabati an mga Parisiyo han larolantugi han mga tawo hini nga mga butang mahitungod ha iya, sanglit nagsugo hin mga gwardya pagdakop kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan an labaw nga kapadian.
en: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Madaliay na la an akon pakig-urosa ha iyo, ngan mabalik na ako ngadto han nagsugo ha akon.
en: Jesus said, “I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.

war: Mamimiling kamo ha akon, kundi diri kamo makakaagi ha akon; kay diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan.”
en: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”

war: Ano ba an karuyag niya sidngon han iya pagsiring, ‘Mamimiling kamo ha akon, kundi diri kamo makakaagi ha akon?’ ngan ‘Diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan?’”
en: What did he mean when he said, ‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’ and ‘Where I am, you cannot come’ ?”

war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan, ‘Tikang ha kasingkasing hadton natoo ha akon maawas in tubig nga nahatag hin kinabuhi.’”
en: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”

war: Iginsiring ini ni Jesus mahitungod han Espiritu nga kakarawaton hadton mga natoo ha iya. Hadto nga takna waray pa ihatag an Espiritu, kay waray pa man mamatay ngan mabanhaw hi Jesus.
en: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.

war: Han pakabati han damo nga mga tawo hini nga siring ni Jesus, nabuhag hira. May-ada nasiring, “Amo na gud ini an Manaragna!”
en: On hearing his words, some of the people said, “Surely this man is the Prophet.”

war: Nagsiring liwat an iba, “Amo na hiya an Mesiyas!” Kundi nagsiring pa an iba, “Diri matikang ha Galilea an Mesiyas!
en: Others said, “He is the Messiah.” Still others asked, “How can the Messiah come from Galilee?

war: Nasiring an kasuratan nga magigin tulin ni David an Mesiyas, ngan matatawo ha Betlehem, an bungto nga gin-ukyan ni David.”
en: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from David’s descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?”

war: Sanglit tungod ha iya nagkabuhag an mga tawo.
en: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.

war: Karuyag magdakop kan Jesus an pira ha ira, kundi waray gud nagpasipara hin pagkapot ha iya.
en: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.

war: Binmalik an mga gwardya ngadto han mga Parisiyo ngan mga puno han kapadian nga nagpakiana ha ira, “Kay ano nga waray man niyo dad-a hiya?”
en: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring him in?”

war: Nagbaton an mga gwardya, “Waray pa gud tawo nga naghimangraw hin sugad nga pagyakan hini nga tawo!”
en: “No one ever spoke the way this man does,” the guards replied.

war: Nagpakiana an mga Parisiyo, “Nalimbongan ba liwat kamo niya?
en: “You mean he has deceived you also?” the Pharisees retorted.

war: May-ada na ba niyo hinbaroan nga usa han mga punoan o usa nga Parisiyo nga tinmoo ha iya?
en: “Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?

war: Diri nasabot ini nga mga tawo han Balaod ni Moises, sanglit ginpanhimaraot hira han Dyos!”
en: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them.”

war: Usa han mga Parisiyo amo hi Nicodemo nga nakigkita hadto kan Jesus. Nagsiring hiya ha ira,
en: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,

war: “Sumala han aton Balaod, diri kita makakaghukom hin tawo kon diri anay naton hibatian hiya ngan hikit-an kon ano an iya nabuhat.”
en: “Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?”

war: [Ngan nanguli an ngatanan, kundi napakadto hi Jesus ha Bukid han mga Olibo.
en: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

war: Han pagkabuwas han temprano pa, binmalik hiya ha templo. Ginalirongan hiya han mga tawo, ngan linmingkod hiya ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo ha ira.
en: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.

war: Gindara han mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan mga Parisiyo in usa nga babaye nga hindakpan nga nanlibog, ngan ginpatindog hiya ha atubangan nira ngatanan.
en: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group

war: Nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, hindakpan ini nga babaye nga nanlibog.
en: and said to Jesus, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

war: Ha aton Balaod, iginsugo ni Moises nga kinahanglan batoon tubtob han kamatay in sugad nga babaye. Yana, ano man an imo isisiring?”
en: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?”

war: Iginsiring nira ini hin pagbitik ha iya, basi mahisumbong nira hi Jesus. Kundi tinmamod hi Jesus ngan nagsurat ha tuna pinaagi han iya tudlo.
en: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.

war: Samtang nagpipinakiana hira, tinmukdaw hi Jesus ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Umona hin pagbato ha iya an waray sala ha iyo.”
en: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, “Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”

war: Ngan tinmamod na liwat hiya ngan nagsurat ha tuna.
en: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.

war: Han pakabati nira hini, nagpatag-usa hira hin pagbaya, tikang han mga magurang. Nahibilin na la hi Jesus, ngan an babaye nga nakada pa harani ha iya.
en: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.

war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Hain naman hira, Mana? Waray ba nahibilin hin pagsirot ha imo?”
en: Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”

war: “Waray, bisan usa,” nagbaton an babaye. Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Diri liwat ako magsisirot ha imo. Hala, kadto na, kundi ayaw na pagpinakasala.”]
en: “No one, sir,” she said. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Go now and leave your life of sin.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga Parisiyo, “Nagpapamatuod ka yana ha imo la ngahaw; diri kamatuoran an imo iginsisiring.”
en: The Pharisees challenged him, “Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid.”

war: Naghuhukom kamo hin tinawo gudla nga paagi; diri ako naghuhukom bisan kan kanay.
en: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.

war: Kundi kon maghukom man lugaring ako, matuod an akon paghukom, kay diri man ako la an maghuhukom; kaupod ko an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.
en: But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.

war: Nahisurat ha iyo Balaod nga kon nagkakauyon in duha nga mga saksi, matuod an ira iginsisiring.
en: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.

war: Nagpapamatuod ako mahitungod ha akon, ngan nagpapamatuod man mahitungod ha akon an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.”
en: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”

war: Ginsiring ni Jesus ini ngatanan samtang magtututdo hiya ha Templo, ha kwarto nga burutangan han mga surudlan han halad. Ngan waray nagdakop ha iya, kay waray pa man umabot an iya takna.
en: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.

war: Nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ha ira, “Malakat ako, ngan pagbibilngon ako niyo, kundi magkakamatay kamo dida han iyo mga sala. Diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan.”
en: Once more Jesus said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come.”

war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga punoan nga Judiyo, “Nasiring hiya nga diri kita makakakadto han iya kakadtoan. Karuyag ba sidngon hini nga mag-uunay hiya?”
en: This made the Jews ask, “Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, ‘Where I go, you cannot come’ ?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Tikang kamo dinhe ha tuna, kundi tikang ako ha langit. Tikang kamo hini nga kalibutan, kundi diri ako tikang hini nga kalibutan.
en: But he continued, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

war: Sanglit nagsumat ako ha iyo nga mamamatay kamo dida han iyo mga sala. Ngan magkakamatay kamo dida han iyo mga sala kon diri kamo tumoo nga ‘Ako Amo hi Ako’.”
en: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins.”

war: “Kay hin-o ka man ngay-an?” nagpakiana hira ha iya. Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ada, amo ako an iginsumat ko na ha iyo tikang pa hadto.
en: “Who are you?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.

war: Damo pa unta an akon igsisiring ngan ighuhukom mahitungod ha iyo. Kundi an nagpadara ha akon diri buwaon, ngan iginsusumat ko la ha kalibutan an hinbatian ko tikang ha iya.”
en: “I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.”

war: Waray hira sabot nga naghihimangraw hiya ha ira mahitungod han Amay.
en: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.

war: Ngan kaupod ko an nagsugo ha akon; waray ako niya pagpabay-i nga mag-usaan, kay dayuday ko binubuhat an nakakalipay ha iya.”
en: The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him.”

war: Tinmoo kan Jesus in damo han mga nagpakabati hini nga mga iginsiring niya.
en: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus ngadto han mga Judiyo nga tinmoo ha iya, “Kamo an tinuod ko nga mga tinun-an, kon tumanon niyo an akon igintutdo,
en: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, “If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.

war: ngan hibabaroan niyo an kamatuoran, ngan an kamatuoran an magtatalwas ha iyo.”
en: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

war: Nagbaton hira, “Mga tulin kami ni Abraham, ngan waray pa gud kami maoripon hin bisan hin-o, sanglit ano an karuyag mo sidngon han imo pagsiring, ‘Matatalwas kamo’?”
en: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: oripon han sala an ngatanan nga nakakasala.
en: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

war: Diri dayuday sakop han panimalay an oripon, kundi sakop ha kadayonan an anak.
en: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.

war: Sanglit matatalwas gud kamo hin tinuod kon an Anak an magtalwas ha iyo.
en: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

war: Maaram ako nga mga tulin kamo ni Abraham, kundi gin-iiparatay ako niyo, kay diri man kamo nakarawat han akon pagturon-an.
en: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.

war: Naghihimangraw ako mahitungod han iginpakita ha akon han akon Amay, kundi binubuhat niyo an iginsumat ha iyo han iyo amay.”
en: I am telling you what I have seen in the Father’s presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father. ”

war: Nagbaton hira ha iya, “Hi Abraham an amon amay.” Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon tinuod nga mga anak kamo ni Abraham, bubuhaton unta niyo an mga buruhaton nga ginbuhat niya.
en: “Abraham is our father,” they answered. “If you were Abraham’s children,” said Jesus, “then you would do what Abraham did.

war: An akon nabuhat amo la an pagsumat ha iyo han kamatuoran nga akon hinbatian tikang han Dyos, kundi gin-iiparatay ako niyo. Waray magbuhat hi Abraham hin sugad hini!
en: As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.

war: Ginbubuhat niyo an ginbuhat han amay niyo.” Nagbaton hira, “An Dyos la an amon Amay; kami an tinuod nga iya mga anak.”
en: You are doing the works of your own father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they protested. “The only Father we have is God himself.”

war: Kay ano nga diri kamo nasabot han akon iginyayakan? Tungod kay diri kamo nailob hin pamati han akon mga mensahe.
en: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.

war: Nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, sanglit diri kamo natuod ha akon.
en: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!

war: Hin-o ha iyo in makakapamatuod nga salaan ako? Kon nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, kay ano man nga diri kamo natuod ha akon?
en: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don’t you believe me?

war: Namamati han mga pulong han Dyos an tawo nga tikang ha Dyos. Kundi diri kamo tikang ha Dyos, sanglit diri kamo namamati ha akon.”
en: Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”

war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo kan Jesus, “Diri ba tama an amon pagsiring nga Samaritano ka ngan sinasangkayan ka hin yawa?”
en: The Jews answered him, “Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri gad ako sinasangkayan hin yawa. Ginpapasidunggan ko la an akon Amay, kundi ginpapakaalohan ako niyo.
en: “I am not possessed by a demon,” said Jesus, “but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

war: Diri ako nagtitingoha hin dungog ha akon kalugaringon. May-ada hito nagtitinguha ngan naghuhukom ugop ha akon.
en: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.

war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: diri na mapatay an bisan hin-o nga magtuman han akon pulong.”
en: Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”

war: Labaw ka pa ba kan Abraham nga amon amay? Namatay ngani hiya sugad man an mga manaragna, baga hin-o ka gud, ha imo paghunahuna?”
en: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”

war: Nalipay hi Abraham nga amay niyo hin pag-ikinikitaan han adlaw han akon pagkanhi; hinkit-an ini niya ngan nalipay hiya.”
en: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga Judiyo, “Waray pa ngani 50 an imo panuigon—ngan hinkit-an mo na hi Abraham?”
en: “You are not yet fifty years old,” they said to him, “and you have seen Abraham!”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: Diri pa tawo hi Abraham, ‘Amo na ako’.”
en: “Very truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “before Abraham was born, I am!”

war: Ngan namurot hira hin mga bato hin pagbato ha iya; kundi tinmago hi Jesus ngan ginmawas ha Templo.
en: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.

war: Han naglalakat hi Jesus, nakakita hiya hin tawo nga daan buta tikang han iya katawo.
en: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.

war: Nagpakiana ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, kanay man sala nga natawo hiya nga daan buta? Iya ba kalugaringon o kanan iya mga kag-anak?”
en: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Waray labot han iya pagkabuta an iya mga sala o an mga sala han iya mga kag-anak. Natawo hiya nga daan buta basi hikit-an an gahom han Dyos dida ha iya.
en: “Neither this man nor his parents sinned,” said Jesus, “but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.

war: Kinahanglan tumanon ta an mga buruhaton han nagsugo ha akon, samtang nga adlaw pa; maabot an gab-i ngan waray na makakagtrabaho.
en: As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.

war: Ako an kapawa han kalibutan samtang aanhi pa ako ha kalibutan.”
en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

war: Katapos niya pagsiring hini, linmura hi Jesus ha tuna, naghimo hin lapok pinaagi han iya laway, ngan gindihogan niya an mga mata han buta,
en: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.

war: ngan iya sidngon, “Kadto na, ngan paghiram-os didto ha linaw han Siloe.” (“Ginsugo” an kahulogan hini nga ngaran.) Sanglit kinmadto an tawo, naghiram-os hiya, ngan binmalik nga nakita na.
en: “Go,” he told him, “wash in the Pool of Siloam” (this word means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

war: Sanglit nagpakiana an iya mga amyaw ngan an mga tawo nga nakakita ha iya hadto, nga nakikilimos, “Diri ba amo ini an tawo nga hadto nalingkod didto ngan agsob makilimos?”
en: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, “Isn’t this the same man who used to sit and beg?”

war: May nagsiring, “Amo ini hiya,” kundi nagsiring an iba, “Diri hiya amo, kundi alid-agid la ha iya.” Sanglit nagsiring an tawo ngahaw, “Amo ako an tawo.”
en: Some claimed that he was. Others said, “No, he only looks like him.” But he himself insisted, “I am the man.”

war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Naunan-o man nga nakita ka na?”
en: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.

war: “Hain naman hiya?” nagpakiana hira. “Ambot,” nagbaton hiya.
en: “Where is this man?” they asked him. “I don’t know,” he said.

war: Ngan gindara nira ngadto han mga Parisiyo an tawo nga hadto anay buta.
en: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

war: Adlaw adto nga Iparahuway han paghimo ni Jesus hin lapok ngan pagtambal niya han kanan tawo mga mata.
en: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.

war: Kundi diri karuyag tumuod an mga punoan nga Judiyo nga buta hiya anay ngan yana nakita na. Sanglit gintawag nira an iya mga kag-anak,
en: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man’s parents.

war: ngan ginpakianhan nira, “Iyo ba ini anak? Nasiring kamo nga natawo hiya nga daan buta, niyan ano man in kasugad nga nakita na man hiya yana?”
en: “Is this your son?” they asked. “Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?”

war: Nagbaton an iya mga kag-anak, “Maaram kami nga amon hiya anak, ngan natawo hiya nga daan buta.
en: “We know he is our son,” the parents answered, “and we know he was born blind.

war: Sanglit nagsiring an iya mga kag-anak, “May buot na man hiya; hiya na la an pakianhi.”
en: That was why his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”

war: “Diri ako maaram kon makasasala ba hiya o diri,” nagbaton an tawo. “An hinsabtan ko la amo ini: nakita na ako yana, kundi hadto buta ako.”
en: He replied, “Whether he is a sinner or not, I don’t know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!”

war: Nagpakiana hira, “Ano an ginbuhat niya ha imo? Gin-unan-o niya hin pagtambal han imo mga mata?”
en: Then they asked him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

war: Nagbaton hiya, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo, kundi diri man kamo natuod. Kay ano nga iyo ini gin-uolit-okit? Bangin la naruruyag liwat kamo nga magin tinun-an niya?”
en: He answered, “I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?”

war: Ginpakaraot hiya nira ngan ginsiring, “Ikaw an iya tinun-an, kundi mga tinun-an kami ni Moises.
en: Then they hurled insults at him and said, “You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!

war: Maaram kami nga nakighimangraw an Dyos kan Moises; mahitungod hito nga tawo, diri ngani kami maaram kon diin hiya tikang!”
en: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from.”

war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Pagkaorosahon hini! Diri kamo maaram kon diin hiya tikang, kundi ginpakita niya an akon mga mata!
en: The man answered, “Now that is remarkable! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

war: Maaram kita nga diri namamati an Dyos han mga makasasala; namamati hiya han mga tawo nga natahod ha iya ngan nagtutuman han karuyag niya ipabuhat ha ira.
en: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.

war: Tikang pa han tinikangan han kalibutan, waray pa gud hinbatian nga may nakatambal han mga mata nga daan buta.
en: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.

war: Waray gud mahihimo hito nga tawo kon diri hiya tikang ha Dyos.”
en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

war: Binmaton hira, “Natawo ngan nagtubo ka ha sala—ngan karuyag mo magtutdo ha amon?” Ngan ginpagawas hiya nira ha sinagoga.
en: To this they replied, “You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!” And they threw him out.

war: Hinbatian ni Jesus nga ginpagawas nira ha sinagoga an tawo. Hin-agian hiya ni Jesus ngan ginpakianhan, “Natoo ka ba han Anak han Tawo?”
en: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”

war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Sumati gad ako kon hin-o hiya, basi makatoo ako ha iya!”
en: “Who is he, sir?” the man asked. “Tell me so that I may believe in him.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hinkit-an mo na hiya, ngan amo hiya nga nakikighimangraw yana ha imo.”
en: Jesus said, “You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”

war: “Natoo ako, Ginoo!” nagsiring an tawo, ngan linmuhod hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus.
en: Then the man said, “Lord, I believe,” and he worshiped him.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kinmanhi ako hini nga kalibutan hin paghukom, basi makakita an mga buta, ngan mabuta an mga nakita.”
en: Jesus said, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind.”

war: Nakabati an pira nga mga Parisiyo nga nakada han pagsiring niya hini, ngan nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Karuyag ba nimo sidngon nga mga buta liwat kami?”
en: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, “What? Are we blind too?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon mga buta kamo, diri unta kamo salaan; kundi kay nasiring man kamo, ‘Nakita kami,’ karuyag sidngon hini nga salaan pa kamo.
en: Jesus said, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.

war: “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: kawatan ngan tikasan an tawo nga diri naagi ha porta hin pagsulod han turil, kundi nagsasaka hin iba nga agian.
en: “Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.

war: Magmarangno han mga karnero an tawo nga naagi ha porta.
en: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

war: Pinaaagi hiya han magbarantay han portahan; namamati an mga karnero han iya tingog kon gintatawag niya hira hin ira tagsatagsa nga ngaran, ngan pinagagawas niya hira han turil.
en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

war: Paghihigawas na nira, nag-uuna hiya ha ira, ngan nasunod an mga karnero ha iya kay nakilala han iya tingog.
en: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

war: Diri hira masunod hin iba; lugod makalagiw hira, kay diri nira kinikilala an iya tingog.”
en: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice.”

war: Iginsumat ni Jesus ha ira ini nga pananglitan, kundi waray hira makasabot han karuyag sidngon han pananglitan.
en: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.

war: Sanglit nagsiring liwat hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: amo ako an porta para han mga karnero.
en: Therefore Jesus said again, “Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.

war: Mga kawatan ngan mga tikasan an ngatanan nga kinmanhi una ha akon; kundi waray mamati ha ira an mga karnero.
en: All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.

war: Amo ako an porta. Matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga masulod pinaaagi ha akon, masulod-guwa hiya ngan makakaagi hin panibsiban.
en: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.

war: Nasulod la an kawatan hin pangawat, panmatay, ngan panmungkag. Kinmanhi ako basi makaangkon hira han kinabuhi, an hura nga kinabuhi.
en: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

war: “Amo ako an maupay nga magmarangno han mga karnero. An maupay nga magmarangno andam pag-unong han iya kinabuhi tungod han mga karnero.
en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

war: Nakalagiw an sinuholan, kay sinuholan man la hiya ngan diri napaid han mga karnero.
en: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.

war: “Nahigugma an Amay ha akon kay andam man ako hin paghatag han akon kinabuhi basi mahibalik liwat ini ha akon.
en: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.

war: Nagkabahin na liwat an mga Judiyo tungod hini nga mga pulong.
en: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.

war: Nagsiring in kadam-an ha ira, “Sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa ngan nakulangan ha hiya hin buot! Kay ano nga namamati pa kamo ha iya?”
en: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?”

war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Diri makakaghimangraw hin sugad hini in tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa! Uunanhon man hin yawa pagpakita han mga buta?”
en: But others said, “These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”

war: Inmabot an panahon han pagsaurog han Pyesta han Paghalad didto ha Jerusalem ngan panahon adto hin kathagkot,
en: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,

war: ngan didto ha Templo naglalakat hi Jesus didto han Balkon ni Solomon.
en: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.

war: Gin-alirongan hiya han mga Judiyo nga nagsiring, “Tubtob san-o an imo pagpinakulbai ha amon? Sumati kami hin tinuod kon amo ka an Mesiyas.”
en: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly.”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo, kundi diri man kamo natuod ha akon. Saksi ha akon an gintuman ko nga mga buhat nga sugo han akon Amay;
en: Jesus answered, “I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,

war: kundi diri kamo matuod kay diri man kamo akon mga karnero.
en: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.

war: Namamati han akon tingog an akon mga karnero; nakilala ako ha ira, ngan nasunod hira ha akon;
en: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

war: Nahatag ako ha ira han dayon nga kinabuhi, ngan diri nagud hira mamamatay; ngan waray makakaagaw ha ira tikang ha akon.
en: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.

war: Labaw han ngatanan an akon Amay nga amo an naghatag ha ira ha akon, ngan waray gud makakaagaw ha ira tikang han kamot han Amay.
en: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all ; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

war: Mag-usa la an Amay ug ako.”
en: I and the Father are one.”

war: Nanmurot na liwat an mga Judiyo hin mga bato paglabay ha iya.
en: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,

war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Damo nga mga mag-upay an akon nabuhat ha iyo atubangan nga sugo han akon Amay; hain man hini nga mga buhat in pinasisikaran niyo hin pagbato ha akon?”
en: but Jesus said to them, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?”

war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Ginbabato ka namon diri tungod hin ano man nga mag-upay nga mga buhat, kundi tungod han imo pagpasipara han Dyos! Nagpapaka-Dyos ka, nga tawo ka man la!”
en: “We are not stoning you for any good work,” they replied, “but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God.”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Di ba nahisurat ha iyo kalugaringon nga Balaod nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Mga dyos kamo’?
en: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’ ?

war: Maaram kita nga matuod ha kadayonan an iginsisiring han kasuratan, ngan gintawag han Dyos nga mga dyos adton mga tawo nga gintaporan han iya mga pulong.
en: If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—

war: Mahitungod ha akon, ginpili ako han Amay ngan ginsugo nganhi ha kalibutan. Sanglit uunanhon pakasiring niyo nga nagpapasipara ako han Dyos tungod han pagsiring ko nga amo ako an Anak han Dyos?
en: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?

war: Sanglit angay diri kamo tumoo ha akon kon diri ako nagbubuhat han mga buhat han akon Amay.
en: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.

war: Gin-idarakop na liwat hiya nira, kundi nakapudlos hiya tikang ha ira mga kamot.
en: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.

war: Binmalik na liwat hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han Salog han Jordan, ngadto han dapit diin nanmunyag hi Juan, ngan nagpabilin hiya didto.
en: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,

war: Pinmakadto ha iya in damo nga mga tawo. Nagsiring hira, “Waray magbuhat hi Juan hin mga orosahon, kundi puros matuod an iginsiring niya mahitungod hini nga tawo.”
en: and many people came to him. They said, “Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true.”

war: Ngan damo nga mga tawo didto in tinmoo kan Jesus.
en: And in that place many believed in Jesus.

war: May usa nga tawo nga hi Lazaro an ngaran. Nag-ukoy hiya ha Betania upod an iya kabugtoan nga kababayen-an, hira Maria ug Marta. (
en: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

war: Amo ini nga Maria an nagbubo hin pahamot ha mga tiil han Ginoo ngan ginpahiran han iya buhok. Nasakit hi Lazaro nga iya bugto.)
en: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)

war: Nagpatugon ini nga magbugto nga kababayen-an ngadto kan Jesus nga sidngon hiya, “Ginoo, masakit an imo suok nga sangkay.”
en: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one you love is sick.”

war: Hinigugma ni Jesus hira Marta, Maria, ug Lazaro.
en: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

war: Han pakabati niya nga masakit hi Lazaro, duha anay ka adlaw an iya ginpalabay san-o hiya kumadto.
en: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,

war: Katapos, nagsiring hiya ngadto han iya mga tinun-an, “Tana, balik kita ha Judea.”
en: and then he said to his disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”

war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, diri pa la maiha nga gin-iibarato ka didto han mga Judiyo, ngan karuyag mo na liwat hin pagkadto?”
en: “But Rabbi,” they said, “a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Di ba may dose ka oras an usa ka adlaw? Sanglit diri mahipapakdol an tawo nga maglalakat ha kapaw-an, kay nakita hiya han kapawa hini nga kalibutan.
en: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this world’s light.

war: Kundi mahipapakdol hiya kon maglakat hiya ha gab-i, kay masirom man.”
en: It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”

war: Ginsiring ini ni Jesus ngan sinumpayan pa niya pagsiring, “Nakaturog hi Lazaro nga aton sangkay, kundi makadto ako hin pagpukaw ha iya.”
en: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up.”

war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Ginoo, mag-uupay hiya kon nakaturog la hiya.”
en: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better.”

war: Karuyag sidngon ni Jesus nga patay na hi Lazaro; kundi naghunahuna an mga tinun-an nga nagsiring hi Jesus nga nakaturog la hiya.
en: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.

war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hin waray lipodlipod, “Patay na hi Lazaro;
en: So then he told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,

war: kundi tungod ha iyo nalilipay ako nga waray ako didto upod ha iya, basi tumoo kamo. Kadtoa ta hiya.”
en: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”

war: Nagsiring ngadto han iya mga igkasi tinun-an hi Tomas, an ginngangaranan nga Karuha, “Tana, bunyog kita ngatanan han Magturutdo, basi mamatay kita upod ha iya!”
en: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus ) said to the rest of the disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him.”

war: Pag-abot ni Jesus, nasayran niya nga upat na ka adlaw nga iginlubong hi Lazaro.
en: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.

war: Mga tulo la ka kilometro an Betania tikang ha Jerusalem,
en: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,

war: ngan damo nga mga Judiyo an kinmadto hin pagliaw kanda Marta ug Maria mahitungod han kamatay han ira bugto.
en: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.

war: Han pakabati ni Marta nga tiarabot hi Jesus, kinmadto hiya hin pagtapo, samtang hi Maria nagpabilin ha balay.
en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.
