war: Nagsiring hi Marta kan Jesus, “Ginoo, diri unta napatay an akon bugto kon nakanhi ka pa!
en: “Lord,” Martha said to Jesus, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

war: Kundi maaram ako nga bisan yana, ihahatag ha imo han Dyos an bisan ano nga imo pangaroon ha iya.”
en: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask.”

war: Ginsumatan hiya ni Jesus, “Mababanhaw an imo bugto.”
en: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

war: Nagbaton hi Marta, “Maaram ako nga mababanhaw hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.”
en: Martha answered, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hi ako an pagkabanhaw ngan an kinabuhi. Mabubuhi an bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon, bisan kon mamatay hiya;
en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;

war: ngan diri na gud mamamatay an bisan hin-o nga buhi nga natoo ha akon. Natuod ka ba hini?”
en: and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

war: Nagbaton hiya, “Oo, Ginoo, natoo ako nga amo ka an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos, nga makanhi ha kalibutan.”
en: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world.”

war: Hinkit-an hiya ni Jesus nga nagtatangis, sugad man an mga Judiyo nga upod niya; nabantad an iya kasingkasing ngan inalpan hiya hin kalooy.
en: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

war: Nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Diin niyo iglubong hiya?” Nagbaton hira, “Kadi, Ginoo, ngan kitaa.”
en: “Where have you laid him?” he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.

war: Nagtangis hi Jesus.
en: Jesus wept.

war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga Judiyo, “Kitaa, pagkadako han iya paghigugma kan Lazaro!”
en: Then the Jews said, “See how he loved him!”

war: Kundi an iba ha ira nagsiring, “Hiya nga nakapakita han mga mata han buta, diri ba hiya takos makapugong han kamatayon ni Lazaro?”
en: But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?”

war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha lubnganan kay inalpan na liwat hiya hin kabido. Usa adto nga lungib nga sinadhan hin bato.
en: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

war: Nagsugo hi Jesus, “Kuhaa niyo an bato!” Nagbaton hi Marta nga bugto han minatay, “Naninimaho na hiya yana, Ginoo, kay upat na ka adlaw tikang hiya iginlubong.”
en: “Take away the stone,” he said. “But, Lord,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ba nagsiring ako ha imo nga hikikit-an mo an gahom han Dyos kon tumoo ka?”
en: Then Jesus said, “Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”

war: Ginkuha nira an bato. Hinmangad hi Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Nagpapasalamat ako ha imo, Amay ko, nga pinamamatian mo ako.
en: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, “Father, I thank you that you have heard me.

war: Maaram ako nga dayuday ka namamati ha akon, kundi iginyakan ko ini tungod hini nga mga tawo nga aanhi yana, basi tumoo hira nga ginsugo mo ako.”
en: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me.”

war: Katapos niya magsiring hini, ginmoliat hiya, “Lazaro! Gawas ngadi!”
en: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

war: Nakakita han ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo han mga Judiyo nga nagduaw kan Maria, ngan tinmoo hira ha iya.
en: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.

war: Kundi kinmadto han mga Parisiyo an iba ha ira hin pagsumat ha ira han ginbuhat ni Jesus.
en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

war: Sanglit nakigkita han Labaw nga Hukmanan an mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo ngan nagsiring, “Ano an aton bubuhaton? Nagbubuhat ini nga tawo hin damo nga mga orosahon!
en: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. “What are we accomplishing?” they asked. “Here is this man performing many signs.

war: Kon pabay-an ta la hiya, matoo an ngatanan ha iya, ngan maabot an mga punoan nga Romano ngan bubungkagon an Templo ngan an aton bug-os nga nasod!”
en: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation.”

war: Nagsiring an usa ha ira, nga Caifas an ngaran, nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, “Waray gud kamo makasabot!
en: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, “You know nothing at all!

war: Diri ba kamo maaram nga mas maupay para ha iyo nga gabay usa la ka tawo an mamatay tungod han bungto, kay nga mabungkag an bug-os nga nasod?”
en: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”

war: Ginsiring ini niya diri ha iya kalugaringon nga pagbuot. Kundi tungod nga hiya an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, ginpanagna niya nga kinahanglan mamatay hi Jesus para han mga Judiyo,
en: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,

war: ngan diri la para ha ira, kundi pagtirok liwat ngan pag-urosa han ngatanan nga nagkakaburublag nga mga anak han Dyos.
en: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.

war: Tikang hadto nga adlaw, nagkasarabot an mga punoan nga Judiyo hin pagpatay kan Jesus.
en: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.

war: Nagpinamiling kan Jesus an mga tawo. Han katirok na nira didto han Templo, naggiparupakiana hira, “Ano an iyo hunahuna? Diri ba hiya mapakanhi ha Pyesta?”
en: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, “What do you think? Isn’t he coming to the festival at all?”

war: Nagsugo na an mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo nga adton maaram kon hain hi Jesus, kinahanglan magpahibaro dayon ha ira basi dakpon nira.
en: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.

war: Unom pa ka adlaw san-o umabot an Pyesta han Paglabay, napakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, an bungto ni Lazaro nga ginbanhaw ni Jesus.
en: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

war: Nag-andam hira didto hin panihapon para ha iya, ngan nagdurot hi Marta, samtang nakigsaro hi Lazaro kan Jesus.
en: Here a dinner was given in Jesus’ honor. Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with him.

war: Nagsiring an usa han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, hi Judas Iscariote—an maglilingo ha iya,
en: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,

war: “Kay ano nga waray lugod ibaligya ini nga pahamot hin sais syintos pesos ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas?”
en: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year’s wages. ”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pasagdi la niyo hiya! Tugoti hiya pagbuhat hini kay gin-aandam niya ini para han adlaw han paglubong ha akon.
en: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “It was intended that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.

war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.”
en: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me.”

war: Nakabati in kadam-an nga mga Judiyo nga nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, sanglit napakadto hira, diri la tungod kan Jesus, kundi pagkita liwat kan Lazaro nga ginbanhaw ni Jesus.
en: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

war: Sanglit nagkasarabot an mga puno han kapadian hin pagpatay kan Lazaro;
en: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,

war: kay tungod ha iya damo nga mga Judiyo in nahibulag ha ira ngan tinmoo na kan Jesus.
en: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and believing in him.

war: Pagkabuwas, hinbatian han kadam-an nga mga tawo nga kinmadto han Pyesta han Paglabay, nga maabot hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.
en: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem.

war: Sanglit nanguha hira hin mga palwa ngan tinmapo hira kan Jesus; ngan naggogoliat hira, “Dayawon an Dyos! Dayawon hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo! Dayawon an Hadi han Israel!”
en: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, “Hosanna! ” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the king of Israel!”

war: Nakaagi hi Jesus hin asno ngan iya ginsakyan, sugad han nahisurat:
en: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:

war: “Ayaw kahadlok, syudad han Sion! Aanhi naabot an imo Hadi nga nasakay hin nati nga asno.”
en: “Do not be afraid, Daughter Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey’s colt.”

war: Nagsumat han nahinabo an mga tawo nga kaupod ni Jesus han pagtawaga niya kan Lazaro tikang ha lubnganan ngan pagbanhawa ha iya.
en: Now the crowd that was with him when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to spread the word.

war: Sanglit gintapo hiya han kadam-an, kay hinbatian nira nga ginbuhat niya ini nga urosahon.
en: Many people, because they had heard that he had performed this sign, went out to meet him.

war: Ngan may hinsiring an mga Parisiyo, “Kitaa daw! Waray gud naton mahihimo! Kitaa, nagsusunod na ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo!”
en: So the Pharisees said to one another, “See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!”

war: May mga Griego nga kaupod han mga kinmadto ha Jerusalem hin pagsingba ha panahon han pyesta.
en: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival.

war: Hinmarani hira kan Felipe nga taga-Betsaida, ha Galilea ngan nagsiring, “Karuyag namon makigkita kan Jesus.”
en: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, with a request. “Sir,” they said, “we would like to see Jesus.”

war: Kinmadto hi Felipe pagsumat kan Andres, ngan kinmadto hira nga duha pagsumat kan Jesus.
en: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Inmabot na yana an takna nga pagpapasidunggan an Anak han Tawo.
en: Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

war: Mawawad-an han iya kalugaringon an nahigugma han iya kinabuhi; kundi makakaangkon lugod han kinabuhi nga dayon adton nagdudumot han iya kinabuhi dinhe hini nga kalibutan.
en: Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

war: Amay ko, paghimayaa an imo ngaran!” Ngan nagyakan in tingog tikang ha langit, “Ginhimaya ko na ini, ngan paghihimayaon ko na liwat.”
en: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.”

war: Nakabati han tingog an kadam-an nga nagkakatukdaw didto, ngan nagsiring, “Nagdalugdog!” An iba nagsiring, “Nagyakan ha iya in usa nga anghel!”
en: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri tungod ha akon nga nagyakan ini nga tingog, kundi tungod ha iyo.
en: Jesus said, “This voice was for your benefit, not mine.

war: Ginhuhukman na yana an kalibutan; pupukanon na yana an punoan hini nga kalibutan.
en: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.

war: Kakabigon ko ngadi ha akon an ngatanan nga mga tawo, kon isahon na ako tikang ha tuna.” (
en: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

war: Ha pagsiring niya hini, iginpasabot niya an paagi han kamatayon nga iya pag-aantoson.)
en: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.

war: Sanglit too kamo han kapawa, samtang aada pa ha iyo ini, basi mahimo kamo nga mga anak han kapawa.” Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, linmakat hiya ngan tinmago.
en: Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light.” When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.

war: Bisan kon ginbuhat niya ini ngatanan nga mga urosahon ha atubangan nira, waray gihapon hira tumoo ha iya,
en: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.

war: basi matuman an iginsiring ni Isaias nga manaragna: “Ginoo, hin-o in tinmuod han iginsumat namon nga mensahe? Hin-o an ginpakita han Ginoo han iya gahom?”
en: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

war: Tungod hini waray hira makatoo, kay nagsiring liwat hi Isaias:
en: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:

war: Ginsiring ini ni Isaias kay hinkit-an niya an gahom ni Jesus, ngan nagyakan hiya mahitungod ha iya.
en: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.

war: Ginpalabi nira an pagdayaw ha ira han mga tawo kay han pagdayaw ha ira han Dyos.
en: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.

war: Namulong hi Jesus hin dako nga tingog, “An bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon; natoo diri la ha akon kundi ha iya liwat nga nagpadara ha akon.
en: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.

war: An bisan hin-o nga nakakakita ha akon nakakakita liwat ha iya nga nagpadara ha akon.
en: The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.

war: Kinmanhi ako usa nga kapawa han kalibutan, basi diri na magpabilin ha kasisidman an ngatanan nga natoo ha akon.
en: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.

war: May-ada maghuhukom hadton nasalikway ha akon ngan diri nakarawat han akon mensahe. An pulong nga akon iginyakan amo an maghuhukom ha iya ha kataposan nga adlaw!
en: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.

war: Tinuod ito, kay waray ako magyakan ha akon la kalugaringon, kundi an Amay nga nagpadara ha akon amo an nagsugo ha akon kon ano an akon igsisiring ngan igyayakan.
en: For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.

war: Ngan maaram ako nga nahatag han dayon nga kinabuhi an iya sugo. Sanglit kon ano an akon igsisiring, amo man ito an pinapagyakan ha akon han Amay.”
en: I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.”

war: Tarangka ha panihapon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an. Ginlarang na han Yawa nga maglilingo kan Jesus hi Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.
en: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

war: Maaram hi Jesus nga itinubyan ha iya han Amay an bug-os nga gahom, ngan maaram hiya nga tikang hiya ha Dyos, ngan tikadto na hiya sa Dyos.
en: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;

war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jesus ngan maglubas han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan magbagkos hin twalya.
en: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

war: Inmipis hiya hin tubig ngada ha palanggana ngan nagtikang hin panmusa han mga tiil han mga tinun-an, ngan ginpahiran han twalya nga iya iginbagkos.
en: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

war: Hinmarani kan Simon Pedro nga nagsiring ha iya, “Ginoo, mamumusa ka ba han akon mga tiil?”
en: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ka pa maaram yana kon ano an akon ginbubuhat, kundi hibabaroan mo ini onina.”
en: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”

war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako matugot nga mamusa ka han akon mga tiil!” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon diri ako mamusa han imo mga tiil, diri ka na magigin tinun-an ko.”
en: “No,” said Peter, “you shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with me.”

war: Nagbaton hi Simon Pedro, “Kon amo man ini, Ginoo, diri la an akon mga tiil, kundi ilakip liwat hin paghugas an akon mga kamot ngan ulo!”
en: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!”

war: Maaram na hi Jesus kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.”)
en: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.

war: Katapos niya pamusa han ira mga tiil, nagsul-ot na liwat hi Jesus han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan binmalik ha iya lingkoran ha lamesa. Nagpakiana hiya, “Nasayod ba kamo han ginbuhat ko ha iyo?
en: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. “Do you understand what I have done for you?” he asked them.

war: Natawag kamo ha akon nga magturutdo ngan Ginoo, ngan may kamatuoran, kay amo gud ito ako.
en: “You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.

war: Sanglit kon ako nga iyo Ginoo ngan Magturutdo namusa han iyo mga tiil, angay man liwat kamo maggiparupamusa han iyo mga tiil.
en: Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

war: Gintagan ko kamo hin susbaranan, basi sugaron niyo hin pagbuhat han ginbuhat ko ha iyo.
en: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.

war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron; waray sinugo nga labaw han nagsugo ha iya.
en: Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

war: Yana maaram na kamo hini nga kamatuoran; palaran kamo kon buhaton ini niyo!
en: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

war: Ginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo nga hi ‘Ako Amo Ako.’
en: “I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.

war: Nagsusumat ako ha iyo hin tinuod: an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han akon sinusugo, nakarawat man ha akon; ngan an nakarawat ha akon, nakarawat man han nagsugo ha akon.”
en: Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.”

war: Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, inalpan hiya hin dako nga kabido, ngan nagsiring hin dayag, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: maglilingo ha akon in usa ha iyo.”
en: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, “Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me.”

war: Naggipasirosiplat hira nga nanhiburong kon hin-o gud an iya karuyag sidngon.
en: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.

war: Nalingkod sapit ni Jesus an hinigugma niya nga tinun-an.
en: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.

war: Nagsenyas hi Simon Pedro ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Pakianhi daw hiya kon hin-o an iya hinnanabihan.”
en: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, “Ask him which one he means.”

war: Sanglit sinmiring kan Jesus adto nga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man hiya, Ginoo?”
en: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

war: Han pakakarawat gud la ni Judas han tinapay, sinmulod dayon ha iya hi Satanas. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Dagmit ngan tumana an kinahanglan mo buhaton!”
en: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”

war: Waray nakasabot han mga nakada ha lamesa kay ano nga ginsiring ini ni Jesus ha iya.
en: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.

war: Ginkarawat ni Judas an tinapay ngan ginmawas hiya dayon. Gab-i adto.
en: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.

war: Han paggawas na ni Judas, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Iginpapakita na yana an himaya han Anak han Tawo, ngan pinaagi ha iya, ginpapakita liwat an himaya han Dyos.
en: When he was gone, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.

war: Kon iginpapakita an himaya han Dyos pinaagi ha iya, magpapakita man an Dyos han himaya han Anak han Tawo ha iya ngahaw, ngan bubuhaton ito niya dayon.
en: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.

war: Ihinahatag ko ha iyo in bag-o nga sugo: magsihigugmaay kamo. Kinahanglan magsihigugmaay kamo sugad han akon paghigugma ha iyo.
en: “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.

war: Kon magsihigugmaay kamo, mahibabaro an ngatanan nga akon kamo mga tinun-an.”
en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”

war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain ka man kakadto, Ginoo ?” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri ka pa yana makakasunod ngadto han akon kakadtoan, kundi masunod ka ha akon onina.”
en: Simon Peter asked him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, “Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later.”

war: Nagpakiana hi Pedro, “Ginoo, kay ano hin diri ko pakasunod ha imo yana? Andam man ako pagpakamatay tungod ha imo!”
en: Peter asked, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ungod ba nga andam ka pagpakamatay tungod ha akon? Susumatan ko ikaw hin tinuod: diri pa matugaok an manok, iglilirong mo na akon hin makatulo.”
en: Then Jesus answered, “Will you really lay down your life for me? Very truly I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!

war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kagupong. Too kamo han Dyos ngan too man kamo ha akon.
en: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God ; believe also in me.

war: Damo in mga kwarto didto han balay han akon Amay, ngan makadto ako hin pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo. Diri ako magsusumat hini ha iyo kon diri pa ini tinuod.
en: My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

war: Ngan katapos ko kadto ngan pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo, mabalik ako ngan pauupdon ko kamo ha akon, basi kon hain ako aadto man liwat kamo.
en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.

war: Maaram na kamo kon uunanhon niyo pagsangpot ngadto han akon kakadtoan.”
en: You know the way to the place where I am going.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Tomas, “Ginoo, diri kami maaram kon tikain ka; uunanhon man namon paghibaro han dalan nga tipakadto?”
en: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going, so how can we know the way?”

war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Amo ako an dalan, an kamatuoran, ngan an kinabuhi; waray makakadto han Amay kon diri pinaagi ha akon.”
en: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Yana nga nakakilala na kamo ha akon, makilala man kamo han akon Amay; ngan tikang yana nakilala na kamo ha iya, ngan hinkit-an na hiya niyo.”
en: If you really know me, you will know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Ginoo, ipakita ha amon an Amay ngan igo na ito para ha amon.”
en: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us.”

war: Tuohi niyo nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon; kon diri man, tuohi ako niyo tungod hini nga mga buhat.
en: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works themselves.

war: Ngan bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha akon ngaran, basi pagdayawon an Amay pinaagi han Anak.
en: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

war: Bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo ha akon ngaran.
en: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.

war: “Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, magtutuman kamo han akon mga sugo.
en: “If you love me, keep my commands.

war: Pangangaroon ko han Amay, ngan tatagan kamo niya hin lain nga Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga magpapabilin ha iyo ha kadayonan.
en: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another advocate to help you and be with you forever—

war: “Diri ko kamo babayaan nga mag-uusaan; mabalik ako ngada ha iyo.
en: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

war: Ha diri maiha diri na makita ha akon an kalibutan, kundi makita kamo ha akon; ngan mabubuhi kamo kay buhi man ako.
en: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.

war: Kon umabot na ito nga adlaw, hibabaroan niyo nga aada ako han akon Amay, ngan aadi kamo ha akon, sugad nga aada ako ha iyo.
en: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

war: Nagpakiana hi Judas (diri hi Judas Iscariote), “Ginoo, uunanhon hin pagpakilala mo han imo kalugaringon ha amon, ngan diri ngadto ha kalibutan?”
en: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, “But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?”

war: Diri nagtutuman han akon mga pulong an bisan hin-o nga diri nahigugma ha akon. Diri akon an mensahe nga hinbatian niyo, kundi natikang han Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.
en: Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.

war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo samtang upod pa ako niyo.
en: “All this I have spoken while still with you.

war: Iginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo.
en: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.

war: Diri na ako maghihimangraw ha iyo hin maiha, kay maabot na an punoan hini nga kalibutan. Waray hiya gahom ha akon,
en: I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold over me,

war: kundi kinahanglan mahibaro an kalibutan nga nahigugma ako han Amay; sanglit ginbubuhat ko an ngatanan nga iginsugo niya ha akon. “Tana, kalakat kita.
en: but he comes so that the world may learn that I love the Father and do exactly what my Father has commanded me. “Come now; let us leave.

war: “Amo ako an tinuod nga balagon, ngan an akon Amay an magmarangno.
en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.

war: Binabanggi niya an ngatanan nga sanga nga diri nabunga. Tinatag-an niya hin paghawan an kada sanga nga nabunga, basi mamunga hin darodamo.
en: He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.

war: Nalinisan na kamo pinaagi han mensahe nga akon iginhimangraw ha iyo.
en: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

war: “Ako an balagon ngan kamo an mga sanga. Mabunga hin damo an bisan hin-o nga magpabilin didi ha akon, ngan ako dida ha iya, kay waray niyo mahihimo kon bulag kamo ha akon.
en: “I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

war: Ilinalabog ha gawas an bisan hin-o nga diri nagpapabilin ha akon, ngan nauuga sugad hin sanga; gintitirok in sugad nga mga sanga, ngan ilinalabog ha kalayo, ngan sunogon.
en: If you do not remain in me, you are like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.

war: Kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpabilin an akon mga pulong dida ha iyo, mangangaro kamo hin bisan ano nga inuungara niyo, ngan katutumanan kamo.
en: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

war: Ginhihimaya an akon Amay tungod han iyo pamunga hin damo; ngan pinaagi hini, nagigin mga tinun-an ko kamo.
en: This is to my Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

war: Hinihigugma ko kamo sugad gud han paghigugma ha akon han Amay; pagpabilin kamo didi han akon gugma.
en: “As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.

war: Kon tumanon niyo an akon mga sugo, magpapabilin kamo ha akon gugma, sugad gud han pagtuman ko han mga sugo han akon Amay ngan nagpapabilin ako dida han iya gugma.
en: If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.

war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi mahingada ha iyo an akon kalipay, ngan basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.
en: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

war: Amo ini an akon sugo: pagsihigugmaay kamo, sugad han paghigugma ko ha iyo.
en: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.

war: An gidadakoi nga gugma nga maaangkon hin usa ka tawo tungod han iya kasangkayan, amo an pagtubyan han iya kinabuhi para ha ira.
en: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.

war: Ngan kasangkayan ko kamo, kon buhaton niyo an akon iginsusugo ha iyo.
en: You are my friends if you do what I command.

war: Sanglit amo ini an igsusugo ko ha iyo: paggihigugmaay kamo.”
en: This is my command: Love each other.

war: “Kon magdumot ha iyo an kalibutan, kinahanglan hisabotan niyo nga una ako pagdumtan han kalibutan.
en: “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.

war: Kundi bubuhaton nira ini ngatanan ha iyo, kay akon man kamo sakop; kay diri hira nakilala han nagsugo ha akon.
en: They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the one who sent me.

war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray pa ako kumanhi ngan maghimangraw ha ira; kundi yana, waray na hira baribad han ira sala.
en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

war: An bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot ha akon, nagdudumot man han akon Amay.
en: Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.

war: Kundi kinahanglan mahinabo ini, basi matuman an iginsurat dida han ira Balaod: ‘Gindumtan ako nira hin waray la hinungdan.’
en: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’

war: “Maabot an Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga natikang han Amay. Susugoon ko hiya nganhi ha iyo tikang han Amay, ngan magpapamatuod hiya mahitungod ha akon.
en: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.

war: Ngan magpapamatuod liwat kamo mahitungod ha akon, kay nagin kaupod ko man kamo tikang pa gud ha tinikangan.
en: And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.

war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi diri lumuya an iyo pagtoo ha akon.
en: “All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.

war: Paiiwason kamo nira ha ira mga sinagoga. Maabot an panahon nga an magpapatay ha iyo makakahunahuna nga nag-aalagad hiya han Dyos.
en: They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are offering a service to God.

war: Bubuhaton nira ha iyo ini nga mga butang, kay waray hira makakilala han Amay o ha akon.
en: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.

war: Kundi yana, makadto na ako han nagsugo ha akon; kundi waray ha iyo napakiana ha akon, ‘Tikain ka?’
en: but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

war: Ngan yana nga ginsumatan ko na kamo, nagmamabidoon kamo.
en: Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.

war: Ngan kon umabot na hiya, magpapamatuod hiya ha mga tawo han kalibutan nga mga sayop hira mahitungod han sala, mahitungod han pagkamatadong, ngan mahitungod han paghukom han Dyos.
en: When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin and righteousness and judgment:

war: Sayop hira mahitungod han sala, kay diri hira natoo ha akon;
en: about sin, because people do not believe in me;

war: mahitungod han pagkamatadong, kay makadto ako han Amay ngan diri na kamo makita ha akon;
en: about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;

war: mahitungod han paghukom, kay ginhukman na an punoan hini nga kalibutan.
en: and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.

war: “Damo pa gad an akon igsurumat ha iyo, kundi diri pa ini niyo maaakos yana.
en: “I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.

war: Paghihimayaon ako niya, kay natikang ha akon an igsusumat niya ha iyo.
en: He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.

war: Akon an ngatanan nga kanan Amay; sanglit nagsiring ako nga natikang ha akon an igsusumat ha iyo han Espiritu.
en: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.”

war: “Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon; ngan ha diri liwat maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.”
en: Jesus went on to say, “In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”

war: Nagpakiana pa hira, “Ano an buot niya sidngon han ‘diri maiha’? Diri kita nasabot han iya ginyiyinakan!”
en: They kept asking, “What does he mean by ‘a little while’ ? We don’t understand what he is saying.”

war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: magtatangis ngan magngunguyngoy kamo, kundi maglilipay an kalibutan; magmamabidoon kamo, kundi magigin kalipayan an iyo kabidoan.
en: Very truly I tell you, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

war: Amo man ini dida ha iyo: mabidoon kamo yana, kundi makikigkita liwat ako ha iyo, ngan magmamalipayon gud kamo hin kalipay nga waray makakaagaw ha iyo.
en: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

war: Ngada yana waray pa kamo mangaro hin bisan ano ha akon ngaran; pangaro ngan makarawat kamo, basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.
en: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.

war: Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw mangangaro kamo ha iya ha akon ngaran; ngan diri ako nasiring nga mangangaro ako ha iya para ha iyo,
en: In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

war: kay nahigugma ha iyo an Amay ngahaw. Nahigugma hiya ha iyo kay nahigugma man kamo ha akon ngan tinmoo kamo nga tinmikang ako han Dyos.
en: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

war: Tikang gud ako han Amay ngan kinmanhi ako ha kalibutan; ngan yana mabaya na ako han kalibutan ngan mabalik ako ngadto han Amay.”
en: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”

war: Ngan nagsiring an iya mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, dayag na kaupay an imo pagyakan, ngan diri ka na nagamit hin mga pananglitan.
en: Then Jesus’ disciples said, “Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.

war: Maaram na kami yana nga sayod ka han ngatanan; diri ka nagkikinahanglan nga may magpinakiana pa ha imo. Nakakapatoo ini ha amon nga tikang ka han Dyos.”
en: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God.”

war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Natoo na ba kamo yana?
en: “Do you now believe?” Jesus replied.

war: Katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini, hinmangad hiya ha langit ngan nagsiring, “Amay ko, inmabot na an takna. Paghimayaa an imo Anak, basi paghimayaon ka man han imo Anak.
en: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.

war: Kay gintagan mo man hiya hin gahom hin pagmando han ngatanan nga mga tawo basi humatag hiya han dayon nga kinabuhi ngadto han ngatanan nga igintubyan mo ha iya.
en: For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.

war: Ngan amo ini an dayon nga kinabuhi; nga kumilala ha imo an mga tawo, nga ikaw la an matuod nga Dyos, ngan kumilala kan Jesu-Cristo nga imo ginsugo.
en: Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.

war: Iginpakita ko ha tuna an imo himaya; ginhuman ko na an iginpabuhat mo ha akon.
en: I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.

war: Amay ko, himayaa ako yana ha imo atubangan sugad han himaya nga akon hadto han kaupod pa ako nimo, han waray pa himoa an kalibutan.
en: And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.

war: “Iginpakilala ko ikaw han mga tawo nga imo ginkuha ha kalibutan. Imo hira, ngan gintubyan mo hira ha akon. Gintuman nira an imo pulong,
en: “I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.

war: ngan yana maaram hira nga tikang ha imo an ngatanan nga iginhatag mo ha akon.
en: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.

war: Igintutdo ko ha ira an mensahe nga iginhatag mo ha akon, ngan ginkarawat ini hira. Maaram hira nga tikang ako ha imo, ngan natoo hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.
en: For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.

war: “Nag-aampo ako para ha ira. Diri ako nag-aampo para han kalibutan, kundi para han mga tawo nga igintubyan mo ha akon, kay imo man hira.
en: I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.

war: Imo an ngatanan nga akon, ngan akon man an ngatanan nga imo; ngan napapasidunggan ako tungod ha ira.
en: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.

war: Kundi yana makada na ako ha imo, ngan ginhihimangraw ko ini nga mga butang dinhe ha kalibutan, basi matugob gud hira han akon kalipayan.
en: “I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.

war: Iginhatag ko ha ira an imo mensahe ngan nagdumot ha ira an kalibutan, kay diri man hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.
en: I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.

war: Diri ako nahangyo nga kuhaon mo hira ha kalibutan, kundi nga panalipdan mo hira han Yawa.
en: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.

war: Diri hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.
en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.

war: Ihalad hira ngada ha imo pinaagi han kamatuoran; an imo pulong amo an kamatuoran.
en: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.

war: Ginpadara ko hira nganhi ha kalibutan sugad han pagsugoa mo ha akon nganhi ha kalibutan.
en: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.

war: Ngan tungod ha ira ihinahalad ko ha imo an akon kalugaringon, basi hira liwat magin tinuod man nga iginhalad ha imo.
en: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.

war: “Nag-aampo ako diri para la ha ira, kundi para liwat hadton mga matoo ha akon tungod han ira mensahe.
en: “My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,

war: Nag-aampo ako nga magkaurosa unta hira ngatanan. Amay, mahiusa unta hira ha aton, sugad gud nga aadi ka ha akon ngan aada ako ha imo, basi tumoo an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.
en: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

war: Gintagan ko hira han amo nga himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita;
en: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—

war: Matadong nga Amay, diri nakilala ha imo an kalibutan, kundi nakilala ako ha imo, ngan maaram ini hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.
en: “Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.

war: Iginpakilala ko ikaw ha ira, ngan ipadadayon ko hin pagpakilala ha imo, basi maangkon man nira an gugma mo para ha akon, ngan mag-ukoy man ako dida ha ira.”
en: I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them.”

war: Agsob hi Jesus makig-urosa han iya mga tinun-an didto, sanglit maaram hini nga dapit an malingo nga Judas.
en: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.

war: Maaram hi Jesus han ngatanan nga mahinanabo ha iya, sanglit gintapo niya ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Hin-o an iyo ginbibiling?”
en: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, “Who is it you want?”

war: Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.” “Amo ako,” nagsiring hiya. Natindog didto upod ha ira an malingo nga Judas.
en: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. “I am he,” Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)

war: Han pagsiring la ni Jesus, “Amo ako,” inmisol hira ngan nagkatutumba ha tuna.
en: When Jesus said, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

war: Ginpakianhan na liwat hira ni Jesus, “Hin-o gud an iyo ginbibiling?” Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”
en: Again he asked them, “Who is it you want?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo nga amo ako, sanglit kon ako an iyo tuyo, palakta niyo inin iba.” (
en: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, then let these men go.”

war: Ginsiring niya ini basi matuman an iya iginyakan, “Amay, waray ako kawad-i bisan usa han imo iginhatag ha akon.”)
en: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: “I have not lost one of those you gave me.”

war: May espada hi Simon Pedro; hinulbot ini niya ngan tigbason an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an tuo nga talinga han oripon. Malco an ngaran han oripon.
en: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada! Naghuhunahuna ka ba nga diri ko iimnon an kupa hin pag-antos nga iginhatag ha akon han akon Amay?”
en: Jesus commanded Peter, “Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?”

war: Gindakop ngan gingapos hi Jesus han mga sondalo nga upod han ira kapitan, ngan han mga gwardya nga Judiyo.
en: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him

war: Gindara hiya nira, syahan ngadto kan Anas nga ugangan ni Caifas nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig.
en: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

war: Hi Caifas an nagsagdon han mga Judiyo nga maoruopay pa nga usa la nga tawo an mamatay para han ngatanan nga katawhan.
en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.

war: Nagpakiana kan Pedro ini nga daragita nga bantay han portahan, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?” “Diri,” nagbaton hi Pedro.
en: “You aren’t one of this man’s disciples too, are you?” she asked Peter. He replied, “I am not.”

war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi mahitungod han iya mga tinun-an ngan mahitungod han iya pagturon-an.
en: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.

war: Kay ano nga ako an iyo ginpapakianhan? Asay niyo pakianhi an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha akon. Pakianhi hira kon ano an akon iginsumat ha ira, sayod hira han akon iginyakan.”
en: Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said.”

war: Han pagsiring hini ni Jesus, gintampalo hiya hin usa han mga gwardya nga nakadto ngan sidngon, “Kamailob mo hin pagyakan hin sugad ngadto han Labaw nga Padi!”
en: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby slapped him in the face. “Is this the way you answer the high priest?” he demanded.

war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Kon may iginyakan ko nga sayop, sumati an ngatanan nga hahani kon ano an akon ginyakan. Kundi kon matadong man an akon ginyakan, kay ano nga gintampalo mo ako?”
en: “If I said something wrong,” Jesus replied, “testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?”

war: Ngan iginpadara ni Anas hi Jesus nga ginapos pa, ngadto kan Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.
en: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

war: Han natindog pa hi Pedro nga nagdadangdang harani han tap-ong, nagpakiana ha iya an iba, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?” Naglirong hiya ngan nagsiring, “Diri!”
en: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing there warming himself. So they asked him, “You aren’t one of his disciples too, are you?” He denied it, saying, “I am not.”

war: Sinmagbang hin pagpakiana in usa han mga oripon han Labaw nga Padi, nga urupod han ginpalongan ni Pedro, “Diri ba ikaw an hinkit-an ko nga kaupod niya didto han tanaman?”
en: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, “Didn’t I see you with him in the garden?”

war: Ngan nagsiring na liwat hi Pedro, “Diri,” ngan hito ngahaw nga takna tinmugaok in manok.
en: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.

war: Sanglit ginmawas na la hi Pilato ngadto ha ira ngan nagpakiana, “Ano in iyo sumbong kontra hini nga tawo?”
en: So Pilate came out to them and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”

war: Nagbaton hira, “Diri unta namon hiya gindadara nganhi ha imo kon waray pa hiya makagtalapas.”
en: “If he were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed him over to you.”

war: Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Dad-a hiya ngan usisaha niyo sumala han iyo kalugaringon nga balaod.” Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Diri itinutugot ha amon hin pagpatay bisan kan kanay.” (
en: Pilate said, “Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law.” “But we have no right to execute anyone,” they objected.

war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginyakan ni Jesus han paghimangraw niya kon ano nga paagi mamamatay hiya.)
en: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.

war: Sinmulod liwat ha palasyo hi Pilato ngan gintawag hi Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya kan Jesus, “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”
en: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kalugaringon mo ba ini nga pakiana, o ginsumatan ka ba hin iba mahitungod ha akon?”
en: “Is that your own idea,” Jesus asked, “or did others talk to you about me?”

war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “Kay ano, Judiyo ba ako? An imo kalugaringon nga mga tawo ngan an ira mga puno han kapadian an nagtubyan ha imo nganhi ha akon. Ano ba in nabuhat mo?”
en: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?”

war: Nagpakiana hi Pilato, “Ano ba an kamatuoran?” Binmalik ngadto ha gawas hi Pilato ngan nagsiring ngadto han mga Judiyo, “Waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.
en: “What is truth?” retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

war: Kundi sumala han iyo batasan, nagpapagawas ako hin usa nga priso para ha iyo ha panahon hin Paglabay. Karuyag ba niyo nga buhian ko para ha iyo an hadi han mga Judiyo?”
en: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?”

war: Ginmoliat hira pagbaton ha iya, “Diri, ayaw hiya! Karuyag namon hi Barabas?” (Tikasan ini hi Barabas.)
en: They shouted back, “No, not him! Give us Barabbas!” Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.

war: Ngan ipinakuha ni Pilato hi Jesus ngan iginpalatob hiya ha ira.
en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.

war: Naghimo an mga sondalo hin korona tikang hin tunokon nga mga sanga ngan iginsul-ot ha iya ulo. Ginbadoan hiya nira hin panapton nga pula,
en: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe

war: gindaop hiya, ngan ginsiring, “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!” Ngan gintampalo hiya nira.
en: and went up to him again and again, saying, “Hail, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.

war: Ginmawas na liwat hi Pilato ngan sidngon an mga tawo, “Tan-awa, dadad-on ko hiya nganhi ha iyo basi niyo hibaroan nga waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”
en: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, “Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

war: Ngan ginmawas hi Jesus nga nakakasul-ot han tunokon nga korona ngan han panapton nga pula. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga tawo, “Kitaa, iini an tawo!”
en: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”

war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “May-ada kami balaod nga nagsusumat nga kinahanglan hiya mamatay, kay nagpaka-Anak han Dyos hiya.”
en: The Jewish leaders insisted, “We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God.”

war: Labi na nga nahadlok hi Pilato han pakabati niya hini.
en: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,

war: Binmalik hiya pagsulod ngadto han palasyo ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Tikang ka ba diin?” Kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus.
en: and he went back inside the palace. “Where do you come from?” he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Pilato, “Diri ka ba nabaton ha akon? Tigamni nga may-ada ko gahom hin pagtalwas ha imo ngan hin pagraysang ha imo ha kros.”
en: “Do you refuse to speak to me?” Pilate said. “Don’t you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?”

war: Tikaurudto na adto han bisperas han Paglabay. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga Judiyo, “Iini an iyo hadi!”
en: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. “Here is your king,” Pilate said to the Jews.

war: Sanglit igintubyan ha ira ni Pilato hi Jesus, basi igraysang ha kros. Sanglit gindara nira hi Jesus.
en: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.

war: Ginmuwa hiya nga nagpapas-an han iya kros, ngan inmabot ha dapit nga gintatawag “An Dapit han Klabera.” (“Golgota” an tawag hini ha Hebreo.)
en: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).

war: Didto iginraysang nira ha kros hi Jesus. Iginraysang liwat nira ha mga kros in duha pa ka tawo ha magkasi ligid niya, nga nabubutnga nira hi Jesus.
en: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

war: Iginsurat ni Pilato in usa nga pahibaro ngan iginpataod ini ha kros. Amo ini an ginsurat: “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, an Hadi han mga Judiyo.”
en: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews .

war: Nakabasa hini in damo nga mga Judiyo kay diri man hirayo tikang han syudad an dapit nga ginraysangan kan Jesus. Iginsurat an pahibaro ha pinulongan nga Hebreo, Latin, ngan Griego.
en: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.

war: Nagsiring kan Pilato an mga puno han kapadian han mga Judiyo, “Ayaw isurat ‘An Hadi han mga Judiyo,’ kundi ‘Nagsiring ini nga tawo, Ako an Hadi han mga Judiyo.’”
en: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, “Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews.”

war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “An nahisurat, nahisurat na.”
en: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus hi iya nanay ngan an tinun-an nga iya hinigugma nga natukdaw harani han kros; sanglit nagsiring hiya kan iya nanay, “Babaye, iini an imo anak.”
en: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, “Woman, here is your son,”

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ngadto han tinun-an, “Iini an imo nanay.” Ngan tikang hadto gindara hiya han tinun-an hin pag-ukoy tampo han iya panimalay.
en: and to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.

war: Maaram hi Jesus nga natuman na an ngatanan, ngan basi matuman an kasuratan, nagsiring hiya, “Inuuhaw ako.”
en: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”

war: May surudlan didto nga puno hin maaslom nga bino. Ginhumog nira an espongha hin bino, igintaod ha kataposan hin sanga hin isopo, ngan iginhungit ha iya.
en: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus’ lips.

war: Dinmimdim hi Jesus han bino ngan nagsiring hiya, “Natuman na!” Ngan dinmuko hiya ngan nabunoson hiya han iya kinabuhi.
en: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, “It is finished.” With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

war: Sanglit kinmadto an mga sondalo ngan ginbari an mga bitiis han syahan nga tawo ngan han usa pa nga tawo nga iginraysang upod kan Jesus.
en: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.

war: Kundi han pag-abot na nira kan Jesus, hinkit-an nira nga patay na hiya, sanglit waray na la nira baria an iya mga bitiis.
en: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

war: Kundi ginbangkaw an iya kagiliran hin usa han mga sondalo, ngan inmawas dayon in dugo ug tubig. (
en: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.

war: Nagpamatuod mahitungod hini an nakakita hini nga hinabo, basi tumoo man kamo. Matuod an iya iginsiring, ngan maaram hiya nga naghihimangraw hiya han kamatuoran.)
en: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.

war: Ginbuhat ini basi matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, “Waray usa han iya mga tul-an nga mababari.”
en: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken,”

war: Ngan may-ada lain pa nga bahin han kasuratan nga nasiring, “Makita an mga tawo ngadto hadton ginbangkaw nira.”
en: and, as another scripture says, “They will look on the one they have pierced.”

war: Binmunyog ha iya hi Nicodemo, an tawo nga nakigkita kan Jesus ha usa ka gab-i. May dara hiya nga mga kwarenta ka kilo nga pahamot nga sinakot nga mira ug aloe.
en: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.

war: Ginkuha nira nga duha an lawas ni Jesus ngan ginputos hin lino nga mga dugnit upod han mga pahamot sumala han batasan hin paglubong han mga Judiyo.
en: Taking Jesus’ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.

war: May-ada tanaman didto han dapit nga ginraysangan kan Jesus, ngan nakada in bag-o nga lubnganan nga waray pa paglubngi.
en: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.

war: Tungod kay bisperas na adto han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, ngan hirani manla an lubnganan, didto na la nira iglubong hi Jesus.
en: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

war: Temprano pa han aga han Domingo, samtang masirom pa, kinmadto hi Maria Magdalena ha lubnganan, ngan hinkit-an niya nga kinuha na an bato nga ginsada han lubnganan.
en: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

war: Ngan napakadto dayon ha lubnganan hi Pedro ngan an usa nga tinun-an.
en: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.

war: Nagdalagan hira nga duha, kundi nahiuna pag-abot ha lubnganan an usa nga tinun-an kay malurolaksi hiya dumalagan kan Pedro.
en: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

war: Inmubo hiya hin paghiling ngan hinkit-an niya an lino nga mga dugnit, kundi waray hiya sumulod.
en: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.

war: Inmabot hi Simon Pedro nga sinmunod ha iya, ngan sinmulod dayon han lubnganan. Hinkit-an niya didto an lino nga mga dugnit.
en: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,

war: Diri na tampo han lino nga mga dugnit an panyo nga iginputos han ulo ni Jesus, kundi bulag nga nalulukot ha piliw.
en: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesus’ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.

war: Ngan sinmulod liwat an tinun-an nga una makaabot han lubnganan; nakakita hiya ngan tinmoo. (
en: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.

war: Waray pa gihapon hira makasabot han kasuratan nga nagsiring nga kinahanglan mabanhaw hiya.)
en: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)

war: Ngan nanngoli an mga tinun-an.
en: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.

war: Nagtitinangis hi Maria nga natukdaw ha gawas han lubnganan. Nagtitinangis pa hiya han pag-ubo niya hin paghiling han lubnganan,
en: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb

war: ngan hinkit-an niya didto in duha nga mga anghel nga nakakabado hin busag, ngan nagkakalingkod ha dapit nga ginpahigdaan kan Jesus, usa ha ulohan, ngan an usa ha tiilan.
en: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.

war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Babaye, kay ano nga nagtitinangis ka?” Nagbaton hiya, “Ginkuha nira an akon Ginoo ngan diri ako maaram kon diin nira igbutang hiya.”
en: They asked her, “Woman, why are you crying?” “They have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I don’t know where they have put him.”

war: Han pakayakan niya hini, tinmalikod hiya ngan hinkit-an niya hi Jesus nga natukdaw didto, kundi waray hiya makakilala nga hi Jesus adto.
en: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Maria!” Inmatubang hi Maria ngan nagsiring ha iya ha Hebreo, “Raboni!” (“Magturutdo” an kahulogan hini.)
en: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

war: Sanglit linmakat hi Maria Magdalena ngan ginsumatan niya an mga tinun-an nga hinkit-an niya an Ginoo ngan amo ini an iginsiring han Ginoo ha iya.
en: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them that he had said these things to her.

war: Katapos niya pagsiring hini, iginpakita niya ha ira an iya mga kamot ngan an iya kagiliran. Nalipay an mga tinun-an han pakakita nira han Ginoo.
en: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.

war: Ngan nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ha ira, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo. Sugad nga ginsugo ako han Amay, sinusugo ko man kamo.”
en: Again Jesus said, “Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.”

war: Ginhuypan hira niya nga sidngon, “Karawata niyo an Espiritu Santo.
en: And with that he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.

war: Kon pasayloon niyo an mga sala han mga tawo, pasasayloon hira; ngan kon diri niyo pasayloon hira, diri man hira pasasayloon.”
en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.”

war: Diri kaupod nira hi Tomas, (an gintatawag nga karuha) nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, han pagpakita ni Jesus ha ira.
en: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus ), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

war: Nagbaton hi Tomas ha iya, “Ginoo ko ngan Dyos ko!”
en: Thomas said to him, “My Lord and my God!”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Natoo ka na ba kay nakakita ka ha akon? Palaran adton natoo bisan waray makakita ha akon!”
en: Then Jesus told him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”

war: Ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo pa nga mga milagro ha atubangan han iya mga tinun-an, nga waray mahisurat dida hini nga basahan.
en: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.

war: Kundi iginsurat ini, basi tumoo kamo nga hi Jesus amo an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos, nga pinaagi hini nga pagtoo ha iya, makaangkon unta kamo han kinabuhi.
en: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

war: Katapos hini, nagpakita liwat hi Jesus ngadto han iya mga tinun-an didto ha Lanaw han Tiberias. Sugad hini an iya pagpakita.
en: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:

war: Urosa hira Simon Pedro, hi Tomas (an tinatawag nga Karuha), hi Natanael (an taga-Cana, ha Galilea), an mga anak ni Sebedeo, nga duha pa nga mga tinun-an ni Jesus.
en: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

war: Han tisirang na an adlaw, tinmindog hi Jesus ha baybayon, kundi waray makakilala an mga tinun-an nga hi Jesus ngay-an adto.
en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nakadakop ba kamo?” “Waray!” binmaton hira.
en: He called out to them, “Friends, haven’t you any fish?” “No,” they answered.

war: Dinmuong ha baybayon an iba nga mga tinun-an, nga nagbubutong han pukot nga puno hin isda, kay diri man hira hirayo ha tabi, may mga 60 la ka dupa.
en: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.

war: Paghaw-as na nira, hinkit-an nira in mga baga nga may ginsusugba nga isda ngan mga tinapay.
en: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.

war: Ngan nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Pagdara ngadi hin mga isda nga iyo pa la nadakop.”
en: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”

war: Sanglit sinmakay hi Pedro ngan ginguyod niya ngadto ha baybayon an pukot nga puno hin dagko nga mga isda, 153 ngatanan; waray magisi an pukot, bisan kon damo hin duro an mga isda.
en: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kadi, ngan pamahaw kita.” Waray gud han mga tinun-an nangahas hin pagpakiana ha iya, “Hin-o ka?” kay nasayod man hira nga amo hiya an Ginoo.
en: Jesus said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.

war: Sanglit dinmaop hi Jesus, ginkuha an tinapay, ngan iginhatag ha ira, ngan sugad man an mga isda.
en: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.

war: Amo ini an ikatulo nga pagpakita ni Jesus han iya mga tinun-an katapos niya mabanhaw.
en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.

war: Iginyakan ini ni Jesus ha pagpasabot kon ano nga paagi an pagkamatay ni Pedro ngan an iya paghimaya han Dyos.) Ngan nagsiring ha iya hi Jesus, “Sunod ha akon!”
en: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, “Follow me!”

war: Han pakakita ni Pedro ha iya, nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Ginoo, ano man an mahinanabo hini nga tawo?”
en: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”

war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Kon karuyag ko nga mabuhi hiya tubtob han akon pag-abot, ano man in labot mo? Sunod ha akon!”
en: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me.”

war: Amo hiya an tinun-an nga naghimangraw hini nga mga butang, ngan amo liwat hiya an nagsurat hini nga mga butang; ngan maaram kami nga matuod an iginsiring niya.
en: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.

war: Han kamatay na han surugoon han Ginoo , hi Moises, naghimangraw an Ginoo han kabulig ni Moises, hi Josue nga anak ni Nun.
en: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ aide:

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Patay na hi Moises, an akon surugoon. Pag-andam kamo, ikaw ug an ngatanan nga mga tawo han Israel, ngan tabok kamo han Salog Jordan ngadto han tuna nga ighahatag ko ha ira.
en: “Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them—to the Israelites.

war: Sugad han akon siring kan Moises, iginhatag ko ha imo ug han ngatanan nga akon mga tawo an bug-os nga tuna nga iyo pag-aagian.
en: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

war: Josue, samtang nga buhi ka pa, waray gud makakadaog ha imo. Maupod ako ha imo sugad han akon pag-upod kan Moises. Dayuday maupod ako ha imo; diri gud ako mabaya ha imo.
en: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

war: Dig-ona an imo kalugaringon ngan ipakita an imo pagtapod kay magigin pangulo ka hini nga mga tawo ha ira pagtag-iya hini nga tuna nga iginsaad ko han ira mga ginikanan.
en: Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.

war: Panumdom han akon sugo, “Dig-ona an imo kalugaringon ngan ipakita an imo pagtapod. Ayaw kahadlok ngan ayaw pagturaw, kay ako, an Ginoo nga iyo Dyos, dayuday kaupod nimo bisan kon pumakain ka.”
en: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.”

war: Ug ginsugo ni Josue an mga pangulo
en: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:

war: Ginsiring ni Josue an mga banay nira Ruben ug Gad ngan an katunga han banay ni Manases,
en: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,

war: Nagbaton hira kan Josue, “Tutumanon namon an ngatanan nga imo ginhimangraw ha amon ngan mapakadto kami ha bisan diin nga dapit kami pakadtoa.
en: Then they answered Joshua, “Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

war: Masugot kami ha imo sugad nga dayuday sinmugot kami kan Moises. Updan ka unta han Ginoo nga imo Dyos sugad nga kaupod hiya ni Moises!
en: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.

war: Adton mariwa han imo gahom ug masupak han imo sugo, kinahanglan nga patayon. Rig-ona an imo kasingkasing ug ipakita an imo pagtapod.”
en: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey it, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!”

war: Nakabati an hadi han Jerico nga may-ada mga Israelita nga sinmulod han syudad hadto nga gab-i hin pag-inaw han nasod,
en: The king of Jericho was told, “Look, some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land.”

war: sanglit nagpatugon hiya kan Rahab: “An mga tawo nga sinmaka ha imo balay nakanhi hin pagtiktik han bug-os nga nasod! Pagawsa hira!”
en: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land.”

war: Binmaya han syudad an mga ginsugo han hadi ngan ginsadhan an ganghaan. Nagpinamiling hira han mga mag-irinaw nga Israelita tubtob han dapit diin an dalan natabok han Jordan.
en: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.

war: Han waray pa magkakahigda an mga mag-irinaw, sinmaka hi Rahab ngadto ha atop
en: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof

war: Pagsaad kamo ha akon nga tatalwason niyo an akon amay ug iroy, an akon mga kabugtoan ug an ira mga panimalay! Ayaw itugot nga pamatayon kami!”
en: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them—and that you will save us from death.”

war: Nag-ukoy hi Rahab dida hin balay nga dukot han pader han syudad, sanglit ginpalusad niya an mga tawo ha bintana pinaagi hin pisi.
en: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga tawo, “Tutumanon namon ini nga imo ginpasaad ha amon.
en: Now the men had said to her, “This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us

war: Kundi kon igsumat niyo an amon ginbuhat dinhe, diri kami kinahanglan magtuman han amon saad nga imo ginpasaad ha amon.”
en: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”

war: Tinmangdo hiya ngan ginpalakat hira. Han paghilakat na nira, ginhigot niya an pula nga lubid ngadto han bintana.
en: “Agreed,” she replied. “Let it be as you say.” So she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

war: Ug an duha nga mag-irinaw linmusad tikang han sagkahon nga tuna, tinmalabok hira han salog, ngan inmoli hira ngadto kan Josue. Ginsumatan nira hi Josue han ngatanan nga nahitabo, ngan
en: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.

war: sinmiring hira, “Waray ruhaduha nga iginhatag ha aton han Ginoo an bug-os nga katunaan. Nagkakahadlok ha aton an ngatanan nga mga tawo didto.”
en: They said to Joshua, “The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us.”

war: Kahuman han ikatolo ka adlaw, an mga pangulo nagsudoy han kampo
en: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,

war: Ginsiring ni Josue an mga tawo, “Paglinis kamo ha iyo kalugaringon kay buwas an Ginoo magbubuhat hin mga milagro dida ha iyo.”
en: Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.”

war: Ngan ginsiring niya an mga kapadian nga dad-on nira an Kahon han Ginsaaran ug mag-una hira han mga tawo. Gintuman ini nira sugad han siring niya ha ira.
en: Joshua said to the priests, “Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people.” So they took it up and went ahead of them.

war: Sumati an mga kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran nga ha pag-abot nira ha salog, kinahanglan lumugsong hira ha tubig ngan umukoy hira nga natukdaw hirani han pangpang.”
en: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan’s waters, go and stand in the river.’ ”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Josue han mga tawo, “Pakadi kamo ngan pamati kamo kon ano an ighihimangraw ha iyo han Ginoo nga iyo Dyos.
en: Joshua said to the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the Lord your God.

war: kon an Kahon han Ginsaaran han Ginoo han ngatanan nga tuna tumalabok han Jordan una ha iyo.
en: See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go into the Jordan ahead of you.

war: Yana pagpili kamo hin dose nga mga kalalaken-an, usa ha kada tribo han Israel.
en: Now then, choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.

war: Kaubos hin pakatabok na han Jordan han bug-os nga nasod, sinmiring an Ginoo kan Josue,
en: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua,

war: “Pagpili hin dose nga mga kalalaken-an, tag-usa ha kada tribo,
en: “Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,

war: Ug gintawag ni Josue an dose nga kalalaken-an nga iya ginpili,
en: So Joshua called together the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,

war: Han didto na hira ha tabok, nag-una han mga tawo an kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran.
en: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.

war: An mga tawo han mga tribo nira Ruben, Gad, ngan han katunga han banay ni Manases nga andam hin pakig-away, nag-una pagtabok han kadam-an han mga tawo sugad han tugon ni Moises ha ira.
en: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, ready for battle, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.

war: Samtang nga nagkikita an Ginoo , kapin hin 40,000 nga mga tawo nga andam hin pakig-away in tinmabok ngadto han kapatagan harani han Jerico.
en: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the Lord to the plains of Jericho for war.

war: Ug ginsiring han Ginoo hi Josue
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua,

war: nga sidngon na niya an kapadian nga nagpapas-an han Kahon han Ginsaaran nga humaw-as na ha Jordan.
en: “Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan.”

war: Nagtuman hini hi Josue
en: So Joshua commanded the priests, “Come up out of the Jordan.”

war: Tinmalabok han Jordan an mga tawo dida han ikanapulo ka adlaw han syahan nga bulan, ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Gilgal, ha may sinirangan han Jerico.
en: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

war: Didto ni Josue tindoga an dose nga mga bato nga kinuha didto ha Jordan.
en: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.

war: Ngan ginsiring niya an mga tawo han Israel, “Ha panahon nga tiarabot, kon an iyo mga anak magpakiana kon ano an kahulogan hini nga mga bato,
en: He said to the Israelites, “In the future when your descendants ask their parents, ‘What do these stones mean?’

war: sumati niyo hira nga tinmabok han Jordan an Israel dida hin mamara nga tuna.
en: tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’

war: Tungod hini makakasabot an ngatanan dinhe ha tuna nga makagarahum an Ginoo , ngan pagdadayawon niyo ha kadayunan an Ginoo nga iyo Dyos.”
en: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God.”

war: Ginsiring han Ginoo hi Josue, “Paghimo hin mga kutsilyo tikang hin bato bantilis ngan toria an mga Israelita.”
en: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again.”

war: Gintuman ini ni Josue sugad han sugo ha iya han Ginoo , ngan iya gintori an mga Israelita didto hin dapit nga ginngaranan Torian nga Pungtod.
en: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.

war: An mga anak nga kalalaken-an hini nga mga tawo waray gud may natori ug amo ini nga bag-o nga tulin an ginpanori ni Josue.
en: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.

war: Kahuman han pagtoria han kalalaken-an, pinmabilin ini hira ha kampo tubtob han kaupay han katorian.
en: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.

war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Josue, “Yana ginkuha ko ha iyo an makaarawod nga kahimtang hin pagkaoripon didto ha Ehipto.” Sanglit ginngaranan hin Gilgal an dapit ngada yana.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.

war: Samtang an mga Israelita nagkampo didto ha Gilgal dida han kapatagan harani han Jerico, nagsaurog hira han Paglabay dida han gab-i han ika-14 nga adlaw han bulan.
en: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.

war: An pagkabuwas nga adlaw amo an ira syahan nga pagkaon hin mga abot ha Canaan: sinanlag nga trigo ug tinapay nga waray patubo.
en: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

war: Ug an kapitan han kasondalohan han Ginoo nagsiring ha iya, “Hukasa an imo mga sandalyas, kay natukdaw ka dida hin baraan nga tuna.” Ngan gintuman ini ni Josue sugad han siring ha iya.
en: The commander of the Lord ’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.

war: An mga aragian han Jerico ginsadhan ug ginbantayan hin maupay basi diri makasulod an mga Israelita. Waray nakakasulod kon nakakagawas han syudad.
en: Now the gates of Jericho were securely barred because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

war: Nagsiring kan Josue an Ginoo , “Itinutubyan ko ha imo an Jerico upod an iya mga kahadian ngan an ngatanan nga mga mag-isog nga sondalo.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.

war: Ikaw ug an imo mga sondalo magmamartsa palibot han syudad makausa kada adlaw sulod hin unom ka adlaw.
en: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.

war: Niyan ginsugo niya an iya mga tawo hin pagtikang hin pagmartsa palibot han syudad upod in mga armado nga gwardya nga nag-uuna han Kahon han Ginsaaran.
en: And he ordered the army, “Advance! March around the city, with an armed guard going ahead of the ark of the Lord .”

war: Ginsugo niya an iya mga tawo nga ilibot nira han syudad an Kahon han Ginsaaran makausa. Kahuman binmalik hira ngadto ha kampo ngan didto hira pahuway.
en: So he had the ark of the Lord carried around the city, circling it once. Then the army returned to camp and spent the night there.

war: Dida hini nga ikaduha ka adlaw, nakausa hira paglibot han syudad ngan kahuman, inmoli hira ngadto ha kampo. Ginbuhat nira ini sakob hin unom ka adlaw.
en: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
