en: If they dedicate a field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.

war: Kon karuyag han tawo nga naghalad han uma hin paglukat hini, kinahanglan baydan niya an kabaraydan upod in dugang nga 20 por syento.
en: If the one who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the field will again become theirs.

war: Kon igbaligya niya an tuna ngadto hin lain nga tawo, nga diri anay niya paglukaton ini tikang han Ginoo , mawawad-an hiya han iya katungod hin paglukat hini.
en: If, however, they do not redeem the field, or if they have sold it to someone else, it can never be redeemed.

war: Ha pag-abot han Tuig han Pagpahioli magigin kadayonan na ini nga hiagi han Ginoo ; ighahatag ini ha kapadian.
en: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the Lord ; it will become priestly property.

war: Kon ighalad hin usa ka tawo ngadto han Ginoo in usa nga uma nga iya napalit, ngan diri bahin han tuna nga iya nasunod,
en: “ ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord a field they have bought, which is not part of their family land,

war: Pag-abot han Tuig han Pagpahioli, ig-ooli an tuna ngadto han tunay nga tag-iya o ngadto han iya mga tulin.
en: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom it was bought, the one whose land it was.

war: Ipapasikad an ngatanan nga kabaraydan han timbangan nga ginagamit ha sanktuaryo.
en: Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

war: Diri na ini malulukat, bisan pa ngani usa ka tawo nga iginhalad na; kinahanglan pagpatayon hiya.
en: “ ‘No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; they are to be put to death.

war: An Ginoo an tag-iya han ikanapulo nga bahin han ngatanan nga abot han tuna, bisan inani o bunga hin kahoy; sagrado ini para han Ginoo .
en: “ ‘A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord ; it is holy to the Lord .

war: Kon karuyag hin usa ka tawo hin paglukat hini, kinahanglan pagbaydan niya an angay nga kabaraydan upod in dugang nga 20 por syento.
en: Whoever would redeem any of their tithe must add a fifth of the value to it.

war: Kanan Ginoo an usa han kada napulo nga mga hayop. Dida han pag-ihap han mga hayop, kanan Ginoo an kada ikanapulo.
en: Every tithe of the herd and flock—every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd’s rod—will be holy to the Lord .

war: Amo ini an mga sugo nga iginhatag han Ginoo kan Moises didto ha Bukid Sinai para han mga tawo han Israel.
en: These are the commands the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

war: Hinigugma ko nga Teofilo: Damo na in nagtalingoha hin pagsurat han mga butang nga nahinabo dinhe ha aton.
en: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,

war: Iginsurat nira an ngatanan nga iginsumat ha aton hadton mga nagpakakita hini nga mga butang tikang pa ha tinikangan, ngan hadton nagpasangyaw han mensahe.
en: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.

war: Binubuhat ko ini basi hibaroan mo an bug-os nga kamatuoran mahitungod hadton mga butang nga igintutdo ha imo.
en: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

war: Matadong hira nga duha ha atubangan han Dyos, ngan matinumanon han ngatanan nga mga sugo ngan mga turumanon han Ginoo.
en: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, observing all the Lord’s commands and decrees blamelessly.

war: Waray nira anak kay baw-as hi Elisabet, ngan mga lagas na kaupay hira nga duha.
en: But they were childless because Elizabeth was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.

war: Usa ka adlaw nagtuman hi Zacarias han iya katungdanan hin pagkapadi ha atubangan han Dyos, dida ha pagtuman han iya turno han kada adlaw nga iya buruhaton.
en: Once when Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,

war: Sumala han batasan nga ginsusunod han kapadian, napili hiya, pinaagi hin ripa, hin pagtubod han insyenso didto ha altar. Sanglit sinmulod hiya ngadto han Templo han Ginoo,
en: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

war: samtang nag-aampo ha gawas in damo nga mga tawo ha takna han pagtubod han insyenso.
en: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.

war: Pinmakita ha iya in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, nga natindog didto ha tuo nga dapit han altar diin gintutubod an insyenso.
en: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

war: Nalisang ngan nahadlok hi Zacarias han pakakita niya han anghel.
en: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear.

war: Mapupuno ka hin kalipay sugad man in damo nga mga tawo kon matawo na hiya!
en: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,

war: Mahihimo hiya nga dako nga pagkatawo ha atubangan han Ginoo. Kinahanglan diri hiya uminom hin bino o mapintas nga irimnon. Mapupuno hiya han Espiritu Santo tikang pa han iya katawo.
en: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born.

war: Damo in mga tawo han Israel nga bubuligan niya hin pagbalik ngadto han Ginoo nga ira Dyos.
en: He will bring back many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.

war: Nagsiring hi Zacarias ha anghel, “Uunanhon ko hin pakasabot nga matuod ini? Lagas na ako ngan lagas na liwat an akon asawa.”
en: Zechariah asked the angel, “How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years.”

war: Binmaton an anghel, “Ako amo hi Gabriel nga natindog ha atubangan han Dyos nga nagsugo ha akon hin pagyakan ngan pagsumat ha imo hini nga maupay nga sumat.
en: The angel said to him, “I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news.

war: Hito nga takna, nagpipinamulat kan Zacarias an mga tawo ngan nahipausa hira kay ano nga maiha naman hiya didto ha sulod han Templo.
en: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the temple.

war: Katapos na han iya buruhaton ha Templo, inmoli hi Zacarias.
en: When his time of service was completed, he returned home.

war: Waray pag-iha, nagburod hi Elisabet nga iya asawa, ngan nakadto la hiya ha sakob han ira balay sulod hin lima ka bulan.
en: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion.

war: Nagsiring hi Elisabet, “Yana ginbuligan gihapon ako han Ginoo dida hini nga paagi. Ginkuha na niya an akon kaarawdan ha atubangan han mga tawo!”
en: “The Lord has done this for me,” she said. “In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”

war: Han burod ni Elizabet hin unom ka bulan, ginsugo han Dyos hi Gabriel nga anghel ngadto ha Galilea, ha usa nga bungto nga Nazaret an ngaran.
en: In the sixth month of Elizabeth’s pregnancy, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a town in Galilee,

war: May dara hiya nga sumat para hin usa nga daraga nga sinayoran na hin lalake nga ginngaranan kan Jose, nga tulin ni Hadi David. Maria an ngaran hini nga daraga.
en: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.

war: Kinmadto an anghel ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Maghimaya ka! Puno ka hin grasya! An Ginoo aada ha imo!”
en: The angel went to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.”

war: Dako an kagupong ni Maria han iginpasabot han anghel, ngan ginpainoino niya kon ano an kahulogan han iya mga pulong.
en: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an anghel, “Ayaw kahadlok, Maria, kay ginpalabi ka han Dyos.
en: But the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God.

war: Magbuburod ngan mag-aanak ka hin lalake, ngan pagngangaranan mo hiya nga Jesus.
en: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.

war: Mahihimo hiya nga dako nga pagkatawo ngan tatawgon nga Anak han Gihahataasi nga Dyos. Hihimoon han Ginoo nga Dyos nga hadi hiya, sugad kan David nga iya ginikanan,
en: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

war: ngan mahihimo hiya nga hadi ha kadayonan han mga tulin ni Jacob; an iya ginhadian waray kataposan!”
en: and he will reign over Jacob’s descendants forever; his kingdom will never end.”

war: Hi Maria nagsiring han anghel, “Uray ngan putli ako. Uunanhon man hin kahimo hini?”
en: “How will this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”

war: Nagbaton an anghel, “Makunsad ha imo an Espiritu Santo, ngan magpapabilin ha imo an gahom han Dyos. Tungod hini, tatawgon nga Anak han Dyos ini nga santos nga bata.
en: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called the Son of God.

war: Kay waray butang nga diri mahihimo han Dyos.”
en: For no word from God will ever fail.”

war: Nagsiring hi Maria, “Iini ako nga surugoon han Ginoo. Matuman unta dinhe ha akon sumala han imo pulong.” Ngan binayaan hiya han anghel.
en: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May your word to me be fulfilled.” Then the angel left her.

war: Waray pag-iha, nag-andam hi Maria ngan nagdagmit hin pagkadto ha usa nga bungto ha sagkahon nga tuna han Judea.
en: At that time Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea,

war: Kinmadto hiya ha balay ni Zacarias ngan naghatag hin katalahoran kan Elisabet.
en: where she entered Zechariah’s home and greeted Elizabeth.

war: Han pakabati la ni Elisabet han mga pulong ni Maria, nagkiwa an bata ha sulod han iya tiyan. Napuno hi Elisabet han Espiritu Santo,
en: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

war: ngan nagyakan hin dako nga tingog, “Ikaw an labi kabaraan han ngatanan nga kababayen-an, ngan baraan an bata nga gindadara nimo ha imo tiyan!
en: In a loud voice she exclaimed: “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!

war: Kay ano nga itinugot man ini nga makanhi hin pagduaw ha akon an iroy han akon Ginoo?
en: But why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

war: Kay han pakabati ko han imo nga pulong, linmukso hin kalipay an bata ha akon tiyan.
en: As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

war: Hin kabaraan niya nga natoo nga matutuman an ginpamulong ha iya han Ginoo!”
en: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!”

war: Nagsiring hi Maria, “Nagdadayaw an akon kalag han Ginoo;
en: And Mary said: “My soul glorifies the Lord

war: naglilipay an akon kasingkasing dida han Dyos nga akon Manunubos,
en: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,

war: kay nahinumdoman ako niya, an iya ubos nga surugoon! Tikang yana tatawgon ako nga baraan han ngatanan nga katulinan,
en: for he has been mindful of the humble state of his servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed,

war: tungod han dagko nga mga butang nga ginbuhat para ha akon han Makagarahum nga Dyos. Baraan an iya ngaran;
en: for the Mighty One has done great things for me— holy is his name.

war: nagpapakita hiya hin kalooy hadton mga nahadlok ha iya, tikang ha usa ngadto han sunod nga katulinan.
en: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.

war: Ginpakita niya an kusog han iya butkon, ngan ginpasarang niya an mga mapahitas-on ha kasingkasing.
en: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.

war: Ginpukan niya in gamhanan nga mga hadi tikang han ira mga trono, ngan ginpahitaas niya an mga mapainubsanon.
en: He has brought down rulers from their thrones but has lifted up the humble.

war: Ginbusog niya hin mag-upay nga mga butang an mga gutom, ngan ginpalakat niya an mga riko nga waray dara.
en: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

war: Gintuman niya an iya iginsaad ha aton mga kaapoy-apoyan, ngan binuligan niya an Israel nga iya surugoon;
en: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering to be merciful

war: nahinumdom hiya hin pagkalooy kan Abraham ngan ha ngatanan nga iya katulinan ha kadayonan!”
en: to Abraham and his descendants forever, just as he promised our ancestors.”

war: Linmungon hi Maria kan Elisabet sulod hin mga tulo ka bulan, ngan katapos, inmoli hiya.
en: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.

war: Inmabot an panahon han pag-anak ni Elisabet, ngan nag-anak hiya hin lalake.
en: When it was time for Elizabeth to have her baby, she gave birth to a son.

war: Nakabati an iya mga amyaw ngan kauropdan han dako nga kalooy han Ginoo ha iya, ngan dinmuyog hira ngatanan ha iya hin pagkalipay.
en: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.

war: Han walo na ka adlaw an bata, kinmadto hira basi buhaton nira an seremonyas hin pagtori ha iya. Ginngangaranan na unta nira nga Zacarias, an ngaran han amay han bata.
en: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father Zechariah,

war: Kundi nagsiring an iroy niya, “Diri! Juan an igngangaran ha iya.”
en: but his mother spoke up and said, “No! He is to be called John.”

war: Nagsiring hira ha iya, “Kundi waray man niyo uropod nga may sugad hini nga ngaran!”
en: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who has that name.”

war: Niyan ginsenyasan nira hi Zacarias kon ano an iya karuyag igngaran han bata.
en: Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child.

war: Nag-aro hi Zacarias hin susuratan, ngan nagsurat, “Juan an iya ngaran.” Duro gud an paghipausa nira ngatanan!
en: He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone’s astonishment he wrote, “His name is John.”

war: Hito manta nga takna nakayakan na liwat hi Zacarias ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagdayaw han Dyos.
en: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue set free, and he began to speak, praising God.

war: Kinulba gud an ngatanan nga mga amyaw, ngan nabantog ha bug-os nga katunaan han Judea an sumat mahitungod hini nga hinabo.
en: All the neighbors were filled with awe, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things.

war: An ngatanan nga nagpakabati namalandong mahitungod hini ngan nagpakiana hira, “Ano daw la an aabutan hini nga bata?” Dayag gud nga nakada ha iya an gahom han Ginoo.
en: Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, “What then is this child going to be?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.

war: Napuno han Espiritu Santo hi Zacarias nga amay ni Juan, ngan namulong hiya han mensahe han Dyos:
en: His father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:

war: “Dayawa ta an Ginoo, an Dyos han Israel! Kinmanhi hiya hin pagbulig ngan pagtalwas han iya katawhan.
en: “Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has come to his people and redeemed them.

war: Naghatag hiya hin gamhanan nga Magtaralwas para ha aton, nga tulin ni David nga iya surugoon.
en: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

war: Nagsaad hiya ha maiha na nga panahon pinaagi han iya baraan nga mga manaragna:
en: (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),

war: nga tatalwason kita tikang han aton mga kaaway, ngan tikang han gahom hadton ngatanan nga nagdudumot ha aton.
en: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us—

war: Nagsiring hiya nga malolooy hiya han aton mga ginikanan, ngan manunumdom hiya han iya baraan nga ginsaaran.
en: to show mercy to our ancestors and to remember his holy covenant,

war: 73-74 Nagsumpa hiya kan Abraham nga aton ginikanan, ngan nagsaad nga babawion kita niya tikang han aton mga kaaway, ngan tutugotan kita hin pag-alagad ha iya hin waray kahadlok;
en: to rescue us from the hand of our enemies, and to enable us to serve him without fear

war: basi mabaraan ngan magmatadong kita ha iya atubangan, ha ngatanan nga mga adlaw han aton kinabuhi.
en: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

war: “Tatawgon ka, anak ko, nga manaragna han Gihahataasi nga Dyos. Mag-uuna ka han Ginoo hin pag-andam han dalan nga iya aagian;
en: And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him,

war: hin pagsumat han iya katawhan nga matatalwas hira, pinaagi hin pagpasaylo han ira mga sala.
en: to give his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

war: Maloloy-on ngan mapuanguron an aton Dyos. Ipapasirang niya ha aton an adlaw han katalwasan,
en: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven

war: ngan masanag tikang ha langit ngada hadton ngatanan nga nag-uukoy dida han masirom nga lambong han kamatayon, ha pagtugway ha aton ngadto ha dalan han kamurayaw.”
en: to shine on those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.”

war: Tinmubo an bata ngan dinmako ha lawas nga nagmakusog. Nag-ukoy hiya didto ha kamingawan tubtob han adlaw nga mapakita hiya hin dayag ha katawhan han Israel.
en: And the child grew and became strong in spirit ; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to Israel.

war: Hadto nga panahon nagsugo hi Emperador Augusto nga magpalista para han sensos an ngatanan nga mga sakop han Imperyo.
en: In those days Caesar Augustus issued a decree that a census should be taken of the entire Roman world.

war: Hi Cirenio amo an gobernador han Siria han paghimoa hini nga syahan nga sensos.
en: (This was the first census that took place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.)

war: Sanglit kinmadto hin pagpalista an ngatanan, an kada usa ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto.
en: And everyone went to their own town to register.

war: Tikang ha bungto han Nazaret ha Galilea, kinmadto hi Jose ha Judea, ngadto han bungto han Betlehem nga natawhan ni Hadi David, kay tulin man hiya ni David.
en: So Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of David, because he belonged to the house and line of David.

war: Kinmadto hiya hin pagpalista upod hi Maria nga sinayoran na ha iya, ngan hingarak-an na.
en: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child.

war: Samtang nakadto hira ha Betlehem, inmabot an panahon nga mag-aanak na hi Maria.
en: While they were there, the time came for the baby to be born,

war: Nag-anak hiya han iya suhag nga lalake, ginputos niya hin mga lampin, ngan iginhulid ha pasungan, kay waray na man lugar para ha ira didto han balay nga pahuwayan.
en: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. She wrapped him in cloths and placed him in a manger, because there was no guest room available for them.

war: May mga magmarangno hin karnero didto hadto nga dapit nga nag-aagma ha bug-os nga gab-i didto han kaumhan hin pagmangno han ira mga panon.
en: And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night.

war: Pinmakita ha ira in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, ngan nalamragan hira han himaya han Ginoo, ngan nagkahadlok hira.
en: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

war: Kundi nagsiring ha ira an anghel, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Hahani ako ngan may-ada ako dara nga maupay nga sumat para ha iyo, nga maghahatag hin dako nga kalipayan han ngatanan nga katawhan.
en: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people.

war: Natawo yana nga adlaw didto han bungto ni David an iyo Magtaralwas nga amo an Cristo nga Ginoo.
en: Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.

war: Amo ini an tigaman para ha iyo: hiaagian niyo in bata nga pinutos hin mga lampin ngan hinulid ha pasungan.”
en: This will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.”

war: Ha gilayon pinmakita upod han anghel in dako nga hugpo hin mga anghel ha langit, nga nagkakanta hin mga pagdayaw ha Dyos:
en: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising God and saying,

war: “Himaya sa Dyos ha kahitas-an, ngan kalinaw dinhe ha tuna hadton mga tawo nga maupay an kaburot-on!”
en: “Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests.”

war: Sanglit nagdagmit hira hin pagkalakat, ngan hin-agian nira hira Maria ug Jose, ngan hinkit-an nira an bata nga hinulid ha pasungan.
en: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.

war: Han pakakita nira han bata, iginsumat han mga magmarangno an iginsiring han anghel mahitungod ha iya.
en: When they had seen him, they spread the word concerning what had been told them about this child,

war: Nanhipausa an ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini nga iginsumat ha ira han mga magmarangno.
en: and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.

war: Gintipigan ni Maria ini ngatanan nga mga butang, ngan ginpamalandong niya ha iya kasingkasing.
en: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

war: Namalik an mga magmarangno nga nagkakanta hin mga pagdayaw sa Dyos, tungod han ngatanan nga ira hinbatian ngan hinkit-an; nahinabo an ngatanan sumala gud han iginsumat ha ira han anghel.
en: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.

war: Pag-agi han ikawalo ka adlaw, nga amo na an pagtuman han seremonyas hin pagtori han bata, ginngaranan hiya nga Jesus, an ngaran nga iginhatag han anghel han waray pa hiya igpapanamkon.
en: On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise the child, he was named Jesus, the name the angel had given him before he was conceived.

war: sumala han iginsurat dida han balaod han Ginoo: “Kinahanglan ighalad ngadto han Ginoo an tagsa nga suhag nga lalake.”
en: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord, “Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord” ),

war: Naghalad liwat hira, sumala han kinahanglan han balaod han Ginoo, “Usa ka padis nga sarapati o duha nga piso nga tukmo.”
en: and to offer a sacrifice in keeping with what is said in the Law of the Lord: “a pair of doves or two young pigeons.”

war: Niyan, may-ada tawo nga nag-uokoy ha Jerusalem, nga Simeon an ngaran. Maupay ngan mainampoon hiya nga tawo, ngan naghihinulat hiya han katalwasan han Israel. Nakada ha iya an Espiritu Santo,
en: Now there was a man in Jerusalem called Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

war: ngan ginpatapod hiya han Espiritu Santo nga diri gud hiya mapatay, kon diri anay kumita hiya han Mesiyas nga iginsaad han Ginoo.
en: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not die before he had seen the Lord’s Messiah.

war: Ginkugos ni Simeon an bata ngan nagpasalamat han Dyos:
en: Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying:

war: “Yana, Ginoo, gintuman mo na an imo saad, ngan tugoti na pagbaya ha kamurayaw an imo surugoon.
en: “Sovereign Lord, as you have promised, you may now dismiss your servant in peace.

war: Ha akon kalugaringon nga mga mata, hinkit-an ko na an imo katalwasan,
en: For my eyes have seen your salvation,

war: nga imo gin-andam ha atubangan han ngatanan nga mga katawhan:
en: which you have prepared in the sight of all nations:

war: Kapawa nga magpapadayag ha mga Hentil han imo paagi ngan magdadara hin kadungganan han imo katawhan nga Israel.”
en: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.”

war: Nanhipausa an amay ug iroy han bata han mga butang nga iginsiring ni Simeon mahitungod ha iya.
en: The child’s father and mother marveled at what was said about him.

war: ngan tungod hini, ipadadayag niya an ira tinago nga mga panhunahuna. Ngan sasamaron sugad hin matarom nga espada an imo kasingkasing tungod hin kabido.”
en: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your own soul too.”

war: ngan nabalo hiya ug 84 ka tuig na an iya panuigon. Waray gud hiya bumaya han Templo; adlaw gab-i nagsingba hiya han Dyos, nga nagpuasa ngan nag-ampo hiya.
en: and then was a widow until she was eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

war: Inmabot hiya hito manta nga takna ngan nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan namulong hiya mahitungod han bata ha ngatanan mga naghihinulat han kanan Dyos pagtubos han Jerusalem.
en: Coming up to them at that very moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the child to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

war: Katapos nira pagbuhat han ngatanan nga ginkikinahanglan han balaod han Ginoo, binmalik hira ngadto ha Galilea, ha ira kalugaringon nga bungto ha Nazaret.
en: When Joseph and Mary had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth.

war: Tinmubo ngan nagmakusog an bata; puno hiya hin kinaadman, ngan nakada ha iya an mga bendisyon han Dyos.
en: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.

war: Kada tuig, napakadto ha Jerusalem an mga kag-anak ni Jesus para han Pyesta han Paglabay.
en: Every year Jesus’ parents went to Jerusalem for the Festival of the Passover.

war: Han dose na an edad ni Jesus, kinmadto hira han pyesta sumala han ira nababatasan.
en: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the festival, according to the custom.

war: Katapos han pyesta, nagtipaoli hira, kundi nagpabilin an bata nga Jesus didto ha Jerusalem. Waray mahibaro hini an iya mga kag-anak;
en: After the festival was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.

war: naghunahuna hira nga upod hiya han kadam-an, sanglit naglinakat hira anay hin bug-os nga adlaw; ngan amo na an pamiling nira ha iya didto han ira kauropdan ngan kasangkayan.
en: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.

war: Waray hira makaagi ha iya, sanglit binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem hin pagbiling ha iya.
en: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.

war: Han pag-ikatulo ka adlaw, hin-agian nira hiya didto ha Templo, nga nalingkod upod han mga magturutdo nga Judiyo, namamati ngan nagpapakiana ha ira.
en: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

war: Nahipausa gud an ngatanan nga nagpakabati han iya mag-upay nga mga baton.
en: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.

war: Ginbaton niya hira, “Kay ano hin pagbiniling niyo ha akon? Diri ba kamo maaram nga kinahanglan hahani ako ha balay han akon Amay?”
en: “Why were you searching for me?” he asked. “Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?”

war: Kundi waray hira makasabot han iginsiring niya ha ira.
en: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

war: Sanglit inmupod hi Jesus ha ira pagbalik ha Nazaret, diin nagmasinugtanon hiya ha ira. Gintipigan ha kasingkasing han iroy niya ini nga mga butang.
en: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.

war: Ngan nagtubo hi Jesus ha lawas ngan ha kinaadman; ngan nakalipay hiya han Dyos ngan han mga tawo.
en: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

war: ngan hira Anas ug Caifas an mga Labaw nga kapadian. Hini nga panahon inmabot an pulong han Dyos kan Juan nga anak ni Zacarias, didto ha kamingawan.
en: during the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.

war: Sanglit, ginsudoy ni Juan an bug-os nga katunaan nga hirani han Salog han Jordan, ngan nagwali, “Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan magpabunyag kamo, ngan pasasayloon kamo han Dyos han iyo mga sala.”
en: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

war: Sumala han iginsurat ni manaragna Isaias ha iya basahan: “May naggogoliat ha kamingawan: ‘Andama an dalan han Ginoo para ha iya; tadonga an dalan nga iya aagian!
en: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.

war: Kinahanglan tak-upan an ngatanan nga kahamub-an, panason an ngatanan nga kabungtoran ug kabukiran. Kinahanglan tadongon an baliko nga mga dalan, ngan hamison an luongluong nga mga agian.
en: Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.

war: Ngan makakakita an ngatanan nga katawhan han katalwasan nga tikang han Dyos!’”
en: And all people will see God’s salvation.’ ”

war: Kinmadto kan Juan in kadam-an nga mga tawo hin pagpabunyag ha iya. Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kamo nga mga halas, hin-o in nagsumat ha iyo nga makakalikay kamo han tiarabot nga kapungot han Dyos?
en: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

war: Andam na an parakol hin pagpulod han mga kahoy upod an mga gamot; pupudlon an tagsa nga kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga ngan ilalabog ha kalayo.”
en: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”

war: Nagpakiana ha iya an mga tawo, “Sanglit, ano man an amon bubuhaton?”
en: “What should we do then?” the crowd asked.

war: Binmaton hiya, “kon hin-o in may duha nga bado, kinahanglan tagan niya an tawo nga waray bado, ngan kon hin-o in may pagkaon kinahanglan makigsaro hiya.”
en: John answered, “Anyone who has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and anyone who has food should do the same.”

war: Inmabot pagpabunyag in mga parasukot hin buhis ngan nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Magturutdo, ano man an amon bubuhaton?”
en: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”

war: Ginsiring niya hira, “Ayaw kamo pagsukot hin diri na igo ug kaangayan.”
en: “Don’t collect any more than you are required to,” he told them.

war: Dinmugang an paglaom han mga tawo, ngan nakahunahuna hira hiunong kan Juan, nga bangin hiya na an Mesiyas.
en: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Messiah.

war: Dara niya an igparalid nga nigo hin pagpalid han giniok nga mga inani, ngan pagtirok han trigo ngadto han iya kamalig; kundi iya susunogon an ohot didto ha kalayo nga diri gud mapaparong.”
en: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

war: Gindasig ni Juan an mga tawo hin damo kalain nga mga paagi, samtang nga nagwawali hiya han Maupay nga Sumat ha ira.
en: And with many other words John exhorted the people and proclaimed the good news to them.

war: Kundi ginsusnan ni Juan hi Gobernador Herodes, kay pinangasawa niya hi Herodias nga asawa han iya bugto, ngan tungod hin damo pa nga iba nga magraot nga mga butang nga iya ginbuhat.
en: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of his marriage to Herodias, his brother’s wife, and all the other evil things he had done,

war: Ginbuhat pa ni Herodes in dako nga karat-an. Iginpapriso pa niya hi Juan.
en: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

war: Katapos na kabunyagi han ngatanan nga mga tawo, ginbunyagan liwat hi Jesus. Samtang nag-aampo hiya, nabuksan an langit,
en: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened

war: Mga 30 na an edad ni Jesus han pagtikang niya han iya buruhaton. Nagtoo an mga tawo nga anak hiya ni Jose nga anak ni Eli.
en: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,

war: Ini hi Eli anak ni Matat nga anak ni Levi nga anak ni Melqui nga anak ni Jana nga anak ni Jose.
en: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melki, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

war: Hi Jose anak ni Matatias nga anak ni Amos nga anak ni Nahum nga anak ni Esli nga anak ni Nagai.
en: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

war: Hi Nagai anak ni Maat nga anak ni Matatias nga anak ni Semei nga anak ni Jose nga anak ni Juda.
en: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josek, the son of Joda,

war: Hi Juda anak ni Joan nga anak ni Resa nga anak ni Sorobabel nga anak ni Salatiel nga anak ni Neri.
en: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

war: Ini hi Neri anak ni Melqui nga anak ni Adi nga anak ni Cosam nga anak ni Elmodam nga anak ni Er.
en: the son of Melki, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

war: Hi Er anak ni Josue nga anak ni Eliezer nga anak ni Jorim nga anak ni Matat nga anak ni Levi.
en: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

war: Hi Levi anak ni Simeon nga anak ni Juda nga anak ni Jose nga anak ni Jonan nga anak ni Eliakim.
en: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

war: Hi Eliakim anak ni Melea nga anak ni Mainan nga anak ni Matata nga anak ni Natan nga anak ni David.
en: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

war: Anak ini hi David ni Isai nga anak ni Obed nga anak ni Boos nga anak ni Salmon nga anak ni Naason.
en: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

war: Hi Naason anak ni Abinadab nga anak ni Admin nga anak ni Arni nga anak ni Esrom nga anak ni Fares nga anak ni Juda.
en: the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

war: Hi Juda anak ni Jacob nga anak ni Isaac nga anak ni Abraham nga anak ni Tare nga anak ni Nahor.
en: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

war: Hi Nahor anak ni Serug nga anak ni Ragau nga anak ni Peleg nga anak ni Eber nga anak ni Sela.
en: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

war: Hi Sela anak ni Cainan nga anak ni Arfaxad nga anak ni Sem nga anak ni Noe nga anak ni Lamec.
en: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

war: Hi Lamec anak ni Metusela nga anak ni Enoc nga anak ni Jared nga anak ni Mahalaleel nga anak ni Cainan.
en: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Kenan,

war: Anak ini hi Cainan ni Enos nga anak ni Set nga anak ni Adan nga anak han Dyos.
en: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

war: Binmalik tikang ha Jordan hi Jesus nga puno han Espiritu Santo, ngan gindara han Espiritu ngadto ha kamingawan,
en: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

war: diin ginsulay hiya han Yawa sulod hin kwarenta ka adlaw. Waray hiya kumaon sakob hini nga mga adlaw, sanglit ginutom hiya.
en: where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an Yawa, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, igbuot nga ini nga bato mahimo nga tinapay.”
en: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Diri mabubuhi an tawo ha tinapay la.’”
en: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’ ”

war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto ha igbaw, ngan iginpakita ha iya hin usa la kadali an ngatanan nga mga ginhadian ha kalibutan.
en: The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.

war: Sanglit, ihahatag ko ini ngatanan ha imo kon magsingba ka ha akon.”
en: If you worship me, it will all be yours.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Singbahon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos ngan hiya gudla an imo pagsirbehan.’”
en: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.’ ”

war: Kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Susugoon han Dyos an iya mga anghel hin pagmangno hin maupay ha imo.’
en: For it is written: “ ‘He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;

war: Nasiring liwat, ‘Sasapnayon ka nira han ira mga kamot, basi diri mapilasan an imo mga tiil dida ha mga bato.’”
en: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’ ”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Kinahanglan diri mo pagsulayon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos.’”
en: Jesus answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”

war: Katapos na han Yawa pagsulay kan Jesus hin ngatanan nga paagi, ginbayaan anay hiya hin madaliay han yawa.
en: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ha Galilea, ngan nakada ha iya an gahom han Espiritu Santo. Nahibantog an sumat mahitungod ha iya dida hito nga katunaan.
en: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.

war: Nagtutdo hiya ha ira mga sinagoga, ngan gindayaw hiya han ngatanan.
en: He was teaching in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ha Nazaret, diin hiya nagtubo, ngan sugad han iya nabatasan, kinmadto hiya ha sinagoga ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Tinmindog hiya hin pagbasa han Kasuratan,
en: He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. He stood up to read,

war: ngan iginhatag ha iya an basahan ni manaragna Isaias. Ginbuklad niya an linikid nga basahan ngan amo ini an iya nabasa:
en: and the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:

war: ngan hin pagpahibaro nga inmabot na an panahon nga tatalwason han Ginoo an iya katawhan.”
en: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”

war: Ginlukot ngahaw ni Jesus an linikid nga basahan, iginhatag han magtiripig, ngan lumingkod. Tinmutok ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha sinagoga.
en: Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him.

war: Nagtikang hiya paghimangraw ha ira: “Natuman yana nga adlaw ini nga bahin han kasuratan samtang hinbatian niyo nga ginbabasa ko ha iyo.”
en: He began by saying to them, “Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”

war: Nanhingalipay ha iya hira ngatanan, ngan nanhipausa han magnamit nga mga pulong nga iya iginhimangraw. Nagsiring hira, “Diri ba hiya an anak ni Jose?”
en: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?” they asked.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hini: Diri tinutuod in usa nga manaragna ha iya kalugaringon nga bungto.
en: “Truly I tell you,” he continued, “no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

war: Kundi waray pakadto hi Elias ha bisan kanay ha ira, kundi ngadto hin usa la nga balo ha Sarepta, ha tuna han Sidon.
en: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon.

war: Ngan may hadto damo nga mga sanlahon ha Israel ha panahon ni manaragna Eliseo, kundi waray bisan usa ha ira nga ginlinisan, labot kan Naaman nga taga-Siria.”
en: And there were many in Israel with leprosy in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”

war: Napungot an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha sinagoga han pakabati nira hini.
en: All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this.

war: Nagkabuhat hira, gindanas nira hi Jesus ha gawas han bungto ngan gindara hiya ha bawbaw han bukid nga gintukoran han ira bungto. An ira tuyo amo an paghulog ha iya ngadto han umpas.
en: They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff.

war: Kundi nagtarap hiya ha butnga han kadam-an ngan linmakat.
en: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ha Capernaum, usa nga bungto ha Galilea, diin nagtutdo hiya han mga tawo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath he taught the people.

war: Nahipausa hira ngatanan han paagi han iya pagtutdo, kay may gahom an iya mga pulong.
en: They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.

war: May-ada tawo ha sinagoga nga may espiritu hin mahugaw nga yawa, ngan naggoliat hin dako nga tingog:
en: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,

war: “Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, ano an imo karuyag ha amon? Kinmanhi ka ba hin pagpatay ha amon? Maaram ako kon hin-o ka: amo ka an baraan nga surugoon han Dyos!”
en: “Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”

war: Nanhipausa hira ngatanan ngan may hinsiring, “Ano ba ini nga mga pulong? Ini nga tawo may gahom ug kusog hin pagsugo han mga magraot nga espiritu hin paggawas, ngan nagawas hira!”
en: All the people were amazed and said to each other, “What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!”

war: Ngan nahibantog an sumat mahitungod kan Jesus ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hito nga tuna.
en: And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.

war: Binmaya hi Jesus han sinagoga, ngan kinmadto ha balay ni Simon. Hinihirantan an babaye nga ugangan ni Simon, ngan ginsumatan nira hi Jesus mahitungod ha iya.
en: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.

war: Dinmuok ngan tinmindog hi Jesus ha ligid han iya higdaan. Ginpagawas niya an hiranat, ngan nalungasan hiya dayon. Binmuhat dayon hiya ngan nagdurot ha ira.
en: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

war: Han pagpunias han adlaw, ginmawas hi Jesus han bungto ngan kinmadto hin mamingaw nga dapit. Nagbiling ha iya an mga tawo, ngan han paghiagii nira ha iya, nagtalingoha hira hin paghawid ha iya.
en: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.

war: Kundi nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kinahanglan igwali ko an Maupay nga Sumat han Ginhadian han Dyos ngadto liwat ha iba nga mga bungto, kay ginsugo ako han Dyos tungod hini.”
en: But he said, “I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.”

war: Sanglit nagwali hiya didto ha mga sinagoga han bug-os nga Judea.
en: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.

war: Usa ka adlaw natukdaw hi Jesus ha baybayon han Lanaw han Genesaret, samtang nagdadaisog an mga tawo ngadto ha iya, pamati han pulong han Dyos.
en: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.

war: Hinkit-an niya in duha nga sakayan nga iginsangya ha baybayon. Nagkahaw-as an mga mangirisda, ngan nagbulyas han ira mga pukot.
en: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.

war: Han katapos niya paghimangraw, nagsiring hiya kan Simon, “Palawod ngan itunod niyo an mga pukot, ngan makakadakop kamo.”
en: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”

war: Binmaton hi Simon, “Agaron, nagkabudlay kami ha bug-os nga gab-i, ngan waray gud kami makadakop. Kundi kon amo man an imo siring, tutunoron namon an mga pukot.”
en: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”

war: Gintunod nira an mga pukot, ngan nakadakop hira hin damo nga isda, nga haros magisi an mga pukot.
en: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.

war: Sanglit ginkampay nira an ira mga kaupod didto hin lain nga sakayan basi buligan hira. Hinmarani hira ngan gintugob hin isda an duha nga sakayan, nga haros malunod na hira.
en: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

war: Pakakita ni Simon Pedro han nahinabo, linmuhod hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Pahirayo ha akon, Ginoo! Makasasala ako nga tawo!”
en: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”

war: Nahipausa hi Simon ngan an iba nga mga kaupod niya han duro kadamo nga isda nga ira nadakop.
en: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

war: Nahipausa man liwat hira Santiago ug Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo ngan mga kabulig ni Simon. Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Simon, “Ayaw kahadlok; tikang yana mananakop ka na hin mga tawo.”
en: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.”

war: Iginsangya nira an mga sakayan, ginbayaan an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod hira kan Jesus.
en: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.

war: Ginpadapat ni Jesus ngada ha iya an iya kamot, ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko, magmalinis ka!” Ha gilayon nawara an iya sanla.
en: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.

war: Kundi nagsarang lugod an sumat mahitungod kan Jesus, ngan inmabot in damo nga mga tawo pamati ha iya, ngan pagpabulong han ira mga sakit.
en: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

war: Kundi napakadto hiya ha mga dapit nga mamingaw, diin nag-ampo hiya.
en: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

war: Inmabot in mga tawo nga nagdara hin usa nga lulid ha higdaan, ngan nagtalinguha hira pagdara ha iya ha sakob han balay, pagbutang ha iya ha atubangan ni Jesus.
en: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.

war: Han pakakita ni Jesus han kadako han ira pagtoo, ginsiring niya an lulid, “Sangkay, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”
en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”

war: Nakasabot ni Jesus an ira panhunahuna ngan ginsiring hira, “Kay ano nga naghunahuna kamo hin sugad nga mga butang?
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?

war: Hain ba in masurusayon, an pagsiring, ‘Ginpasaylo an imo mga sala,’ o an pagsiring, ‘Buhat ngan lakat?’
en: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

war: Tinmukdaw dayon an tawo ha atubangan nira ngatanan, gindara an iya higdaan, ngan inmoli nga nagdadayaw han Dyos.
en: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.

war: Duro gud an paghipausa nira ngatanan! Tugob hin kahadlok, nagdayaw hira han Dyos, nga nasiring, “Kaurosahon han mga butang nga aton hinkit-an yana nga adlaw!”
en: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”

war: Katapos hini, ginmawas hi Jesus ngan hinkit-an niya in usa nga parasukot hin buhis, nga ginngangaranan kan Levi, nga nalingkod didto ha iya buhatan. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Sunod ha akon.”
en: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. “Follow me,” Jesus said to him,

war: Binmuhat hi Levi, ginbayaan an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod ha iya.
en: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.

war: Niyan nag-andam hi Levi hin dako nga panagtawo didto ha iya balay para kan Jesus. May damo nga parasukot hin buhis ngan iba pa nga mga tawo nga upod nira.
en: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Diri nagkikinahanglan hin magtarambal an mga tawo nga mag-upay an lawas, kundi adton mga magsakit la.
en: Jesus answered them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

war: Waray ako kumanhi hin pagtawag nga basi magbasol an mga magtadong, kundi hin pagtawag han mga makasasala.”
en: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Makakapugong ba kamo hin pagpakaon han mga dinapit ngada hin pagkasal, samtang kaupod pa nira an karaslon nga lalake? Diri gud kamo makakahimo!
en: Jesus answered, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?

war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an karaslon nga lalake, ngan diri na ngahaw hira makaon ug mainom.”
en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.”

war: Diri! Kinahanglan igsulod an bag-o nga bino ngada hin bag-o nga anit nga surudlan!
en: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.

war: Ngan waray naruruyag hin bag-o nga bino, katapos makainom hiya hin daan nga bino, kay nasiring hiya, ‘Mauruopay an daan!’”
en: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’ ”

war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, naglatas hi Jesus ha kaumhan hin trigo. Nagtikang an iya mga tinun-an pangutos hin mga uhay han trigo, ginkurukuso ha ira mga kamot, ngan nangaon han trigo.
en: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.

war: Nagsiring in pira nga mga Parisiyo, “Kay ano nga ginbubuhat niyo an igindidiri han aton Balaod hin pagbuhat ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”
en: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Waray ba niyo mabasa an ginbuhat ni David han paggutoma ha iya ngan an iya mga kaupod?
en: Jesus answered them, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “An Anak han Tawo amo an Ginoo han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”
en: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

war: Ha lain nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kinmadto hi Jesus ha sinagoga ngan nagtutdo. May tawo didto nga patay an tuo nga kamot.
en: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.

war: Kundi nahibaroan ni Jesus an ira panhunahuna, ngan nagsiring hiya ha tawo nga patay an kamot, “Buhat ngan pa kadi ha atubangan.” Binmuhat an tawo ngan tinmukdaw ha iya atubangan.
en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Get up and stand in front of everyone.” So he got up and stood there.

war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus ha ira ngatanan, ngan kahuman ginsiring niya an tawo, “Unata an imo kamot.” Gin-unat han tawo an iya kamot ngan naupay.
en: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and his hand was completely restored.

war: Kundi duro gud an ira kapungot, ngan nagsarabot hira kon ano an angay pagbuhaton nira kan Jesus.
en: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.

war: Hadto nga panahon sinmagka hi Jesus ngadto hin usa nga bukid para hin pag-ampo, ngan mag-aga an iya pag-inampo ngadto sa Dyos.
en: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.

war: Han pagkaaga, gintawag niya an iya mga tinun-an ngan nagpili hiya hin dose ha ira, nga ginngaranan nga mga apostoles:
en: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:

war: hira Simon (nga iya liwat ginngaranan kan Pedro) ug Andres nga iya bugto; Santiago ug Juan, Felipe ug Bartolome,
en: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,

war: Mateo ug Tomas, Santiago nga anak ni Alfeo, ug Simon (nga gintawag, an Bayani),
en: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,

war: Judas nga anak ni Santiago, ug Judas Iscariote nga naglingo han Ginoo.
en: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

war: Nagkaabot hira pamati ha iya ngan pagpatambal han ira mga sakit. Nagkaabot liwat an mga sinasangkayan hin magraot nga mga espiritu ngan natambal hira.
en: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,

war: Nagtalingoha hin pagkamkam ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo, kay naguwa tikang ha iya in gahom nga nagtatambal ha ira ngatanan.
en: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.

war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Palaran kamo nga mga kablas, kay iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos!
en: Looking at his disciples, he said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

war: “Palaran kamo nga mga ginugutom yana, kay pagbubusgon kamo! “Palaran kamo nga mga nagtatangis yana, kay malilipay kamo!
en: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

war: “Palaran kamo kon tungod han Anak han Tawo, pagdumtan, igsalikway, pagyubiton, ngan pakaraoton kamo han mga tawo!
en: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

war: “Kundi pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo nga mga riko yana, kay nagkaada na kamo han iyo himyang nga kinabuhi!
en: “But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.

war: “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo nga mga busog yana, kay gugutomon kamo! “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo nga nagtitinawa yana, kay magmamasulub-on ngan magtatangis kamo!
en: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

war: “Pagkamakaharadlok kon pagdinayawon kamo han ngatanan nga mga tawo, kay ginsiring han ira mga kaapoy-apoyan ini ngahaw nga mga butang mahitungod han buwaon nga mga manaragna.
en: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.

war: “Kundi nasiring ako ha iyo nga namamati ha akon: higugmaa an iyo mga kaaway, buhata an maupay para han mga nagdudumot ha iyo.
en: “But to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

war: Pakaupaya an nagpapakaraot ha iyo, ngan ig-ampo an mga nagraraogdaog ha iyo.
en: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.

war: Kon tampalohon ka ha usa nga bayhon, ipatampalo liwat an luyo; kon may magkuha han imo barong, ihatag liwat an imo kamiseta.
en: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.

war: Tagi adton maaro ha imo, ngan kon may magkuha han imo butang, ayaw na ipaoli ha iya.
en: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.

war: Buhata ha iba an imo karuyag nga ira pagbuhaton ha imo.
en: Do to others as you would have them do to you.

war: “Kon higugmaon la niyo an mga tawo la nga nahigugma ha iyo, kay ano nga makarawat kamo hin kaupayan? Bisan ngani an mga makasasala nahigugma han mga nahigugma man ha ira!
en: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.

war: Ngan kon buhaton niyo an maupay ngadto la han mga nagbubuhat hin maupay ha iyo, kay ano nga makarawat kamo hin kaupayan? Nagbubuhat ngani hito, bisan an mga makasasala!
en: And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do that.

war: Pagmaloloy-on kamo sugad nga maloloy-on an Amay niyo.
en: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.

war: Ngan iginsumat ni Jesus ha ira ini nga pananglitan: “Diri makakagtugway in buta hin igkasi buta; kon buhaton niya ini, mahuhulog hira nga duha ngadto ha kali.
en: He also told them this parable: “Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?

war: Waray tinun-an nga labaw han iya magturutdo; kundi masusugad han iya magturutdo an tagsa nga tinun-an, kon tapos na an iya pag-aram.
en: The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.

war: “Kay ano nga asay mo kinikita an poling ha mata han imo bugto, kundi diri ka nanginginano han nabalabag ha imo kalugaringon nga mata?
en: “Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?

war: “Diri nahatag hin maraot nga bunga in maupay nga kahoy, o nahatag hin maupay nga bunga in maraot nga kahoy.
en: “No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.

war: Kinikilala an tagsa nga kahoy pinaagi han iya mga bunga; diri ka naburo hin mga igos tikang hin mga sapinit, o nagtitirok hin mga ubas tikang hin mga niyutiyo.
en: Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.

war: “Kay ano nga gintatawag ako niyo, ‘Ginoo, Ginoo,’ ngan diri niyo ginbubuhat an iginsusumat ko ha iyo?
en: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?

war: An tagsatagsa nga nadaop ha akon, ngan namamati han akon mga pulong, ngan iya gintutuman, ipapakita ko ha iyo kon ano an itatanding ha iya.
en: As for everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like.

war: Katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini ngatanan nga mga butang ha mga tawo, kinmadto hiya ha Capernaum.
en: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people who were listening, he entered Capernaum.

war: May didto kapitan nga Romano, nga may-ada surugoon nga iya minahal, nga masakit ngan tikamaratay na.
en: There a centurion’s servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.

war: Han pakabati han kapitan hiunong kan Jesus, ginpakadto niya in katigurangan nga mga Judiyo hin paghangyo kan Jesus nga kadtoon ngan tambalon an iya surugoon.
en: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.

war: Dinmaop hira kan Jesus ngan nakimalooy ha iya, “Takos gud ini nga tawo han imo bulig.
en: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, “This man deserves to have you do this,

war: Nahigugma hiya han aton mga tawo, nga nagtindog hiya hin sinagoga para ha aton.”
en: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue.”

war: ngan diri man ako takos makigkita ha imo. Sanglit pagyakan na la ngan mag-uopay an akon surugoon.
en: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

war: Binmalik ha balay han kapitan an mga sinugo ngan hinkit-an nira nga maupay na an iya surugoon.
en: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.

war: Waray pag-iha kinmadto hi Jesus hin bungto nga Nain an ngaran. Inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an ngan hin dako nga hugpo hin mga tawo.
en: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.

war: Han pakakita ha iya han Ginoo, inalpan an Ginoo hin kalooy ha iya, ngan nagsiring an Ginoo ha iya, “Ayaw pagtangis.”
en: When the Lord saw her, his heart went out to her and he said, “Don’t cry.”

war: Hinmarani hiya ngan gindun-an an lungon, ngan inmukoy an magparasag nga mga tawo. Sinmiring hi Jesus, “Ikaw nga olitawo, nasiring ako ha imo, buhat!”
en: Then he went up and touched the bier they were carrying him on, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I say to you, get up!”

war: Linmingkod an minatay ngan nagtikang hin pagyakan, ngan iginhatag hiya ni Jesus ngadto han iroy niya.
en: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

war: Pinangulba an ngatanan, ngan nagdayaw hira han Dyos, “Nagpakita ha butnga naton in dako nga manaragna!” ngan, “Kinmanhi an Dyos hin pagtalwas han iya katawhan!”
en: They were all filled with awe and praised God. “A great prophet has appeared among us,” they said. “God has come to help his people.”

war: Nahibantog ini nga sumat mahitungod kan Jesus ha bug-os nga Judea ngan ha mga higrani nga katunaan.
en: This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding country.

war: Ginsumatan hi Juan han iya mga tinun-an hiunong hini ngatanan nga mga butang. Gintawag ni Juan in duha ha ira,
en: John’s disciples told him about all these things. Calling two of them,

war: ngan ginsugo hira ngadto han Ginoo hin pagpakiana ha iya kon hiya ba an tiarabot nga ginsiring ni Juan, o kon magpapaabot pa ba hira hin lain.
en: he sent them to the Lord to ask, “Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?”

war: Han pag-abot nira, nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Ginsugo kami ni Juan nga Parabunyag hin pagpakiana, ‘Amo ka ba an iya ginsiring nga tiarabot, o magpapaabot pa ba kami hin lain?’”
en: When the men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to you to ask, ‘Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?’ ”

war: Hito manta nga panahon gintambal ni Jesus in damo nga mga tawo han ira mga sakit, mga balatian, mga magraot nga mga espiritu, ngan nagpakakita in damo nga mga buta.
en: At that very time Jesus cured many who had diseases, sicknesses and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.

war: Pagkapalaran hadton waray na mga pagruhaduha hiunong ha akon!”
en: Blessed is anyone who does not stumble on account of me.”

war: Sumati daw ako, ano gud an iyo ginkadto hin pagkita? Usa ba nga manaragna? Oo, nasiring ako ha iyo nga hinkit-an niyo in labaw pa hin manaragna.
en: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

war: Kay amo hi Juan an iginsiring han kasuratan, ‘Iini an akon magsarangyaw, nasiring an Dyos; ipadadara ko hiya una ha imo hin pag-andam han dalan para ha imo!’”
en: This is the one about whom it is written: “ ‘I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.’

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, labaw pa hi Juan kay hin bisan hin-o nga natawo; kundi labaw pa ha iya an gigugutiayi dida han Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.”

war: Nakabati ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo; hira ngan an mga parasukot hin buhis amo an nagtuman han matadong nga mga paglarang han Dyos, ngan ginbunyagan hira ni Juan.
en: (All the people, even the tax collectors, when they heard Jesus’ words, acknowledged that God’s way was right, because they had been baptized by John.

war: Kundi iginsalikway han mga Parisiyo ngan han mga magturutdo han Balaod an katoyoanan han Dyos para ha ira, ngan dinmiri hira hin pagpabunyag kan Juan.
en: But the Pharisees and the experts in the law rejected God’s purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.)

war: “Niyan, ano man an akon ikatatanding han mga tawo hini nga panahon? Sugad hin ano hira?
en: Jesus went on to say, “To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

war: Kinmanhi hi Juan nga Parabunyag, ngan nagpuasa hiya ngan waray uminom hin bino, ngan nagsiring kamo, ‘Ginsasangkayan hiya hin yawa!’
en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

war: Kundi an kinaadman han Dyos ipapakita nga matuod hadton ngatanan nga makarawat hini nga kinaadman.”
en: But wisdom is proved right by all her children.”

war: Gindapit hi Jesus hin usa nga Parisiyo ngadto hin pangaon. Kinmadto hi Jesus ha iya balay ngan linmingkod hin pagkaon.
en: When one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, he went to the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.

war: Nagyakan hi Jesus ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Simon, may-ada ko unta igsusumat ha imo.” Nagsiring hi Simon, “Oo, Magturutdo, sumati ako.”
en: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, teacher,” he said.

war: Sinmiring hi Jesus, “May duha ka tawo nga nakautang didto hin usa ka tawo nga nagpapautang hin kwarta. Nakautang hin mil pesos an usa, ngan syin pesos an ikaduha.
en: “Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

war: Waray man ha ira nakakabayad, sanglit ginpara na la niya an ira mga utang. Niyan, hin-o man han duha an mahigugma ha iya hin darudako?”
en: Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?”

war: Binmaton hi Simon, “Bangin la hiya nga dako an utang.” “Igo an imo baton,” nagsiring hi Jesus.
en: Simon replied, “I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven.” “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.

war: Waray mo ako tapoa hin harok, kundi tikang han akon pag-abot, waray hiya undang hin paghinarok han akon tiil.
en: You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.

war: Waray ka mag-andam hin lana para han akon ulo, kundi ginbub-an niya an akon mga tiil hin talamhot.
en: You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ngadto han babaye, “Ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”
en: Then Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

war: Nagtikang hin pagngurutob an iba nga nalingkod ha lamisa, “Hin-o ngani ini nga nagpapasaylo han mga sala?”
en: The other guests began to say among themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus ngadto han babaye, “An imo pagtoo an nagtalwas ha imo; maupay na la nga imo paglakat!”
en: Jesus said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”

war: Waray pag-iha, nagsudoy hi Jesus han kabungtohan ug kabaryohan, hin pagwali han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod han Ginhadian han Dyos. Inmupod ha iya an dose nga mga tinun-an,
en: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,

war: ngan pira nga kababayen-an nga gin-upay tikang hin magraot nga mga espiritu ngan mga sakit: hira Maria (nga ginngangaranan nga Magdalena), nga tikang ha iya ginmawas in pito nga mga yawa;
en: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;

war: Abotkiabot an mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus tikang ha usa ngadto han sunod nga bungto, ngan han pagtirok na hin dako nga hugpo hin mga tawo, iginsumat ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan:
en: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:

war: Nagkataktak in pira han mga binhe ha batoon nga tuna, ngan han pagtubo na han mga tanom, nagkalalaya hira, kay mamara man an tuna.
en: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.

war: Nagkataktak an iba han mga binhe ha katunokan, nga tinmubo tampo han mga tanom, ngan naambongan an mga tanom.
en: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.

war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an iya mga tinun-an kon ano an kahulogan hini nga pananglitan.
en: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.

war: “Amo ini an kahulogan han pananglitan: an pulong han Dyos amo an binhe.
en: “This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.

war: An mga namamati amo an binhe nga nataktak ha ligid han dalan, kundi naabot an Yawa ngan inaagaw an mensahe tikang ha ira mga kasingkasing, basi diri hira tumuo ngan matalwas.
en: Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.

war: An binhe nga nahulog ha maupay nga tuna, amo adton namamati han mensahe ngan gintitipigan nira ha maupay ngan masinugtanon nga kasingkasing, ngan nagpapadayon hira tubtob nga makapamunga.
en: But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.

war: An bisan ano nga tinago, ipadadayag; ngan an bisan ano nga tinahoban, ipahahayag.
en: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.

war: “Sanglit, paghirot han iyo pamati; kay adton may-ada, tatagan pa hin dugang; kundi adton waray, kukuhaan pa hiya bisan han gutiay nga iya ginhuhunahuna nga iya.”
en: Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they think they have will be taken from them.”

war: Kinmadto kan Jesus an iroy ngan kabugtoan niya, kundi waray makahirani ha iya tungod han damo nga mga tawo.
en: Now Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.

war: May nagsiring kan Jesus, “Aadto ha gawas an iroy ngan kabugtoan mo, ngan karuyag makigkita ha imo.”
en: Someone told him, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira ngatanan, “Adton namamati ngan nagtutuman han pulong han Dyos amo an iroy ngan kabugtoan ko.”
en: He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear God’s word and put it into practice.”

war: Usa ka adlaw sinmakay hi Jesus hin sakayan, upod han iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Tabok kita ngadto ha luyo han lanaw.” Sanglit pinmalawod hira.
en: One day Jesus said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side of the lake.” So they got into a boat and set out.

war: Samtang nagsasakay hira, nahingaturog hi Jesus. Nagmadlos in hangin didto han lanaw, ginsakayan hin tubig an sakayan, ngan nahingada hira ngatanan hin dako nga kataragman.
en: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.

war: Nagpadayon hira hin pagsakay ngadto ha tuna han mga taga-Gadara, nga tabok han lanaw tikang ha Galilea.
en: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.

war: Ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Ano an imo ngaran?” Binmaton hiya, “Panon an akon ngaran,” kay damo nga mga yawa an sinmulod ha iya.
en: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.

war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga yawa nga diri hira tabogon ngadto ha kahiladman.
en: And they begged Jesus repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.

war: Hinkit-an an nahinabo han mga tawo nga nagmamangno han kababoyan, sanglit nagdadlagan hira ngadto ha bungto ug kaumhan hin pagsumat han nahinabo.
en: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,

war: An mga nagpakakita nagsumat han mga tawo kon gin-unan-o hin pag-upay han sinangkayan hin yawa.
en: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.

war: Niyan ginhangyo hi Jesus han mga taga-Gadara nga bumaya hiya ha ira, kay nahadlok hira. Sanglit sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan ngan ginmikan.
en: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.

war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an tawo nga iniwasan han mga yawa, “Paupda gad ako ha imo.” Kundi ginpalakat hiya ni Jesus upod ini nga tugon,
en: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

war: “Oli ngadto ha iyo ngan igsumat an ginbuhat han Dyos ha imo.” Linmakat an tawo nga iginsumat niya ha bug-os nga bungto an ngatanan nga ginbuhat ni Jesus ha iya.
en: “Return home and tell how much God has done for you.” So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.

war: Pagbalik ni Jesus ngadto ha tabok han lanaw, gintapo hiya han mga tawo, kay naghihinulat na hira ngatanan ha iya.
en: Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.

war: Inmabot in usa ka tawo nga ginngangaranan kan Jairo nga usa nga opisyal han sinagoga. Hinmapa hiya ha tiilan ni Jesus ngan nakimalooy ha iya nga kumadto ha iya balay,
en: Then a man named Jairus, a synagogue leader, came and fell at Jesus’ feet, pleading with him to come to his house

war: kay tikamaratay na an amo la nga iya anak nga babaye nga 12 an edad. Han nagtitipakadto na hi Jesus, gindadaisog hiya paluyoluyo han mga tawo.
en: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.

war: Nagpirit hiya hin pagkadto ha luyo ni Jesus, kinamkam niya an sidsid han panapton ni Jesus ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya.
en: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.

war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Hin-o in nagkamkam ha akon?” Waray la makigbali an mga tawo, sanglit sinmiring hi Pedro, “Agaron, diri ka ba maaram nga ginlilibotan ngan gindadaisog ka han mga tawo?”
en: “Who touched me?” Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, “Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you.”

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “May-ada gud nagkamkam ha akon, kay inmabat ako nga may ginmawas nga gahom tikang ha akon.”
en: But Jesus said, “Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me.”

war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Anak ko, an imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo. Maupay na la nga imo paglakat.”
en: Then he said to her, “Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”

war: Samtang nagyayakan pa hi Jesus, inmabot in usa nga sinugo tikang ha balay han opisyal. Ginsiring niya hi Jairo, “Patay na an imo anak nga babaye. Ayaw na pagsamoka an Magturutdo.”
en: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” he said. “Don’t bother the teacher anymore.”

war: Kundi hinbatian ini ni Jesus ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jairo, “Ayaw kahadlok; too la, ngan mag-uupay hiya.”
en: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, “Don’t be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”

war: Han pag-abot ni Jesus ha balay, waray hiya tumugot nga may umupod ha iya, labot kanda Pedro, Juan, ug Santiago, ngan an amay ug iroy han bata.
en: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child’s father and mother.

war: Nagtitinangis ngan masulob-on an ngatanan didto tungod han bata. Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo pagtangis; diri patay an bata, nakaturog la hiya!”
en: Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. “Stop wailing,” Jesus said. “She is not dead but asleep.”

war: Gintinawaan la hiya nira ngatanan, kay maaram hira nga patay na an bata.
en: They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.

war: Kundi ginkaptan ha kamot ni Jesus an bata ngan ginsiring, “Anak, buhat!”
en: But he took her by the hand and said, “My child, get up!”

war: Binmalik ha iya an kinabuhi ngan binmuhat hiya dayon; ngan ginsugo hira ni Jesus nga tagan hiya hin pagkaon.
en: Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

war: Nanhipausa an iya mga kag-anak, kundi ginsugo hira ni Jesus nga diri magsumat bisan kan kanay han nahinabo.
en: Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.

war: Gintirok ni Jesus an 12 nga mga tinun-an ngan gintagan hira hin gahom hin pagpagawas han ngatanan nga mga yawa ngan pagtambal han mga sakit.
en: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,

war: Niyan ginsugo niya hin pagwali han Ginhadian han Dyos ngan pagtambal han mga magsakit.
en: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

war: Ginsiring niya hira: “Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bisan ano ha iyo paglalaktan: waray tungkod, waray supot para hin limos, waray balon nga pagkaon, waray kwarta, waray bisan usa nga liliwanan.
en: He told them: “Take nothing for the journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra shirt.

war: Kon karawaton kamo, pabilin dida hito nga balay ngada han pagbaya niyo han bungto;
en: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.

war: kon diri kamo karawaton han mga tawo, bayai ito nga bungto, ngan padpara an tapotapo tikang han iyo mga tiil, sugad nga pahimangno ha ira?”
en: If people do not welcome you, leave their town and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”

war: Linmakat an mga tinun-an ngan nagsudoy han ngatanan nga kabaryohan. Nagwali hira han Maupay nga Sumat ngan nagtambal han mga tawo ha bisan diin nga dapit.
en: So they set out and went from village to village, proclaiming the good news and healing people everywhere.

war: an iba nasiring nga nagpakita hi Elias, samtang nagsiring pa nga usa han kamaihaan na nga mga manaragna in nabanhaw.
en: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.

war: Nagsiring hi Herodes, “Ginpapugotan ko na hi Juan; kundi hin-o ini nga tawo nga hinbabatian ko hiunong hini nga mga butang?” Ngan nagtalingoha hiya hin pag-ikinikitaan kan Jesus.
en: But Herod said, “I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?” And he tried to see him.

war: Binmalik an mga apostoles ngan ira ginsumatan hi Jesus han ngatanan nga ira nabuhat. Igin-upod hira niya ngan kinmadto nga hira la, ha usa nga bungto nga ginngangaranan Betsaida.
en: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,

war: (May mga lima ka yukot an kalalaken-an didto.) Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Papanlingkora niyo an mga tawo hin pundokpundok nga mga tinag-50 an kada usa.”
en: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, “Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

war: Ginbuhat ini han mga tinun-an ngan ginpalingkod hira ngatanan.
en: The disciples did so, and everyone sat down.

war: Nangaon hira ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog; ngan nakatirok an mga tinun-an hin 12 pa ka basket han nahisalin han mga tawo.
en: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

war: Usa ka panahon han nag-uusaan hi Jesus hin pag-ampo, dinmaop an mga tinun-an ha iya. Ginpakianhan hira niya, “Hin-o man ako, sumala han siring han mga tawo?”
