en: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, “Who do the crowds say I am?”

war: Binmaton hira, “May nasiring nga amo ka hi Juan nga Parabunyag. Nasiring an iba nga hi Elias ka, samtang nasiring naman an iba nga nabanhaw in usa han kamaihaan na nga mga manaragna.”
en: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life.”

war: Ginpakianhan hira niya, “An ha iyo, hin-o gud ako?” Binmaton hi Pedro, “Amo ka an Mesiyas han Dyos.”
en: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “God’s Messiah.”

war: Niyan gintugon gud hira ni Jesus nga diri magsumat bisan kan kanay,
en: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.

war: Kay an bisan hin-o nga karuyag magtalwas han iya kalugaringon nga kinabuhi, kawawad-an ini hiya; kundi an bisan hin-o nga kawad-an han iya kinabuhi tungod ha akon, matatalwas.
en: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will save it.

war: May-ada ba kapulsanan para hin usa ka tawo, kon maangkon niya an bug-os nga kalibutan, kundi kawad-an hiya han iya kinabuhi? Waray gud!
en: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit their very self?

war: Tigamni ini! Susumatan ko kamo, may-ada pipira dinhe ha iyo nga diri mapatay tubtob nga hikit-an nira an Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: “Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”

war: Mga usa na ka simana an linmabay katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini nga mga butang. Igin-upod niya hira Pedro, Juan, ug Santiago, ngan sinmagka hira hin bukid para hin pag-ampo.
en: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.

war: Samtang nag-aampo hi Jesus, nag-iba an dagway han iya bayhon, ngan tungod hin kamasilaw, nagmabusag an iya panapton.
en: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.

war: Ha gilayon pinmakita in duha ka tawo nga nakikighimangraw ha iya. Hira Moises ug Elias adto,
en: Two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus.

war: nga pinmakita dida ha langitnon nga himaya, ngan nakighimangraw kan Jesus mahitungod han paagi nga diri maiha magtutuman hiya han tuyo han Dyos, pinaagi han iya pagkamatay didto ha Jerusalem.
en: They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.

war: Maupay gud an paghingaturog ni Pedro ngan han iya mga kaupod, kundi nagmata hira ngan nakakita han himaya ni Jesus ngan han duha nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw upod ha iya.
en: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.

war: Samtang nagyiyinakan pa hiya, pinmakita in usa nga dampog nga nakalambong ha ira; ngan nahadlok an mga tinun-an dida han pagtungod han dampog ha ira.
en: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and covered them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

war: Nagsiring in tingog tikang han dampog: “Amo ini an akon Anak nga akon pinili; pamatii hiya niyo!”
en: A voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him.”

war: Pag-ukoy na han tingog, nag-usaan na la hi Jesus. Ginhilom han mga tinun-an ini ngatanan, ngan hadto nga mga adlaw waray gud hira magsumat bisan kan kanay han ira hinkit-an.
en: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves and did not tell anyone at that time what they had seen.

war: Pagkabuwas, linmugsong hira han bukid, ngan gintapo hi Jesus hin damo nga mga tawo.
en: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.

war: Ginmoliat in usa ka tawo tikang han kadam-an: “Magturutdo! Nakikimalooy ako ha imo, kitaa gad an akon anak, an amo la nga akon anak!
en: A man in the crowd called out, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

war: Sinmulod ha iya in espiritu, nga tigda la hiya hin paggoliat, ngan binubuntog hiya, sanglit nagbububura an iya baba; waray hunong in pagpakurii ha iya, ngan makuri gud bumaya ha iya!
en: A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.

war: Nakimalooy ako han imo mga tinun-an nga pagawson ini nga maraot nga espiritu, kundi diri man hira nakakahimo.”
en: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not.”

war: Nanhipausa gud an ngatanan nga mga tawo han dako nga gahom han Dyos. Dako pa an paghipausa han mga tawo han ngatanan nga ginbuhat ni Jesus, han pagsiring niya ha iya mga tinun-an,
en: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

war: “Ayaw hingalimti ini nga akon iginsusumat ha iyo: itutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto ha gahom han mga tawo.”
en: “Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men.”

war: Kundi waray hira makasabot kon ano an kahulugan hini, ngan nahadlok hira hin pagpakiana ha iya mahitungod hini nga butang.
en: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.

war: Nagkaada hin lantogi an mga tinun-an kon hin-o ha ira an gilalabawi.
en: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.

war: Nasabtan ni Jesus an ira ginhuhunahuna, sanglit kinmuha hiya hin bata, ginpatukdaw ha iya ligid,
en: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.

war: Nagyakan hi Juan, “Agaron, hinkit-an namon in tawo nga nagpapagawas hin mga yawa ha imo ngaran, ngan ginsaway hiya namon, kay diri man hiya sakop han aton hugpo.”
en: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya ngan ha iba nga mga tinun-an, “Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hiya, kay naugop ha iyo an diri nasupak ha iyo.”
en: “Do not stop him,” Jesus said, “for whoever is not against you is for you.”

war: Samtang nagtitikahirani an mga adlaw nga masaka na hi Jesus ha langit, nagbuot na gud la hiya nga mapakadto hiya ha Jerusalem.
en: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

war: May-ada niya mga ginsugo hin pag-una ha iya. Linmakat hira ngan kinmadto hin usa nga baryo han Samaria hin pag-andam han ngatanan para ha iya.
en: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;

war: Kundi waray karawata hira han mga tawo didto, kay maaram hira nga tipakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.
en: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.

war: Linmingi hi Jesus ngan ginbusaan hira;
en: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.

war: Samtang naglalakat hira ha dalan, nagsiring in usa ka tawo kan Jesus, “Masunod ako ha imo bisan ngain.”
en: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, “I will follow you wherever you go.”

war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “May mga buho an mga miro ngan may mga salag an katamsihan, kundi waray ngani dapit nga sadang kapahuwayan an Anak han Tawo.”
en: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha lain nga tawo, “Sunod ha akon.” Kundi nagsiring adto nga tawo, “Tugoti ako anay hin pag-uli ngan paglubong han akon amay.”
en: He said to another man, “Follow me.” But he replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Asay papaglubnga an mga patay han ira kalugaringon nga minatay. Kundi ikaw, lakat ngan igwali an Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: Jesus said to him, “Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”

war: Nagsiring in usa pa nga tawo, “Masunod ako ha imo; kundi tugoti ako anay pagkadto ngan pagpanamilit han akon panimalay.”
en: Still another said, “I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say goodbye to my family.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri angay han Ginhadian han Dyos an bisan hin-o nga kinmapot na han arado ngan nagliliningi pa.”
en: Jesus replied, “No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God.”

war: Katapos hini nagpili an Ginoo hin iba nga 72 nga kalalaken-an ngan ginsugo hira, padis padis, hin pag-una ha iya ngadto ha tagsa nga bungto ug dapit nga iya ngahaw kakadtoan.
en: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.

war: Kadto na! Ginsusugo ta kamo sugad hin mga karnero ha butnga hin mga lubo.
en: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.

war: Ayaw kamo pagdara hin supot o surudlan hin limos o sandalyas; ayaw kamo pakigbali bisan kan kanay dida ha dalan.
en: Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.

war: Pagsulod niyo hin balay, siring anay, ‘An kalinaw maada hini nga balay.’
en: “When you enter a house, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’

war: Kon naukoy didto in tawo nga murayaw an kinabuhi, ibilin ha iya an iyo ginpamulong nga kamurayaw; kon diri, bakwia an iyo ginpamulong nga kamurayaw.
en: If someone who promotes peace is there, your peace will rest on them; if not, it will return to you.

war: Pabilin dida hito ngahaw nga balay; kaon ngan inom han ira idudurot ha iyo, kay an magburudlay takos han iya suhol. Ayaw kamo pagbinurobalhin hin urokyan.
en: Stay there, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.

war: Kon makadto kamo hin bungto ngan karawton kamo, kaon han igdudurot ha iyo,
en: “When you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is offered to you.

war: tambala niyo an mga magsakit didto hito nga bungto, ngan sidnga an mga tawo, ‘Haraniay na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.’
en: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’

war: Kundi kon sumulod kamo hin bungto ngan diri kamo karawaton, kadto kamo ha kadalanan ngan siring,
en: But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,

war: ‘Ginpapadpad namon kontra ha iyo bisan an tapotapo han iyo bungto nga nadukot ha amon mga tiil; kundi tigamni ini, haraniay na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos!’
en: ‘Even the dust of your town we wipe from our feet as a warning to you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God has come near.’

war: Susumatan ko kamo nga ha Adlaw han Paghukom, mas kalolooyan pa han Dyos an Sodoma kay hito nga bungto!
en: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.

war: Mas kalolooyan pa han Dyos an Tiro ug Sidon, kay ha iyo, ha Adlaw han Paghukom.
en: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.

war: Ngan para ha imo Capernaum, karuyag mo ba mag-undong han imo kalugaringon ngadto ha langit? Ilalabog ka ngadto ha impyerno!”
en: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades.

war: Binmalik nga puno hin kalipay an 72 nga kalalaken-an ngan nagsiring, “Ginoo, sinmugot ha amon bisan an mga yawa, han pagsugoa namon ha imo ngaran!”
en: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name.”

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Hinkit-an ko hi Satanas nga nahulog sugad hin kikidlat tikang ha langit.
en: He replied, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

war: Pamati! Gintagan ko kamo hin gahom, basi tamakan niyo an mga halas ngan mga bungad, ngan an ngatanan nga gahom han kaaway, ngan waray bisan ano nga makakadaot ha iyo.
en: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

war: Kundi pagkalipay kamo, diri tungod nga sinusugot kamo han magraot nga espiritu; kundi lugod pagkalipay kamo, kay nahisurat na an iyo mga ngaran didto ha langit.”
en: However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

war: Kahuman, inmatubang hi Jesus ha mga tinun-an ngan ginhilit hira hin pagsiring, “Kapalaran niyo hin pagkita han mga butang nga iyo hinkit-an!
en: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.

war: Inmabot in usa nga magturutdo han Balaod ngan nagtalinguha hin pagbitik kan Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya, “Magturutdo, ano an kinahanglan ko buhaton basi maangkon ko an dayon nga kinabuhi?”
en: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Ano an siring han Kasuratan? Inuunano mo hin pagsaysay ha ira?”
en: “What is written in the Law?” he replied. “How do you read it?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Igo an imo baton; buhata ini ngan mabubuhi ka.”
en: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus replied. “Do this and you will live.”

war: Kundi karuyag magpakamatadong ha iya kalugaringon an magturutdo han balaod, sanglit nagpakiana pa hiya kan Jesus, “Hin-o man an akon igkasi-tawo?”
en: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”

war: Nahinabo nga may padi nga naagi hadto nga dalan; pakakita niya han tawo, nagpadayon hiya paglakat didto ha luyo nga ligid han dalan.
en: A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.

war: Sugad man, inmagi liwat didto in usa nga Levita; hinmarani, kinmita han tawo, ngan nagpadayon paglakat ha luyo nga ligid han dalan.
en: So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

war: Kundi in usa nga Samaritano nga naagi hadto nga dalan inmagi ha iya, kinmita hini nga tawo ngan inalpan hin kalooy an iya kasingkasing han pakapanginano niya han tawo.
en: But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.

war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Ha imo paghunahuna, hain man hini nga tulo an nagpakita nga igkasi-tawo hiya han gin-gamaan han mga tikasan?”
en: “Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”

war: Nagbaton an magturutdo han Balaod, “Adton nalooy ha iya.” Binmaton hi Jesus, “Sanglit, kadto na, ngan buhata sugad han ginbuhat han Samaritano.”
en: The expert in the law replied, “The one who had mercy on him.” Jesus told him, “Go and do likewise.”

war: May-ada bugto hi Marta nga Maria an ngaran, nga linmingkod ha tiilan han Ginoo ngan namati han iya gintututdo.
en: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what he said.

war: Binmaton ha iya an Ginoo, “Marta, Marta! Naguguol ngan nababaraka ka hin damo nga mga butang,
en: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord answered, “you are worried and upset about many things,

war: kundi usa la an kinahanglanon. Ginpili ni Maria an labi ka maupay nga butang, ngan diri na ini maaagaw ha iya.”
en: but few things are needed—or indeed only one. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her.”

war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Sugara hini an iyo pag-ampo: ‘Amay: Pagdayawon unta an imo baraan nga ngaran; maghadi ka unta ha amon.
en: He said to them, “When you pray, say: “ ‘Father, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come.

war: Tagi kami adlaw-adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.
en: Give us each day our daily bread.

war: Pasayloa kami han amon nga sala, kay napasaylo man kami hadton mga makakasala ha amon. Ngan ayaw itugot nga mahingadto kami hin makuri nga pagsulay.’”
en: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation. ’ ”

war: Inmabot ha akon balay in usa ko nga sangkay nga naglalakaton, ngan waray ko sadang igdurot ha iya!’
en: a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have no food to offer him.’

war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: pangaro, ngan makarawat kamo; pamiling, ngan nakakaagi kamo; pagtuktok, ngan aabrehan an porta ha iyo.
en: “So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

war: Kay makarawat an nangangaro, ngan makakaagi an namimiling, ngan aabrehan an porta ha iya nga nagtutuktok.
en: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

war: May-ada ba usa ha iyo nga mga amay, nga mahatag han iya anak hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?
en: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

war: O tatagan ba niyo hiya hin bungad kon mangaro hiya hin bonay?
en: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

war: Ginpaiwas ni Jesus in ngula nga yawa; nakagyakan an tawo han paghigawas na han yawa. Nanhipausa an kadam-an,
en: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.

war: kundi nagsiring in pira han mga tawo, “Hi Beelsebul nga puno han mga yawa amo an nahatag ha iya hin gahom hin pagpagawas hin mga yawa.”
en: But some of them said, “By Beelzebul, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons.”

war: Karuyag han iba magbitik ha iya, sanglit nangaro hira ha iya nga magbuhat hiya hin milagro pagpakita nga hiya ginpadara han Dyos.
en: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.

war: Kon amo ini an paagi hin pagpagawas ko ha ira, inuunan-o man han iyo mga sakop hin pagpagawas han mga yawa? Nagpapakita an iyo kalugaringon nga mga sayop kamo!
en: Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

war: Diri, nagpapaguwa lugod ako hin yawa, pinaagi han gahom han Dyos, nga nagpapamatuod nga inmabot na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.
en: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

war: “Kon in kusgan nga tawo nga sangkap han ngatanan niya nga hinganiban nagbabantay han iya kalugaringon nga balay, diri maano an ngatanan niya nga mga higamit.
en: “When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.

war: Kundi kon sulongon ngan madaog hiya hin makarukosog nga tawo, aagawon an ngatanan nga hinganiban nga sinasarigan han tag-iya, ngan ginbabahinbahin an iya naagaw.
en: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up his plunder.

war: “Tinuod nga nasupak ha akon an bisan hin-o nga diri naugop ha akon; tinuod nga nagpapasarang, an bisan hin-o nga diri nabulig ha akon hin pagtirok.
en: “Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.

war: Sanglit nabalik an yawa ngan nakita han balay nga malinis ngan inayad na an ngatanan.
en: When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.

war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Lugod pagkapalaran hadton mga namamati ngan nagtutuman han pulong han Dyos!”
en: He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”

war: Sugad nga nagin tigaman hi Jonas nga manaragna para han mga tawo ha Ninibe, magigin tigaman man an Anak han Tawo para han mga tawo hini nga panahon.
en: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.

war: “Waray nadagkot hin suga ngan tagoon o takloban hin makaong; lugod, ibinubutang niya ha burutangan hin suga, basi hikit-an han mga tawo an kapawa ha pagsulod nira.
en: “No one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.

war: Sugad hin suga para han lawas an iyo mga mata. Puno hin kalamrag an iyo bug-os nga lawas, kon matin-aw an iyo mga mata; kundi magmamasirom an iyo bug-os nga lawas, kon maraot an iyo mga mata.
en: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are healthy, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are unhealthy, your body also is full of darkness.

war: Sanglit paghirot nga an kapawa dida ha iyo diri mahimo nga kasisidman.
en: See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.

war: Kon puno hin kalamrag an imo bug-os nga lawas, nga waray bahin nga aada hin kamasirom, maluluob hin kamapawa an iyo lawas, sugad kon nasanag ha imo an kapawa hin suga.”
en: Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be just as full of light as when a lamp shines its light on you.”

war: Katapos gud ni Jesus magyakan, gindapit hiya hin usa nga Parisiyo hin pagkaon upod ha iya; sanglit sinmulod hiya ngan linmingkod hin pagkaon.
en: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.

war: Nahipausa an Parisiyo han pakakita niya, nga waray anay manhunaw hi Jesus san-o kumaon.
en: But the Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.

war: Sanglit nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Yana, naghuhugas kamo nga mga Parisiyo han gawas han kupa ngan han plato, kundi puno kamo hin mga panlupig ngan karat-an ha sulod niyo.
en: Then the Lord said to him, “Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.

war: Mga lurong! Diri ba an Dyos nga naghimo han gawas, amo liwat an naghimo han sakob?
en: You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?

war: Kundi ihatag ha mga kablas an sulod han iyo mga tasa ug plato ngan magmamalinis an ngatanan para ha iyo.
en: But now as for what is inside you—be generous to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.

war: “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo, mga Parisiyo! Karuyag niyo an linain nga mga lingkoran ha mga sinagoga, ngan an paghatag ha iyo hin katalahoran han mga tawo didto ha mga taboan.
en: “Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and respectful greetings in the marketplaces.

war: Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo! Sugad kamo hin mga lubnganan nga waray tigaman nga tinatamakan han mga tawo, kay diri man hira maaram.”
en: “Woe to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which people walk over without knowing it.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya in usa han mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Magturutdo, kon nasiring ka hini ginpapakaalohan nimo kami!”
en: One of the experts in the law answered him, “Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also.”

war: Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo! Naghihimo kamo hin makaruruyag nga mga lubnganan para han mga manaragna—an mga manaragna ngahaw nga pinanmatay han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan.
en: “Woe to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your ancestors who killed them.

war: Kamo ngahaw natangdo nga nauyon kamo han ginbuhat han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan; kay ginpatay nira an mga manaragna, ngan gintindog niyo an ira mga lubnganan.
en: So you testify that you approve of what your ancestors did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.

war: Tungod hini nga pangatadongan, nagsiring an Kinaadman han Dyos: ‘Padadad-an ko hira hin mga manaragna ngan mga magsarangyaw; papatayon nira in pira ha ira ngan pagtitimaraotan an iba.’
en: Because of this, God in his wisdom said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.’

war: Sanglit kakastigohon an mga tawo hini nga panahon, tungod han pagpataya han ngatanan nga mga manaragna tikang pa han paghimoa han kalibutan,
en: Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,

war: Han pagbaya na ni Jesus hadto nga dapit, nagtikang an mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an mga Parisiyo hin pagsuson ha iya, ngan pagpakiana ha iya mahitungod hin damo la nga mga butang,
en: When Jesus went outside, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,

war: nga nagtalingoha hira hin pagbitik ngan pagdakop ha iya dida hin sayop nga iya igyayakan.
en: waiting to catch him in something he might say.

war: Mabubuksan an bisan ano nga tinahoban, ngan mahibabaroan an tagsa nga tinago.
en: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

war: Sanglit, an bisan ano nga imo iginyakan ha kasisidman, mahibabatian ha kapaw-an; ngan an bisan ano nga imo iginhoring ha sinadhan nga kuwarto igogoliat ha mga atop.
en: What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.

war: “Kasangkayan ko, susumatan ko kamo, ayaw kamo kahadlok hadton mga nakakamatay han lawas, kundi katapos waray na nira nahihimo.
en: “I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.

war: “Diri ba iginbabaligya hin duha ka sintabo an lima nga mga tamsi nga balinsasayaw? Kundi waray gud usa ha ira nga hinngangalimtan han Dyos.
en: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.

war: Gin-ihap na nga daan an ngatanan nga mga buhok han iyo ulo. Sanglit ayaw kamo kahadlok; labaw pa gud kamo hin kamahal kay hin damo nga katamsihan nga balinsasayaw!
en: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

war: “Susumatan ko kamo: an bisan hin-o nga magpadayag ha kadam-an nga akon hiya amo man an bubuhaton han Anak han Tawo ha atubangan han mga anghel han Dyos;
en: “I tell you, whoever publicly acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.

war: kundi an bisan hin-o nga maglirong ha kadam-an nga akon hiya iglilirong liwat han Anak han Tawo ha atubangan han mga anghel han Dyos.
en: But whoever disowns me before others will be disowned before the angels of God.

war: “Mapapasaylo an bisan hin-o nga magpapakaraot han Anak han Tawo, kundi diri mapapasaylo an magpapakaraot han Espiritu Santo.
en: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

war: Kay tututdoan kamo han Espiritu Santo, hito nga takna, kon ano an angay niyo igyakan.”
en: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.”

war: Nagsiring ha iya in tawo dida han kadam-an, “Magturutdo, sidnga gad an akon bugto pakigbahin ha akon han malon nga iginbilin han amon amay.”
en: Someone in the crowd said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Hin-o in naghatag ha akon hin katungod hin paghukom o pagbahin han malon niyo nga duha?”
en: Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?”

war: Niyan iginsumat ha ira ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan: “May usa ka tawo nga riko nga may-ada uma nga kinmuha hin damo nga abot.
en: And he told them this parable: “The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.

war: Naghunahuna hiya, ‘Waray ko na dapit nga hihimosan han ngatanan nga akon mga abot. Ano ba an akon bubuhaton?
en: He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’

war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Masusugad hini adton mga nagtitirok hin mga manggad para la ha ira kalugaringon, kundi diri mga riko ha atubangan han Dyos.”
en: “This is how it will be with whoever stores up things for themselves but is not rich toward God.”

war: Labaw pa ka importante an kinabuhi kay han pagkaon, ngan labaw pa ka importante an lawas kay han panapton.
en: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.

war: Tan-awa daw an mga uwak: diri hira nagtatanom o nag-aani; waray hira hirimosan nga mga payag o mga kamalig; gintutubongan man hira han Dyos! Labi kamo hin ka minahal kay han katamsihan!
en: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!

war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakadugang hin pira ka tuig han iya kinabuhi pinaagi hin pagkinabaraka?
en: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life ?

war: Kon diri man kamo nakakahimo bisan han mga gudtiay nga butang, kay ano nga mababaraka kamo hiunong han iba nga mga butang?
en: Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?

war: Sanglit ayaw kamo pagpinangarit, nga dayuday la nababaraka hiunong han iyo kakaonon ngan iimnom.
en: And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.

war: (Kay dayuday la nababaraka hini ngatanan nga mga butang an mga diri dyosnon hini nga kalibutan.) Maaram an iyo Amay nga kinahanglan niyo ini nga mga butang.
en: For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.

war: Lugod unaha niyo hin pagbiling an Ginhadian, ngan tatagan kamo niya hini nga mga butang.
en: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.

war: “Ayaw kamo kahadlok, gutiay nga panon, kay nalilipay an Amay niyo hin paghatag ha iyo han Ginhadian.
en: “Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

war: Kon hain an imo mga manggad dayuday aadto man an imo kasingkasing.
en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

war: “Pag-andam dayuday kamo han bisan ano nga maabot, nga daan hinugtan ha hawak an iyo mga panapton, ngan daan dinagkotan an iyo mga suga,
en: “Be dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,

war: sugad hin mga surugoon nga naghuhulat han ira agaron pagbalik tikang hin kombite han pagkasal. Aabrehan nira dayon an porta para ha iya, kon umabot ngan magtuktok hiya.
en: like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.

war: Palaran hira kon hiabtan hira nga andam, bisan kon umabot hiya ha katutnga, o ha kaagahon na!
en: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the middle of the night or toward daybreak.

war: Ngan tigamni ini: kon maaram la an tagbalay han takna han pag-abot han kawatan, diri gud hiya matugot nga sudlon an iya balay.
en: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.

war: Ngan pag-andam man liwat kamo, kay maabot an Anak han Tawo ha takna nga diri niyo ginpapamulat hiya.”
en: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.”

war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Ginoo, iginsusumat mo ba ini nga pananglitan para la ha amon, o para ba ini han ngatanan?”
en: Peter asked, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?”

war: Palaran adto nga surugoon nga hiabtan han iya agaron ha iya pagbalik, nga nagbubuhat hini!
en: It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.

war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod, itatapod han agaron hadto nga surugoon an ngatanan nga iya mga manggad.
en: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

war: “An surugoon nga maaram han karuyag igpabuhat ha iya han iya agaron, kundi diri nag-aandam ngan diri nagbubuhat han karuyag han iya agaron, pagkakastigohon hin damo nga paglatob;
en: “The servant who knows the master’s will and does not get ready or does not do what the master wants will be beaten with many blows.

war: “Kinmanhi ako hin pagsunog han tuna; karuyag ko unta nga magdilaab na ini!
en: “I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

war: May-ada bunyag nga akon kakarawaton nga diri ako mahimumutang tubtob nga matapos ini!
en: But I have a baptism to undergo, and what constraint I am under until it is completed!

war: Naghunahuna ba kamo nga kinmanhi ako hin pagdara hin kalinaw nganhi ha kalibutan? Susumatan ko kamo, diri an kalinaw, kundi an pagkabahinbahin.
en: Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.

war: Tikang yana, mababahin in panimalay nga may lima nga mga sakop, an tulo kontra han duha, ug an duha kontra han tulo.
en: From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.

war: Nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ngadto han mga tawo, “Kon nakita kamo hin dampog nga tikang ha katundan, nasiring kamo dayon, ‘Mauran gud ada,’ ngan nauran manggud.
en: He said to the crowd: “When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, ‘It’s going to rain,’ and it does.

war: Ngan kon naabat kamo nga nahangin an timog, nasiring kamo, ‘Magmamapaso ada,’ ngan nagmamapaso manggud.
en: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.

war: Mga salingkapaw! Nakita la kamo han tuna ngan han langit, ngan nababaro kamo han panahon; kay ano man nga diri kamo nakakahubad han kahulogan hini yana nga panahon?
en: Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don’t know how to interpret this present time?

war: “Kay ano nga diri man kamo magtirutimbang kon ano an angay buhaton?
en: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

war: Susumatan ko kamo, diri ka makakagawas didto, tubtob nga kabaydan mo an multa han kataposan mo nga sintabo.”
en: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.”

war: Hito nga panahon may mga tawo didto nga nagsumat kan Jesus hiunong han mga taga-Galilea nga ginpamatay ni Pilato samtang naghahalad hira ngadto han Dyos.
en: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

war: Diri! Susumatan ko kamo nga kon diri kamo bumaya han iyo mga sala, mapatay kamo ngatanan sugad ha ira.
en: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

war: Diri! Susumatan ko kamo nga kon diri kamo bumaya han iyo mga sala, mapatay kamo ngatanan sugad ha ira.”
en: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”

war: Ngan nagsumat ha ira hi Jesus hini nga pananglitan: “May hadto usa ka tawo nga may kahoy nga igos nga naturok ha iya uma. Nakadto hiya hin pamiling han bunga, kundi waray makaagi.
en: Then he told this parable: “A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.

war: Kundi binmaton an magbarantay, ‘Ayaw la pagpudla; pahagosa ta anay hin usa ka tuig. Liliboton ko hin pag-ukab ngan bubutangan ko hin abuno.
en: “ ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone for one more year, and I’ll dig around it and fertilize it.

war: Manggad nala bumunga han sunod nga tuig; kay kon diri pa, amo na in pagpudla naton.’”
en: If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.’ ”

war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nagtutdo hi Jesus didto hin usa nga sinagoga.
en: On a Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,

war: Nakadto in usa nga babaye nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan 18 na ka tuig an iya kasakit. Nakaob na gud hiya, ngan makuri na gud hiya makatadong.
en: and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

war: Han paghikit-i ha iya ni Jesus, ginsiring hiya, “Babaye, talwas ka na han imo sakit!”
en: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, “Woman, you are set free from your infirmity.”

war: Idinuon ni Jesus an iya mga kamot ha iya, ngan nakatadong hiya dayon, ngan nagdayaw hiya han Dyos.
en: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.

war: Yana, iini in tulin ni Abraham nga gingapos ni Satanas sulod hin 18 na ka tuig; diri ba hiya huhubaran han iya mga gapos ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”
en: Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?”

war: Tungod hini nga iya baton naawod an mga kaaway ni Jesus, samtang an ngatanan nga mga tawo nalipay tungod han ngatanan nga urosahon nga mga butang nga iya ginbuhat.
en: When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.

war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Ano an akon itatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?
en: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?

war: Nagpakiana liwat hi Jesus, “Ano an akon itatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?
en: Again he asked, “What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?

war: Sugad ini hin patubo nga kinukuha hin usa nga babaye ngan isinasakot hin usa ka takos nga harina, tubtob han pagtubo han bug-os nga minasa.”
en: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”

war: Naglatas hi Jesus ha mga bungto ngan mga baryo, ngan nagtutdo samtang tipakadto hiya ha Jerusalem.
en: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.

war: May nagpakiana ha iya, “Tinuod ba nga gutiay la an matatalwas?” Ginbaton hira ni Jesus,
en: Someone asked him, “Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?” He said to them,

war: “Tilingohaa niyo hin pagsulod han haligot nga porta, kay susumatan ko kamo nga damo in karuyag sumulod, kundi diri makakahimo.
en: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.

war: Onina mabaton kamo, ‘Nagsasaro ngani kita, ngan nagtutdo ka ngani didto han amon bungto!’
en: “Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’

war: Masiring liwat hiya, ‘Diri gud ako maaram kon diin kamo tikang. Iwas kamo ha akon, kamo ngatanan nga maghuka nga mga tawo!’
en: “But he will reply, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!’

war: Maabot in mga tawo tikang ha sinirangan ug katundan, ha amihanan ug timogan, ngan matangka ha lamesa didto han Ginhadian han Dyos.
en: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.

war: Onina may mauuna nga nauorhe yana, ngan may mauorhe nga nauuna yana.”
en: Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last.”

war: Hito ngahaw nga takna, kinmadto kan Jesus in mga Parisiyo ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Kinahanglan gumawas ka dinhe ngan kumadto ha iba nga dapit, kay karuyag ni Herodes hin pagpatay ha imo.”
en: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, “Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you.”

war: Kundi kinahanglan magpadayon ako han akon paglakat yana, buwas, ngan sangbuwas; kay diri gud mahihimo nga mamatay in usa nga manaragna labot dinhe ha Jerusalem.
en: In any case, I must press on today and tomorrow and the next day—for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!

war: Yana babayaan na an imo Templo. Susumatan ko ikaw, diri ka na makita ha akon tubtob nga magsiring ka, ‘Dayawon han Dyos hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo.’”
en: Look, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”

war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kinmadto hi Jesus hin pagkaon ha balay hin usa nga tinahod nga Parisiyo, ngan gin-ininaw hiya han mga tawo.
en: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.

war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in tawo nga nanhuhubag an mga bitiis ngan mga butkon.
en: There in front of him was a man suffering from abnormal swelling of his body.

war: Ngan nagyakan hi Jesus ngan nagpakiana han mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan han mga Parisiyo, “Natugot ba an aton Balaod hin pagtambal ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”
en: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”

war: Kundi waray hira pag-aringasa. Kinaptan ni Jesus an tawo, gintambal, ngan ginpalakat hiya.
en: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him on his way.

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kon may-ada niyo anak o baka nga mahinabo hin kahulog ngadto hin atabay ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway, diri ba niyo kukuhaon dayon hito ngahaw nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”
en: Then he asked them, “If one of you has a child or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull it out?”

war: Kundi waray hira makabaton ha iya hiunong hini.
en: And they had nothing to say.

war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus nga an mga dinapit nagpipili han gimaupayi nga mga lingkoran, sanglit iginsumat niya ini nga pananglitan ha ira ngatanan:
en: When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:

war: “Kon dapiton kamo ngadto hin kombite hin pagkasal, ayaw paglingkod didto han syahan ug gimamaupayi nga lingkoran. Bangin may gindapit nga mas dungganan pa kay ha imo,
en: “When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.

war: ngan masiring ha imo an nagdapit ha iyo nga duha, ‘Asay hiya palingkora hini nga lingkoran.’ Niyan maawod ka ngan malingkod ka didto han giuubosi nga lingkoran.
en: If so, the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, ‘Give this person your seat.’ Then, humiliated, you will have to take the least important place.

war: Kay adton nagpapadako han iya kalugaringon pauubson; ngan adton magpaubos han iya kalugaringon padadakoon.”
en: For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”

war: Kundi, kon mananagtawo ka asay lugod dapita an mga kablas, an mga lulid, an mga piay, ngan an mga buta.
en: But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,

war: Ngan magmamalipayon ka, kay diri man hira makakabalos ha imo. Babaloson ka han Dyos kon mabanhaw na an mag-upay nga mga tawo.”
en: and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”

war: Nakabati hini in usa han mga nalingkod ha lamesa, ngan nagsiring kan Jesus, “Pagkapalaran hadton mga malingkod ha kombite didto han Ginhadian han Dyos!”
en: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is the one who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “May-ada hadto tawo nga nagdapit hin damo nga mga tawo ngadto han iya dako nga kombite.
en: Jesus replied: “A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.

war: Ha takna nga andam na an kombite, ginsugo niya an iya surugoon hin pagsumat han iya mga gindapit nga mapakadto na, kay andam na an ngatanan.
en: At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’

war: Nagsiring an ikaduha, ‘Nakapalit ako hin lima ka padis nga baka ngan tikadto na ako kay sasarihan ko hin paggamit. Pasayloa na la ako.’
en: “Another said, ‘I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I’m on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.’

war: Nagsiring in lain pa, ‘Bag-o pa la ako nga nakaasawa, ngan tungod hini, diri ako makakakadto.’
en: “Still another said, ‘I just got married, so I can’t come.’

war: Waray pag-iha nagsiring an surugoon, ‘Natuman na an imo sugo, kundi may mga tarangkaan pa.’
en: “ ‘Sir,’ the servant said, ‘what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.’

war: Sanglit nagsiring an agaron ha iya surugoon, ‘Kadto na ha kadalanan ngan mga aragian ha gawas han bungto, ngan pakanhia gud an mga tawo, basi mapuno an akon balay.
en: “Then the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the roads and country lanes and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.

war: Susumatan ko kamo ngatanan, nga waray hadton mga dinapit makakatilaw han akon panagtawo!’”
en: I tell you, not one of those who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.’ ”

war: Binmunyog kan Jesus in damo gud nga mga tawo. Inatubang hira ni Jesus ngan sidngon,
en: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:

war: Diri mahihimo nga akon tinun-an an bisan hin-o nga diri magpas-an han iya kalugaringon nga kros ngan sumunod ha akon.
en: And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

war: Kay kon diri sugaron hini, diri niya mahuhuman an lantawan, katapos niya igpahimutang an patukoran, ngan pagtitinawaan hiya han ngatanan nga makita hini nga kasugaran.
en: For if you lay the foundation and are not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule you,

war: Masiring hira, ‘Maupay la ini nga tawo hin pagtikang, diri ngay-an maaram hin paghuman!’
en: saying, ‘This person began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

war: Kay kon waray, kinahanglan magpadara hiya hin mga tinaporan hin pakigkita han pangontra nga hadi, basi samtang hirayo pa hiya magsarabot na la hin paagi nga mahusay ug malinawon.
en: If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.

war: Ha amo nga paagi,” gintapos ni Jesus, “waray ha iyo mahihimo nga akon tinun-an, gawas kon isalikway niya an ngatanan nga iya mga butang.
en: In the same way, those of you who do not give up everything you have cannot be my disciples.

war: “Maupay an asin, kundi kon magmatab-ang na, waray nagud paagi nga mahibalik an iya kapag-ad.
en: “Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

war: Diri na ini maupay para ha tuna o magamit para hin pag-abuno; gabay na la ilabog. Sanglit, pamati kamo kon may niyo mga durunggan!”
en: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

war: Usa ka panahon hinmarani hin pamati kan Jesus in damo nga mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga makasasala.
en: Now the tax collectors and sinners were all gathering around to hear Jesus.

war: Nagtikang pagngurutob an mga Parisiyo ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Nakarawat man ini nga tawo hin mga makasasala, ngan nakikigsaro pa ngani ha ira!”
en: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”

war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hini nga pananglitan:
en: Then Jesus told them this parable:

war: Kon hiagian na ini niya, malipayon na hiya, ngan papas-anon ini niya,
en: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders

war: Kon iya hiagian, tatawagon niya an iya kasangkayan ngan mga kahigrani ngan sisidngon niya, ‘Malipayon ako hin duro nga hin-agian ko an akon nawara nga kwarta! Pagsaurog kita!’
en: And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.’

war: Ha amo nga paagi, susumatan ko kamo, nalilipay an mga anghel han Dyos, tungod hin usa nga makasasala nga nabaya na han sala.”
en: In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring, “May hadto usa ka tawo nga may-ada duha nga anak nga lalake.
en: Jesus continued: “There was a man who had two sons.

war: Nagsiring ha iya an manghod, ‘Tatay, tagi na ako yana han akon malon han mga hiagi.’ Sanglit ginbahin han tawo an iya mga hiagi ngan ihatag ngadto han duha niya nga anak.
en: The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.

war: Gingasto niya an ngatanan nga iya dara. Dinmuroy nga inmabot in dako nga gutom didto hadto nga dapit, ngan nawarayan hiya bisan ano.
en: After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.

war: Sanglit kinmadto hiya hin pagtrabaho didto hin usa han mga tuminungnong hadto nga tuna ngan ginsugo hiya ngadto ha uma para hin pagmangno hin kababoyan.
en: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.

war: Karuyag unta niya hin pagkaon han itinutubong han kababoyan, kundi waray man nahatag ha iya hin ano man nga pagkaon.
en: He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

war: Mabangon ako ngan makadto han akon tatay ngan masiring, “Tatay, nakasala ako han Dyos ngan ha imo.
en: I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

war: Diri na ako takos nga isipon pa nga imo anak. Isipa na la ako nga usa han imo mga surugoon.” ’
en: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’

war: Ngan nagsiring an anak, ‘Tatay, nakasala ako han Dyos ngan ha imo, sanglit diri na ako takos isipon pa nga imo anak.’
en: “The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

war: Katapos, kuhaa ngan ihawa niyo an pinatambok nga nati nga baka, ngan pagkombite kita!
en: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let’s have a feast and celebrate.

war: Kay patay na ini nga akon anak, kundi yana buhi na hiya; nawara hiya, kundi yana hin-agian na hiya.’ Ngan nagtikang hira pagkalipay.
en: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ So they began to celebrate.

war: “Hito nga takna, nakadto ha uma an magurang nga anak. Han pag-uli na niya, han hiraniay na hiya han balay, hinbatian niya an tukar ngan sarayaw.
en: “Meanwhile, the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.

war: Gintawag niya in usa han mga surugoon ngan nagpakiana ha iya, ‘Ano ini nga rugyaw?’
en: So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.

war: Duro an kapungot han magurang nga bugto, sanglit waray hiya sumulod han balay; ginmawas an amay niya ngan ginhangyo nga sumulod hiya.
en: “The older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.

war: Kundi ginkaragan hini nga imo anak an ngatanan mo nga hiagi ha maraot nga kinabuhi, ngan ha iya pag-oli, asay mo lugod gin-ihawan han pinatambok nga nati nga baka!’
en: But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!’

war: Nagbaton ha iya an amay, ‘Anak ko, dayuday ko ikaw nga kaupod dinhe, ngan imo an ngatanan nga akon mga butang.
en: “ ‘My son,’ the father said, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

war: Kundi kinahanglan maglipay ngan magrayhak kita, kay namatay ini nga imo bugto, kundi yana buhi na hiya; nawara, kundi yana hin-agian na hiya.’”
en: But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ ”

war: Yana, maaram ako kon ano an akon bubuhaton, basi kon mawaray na ako trabaho, mamamay-ada ako kasangkayan nga makarawat ha akon ha ira panimalay.’
en: I know what I’ll do so that, when I lose my job here, people will welcome me into their houses.’

war: Sanglit iginpatawag niya an ngatanan nga nakautang han iya agaron. Ginsiring niya an syahan, ‘Pira an imo nautang han akon agaron?’
en: “So he called in each one of his master’s debtors. He asked the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’

war: ‘Usa ka gatos ka baril nga lana hin olibo,’ nagbaton hiya. Nagsiring ha iya an tinaporan, ‘Iya, iini an imo resibo. Lingkod ngan liwata. Ibutang nga 50 la ka baril.’
en: “ ‘Nine hundred gallons of olive oil,’ he replied. “The manager told him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred and fifty.’

war: Adton kasasarigan hin gudti nga butang, kasasarigan man liwat hin dagko nga mga butang; adton diri tangkod hin talagudti nga butang, diri liwat tangkod ha mga dagko nga butang.
en: “Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

war: Sanglit kon diri ka kasarigan hin pagdumara hin manggad nga kalibutanon, uunanhon hin pagtapori ha imo hin matuod nga manggad?
en: So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

war: Ngan kon diri ka kasarigan han mga butang hin iba, hin-o man in mahatag ha imo han imo kalugaringon nga mga butang?
en: And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else’s property, who will give you property of your own?

war: Hinbatian han mga Parisiyo ini ngatanan, ngan gintinawaan la nira hi Jesus, kay makisalapi hira.
en: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.

war: Kundi masarusayon pa an pagpapas han langit ngan han tuna kay han pagkawara han gigugutiayi nga bahin han Balaod.
en: It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.

war: “May-ada hadto usa nga riko nga nagbabado han gimamahali nga mga panapton ngan nagpapatakas han iya mga bahandi ha adlaw-adlaw.
en: “There was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.

war: May-ada man liwat usa nga makililimos nga Lazaro an ngaran, nga lukop an iya lawas hin mga katol. Agsob hiya dad-on ngadto han porta han riko,
en: At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores

war: kay hingyap niya nga makakaon hiya han mga natataktak nga pagkaon tikang han lamesa han riko. Nadaop bisan an mga ayam hin pagdilap han iya mga kaduntan.
en: and longing to eat what fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.

war: Namatay an makililimos ngan gindara han anghel ngadto ha sapit ni Abraham, didto han kombite ha langit. Namatay man liwat an riko ngan iginlubong,
en: “The time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.

war: ngan nahingadto hiya ha dako nga kasakitan ha impyerno. Paghangad niya, hinkit-an niya hi Abraham hirayo ha iya, ngan nasapit hi Lazaro ha iya.
en: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.

war: Nagsiring an riko, ‘Amay, kon amo man ito, nakikimalooy ako ha imo nga sugoon mo hi Lazaro ngadto ha balay han akon amay,
en: “He answered, ‘Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my family,

war: diin may-ada ko lima pa nga kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an. Pakadtoa gad hiya hin pagpahimangno ha ira, basi diri liwat hira mahinganhi hini nga dapit han kasakitan.’
en: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.’

war: Nagsiring hi Abraham, ‘Aadto na hira Moises ngan an mga manaragna nga magpapahimangno han imo kabugtoan. Kinahanglan mamati hira han ira igsisiring.’
en: “Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.’

war: Nagbaton an riko, ‘Diri pa ito igo, amay nga Abraham! Kundi kon may mabanhaw ngan kumadto ha ira, mabaya gud hira han ira mga sala.’
en: “ ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.’

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Abraham, ‘Kon diri hira mamati kan Moises ngan han mga manaragna, diri hira malulukmay, bisan pa kon may mabanhaw tikang han mga minatay.’”
en: “He said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.’ ”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Mahinanabo manta in mga butang nga makakapasala han tawo; kundi kairo han tawo nga magigin tinikangan han sala!
en: Jesus said to his disciples: “Things that cause people to stumble are bound to come, but woe to anyone through whom they come.

war: Mauruupay pa ha iya kon higtan an iya liog hin dako nga gilingan nga bato, ngan itunod hiya ngadto ha dagat, kay nga matinikangan hiya hin pakasala hini nga gudtiay nga kabataan.
en: It would be better for them to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.

war: Pagbantay gud kamo! “Kon makasala an imo bugto, sawaya hiya; ngan kon magbasol hiya, pasayloa.
en: So watch yourselves. “If your brother or sister sins against you, rebuke them; and if they repent, forgive them.

war: Kon makasala hiya ha imo makapito ha usa ka adlaw, ngan ha kada niya pakakasala, makada ha imo ngan masiring nga nagbabasol hiya, kinahanglan pasayloon mo hiya.”
en: Even if they sin against you seven times in a day and seven times come back to you saying ‘I repent,’ you must forgive them.”

war: Nagsiring ha Ginoo an mga apostol, “Dugangi gad an amon pagtoo.”
en: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”

war: “Pananglit usa ha iyo may surugoon nga nag-aarado o nagmamangno hin mga karnero. Kon naabot hiya tikang ha uma, nasiring ba kamo ha iya, ‘Dagmit ngan kaona an imo pagkaon?’
en: “Suppose one of you has a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Will he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, ‘Come along now and sit down to eat’?

war: Diri angay an surugoon nga magpasalamat tungod han iya pagsugot, di ba?
en: Will he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?

war: Amo man ito ha iyo; kon ginbuhat na niyo an ngatanan nga iginpabuhat ha iyo, masiring kamo, ‘Mga surugoon la kami; gintuman la namon an amon katungdanan.’”
en: So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’ ”

war: Han tipakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem, nag-agi hiya ha pag-ultan han Samaria ug Galilea.
en: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

war: Tipakadto hiya hin usa nga baryo nga tapoon hiya hin napulo nga mga sanlahon. Tay-aw la ini hira.
en: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance

war: Naggoliat hira hin pagsiring, “Jesus! Agaron! Kalooyi gad kami!”
en: and called out in a loud voice, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”

war: Hinkit-an hira ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Kadto na, ngan pausisa kamo han kapadian.” Nalinisan hira han tipakadto pa la hira.
en: When he saw them, he said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they went, they were cleansed.

war: Usa ha ira, han pakakita nga upay na hiya, binmalik nga nagdadayaw han Dyos hin dako nga tingog.
en: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.

war: Hinmapa hiya ha tiilan ni Jesus hin pagpasalamat ha iya. Usa hiya nga Samaritano.
en: He threw himself at Jesus’ feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.

war: Nagyakan hi Jesus, “Napulo man adto hira nga nagkalilinisan; hain naman an siyam?
en: Jesus asked, “Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?

war: Kay ano nga ini la nga diri dinhianon an binmalik hin pagpasalamat han Dyos?”
en: Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Buhat ngan lakat. An imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.”
en: Then he said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well.”

war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus in pira nga mga Parisiyo kon san-o maabot an Ginhadian han Dyos. Nagbaton hiya, “Diri maabot an Ginhadian han Dyos hin paagi nga makikita.
en: Once, on being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The coming of the kingdom of God is not something that can be observed,

war: Waray masiring, ‘Kitaa, hahani na!’ o ‘Aadto na!’ kay aada ha sakob niyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: nor will people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is,’ because the kingdom of God is in your midst.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha mga tinun-an, “Maabot in panahon nga maungara kamo nga makakita kamo hin usa han mga adlaw han Anak han Tawo, kundi diri kamo makakakita hini.
en: Then he said to his disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

war: May-ada ha ira masiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, aadto didto!’ o, ‘Kitaa, aadi didi!’ Kundi ayaw kamo pagkadto hin pamiling hito.
en: People will tell you, ‘There he is!’ or ‘Here he is!’ Do not go running off after them.

war: Sugad han kikidlat nga naidlap pataboktabok han langit tikang ha usa nga bahin hini ngadto han luyo, amo man liwat ini an pag-abot han Anak han Tawo.
en: For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.

war: Kundi kinahanglan mag-antos hiya anay ngan igsalikway han mga tawo hini nga panahon.
en: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

war: Sugad an nahinabo han panahon ni Noe amo man an mahinanabo kon umabot na an Anak han Tawo.
en: “Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.

war: Masusugad liwat ini han panahon ni Lot. Nagpadayon an ngatanan hin pagpinangaon ug pag-ininom; pagpinamalit ngan pagpinamaligya, pagpinananom ngan pagpinanmalay.
en: “It was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

war: Ha adlaw han paggawas ni Lot ha Sodoma, inmuran hin kalayo ug asupre tikang ha langit, nga amo an nakamatay ha ira ngatanan.
en: But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

war: Amo liwat ini an mahinanabo kon magpadayag na an Anak han Tawo.
en: “It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

war: Hinumdomi niyo an asawa ni Lot!
en: Remember Lot’s wife!

war: An nagtitingoha hin pagtalwas han iya kalugaringon nga kinabuhi ini mawawara ha iya; kundi adton kawad-an han iya kinabuhi matatalwas.
en: Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life will preserve it.

war: Susumatan ko kamo: hito nga gab-i, makaturog in duha ka tawo ha usa nga higdaan kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.
en: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.

war: Magbubulig hin paggiling in duha nga babaye; kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.”
en: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left.”

war: Nagpakiana an mga tinun-an ha iya, “Diin man, Ginoo?” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Magtititirok an mga agila kon hain an patay nga lawas.”
en: “Where, Lord?” they asked. He replied, “Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather.”

war: Niyan, nagsumat hin pananglitan hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an hin pagtutdo ha ira nga kinahanglanon an dayuday nga pag-ampo, ngan diri gud magturaw.
en: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.

war: “May-ada hadto usa nga maghurukom hin usa nga bungto, nga waray pagkahadlok han Dyos ngan waray pagtahod han mga tawo.
en: He said: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought.

war: Ngan may-ada balo nga babaye hito ngahaw nga bungto, nga nagkikinadto hin pakimalooy ha iya: ‘Buligi gad ako kontra han akon kaaway!’
en: And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, ‘Grant me justice against my adversary.’

war: Hin maiha nga panahon ginpasibay-an la ini han maghurukom, kundi ha kataposan nagsiring an maghurukom ha iya ngahaw, ‘Bisan kon waray ako pagkahadlok han Dyos o pagtahod han mga tawo,
en: “For some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or care what people think,

war: Ngan nagpadayon an Ginoo, “Paghunahunaa daw an iginsiring hadto nga maraot nga maghurukom.
en: And the Lord said, “Listen to what the unjust judge says.

war: Niyan, kon maghukom an Dyos diri ba hiya maugop han iya kalugaringon nga mga tawo nga nasangpit ha iya adlaw gab-i hin pakibulig? Maglalangan ba hiya hin pagbulig ha ira?
en: And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?

war: Susumatan ko kamo, maugop hiya ha ira, ngan bubuhaton ito dayon niya. Kundi kon bumalik na an Anak han Tawo, makakaagi ba hiya hin pagtoo dinhe ha tuna?”
en: I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

war: Iginsumat liwat ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan ha mga tawo nga natapod ha ira kalugaringon nga kamaupay, ngan nagtatamay han iba:
en: To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everyone else, Jesus told this parable:

war: “Kinmadto ha Templo hin pag-ampo in duha ka tawo; Parisiyo an usa, ngan parasukot hin buhis an ikaduha.
en: “Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

war: Nagpupuasa ako duha ka adlaw kada semana, ngan nahatag ako ha imo han ikanapulo nga bahin han ngatanan ko nga hiagi.’
en: I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’

war: Kundi gintawag ni Jesus an kabataan ngada ha iya, ngan nagsiring, “Padaopa ha akon an kabataan, ngan ayaw hira pagdid-i, kay an Ginhadian han Dyos para la hadton sugad ha ira.
en: But Jesus called the children to him and said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

war: Tigamni ini: an diri kumarawat han Ginhadian han Dyos sugad hin bata, diri gud makakasulod han Ginhadian.”
en: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus in usa nga pangulo nga Judiyo, “Maupay nga Magturutdo, ano an sadang ko buhaton basi makakarawat ako han dayon nga kinabuhi?”
en: A certain ruler asked him, “Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

war: Nagpakiana man hi Jesus, “Kay ano hin pagtawga mo ha akon nga maupay? Waray iba nga maupay labot han Dyos.
en: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.

war: Maaram ka man han mga sugo: ‘Diri ka manlibog; diri ka magpatay; diri ka mangawat; diri ka magbuwa; tahoron mo an imo mga kag-anak.’”
en: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.’ ”

war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Gintuman ko na ini ngatanan nga mga sugo tikang pa han akon kabata.”
en: “All these I have kept since I was a boy,” he said.

war: Kundi han pakabati niya hini, duro an iya kasubo, kay riko hiya hin duro.
en: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was very wealthy.

war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus nga nagmabidoon hiya, ngan nagsiring, “Kamakuri para hin riko nga mga tawo hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!
en: Jesus looked at him and said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

war: Labaw pa kamakuri para hin riko pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos, kay hin kamelyo pagsuhot ha tanogan hin dagom.”
en: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”

war: Nagpakiana an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha iya, “Kon amo ini, hin-o man ngay-an in matatalwas?”
en: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Nahihimo han Dyos an diri nahihimo han mga tawo.”
en: Jesus replied, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Kitaa! Ginbayaan na namon an amon mga panimalay ha pagsunod ha imo.”
en: Peter said to him, “We have left all we had to follow you!”

war: Itutubyan hiya ha mga Hentil nga magbibiaybiay ha iya, magyuyubit, ngan maglulura ha iya.
en: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him and spit on him;

war: Paglalatobon ngan pagpapatayon hiya nira, kundi mababanhaw hiya ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”
en: they will flog him and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

war: Kundi waray makasabot an mga tinun-an hin bisan usa hini nga mga butang. An kahulogan han mga pulong gintago ha ira, ngan waray hira makasabot kon ano an ginyinakan ni Jesus.
en: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.

war: Tikahirani na hi Jesus ha Jerico, ngan nakada ha ligid han dalan in usa nga buta nga nalingkod hin pakilimos.
en: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

war: Han pakabati niya han kadam-an nga nalabay, nagpakiana hiya, “Ano ba ini?”
en: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.

war: Ginsumatan hiya nga nalabay hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.
en: They told him, “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by.”

war: Naggoliat hiya, “Jesus! Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad ako!”
en: He called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

war: Nasinahan hiya han mga tawo nga nag-uuna, ngan ginpahilom hiya. Kundi dinmugang lugod hiya hin paggoliat, “Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad ako!”
en: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

war: Sanglit inmukoy hi Jesus ngan nagsugo nga dad-on an buta ngada ha iya. Han pagdaop na han buta, nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya,
en: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,

war: “Ano an imo karuyag nga buhaton ko ha imo?” Nagbaton hiya, “Karuyag ko nga makakita na liwat ako.”
en: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see,” he replied.

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Makakakita ka na! An imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.”
en: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight; your faith has healed you.”

war: Nakakita hiya dayon, nagsunod hiya kan Jesus, ngan nagpasalamat han Dyos. Han pakakita hini han kadam-an, nagdayaw hira ngatanan han Dyos.
en: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus pagsulod ha Jerico, ngan naglatas hiya han bungto.
en: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

war: May didto riko nga labaw nga parasugot hin buhis, nga Saqueo an ngaran.
en: A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.

war: Nagtingoha hiya hin pagkita kon hin-o hi Jesus, kundi habuboay hiya nga tawo, sanglit waray hiya makakita kan Jesus tungod han damo nga mga tawo.
en: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but because he was short he could not see over the crowd.

war: Sanglit nagdalagan hiya hin pag-una han mga tawo ngan nagsaka hiya hin kahoy nga sikomoro, basi makakita hiya kan Jesus nga malabay.
en: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.

war: Han pag-abot ni Jesus ngadto hito nga dapit, hinmangad hiya ngan nagsiring kan Saqueo, “Dagmit hin paglusad, Saqueo, kay kinahanglan humapit ako ha imo balay yana nga adlaw.”
en: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, “Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today.”

war: Nagdagmit hi Saqueo hin paglusad ngan ginkarawat niya nga malipayon hi Jesus.
en: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.

war: Nagtikang hin pagngurotob an ngatanan nga nakakita hini, “Sinmulod ini nga tawo sugad nga bisita ha balay hin makasasala!”
en: All the people saw this and began to mutter, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinner.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Inmabot an katalwasan ngada hini nga balay yana nga adlaw, kay tulin man liwat ni Abraham ini nga tawo.
en: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.

war: Kay kinmanhi an Anak han Tawo hin pagbiling ngan pagtalwas han mga nagkawawara.”
en: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”

war: Sanglit nagsiring hiya, “May-ada hadto usa nga harangdon nga tawo nga kinmadto ha hirayo nga tuna basi himoon nga hadi, ngan kahuman, nakahunahuna hin pag-oli liwat.
en: He said: “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.

war: Ugsa hiya lumakat, gintawag anay niya an iya napulo nga mga surugoon, ngan gintagan an tagsa ha ira hin kwarta nga bulawan, ngan gintugon hira, ‘Igpatigayon niyo ini tubtob han akon pagbalik.’
en: So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Put this money to work,’ he said, ‘until I come back.’

war: Kundi, dinmiri gud ha iya an iya mga taghimungto, sanglit nagpalanat hira hin mga sinugo nga masiring, ‘Diri namon karuyag nga ini nga tawo an maghadi ha amon.’
en: “But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be our king.’

war: Inmabot an syahan ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, nakaganansya ako hin napulo nga kwarta nga bulawan tikang han usa nga iginhatag mo ha akon.’
en: “The first one came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more.’

war: Nagsiring hiya, ‘Maupay nga buhat, maupay ka nga surugoon. Itatapod ko ha imo an pagdumara hin napulo nga mga syudad, kay matinumanon ka han gudti nga mga butang.’
en: “ ‘Well done, my good servant!’ his master replied. ‘Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.’

war: Inmabot an ikaduha nga surugoon ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, nakaganansya ako hin lima nga kwarta nga bulawan tikang han usa nga iginhatag mo ha akon.’
en: “The second came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned five more.’

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha iya, ‘Itatapod ko ha imo an pagdumara hin lima nga mga syudad.’
en: “His master answered, ‘You take charge of five cities.’

war: Inmabot in lain pa nga surugoon ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, iini an imo kwarta nga bulawan. Ginputos ko ini hin panyo.
en: “Then another servant came and said, ‘Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.

war: Nahadlok ako ha imo kay makuri ka nga tawo. Kinukuha mo an diri imo, ngan nag-aani ka han waray mo igtanom.’
en: I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.’

war: Niyan, kay ano nga waray mo lugod ibutang an akon kwarta ha bangko? Pagbalik ko, makakarawat ko unta an kwarta upod na an patubo.’
en: Why then didn’t you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?’

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha mga nagkakatukdaw didto, ‘Kuhaa ha iya an kwarta nga bulawan, ngan ihatag ha surugoon nga may napulo nga kwarta.’
en: “Then he said to those standing by, ‘Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’

war: Nagsiring hira ha iya, ‘Agaron, may-ada na hiya napulo nga kwarta.’
en: “ ‘Sir,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’

war: Nagbaton hiya, ‘Susumatan ko kamo nga tatagan hin labaw pa an ngatanan nga may-ada na; kundi kukuhaon tikang ha iya nga waray, bisan pa an gutiay nga aada ha iya.
en: “He replied, ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what they have will be taken away.

war: Niyan, mahitungod hini nga akon mga kaaway, nga waray maruyag nga maghadi ako ha ira: dad-a hira nganhi, ngan pamataya hira ha akon atubangan!’”
en: But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and kill them in front of me.’ ”

war: Nagsiring hini hi Jesus, ngan nagpadayon hiya ngadto ha Jerusalem, ngan nag-una hiya ha ira.
en: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

war: Han pag-abot niya hirani ha Betfage ug Betania, ha bukid han mga Olibo, ginpauna niya in duha nga mga tinun-an,
en: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,

war: Kon may magpakiana ha iyo, ‘Kay ano nga iyo man ito ginhuhubaran?’ sidnga hiya, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Agaron.’”
en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”

war: Nagkalakat hira ngan nakita nira sugad gud han iginsiring ni Jesus ha ira.
en: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.

war: Han ginhuhubad na nira an nati nga asno, nagpakiana ha ira an mga tag-iya, “Kay ano nga iyo man ito ginhuhubaran?”
en: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

war: Nagbaton hira, “Ginkikinahanglan ini han Agaron,”
en: They replied, “The Lord needs it.”

war: ngan gintugwayan nira an nati ngadto kan Jesus. Niyan, iginhapin nira an ira mga kurugpos ha bungkog han hayop, ngan ginbuligan nira hi Jesus hin pagsakay.
en: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.

war: Han pagtipaunhan niya, pinanmitad nira ha dalan an ira mga kurugpos.
en: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.

war: “Dayawon han Dyos an hadi nga makanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo! Kalinaw ha langit, himaya sa Dyos ha kahitas-an!”
en: “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”

war: Niyan nagsiring kan Jesus in pira nga mga Parisiyo tikang dida han kadam-an nga tawo, “Magturutdo, sawaya an imo mga tinun-an nga diri hira mag-inaringasa.”
en: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo: kon maghilom ngani hira, an mga bato ngahaw an mangongogliat.”
en: “I tell you,” he replied, “if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out.”

war: Han hirani na hi Jesus ngan han pakakita niya han syudad han Jerusalem, nagtangis hiya,
en: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it

war: ngan nagsiring, “Kon maaram ka la yana, kon ano an kinahanglan para han kalinaw! Kundi yana diri ka hini makakakita.
en: and said, “If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace—but now it is hidden from your eyes.

war: Maabot in panahon nga paglilibotan ka han imo mga kaaway, pag-uulangon ka, ngan susulongon ka nira ha ngatanan nga dapit.
en: The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.

war: Sinmulod hi Jesus han Templo ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtabog han mga nanmamaligya,
en: When Jesus entered the temple courts, he began to drive out those who were selling.

war: ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nahisurat ha Kasuratan nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Tatawgon nga balay hin pag-ampo an akon balay.’ Kundi ginhimo niyo ito nga tagoan hin mga kawatan!”
en: “It is written,” he said to them, “ ‘My house will be a house of prayer’ ; but you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”

war: Nagtutdo hi Jesus ha Templo adlaw-adlaw. Karuyag nga patayon hiya han mga puno han kapadian, han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan han mga pangulo han mga tawo.
en: Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.

war: Kundi waray hira makakaagi hin higayon hin pagbuhat han ira karuyag, kay naawil pagpinamati ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga diri gud nira karuyag hilikatan in bisan usa ka pulong.
en: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.

war: Usa ka adlaw, han nagtututdo hi Jesus han mga tawo ha Templo, ngan nagwawali han Maupay nga Sumat, inmabot an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, kaupod han katigurangan,
en: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.

war: ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Sumati daw kami, ano an imo katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang? Hin-o an naghatag ha imo hin katungod hin pagbuhat hini?”
en: “Tell us by what authority you are doing these things,” they said. “Who gave you this authority?”

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Mapakiana man ako ha iyo. Sumati daw ako,
en: He replied, “I will also ask you a question. Tell me:

war: tikang ba sa Dyos an katungod ni Juan hin pagbunyag, o tikang ba han mga tawo?”
en: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin?”
