war: Ira ini anay gintirutimbang hin pagsiring, “Ano man an aton igsisiring? Kon magsiring kita, ‘Tikang sa Dyos,’ masiring hiya, ‘Kay ano man nga waray kamo tumoo kan Juan?’
en: They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

war: Kundi kon sumiring kita, ‘Tikang han mga tawo,’ pagbabatohon kita hini nga mga tawo dinhe, kay natoo gud hira nga manaragna hi Juan.”
en: But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

war: Sanglit nagbaton hira, “Diri kami maaram kon diin adto tikang.”
en: So they answered, “We don’t know where it was from.”

war: Ngan nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Sanglit, diri man ako magsusumat ha iyo, kon ano nga katungod an pagbuhat ko hini nga mga butang.”
en: Jesus said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”

war: Sanglit nagsugo hiya hin lain nga oripon, kundi gintubal liwat ini, ginpakaalohan pa, ngan ginpaoli nga waray liwat dara.
en: He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.

war: Niyan nagsugo hiya hin ikatulo nga oripon; ginkastigo liwat ini han mga saop, ngan iginlabog ha gawas.
en: He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.

war: Nagsiring an tag-iya han urubasan, ‘Ano ba an akon bubuhaton? Asay ko pakakadtoon an akon kalugaringon nga hinigugma nga anak; maaram ako nga tatahoron hiya nira!’
en: “Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.’

war: Kundi han pakakita han mga saop ha iya, nagsarabot hira, ‘Amo ini an anak han tag-iya. Pataya ta hiya, ngan kita na an tag-iya han urubasan!’
en: “But when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. ‘This is the heir,’ they said. ‘Let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

war: Sanglit iginlabog hiya nira ha gawas han urubasan, ngan ginpatay hiya. “Niyan, ano man an bubuhaton han magtatag-iya han urubasan hini nga mga saop?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.
en: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. “What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

war: “Maabot hiya ngan pamamatayon adto nga mga tawo, ngan itatapod an urubasan ha iba nga mga saop.” Han pakabati hini han mga tawo, nagsiring hira, “Diri la unta ini mahinabo!”
en: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.” When the people heard this, they said, “God forbid!”

war: An ngatanan nga mahulog ngada hini nga bato magkakasasamad, ngan mapipisa an kahulogan hini nga bato.”
en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”

war: Sumati daw kami, supak ba ha aton Balaod an pagbayad ta hin buhis han Emperador ha Roma, o diri?”
en: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

war: Kundi nahisabtan ni Jesus an ira bitik ngan ginsiring hira,
en: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,

war: “Pakitaa daw ako niyo hin kwarta nga salapi. Kanay man ini bayhon ug ngaran nga aanhi hini nga kwarta?” “Kanan Emperador,” nagbaton hira.
en: “Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they replied.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon amo ito, ibayad ha Emperador an kanan Emperador, ngan ibayad man sa Dyos an kanan Dyos.”
en: He said to them, “Then give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

war: Waray gud hira makabitik ha iya hin bisan ano ha atubangan han mga tawo, sanglit hinmilom nala hira, nga nahipausa hira han iya baton.
en: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.

war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in pira nga mga Sadusiyo. (Amo ini hira an nasiring nga waray na pagkabanhaw.) Nagpakiana hira ha iya,
en: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.

war: Niyan, may-ada hadto pito nga magburugto nga kalalaken-an. Nangasawa an gimagugurangi, ngan namatay nga waray anak.
en: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.

war: Ngan pinangasawa han sunod nga manghod an nabalo nga babaye
en: The second

war: ngan niyan han ikatulo nga manghod. Amo gihapon an nahinabo ha ngatanan nga pito—nagkamatay hira nga waray anak.
en: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.

war: Ha kataposan namatay an babaye.
en: Finally, the woman died too.

war: Niyan ha adlaw kon mabanhaw na an mga minatay, kanay man hiya asawa? Kay an pito nga magburugto nangasawa man ha iya.”
en: Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Nag-aasawa an kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an hini nga panahon,
en: Jesus replied, “The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.

war: kundi an kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an nga takos hin pagkabanhaw ha mga minatay ngan pag-ukoy ha panahon nga tiarabot diri na mag-aasawa.
en: But those who are considered worthy of taking part in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,

war: Sugad hira hin mga anghel, ngan diri na mapatay. Mga anak hira han Dyos, kay nabanhaw na hira.
en: and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God’s children, since they are children of the resurrection.

war: Karuyag sidngon hini nga Dyos hiya han mga buhi, diri han mga minatay, kay ha iya buhi an ngatanan.”
en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive.”

war: Nagyakan in pira nga mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Maupay nga pagkabaton, Magturutdo!”
en: Some of the teachers of the law responded, “Well said, teacher!”

war: Ngan waray na hira mangahas hin pagpakiana ha iya hin bisan ano.
en: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Uunanhon hin pakasiring nira nga magigin tulin ni David an Mesiyas?
en: Then Jesus said to them, “Why is it said that the Messiah is the son of David?

war: Kay nasiring man hi David ngahaw, ha basahan han mga Salmo: ‘Nagsiring an Ginoo ngadto han akon Ginoo: Lingkod didi ha akon tuo,
en: David himself declares in the Book of Psalms: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand

war: tubtob nga ibutang ko an imo mga kaaway nga taramakan ha ilarom han imo mga tiil.’
en: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.” ’

war: Gintawag hiya nga ‘Ginoo’ ni David. Sanglit, uunanhon nga magin tulin ni David an Mesiyas?”
en: David calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?”

war: Samtang nanmamati kan Jesus an ngatanan nga mga tawo, nagsiring hiya ha iya mga tinun-an,
en: While all the people were listening, Jesus said to his disciples,

war: An ngatanan siniplatan ni Jesus, ngan kinmita hiya nga an mga riko naghulog han ira mga halad didto han surudlan ha Templo.
en: As Jesus looked up, he saw the rich putting their gifts into the temple treasury.

war: Hinkit-an liwat niya in kablas nga balo nga babaye nga naghulog hin duha la nga sensilyo nga kwarta nga bronse.
en: He also saw a poor widow put in two very small copper coins.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo, nga larulabaw an ginhatag hini nga kablas nga balo kay ha ira ngatanan.
en: “Truly I tell you,” he said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

war: Kay naghalad an iba han sobra la han ira karikohan; kundi hiya, bisan kon kablas hiya, naghatag han ngatanan nga iya kinabubuhian.”
en: All these people gave their gifts out of their wealth; but she out of her poverty put in all she had to live on.”

war: Naghiruhimangraw in pira han mga tinun-an, hiunong han pagkatahom han Templo nga rinayandayanan hin hamili nga mga bato, ngan han mga halad ngadto han Dyos. Nagsiring hi Jesus,
en: Some of his disciples were remarking about how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and with gifts dedicated to God. But Jesus said,

war: “Mahitungod hini ngatanan nga mga butang nga iyo nakikita, maabot in panahon nga waray ngani bisan usa nga bato dinhe nga mahibibilin dida han iya hinmumutangan; titimpagon ini ngatanan.”
en: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one of them will be thrown down.”

war: Nagpakiana hira, “Magturutdo, san-o man ini mahinanabo? Ngan ano man an mga tigaman nga magpapasabot ha amon nga maabot na an panahon nga ini ngatanan matutuman?”
en: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pagbantay, ngan ayaw kamo palimbong. Kay damo in maabot ngan masiring ha akon ngaran, ‘Ako amo hi Cristo!’ ngan ‘Inmabot na an panahon!’ Kundi ayaw kamo pagsunod ha ira.
en: He replied: “Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.

war: Ayaw kahadlok kon bumati kamo hin mga aragway ngan mga kasamokan; kinahanglan mahinabo anay in sugad nga mga butang, kundi diri buot sidngon nga hirani na an kataposan.”
en: When you hear of wars and uprisings, do not be frightened. These things must happen first, but the end will not come right away.”

war: Nagpadayon hiya hin pagsiring, “Mag-aaruaraway an mga nasod, ngan maggigipasulongsulong an mga ginhadian.
en: Then he said to them: “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

war: Magkakaada magpakalilisang nga mga linog, mga kagutom, ngan mga piste ha magkalainlain nga mga dapit; magkakaada magpakaharadlok nga mga butang, ngan dagko nga mga orosahon ha kalangitan.
en: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.

war: Iyo ini higayon hin pagpasangyaw han Maupay nga Sumat.
en: And so you will bear testimony to me.

war: Padig-ona ngadaan an iyo mga hunahuna basi diri kamo mabaraka kon uunanhon niyo hin pagpanalipod han iyo kalugaringon;
en: But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.

war: kay tatagan ko kamo hin mga pulong ngan kinaadman nga waray han iyo mga kaaway makakabaton o makakariwa han iyo igyayakan.
en: For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

war: Igtutubyan kamo han iyo mga kag-anak, kabugtoan, kauropdan, ngan kasangkayan; papatayon ngani an iba ha iyo.
en: You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.

war: Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan tungod ha akon.
en: Everyone will hate you because of me.

war: Kundi waray mawawara bisan usa nga buhok han iyo mga ulo.
en: But not a hair of your head will perish.

war: Pagpadayon kamo hin kamakusog, kay hini nga paagi matatalwas an iyo mga kinabuhi.
en: Stand firm, and you will win life.

war: “Kon kitaon niyo nga ginlilibotan na an Jerusalem hin kasondalohan, hibabaroan niyo nga hirani na an iya pagkapukan.
en: “When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.

war: Niyan kinahanglan kumalagiw ngadto ha kabukiran an mga aadto ha Judea; kinahanglan gumawas na han syudad an aadto ha sakob, ngan kinahanglan diri na sumulod ha syudad an aadto ha huron.
en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.

war: Kay amo na ini ‘An mga Adlaw han Pagkastigo’ basi matuman an ngatanan nga iginsiring han Kasuratan.
en: For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.

war: Manhihiraptay hin kahadlok an mga tawo samtang naghuhulat hira kon ano an mapaabot han bug-os nga tuna; kay masimang ha ira mga agianan an mga kagamhanan ha kahitas-an.
en: People will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.

war: Katapos, mapakita na an Anak han Tawo nga maabot dida hin dampog, may gahom ug himaya.
en: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

war: Kon makakita na kamo nga mahinabo ini nga mga butang, tindog ngan hangad, kay hirani na an iyo katalwasan.”
en: When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

war: Ngan ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hini nga pananglitan: “Hinumdomi an kahoy nga igos ngan an ngatanan nga iba nga mga kahoy.
en: He told them this parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.

war: Kon hikit-an na niyo nga nananaringsing, maaram kamo nga hirani na an panahon han kamapaso.
en: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

war: Ha sugad nga kaagi, kon kumita kamo nga nahinanabo na ini nga mga butang, hibaroi niyo nga tiarabot na an Ginhadian han Dyos.
en: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.

war: “Tigamni ini! Mahinanabo ini ngatanan nga mga butang nga diri pa mapatay an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga buhi yana.
en: “Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

war: Nagpapapas pa an langit ngan an tuna, kundi magpapabilin an akon mga pulong.
en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

war: Kay maabot ini sugad hin bitik ha ngatanan nga mga tawo ha bug-os nga tuna.
en: For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth.

war: Ginamit ni Jesus adto nga mga adlaw hin pagtutdo didto ha Templo, nga ha pagkagab-i, naguwa hiya hin pagpahuway didto ha Bukid han mga Olibo.
en: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,

war: Timprano pa ha kada aga napakadto na ha Templo an ngatanan nga mga tawo hin pamati ha iya.
en: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.

war: Hirani na an Pyesta han Tinapay nga Waray Patubo nga ginngangaranan nga Paglabay.
en: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

war: An mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod nahadlok han mga tawo, sanglit nagtinguha hira hin pagbiling hin paagi hin pagpatay kan Jesus.
en: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

war: Ngan sinmulod hi Satanas kan Judas nga gintatawag nga Iscariote, usa han dose nga mga tinun-an.
en: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.

war: Sanglit kinmadto hiya ngan nakighimangraw han mga puno han kapadian ngan han mga opisyal han gwardya han Templo kon uunanhon niya hin pagtubyan kan Jesus ha ira.
en: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.

war: Nalipay hira ngan nagsaad hin paghatag ha iya hin kwarta.
en: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

war: Inmuyon hi Judas ha ira, ngan nagtikang hiya pamiling hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus, nga diri hibabaroan han mga tawo.
en: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.

war: Inmabot an adlaw nga ig-iihaw han nati nga mga karnero para han Paglabay nga panihapon ha panahon han Pyesta han Tinapay nga Waray Patubo.
en: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

war: Ginsugo ni Jesus hira Pedro ug Juan upod ini nga mga tugon: “Kadto ngan andama niyo an aton Paglabay nga panihapon basi mangaon kita.”
en: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”

war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Diin an karuyag mo nga pag-aandaman namon?”
en: “Where do you want us to prepare for it?” they asked.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Pamati! Pagsulod niyo han syudad, matapo ha iyo in lalake nga nagpapas-an hin tibod nga may tubig. Sunda hiya ngadto han balay nga iya susudlan,
en: He replied, “As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,

war: ngan sidnga an tagbalay: ‘Napakiana ha imo an Magturutdo kon hain an kwarto nga kakaonan niya han Paglabay nga panihapon kaupod han iya mga tinun-an?’
en: and say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’

war: Ipapakita niya ha iyo in dako nga kwarto ha igbaw nga sangkap na. Andama niyo didto an ngatanan.”
en: He will show you a large room upstairs, all furnished. Make preparations there.”

war: Nagkalakat hira ngan ira hin-agian an ngatanan sugad han iginsumat ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gin-andam nira an Paglabay nga panihapon.
en: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

war: Han pag-abot na han takna, linmingkod hi Jesus ha iya dapit ha lamesa upod han mga apostoles.
en: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Karuyag ko gud hin pakigsaro ha iyo hini nga Paglabay nga panihapon ugsa ako mag-antos!
en: And he said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

war: Kay susumatan ko kamo: diri na ako makaon hini tubtob nga matuman an kahulogan hini didto han Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God.”

war: Ngan ginkuha ni Jesus an kupa, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan nagsiring, “Kuhaa niyo ini ngan pagbahinbahina ha iyo ngahaw,
en: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among you.

war: kay susumatan ko kamo nga diri na ako mainom hini nga bino tikang yana tubtob han pag-abot han Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: For I tell you I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes.”

war: “Kundi kitaa! Aanhi kaupod ko ha lamesa an naglilingo ha akon!
en: But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.

war: Kay mapatay an Anak han Tawo sumala han pagbuot han Dyos; kundi kairo hito nga tawo nga maglilingo ha akon!”
en: The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed. But woe to that man who betrays him!”

war: Ngan nagtikang hira hin paggiparupakiana kon hin-o ha ira an magbubuhat hini.
en: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.

war: Nagtikang dida han mga tinun-an in lantugi kon hin-o ha ira an angay kilalahon nga gilalabawi.
en: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “May gahom an mga hadi hini nga kalibutan hin pagbuot han ira mga sakop, ngan ginngangaranan an mga pangulo nga ‘Mga Sangkay han mga tawo.’
en: Jesus said to them, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.

war: Kundi diri amo ini nga paagi ha iyo; lugod an gilalabawi ha iyo kinahanglan masugad han gimamanghuri, ngan an pangulo kinahanglan masugad han surugoon.
en: But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.

war: Hin-o an larulabaw, an nalingkod ba hin pagkaon o an nagsisirbe ha iya? Ada, an nalingkod. Kundi kaupod ako niyo sugad hin usa nga nagsisirbe.
en: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

war: “Nagpabilin kamo upod ha akon ha ngatanan ko nga mga pag-antos;
en: You are those who have stood by me in my trials.

war: ngan sugad nga gintagan ako han akon Amay han katungod hin paghadi, tatagan ko man kamo han amo ngahaw nga katungod.
en: And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,

war: Makaon ngan mainom kamo ha akon lamesa didto han akon Ginhadian, ngan malingkod kamo ha mga trono hin paghukom han dose nga mga tribo han Israel.
en: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

war: “Simon, Simon! Pamati! Gintugotan hi Satanas hin pagsulay ha iyo ngatanan, sugad han paglaina hin mag-uroma han trigo ngan han uhot.
en: “Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you as wheat.

war: Kundi nag-ampo ako para ha imo, Simon, nga diri mapakyas an imo pagtoo. Ngan kon mahibalik ka na ha akon, kinahanglan padig-onon mo an imo kabugtoan.”
en: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”

war: Nagbaton hi Pedro, “Ginoo, andam ako hin pag-upod ha imo ha bilanggoan, ngan hin pagpakamatay pa upod ha imo!”
en: But he replied, “Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death.”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko ikaw, Pedro, diri matugaok an manok yana nga gab-i tubtob nga magsiring ka hin makatulo nga diri ka nakilala ha akon.”
en: Jesus answered, “I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.”

war: Nagsiring an mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, Ginoo! Iini in duha nga espada.” “Igo na ito!” nagbaton hiya.
en: The disciples said, “See, Lord, here are two swords.” “That’s enough!” he replied.

war: Ginmawas hi Jesus han syudad, ngan sugad han iya nahiaraan, kinmadto hiya ha Bukid han mga Olibo; ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.
en: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.

war: Han pag-abot niya didto, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Pag-ampo nga diri kamo masulay.”
en: On reaching the place, he said to them, “Pray that you will not fall into temptation.”

war: Ngan inmuruonhan hiya ha ira hin kahirayo nga kanan usa ka labay hin bato, ngan linmuhod ngan nag-ampo,
en: He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,

war: “Amay ko, kon imo pagbuot, kuhaa gad ini nga kupa ha akon. Diri an akon, kundi an imo pagbuot an matuman.” [
en: “Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done.”

war: Pinmakita ha iya in usa nga anghel tikang ha langit, nga nagpakusog ha iya.
en: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

war: Ha dako gud nga kasakit nag-ampo hiya hin huruhugot pa nga pangamuyo, an iya balhas sugad na hin mga turo hin dugo nga natabigis ha tuna.]
en: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

war: Han pagbangon niya tikang ha pag-ampo, binmalik hiya ngadto han iya mga tinun-an, ngan iya hira hin-agian nga nangangaturog na, nga rutay na tungod han ira kabidoon.
en: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nangangaturog kamo? Pagmata kamo ngan pag-ampo nga diri kamo masulay.”
en: “Why are you sleeping?” he asked them. “Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation.”

war: Nagyayakan pa hi Jesus han pag-abot hin mga tawo. Nag-uuna ha ira hi Judas nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan dinmaop hiya kan Jesus hin pagharok ha iya.
en: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Judas, lilingoon mo ba an Anak han Tawo pinaagi hin harok?”
en: but Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”

war: Pakasabot han mga tinun-an nga kaupod ni Jesus han mahinanabo, nagsiring hira, “Ginoo, gagamiton na ba namon an amon mga espada?”
en: When Jesus’ followers saw what was going to happen, they said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”

war: Ngan gintigbas han usa ha ira an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an iya tuo nga talinga.
en: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Igo na ini!” Ginkamkam niya an talinga han tawo, ngan gin-upay niya.
en: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.

war: Kaupod man ako niyo adlaw-adlaw ha Templo, ngan waray kamo magtalinguha hin pagdakop ha akon. Kundi amo na ini an iyo takna, nga diin naghahadi na an gahom han kasisidman.”
en: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.”

war: Gindakop nira hi Jesus, ngan gindara hiya ngadto han balay han Labaw nga Padi; ngan inmantaw la hi Pedro hin pagsunod ha iya.
en: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.

war: May ginharing nga tap-ong ha butnga han bungsaran, ngan tinmampo hi Pedro han mga nagkakalingkod palibot han kalayo.
en: And when some there had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.

war: Han paghikit-i ha iya han usa han mga surugoon nga kababayen-an nga tinmampo hiya hin paglingkod, tinutokan hiya niya ngan sidngon, “Kaupod liwat niya ini nga tawo!”
en: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, “This man was with him.”

war: Kundi naglirong hi Pedro hin pagsiring, “Babaye, diri ngani ako nakilala ha iya!”
en: But he denied it. “Woman, I don’t know him,” he said.

war: Waray pag-iha hinkit-an hi Pedro hin usa ka tawo ngan ginsiring, “Kausa ka liwat nira!” Kundi nagbaton hi Pedro, “Sangkay, diri ako kausa nira!”
en: A little later someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” “Man, I am not!” Peter replied.

war: Ngan naglabay hin mga usa ka oras, ug may lain nga tawo nga nangusog hin pagsiring, “Waray ruhaduha upod gud ini nga tawo ha iya, kay taga-Galilea liwat hiya!”
en: About an hour later another asserted, “Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean.”

war: Kundi nagbaton hi Pedro, “Sangkay, diri ako maaram han imo ginyayakan!” Samtang nagyayakan pa hiya, tinmugaok dayon in usa nga manok.
en: Peter replied, “Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about!” Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.

war: Ginmawas hi Pedro ngan nagtangis nga duro an kabido.
en: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

war: Ginyubitan ngan gintubal hi Jesus han mga tawo nga nagbabantay ha iya.
en: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.

war: Gintahoban nira an iya mga mata, ngan ginpakianhan, “Tigoha! Hin-o an nagsuntok ha imo?”
en: They blindfolded him and demanded, “Prophesy! Who hit you?”

war: Ngan damo la nga mga pagyubit an ira ginyakan ha iya.
en: And they said many other insulting things to him.

war: Pagkaadlaw na, nagtirok an katigurangan han mga Judiyo, an mga puno han kapadian, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan gindara hi Jesus ngadto han ira Labaw nga Hukmanan.
en: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.

war: Nagsiring hira, “Sumati kami, amo ka ba an Mesiyas?” Nagbaton hiya, “Diri kamo matuod ha akon kon pagsumatan ko kamo,
en: “If you are the Messiah,” they said, “tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe me,

war: ngan diri kamo mabaton kon magpakiana ako ha iyo.
en: and if I asked you, you would not answer.

war: Kundi yana, malingkod na an Anak han Tawo ha tuo han Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum.”
en: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God.”

war: Nagsiring hira ngatanan, “Kon sugad amo ka ba an Anak han Dyos?” Nagbaton niya ha ira, “Kamo an nasiring nga Anak ako han Dyos.”
en: They all asked, “Are you then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hira, “Waray na kita kinahanglan hin mga saksi! Nakabati na kita ngahaw han iya gud kalugaringon nga mga pulong!”
en: Then they said, “Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips.”

war: Binmuhat an bug-os nga hugpo ngan gindara hi Jesus ngadto kan Pilato,
en: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.

war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi Pilato, “Amo ka ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?” “Ikaw an nagyakan hito,” nagbaton hi Jesus.
en: So Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

war: Niyan ginsiring ni Pilato an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga tawo, “Waray ako hin-aagian nga pangatadongan hin pagsirot hini nga tawo.”
en: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

war: Kundi nagpirit gud hira hin pagsiring, “Pinaagi han iya pagtutdo hiya an tinikangan han kasamokan han mga tawo ha bug-os nga Judea. Inmuna hiya ha Galilea, nga yana aanhi na hiya.”
en: But they insisted, “He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here.”

war: Pakabati ni Pilato hini, nagpakiana hiya, “Taga-Galilea ba ini nga tawo?”
en: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.

war: Paghibaro niya nga tikang hi Jesus ha dapit nga ginhahadian ni Herodes, iginpadara niya hiya ngadto kan Herodes, nga nakadto liwat ha Jerusalem hadto nga panahon.
en: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

war: Sanglit damo an iya pakiana kan Jesus, kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus bisan usa ka pulong.
en: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.

war: Dinmaop ha atubangan an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan nagpasaka hin makusog nga mga sumbong kontra kan Jesus.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.

war: Ginyubitan hi Jesus ni Herodes ngan han iya mga sondalo, ngan ginpakaalohan hiya nira. Ginbistehan hiya nira hin kanan hadi panapton, ngan iginbalik ngadto kan Pilato.
en: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.

war: Hadto manta nga adlaw nagkasangkay hira Herodes ug Pilato; magkontra hira hadto anay han waray pa ini mahinabo.
en: That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.

war: Gintirok ni Pilato an mga puno han kapadian, an mga pangulo, ngan an mga tawo,
en: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,

war: Waray gihapon makaagi hin sala ha iya bisan ngani hi Herodes, kay iginbalik man hiya ha aton. Waray ginbuhat hini nga tawo nga angay sirotan han kamatayon.
en: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.

war: Sanglit ipalalatob ko nala hiya ngan pabubuhian.” [
en: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him.”

war: Naggoliat an bug-os nga hugpo, “Pataya hiya! Buhii hi Barabas para ha amon!” (
en: But the whole crowd shouted, “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”

war: Napriso hi Barabas tungod hin karibok nga nahinabo ha syudad, ngan tungod hin pagpatay.)
en: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)

war: Karuyag ni Pilato nga buhian hi Jesus, sanglit gintawag liwat niya an mga tawo.
en: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.

war: Kundi naggogliat hira, “Igraysang hiya ha kros! Igraysang ha kros!”
en: But they kept shouting, “Crucify him! Crucify him!”

war: Kundi dinmuroy lugod hira hin pagtikadako han ira gogliat nga kinahanglan igraysang hi Jesus ha kros; ngan ha kataposan tinugotan hira ni Pilato.
en: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.

war: Sanglit iginpahamtang ni Pilato kan Jesus an sirot nga ira ginpangaro.
en: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.

war: Ginbuhian ni Pilato an tawo nga ira kinaruyag, an napriso tungod hin pagribok ngan pakamatay, ngan igintubyan hi Jesus ha ira, basi buhaton nira an ira karuyag.
en: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.

war: Nagsunod ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo, ngan upod ha ira in pira nga kababayen-an nga nagtitinangis ngan nagngunguugoy tungod ha iya.
en: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.

war: Kay maabot an mga adlaw, nga masiring an mga tawo, ‘Kapalaran han kababayen-an nga mga baw-as, nga waray mga anak, nga waray magpasuso!’
en: For the time will come when you will say, ‘Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’

war: Amo ito an panahon nga masiring ha kabukiran an mga tawo, ‘Tabuni kami!’ ngan ha kapungtoran, ‘Tagoa kami!’
en: Then “ ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!” ’

war: Kay kon pagbuhaton in sugad nga mga butang kon hilaw pa an kahoy, ano in mahinanabo kon uga na ito?”
en: For if people do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”

war: Nagdara liwat hira hin duha nga mga kriminal, nga papatayon nira upod kan Jesus.
en: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.

war: Han pag-abot nira ha dapit nga gintatawag “An Klabera,” didto iginraysang nira ha kros hi Jesus, ngan an duha nga mga kriminal, an usa ha iya tuo, ngan an usa ha iya wala.
en: When they came to the place called the Skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Amay ko, pasayloa hira! Kay diri hira maaram han ira ginbubuhat.” Ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa.
en: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

war: Ginyubitan liwat hiya han mga sondalo. Kinmadto hira ha iya hin paghatag ha iya hin maaslom nga bino,
en: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar

war: ngan nagsiring, “Talwasa an imo kalugaringon, kon tinuod manggud nga ikaw amo an hadi han mga Judiyo!”
en: and said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.”

war: Iginsurat ini nga mga pulong ha igbaw niya: “Amo ini an Hadi han mga Judiyo.”
en: There was a written notice above him, which read: this is the king of the jews .

war: Ginyubitan liwat hiya han usa han mga kriminal nga nabitay didto, “Diri ka ba amo an Mesiyas? Talwasa an imo kalugaringon ngan talwasa kami!”
en: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: “Aren’t you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!”

war: Kundi ginsaway hiya han usa nga kriminal, “Diri ka ba nahadlok han Dyos? Aanhi kita ginsirotan hin sugad nga sirot nga ihinatag ha iya.
en: But the other criminal rebuked him. “Don’t you fear God,” he said, “since you are under the same sentence?

war: Matadong ini nga sirot para ha aton, kay nakarawat kita han angay nga sirot han aton ginbuhat; kundi waray hiya ginbuhat nga maraot.”
en: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Jesus, hinumdomi gad ako kon makanhi ka na nga hadi.”
en: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. ”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Susumatan ko ikaw: yana ngahaw nga adlaw, maupod ka ha akon ngadto ha Paraiso.”
en: Jesus answered him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise.”

war: May mga alas dose an takna nga waray na pagsirak an adlaw, ngan nalukop hin kasirom an bug-os nga tuna tubtob ha alas tres han kulop;
en: It was now about noon, and darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon,

war: ngan napikas an biray han Templo.
en: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.

war: Ginmoliat hi Jesus hin makusog nga tingog, “Amay ko! Ha imo mga kamot itinutubyan ko an akon espiritu!” Katapos pagyakan niya hini, nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.
en: Jesus called out with a loud voice, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.” When he had said this, he breathed his last.

war: Hinkit-an han kapitan han mga sondalo an nahinabo, ngan gindayaw niya an Dyos, hin pasiring, “Matuod gud nga maupay hiya nga tawo!”
en: The centurion, seeing what had happened, praised God and said, “Surely this was a righteous man.”

war: An mga tawo nga nagtirok hin pagtan-aw hini nga kiritaon, kinmita han nahinabo. Nanguli hira nga nagpupukpok han ira mga dughan tungod han ira kabidoan.
en: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.

war: Kinmadto hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus.
en: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body.

war: Ngan gintanggal an lawas, ginputos hin dugnit nga lino ngan ibinutang ha lubnganan nga inukab ha bato—usa nga lubnganan nga waray pa gud gamita.
en: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.

war: Adlaw adto ha pag-andam ngan bisperas na han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.

war: Binmunyog kan Jose an kababayen-an nga nagsinunod kan Jesus tikang pa ha Galilea, ngan nakakita han lubnganan, ngan kon gin-unan-o hin pagbutang han lawas ni Jesus didto.
en: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and saw the tomb and how his body was laid in it.

war: Niyan nanguli hira ngan nag-andam hin mga pahamot ngan mga idirihog han iya lawas. Pinmahuway hira ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway sumala han sugo han Balaod.
en: Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.

war: Maagahon pa gud han Domingo kinmadto na ha lubnganan an kababayen-an dara an mga pahamot nga ira gin-andam.
en: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.

war: Hinkit-an nira nga nakadto na ha ligid an bato nga igintaklob han porta han lubnganan,
en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,

war: sanglit sinmulod hira; kundi waray nira hiagii an lawas han Ginoo nga Jesus.
en: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

war: Samtang natindog hira didto nga nagugupong mahitungod hini, tinmindog dayon tupad ha ira in duha nga kalalaken-an nga magsilaw an mga panapton.
en: While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.

war: Tugob hin kahadlok yinmukbo ha tuna an kababayen-an, samtang ginsiring hira han kalalaken-an, “Kay ano nga ginbibiling niyo an buhi dinhe han mga minatay?
en: In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?

war: Waray na hiya dinhe, nabanhaw na hiya. Panumdoma an iginsiring niya ha iyo han nakadto pa hiya ha Galilea:
en: He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:

war: ‘Kinahanglan itubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga makasasala, igraysang ha kros, ngan mabanhaw ha ikatulo ka adlaw.’”
en: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered over to the hands of sinners, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.’ ”

war: Niyan nahinumdom an kababayen-an han iya mga pulong,
en: Then they remembered his words.

war: inmoli hira tikang han lubnganan, ngan iginsumat ini ngatanan nga mga butang ngadto han onse nga mga tinun-an ngan han iba pa.
en: When they came back from the tomb, they told all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.

war: An kababayen-an amo hira Maria Magdalena, Juana, ug Maria nga iroy ni Santiago. Hira ngan an iba pa nga kababayen-an nga kaupod nira nagsumat han mga apostoles hini nga mga butang.
en: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.

war: Kundi naghunahuna an mga apostoles nga kalurongan la an iginsiring han kababayen-an ngan waray tumuod ha ira.
en: But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.

war: Hadto manta nga adlaw duha han kan Jesus mga tinun-an napakadto ha usa nga baryo nga Emmaus an ngaran, mga onse ka kilometro tikang ha Jerusalem.
en: Now that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

war: Naghihinimangraw hira mahitungod han ngatanan nga mga butang nga nanhinabo.
en: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

war: Samtang naghihimangraw hira, dinmaop hi Jesus ngan binmunyog ha ira.
en: As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;

war: Hinkit-an hiya nira, kundi ambot kon ano nga waray man hira pakakilala ha iya.
en: but they were kept from recognizing him.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Mahitungod hin ano an iyo ginkakarukayakan samtang naglalakat kamo?” Inmukoy hira nga mabidoon an ira mga bayhon.
en: He asked them, “What are you discussing together as you walk along?” They stood still, their faces downcast.

war: Nagpakiana ha iya an usa ha ira nga Cleopas an ngaran, “Ikaw gud la an umurukoy ha Jerusalem nga waray mahibaro han mga butang nga nanhinabo didto hini nga pira ka mga adlaw nga naglabay?”
en: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, “Are you the only one visiting Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?”

war: Igintubyan hiya han amon mga puno han kapadian ngan mga punoan nga sirotan han kamatayon ngan iginraysang hiya ha kros.
en: The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;

war: Ngan naglaom gud kami nga amo hiya an magtutubos han Israel! Labot pa hini ngatanan, amo na yana an ikatulo ka adlaw tikang mahinabo ini.
en: but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.

war: Nanhipausa kami han sumat hin pira nga kababayen-an han amon hugpo. Kinmadto hira ha lubnganan han maagahon pa,
en: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning

war: kundi waray hiagii nira an iya lawas. Binmalik hira hin pagsumat nga nakakita hira hin panan-awon hin mga anghel nga nagsumat ha ira nga buhi hiya.
en: but didn’t find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.

war: Kinmadto ha lubnganan in pira han amon hugpo, ngan hinsabotan nira sumala han iginsiring ha kababayen-an, kundi waray hira makakita ha iya.”
en: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they did not see Jesus.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hin ka mga lurong niyo, hin kahinay niyo tumoo han ngatanan nga iginsiring han mga manaragna!
en: He said to them, “How foolish you are, and how slow to believe all that the prophets have spoken!

war: Diri ba kinahanglan mag-antos anay an Mesiyas hini nga mga butang san-o hiya makasulod han iya himaya?”
en: Did not the Messiah have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?”

war: Niyan iginsaysay ha ira ni Jesus an iginsiring mahitungod ha iya ha ngatanan nga Kasuratan, tikang han mga basahan ni Moises ngan han mga sinurat han ngatanan nga mga manaragna.
en: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself.

war: Inmabot hira hirani han baryo nga ira kinakadtoan, ngan nagpakita hi Jesus nga sugad hin magpapadayon pa hiya ngadto ha unhan;
en: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus continued on as if he were going farther.

war: kundi ginhawiran hiya nira, “Pabilin na la upod ha amon kay kulopay na man ngan tikasirom na.” Sanglit sinmulod hiya ngan nagpabilin upod ha ira.
en: But they urged him strongly, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over.” So he went in to stay with them.

war: Linmingkod hiya ha lamesa upod ha ira, kinmuha han tinapay, ngan ginbendisyonan ini niya; katapos, ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha ira.
en: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.

war: Nabuksan an ira mga mata ngan kinmilala hira ha iya; kundi napara hiya dayon ha ira mga mata.
en: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.

war: Naggipasiringsiring hira, “Diri ba sugad hin kalayo nga nagdidilaab dinhe ha aton, han nagyayakan hiya ha aton dida ha dalan, ngan nagsasaysay ha aton han Kasuratan?”
en: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”

war: Nagkabuhat hira dayon ngan binmalik ha Jerusalem, diin ira hin-agian nga nagkakatirok an onse nga mga tinun-an, kaupod han iba
en: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together

war: nga nagsiring, “Tinuod gud nga nabanhaw an Ginoo! Nagpakita hiya kan Simon!”
en: and saying, “It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon.”

war: Niyan iginsaysay nira nga duha ha ira an nahinabo ha dalan ngan kon naunan-o an ira pakakilala han Ginoo dida han pagpinitpinit niya han tinapay.
en: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.

war: Samtang nagsusumat hira hini ha ira, tigda la nga tinmindog an Ginoo ngahaw ha butnga nira ngan ginsiring hira, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”
en: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you.”

war: Tugob hira hin kahadlok ngan kakulba. An ira hunahuna nga kinmita hira hin kalag.
en: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.

war: Kundi nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nababaraka man kamo? Kay ano nga nagruruhaduha man kamo ha iyo mga hunahuna?
en: He said to them, “Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?

war: Iginsiring niya ini ngan iginpakita niya ha ira an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil.
en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.

war: Waray la gihapon hira makakatoo tungod han ira dako nga kalipay ngan paghipausa, sanglit nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “May-ada ba niyo sadang makaon dinhe?”
en: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

war: Gintagan hiya nira hin sinugba nga isda,
en: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,

war: ngan kinarawat ini ni Jesus ngan ginkaon ha ira atubangan.
en: and he took it and ate it in their presence.

war: Ngan ginbuksan niya an ira mga hunahuna basi makasabot hira han Kasuratan,
en: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

war: ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Amo ini an nahisurat: kinahanglan mag-antos an Mesiyas ngan mabanhaw ha ikatulo ka adlaw,
en: He told them, “This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

war: ngan ha iya ngaran kinahanglan igwali ha ngatanan nga mga nasod, tikang ha Jerusalem, an mensahe mahitungod han pagbasol ngan pagpasaylo han mga sala.
en: and repentance for the forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

war: Mga saksi kamo hini nga mga butang.
en: You are witnesses of these things.

war: Ngan ako ngahaw an magpapadara nganhi ha iyo han iginsaad han akon Amay. Kundi kinahanglan maghulat kamo didto ha syudad tubtob nga kumunsad ha iyo an gahom nga tikang ha igbaw.”
en: I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”

war: Niyan gindara hira niya ha gawas han syudad tubtob ha Betania diin gin-alsa niya an iya mga kamot ngan ginbendisyonan hira.
en: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

war: Samtang nagbebendisyon hiya ha ira, binmaya hiya ha ira ngan ginbayaw hiya ha langit.
en: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

war: Nagsingba hira ha iya ngan binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem, nga malipayon,
en: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

war: ngan dayuday didto hira ha Templo, hin pagpasalamat han Dyos.
en: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.

war: Amo ini an pagkasunodsunod han mga kaapoy-apoyan ni Jesu-Cristo nga tulin ni David, nga tulin ni Abraham.
en: This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham:

war: Diri karuyag magpakaalo kan Maria hi Jose kay matadong hiya nga tawo. Sanglit, nakahunahuna hiya hin pagbaya kan Maria hin hilom la.
en: Because Joseph her husband was faithful to the law, and yet did not want to expose her to public disgrace, he had in mind to divorce her quietly.

war: Mag-aanak hiya hin lalake, ngan pagngangaranan mo hiya nga Jesus, kay magtatalwas hiya han iya katawhan tikang han ira mga sala.”
en: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”

war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan basi matuman an iginyakan han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna nga nasiring,
en: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

war: “Magbuburod in usa nga uray nga daraga ngan mag-aanak hin lalake, ngan tatawgon hiya nga Emmanuel” (nga karuyag sidngon, “An Dyos aanhi upod ha aton”).
en: “The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel” (which means “God with us”).

war: Sanglit, han pagmata ni Jose, gintuman niya an iginsugo ha iya han anghel han Ginoo, ngan pinangasawa niya hi Maria.
en: When Joseph woke up, he did what the angel of the Lord had commanded him and took Mary home as his wife.

war: Kundi hi Jose waray makighilawas kan Maria tubtob nga nag-anak hi Maria. Ngan Jesus an iginngaran ni Jose han bata.
en: But he did not consummate their marriage until she gave birth to a son. And he gave him the name Jesus.

war: ngan nagpakiana hira, “Hain ba an natawo nga bata nga hadi han mga Judiyo? Hinkit-an namon ha sinirangan an iya bituon, ngan kinmanhi kami hin pagsingba ha iya.”
en: and asked, “Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.”

war: Han pakabati hini ni Hadi Herodes, nabaraka hiya pati an bug-os nga Jerusalem.
en: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

war: Gintirok niya an ngatanan nga mga puno han kapadian ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Diin ba matatawo an Mesiyas?”
en: When he had called together all the people’s chief priests and teachers of the law, he asked them where the Messiah was to be born.

war: “Didto ha bungto han Betlehem, ha Judea,” nagbaton hira. “Amo ini an iginsurat han manaragna:
en: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:

war: Sanglit, iginpatawag ni Herodes hin hilom an mga kamag-araman nga tikang ha sinirangan. Hinbaroan niya tikang ha ira an untop nga takna han pagpakita han bitoon.
en: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.

war: Ginpahimangno hira han Dyos pinaagi hin inop nga diri na bumalik hira ngadto kan Herodes; sanglit nangoli hira ngan lain nga dalan an ira gin-agian.
en: And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.

war: Binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy, ngan pinmalagiw hira ngadto ha Ehipto hadto ngahaw nga gab-i.
en: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,

war: Nagpabilin hira didto ngada han kamatay ni Herodes. Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsiring han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna, “Gintawag ko an akon Anak tikang ha Ehipto.”
en: where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

war: Dida hini natuman an iginsurat ni Jeremias nga manaragna nga nasiring:
en: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

war: Han kamatay na ni Herodes, pinmakita kan Jose pinaagi hin inop didto ha Ehipto in usa nga anghel han Ginoo.
en: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Buhat, dad-a an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan balik ngadto ha tuna han Israel, kay patay na an mga nagdudumot han bata.”
en: and said, “Get up, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who were trying to take the child’s life are dead.”

war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan inmoli ngadto ha Israel.
en: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.

war: ngan nag-ukoy hiya ha Nazaret nga bungto, basi matuman ini nga iginsiring han manaragna: “Tatawgon hiya nga Nazareno.”
en: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was said through the prophets, that he would be called a Nazarene.

war: Hadto nga panahon hi Juan nga Parabunyag kinmadto ha kamingawan han Judea ngan nagtikang hin pagwali.
en: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Magbasol ngan bayai an iyo mga sala kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit.”
en: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”

war: Hinimo hin buhok hin kamelyo an kan Juan panapton, anit an iya bakos ha hawak, ngan mga duron ngan dugos ha kagurangan an karaonon niya.
en: John’s clothes were made of camel’s hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

war: Kinmadto ha iya an mga tawo tikang ha Jerusalem, tikang ha bug-os nga lalawigan han Judea ngan tikang han ngatanan nga katunaan nga harani han Salog Jordan.
en: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region of the Jordan.

war: Iginkumpisal nira an ira mga sala ngan ginbunyagan hira ni Juan didto ha Salog Jordan.
en: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

war: Ipakita ha iyo mga buhat nga nagbasol na kamo han iyo mga sala.
en: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.

war: Andam na an parakol hin pagpulod han kahoy ha iya mga gamot; pupudlon ngan susunogon an tagsa nga kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.
en: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

war: Hadto nga panahon, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Galilea, ngan kinmadto kan Juan didto ha Jordan basi bunyagan hiya ni Juan.
en: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

war: Gintalinguha ni Juan nga magbalhin hi Jesus han iya nahuhunahunaan ngan iya ginsiring, “Ako kunta an angay pagbunyagan mo, kundi ikaw lugod an napakanhi ha akon!”
en: But John tried to deter him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Pabay-i la anay ini yana. Kay dida hini nga paagi mahihimo naton an ngatanan nga ginkikinahanglan han Dyos.” Ngan tinmangdo hi Juan.
en: Jesus replied, “Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.” Then John consented.

war: Ngan nagsiring in tingog tikang ha langit, “Amo ini an akon hinigugma nga Anak nga nakakalipay gud ha akon.”
en: And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”

war: Niyan gindara hi Jesus han Espiritu ngadto han kamingawan basi pagsulayon han Yawa.
en: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

war: Katapos hin 40 ka adlaw ngan 40 ka gab-i nga pagpuasa, ginutom hi Jesus.
en: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.

war: Dinmaop ha iya an Yawa ngan nagsiring, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, himoa nga tinapay ini nga mga bato.”
en: The tempter came to him and said, “If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Nabubuhi an tawo diri la hin tinapay, kundi han tagsa nga pulong nga ginyayakan han Dyos.’”
en: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’ ”

war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto han Baraan nga Syudad, ngan ibinutang hiya didto han gihahataasi nga atop han Templo,
en: Then the devil took him to the holy city and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kundi nasiring man liwat an kasuratan, ‘Kinahanglan diri mo pagsulayon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos.’”
en: Jesus answered him, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”

war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto hin gihahataasi nga bukid ngan iginpakita ha iya an ngatanan nga mga ginhadian han kalibutan, ngan an ira kagamhanan.
en: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor.

war: “Ihahatag ko ha imo ini ngatanan,” nagsiring an Yawa, “kon humapa ka ngan magsingba ka ha akon.”
en: “All this I will give you,” he said, “if you will bow down and worship me.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iwas dida, Satanas! Kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Singbahon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos, ngan hiya la an pag-alagdon nimo!’”
en: Jesus said to him, “Away from me, Satan! For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God, and serve him only.’ ”

war: Ngan binmaya an Yawa kan Jesus, ngan nagkaabot in mga anghel ug nagtimangno kan Jesus.
en: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.

war: Han pakabati ni Jesus nga napriso hi Juan, kinmadto hiya ha Galilea.
en: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he withdrew to Galilee.

war: Waray na hiya pag-ukoy ha Nazaret kundi ha Capernaum. Aada ini nga bungto ha ligid han Lanaw Galilea, ha katunaan han Zabulon ug Neftali.
en: Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum, which was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali—

war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna nga nasiring:
en: to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:

war: “Galilea han mga Hentil! An tuna ha Zabulon ngan an tuna ha Neftali, aragian tipakadto ha dagat, ha tabok han Jordan.
en: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—

war: An mga tawo nga nag-uukoy ha kasisidman makita hin dako nga kapawa. Ha ira nga nag-uokoy ha masirom nga tuna han kamatayon malamrag an kapawa!”
en: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned.”

war: Tikang hadto nagtikang hi Jesus hin pagwali, “Bayai niyo an iyo mga sala, kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit!”
en: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Upod kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ko kamo pagdakop hin mga tawo.”
en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

war: Ira binayaan dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira ha iya.
en: At once they left their nets and followed him.

war: Dida dayon binayaan nira an sakayan ngan an ira amay, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.
en: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

war: Damo nga mga tawo in nagsunod ha iya tikang ha Galilea ngan ha Decapolis, ha Jerusalem, ha Judea, ngan ha tuna nga tabok han Jordan.
en: Large crowds from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and the region across the Jordan followed him.

war: Han pakakita ni Jesus han damo nga mga tawo, sinmagka hiya hin pungtod ngan didto linmingkod hiya. Gin-alirongan hiya han iya mga tinun-an,
en: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on a mountainside and sat down. His disciples came to him,

war: ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira:
en: and he began to teach them. He said:

war: “Palaran adton nakilala nga kablas hira ha espiritu, kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!
en: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

war: “Palaran adton masulob-on, kay pagliliawon hira han Dyos!
en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

war: “Palaran adton mapinaubsanon, kay kakarawaton nira an iginsaad han Dyos!
en: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

war: “Palaran adton may dako nga tinguha pagtuman han kaburut-on han Dyos, kay patutungahon gud hira han Dyos!
en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

war: “Palaran adton maloloy-on ha iba, kay malolooy man an Dyos ha ira!
en: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

war: “Palaran adton maglinis in kasingkasing, kay makakakita hira han Dyos!
en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

war: “Palaran adton nagbubuhat para hin kamurayaw ha mga tawo, kay tatawgon hira nga mga anak han Dyos!
en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

war: “Palaran adton ginpapakurian tungod nga nagtutuman hira han kaburut-on han Dyos, kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!
en: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

war: “Palaran kamo kon pagbiaybiayon, ngan pagpakurian kamo han mga tawo, ngan pagbutangbutangan kamo tungod la nga akon kamo mga sakop.
en: “Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.

war: Pagrayhak ngan paglipay kamo, kay dako an balos nga andam didto ha langit para ha iyo. Amo ini an ginbuhat han mga tawo han pagpakurii nira han mga manaragna nga una pa ha iyo.
en: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

war: “Kamo amo an kapawa han bug-os nga kalibutan. Diri matatago in bungto nga gintindog ha bawbaw hin bukid.
en: “You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

war: Waray nadagkot hin suga ngan takloban. Lugod, ibinubutang ha burutangan hin suga basi makalamrag han ngatanan nga aada ha balay.
en: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.

war: Ha sugad nga paagi, kinahanglan an iyo suga magmapawa ha atubangan han mga tawo, basi hikit-an nira an iyo maupay nga buhat, ngan pagdayawon nira an Amay niyo ha langit.
en: In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

war: “Ayaw kamo paghunahuna nga kinmanhi ako pagpara han Balaod ni Moises ngan han mga igintutdo han mga manaragna. Waray ako kumanhi hin pagpara hini, kundi hin pagtuman.
en: “Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them.

war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: kon diri lumabaw an iyo pagkamatadong han kanan mga Parisiyo ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod, diri gud kamo makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit.
en: For I tell you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the Pharisees and the teachers of the law, you will certainly not enter the kingdom of heaven.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga gintutdoan hini an mga tawo han una nga panahon, ‘Diri ka magpatay; dadad-on ha hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga makamatay.’
en: “You have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘You shall not murder, and anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’

war: Sanglit kon maghalad ka sa Dyos ngan manumdom ka nga may kasina an imo bugto ha imo,
en: “Therefore, if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,

war: bayai anay an imo halad didto ha altar ngan kadto dayon pakighioli han imo bugto. Kahuman, balik ngan paghalad sa Dyos.
en: leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled to them; then come and offer your gift.

war: Nasiring ako ha imo: diri ka makakagawas didto tubtob nga kabaydan mo an ngatanan nga multa ha imo.
en: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring ini, ‘Diri ka manlibog.’
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’

war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: nakapanlibog na ha iya kasingkasing an bisan hin-o nga nasiplat hin babaye ngan nakahunahuna hin pakighilawas ha iya.
en: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

war: “Iginsiring liwat ini, ‘Adton makig-bulag han iya asawa, kinahanglan nga maghatag hin sinurat nga karig-onan hin pagpahibaro han iya asawa mahitungod han iya pakigbulag.’
en: “It has been said, ‘Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’

war: “Hinbatian liwat niyo nga igintutdo ha mga tawo han una nga panahon, ‘Tumana an imo iginsaad ngan buhata an imo iginsumpa ha Ginoo.’
en: “Again, you have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill to the Lord the vows you have made.’

war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagsumpa kon nagsasaad ka. Ayaw gamita an langit hin pagsumpa, kay trono ito han Dyos;
en: But I tell you, do not swear an oath at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;

war: ayaw man an tuna, kay tungtungan ito han iya mga tiil. Ayaw liwat an Jerusalem, kay syudad ito han harangdon nga Hadi.
en: or by the earth, for it is his footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the Great King.

war: Ayaw gamita bisan pa an imo ulo, kay diri ka makakapabusag o makakapaitom hin usa han imo buhok.
en: And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make even one hair white or black.

war: Igo na nga masiring ka, ‘Oo’ kon matangdo ka; ‘Diri’ kon mariwa ka; natikang na han Yawa an sobra pa hini nga igyayakan mo.
en: All you need to say is simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything beyond this comes from the evil one.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘An mata bayaran hin mata ngan an ngipon bayaran hin ngipon.’
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’

war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagbulos han nagpapakaraot ha imo. Kon may magtampalo han imo tuo nga bayhon, ipatampalo liwat ha iya an imo wala nga bayhon.
en: But I tell you, do not resist an evil person. If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to them the other cheek also.

war: Ngan kon may magsumbong ha imo basi makuha niya an imo kamiseta, ihatag pa ha iya pati an imo kamisadentro.
en: And if anyone wants to sue you and take your shirt, hand over your coat as well.

war: Kon in sondalo magpirit ha imo hin pagdara han iya kasangkapan sulod hin usa ka kilometro, dad-a ito hin duha ka kilometro.
en: If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.

war: Tagi kon may mangaro ha imo, ngan pahudma kon may humoram ha imo.
en: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘Higugmaa an iyo kasangkayan, pagdumti an iyo mga kaaway.’
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: higugmaa an iyo mga kaaway ngan ig-ampo an mga nagpapakuri ha iyo,
en: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

war: Kon hihigugmaon la niyo an mga tawo nga nahigugma ha iyo, ano man nga balos an iyo pamumulaton? Diri ba amo ini an ginbubuhat han mga parasukot hin buhis?
en: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Are not even the tax collectors doing that?

war: Ngan kon makikig-upay kamo hin kaburut-on ha iyo la mga kasangkayan, ano man an ginbubuhat niyo nga malabaw han iba? Ginbubuhat ini bisan pa han mga Hentil.
en: And if you greet only your own people, what are you doing more than others? Do not even pagans do that?

war: Sanglit kinahanglan mahingpit kamo, sugad nga hingpit an iyo Amay ha langit.
en: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

war: Kundi kon mabulig kamo han nagkikinahanglan, buhata ini hin hilom, kon mahimo, diri mahibaroan han wala niyo nga kamot an ginbubuhat han iyo tuo,
en: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,

war: basi mahilom an iyo paghatag, ngan babaloson kamo han Amay niyo nga nakita han maupay nga ginbubuhat niyo hin hilom.
en: so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

war: Ayaw kamo pagsubad ha ira, kay maaram na nga daan an Amay niyo han iyo ginkikinahanglan samtang nga diri pa kamo naaro ha iya.
en: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.

war: Sanglit sugara hini an iyo pag-ampo: ‘Amay namon ha langit: Pagdayawon an imo baraan nga ngaran,
en: “This, then, is how you should pray: “ ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name,

war: Maghadi ka unta ha amon, matuman dinhe ha tuna an imo kaburut-on sugad han didto ha langit.
en: your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

war: Tagi kami yana nga adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.
en: Give us today our daily bread.

war: Pasayloa kami han amon mga sala sugad han pagpasaylo namon han mga nakasala ha amon.
en: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

war: Ayaw itugot nga mahingadto kami hin makuri nga kataragman, kundi bawia kami ha Karat-an.’ [Kay imo an ginhadian, an gahom ngan an himaya ha kadayonan! Amen.]
en: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. ’

war: “Kon pasayloon niyo an nakakasala ha iyo, pasasayloon man kamo han Amay niyo ha langit.
en: For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

war: Kundi kon diri niyo pasayloon an mga nakakasala ha iyo, diri man mapasaylo ha iyo an Amay niyo ha langit.
en: But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.

war: Kon magpupuasa kamo, paghiram-os ngan pagsudlay,
en: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,

war: basi diri mahibaroan han mga tawo nga nagpupuasa kamo. An Amay niyo nga diri kinikita amo la an mahibabaro, ngan babaloson kamo han maupay nga iyo ginbubuhat hin hilom.
en: so that it will not be obvious to others that you are fasting, but only to your Father, who is unseen; and your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

war: “Ayaw kamo pagtirok hin mga bahandi dinhe ha tuna nga pagkukutkuton hin mga tangkob ug taoy, ngan may-ada makakasulod hin pangawat nga mga tikasan.
en: “Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

war: Lugod, pagtirok kamo para han iyo kalugaringon hin mga manggad didto ha langit diin waray tangkob ug taoy nga nakakakutkot, ngan waray makakasulod hin pangawat nga mga tikasan.
en: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

war: Kay kon hain an iyo mga manggad, dayuday aadto man an iyo kasingkasing.
en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

war: “An mga mata amo an suga para han lawas. Kon maupay an iyo mga mata, malulukop hin kapawa an bug-os niyo nga lawas.
en: “The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

war: Kundi kon diri maupay an iyo mata, mapuputos hin kamasirom an bug-os niyo nga lawas. Sanglit kon an kapawa dida ha iyo, kasisidman ngay-an, kamakalilisang hito nga kasisidman!
en: But if your eyes are unhealthy, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!

war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakapahilaba han iya kinabuhi hin bisan pira la ka tuig pinaagi han iyo pagkinabaraka?
en: Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life ?

war: “Ngan kay ano nga nababaraka kamo mahitungod hin panapton? Paghunahunaa daw niyo an pagtubo han mga bukad ha kapatagan; diri hira nagbubuhat o naghahablon.
en: “And why do you worry about clothes? See how the flowers of the field grow. They do not labor or spin.

war: Kundi nasiring ako ha iyo: bisan hi Solomon, dida han iya pagkamanggaranon, waray panapton nga sugad kamakaruruyag han usa hini nga mga bukad.
en: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.

war: Kon ginpapanaptonan han Dyos an mga banwa ha kapatagan nga buhi yana, ngan pagkabuwas sinusunog ha hudno, kamo pa in diri? Pagkagutiay han iyo pagtoo!
en: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, will he not much more clothe you—you of little faith?

war: “Sanglit ayaw kamo kabaraka han iyo kakaonon, iimnon, o igpapanapton.
en: So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’

war: (Amo ini nga mga butang an nababarak-an han mga tawo nga waray pagsarig sa Dyos.) Maaram an Amay niyo ha langit nga kinahanglan niyo ini ngatanan.
en: For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

war: Sanglit unaha gud niyo pamiling han iya Ginhadian ngan han iya kaburut-on, ngan ihahatag niya ha iyo an iba ngatanan nga mga butang.
en: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

war: Sanglit, ayaw kamo kabaraka mahitungod hiton buwas nga adlaw; may-ada hito kalugaringon nga mga kabaraka. Sanglit ayaw na dugangi an mga kabaraka ha kada adlaw.
en: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

war: “Ayaw kamo paghukom han iba basi diri kamo paghukman han Dyos.
en: “Do not judge, or you too will be judged.

war: Kay paghuhukman kamo han Dyos sumala han paghukom niyo han iba, ngan an iyo igsusukol han iba amo man an gagamiton ha iyo.
en: For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.

war: Kay ano nga nakita man kamo han poling ha mata han iyo bugto, kundi diri kamo nanginginano han nabalabag han iyo kalugaringon nga mata?
en: “Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?

war: Uunanhon niyo hin pagsiring ha imo bugto, ‘Kadi, kukuhaon ta an poling ha imo mata,’ kon aada pa in nabalabag ha iyo kalugaringon nga mata?
en: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when all the time there is a plank in your own eye?

war: Kamalabyaw niyo! Kuhaa anay an nabalabag ha iyo mata, ngan unina, makakakita kamo hin maupay, ngan makakakuha kamo han poling han iyo bugto.
en: You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.

war: “Pangaro ngan tatagan kamo; pamiling ngan makakaagi kamo; pagtuktok ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iyo.
en: “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

war: Kay makarawat an tagsa nga nangangaro, makakaagi an namimiling, ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iya nga nagtutuktok.
en: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

war: Kamo nga mga amay, tatagan ba niyo hin bato kon mangaro an iyo anak hin tinapay?
en: “Which of you, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

war: Tatagan ba niyo hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?
en: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?

war: “Buhata niyo ha iba an karuyag niyo nga buhaton nira ha iyo. Amo ini an kahulogan han Balaod ni Moises ngan han igintutdo han mga manaragna.
en: So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you, for this sums up the Law and the Prophets.

war: “Sulod kamo han haligot nga aragian; kay haluag an aragian ngan masayon an dalan tipakadto ha impyerno, ngan damo an naagi hini nga dalan.
en: “Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

war: Kundi haligot an aragian ngan makuri an dalan tipakadto ha kinabuhi nga dayon, ngan diri damo an nakakatoltol hini nga dalan.
en: But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.

war: “Pag-ikmat kamo han buwaon nga mga manaragna; napahirani hira ha iyo sugad hin mga karnero pagkit-on, kundi balitaw, ha sulod, sugad gud hira hin magbangis nga mga lubo.
en: “Watch out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ferocious wolves.

war: Makikilala niyo hira pinaagi han ira mga panggawi. Binuburo ba in ubas tikang hin kasapinitan, o in igos tikang hin niyutiyo?
en: By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

war: Nabunga hin maupay an maupay nga kahoy, kundi nabunga hin maraot an maraot man nga kahoy.
en: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.

war: Diri makakabunga hin maraot an maupay nga kahoy, diri man liwat makakabunga hin maupay an maraot nga kahoy.
en: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.

war: Pupudlon ngan susunogon an kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.
en: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

war: Sanglit, makikilala niyo an buwaon nga mga manaragna pinaagi han ira mga panggawi.
en: Thus, by their fruit you will recognize them.

war: “Diri ngatanan nga natawag ha akon, ‘Ginoo, Ginoo,’ makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit, kundi adton nagtutuman la han kaburut-on han akon Amay ha langit.
en: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

war: Niyan masiring ako ha ira, ‘Waray gud ako kumilala ha iyo. Pahirayo kamo, mga banyaga nga mga tawo!’
en: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!’

war: “Sanglit, an tagsa nga mamati ngan magtuman hini nga akon mga pulong masusugad hin tawo nga may-ada hibaro nga nagbalay ha bawbaw han bato.
en: “Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

war: Inmuranos, binmaha an mga salog, ngan inagmakan han makusog nga hangin adto nga balay; kundi waray mapukan, kay maupay an katindog ha bawbaw han bato.
en: The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock.

war: “An tagsa nga mamati hini nga akon mga pulong, ngan diri magtuman masusugad hin tawo nga buangbuang nga nagbalay ha bawbaw han baras.
en: But everyone who hears these words of mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

war: Inmuranos, binmaha an mga salog, ngan inagmakan han makusog nga hangin adto nga balay, ngan napukan. Kamakalilisang an pagkapukan hadto nga balay!”
en: The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash.”

war: Katapos ni Jesus pagyakan hini nga mga butang, nahipausa an mga tawo han paagi han iya pagtutdo,
en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,

war: kay nagtutdo hiya nga may gahom ngan diri sugad han ira mga magturutdo han Balaod.
en: because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.

war: Linmugsong hi Jesus tikang hin pungtod ngan nagsunod ha iya in damo kaupay nga mga tawo.
en: When Jesus came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.

war: Hinmarani ha iya in usa nga sanlahon, linmuhod ha atubangan niya ngan sinmiring, “Kon imo karuyag, makakalinis ka ha akon.”
