war: Sanglit han pagdaop na hin pagkarawat han suhol an mga tawo nga una magtrabaho, naghunahuna hira nga darudako an ira kakarawaton, kundi tinagan liwat hira hin tag-usa ka salapi an kada usa.
en: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.

war: Ginkarawat nira an ira suhol, ngan nagtikang hira hin pagngurutob kontra han tag-iya han urubasan.
en: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.

war: Ngan ginbaton han tag-iya an usa ha ira, ‘Sangkay, pamati daw! Waray ako maglimbong ha imo. Di' ba inmuyon ka hin usa ka salapi nga suhol hin usa ka adlaw nga pagtrabaho?
en: “But he answered one of them, ‘I am not being unfair to you, friend. Didn’t you agree to work for a denarius?

war: Yana, karawta an imo suhol, ngan oli ha iyo. Karuyag ko tagan an orhe na magtrabaho hin pareho nga suhol han akon iginhatag ha imo.
en: Take your pay and go. I want to give the one who was hired last the same as I gave you.

war: Waray ba ngay-an ako katungod paggamit han akon kwarta sugad han akon karuyag? O nauba ka ba tungod han akon kamahinatagon?’”
en: Don’t I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?’

war: Ngan gintapos ini ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Sanglit, mahiuuna adton mga orhe, ngan mauorhe adton mga nahiuna.”
en: “So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”

war: Samtang nasagka hi Jesus tipakadto ha Jerusalem, ginlain niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan ginhilit hira hin pagsiring,
en: Now Jesus was going up to Jerusalem. On the way, he took the Twelve aside and said to them,

war: ngan igtutubyan hiya ha mga Hentil. Pagbibiaybiayon, paglalatobon, ngan igraraysang hiya ha kros; kundi mababanhaw hiya ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”
en: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!”

war: Niyan, kinmadto kan Jesus an iroy han mga anak ni Sebedeo, upod an iya mga anak nga lalake, ngan yinmukbo ha iya ngan may-ada niya pinangaro.
en: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri kamo maaram kon ano an iyo pinangangaro. Makakainom ba kamo han kupa han mga pag-antos nga ha diri maiha akon iimnan?” “Makakahimo kami,” binmaton hira.
en: “You don’t know what you are asking,” Jesus said to them. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” they answered.

war: Han pakabati hini han iba nga napulo nga mga tinun-an, nagkasisina hira han duha nga magbugto.
en: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

war: Kundi diri ini amo nga paagi an angay niyo sundon. Kon may usa ha iyo nga karuyag magin labaw, kinahanglan magin surugoon hiya han iba;
en: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

war: ngan kon may usa ha iyo nga karuyag magin gilalabawi, kinahanglan magin oripon hiya niyo—
en: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—

war: sugad han Anak han Tawo nga waray makanih hin pagpaataman, kundi hin paghatag han iya kinabuhi para hin pagtubos hin damo nga mga tawo.”
en: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

war: Han nabaya na hi Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an han Jerico, ginsunod hi Jesus hin damo nga mga tawo.
en: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

war: May duha nga buta nga nalingkod ha ligid han dalan nga nakabati nga hi Jesus nalabay, sanglit nagtikang hira paggoliat, “Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad kami!”
en: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

war: Ginbusaan hira han mga tawo ngan ginpahilom hira, kundi dinmugang la lugod hira paggoliat, “Anak ni David! Kalooyi kami!”
en: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

war: Hinmunong hi Jesus ngan gintawag hira. “Ano an iyo karuyag nga buhaton ko ha iyo?” nagpakiana hiya.
en: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.

war: Binmaton hira, “Ginoo, karuyag namon nga makakita kami!”
en: “Lord,” they answered, “we want our sight.”

war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha ira, ngan ginkamkam an ira mga mata. Nakakita dayon hira, ngan sinmunod hira ha iya.
en: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.

war: Han tikahirani na hi Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an han Jerusalem, inmabot hira ha Betfage, ha Bukid han mga Olibo. Ginpauna ni Jesus in duha han iya mga tinun-an
en: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,

war: Ngan kon may-ada magpakiana ha iyo, sidnga niyo hiya, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Ginoo,’ ngan ipadadara dayon ha iyo.”
en: If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”

war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsiring han manaragna:
en: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

war: “Sumati an syudad han Sion, maabot yana ngada ha imo an imo hadi. Mapinaubsanon hiya ngan nasakay hin asno, ug han iya nati.”
en: “Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ ”

war: Sanglit linmakat an mga tinun-an ngan gintuman nira an iginsugo ni Jesus ha ira.
en: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.

war: Gindara nira an asno ngan an nati, ngan ginhapinan nira han ira mga kurugpos, ngan sinmakay hi Jesus.
en: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.

war: An dako nga hugpo hin mga tawo nagbitad dida ha dalan han ira mga kurugpos, samtang an iba nangutod hin mga sanga hin mga kahoy ngan iginkatag nira ha dalan.
en: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

war: Han pagsulod na ni Jesus han Jerusalem, narigumok an bug-os nga syudad. Nagpakiana an mga tawo, “Hin-o man ini hiya?”
en: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”

war: Binmaton an hugpo han mga tawo, “Amo ini hi Jesus, an manaragna nga taga-Nazaret, ha Galilea.”
en: The crowds answered, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Iginsurat ha Kasuratan nga an Dyos nagsiring, ‘Tatawgon an akon Templo nga balay hin pag-ampo.’ Kundi ginhimo niyo ini nga tagoan hin mga tikasan!”
en: “It is written,” he said to them, “ ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”

war: Gindara ngada ha iya didto ha templo an mga buta ngan an mga lulid, ngan gintambal niya hira.
en: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.

war: Binayaan hira ni Jesus ngan ginmawas hiya han syudad ngadto ha Betania, ngan didto magpalabay hiya han gab-i hin pagpahuway.
en: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

war: Han pagkaaga na, han pagbalik ni Jesus ngadto ha syudad, ginutom hiya.
en: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.

war: Nakakita hini an mga tinun-an ngan nahipausa hira. Nagpakiana hira, “Kay ano nga nalaya man dayon an igos?”
en: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?” they asked.

war: Kon natoo kamo, kakarawaton niyo an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon dida hin pag-ampo.”
en: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”

war: Kundi kon sumiring kita, ‘Tikang han mga tawo,’ mahadlok kita han pagbubuhaton han mga tawo ha aton kay maaram an ngatanan nga manaragna hi Juan.”
en: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet.”

war: Sanglit ginbaton nira hi Jesus, “Diri kami maaram.” Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Diri ko man liwat kamo pagsusumatan kon ano an katungod ko hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang.
en: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Then he said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

war: “Yana, ano man an iyo paghunahuna? May-ada hadto tawo nga may duha nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an. Ginkadto niya an magurang ngan ginsiring, ‘Anak, pagtrabaho yana nga adlaw ha urubasan.’
en: “What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’

war: Binmaton ini hiya, ‘Diri ako magtratrabaho!’ kundi naliwat an iya hunahuna, ngan kinmadto hiya ha urubasan.
en: “ ‘I will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.

war: Niyan an amay kinmadto han manghod nga anak ngan amo gihapon an iya iginsiring, ‘Oo, makadto ako,’ binmaton hiya, kundi waray hiya makadto.
en: “Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.

war: Pag-abot na han panahon han panguha han mga ubas, ginsugo niya in iya mga oripon ngadto han mga saop hin pagkuha han iya bahin.
en: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.

war: Kundi gindakop han mga saop an iya mga oripon; ginbalbag nira an usa, ginpatay an ikaduha ngan ginbato an iba.
en: “The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

war: Nagsugo liwat an tawo hin iba pa nga mga oripon, labaw pa kadamo han syahan, kundi amo gihapon an ginbuhat ha ira han mga saop.
en: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.

war: Ha kataposan, ginsugo niya ngadto ha ira an iya anak nga lalake. Nagsiring hiya, ‘Ha waray ruhaduha tatahoron nira an akon anak.’
en: Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.

war: Kundi han pakakita han mga saop han anak, may hinsiring ha ira, ‘Anak ini han tag-iya. Tana, pataya ta hiya, ngan aangkonon ta an urubasan!’
en: “But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’

war: Sanglit gindakop nira an anak, iginlabog ha gawas han urubasan, ngan ginpatay nira.
en: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

war: “Niyan kon umabot na an tag-iya han urubasan, ano man an iya bubuhaton han mga saop?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.
en: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”

war: “Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo,” nagpadayon hi Jesus, “kukuhaon ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos ngan ihahatag ha mga Tawo nga makakahimo hin angay nga mga bunga. [
en: “Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

war: Masasamad an mahulog ngada hini nga bato; ngan mapipisa an mahulogan hini nga bato.]”
en: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”

war: Nakabati han mga pananglitan ni Jesus an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga Parisiyo, ngan nakasabot hira nga nagyakan hiya mahitungod ha ira,
en: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus’ parables, they knew he was talking about them.

war: sanglit nagtinguha hira hin pagdakop ha iya. Kundi nahadlok hira han mga tawo nga nakilala kan Jesus nga usa hiya nga manaragna.
en: They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.

war: Ginmamit gihapon hi Jesus hin mga pananglitan han iya pagyakan ha mga tawo.
en: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:

war: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad hin hadi nga nag-andam hin kombite han pagkasal para han iya anak nga lalake.
en: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

war: Nagsugo hiya han iya mga surugoon hin pagsumat han mga dinapit nga makadto na hira han kombite, kundi waray ini hira maruyag hin pagtambong.
en: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.

war: Kundi nagpaka bungol la an mga gindapit ngan nagpadayon la han ira mga buruhaton: kinmadto ha iya uma an usa, ngan ha iya tindahan an usa,
en: “But they paid no attention and went off—one to his field, another to his business.

war: samtang an iba nagdakop han mga surugoon, ginbalbag ngan pinanmatay nira.
en: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.

war: Duro an kasina han hadi; ginsugo niya an iya mga sondalo hin pamatay hadton nagpatay han iya mga surugoon ngan ginsunog an ira syudad.
en: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

war: Niyan gintawag niya an iya mga surugoon ngan ginsiring hira, ‘Andam na an akon kombite han pagkasal, kundi diri angay hini an gindapit ko nga mga tawo.
en: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.

war: Yana kadto kamo ha mga kadalanan ngan dapita niyo ngadto han kombite an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga igkita niyo.’
en: So go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.’

war: “Sinmakob an hadi hin pag-usisa han mga gindapit, ngan hinkit-an niya in tawo nga waray magbado hin bisti para hin pagkasal.
en: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.

war: Nagpakiana ha iya an hadi, ‘Sangkay, gin-unan-o nimo hin pagsulod dinhe nga waray ka man bisti para hin pagkasal?’ Kundi waray magtingog an tawo.
en: He asked, ‘How did you get in here without wedding clothes, friend?’ The man was speechless.

war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Kay damo an mga gindapit kundi gutiay la an mga ginpili.”
en: “For many are invited, but few are chosen.”

war: Linmakat an mga Parisiyo ngan naghunahuna hira hin pagbitik kan Jesus pinaagi hin mga pakiana.
en: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.

war: Sanglit pagsumati daw kami kon ano an imo paghunahuna: supak ba ha aton Balaod o diri an pagbayad hin buhis ngadto han Emperador han Roma?”
en: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?”

war: Kundi nakasabot hi Jesus han ira maraot nga panhunahuna, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Mga salingkapaw! Kay ano nga nagtatalingoha kamo hin pagbitik ha akon?
en: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, “You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?

war: Pakitaa daw ako hin kwarta nga ibinabayad para hin buhis!” Gindad-an hiya nira hin kwarta nga salapi.
en: Show me the coin used for paying the tax.” They brought him a denarius,

war: Ngan nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Kanay bayhon ug ngaran inin aanhi?”
en: and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”

war: “Kanan Emperador,” binmaton hira. Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kon amo ito, ibayad ngadto han Emperador an kanan Emperador, ngan ibayad man ngadto han Dyos an kanan Dyos.”
en: “Caesar’s,” they replied. Then he said to them, “So give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

war: Han pakabati nira hini, nanhipausa hira. Binayaan nira hiya ngan nagkalakat hira.
en: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.

war: Hito manta nga adlaw kinmadto kan Jesus in pira nga mga Sadusiyo. (Amo ini hira an nasiring nga waray pagkabanhaw an mga minatay.)
en: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

war: Amo liwat ini an nahanabo han ikaduha nga bugto, han ikatulo, hasta ngadto han ikapito.
en: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.

war: Ha kataposan namatay man an babaye.
en: Finally, the woman died.

war: Niyan, ha adlaw han pagkabanhaw, kanay man hiya asawa, kay nangasawa man an ngatanan ha iya?”
en: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?”

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Pagkasayop niyo! Tungod ini nga diri kamo maaram han Kasuratan o han gahom han Dyos.
en: Jesus replied, “You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

war: Kay kon mabanhaw na an mga minatay, sugad na hira han mga anghel ha langit, ngan diri na mag-aaragsawa an kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an.
en: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

war: Niyan, mahitungod han pagkabanhaw han mga minatay: waray ba niyo mabasa an ginsiring han Dyos ha iyo? Kay nagsiring hiya,
en: But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,

war: ‘Ako an Dyos ni Abraham, an Dyos ni Isaac, ngan an Dyos ni Jacob.’ Karuyag sidngon hini, nga Dyos hiya han mga buhi, diri han mga minatay.”
en: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.”

war: Han pakabati hini han mga tawo, nanhipausa hira han iya pagturon-an.
en: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

war: Nagkausa nga hugpo an mga Parisiyo han pakabati nira nga ginpahilom ni Jesus an mga Sadusiyo.
en: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

war: Ngan in usa ha ira nga magturutdo han Balaod karuyag magbitik kan Jesus pinaagi hin pakiana.
en: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:

war: Nagpakiana hiya, “Magturutdo, ano an gidadakoi nga sugo han Balaod?”
en: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “‘Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos ha bug-os mo nga kasingkasing, ha bug-os mo nga kalag, ngan ha bug-os mo nga hunahuna.’
en: Jesus replied: “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’

war: Amo ini an gidadakoi ngan labi ka importante nga sugo.
en: This is the first and greatest commandment.

war: Sugad hini an ikaduha hin ka importante nga sugo: ‘Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an igkasi tawo sugad han imo kalugaringon.’
en: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’

war: Dida hini nga duha nga sugo nasandig an bug-os nga Balaod ni Moises ngan an mga pagturon-an han mga manaragna.”
en: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”

war: Han katirok na han mga Parisiyo, nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira:
en: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

war: “Ano an paghunahuna niyo mahitungod han Mesiyas? Kanay man hiya tulin?” Binmaton hira, “Kan David.”
en: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose son is he?” “The son of David,” they replied.

war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kay ano man nga nag-aghat an Espiritu kan David pagtawag ha iya nga ‘Ginoo’? Kay nagsiring hi David,
en: He said to them, “How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him ‘Lord’? For he says,

war: ‘Nagsiring an Ginoo ngadto han akon Ginoo: Lingkod dinhe ha akon tuo, tubtob nga ibutang ko an imo kaaway ha ubos han imo mga tiil.’
en: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’

war: Sanglit kon gintawag man hiya ni David nga ‘Ginoo’, uunanhon man nga tawgon an Mesiyas nga tulin ni David?”
en: If then David calls him ‘Lord,’ how can he be his son?”

war: Waray hira makabaton kan Jesus hin bisan usa ka pulong, ngan tikang hadto nga adlaw waray na nagpasipara hin pagpakiana ha iya.
en: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ha mga tawo ngan ha iya mga tinun-an,
en: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:

war: “An mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an mga Parisiyo amo an tinagan hin gahom hin paghubad han balaod ni Moises.
en: “The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.

war: Sanglit, kinahanglan tumanon ngan sundon niyo an ngatanan nga iginpapabuhat nira ha iyo; kundi ayaw pagsubda an ira mga buhat, kay diri nira ginbubuhat an ira iginwawali.
en: So you must be careful to do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.

war: Nagbubutok hira hin magbug-at nga mga darad-on, ngan ira ini iginpapapas-an han mga tawo, kundi diri ngani nagamit bisan na man la usa han ira tudlo hin pagdara hito nga mga darad-on.
en: They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

war: Karuyag nira an gimauupayi nga mga lingkoran ha mga kombite ngan an linain nga mga lingkoran ha mga sinagoga;
en: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;

war: karuyag nira nga yumukbo ha ira an mga tawo didto ha mga taboan, ngan tawgon hira nga ‘Magturutdo.’
en: they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by others.

war: Diri kinahanglan tawgon kamo nga ‘Magturutdo,’ kay magburugto la kamo ngatanan, ngan uusa la an iyo Magturutdo.
en: “But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.

war: Ngan diri kinahanglan tawgon niyo nga ‘Amay’ an bisan hin-o dinhe ha tuna, kay uusa la an Amay niyo ha langit.
en: And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.

war: Ayaw kamo pagpatawag nga ‘Pangulo,’ kay an Mesiyas la an iyo pangulo.
en: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.

war: Kinahanglan mahimo nga iyo surugoon an gilalabawi ha iyo.
en: The greatest among you will be your servant.

war: Adton magpahitaas han iya kalugaringon, pauubson; ngan adton magpapaubos, pagpapahitas-on.
en: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.

war: Mga buta ngan mga lurong! Hain labaw ka importante, an bulawan, o an Templo ba nga nagsasantos han bulawan?
en: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?

war: Pagkabuta gud niyo! Hain in labaw ka importante, an halad, o an altar ba nga naguuray han halad?
en: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?

war: Sanglit kon nagsusumpa in tawo pinaagi han altar, nagsusumpa hiya pinaagi hini, ngan pinaagi han ngatanan nga halad nga aada hini nga altar;
en: Therefore, anyone who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

war: ngan kon nagsusumpa in tawo pinaagi han Templo, nagsusumpa hiya pinaagi hito ngan pinaagi han Dyos nga nag-uokoy dida han Templo;
en: And anyone who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.

war: ngan kon nagsusumpa in tawo pinaagi han langit, nagsusumpa hiya pinaagi han trono han Dyos ngan pinaagi ha iya nga nalingkod dida hini nga trono.
en: And anyone who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the one who sits on it.

war: Buta nga mga magturugway! Ginsasara niyo an langaw tikang han iyo irimnon kundi gintutulon niyo in kamelyo!
en: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.

war: Mga buta nga Parisiyo! Linisi anay an sulod han tasa, ngan magmamalinis liwat an gawas!
en: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.

war: Ha amo man nga paagi, nakikita han ngatanan nga maupay kamo ha gawas, kundi puno kamo hin mga pagkamalabyaw ngan mga sala ha sakob.
en: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

war: ngan nasiring kamo, ‘Kon kami an nabuhi han panahon han amon mga kaapoy-apoyan, diri unta namon ginbubuhat an ginbuhat nira hin pagpatay han mga manaragna.’
en: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’

war: Ha pagyakan niyo hini, inuuyonan niyo nga kamo mga tulin hadton nagpatay han mga manaragna.
en: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

war: Sanglit padayona ngan taposa niyo an gintikangan han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan!
en: Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!

war: Mga halas, ngan mga anak hin mga halas! Uunanhon niyo pakalikay han sirot han impyerno?
en: “You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?

war: Nasiring ako ha iyo: an sirot tungod hini ngatanan nga pamatay mahingangada han mga tawo hini yana nga panahon.
en: Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.

war: Yana babayaan an ngatanan han imo Templo ngan waray masasalin.
en: Look, your house is left to you desolate.

war: Nasiring ako ha imo: tikang yana diri ka makakakita ha akon tubtob nga masiring ka, ‘Paglipayon han Dyos hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo!’”
en: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”

war: Ginmawas hi Jesus ngan samtang nabaya hiya han Templo, dinmaop ha iya an iya mga tinun-an ngan ginpahinumdom hiya han mga balay han Templo.
en: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Pagbantay kamo ngan ayaw kamo palimbong bisan kan kanay.
en: Jesus answered: “Watch out that no one deceives you.

war: Kay makanhi ha akon ngaran in damo nga mga tawo ngan masiring, ‘Amo ako an Mesiyas!’ ngan malilimbongan in damo nga mga tawo.
en: For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.

war: Mag-aaruaragway an mga nasod ngan magpapagubatgubat an mga ginhadian. Magkakamay-ada mga kagutom ngan mga linog ha ngatanan nga dapit.
en: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

war: Ini ngatanan sugad han syahan nga mga kasakit nga babation hin tipagaranak.
en: All these are the beginning of birth pains.

war: “Niyan dadakpon ngan igtutubyan kamo basi kamo pagsirotan, ngan papatayon kamo. Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan nga mga tawo tungod ha akon.
en: “Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.

war: Damo in mabaya han ira pagtoo hadto nga panahon; magpapalingolingo ngan magpapadumotdumot hira.
en: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,

war: Niyan maabot in damo nga buwaon nga mga manaragna ngan damo an malilimbongan nira.
en: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.

war: Tungod kay magsasarang an karat-an, mahagkot an gugma han kadam-an nga mga tawo.
en: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,

war: Kundi matatalwas an magpadayon tubtob ha kataposan.
en: but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.

war: Ngan ini nga Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod han Ginhadian igwawali ha bug-os nga kalibutan hin pagpamatuod han ngatanan nga katawhan; ngan amo na an pag-abot han kataposan.
en: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

war: “Niyan makita kamo han Makaharadlok nga Taran-awon nga ginhinabe ni Daniel nga manaragna ngan matindog ini didto han baraan nga dapit.” (Para han magbarasa: hibaroi an kahulogan hini!)
en: “So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel—let the reader understand—

war: “Niyan adton mga aadto ha Judea kinahanglan kumalagiw ngadto ha kabukiran.
en: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

war: Kinahanglan diri na lumusad hin pagkuha han iya mga higamit ha sakob han iya balay an tawo nga aadto han atop han iya balay.
en: Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.

war: Kinahanglan diri na umoli hin pagkuha han iya kurugpos an tawo nga aadto ha uma.
en: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.

war: Kamakalilisang hito nga mga adlaw para han mga burod ngan han mga iroy nga may minasus-an!
en: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

war: Pag-ampo kamo sa Dyos nga diri unta ituman an iyo pagkalagiw ha panahon han kahagkot ngan kamauran o ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway!
en: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

war: An kasamok hadto nga panahon labaw pa kamakalilisang kay han bisan ano nga nahinabo tikang pa ha tinikangan han kalibutan ngada yana nga adlaw; ngan waray na sugad hini nga mahinanabo.
en: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now—and never to be equaled again.

war: Kundi ginpahalipot na han Dyos an kamaiha hini nga mga adlaw; kay kon waray pa, waray kunta mabubuhi. Ginpahalipot ini tungod han iya mga pinili.
en: “If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.

war: “Niyan kon may magsiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, iini na an Mesiyas!’ o ‘Aadto hiya didto!’—ayaw kamo tuod ha iya.
en: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.

war: Kay mapakita in buwaon nga mga Mesiyas ngan buwaon nga mga manaragna; magpapakita hira hin dagko nga mga tigaman ngan mga urosahon hin paglimbong, kon mahimo, han mga pinili han Dyos.
en: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

war: Tigamni niyo: daan ko na kamo ginpasidaanan hini.
en: See, I have told you ahead of time.

war: “Sanglit, kon magsiring hira ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, aadto hiya ha kamingawan!’ ayaw kamo pakadto; o kon magsiring hira ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, natago hiya dinhe!’ ayaw kamo tuod.
en: “So if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.

war: Kay maabot an Anak han Tawo sugad hin kikidlat nga naidlap ha bug-os nga langit, tikang ha sinirangan ngadto ha katundan.
en: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

war: “Kon hain an mga patay nga lawas, aadto man magtitirok an mga agila.
en: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

war: Ha amo man nga pagkaagi, kon hikit-an na niyo ini ngatanan, mahibabaro kamo nga hiraniay na hiya, aada na gud ha ganghaan.
en: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.

war: Hinumdomi ini niyo: mahinanabo ini ngatanan nga diri pa mapatay an ngatanan nga mga tawo hini nga katulinan.
en: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

war: Magpapapas pa an langit ngan an tuna, kundi magpapabilin an akon mga pulong.
en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

war: “Kundi waray maaram kon san-o maabot ito nga adlaw ug takna—bisan an kaanghelesan ha langit, bisan ngani an Anak, kundi an Amay la an maaram.
en: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

war: An pag-abot han Anak han Tawo masusugad han nahinabo han panahon ni Noe.
en: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

war: Sugad han mga adlaw nga waray pa an lunop, nagpinangaon ngan nag-inirignom an mga tawo. Nag-aragsawa an kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an tubtob han adlaw han pagsulod ni Noe han arka.
en: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;

war: Waray makasabot an mga tawo kon ano an nahinanabo ngada han pag-abot han lunop, ngan igin-anod hira ngatanan. Amo man liwat ito an mahinanabo kon umabot na an Anak han Tawo.
en: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

war: Hito nga panahon, duha ka tawo in magtratrabaho ha uma: kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.
en: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.

war: Duha nga babaye in maggigiling hin pagkaon: kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.
en: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.

war: Sanglit, pagbantay, kay diri kamo maaram kon san-o nga adlaw an pagkanhi han iyo Ginoo.
en: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.

war: Hinumdomi ini niyo: kon maaram la an amay han panimalay han takna han pag-abot han kawatan, mag-aagma manta hiya ngan diri matugot nga makasulod han iya balay an kawatan.
en: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.

war: Sanglit, tungod hini, kinahanglan nga dayuday andam liwat kamo, kay maabot an Anak han Tawo ha takna nga diri niyo hiya pamumulaton.
en: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.

war: “Sanglit, hin-o man an buotan ngan maaram nga surugoon? Amo hiya an gintaporan han iya agaron hin panimangno han iba nga mga surugoon, ngan paghatag ha ira pagkaon ha igo nga panahon.
en: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?

war: Pagkamalipayon hito nga surugoon, kon ha pag-oli han iya agaron, hiabotan hiya nga nagtutuman hini!
en: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod, itatapod han agaron ngada hini nga surugoon an ngatanan niya nga katigayonan.
en: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

war: Kundi kon maraot hiya nga surugoon, masiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, ‘Maiha pa umoli an akon agaron.’
en: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’

war: Ngan magtikang hiya pagtubal han iya mga igkasi-surugoon, ngan magpapatakas hin pagkaon ngan pag-inom upod han mga parahubog.
en: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

war: Niyan maoli an agaron hini nga surugoon ha adlaw nga waray niya pagpapaabota, ngan ha takna nga diri hiya maaram.
en: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.

war: Tatadtaron hiya han iya agaron, ngan paaagomon hiya han dadangatan han mga salingkapaw. Didto magtatangis hiya ngan manliligot hiya an iya mga ngipon.
en: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

war: “Hadto nga adlaw an Ginhadian han langit masusugad hin napulo nga kadaragan-an nga nagdara han ira mga suga ngan kinmadto hin pagtapo han karaslon nga lalake.
en: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

war: Mga waray buot an lima ha ira ngan mga may-ada buot an lima.
en: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.

war: Nagdara an mga waray buot han ira mga suga kundi waray hira magbalon hin idurugang nga lana.
en: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.

war: Kundi nagdara an mga may buot hin mga surudlan nga puno hin lana upod han ira mga suga.
en: The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.

war: Nalangan pag-abot an karaslon nga lalake, sanglit pinamiraw ini nga mga daraga, ngan nanhingaturog.
en: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

war: “Han katutnga na, may ginmoliat ‘Aadi na an karaslon? Pakadi na kamo ngan tapoa niyo hiya!’
en: “At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’

war: Nagkamata an napulo nga kadaragan-an ngan gin-andam nira an ira mga suga.
en: “Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.

war: Niyan sinmiring an mga waray buot ngadto han mga may buot, ‘Tagi gad kami han iyo lana kay nagtitikaparong na an amon mga suga.’
en: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’

war: Binmaton an mga may buot, ‘Ayaw, bangin diri masadang an lana para ha iyo ngan ha amon. Kadto lugod kamo ha tindahan ngan palit kamo para ha iyo.’
en: “ ‘No,’ they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’

war: “Waray pag-iha, inmabot an mga waray buot nga kadaragan-an, ‘Pasudla kami!’ ginmoliat hira.
en: “Later the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’

war: Kundi binmaton an karaslon, ‘Nasiring ako ha iyo: diri gud ako nakilala ha iyo.’”
en: “But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

war: Gintapos ni Jesus an pananglitan hin pagsiring, “Sanglit pagbantay kamo, kay diri kamo maaram han adlaw o han takna.”
en: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

war: Gintagan niya an tagsa ha ira hin puhonan sumala han iya pagkatakos: gintagan niya hin singko mil pesos an usa, dos mil pesos an ikaduha, ngan mil pesos an ikatulo. Kahuman, linmakat hiya.
en: To one he gave five bags of gold, to another two bags, and to another one bag, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.

war: Linmakat dayon an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin singko mil pesos ngan iginpatigayon an iya kwarta, ngan nakadugang pa hiya hin singko mil pesos.
en: The man who had received five bags of gold went at once and put his money to work and gained five bags more.

war: Ha amo man nga paagi, nakadugang pa hin dos mil pesos an kinmarawat hin dos mil pesos.
en: So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.

war: Kundi linmakat an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin mil pesos, nagbuho hiya ngan tagoon an kwarta han iya agaron.
en: But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.

war: “Paghagos hin maiha nga panahon, inmoli an agaron hini nga mga surugoon ngan nakigtuhay ha ira.
en: “After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

war: Niyan sinmulod an surugoon nga gintagan hin dos mil pesos ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, gintagan mo ako hin dos mil pesos. Kitaa! Aadi liwat in dugang nga dos mil pesos nga akon pinakabuhian.’
en: “The man with two bags of gold also came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with two bags of gold; see, I have gained two more.’

war: Nahadlok ako, sanglit linmakat ako ngan gintago ko ha tuna an imo kwarta. Kitaa, iini an kwarta. Waray ito kaibani.’
en: So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’

war: Nagsiring an iya agaron, ‘Maraot ngan hubya ka nga surugoon! Maaram ka man kunta nga nag-aani ako han waray ko igtanom, ngan nagtitirok ako han abot han uma nga waray ko igpugas,
en: “His master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?

war: kay ano man nga waray mo igbutang ha bangko an akon kwarta, basi ha akon pag-oli, karawton ko an puhonan, upod an patubo?
en: Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.

war: Yana, kuhaa niyo an kwarta ha iya ngan ihatag ngadto han surugoon nga may napulo ka yukot ka pesos.
en: “ ‘So take the bag of gold from him and give it to the one who has ten bags.

war: Kay tatagan hin labaw pa an ngatanan nga may-ada na, ngan mamamay-ada hiya labaw han kasadangan; kundi kukuhaon tikang ha iya nga waray bisan pa an gutiay nga aada ha iya.
en: For whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.

war: Mahitungod hini nga waray gamit nga surugoon—ilabog hiya ngadto ha kasisidman ha gawas; didto magtatangis hiya ngan manliligot hiya han iya mga ngipon.’
en: And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

war: “Kon makanhi na an Anak han Tawo sugad nga Hadi ngan upod niya an ngatanan nga mga anghel, malingkod hiya dida han iya hadianon nga trono,
en: “When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his glorious throne.

war: Ibubutang niya an mga karnero ha iya tuo, ngan an mga kanding ha iya wala.
en: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

war: Niyan masiring an hadi ngadto han mga tawo ha iya tuo, ‘Pakadi kamo nga ginpakaupay han akon Amay, ngan karawta niyo an ginhadian nga igin-andam para ha iyo tikang pa han kahimo han kalibutan.
en: “Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.

war: Ginutom ako, ngan iyo ako ginpakaon; inuhaw ako, ngan iyo ako ginpainom; waray nakilala ha akon, ngan iyo ako kinarawat ha iyo mga balay;
en: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,

war: lubas ako, ngan iyo ako ginpanaptonan; nasakit ako, ngan iyo ako ginmangnoan; napriso ako, ngan iyo ako ginbisita.’
en: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’

war: Niyan mabaton ha iya an mga magtadong, ‘Ginoo, kakan-o ngani kami kita ha imo nga ginugutom ngan ginpakaon ka, o inuuhaw ngan ginpainom ka?
en: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?

war: Kakan-o kami kita ha imo nga diri ka kinikilala ngan ginkarawat ka ngadto han amon mga panimalay o lubas ngan ginpanaptonan ka?
en: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?

war: Kakan-o kami kita ha imo nga masakit o priso, ngan ginbisita ka namon?’
en: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’

war: “Niyan masiring hiya ngadto han mga tawo ha iya wala: ‘Iwas kamo nga ginpanhimaraot han Dyos! Pakadto kamo han kalayo nga diri mapaparong nga gin-andam para han Yawa ngan han iya mga anghel!
en: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

war: Kay ginutom ako, kundi waray ako niyo pakaona; inuhaw ako, kundi waray ako niyo paimna.
en: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,

war: Waray nakilala ha akon, ngan waray ako niyo karawata ngadto han iyo mga panimalay; lubas ako, kundi waray ako niyo pagpanaptoni; nasakit ako ngan napriso, kundi waray ako niyo bisitaha.’
en: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.’

war: Mabaton ha ira an Hadi, ‘Nasiring ako ha iyo, kada pagdumiri niyo hin pagbulig han usa hini nga mga giuubosi, nagdumiri kamo hin pagbulig ha akon.’
en: “He will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.’

war: Sanglit ikakadto ini hira ha sirot nga waray kataposan; kundi mapakadto an mga magtadong ha dayon nga kinabuhi.”
en: “Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life.”

war: Katapos ni Jesus pagtutdo hini ngatanan, nagsiring hiya ha iya mga tinun-an,
en: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,

war: “Maaram na kamo nga duha na la ka adlaw ngan sasaurogon an Pyesta han Paglabay, ngan itutubyan an Anak han Tawo basi igraysang ha kros.”
en: “As you know, the Passover is two days away—and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”

war: Niyan nagtirok an mga puno han kapadian ngan an katigurangan nga mga Judiyo didto han palasyo ni Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.
en: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

war: Nagsarabot hira hin hilom la nga pagdakop kan Jesus, ngan pagpatay ha iya.
en: and they schemed to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.

war: Nagsiring hira, “Kinahanglan diri ta buhaton ini ha panahon han pyesta, kay bangin magkasaramok an mga tawo.”
en: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”

war: Han nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania didto han balay ni Simon nga sanlahon,
en: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,

war: hinmarani ha iya in babaye nga may dara nga tibod nga alabastro nga puno hin mahal nga pahamot. Ginbubo ini niya ha ulo ni Jesus samtang nakaon hi Jesus.
en: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.

war: Hinkit-an ini han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, ngan nasina hira. “Kay ano hin pagkaragi hini nga pahamot?” nagpakiana hira.
en: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. “Why this waste?” they asked.

war: “Mababaligya unta hin mahal ini nga pahamot ngan an kwarta mahahatag ha mga kablas!”
en: “This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor.”

war: Nasayod hi Jesus han ira ginyinakan, ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Kay ano nga ginsasamok man niyo an babaye? Maupay ngan makaruruyag an iya ginbuhat ha akon.
en: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.
en: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have me.

war: Iginbubo niya ha akon lawas ini nga pahamot para pag-andam han paglubong ha akon.
en: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

war: Hinumdomi niyo ini: bisan diin igwali ini nga Maupay nga Sumat ha bug-os nga kalibutan, hinanabihan manta an iya ginbuhat nga usa nga hinumdoman ha iya.”
en: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”

war: Kinmadto han mga puno han kapadian in usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, nga ginngangaranan kan Judas Iscariote,
en: Then one of the Twelve—the one called Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests

war: ngan nagsiring, “Ano man an ihahatag niyo ha akon kon itubyan ko ha iyo hi Jesus?” Nag-ihap hira hin 30 ka salapi ngan iginhatag nira ha iya.
en: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him over to you?” So they counted out for him thirty pieces of silver.

war: Tikang hadto nga takna naghingita na hi Judas hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus.
en: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

war: Gintuman han mga tinun-an an iginsugo ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gin-andam an kanan Paglabay nga pangaon.
en: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.

war: Han pagkagab-i na, linmingkod hin pagkaon hi Jesus ngan an dose niya nga mga tinun-an.
en: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.

war: Samtang nangangaon hira, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo, usa ha iyo in maglilingo ha akon.”
en: And while they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me.”

war: Duro an kabido han mga tinun-an ngan an tagsatagsa nagpakiana ha iya, “Ako ba, Ginoo?”
en: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, “Surely you don’t mean me, Lord?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “An madungan ha akon hin pagtunlob han iya tinapay ha plato, amo hiya an maglilingo ha akon.
en: Jesus replied, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.

war: Nagpakiana hi Judas, an malingo nga tawo, “Magturutdo, ako ba an karuyag mo sidngon?” Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ginyakan mo ini.”
en: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you don’t mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said so.”

war: Ngan kinuha niya an kupa, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan iginhatag ini ha ira upod an pagsiring, “Inom kamo ngatanan hini.
en: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.

war: Amo ini an akon dugo nga nagpapadig-on han ginsaaran han Dyos, an akon dugo nga gin-ula para han kadam-an, basi mapasaylo an mga sala.
en: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

war: Nasiring ako ha iyo nga diri na gud ako mainom hini nga bino tubtob han adlaw nga imnon ko an bag-o nga bino upod ha iyo didto han Ginhadian han akon Amay.”
en: I tell you, I will not drink from this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.”

war: Ngan nagkanta hira hin usa nga imno ngan nagpasingadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo.
en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

war: Kundi kon mabanhaw na ako, mag-uuna ako ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea.”
en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”

war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Diri gud ako mabaya ha imo bisan pa kon bayaan ka han ngatanan!”
en: Peter replied, “Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro, “Tigamni ini: diri pa matugaok an manok yana nga gab-i iglilirong mo na ako makatulo.”
en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”

war: Binmaton hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako maglilirong ha imo bisan kon patayon ako upod ha imo!” Ngan amo man an iginsiring han ngatanan nga mga tinun-an.
en: But Peter declared, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the other disciples said the same.

war: Igin-upod niya hira Pedro ngan an duha nga mga anak ni Sebedeo. Binmati hiya hin dako nga kasakit ngan kabido,
en: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.

war: ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Tugob hin kabidoan an akon kasingkasing nga haros ko ikamatay. Pabilin kamo dinhe ngan pagbantay upod ha akon.”
en: Then he said to them, “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”

war: Pagbantay ngan pag-ampo kamo, basi diri kamo mahulog ngadto hin kasulay. Andam an espritu, kundi maluya an lawas.”
en: “Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

war: Binmaya ha ira hi Jesus ngan nag-ampo, “Amay ko, kon diri man makukuha ini nga kupa labot kon imnon ko, matuman an imo kaburut-on.”
en: He went away a second time and prayed, “My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”

war: Binmalik liwat hiya ngan hin-agian niya an mga tinun-an nga nangangaturog kay piraw na gud hira hin duro.
en: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

war: Sanglit binayaan liwat hira ni Jesus, pinmaharayo hiya, ngan nag-ampo hin ikatulo, hin amo gihapon nga mga pulong.
en: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

war: Pagkabuhat kamo, pagkalakat na kita. Kitaa, aanhi na an tawo nga maglilingo ha akon!”
en: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”

war: Naghatag an malingo hin usa nga tigaman ngadto han mga tawo: “An tawo nga akon hadkan amo an iyo ginbibiling. Dakpa niyo hiya!”
en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him.”

war: Han pag-abot ni Judas, kinmadto dayon hiya kan Jesus ngan sinmiring, “Magturutdo, an kalinaw maada ha imo,” ngan ginhadkan hiya.
en: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Sangkay, tumana dayon an imo karuyag pagbuhaton!” Ngan dinmaop hira, gindakop nira hi Jesus, ngan gintalo hiya.
en: Jesus replied, “Do what you came for, friend.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.

war: Hinmulbot ha iya espada in usa han mga kaupod ni Jesus, ngan tigbason an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an usa niya nga talinga.
en: With that, one of Jesus’ companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

war: Sinmiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada, kay adton magamit hin espada, mapatay pinaagi hin espada.
en: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him, “for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

war: Diri ka ba maaram nga makakaaro ako hin bulig tikang han akon Amay, ngan ha gilayon magpapadara hiya ha akon hin sobra dose nga mga hugpo hin kasondalohan nga mga anghel?
en: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

war: Kundi kon buhaton ini, ano man hin katuman han Kasuratan nga nasiring nga kinahanglan ini mahinabo?”
en: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”

war: Kundi nahinabo ini ngatanan basi matuman an iginsurat han mga manaragna dida han Kasuratan.” Niyan an ngatanan nga mga tinun-an binmaya ha iya ngan nangalagiw.
en: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.

war: Gindara hi Jesus han mga tawo nga nagdakop ha iya ngadto han balay ni Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi, diin nagkatirok an mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an katigurangan.
en: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.

war: An mga puno han kapadian ngan an bug-os nga konseho nagtalinguha hin pagbiling hin sadang igbutangbutang kan Jesus basi patayon nira.
en: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.

war: Kundi waray gud nira hin-agian, bisan kon damo in dinmaop ngan nagsumat hin mga buwa mahitungod ha iya. Ha kataposan dinmaop in duha ka tawo
en: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

war: ngan nagsiring, “Nagsiring ini nga tawo, ‘Makakahimo ako hin pagruba han Templo han Dyos, ngan akon liwat titindogon sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.’”
en: and declared, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ ”

war: Tinmindog an Labaw nga Padi ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Waray ba nimo sadang ibaton hini nga sumbong kontra ha imo?”
en: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”

war: Ano an iyo ighuhukom?” Binmaton hira, “Salaan hiya ngan kinahanglan mamatay.”
en: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.

war: 67-68 Niyan gintuprahan nira an iya bayhon ngan ginlatob hiya. Nagsiring an mga nagtampalo ha iya, “Pagtagna ha amon, Mesiyas, tigoha kon hin-o an nagtampalo ha imo!”
en: and said, “Prophesy to us, Messiah. Who hit you?”

war: Nalingkod hi Pedro didto han libong ha gawas. Hinmarani ha iya in usa han mga babaye nga surugoon han Labaw nga Padi ngan sinmiring, “Upod ka liwat ni Jesus nga taga-Galilea.”
en: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. “You also were with Jesus of Galilee,” she said.

war: Kundi iginlirong niya ini ha atubangan nira ngatanan. “Diri ako maaram han imo ginyayakan,” binmaton hiya,
en: But he denied it before them all. “I don’t know what you’re talking about,” he said.

war: ngan ginmawas hiya ngadto han ganghaan han libong. Hinkit-an hiya hin lain nga surugoon nga babaye, ngan nagsumat hiya han mga tawo didto, “Kaupod hiya ni Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”
en: Then he went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

war: Kundi naglirong liwat hi Pedro ngan binmaton, “Iginsusumpa ko nga diri ako nakilala hito nga tawo!”
en: He denied it again, with an oath: “I don’t know the man!”

war: Waray pag-iha hinmarani kan Pedro an kalalaken-an nga nakadto. Nagsiring hira, “Waray ruhaduha usa ka ha ira, kay hinsasabutan namon pinaagi han imo pagyakan!”
en: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, “Surely you are one of them; your accent gives you away.”

war: Niyan nagsumpa hi Pedro ngan nagsiring, “Mamatay pa ako kon buwa an akon siring! Diri gud ako nakilala hito nga tawo!” Dida dayon tinmugaok in manok,
en: Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately a rooster crowed.

war: ngan nahinumdom hi Pedro han iginsiring ha iya ni Jesus, “Iglilirong mo ako makatulo nga diri pa matugaok an manok.” Ngan ginmawas hiya ngan nagtangis upod an pagbasol.
en: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.

war: Timprano pa han aga nagsarabot na an ngatanan nga mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan han mga Judiyo kon uunanhon nira hin pagpatay kan Jesus.
en: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people made their plans how to have Jesus executed.

war: Ginggapos nira hiya, gindara, ngan igintubyan kan Pilato, an gobernador nga Romano.
en: So they bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate the governor.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Nakasala ako kay akon igintubyan ha kamatayon an tawo nga waray sala!” Binmaton hira, “Ano man an amon labot hini? Imo na ito baratonon!”
en: “I have sinned,” he said, “for I have betrayed innocent blood.” “What is that to us?” they replied. “That’s your responsibility.”

war: Ipinilak ni Judas an kwarta ngadto han ruwang han Templo ngan ginmawas hiya. Katapos, linmakat hiya ngan naghikog.
en: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.

war: Ginpurot han mga puno han kapadian an kwarta ngan sinmiring hira, “Kwarta ini nga naunongan hin kinabuhi, ngan supak han aton Balaod nga ini ibutang didto han hiriposan han Templo.”
en: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, “It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”

war: Ira ginkatarangdoan nga gamiton an kwarta hin pagpalit han Uma han Maghirimo hin Daba, basi himoon nga lubnganan hin mga lumalangyaw.
en: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.

war: Sanglit ginngaranan an uma nga “Uma hin Dugo” ngada yana nga adlaw.
en: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

war: Sanglit natuman an iginsiring ni Jeremias nga manaragna: “Ginkuha nira an 30 ka bug-os nga salapi, an ginkatangdoan han mga tawo han Israel hin pagpalit ha iya,
en: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on him by the people of Israel,

war: ngan ginamit nira hin pagpalit han uma han maghirimo hin daba, sumala han sugo ha akon han Ginoo.”
en: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

war: Tinmindog hi Jesus ha atubangan han gobernador nga Romano ngan ginpakianhan hiya. “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?” “Imo ito ginyakan,” nagbaton hi Jesus.
en: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

war: Kundi waray hiya magbaton han mga sumbong han mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan.
en: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Pilato ha iya, “Diri ka ba nabati han ngatanan nga ira sumbong ha imo?”
en: Then Pilate asked him, “Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”

war: Kundi waray gud hi Jesus magbaton bisan na man la usa ka pulong, sanglit duro gud an paghipausa han gobernador.
en: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.

war: Kada Pyesta han Paglabay may batasan han gobernador hin pagbuhi hin bisan hin-o nga priso nga pangaroon han mga tawo.
en: Now it was the governor’s custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

war: Hadto nga panahon may kilala kaupay nga preso nga Jesus Barabas an ngaran.
en: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.

war: Sanglit han pagkatirok na han mga tawo, nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira, “Hin-o man an iyo karuyag nga akon buhian? Hi Jesus Barabas ba o hi Jesus nga ginngangaranan nga Cristo?”
en: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?”

war: Nasayod hi Pilato nga igintubyan nira hi Jesus ha iya tungod la hin kaawa.
en: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.

war: Ginhugay han mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan an mga tawo nga pangaroon nira kan Pilato nga buhian niya hi Barabas ngan patayon hi Jesus.
en: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.

war: Kundi ginpakianhan hira han gobernador, “Hin-o man hini nga duha an iyo karuyag nga akon buhian?” “Hi Barabas!” nagbaton hira.
en: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they answered.

war: “Kon sugad, ano man an akon bubuhaton kan Jesus nga ginngangaranan nga Cristo?” nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira. Nagbaton hira ngatanan, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”
en: “What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify him!”

war: Kundi nagpakiana hi Pilato, “Ano nga sala an iya nabuhat?” Ngan hira ha makusog nga tingog nagdurungan hin paggoliat, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”
en: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”

war: Binmaton an ngatanan nga mga tawo, “Kami ngan han amon mga anak an mabaton han kamatayon hini nga tawo!”
en: All the people answered, “His blood is on us and on our children!”

war: Niyan ginbuhian ni Pilato hi Barabas, iginpalatob niya hi Jesus, ngan igintubyan hiya ha ira basi igraysang ha kros.
en: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

war: Niyan gindara hi Jesus han mga sondalo ni Pilato ngadto han palasyo han gobernador ngan gin-alirongan hiya han bug-os nga hugpo han mga sondalo.
en: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

war: Ginlubasan hiya han iya panapton ngan ginsul-otan hiya hin hilawig nga pula nga bado.
en: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

war: Ginludhan hiya ngan kinuha nira an sipak han iya kamot ngan ginbalbag an iya ulo.
en: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

war: Kahuman na nira pag-oyan-oyan ha iya, ginlubas nira an hilawig nga bado, iginsul-ot an iya kalugaringon nga panapton, ngan gindara hiya ha gawas basi igraysang ha kros.
en: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.

war: Han tigawas na hira han bungto, iginkatapo nira in tawo nga ginngaranan kan Simon nga taga Cirene, ngan ginpirit ini hiya nira hin pagpas-an han kros ni Jesus.
en: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

war: Inmabot hira ha usa nga dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Golgota, nga an kahulogan, “An Dapit han Klabera.”
en: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).

war: Didto gintagan nira hi Jesus hin bino nga sinaktan hin apdo basi niya imnon. Kundi han pakatilaw ni Jesus, waray hiya uminom.
en: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

war: Niyan iginraysang hiya nira ha kros ngan ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa.
en: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

war: Pagkatapos, linmingkod hira ngan ginbantayan nira hiya.
en: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.

war: Iginpaskin nira ha igbaw han iya ulo an sinurat nga sumbong kontra ha iya: “Amo ini hi Jesus, an hadi han mga Judiyo.”
en: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews .

war: Ngan iginraysang liwat nira ha kros in duha nga mga tulisan upod kan Jesus, an usa ha iya tuo ngan an usa ha iya wala.
en: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

war: An mga tawo nga nangangagi nagpilingpiling han ira ulo ngan nagyubit kan Jesus hin pagsiring,
en: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads

war: “Ikaw man ngay-an an magruruba han Templo ngan magtitindog liwat hini sulod hin tulo ka adlaw! Pagtalwas na ha imo ngahaw kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos! Lusad dida ha kros!”
en: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!”

war: Ha amo man nga paagi ginyubitan hiya han mga puno han kapadian, han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan han katigurangan nga nasiring:
en: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.

war: “Gintalwas niya an iba, kundi diri hiya nakakatalwas han iya kalugaringon! Diri ba hiya amo an hadi han Israel? Kon lumusad hiya yana ha kros, matoo kita ha iya!
en: “He saved others,” they said, “but he can’t save himself! He’s the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

war: Nasarig hiya han Dyos ngan nasiring nga amo hiya an Anak han Dyos. Kitaon ta kon karuyag man han Dyos hin pagtalwas ha iya yana!”
en: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”

war: Bisan pa ngani an mga tulisan nga iginraysang upod ha iya nagbiaybiay ha iya.
en: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

war: Han pagka-udto, nagsirom an bug-os nga tuna sulod hin tulo ka oras.
en: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.

war: Nakabati ha iya an iba nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto ngan nagsiring hira, “Nagtatawag hiya kan Elias!”
en: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He’s calling Elijah.”

war: Dinmalagan dayon in usa ha ira, kinmuha hin espongha nga hinumog hin bino, igintaod ini ha kataposan hin sipak, ngan iginhungit ngadto kan Jesus hin pagpainom ha iya.
en: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.

war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hulat anay, kikitaon ta kon kumanhi manggud hi Elias hin pagtalwas ha iya!”
en: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him.”

war: Hin makusog nga tingog ginmuliat hi Jesus, ngan nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.
en: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

war: Tigda la nga nagisi ha butnga an biray han Templo, tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos. Nabay-og an tuna, nagkabubuka an mga bato,
en: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split

war: nagkaabre an mga lubnganan, ngan damo nga mga patay na nga magtinuohon han Dyos an nabanhaw.
en: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

war: Ginmawas hira han mga lubnganan; ngan katapos mabanhaw hi Jesus, kinmadto hira han Syudad nga Baraan, ngan didto hinkit-an hira hin damo nga mga tawo.
en: They came out of the tombs after Jesus’ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

war: Damo in kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Nagsinunod ini hira kan Jesus tikang pa ha Galilea, ngan nagbulig ha iya.
en: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.

war: Upod ha ira, amo hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy nira Santiago ug Jose, ngan an asawa ni Sebedeo.
en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.

war: Han kulopay na, inmabot in usa nga taga-Arimatea nga ginngaranan kan Jose. Usa hiya nga tinun-an ni Jesus.
en: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

war: Nakigkita hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus. Nagsugo hi Pilato nga ihatag an lawas kan Jose.
en: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

war: Sanglit gindara ni Jose an lawas ngan ginputos hin bag-o nga taklap nga lino.
en: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

war: Nakadto hira Maria Magdalena ngan an usa pa nga Maria, nalingkod ha atubangan han lubnganan.
en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

war: Han pagkasunod nga adlaw, nga amo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nakigkita kan Pilato an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga Parisiyo,
en: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.

war: ngan nagsiring hira, “Nahinunumdom kami nga han buhi pa adto nga buwaon, nagsiring hiya, ‘Mababanhaw ako katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.’
en: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuha kamo hin magbarantay ngan pabantayi ha iya hin maupay an lubnganan.”
en: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”

war: Sanglit nagkalakat hira ngan basi masiguro nga waray gud maglabot han lubnganan, ira gintimrehan an lubnganan, ngan ginpabantayan pa.
en: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.

war: Katapos han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, han nagmamanagbanag na ha aga han Domingo nga adlaw, kinmadto hin panginano han lubnganan hira Maria Magdalena ngan usa pa nga Maria.
en: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

war: Tigda la nga linminog hin makusog; kinmunsad tikang ha langit in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, ginkaliding niya an sada nga bato, ngan iya ini ginlingkoran.
en: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.

war: Sugad hin kikidlat an iya dagway, ngan duro kamabusag an iya panapton.
en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

war: Duro an pangurog tungod hin kahadlok an mga bantay, ngan waray hira makakiwa, sugad hira hin mga patay.
en: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

war: Ginsiring han anghel an kababayen-an, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Maaram ako nga ginbibiling niyo hi Jesus nga iginraysang ha kros.
en: The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

war: Waray hiya dinhe; nabanhaw hiya sugad han siring niya. Kadi ngan kitaa niyo an dapit nga ginhigdaan niya.
en: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

war: Sanglit ha kadagmitan, binmaya hira han lubnganan. Nakada pa ha ira an kahadlok, kundi puno hin kalipay, ngan nagdadlagan hira hin pagsumat han iya mga tinun-an.
en: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

war: Tigda la nga gintapo hira ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.” Dinmaop hira ha iya, kinaptan an iya mga tiil, ngan nagsingba ha iya.
en: Suddenly Jesus met them. “Greetings,” he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Kadtoa niyo an akon kabugtoan ngan sumati hira nga mapakadto hira ha Galilea, ngan didto makita hira ha akon.”
en: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”

war: Han pagkalakat na han kababayen-an, binmalik ha syudad in pira han mga sondalo nga nagbantay han lubnganan, ngan nagsumat han mga puno han kapadian han ngatanan nga nahinabo.
en: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

war: Nakigkita han katigurangan an mga puno han kapadian ngan nagsarabot hira kon ano an maupay buhaton. Ginhukipan nira an mga sondalo hin damo nga kwarta,
en: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,

war: ngan ginsiring, “Igsumat niyo nga kinmadto an iya mga tinun-an kagab-i ngan ginkawat an iya lawas, samtang nangangaturog kamo.
en: telling them, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’

war: Ngan kon makabati hini an Gobernador, kami na an labi nga maaram hin pagbaton ha iya ngan waray niyo sadang kabarak-an.”
en: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”

war: Ginkarawat han mga sondalo an kwarta, ngan ginbuhat nira an iginsugo ha ira. Amo ini nga sumat an iginpabantog han mga Judiyo tubtob ngada yana nga adlaw.
en: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.

war: Kinmadto ha Galilea an onse nga mga tinun-an, ha bukid nga ginpakadtoan ha ira ni Jesus.
en: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

war: Han pakakita nira ha iya, ginsingba hiya nira, bisan kon may-ada ha ira nagruhaduha.
en: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

war: Hinmarani hi Jesus ngan ginsiring hira, “Iginhatag ha akon an ngatanan nga gahom ha langit ngan ha tuna.
en: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

war: Sanglit pakadto kamo ha ngatanan nga mga katawhan ha bug-os nga kalibutan ngan himoa niyo hira nga akon mga tinun-an. Bunyagi hira ha ngaran han Amay, ngan han Anak, ngan han Espiritu Santo,
en: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

war: ngan tutdoi hira hin pagtuman han ngatanan nga akon iginsugo ha iyo. Ngan hinumdomi! Dayuday ako maupod ha iyo ha ngatanan nga katuigan tubtob ha katapos han kalibutan.”
en: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”

war: Amo ini an Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesu-Cristo nga Anak han Dyos.
en: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,

war: Nagtikang ini sumala han iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna: “Nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Iini an akon magsarangyaw, nga akon ipadadara hin pag-una ha imo, basi andamon niya an imo aagian.’
en: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way” —

war: May-ada usa nga naggiginoliat ha kamingawan, ‘Andama an dalan para han Ginoo; ngan tadonga an iya aagian!’”
en: “a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”

war: Pinmakita hi Juan didto ha kamingawan, diin namunyag hiya hin mga tawo ngan nagwali. Ginsiring niya an mga tawo, “Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan pabunyag kamo, ngan mapasaylo an Dyos ha iyo.”
en: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

war: Kinmadto an ngatanan nga mga tawo tikang ha katunaan han Judea ngan ha syudad han Jerusalem pamati kan Juan. Nagkompisal hira han ira mga sala ngan nabunyagan hira didto han Salog Jordan.
en: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

war: Hinimo hin buhok hin kamelyo an bado ni Juan, ngan anit an iya bakos ha hawak. Mga duron ug dugos ha kagurangan an pagkaon niya.
en: John wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

war: Ginsiring niya an mga tawo, “Labaw pa hin gahom ha akon an tawo nga masunod ha akon. Diri ngani ako takos maghubad han higot han iya mga sandalyas.
en: And this was his message: “After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.

war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, kundi magbubunyag hiya ha iyo han Espiritu Santo.”
en: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”

war: Waray pag-iha, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Nazaret nga bungto ha Galilea, ngan ginbunyagan hiya ni Juan didto ha Salog han Jordan.
en: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

war: Paghaw-as ni Jesus tikang ha tubig, kinmita hiya nga nabuksan an langit ngan kinmunsad an Espiritu Santo sugad hin sarapati.
en: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

war: Hinbatian in tingog tikang ha langit nga nasiring, “Ikaw an akon hinigugma nga Anak. Nalilipay gud ako ha imo.”
en: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”

war: Ha gilayon hi Jesus ginpakadto han Espiritu ha kamingawan.
en: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,

war: Nag-ukoy hiya didto hin 40 ka adlaw ngan didto ginsulay hiya ni Satanas. Didto hito nga dapit damo in ihalas nga kamanampan, kundi inmabot in mga anghel ngan nagtimangno ha iya.
en: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.

war: Han kabilanggo ni Juan, kinmadto hi Jesus ha Galilea ngan nagwali hiya didto han Maupay nga Sumat tikang sa Dyos.
en: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.

war: “Inmabot na an igo nga panahon,” nasiring hiya, “ngan haraniay na an Ginhadian han Dyos. Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan tuohi niyo an Maupay nga Sumat.”
en: “The time has come,” he said. “The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”

war: Samtang nalabay hi Jesus ha tabi han Lanaw Galilea, hinkit-an niya in duha nga mangirisda, hi Simon ngan an iya bugto, hi Andres nga nagtutunod han ira pukot hin pagdakop hin isda.
en: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Bunyog kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ta kamo hin pangisda hin mga tawo.”
en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

war: Binayaan nira dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.
en: At once they left their nets and followed him.

war: Nagtipaunhan hiya ngan hinkit-an niya in duha pa nga magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan, an mga anak ni Sebedeo. Nakadto hira han sakayan, nag-aandam han ira mga pukot.
en: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.

war: Pakakita ni Jesus ha ira, gintawag hira. Ginbayaan nira an ira amay, hi Sebedeo, nga nakadto ha sakayan upod in mga sinuholan nga mga tawo, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.
en: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.

war: Inmabot hira ha bungto han Capernaum ngan han pagkasunod nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway, sinmakob hi Jesus han ira sinagoga ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo.
