en: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.

war: Nahipausa an mga tawo han iya pagtutdo, kay diri man hiya sugad han mga magturutdo han Balaod ni Moises; lugod, an iya pagtutdo may-ada gahom.
en: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.

war: Hito nga takna, sinmakob han sinagoga in tawo nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan ginmoliat,
en: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,

war: “Ano an imo karuyag buhaton ha amon, Jesus nga taga-Nazaret? Pupuohon mo ba kami? Nakilala ako kon hin-o ka: Ikaw an baraan nga sinugo han Dyos!”
en: “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”

war: Ginsaway ni Jesus an maraot nga espiritu, “Ayaw hin aringasa. Gawas dida hito nga tawo!”
en: “Be quiet!” said Jesus sternly. “Come out of him!”

war: Binuntog an tawo, ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog, ngan ginmawas an maraot nga espiritu dida ha iya.
en: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.

war: Nahisangyaw dayon ha bisan diin nga dapit han katunaan ha Galilea ini nga hinabo nga ginbuhat ni Jesus.
en: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.

war: Ginmawas han sinagoga hira Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an, upod hira Santiago ug Juan ngan nagpadayon hira ngadto han balay nira Simon ug Andres.
en: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

war: Nahigda an ugangan nga babaye ni Simon kay hinihirantan. Pag-abot ni Jesus, ginsumatan hiya mahitungod hini nga masakit.
en: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.

war: Gindaop ni Jesus an masakit, kinaptan an kamot, ngan binuligan niya hin pagbuhat. Nalungasan an masakit han iya hiranat ngan nagdurot ha ira hin pagkaon.
en: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.

war: Pagkagab-i, katunod na han adlaw, gindara han mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus an mga magsakit ngan an mga sinasangkayan hin yawa.
en: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.

war: Nagtirok an mga tawo ha atubangan han balay.
en: The whole town gathered at the door,

war: Gintambal ni Jesus in damo kalain nga mga sakit ngan ginpagawas niya in damo nga mga yawa. Waray niya tugoti nga makagyakan an mga yawa, kay nakilala ini nga mga yawa kon hin-o hiya.
en: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.

war: Han temprano pa han aga, han waray pa sisidlit an adlaw,, binmuhat hi Jesus ngan linmakat. Ginmawas hiya han bungto ngan kinmadto hin mamingaw nga dapit ngan didto nag-ampo hiya.
en: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.

war: Kundi ginmawas liwat han bungto hi Simon ngan an iya mga kaurupod hin pamiling kan Jesus.
en: Simon and his companions went to look for him,

war: Paghiagii nira ha iya, ginsiring nira hiya, “An mga tawo nagpipinamiling ha imo.”
en: and when they found him, they exclaimed: “Everyone is looking for you!”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Pakadto kita ha iba nga mga baryo nga hiraniay dinhe hini nga dapit. Kinahanglan magwali liwat ako didto, kay amo ini an tuyo han akon pagkanhi.”
en: Jesus replied, “Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come.”

war: Sanglit nagsudoy hiya han bug-os nga Galilea, nagwali hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagpagawas hiya hin mga yawa.
en: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in usa nga sanlahon, linmuhod ha iya atubangan, ngan nakimalooy nga buligan hiya. “Kon imo karuyag,” nagsiring an sanlahon, “makakalinis ka ha akon.”
en: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, “If you are willing, you can make me clean.”

war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha iya. Gindun-an hiya ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko. Magmalinis ka!”
en: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!”

war: Nakuha dayon an sanla ngan naupay an tawo.
en: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.

war: Ginpaoli hiya upod an hugot nga pagtugon ha iya,
en: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:

war: Paglabay hin pira ka adlaw, binmalik hi Jesus ha Capernaum ngan nahibantog nga inmoli na hiya.
en: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.

war: Damo in mga tawo nga kinmadto, sanglit napuno an balay, bisan pa ngani an bungasaran ha atubangan han portahan. Han nagwawali hi Jesus ha ira,
en: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.

war: gindara ngada ha iya in usa nga lulid nga ginpasag hin upat ka tawo.
en: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.

war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira dako nga pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Anak, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”
en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

war: May-ada mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkakalingkod didto nga nagsiring ha ira ngahaw,
en: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,

war: “Kay ano nga ginmahom man hiya pagyakan hin sugad hini? Usa ini nga pagpanamastamas han Dyos? Waray tawo nga makakapasaylo hin sala; an Dyos la in makakahimo.”
en: “Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

war: Hain in masarosayon: an pagsiring ngada hini nga lulid, ‘An imo sala ginpasaylo,’ kon an pagsiring, ‘Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan lakat?’
en: Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?

war: Ipapakita ko ha iyo nga may gahom dinhe ha tuna an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala.” Sanglit ginsiring niya an lulid,
en: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the man,

war: “Nasiring ako ha imo, buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan uli ha iyo balay!”
en: “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha baybayon han Lanaw Galilea. Dinmaop in mga tawo ha iya ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira.
en: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal; ngan amo na an ira diri pagkaon.
en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.

war: Nahinabo nga naglatas hi Jesus ha kaumhan hin trigo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Samtang naglalakat hira, nangutos hin mga uhay an mga tinun-an nga upod niya.
en: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.

war: Nagsiring an mga Parisiyo kan Jesus, “Diri tugot han aton Balaod nga mangutos an imo mga tinun-an ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”
en: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Waray ba kamo makabati han ginbuhat ni David han nagkikinahanglan hiya hin pagkaon? Ginutom hi David ngan an iya mga sakop;
en: He answered, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginhimo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway tungod han tawo; diri an tawo tungod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

war: Sanglit an Anak han Tawo Ginoo bisan han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”
en: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha sinagoga diin nakadto in tawo nga patay an kamot.
en: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.

war: May-ada didto mga tawo nga karuyag magbutangbutang hin sayop kan Jesus, sanglit nag-inaw hira kon magtambal ba hiya ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.

war: Ginsiring ni Jesus an tawo nga patay an kamot, “Pakadi ha atubangan.”
en: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Stand up in front of everyone.”

war: Sanglit ginmawas an mga Parisiyo han sinagoga, ngan nakigkita dayon han iba nga mga kaapi han hugpo ni Herodes. Ngan nagkasarabot hira hin pagpatay kan Jesus.
en: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.

war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha lanaw han Galilea. Binmunyog ha iya in damo nga mga tawo nga tikang ha Galilea, ha Judea,
en: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.

war: Damo kaupay an mga tawo, sanglit ginsugo niya an iya mga tinun-an nga mag-andam hin sakayan basi diri hiya mapiit han mga tawo.
en: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.

war: Damo an iya mga gintambal, sanglit nagpirit gud an mga magsakit nga makaduok kan Jesus, basi la makakamkam ha iya.
en: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.

war: Nahapa ha iya atubangan an mga tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa kon nakita ha iya, ngan nagoliat, “Ikaw an Anak han Dyos!”
en: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, “You are the Son of God.”

war: Gintugon hin maupay ni Jesus an mga yawa nga diri magsumat kon hin-o hiya.
en: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.

war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan ginpadaop niya an mga kalalaken-an nga kinaruyag niya. Dinmaop hira
en: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.

war: ngan nagpili hiya hin dose nga iya ginngaranan nga mga apostoles. “Ginpili ko kamo basi umupod kamo ha akon,” nagsiring hiya, “ngan susugoon ko kamo hin pagwali
en: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach

war: ngan tatagan ko kamo hin gahom hin pagpaiwas hin mga yawa.”
en: and to have authority to drive out demons.

war: Amo ini an dose nga ginpili niya: hi Simon (ginngaranan hiya ni Jesus nga Pedro);
en: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),

war: hi Santiago ngan an iya bugto, hi Juan, mga anak ni Sebedeo (ginngaranan hira ni Jesus nga “Boanerges,” an karuyag sidngon, “Mga Tawo hin Dalugdog”);
en: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges , which means “sons of thunder”),

war: hira Andres, Felipe, Bartolome, Mateo, Tomas, Santiago nga anak ni Alfeo, Tadeo, Simon, an bayani,
en: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot

war: ngan hi Judas Iscariote nga naglingo kan Jesus.
en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.

war: Inmuli hi Jesus ngan gin-alirongan na liwat hiya hin damo nga mga tawo nga waray na ngani hiya ngan an iya mga tinun-an panahon hin pagkaon.
en: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.

war: Pakabati han iya kauropdan mahitungod hini, kinmadto hira hin pagkuha ha iya, kay nasumatan hira nga nawad-an na hiya hin maupay nga panmurubuot.
en: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, “He is out of his mind.”

war: Sanglit gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo ngan nagsumat hiya hin mga pananglitan: “Uunanhon man ni Satanas hin pagpaiwas ha iya ngahaw?
en: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?

war: Kon magkabahinbahin in usa nga nasod ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mapupukan ito nga nasod.
en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

war: Kon makabahinbahin in usa nga panimalay ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mabubungkag ito nga panimalay.
en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

war: Sanglit kon magkabahinbahin an ginhadian ni Satanas, diri ito mag-iiha, kundi mabubungkag ngan mapupukan.
en: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.

war: “Tigamni ini niyo: Mapapasaylo an mga tawo han ira mga sala ngan han magraot nga ira mga ginyakan.
en: Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,

war: Kundi diri mapapasaylo an tawo nga magpasipara hin pagyakan supak han Espiritu Santo.” (
en: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”

war: Ginyakan ini ni Jesus kay may-ada nasiring nga may-ada hiya maraot nga espiritu.)
en: He said this because they were saying, “He has an impure spirit.”

war: Inmabot an iroy ni Jesus ngan an iya kabugtoan. Waray hira sumakob han balay, kundi nagpatugon la hira nga may-ada tuyo nira ha iya.
en: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.

war: Nabubutnga hi Jesus hin mga nagkakalingkod nga mga tawo, ngan nagsiring hira ha iya, “Aadto ha gawas an iroy ngan kabugtoan mo, may-ada tuyo ha imo.”
en: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, “Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Hin-o an akon iroy? Hin-o an akon kabugtoan?”
en: “Who are my mother and my brothers?” he asked.

war: Sinmiplat hiya han mga nagkakalingkod nga mga tawo nga naglilibot ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Amo ini an akon iroy ngan an akon kabugtoan.
en: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!

war: Akon kabugtoan ngan akon iroy an bisan hin-o nga nagtutuman han iginpapabuhat ha iya han Dyos.”
en: Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”

war: Damo an igintutdo niya pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Dida han iya pagtutdo nagsiring hiya ha ira:
en: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:

war: “Pamati kamo! May-ada tawo nga kinmadto han iya uma hin pagsabod.
en: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.

war: Han nagsasabod hiya, may mga binhe nga nagkataktak ha dalan ngan pinanuktok han mga tamsi.
en: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

war: May-ada nahulog ngada hin batoon nga tuna. Tinmurok gad an binhe kay may-ada man manipis nga tuna.
en: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.

war: Kundi han pagsirak han adlaw, nalaya an mga tanom kay waray makagamot hin maupay, ngan nagkauuga.
en: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

war: May mga binhe nga nahulog ha mga tunokon nga kabanwaan. Han pagtubo han kabanwaan, naambongan an mga tanom; sanglit waray mamunga.
en: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.

war: Kundi may mga binhe nga nahulog ha maupay nga tuna. Tinmurok an binhe, tinmubo ngan namunga: may-ada namunga hin 30 ka pilo, 60 ka pilo an iba, ngan 100 ka pilo an iba liwat.”
en: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon hin-o ha iyo an may durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”
en: Then Jesus said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

war: Han nag-uusaan na la hi Jesus, dinmaop ha iya adton iba nga nakabati ha iya upod an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan naghangyo nga igsaysay niya an mga pananglitan.
en: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iginhatag ha iyo an pakasabot han mga natatago nga butang han Ginhadian han Dyos; kundi nakakasabot la adton diri kausa niyo pinaagi hin mga pananglitan,
en: He told them, “The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables

war: Ngan nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri ba kamo nakakasabot hini nga pananglitan? Uunanhon man ngay-an niyo hin pakasabot hin bisan ano nga pananglitan?
en: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?

war: An magsarabod nagsabod han mensahe han Dyos.
en: The farmer sows the word.

war: May-ada mga tawo nga sugad han mga binhe nga nahulog ha dalan. Pakakabati nira han mensahe, naabot dayon hi Satanas ngan inaagaw an mensahe ha ira.
en: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga nataktak ha batoon nga tuna. Pakakabati nira han mensahe, kinakarawat dayon nira nga malipayon.
en: Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.

war: Kundi diri gud napabilin ha ira kasingkasing, ngan diri nag-iiha. Sanglit kon naabot in kakurian ngan pag-antos tungod han mensahe, nabaya hira dayon.
en: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod dida hin tunokon nga kabanwaan. Nakakabati ini hira han mensahe,
en: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;

war: kundi natatabonan an mensahe han mga kabaraka hiunong hin nga kinabuhi, an paghigugma han manggad, ngan an iba nga mga karuyagon, sanglit diri nakakabunga.
en: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Kon may-ada nagdadara hin suga, tinatakloban ba niya ini, o ibinubutang ba ha sirong hin higdaan? Diri ba ikinakadto ha iya burutangan?
en: He said to them, “Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don’t you put it on its stand?

war: Ipadadayag an natatago; bubuksan an natatahoban.
en: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.

war: Kon hin-o an may mga durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”
en: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”

war: Tatagan pa adton may-ada na; kukuhaan adton waray, bisan han gutiay nga aada ha iya.”
en: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring: “Alid-agid an Ginhadian han Dyos hin tawo nga nagsabod hin binhe ha iya uma.
en: He also said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.

war: Kahuman niya pagsabod han binhe, nagpapadayon hiya han iya ikina-adlaw nga mga buruhaton, samtang naturok ngan natubo an binhe. Kundi diri hiya maaram kon ano an kasugad hini.
en: Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.

war: An tuna ngahaw an nakakapatubo ngan nakakapabunga: syahan, nananahon; niyan, namumukad; kahuman, namumunga.
en: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.

war: Kon hinog na an bunga, gin-aani han tag-iya, kay inmabot na an takna hin panguha.
en: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”

war: “Ano ba an aton ikatatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?” nagpakiana hi Jesus. “Ano nga pananglitan an sadang naton gamiton hin pagsaysay hini?
en: Again he said, “What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?

war: Amo ini nga pananglitan: Usa ka tawo nagtanom ha tuna hin liso hin mustasa, an gigugutiayi nga liso dinhe ha tuna.
en: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.

war: Nagwali hi Jesus ha mga tawo pinaagi hin alid-agid hini nga mga pananglitan. Ginsumatan niya hira sugad han ira hinsasabotan.
en: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.

war: Waray gud hiya magyakan ha ira kon diri pinaagi hin mga pananglitan; kundi kon an iya mga tinun-an la an iya kahimangraw, iya iginsasaysay an ngatanan ha ira.
en: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.

war: Han pagkagab-i hito manta nga adlaw, nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Talabok kita ngadto ha luyo han lanaw.”
en: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side.”

war: Sanglit binayaan nira an kadam-an nga mga tawo. Sinmakay han sakayan an mga tinun-an diin nakadto na hi Jesus, ngan tinmalabok hira. May iba nga mga sakayan didto.
en: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.

war: Inmabot in makusog nga alipuros ngan ginsasakayan na an ira sakayan hin mga balod nga haros mapuno na hin tubig an sakayan.
en: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.

war: Nakaturog hi Jesus didto ha may ulin; nakakaulon hiya ha iya paghigda. Ginpukaw hiya han mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, diri ka ba nababaraka nga magkakamatay na kita?”
en: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, “Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?”

war: Binmuhat hi Jesus ngan ginsaway niya an hangin, “Hugpoy na!” ngan an mga balod, “Pagmalinaw kamo!” Hinmugpoy an hangin ngan nagmalinaw.
en: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, “Quiet! Be still!” Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nahahadlok man kamo? Waray la gihapon kamo pagtoo?”
en: He said to his disciples, “Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”

war: Kundi duro gud an ira paghipausa, ngan may hinsiring ha ira: “Hin-o ini nga tawo nga nasugot man ha iya bisan an hangin ngan an mga balod?”
en: They were terrified and asked each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”

war: Inmabot hira ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea, didto han tuna han mga taga-Gadara.
en: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.

war: Han paghaw-as gud la ni Jesus han sakayan, gintapo hiya hin tawo nga tikang ha mga lungib nga lubnganan.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.

war: May-ada ini nga tawo maraot nga espiritu, ngan didto hiya pag-iinukoy han mga lubnganan. Waray na gud nakakagapos ha iya hin kadena.
en: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.

war: Makadamo na gaposa an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil, kundi nauutod la an mga kadena ha kamot ngan an pandog ha iya tiil. Makusog hiya hin duro nga waray gud nakakahawid ha iya.
en: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.

war: Adlaw gab-i nagsusudoysudoy hiya han mga linubngan ngan han mga pungtod, naggiginoliat ngan nag-uunay hin pagsamad ha iya ngahaw pinaagi han mga bato.
en: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.

war: Tay-aw hiya han pakakita niya kan Jesus. Sanglit dinmalagan hiya, hinmapa ha atubangan ni Jesus,
en: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.

war: ngan ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog: “Jesus, Anak han Gilalabawi nga Dyos! Ano an imo karuyag buhaton ha akon? Nakikimalooy ako ha imo, ayaw ako pagkastigoha!” (
en: He shouted at the top of his voice, “What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God’s name don’t torture me!”

war: Ginyakan ini niya kay nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya: “Maraot nga espiritu, gawas dida hini nga tawo!”)
en: For Jesus had said to him, “Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”

war: Sanglit ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Hin-o an imo ngaran?” Binmaton an tawo, “‘Panon’ an akon ngaran, kay damo kami.”
en: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

war: Waray hiya humunong pakimalooy kan Jesus nga diri pagawson an maraot nga mga espiritu dida hito nga tuna.
en: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.

war: May-ada dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon dida hin hirani nga pungtod.
en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.

war: Naghangyo kan Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, “Pasudla kami ngadto han kababoyan.”
en: The demons begged Jesus, “Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them.”

war: Nandadlagan dayon an magmarangno han kababoyan ngadto ha bungto ngan kaumhan hin pagsumat han nahinabo. Kinmadto an mga tawo pagkita han nahinabo.
en: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.

war: Dinmaop hira kan Jesus ngan kinmita hira han tawo nga may-ada anay mga yawa. Nalingkod hiya, diri na lubas ngan maupay na igkahimangraw. Ngan nahadlok hira ngatanan.
en: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

war: Nagsumat han mga tawo adton nakakita kon ano an nahinabo han tawo nga sinangkayan hin yawa ngan han kababoyan.
en: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.

war: Sanglit ginhangyo nira hi Jesus nga gumawas han ira tuna.
en: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.

war: Han naisarakay na hi Jesus, nakimalooy an tawo nga iniwasan hin mga yawa, nga paupdon hiya.
en: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.

war: Inmoli an tawo ngan nagsudoy hiya han Decapolis nga nagsinumat han ginbuhat ni Jesus ha iya. Dako an paghipausa hadton nagpakabati ha iya.
en: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han lanaw. Nag-alirong ha iya in damo nga mga tawo didto ha ligid han lanaw.
en: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.

war: Dinmaop ha iya hi Jairo, usa nga tinaporan han sinagoga. Pakakita niya kan Jesus hinmapa hiya
en: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.

war: ngan duro an iya pakimalooy ha iya hin pagsiring, “Masakit hin duro an akon anak nga babayehay. Kadtoa gud ngan ipadapat an imo kamot ha iya basi maupay hiya ngan diri mamatay!”
en: He pleaded earnestly with him, “My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live.”

war: Ngan inmupod hi Jesus ha iya. Damo liwat nga mga tawo an binmunyog kan Jesus ngan gindadaisog hiya han mga tawo.
en: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.

war: May-ada babaye nga makalilisang na an gin-antos tungod hin duro nga pagdinugoi ha iya hin dose na ka tuig,
en: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.

war: bisan kon damo na in nagtambal ha iya. Naubos na an iya kwarta, kundi waray hiya mag-upay; magtikadugang la lugod an iya sakit.
en: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.

war: Nasumatan hiya mahitungod kan Jesus; sanglit nagpirit hiya hin pagtampo han kadam-an, ngan pinmaluyo hiya kan Jesus.
en: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,

war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, “Kon makakapot la ako bisan la han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”
en: because she thought, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”

war: Kinaptan niya an bado ni Jesus, ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya; inabat niya nga naupay hiya han iya sakit.
en: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.

war: Nakasabot dayon hi Jesus nga ginmawas ha iya in gahom. Linmingi hiya hin pagkita han kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o in nagkapot han akon bado?”
en: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

war: Nagbaton an iya mga tinun-an, “Nakita ka nga ginlilibotan ka han mga tawo. Kay ano nga nagpapakiana ka pa man?”
en: “You see the people crowding against you,” his disciples answered, “and yet you can ask, ‘Who touched me?’ ”

war: Kundi gin-osisa gud ni Jesus kon hin-o an kinapot han iya bado.
en: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.

war: Nakasabot an babaye han nahinabo ha iya; sanglit dinmaop hiya kan Jesus nga nangungurog hin kahadlok. Hinmapa hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus ngan nagsumat han bug-os nga kamatuoran.
en: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Anak ko, nakaupay ha imo an imo pagtoo. Lakat nga malinawon, ngan mauupay ka han imo sakit.”
en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.”

war: Han nagyiyinakan pa hi Jesus, may-ada mga surugoon nga inmabot tikang ha balay ni Jairo. Ginsumatan nira hi Jairo, “Patay na an imo anak nga babaye. Ayaw na pagsinamoka an Magturutdo.”
en: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” they said. “Why bother the teacher anymore?”

war: Waray la makigbali hi Jesus han ira ginsumat, kundi ginsiring hi Jairo, “Ayaw kahadlok. Too la.”
en: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, “Don’t be afraid; just believe.”

war: Ngan waray ginpaupod ni Jesus, labot kan Pedro ngan han magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan.
en: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.

war: Inmabot hira ha balay ni Jairo diin hinkit-an ni Jesus an kasamok ngan hinbatian niya an mga pagnguyngoy ngan pagtangis.
en: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.

war: Sinmakob hiya ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Ano ini nga kasamok? Kay ano nga nagtitinangis man kamo? Diri patay an bata; nakaturog la hiya.”
en: He went in and said to them, “Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep.”

war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan sidngon, “Talitha, koum,” kon ha aton pa, “Babayehay, pinapabuhat ko ikaw!”
en: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha koum!” (which means “Little girl, I say to you, get up!” ).

war: Binmuhat dayon an bata ngan nagtikang hin paglakat. (Dose na an edad han bata.) Dako gud an ira paghipausa hini nga nahinabo.
en: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.

war: Kundi gindid-an hira ni Jesus hin pagsumat hini bisan kan kanay, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Tagi hiya hin pagkaon.”
en: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.

war: Binmaya hi Jesus hito nga dapit ngan inmoli ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto ngan an iya mga tinun-an sinmunod ha iya.
en: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Tinatahod an manaragna bisan diin nga dapit labot la dida han iya kalugaringon nga bungto, han iya kauropdan ngan han iya panimalay.”
en: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home.”

war: Waray hiya makahimo hin pagbuhat hin mga milagro didto, labot la nga gindun-an ngan gintambal niya in pira nga mga magsakit.
en: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.

war: Dako an iya paghipausa tungod han kawaray nira pagtoo. Nagsudoy hi Jesus han mga baryo didto hito nga dapit ngan nagtutdo han mga tawo.
en: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.

war: Gintirok niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan iya ginsugo hin padispadis. Tinagan niya hira hin gahom hin pakadaog han mga yawa
en: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.

war: ngan gintugon hira niya, “Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bisan ano ha iyo paglakaton, labot hin tungkod; ayaw pagdara hin pagkaon, hin supot ngan hin kwarta ha iyo mga bulsa.
en: These were his instructions: “Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.

war: Pagsul-ot kamo hin sandalyas kundi ayaw pagdara hin liliwanan.”
en: Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.

war: Gintugon pa hira, “Kon diin kamo nga balay karawata ngan pasak-a pabilin kamo dida ngahaw tubtob han iyo pagbaya hito nga dapit.
en: Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.

war: Kon diri kamo karawaton ha usa nga dapit o diri kamo pamatian, bayai ito nga dapit katapos niyo padpara an tapotapo ha iyo mga tiil. Usa ini nga pahimangno ha ira.”
en: And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”

war: Sanglit nagkalakat ngan nagwali hira nga kinahanglan bumaya an mga tawo han ira mga sala.
en: They went out and preached that people should repent.

war: Nagpaiwas hira hin damo nga mga yawa, ngan nagdihog hira hin lana ha damo nga mga magsakit, ngan gin-upay nira hira.
en: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.

war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hi Elias hiya.” Nagsiring liwat an iba, “Manaragna hiya sugad hin usa nga bantogan nga manaragna hadton mga una pa nga panahon.”
en: Others said, “He is Elijah.” And still others claimed, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago.”

war: Han pakabati hini ni Herodes, nagsiring hiya, “Amo hiya hi Juan nga Parabunyag! Ginpapugotan ko na hiya, kundi nabuhi liwat!”
en: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!”

war: Waray hunong hin pagsinaway ni Juan kan Herodes, “Diri matadong nga buhat an pag-asawa mo han asawa han imo bugto!”
en: For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

war: Sanglit nagdumot hi Herodias kan Juan ngan karuyag niya patayon, kundi waray hiya makahimo tungod kan Herodes.
en: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,

war: Pinaagi hin damo nga panumpa, nagsiring ha iya na hadi, “Nagsasaad ako nga tatagan ta ikaw han imo karuyag aroon, bisan pa an katunga han akon ginhadian.”
en: And he promised her with an oath, “Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom.”

war: Ginmawas an daragita ngan pinmakiana han iroy niya kon ano an iya aaroon. Binmaton an iroy niya, “An ulo ni Juan nga Parabunyag.”
en: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask for?” “The head of John the Baptist,” she answered.

war: Nabido kaupay an hadi; kundi waray hiya makabaribad, kay nagsaad hiya ha atubangan han iya nga dinapit.
en: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.

war: Sanglit ginsugo niya in gwardya han bilanggoan nga dad-on an ulo ni Juan. Linmakat an gwardya, kinmadto ha bilanggoan, ngan ginpugotan hi Juan.
en: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,

war: Gindara niya an ulo nga sinangga hin plato, ngan iginhatag niya han daragita, ngan ihinatag han daragita ngadto han iroy niya.
en: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.

war: Pakabati hini han mga tinun-an ni Juan, kinmadto hira pagkuha han iya lawas ngan iginlubong nira.
en: On hearing of this, John’s disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.

war: Binmalik ngan nakigkita kan Jesus an mga apostoles ngan ginsumatan hiya nira han ngatanan nga ira ginbuhat ngan gintutdo.
en: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.

war: Sanglit sinmakay hira hin sakayan ngadto hin dapit nga mamingaw.
en: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.

war: Han kulopay na, dinmaop an iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Tikagab-i na, ngan tay-aw ini nga dapit.
en: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. “This is a remote place,” they said, “and it’s already very late.

war: Palakta na an mga tawo ngan pakadtoa na la hira ha mga higrani nga kaumhan ngan kabaryohan, basi makapalit hira hin sadang makaon.”
en: Send the people away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kamo ngahaw in hatag ha ira hin pagkaon.” Nagpakiana hira, “Karuyag ba nimo nga lumakat kami pagpalit hin kanan 400.00 nga tinapay ngan ipakaon ha ira?”
en: But he answered, “You give them something to eat.” They said to him, “That would take more than half a year’s wages ! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?”

war: Pinmakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “Pipira la an iyo tinapay? Panginanoa daw niyo.” Han kasayod na nira, ginsumatan hiya, “Lima la ka bug-os ngan duha nga isda.”
en: “How many loaves do you have?” he asked. “Go and see.” When they found out, they said, “Five—and two fish.”

war: Ginsugo ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an nga pagpurupundokon hira hin pagkalingkod dida han kabanwaan.
en: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.

war: Sanglit nagpurupundok an mga tawo hin tinag 100 ngan tinag 50.
en: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.

war: Nanngaon an ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog.
en: They all ate and were satisfied,

war: Kahuman, nakatirok pa an mga tinun-an hin dose ka alat han nahisalin nga mga tinapay ngan isda.
en: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.

war: Lima ka yukot nga kalalaken-an an nangaon han tinapay.
en: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.

war: Samtang ginpapaoli ni Jesus an mga tawo, ginpasakay dayon niya an iya mga tinun-an basi mag-una ha iya ngadto ha Betsaida, ha tabok han lanaw.
en: Immediately Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.

war: Kahuman niya manamilit han iya mga tinun-an, kinmadto hiya hin usa nga pungtod basi hiya mag-ampo.
en: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.

war: Han pagkagab-i na, nakadto na an sakayan ha butnga han lanaw, samtang nag-uusaan la hi Jesus didto ha sagka.
en: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.

war: Kundi kinmita hira nga naglalakat hiya ha bawbaw han tubig. Hunahuna nira nga murto adto, sanglit ginmoliat hira
en: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,

war: hin kahadlok han pakakita nira ngatanan ha iya. Nagyakan dayon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Hi ako ini!”
en: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, “Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

war: Sinmakay hiya han sakayan upod ha ira ngan hinmugpoy dayon an hangin. Duro an paghipausa han mga tinun-an,
en: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,

war: kay waray nira hisabti an kahulogan han pagpadamo han mga tinapay; makuri pa adto matugkad han ira mga hunahuna.
en: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.

war: Tinmabok hira han lanaw ngan inmabot hira ha Genesaret diin iginhigot nira an ira sakayan.
en: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.

war: Han nabaya na hira han sakayan, kinmilala dayon kan Jesus an mga tawo.
en: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.

war: Sanglit nagdagmit hira hin pagsudoy ngan pagsumat han mga tawo ha bug-os nga dapit, ngan gindara an mga magsakit nga nahigda ha banig ngadto kan Jesus.
en: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.

war: Nag-alirong kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan in pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkaabot tikang ha Jerusalem.
en: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus

war: Nagsusunod an mga Parisiyo, sugad man an iba nga mga Judiyo han pagturon-an nga nababatasan han ira mga kaapoy-apoyan. Diri hira nakaon kon diri anay manhunaw han amo nga paagi,
en: (The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they give their hands a ceremonial washing, holding to the tradition of the elders.

war: Kawang la an ira pagsingba ha akon, kay gintututdo nira an kanan tawo kasugoanan nga daw sugad hin kanan Dyos mga lagda!’
en: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’

war: “Sinasalikway niyo an sugo han Dyos ngan asay niyo gintutuman an mga pagturon-an han mga tawo.”
en: You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus pagsiring ha ira, “Listo gud kamo lumikay han kanan Dyos balaod basi la igpadayon niyo an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an.
en: And he continued, “You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!

war: Kay hi Moises nagsugo, ‘Tahoron mo an amay ngan iroy nimo ngan kinahanglan patayon adton magpapakaraot han amay ngan iroy niya.’
en: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’

war: Kundi nagtututdo kamo nga kon may-ada sadang ikabulig in tawo han amay ngan iroy niya, kundi kon sumiring hiya, ‘Corban ini’ (karuyag sidngon, kanan Dyos ito),
en: But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is Corban (that is, devoted to God)—

war: waray na niya labot pagbulig han amay o iroy niya.
en: then you no longer let them do anything for their father or mother.

war: Kon sugad, gindidiwara niyo an pulong han Dyos pinaagi han pagturon-an nga igintututdo niyo ha iba nga mga tawo. Ngan ginbubuhat niyo in damo pa nga mga butang nga alid-agid hini.”
en: Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that.”

war: Gintawag ngahaw ni Jesus an kadam-an ngada ha iya ngan ginsiring hira, “Pamati kamo ngatanan ngan sabta niyo.
en: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.

war: Waray bisan ano nga nasulod ha tawo tikang ha gawas nga nakakapahugaw ha iya, kundi adton nagawas tikang han tawo amo lugod an nakakapahugaw ha iya. [
en: Nothing outside a person can defile them by going into them. Rather, it is what comes out of a person that defiles them.”

war: Han pagbaya na niya han kadam-an ngan pagsulod na niya han balay, nagpakiana an iya mga tinun-an ha iya mahitungod hini nga pananglitan.
en: After he had left the crowd and entered the house, his disciples asked him about this parable.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Sugad la kamo han iba hin kamahinay makasabot! Diri ba kamo nasabot nga waray bisan ano nga nasulod ha tawo tikang ha gawas nga nakakapahugaw ha iya?
en: “Are you so dull?” he asked. “Don’t you see that nothing that enters a person from the outside can defile them?

war: Kay diri ito nasulod ha iya kasingkasing kundi ha iya tiyan, ngan onina, iginuguwa.” (Dida hini iginpahayag ni Jesus nga mahihimo kaonon an ngatanan nga pagkaon.)
en: For it doesn’t go into their heart but into their stomach, and then out of the body.” (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods clean.)

war: Ngan nagpadayon hiya pagsiring, “An naguwa tikang ha tawo amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.
en: He went on: “What comes out of a person is what defiles them.

war: Kay tikang ha sakob, tikang ha kasingkasing, naguwa an magraot nga mga panhunahuna nga nakakaaghat hin panikas, pamatay,
en: For it is from within, out of a person’s heart, that evil thoughts come—sexual immorality, theft, murder,

war: pakighilawas, kaipa han kanan iba butang, paglimbong, kamalaw-ay, pangabugho, pakaraot, pagparayaw ngan tinuyaw nga buhat.
en: adultery, greed, malice, deceit, lewdness, envy, slander, arrogance and folly.

war: Natikang ha sakob han tawo ini ngatanan ngan amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.”
en: All these evils come from inside and defile a person.”

war: Binmaya hi Jesus ngan kinmadto han tuna hirani han syudad han Tiro. Sinmulod hiya hin balay, ngan diri niya karuyag nga may mahibaro nga nakadto hiya; kundi diri gud hiya natatago.
en: Jesus left that place and went to the vicinity of Tyre. He entered a house and did not want anyone to know it; yet he could not keep his presence secret.

war: Nahibaroan an iya pag-abot hin usa nga babaye, kanay anak nga babayehay may maraot nga espiritu. Kinmadto dayon hiya kan Jesus ngan hinmapa ha iya tiilan.
en: In fact, as soon as she heard about him, a woman whose little daughter was possessed by an impure spirit came and fell at his feet.

war: Langyaw ini nga babaye nga natawo ha Fenicia, didto ha Siria. Nakimalooy hiya kan Jesus nga pagawson an yawa tikang han iya anak.
en: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.

war: Kundi nagbaton hi Jesus, “Pakaona ta anay an mga anak; diri maupay nga kuhaon an pagkaon han mga anak, ngan ilabog ngadto han mga ayam.”
en: “First let the children eat all they want,” he told her, “for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”

war: “Matuod gad ini,” binmaton an babaye, “kundi bisan an mga ayam ha sirong han lamesa ngangangaon man han mga salin han mga anak!”
en: “Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Tungod hini nga imo baton, makakaoli ka na. Ginmawas na an yawa tikang han imo anak!”
en: Then he told her, “For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”

war: Inmoli an babaye ngan hin-agian niya an iya anak nga nahigda ngan ginmawas na tikang ha iya an yawa.
en: She went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.

war: Binmaya hi Jesus han tuna nga hirani ha Tiro ngan inmagi ha Sidon ngadto han lanaw han Galilea, ngan naglatas han mga tuna han Decapolis.
en: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.

war: Gindara ha iya in tawo nga bungol ngan makuri makayakan, ngan nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga nagdara nga dun-an niya ini nga tawo.
en: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged Jesus to place his hand on him.

war: Ibinulag hiya anay ni Jesus han kadam-an, ngan ibinutang ni Jesus an iya mga tudlo dida han kanan tawo nga talinga. Linmura hiya ngan iya kinamkam an dila han tawo.
en: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the man’s ears. Then he spit and touched the man’s tongue.

war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ha langit ngan nangaraba ngan ginsiring an tawo, “ Ephphatha” , karuyag sidngon, “Mabuksan ka!”
en: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means “Be opened!” ).

war: Nakabati dayon an tawo, nawara na an iya kangula, ngan maupay na an iya pagyakan.
en: At this, the man’s ears were opened, his tongue was loosened and he began to speak plainly.

war: Gindid-an hira ni Jesus pagsumat hini bisan kan kanay; kundi dinmugang lugod hira hin pagsinumat.
en: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.

war: Ngan nanhipausa hin duro an ngatanan nga nagpakabati. Nagsiring hira, “Pagkamaupay han ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat! Ginpabati niya an mga bungol ngan ginpayakan niya an mga ngula!”
en: People were overwhelmed with amazement. “He has done everything well,” they said. “He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak.”

war: Waray pag-iha nagkatirok na liwat in kadam-an nga mga tawo. Han waray na nira pagkaon, gintawag ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring hira,
en: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,

war: “Nalolooy ako hini nga mga tawo kay upod hira nakon sulod hin tulo na ka adlaw, ngan waray na nira pagkaon.
en: “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.

war: Kon paolion ko hira nga mga gutom, manhihiraptay hira ha dalan kay hirayo an oolian an iba ha ira.”
en: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”

war: Nagpakiana ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Hain man kita pakakaagi dinhe hini nga kamingawan hin igo kadamo nga pagkaon nga igdudurot hini ngatanan nga mga tawo?”
en: His disciples answered, “But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?”

war: “Pipira pa man an iyo tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira. “Pipito na la,” binmaton hira.
en: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.

war: May-ada liwat nira pira ka bug-os nga gudtiay nga mga isda. Nagpasalamat ngahaw hi Jesus tungod hini ngan nagsugo hiya han iya mga tinun-an nga ipanhatag liwat.
en: They had a few small fish as well; he gave thanks for them also and told the disciples to distribute them.

war: Nangaon ngan nagkabubusog an ngatanan—may mga upat ka yukot adto nga mga tawo.
en: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

war: Gintirok han mga tinun-an an mga nanhisalin, ngan nakapuno pa hira hin pito ka alat. Pinapangoli ni Jesus an mga tawo,
en: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,

war: ngan sinmakay dayon hiya han sakayan upod an iya mga tinun-an, ngan kinmadto hira han tuna han Dalmanuta.
en: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.

war: Nagkaabot in mga Parisiyo ngan nagtikang pakiglantugi kan Jesus. Karuyag nira pagbitik ha iya sanglit nangaro hira nga magbuhat hiya hin milagro nga magpapakita nga uyon ha iya an Dyos.
en: The Pharisees came and began to question Jesus. To test him, they asked him for a sign from heaven.

war: Binayaan niya hira, sinmakay hiya han sakayan, ngan tinmabok han lanaw.
en: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.

war: Nanhingalimot an mga tinun-an pagdara hin igo kadamo nga tinapay, ngan usa la ka bug-os an ira balon ha sakayan.
en: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.

war: “Panginano ngan pagbantay kamo han patubo han mga Parisiyo ngan han patubo ni Herodes,” nagpahimangno hi Jesus ha ira.
en: “Be careful,” Jesus warned them. “Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod.”

war: Naghirohimangraw an mga tinun-an ha ira la ngahaw: “Nasiring hiya hini kay waray man kita dara nga tinapay.”
en: They discussed this with one another and said, “It is because we have no bread.”

war: May-ada niyo mga mata—diri ba kamo nakita? May-ada niyo mga talinga—diri ba kamo nabati? Hinngalimtan na ba niyo
en: Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And don’t you remember?

war: an pagpinitpinit ko han lima nga mga tinapay para han lima ka yukot ngan mga tawo? Pira ka alat an natirok niyo han nanhisalin pa nga mga tinapay?” “Dose,” nagbaton hira.
en: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?” “Twelve,” they replied.

war: “Diri la kamo gihapon nakakasabot?” nagpakiana hiya ha ira.
en: He said to them, “Do you still not understand?”

war: Inmabot hira ha Betsaida. Gindara hin pira nga mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus in buta, ngan nakimalooy hira nga kaptan hiya ni Jesus.
en: They came to Bethsaida, and some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.

war: Hinmangad an tawo ngan binmaton, “Oo, nakita ako hin mga tawo, kundi sugad hira hin mga kahoy nga nagkakalakat.”
en: He looked up and said, “I see people; they look like trees walking around.”

war: Idinuon liwat ni Jesus an iya mga kamot dida han mga mata han tawo. Tinmutok hin maupay an buta; nahibalik an iya pagkita, ngan klaro na gud an iya pagkita han ngatanan.
en: Once more Jesus put his hands on the man’s eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.

war: Ginpaoli hiya ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Ayaw na pagbalik ngadto ha baryo.”
en: Jesus sent him home, saying, “Don’t even go into the village.”

war: Binmaton hira, “May nasiring nga ikaw amo hi Juan nga Parabunyag. Nasiring an iba, hi Elias ka; samtang nasiring naman an iba, usa ka han mga manaragna.”
en: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”

war: “Hi kamo—ano man an isisiring niyo? Hin-o gud ako?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira. Binmaton hi Pedro, “Ikaw an Mesiyas.”
en: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Messiah.”

war: Ngan nagsugo hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay mahitungod ha akon.”
en: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.

war: Iginsumat niya ini hin waray lipodlipod ha ira. Ibinulag anay ni Pedro hi Jesus ngan nakiglantugi ha iya.
en: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

war: Kay adton karuyag matalwas han iya kinabuhi, ini mawawara ha iya; kundi adton mamatay tungod ha akon ngan han Maupay nga Sumat, mabubuhi hiya.
en: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.

war: May-ada ba kaupayan nga makukuha hin tawo kon maangkon niya an bug-os nga kalibutan, kundi kawad-an hiya han iya kinabuhi? Waray gud!
en: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?

war: Waray gud sadang ikahatag hin tawo basi mabawi an iya kinabuhi.
en: Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?

war: Nagsilaw an iya panapton ngan nagmabusag hin duro. Waray bisan hin-o dinhe ha tuna in makakapabusag hin sugad hini.
en: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.

war: Hinkit-an han tulo nga mga tinun-an nga nakikighimangraw kan Jesus hira Elias ug Moises.
en: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.

war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, maupay nga hahani na la kita. Maghihimo kami hin tulo nga tulda: usa ha imo, usa kan Moises, ngan usa kan Elias.”
en: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.”

war: Tungod han kahadlok ni Pedro ngan han iba nga mga tinun-an, waray hira sabot han iya iginyakan.
en: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)

war: Linambongan hira hin dampog ngan hinbatian nira in tingog tikang ha dampog, “Amo ini an hinigugma ko nga Anak. Pamatii niyo hiya!”
en: Then a cloud appeared and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!”

war: Nanginano hira dayon, kundi waray nira hinkit-an nga iba labot kan Jesus nga kaupod nira.
en: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.

war: Han pagkalugsong nira han bukid nagtugon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay han nakita niyo ngada han kabanhaw han Anak han Tawo.”
en: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

war: Gintuman nira an iya tugon, kundi naggiparopakiana hira kon ano an karuyag sidngon han pagkabanhaw han mga minatay.
en: They kept the matter to themselves, discussing what “rising from the dead” meant.

war: Nagpakiana hira kan Jesus, “Kay ano nga nasiring an mga magturutdo han Balaod nga kinahanglan kumanhi anay hi Elias?”
en: And they asked him, “Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?”

war: Nasiring ako ha iyo nga kinmanhi na hi Elias, ngan ginbuhat han mga tawo an ira karuyag buhaton ha iya, sumala han iginsiring han Kasuratan mahitungod ha iya.”
en: But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him.”

war: Han paghitampo nira han iba nga mga tinun-an, hinkit-an nira in damo nga mga tawo. May mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nakiglantugi han mga tinun-an.
en: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.

war: Dako an paghipausa han mga tawo han pakakita nira kan Jesus, ngan nagdadlagan hira hin pagsugat ha iya.
en: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.

war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Ano ba an iyo ginkalantugian ha ira?”
en: “What are you arguing with them about?” he asked.

war: Binmaton in usa ka tawo dida han kadam-an, “Magturutdo, gindara ko an akon anak nganhi ha imo, kay sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa, ngan diri hiya nakakayakan.
en: A man in the crowd answered, “Teacher, I brought you my son, who is possessed by a spirit that has robbed him of speech.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hin kawaray pagtoo niyo nga mga tawo! Tubtob san-o an akon pakigtampo ha iyo? Tubtob san-o an pag-ilob ko ha iyo? Dad-a ngadi ha akon an bata!”
en: “You unbelieving generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”

war: Ngan gindara nira an bata ngadto kan Jesus. Han pakakita la kan Jesus han maraot nga espiritu, ginbuntog dayon an bata. Natumba ini ha tuna ngan nagpulilid nga nagbubura an baba.
en: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

war: “Kakan-o pa masugad hiya hini?” nagpakiana hi Jesus han amay. “Tikang pa han iya pagkabata,” binmaton hiya.
en: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has he been like this?” “From childhood,” he answered.

war: “Makadamo na pag-iparataya hiya han espiritu pinaagi hin paglabogan ha iya ngadto ha kalayo ngan ha tubig. Kalooyi intawon kami ngan buligi kami kon makakahimo ka!”
en: “It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us.”

war: “Oo, kon ikaw ngahaw makakahimo!” nagsiring hi Jesus. “Nahihimo an ngatanan hin tawo nga may-ada pagtoo!”
en: “ ‘If you can’?” said Jesus. “Everything is possible for one who believes.”

war: Binmaton dayon an amay han bata, “Natoo ako, kundi kulang pa an akon pagtoo. Dugangi an akon pagtoo!”
en: Immediately the boy’s father exclaimed, “I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!”

war: Ginmoliat an espiritu, ginbuntog an bata, ngan ginmawas an espiritu. Daw patay na an bata, sanglit nagsiring an ngatanan, “Patay na hiya!”
en: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, “He’s dead.”

war: Kundi kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan ginbangon hiya, ngan tinmindog an bata.
en: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.

war: Pagsulod ni Jesus han balay, ginhilit hiya hin pagpakianhi han iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga waray kami makapaguwa han espiritu?”
en: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Makakapagawas kamo hin sugad nga espiritu pinaagi la hin pag-ampo, waray na iba.”
en: He replied, “This kind can come out only by prayer. ”

war: Binmaya hira hadto nga dapit ngan naglatas ha Galilea. Diri karuyag ni Jesus nga may mahibaro kon hain hiya,
en: They left that place and passed through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where they were,

war: Waray hira makasabot hini nga igintutdo niya, kundi nahadlok hira hin pagpakiana ha iya.
en: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him about it.

war: Inmabot hira ha Capernaum. Pagsulod nira han balay nagpakiana hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Ano an ginkalantugian niyo dida ha dalan?”
en: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, “What were you arguing about on the road?”

war: Kundi waray hira mag-aringasa, kay ginkalantugian nira kon hin-o ha ira an gilalabawi.
en: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.

war: Kinmuha hiya hin gutiay nga bata ngan ginpatukdaw ha atubangan nira. Inagbayan niya an bata ngan nagsiring ha ira.
en: He took a little child whom he placed among them. Taking the child in his arms, he said to them,

war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Juan, “Magturutdo, hinkit-an namon in tawo nga nagpapagawas hin mga yawa ha imo ngaran. Ginsaway namon hiya kay diri man hiya kaupod naton.”
en: “Teacher,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us.”

war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hiya. Kay waray nagbubuhat hin milagro ha akon ngaran nga onina magpapakaraot ha akon.
en: “Do not stop him,” Jesus said. “For no one who does a miracle in my name can in the next moment say anything bad about me,

war: Kay naugop ha aton an diri nasupak ha aton.
en: for whoever is not against us is for us.

war: Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.
en: where “ ‘the worms that eat them do not die, and the fire is not quenched.’

war: Kay an tagsa ka tawo mahihinlo didto pinaagi hin kalayo, sugad nga an halad nahihinlo pinaagi han asin.
en: Everyone will be salted with fire.

war: Hinmarani ha iya in mga Parisiyo ngan nagtalingoha hin pagbitik ha iya. Nagpakiana hira, “Itinutugot ba han aton Balaod an pakigbulag han lalake han iya asawa?”
en: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ano an sugo ni Moises ha iyo?”
en: “What did Moses command you?” he replied.

war: Binmaton hira, “Tinmugot hi Moises nga mabaya an lalake han iya asawa pinaagi hin pagsurat ha pagpasabot nga mabulag hiya.”
en: They said, “Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Iginsurat ini nga sugo tungod ha iyo kay makuri man kamo pagtutdoan.
en: “It was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law,” Jesus replied.

war: Kundi tikang ha tinikangan han paghimoa han kalibutan, daan na iginsiring, ‘Naghimo ha ira an Dyos nga lalake ngan babaye.
en: “But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’

war: Tungod hini mabaya an lalake han amay ug iroy niya ngan makikigtampo han iya asawa.
en: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,

war: Ngan an duha mauusa na la.’ Sanglit diri na hira duduha, kundi uusa na la.
en: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.

war: Kinahanglan diri pagbulagon hin tawo an gin-usa han Dyos.”
en: Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”

war: Han pagbalik nira ngadto han balay, nagpakiana an mga tinun-an kan Jesus mahitungod hini nga mga butang.
en: When they were in the house again, the disciples asked Jesus about this.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “An lalake nga mabulag han iya asawa ngan mangasawa hin iba nga babaye, nakakasala hin panlibog kontra han iya asawa.
en: He answered, “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

war: Ha amo man nga paagi, an babaye nga mabulag han iya bana ngan pumaasawa hin iba nga lalake, nakakasala hin panlibog liwat.”
en: And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”

war: May nagdara hin kabataan ngadto kan Jesus basi agbayan ini hira niya, kundi ginsaway han mga tinun-an adto nga mga tawo.
en: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.

war: Tigamni ini niyo: an bisan hin-o nga diri nakarawat han Ginhadian han Dyos sugad hin gutiay nga bata, diri gud makakasulod ngadto.”
en: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

war: Ngan ginkugos ni Jesus an kabataan, gin-agbayan niya, ngan ginbendisyonan niya hira.
en: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.

war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kay ano nga tinatawag mo ako nga maupay? Waray iba nga maupay kundi an Dyos la.
en: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.

war: Binmaton an tawo, “Magturutdo, gintuman ko ini ngatanan nga mga sugo tikang pa han akon kabata.”
en: “Teacher,” he declared, “all these I have kept since I was a boy.”

war: Nagmasulob-on an nawong han tawo han pakabati niya hini, ngan linmakat hiya nga mabidoon, kay riko hiya hin duro.
en: At this the man’s face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.

war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Makuri gud para han mga riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!”
en: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”

war: Nanhipausa an mga tinun-an hini nga mga pulong. Kundi nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring, “Mga anak ko, makuri gud an pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!
en: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!

war: Masarusayon pa para hin kamelyo hin pagsuhot ha taranogan hin dagom kay hin riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”

war: Dinmugang hin paghipausa an mga tinun-an, sanglit may hin pakiana ha ira, “Hin-o man ngay-an an matatalwas?”
en: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, “Who then can be saved?”

war: Tinutokan hira hin maupay ni Jesus ngan binmaton, “Diri ini nahihimo hin tawo, kundi diri ini makuri para han Dyos. Nahihimo han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga butang.”
en: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.”

war: Niyan nagyakan hi Pedro, “Kitaa, ginbayaan namon an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod kami ha imo.”
en: Then Peter spoke up, “We have left everything to follow you!”

war: Kundi damo an mga nahiuna yana nga mauorhe, ngan damo an mga naorhe yana nga mauuna.”
en: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

war: Pagbibiaybiayon hiya nira, paglulud-an, paglalatobon ngan pagpapatayon, ngan mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”
en: who will mock him and spit on him, flog him and kill him. Three days later he will rise.”

war: Hinmarani kan Jesus hira Santiago ug Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo, ngan naghangyo, “Magturutdo, may-ada namon hinahangyo ha imo.”
en: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. “Teacher,” they said, “we want you to do for us whatever we ask.”

war: “Ano an karuyag niyo nga buhaton ko ha iyo?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.
en: “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.

war: Binmaton hira, “Kon lumingkod ka na ha imo trono didto han imo harangdon nga Ginhadian, tugoti kami hin paglingkod upod ha imo, usa ha tuo ngan usa ha wala.”
en: They replied, “Let one of us sit at your right and the other at your left in your glory.”

war: “Diri kamo maaram han pinangangaro niyo,” nagbaton hi Jesus. “Makakainom ba kamo han kupa nga kinahanglan imnon ko? Makakagpabunyag ba kamo sugad han paagi nga kinahanglan ibunyag ha akon?”
en: “You don’t know what you are asking,” Jesus said. “Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?”

war: “Oo, makakahimo kami,” binmaton hira. Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Mainom gudman kamo han kinahanglan imnon ko, ngan pagbubunyagan kamo sugad han paagi nga kinahanglan ibunyag ha akon.
en: “We can,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with,

war: Kundi waray ako katungod hin pagpili han malingkod ha akon tuo ngan ha akon wala. An Dyos la an mahatag hini nga mga lingkoran ngadto han iya gin-aandaman hito nga mga lingkoran.”
en: but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”

war: Han pakabati la hini han napulo nga mga tinun-an, nagkasisina hira kanda Santiago ug Juan.
en: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.

war: Kundi diri ini amo an angay ha iyo. Kon may-ada ha iyo karuyag magin gamhanan, kinahanglan magin surugoon hiya han iba.
en: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

war: Ngan kon may-ada ha iyo karuyag magin syahan, kinahanglan magin oripon hiya han ngatanan.
en: and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.

war: Kay bisan ngani an Anak han Tawo waray kumanhi hin pagpasirbe, kundi kinmanhi hiya hin pagsirbe ngan hin paghatag han iya kinabuhi hin pagtubos hin damo nga mga tawo.”
en: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

war: Han paghibaro niya nga hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret an nalabay, ginmoliat hiya, “Jesus, Anak ni David, kalooyi gad ako!”
en: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

war: Ginsaway hiya hin damo nga mga tawo ngan ginpahilom hiya. Kundi dinmugang lugod hiya hin paggoliat, “Anak ni David, kalooyi gad ako!”
en: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

war: Inmukoy hi Jesus ngan iginpatawag hiya. Sanglit gintawag nira an buta. “Paglipay!” nagsiring hira. “Buhat, ginpapakadto ka niya.”
en: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.” So they called to the blind man, “Cheer up! On your feet! He’s calling you.”

war: Ilinabog niya an iya kurugpos, binmuhat hin tigda, ngan kinmadto kan Jesus.
en: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.

war: “Ano an karuyag mo nga buhaton ko ha imo?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya. Binmaton an buta, “Magturutdo, karuyag ko nga makakita na liwat ako.”
en: “What do you want me to do for you?” Jesus asked him. The blind man said, “Rabbi, I want to see.”

war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Lakat na, an imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.” Dida ngahaw nakakita hiya dayon ngan nagsunod hiya kan Jesus.
en: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

war: Han hirani na hira ha Jerusalem; ngan han pag-abot nira ha mga bungto han Betfage ug Betania, kinmadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo. Ginpauna ni Jesus in duha han iya mga tinun-an
en: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,

war: Kon may magpakiana ha iyo, ‘Kay ano nga ginbubuhat ini niyo,’ sidnga niyo, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Ginoo, ngan ibabalik ini dayon nganhi.’”
en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ ”

war: Linmakat hira ngan nakaagi dida ha dalan hin nati nga asno nga ihinihigot ha porta hin balay. Han ginhuhubad na nira an hayop,
en: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,

war: nagpakiana ha ira in mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto, “Kay ano nga ginhuhubaran niyo an nati?”
en: some people standing there asked, “What are you doing, untying that colt?”

war: Ginbaton nira sumala han tugon ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gintugotan hira han mga tawo.
en: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.

war: Gindara nira ngadto kan Jesus an nati nga asno, ngan ginhapinan han ira mga kurugpos an hayop, ngan sinmakay hi Jesus.
en: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.

war: Nagbitad han ira mga kurugpos dida ha dalan in damo nga mga tawo; nangutod an iba hin mga dahonan nga sanga ngan iginkatag ha dalan.
en: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.

war: Naggoliat an mga tawo nga naguuna ngan an mga nasunod ha iya, “Dayawon an Dyos! Dayawon han Dyos hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo!
en: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, “Hosanna! ” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”

war: Bendisyonan han Dyos an tiarabot nga Ginhadian ni David nga aton amay! Dayawon an Dyos!”
en: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest heaven!”

war: Han pagkabuwas, samtang nabalik na hira tikang ha Betania, ginutom hi Jesus.
en: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

war: Ginsiring niya an kahoy, “Waray na gud makakakaon han imo bunga!” Ngan hinbatian ini han iya mga tinun-an.
en: Then he said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again.” And his disciples heard him say it.

war: Waray hiya tumugot nga sumulod ha ruwang han Templo an hin-o man nga nagdadara hin bisan ano.
en: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.

war: Han pagkagab-i na, ginmawas han syudad hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an.
en: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.

war: Timprano pa han aga han sunod nga adlaw, samtang naglalakat hira ha dalan, nakita nira nga patay na an kahoy nga igos upod an iya mga gamot.
en: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.

war: Nahinumdom hi Pedro han nahinabo ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, kitaa daw! Patay na an kahoy nga imo ginpanhimaraot!”
en: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!”

war: Binmaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Tigamni niyo ini: kon may pagtoo kamo han Dyos,
en: “Have faith in God,” Jesus answered.

war: Tungod hini nasiring ako ha iyo, ‘Bisan ano an pangaroon niyo dida ha pag-ampo, tuohi nga nakarawat na niyo, ngan tatagan kamo han bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo.
en: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

war: ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Ano an imo katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang? Hin-o an naghatag ha imo hini nga katungod hin pagbuhat?”
en: “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you authority to do this?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Mapakiana ako ha iyo hin makausa gud la, ngan kon makabaton kamo, pagsusumatan ko kamo han akon katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang.
en: Jesus replied, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

war: Sumati ako, diin man tikang an katungod ni Juan hin pagbunyag: sa Dyos ba o ha mga tawo la?”
en: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!”

war: Ngan nagtikang hira hin paggilarolantugi, “Ano man an ibabaton ta? Kon sumiring kita, ‘Tikang sa Dyos!’ masiring hiya, ‘kay ano man nga waray kamo tumoo ha iya?’
en: They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’

war: Kundi kon magsiring kita, ‘Tikang ha mga tawo…’” (Nahadlok hira han mga tawo kay natoo gud an ngatanan nga matuod nga manaragna hi Juan.)
en: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …” (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)

war: Sanglit binmaton hira kan Jesus, “Diri kami maaram.” Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri ko liwat kamo pagsusumatan kon ano an akon katungod nga nagbubuhat ako hini nga mga butang.”
en: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”

war: Han pag-abot na han panahon hin panguha han ubas, ginpakadto niya han mga saop in usa nga oripon hin pagkuha han iya bahin.
en: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.

war: Kundi gindakop ngan ginbalbag han mga saop an oripon, ngan ginpaoli nga waray dara.
en: But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

war: Ngan nagsugo an tag-iya hin lain nga oripon, kundi ginbalbag hiya ha ulo, ngan gipakaalohan pa han mga saop.
en: Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.

war: Nagsugo an tag-iya hin lain pa nga oripon, ngan ginpatay hiya nira. Amo gihapon an ginbuhat nira han iba pa nga mga oripon nga ginpadara han tag-iya; may ha ira ginbalbag, ngan may ginpatay.
en: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.

war: An pinaura nga anak han tag-iya amo na la an nahibilin nga angay masugo. Sanglit ha kataposan, ginpakadto niya han mga saop an iya anak, kay naghunahuna hiya nga tatahoron gud nira.
en: “He had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

war: Kundi nagsarabot an mga saop ngan nagsiring, ‘Amo ini an anak han tag-iya. Tana, pataya ta hiya, basi maaton an uma!’
en: “But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

war: Sanglit gindakop nira an anak, ginpatay, ngan ginlabog ha gawas han urubasan.
en: So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

war: “Niyan, ano man an bubuhaton han tag-iya han uma?” nagpakiana hi Jesus. “Makadto hiya ngan pamamatayon adto nga mga tawo, ngan itatapod niya an uma ha iba nga mga saop.
en: “What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.

war: Waray ba niyo mabasa ini nga kasuratan? ‘An bato nga ginsalikway han mga magtirindog nga waray gamit, amo lugod an importante kaupay nga bato.
en: Haven’t you read this passage of Scripture: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;

war: Ginbuhat ini han Ginoo; pagkaorosahon gud hini nga buhat!’”
en: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?”

war: May ginsugo nga mga Parisiyo ngan mga sakop ni Herodes hin pagkadto kan Jesus hin pagbitik ha iya pinaagi hin mga pakiana.
en: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.

war: Kundi hinsabtan ni Jesus an ira tuyo hin pagbitik ha iya, ngan binmaton hiya, “Kay ano nga ginbibitik ako niyo? Ikadi in usa nga kwarta nga salapi ngan pakitaa ako.”
en: Should we pay or shouldn’t we?” But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. “Why are you trying to trap me?” he asked. “Bring me a denarius and let me look at it.”

war: Gindad-an hiya nira hin usa ka salapi, ngan nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kanay ini bayhon ngan ngaran nga napapatik dida hini nga kwarta?” “Kanan Emperador,” binmaton hira.
en: They brought the coin, and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they replied.

war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon amo ito, ihatag ha Emperador an kanan Emperador, ngan ihatag man sa Dyos an kanan Dyos.” Ngan duro gud an paghipausa nira ha iya.
