en: Then Jesus said to them, “Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s.” And they were amazed at him.

war: May mga Sadusiyo nga dinmaop kan Jesus. (Amo ini hira an nasiring nga waray pagkabanhaw.)
en: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

war: Niyan, may-ada hadto pito nga magburugto nga kalalaken-an. Nangasawa an gimamagurangi, kundi namatay hiya nga waray anak.
en: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.

war: Pinangasawa han sunod niya nga manghod an nabalo, kundi namatay liwat ini nga manghod nga waray anak gihapon. Amo liwat an nahinabo han ikatulo nga bugto,
en: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.

war: ngan han ngatanan nga kabugtoan. Nakaasawa hadto nga usa nga babaye an pito nga magburugto, ngan nagkamatay nga waray anak. Ha kataposan namatay man an babaye.
en: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.

war: Niyan, ha adlaw han pagkabanhaw, kon buhi na liwat hira ngatanan, hin-o man ha ira an magigin asawa hadto nga babaye, kay nakaasawa man hira ngatanan ha iya?”
en: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Pagkasayop niyo! Maaram ba kamo kay ano? Tungod kay waray kamo makasabot han Kasuratan o han gahom han Dyos.
en: Jesus replied, “Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?

war: Waray na pangasawa ha panahon han pagkabanhaw, kay masusugad na han mga anghel ha langit an mga tawo.
en: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

war: Karuyag sidngon hini nga amo hiya an Dyos han mga buhi, diri han mga minatay. Pagkasayop gud niyo!”
en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”

war: Ngan nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ini an gidadakoi han ngatanan: ‘Pamati, Israel! An Ginoo nga aton Dyos amo gud la hiya an Ginoo.
en: “The most important one,” answered Jesus, “is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.

war: Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos ha bug-os mo nga kasingkasing, ha bug-os mo nga kalag, ha bug-os mo nga kusog.’
en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’

war: Ngan amo ini an sunod nga gidadakoi: ‘Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an imo igkasi-tawo sugad ha imo ngahaw.’ Waray na iba nga sugo nga malabaw hini nga duha.”
en: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these.”

war: Nagsiring kan Jesus an magturutdo han Balaod, “Maupay nga imo kaasoy, Magturutdo. Matuod gud, sumala han imo siring, nga an Ginoo gud la an Dyos, ngan waray na iba labot ha iya.
en: “Well said, teacher,” the man replied. “You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.

war: Nasabtan ni Jesus an kamaupay han iya baton, sanglit ginsiring ini hiya niya, “Diri ka na hirayo han Ginhadian han Dyos.” Katapos hini waray na may nagpasipara hin pagpakiana kan Jesus.
en: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.

war: Samtang nagtututdo hi Jesus didto ha Templo, nagpakiana hiya, “Ano hin pakasiring han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga tulin ni David an Mesiyas?
en: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, “Why do the teachers of the law say that the Messiah is the son of David?

war: Nagtawag ha iya nga ‘Ginoo’ hi David ngahaw; sanglit uunanhon man nga magin tulin ni David an Mesiyas?” Namati kan Jesus nga malipayon an kadam-an nga mga tawo.
en: David himself calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?” The large crowd listened to him with delight.

war: Napili hira han syahan nga mga lingkoran ha mga sinagoga ngan han gimamaupayi nga mga dapit ha mga kombite;
en: and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

war: Samtang nalingkod hi Jesus hirani han surudlan han halad nga salapi didto ha Templo, nakita niya an paghulog han mga tawo han ira kwarta. Hinmulog hin damo nga kwarta in damo nga mga riko.
en: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.

war: Ngan inmabot in kablas nga balo nga babaye, ngan hinmulog hin duha ka sensilyo, nga bali usa la ka sintabo.
en: But a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth only a few cents.

war: kay naghatag hira han salin la han ira mga manggad; kundi hiya, bisan kon kablas, naghatag han ngatanan nga iya kinabubuhian.”
en: They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything—all she had to live on.”

war: Han nagawas na hi Jesus han Templo, nagsiring an usa han iya mga tinun-an, “Tan-awa, Magturutdo, pagkamaupay pagkit-on hini nga kabalayan ngan mga bato!”
en: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Nakikita niyo ini nga dagko nga mga balay? Waray dinhe usa nga bato nga mahibibilin dida han hinmumutangan niya. Titimpagon ini ngatanan.”
en: “Do you see all these great buildings?” replied Jesus. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

war: Nalingkod hi Jesus didto ha Bukid han mga Olibo, nga tugbang han Templo, nga daopon hiya hin hilit nira Pedro, Santiago, Juan ug Andres,
en: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,

war: ngan sidngon hiya, “Sumati kamo kon san-o ini mahinanabo, ngan sumati kami kon ano an tigaman nga magpapahibaro ha amon han panahon nga mahinanabo ini ngatanan nga mga butang.”
en: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?”

war: Nagtikang pagtutdo ha ira hi Jesus: “Pagbantay kamo basi diri kamo mauwat hin tawo.
en: Jesus said to them: “Watch out that no one deceives you.

war: Kay maabot ha akon ngaran in damo nga mga tawo nga masiring; ‘Ako amo an Mesiyas!’ ngan malilimbongan in damo nga mga tawo.
en: Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.

war: Kinahanglan igsangyaw anay an Maupay nga Sumat ha ngatanan nga katawhan.
en: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.

war: Itutubyan han mga tawo pagpapatay an ira kalugaringon nga kabugtoan, ngan amo man an bubuhaton han mga amay ha ira mga anak. Maato han ira mga kag-anak an mga anak ngan ipapapatay hira.
en: “Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

war: Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan tungod ha akon, kundi matatalwas adton makaantos hini ngatanan tubtob ha kataposan.
en: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.

war: Diri na maglangan an aadto ha atop han iya balay hin paglusad ngan pagkuha pa hin bisan ano tikang ha sakob ha iya balay.
en: Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.

war: Sugad man an aadto ha uma diri na gud umoli hin pagkuha han iya kurugpos.
en: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.

war: Kamakaharadlok hadto nga mga adlaw para han mga burod ngan han mga iroy nga may mga minasus-an!
en: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

war: Pag-ampo kamo sa Dyos nga diri unta mahinabo ini nga mga butang ha panahon hin kathagkot!
en: Pray that this will not take place in winter,

war: Kundi ginpahalipot han Ginoo ito nga panahon; kay kon diri pa, waray gud mabubuhi. Tungod han iya mga pinili, ginpahilipot niya ito nga panahon.
en: “If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.

war: “Kon may magsiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, iini na an Mesiyas!’ o ‘Tan-awa, aadto hiya!’ ayaw gud kamo tuod ha iya.
en: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.

war: Kay maabot in buwaon nga mga Mesiyas ngan buwaon nga mga manaragna. Magpapakita hira hin mga tigaman ngan mga orosahon hin paglimbong, kon mahihimo, bisan pa han mga pinili han Dyos.
en: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

war: Daan ko kamo ginsusumatan hini; sanglit pagbantay gud kamo.
en: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.

war: “Katapos hadto nga panahon hin kakurian, magmamasirom an adlaw, ngan diri na masanag an bulan.
en: “But in those days, following that distress, “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;

war: Magkakataktak an kabiton-an ha langit, ngan masimang han ira dalan an mga kagamhanan ha kalangitan.
en: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’

war: Ngan mapakita an Anak han Tawo tikang ha mga dampog, inupdan hin dako nga gahom ngan himaya.
en: “At that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

war: Susugoon niya an mga anghel ngadto ha ngatanan nga mga sidsid han tuna hin pagtirok han mga pinili han Dyos tikang ha usa ngadto ha luyo nga sidsid han kalibutan.
en: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.

war: “Pag-aram kamo tikang han kahoy nga igos. Kon lapyo pa an iya mga sanga ngan magtikang na an panaringsing, maaram kamo nga hiraniay na an kathuraw.
en: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

war: Ha amo nga kaagi, kon makita na niyo nga mahinanabo na ini nga mga butang, masabot kamo nga hiraniay na an iya pag-abot; ngan maabot na gud.
en: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.

war: Tigamni ini: mahinanabo ini nga mga butang nga diri pa mauubos hin pagkamatay an mga tawo nga buhi yana.
en: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

war: Magpapapas pa an langit ngan an tuna, kundi magpapabilin gud an akon mga pulong.
en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

war: “Kundi waray maaram kon san-o maabot ito nga adlaw o takna—bisan an mga anghel ha langit, o bisan an Anak; an Amay la an maaram hini.
en: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

war: Pagbantay ngan pag-ikmat kamo kay diri kamo maaram kon san-o ini mahinanabo.
en: Be on guard! Be alert ! You do not know when that time will come.

war: Sanglit pagbantay man kamo kay diri kamo maaram kon san-o aabot an agaron han balay—kon ha kagab-ihon o ha katutnga ba, kon ha panugaok han manok o ha kaagahon na ba.
en: “Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.

war: Kon umabot hiya hin tigda, kinahanglan diri kamo hiabotan nga nangangaturog.
en: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.

war: Sanglit kon ano an igsisiring ko ha iyo, igsisiring ko liwat ha ngatanan: pagbantay kamo!”
en: What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ ”

war: Nagsiring hira, “Kinahanglan diri ta ini buhaton ha panahon han pyesta kay bangin maribok an mga tawo.”
en: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or the people may riot.”

war: Nasina an iba nga mga tawo nga nakadto, ngan may hin siring ha ira, “Kay ano nga ginkaragan man an pahamot?
en: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, “Why this waste of perfume?

war: Mababaligya unta ito hin kapin P600.00 ngan an kwarta ihatag ngadto han mga kablas.” Ngan ginsusnan gud nira an babaye.
en: It could have been sold for more than a year’s wages and the money given to the poor.” And they rebuked her harshly.

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pabay-i niyo hiya. Kay ano nga ginsasamok hiya niyo? Ginbuhat niya ha akon in makaruruyag ngan mahusay nga butang.
en: “Leave her alone,” said Jesus. “Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

war: Dayuday, magigin kaupod niyo an mga kablas, ngan makakabulig kamo ha ira bisan san-o nga karuyag niyo hin pagbulig. Kundi diri dayuday ako magigin kaupod niyo.
en: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.

war: Ginbuhat niya an iya sadang mahimo: ginhirogan niya nga daan hin pahamot an akon lawas, pag-una hin pag-andam han paglubong ha akon.
en: She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.

war: Yana tigamni ini: bisan diin igwali an Maupay nga Sumat ha bug-os nga kalibutan, hinnanabihan liwat an nabuhat hini nga babaye, usa nga hinumdoman ha iya.”
en: Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”

war: Ngan kinmadto han mga puno han kapadian ni Judas Iscariote, usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, pagtubyan kan Jesus ha ira.
en: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.

war: Duro an ira kalipay han pakabati nira han iya iginsiring, ngan nagsaad hira hin paghatag ha iya hin kwarta. Sanglit nagtikang hi Judas pangita hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus.
en: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

war: Ngan ginsugo ni Jesus in duha ha ira, upod ini nga mga tugon: “Pakadto kamo ha syudad, ngan matapo ha iyo in tawo nga nakakadara hin tibod hin tubig.
en: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.

war: Ngan ipakikita niya ha iyo in dako nga ruwang ha igbaw, nga inayad ngan hinusay na; andama didto an mga butang para ha aton.”
en: He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”

war: Nagkalakat an mga tinun-an ngadto ha syudad, ngan nakita nira an ngatanan sugad gud han iginsiring ha ira ni Jesus; ngan gin-andam nira an panihapon han Paglabay.
en: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

war: Han pagkagab-i na, inmabot hi Jesus, upod an iya dose nga mga tinun-an.
en: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.

war: Samtang nangangaon hira ha lamesa, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hini: maglilingo ha akon in usa ha iyo—usa nga kasaro ko yana.”
en: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.”

war: Nabido an mga tinun-an ngan an tagsatagsa may hin pakiana ha iya, “Ako ba?”
en: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, “Surely you don’t mean me?”

war: Ngan binmaton hi Jesus, “Usa hiya ha iyo nga dose, an madungan ha akon hin pagtunlob han iya tinapay dida ha plato.
en: “It is one of the Twelve,” he replied, “one who dips bread into the bowl with me.

war: Samtang nangangaon hira kinmuha hi Jesus hin tinapay, nagpasalamat, ginpinitpinit niya, ngan iginhatag niya ha iya mga tinun-an upod an pagsiring, “Kaon kamo; amo ini an akon lawas.”
en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take it; this is my body.”

war: Ngan kinuha niya an irimnan, nagpasalamat hiya sa Dyos, ihinatag ha ira, ngan nanginom hira ngatanan.
en: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Amo ini an akon dugo ngan gin-ipis tungod han kadam-an, an akon dugo nga nagpapadig-on han ginsaaran han Dyos.
en: “This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many,” he said to them.

war: Susumatan ko kamo: diri na gud ako mainom hini nga bino tubtob han adlaw han akon pag-inom han bag-o nga bino didto han Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: “Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”

war: Ngan nagkanta hira hin usa nga imno ngan napasingadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo.
en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Mapalagiw kamo ngatanan, ngan babayaan ako niyo, kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Papatayon han Dyos an magmarangno, ngan magsasarang an mga karnero.’
en: “You will all fall away,” Jesus told them, “for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

war: Kundi mag-uuna ako ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea kon mabanhaw na ako.”
en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”

war: Binmaton hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako mabulag ha imo, bisan kon bumaya hira ngatanan ha imo.”
en: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I will not.”

war: “Tigamni ini!” nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro. “Diri pa matugaok an manok makaduha yana nga gab-i, iglilirong mo na ako hin makatulo.”
en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times.”

war: Ngan gindig-onan gud ni Pedro an iya pagbaton, “Diri gud ako maglilirong ha imo bisan pa ako patayon upod ha imo!” Ngan amo man an siring han iba nga mga tinun-an.
en: But Peter insisted emphatically, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the others said the same.

war: Inmabot hira ha dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Getsemane, ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Pagkalingkod kamo dinhe samtang mag-aampo ako.”
en: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

war: Ngan igin-upod niya hira Pedro, Santiago ug Juan, ngan inalpan hiya hin dako nga kasakit ngan kabido.
en: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Haros ikamatay inin akon duro nga kabidoan. Pabilin kamo dinhe ngan pagbantay.”
en: “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death,” he said to them. “Stay here and keep watch.”

war: Linmakat hiya ha uruunhan ngan hinmapa ha tuna ngan nag-ampo nga kon mahimo, palabyon unta ini nga takna hin pag-antos.
en: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.

war: Ngan nag-ampo hiya, “Amay ko, nahihimo mo an ngatanan; kuhaa gad ini nga irimnon ha akon. Kundi an imo kaburot-on an matuman, diri an akon.”
en: “Abba, Father,” he said, “everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Pagbantay kamo ngan pag-ampo, basi diri kamo masulay. Andam an espiritu, kundi maluya an lawas.”
en: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

war: Ngan kinmadto na liwat hiya pag-ampo hin amo gihapon nga mga pulong.
en: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.

war: Katapos, binmalik hiya ha iya mga tinun-an, ngan hin-abtan niya nga nangangaturog na liwat, kay mabug-at na gud an ira mga mata. Ngan waray hira sabot kon ano an ira igbabaton ha iya.
en: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.

war: Buhat, tana kalakat kita; kitaa, iini na an maglilingo ha akon!”
en: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”

war: Gintagan hira han malingo hin tigaman nga nasiring, “Kon hin-o an akon hadkan, amo hiya an ginbibiling niyo. Dakpa niyo hiya ngan bantayi gud hin maupay.”
en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard.”

war: Han pag-abot manggud ni Judas, dinmaop hiya dayon kan Jesus, ngan nagsiring, “Magturutdo!” ngan hadkan niya.
en: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Rabbi!” and kissed him.

war: Sanglit gindakop ngan gintalo nira hi Jesus.
en: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.

war: Kundi, hinmulbot han iya espada in usa han mga nakada ha hirani, ngan gintigbas niya an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an talinga.
en: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kinmanhi ba kamo dara in mga espada ngan mga balbag hin pagdakop ha akon nga daw sugad nga ako usa nga tikasan?
en: “Am I leading a rebellion,” said Jesus, “that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?

war: Ikinaadlaw kaupod ako niyo, nagtutdo ako didto ha Templo, kay ano nga waray man ako pagdakpa niyo? Kundi kinahanglan matuman an Kasuratan.”
en: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.”

war: Nangalagiw an ngatanan nga mga tinun-an, ngan binayaan nira hi Jesus.
en: Then everyone deserted him and fled.

war: May nagsisinunod kan Jesus nga ulitawohay nga nakakurugpos hin busag nga panapton, ngan gin-idarakop liwat hiya nira.
en: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,

war: Kundi binul-iwan na la niya an iya kurugpos ngan pinmalagiw hiya nga lubas.
en: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.

war: Ngan gindara nira hi Jesus ngadto han balay han Labaw nga Padi, diin nagkatirok an mga puno han kapadian, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod.
en: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.

war: An mga puno han kapadian ngan an bug-os nga Labaw nga Hukmanan nagtalinguha hin pagpangita hin sumbong supak kan Jesus basi patayon hiya, kundi waray gud nira hin-agian.
en: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.

war: Nagsumat hin mga buwa supak kan Jesus in damo nga mga saksi, kundi waray pagkauroyon an ira mga sumbong.
en: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.

war: Ngan tinmindog in pira ka tawo ngan nagsumat hini nga buwa supak kan Jesus.
en: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:

war: “Hinbatian namon hiya nga nagsiring, ‘Gugub-on ko ini nga Templo nga hinimo hin tawo, ngan sulod hin tulo ka adlaw, titindogon ko in usa nga diri hinimo hin mga tawo.’”
en: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ ”

war: Kundi bisan ngani hira waray gihapon magkauroyon han ira mga sumat.
en: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.

war: Ngan tinmindog an Labaw nga Padi ha atubangan nira ngatanan ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Waray ka ba sadang ibaton han mga sumbong nga ira gindara supak ha imo?”
en: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”

war: Kundi hinmilom la hi Jesus ngan waray gud magyakan hin bisan usa ka pulong. Nagpakiana na liwat kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi, “Amo ka ba an Mesiyas nga Anak han Mahimayaon nga Dyos?”
en: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ako, ngan makikita niyo ngatanan an Anak han Tawo nga malingkod ha tuo han Makagarahum nga Dyos, ngan maabot hiya nga aada ha mga dampog han langit.”
en: “I am,” said Jesus. “And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”

war: Ngan gin-gisi han Labaw nga Padi an iya panapton ngan sinmiring, “Diri na kita kinahanglan hin ano pa nga saksi!
en: The high priest tore his clothes. “Why do we need any more witnesses?” he asked.

war: Hinbatian na niyo an iya mga pagpanamastamas han Dyos. Ano na man an iyo sadang ighukom ha iya?” Ngan nagkauroyon hira ngatanan hin paghukom nga salaan hiya, ngan kinahanglan patayon hiya.
en: “You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?” They all condemned him as worthy of death.

war: Nakadto pa hi Pedro ha bungsaran han pag-abot han usa han mga surugoon nga babaye han Labaw nga Padi.
en: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.

war: Han pakakita niya kan Pedro nga nagdadangdang ha kalayo, gintutokan niya ngan ginsiring, “Kaupod ka liwat ni Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”
en: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. “You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus,” she said.

war: Kundi naglirong hi Pedro, “Ambot, diri ako nasabot han imo ginyayakan,” ngan ginmawas hiya ngadto ha may aragian. Ha gilayon may tinmugaok nga manok.
en: But he denied it. “I don’t know or understand what you’re talking about,” he said, and went out into the entryway.

war: Han paghikit-i ha iya didto han surugoon nga babaye, ginsumatan an mga tawo nga nakada, “Kausa ini hiya nira!”
en: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, “This fellow is one of them.”

war: Ngan naglirong liwat hi Pedro. Waray kaiha ginsiring hiya han mga tawo nga nakada, “Diri ka makakalirong nga usa ka nira kay taga-Galilea ka man liwat.”
en: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean.”

war: Ngan nanumpa hi Pedro, “Mamatay pa ako kon buwa an akon ginsiring! Ha pagkatinuod diri gud ako nakilala han tawo nga iyo hinnanabihan!”
en: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I don’t know this man you’re talking about.”

war: Nagpakiana hi Pilato ha iya, “Amo ka ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Imo ito ginyakan.”
en: “Are you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate. “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

war: Nagpasaka hin damo nga mga sumbong an mga puno han kapadian.
en: The chief priests accused him of many things.

war: Sanglit nagpakiana liwat hi Pilato kan Jesus, “Waray ka ba ibabaton? Kadamo hini nga mga sumbong nira kontra ha imo!”
en: So again Pilate asked him, “Aren’t you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of.”

war: Kundi waray gud magyakan hi Jesus; sanglit nahipausa hi Pilato.
en: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.

war: Ha kada Pyesta han Paglabay nababatasan ni Pilato hin pagbuhi hin priso nga ungaraon han mga tawo.
en: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.

war: Ngan hadto nga panahon may nabilanggo nga lalake nga Barabas an ngaran. Kaupod ini hiya han mga inmato han kagamhanan, nga nanmatay ha panahon han karibok.
en: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.

war: Han katirok na han mga tawo ngan pagtikang nira hin paghangyo kan Pilato nga buhaton na niya para ha ira an iya nababatasan,
en: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.

war: nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira, “Karuyag ba niyo nga buhian ko para ha iyo an hadi han mga Judiyo?”
en: “Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate,

war: Nasantop niya nga tungod la han ira kaawa, igintubyan hi Jesus ha iya han mga puno han kapadian.
en: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.

war: Kundi gin-aghat han mga puno han kapadian an mga tawo nga asay nira pabuhian kan Pilato hi Barabas.
en: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.

war: Sanglit nagpakiana liwat hi Pilato ha mga tawo, “Ano man an bubuhaton ko han tawo nga iyo gintatawag nga hadi han mga Judiyo?”
en: “What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?” Pilate asked them.

war: Nanggogliat hira hin pagbaton, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”
en: “Crucify him!” they shouted.

war: “Kundi, ano nga sala an iya nabuhat?” nagpakiana hi Pilato. Dinmuggang la hira paggoliat, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”
en: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”

war: Tungod nga karuyag man ni Pilato paglipay han kadam-an, ginbuhian niya tungod ha ira hi Barabas, ngan katapos niya ipalatob hi Jesus, igintubyan hiya ha mga tawo basi igraysang ha kros.
en: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

war: Gindara hi Jesus han mga sondalo ngadto ha bungsaran han palasyo han gobernador, ngan gintirok nira an iba pa nga hugpo han mga sondalo.
en: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.

war: Ginsul-otan nira hi Jesus hin pula nga bado. Naghimo hira hin korona tikang hin tunokon nga mga sanga, ngan iginbutang ha iya ulo.
en: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.

war: Ngan nagtikang hira hin pagyuroyukbo ngan pagsiring ha iya: “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!”
en: And they began to call out to him, “Hail, king of the Jews!”

war: Ginbalbag hiya ha ulo, gintuprahan hiya, ginluhodluhoran ngan ginyuroyukboan pa hiya nira.
en: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.

war: Gindara nira hi Jesus ngadto hin dapit nga Golgota an ngaran, nga “An Dapit han Klabera” an kahulogan.
en: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).

war: Gintalinguha nira hin paghatag ha iya hin bino nga sinaktan hin mira, kundi waray uminom hi Jesus.
en: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.

war: Sanglit iginraysang hiya ha kros, ngan ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa, basi masabtan kon hin-o ha ira an makakadara han ginbahin nga bado.
en: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.

war: Alas nuybe na han aga nga igraysang hiya ha kros.
en: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.

war: Iginpaskin an sumbong ha iya nga nasiring, “An Hadi han mga Judiyo.”
en: The written notice of the charge against him read: the king of the jews .

war: Iginraysang liwat nira upod kan Jesus in duha nga mga tikasan, an usa ha iya tuo ngan an usa ha iya wala. [
en: They crucified two rebels with him, one on his right and one on his left.

war: Ginyubitan hi Jesus han mga lumalabay nga nagpipilingpiling ngadto ha iya ngan nasiring “Aha! gugub-on mo an Templo, ngan titindogon mo liwat sakob hin tulo la ka adlaw!
en: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying, “So! You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days,

war: Lusad na yana ha imo kros ngan talwasa an imo kalugaringon.”
en: come down from the cross and save yourself!”

war: Kitaa ta kon malusad ha kros an Mesiyas, an hadi han Israel, ngan matuo kita ha iya.” Ngan nagyubit liwat kan Jesus bisan an duha nga iginraysang kaupod niya.
en: Let this Messiah, this king of Israel, come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe.” Those crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

war: Han pagkaudto na nagsirom an bug-os nga tuna sulod hin tulo ka oras.
en: At noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.

war: Han pagka alas tres ginmoliat hi Jesus, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani,” kon ha aton pa, “Dyos ko, Dyos ko, kay ano nga ginbaya-an mo ako?”
en: And at three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” ).

war: Nakabati an iba nga nakada ha hirani ngan nagsiring, “Pamati daw, nagtatawag hiya kan Elias!”
en: When some of those standing near heard this, they said, “Listen, he’s calling Elijah.”

war: Upod in dako nga goliat, namatay hi Jesus.
en: With a loud cry, Jesus breathed his last.

war: Ngan napikas an biray han Templo tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos.
en: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

war: Kinmita an kapitan han mga sondalo nga natindog ha atubangan han kros, han kamatay ni Jesus. Nagsiring hiya, “Matuod gudman nga ini nga tawo amo an Anak han Dyos!”
en: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, saw how he died, he said, “Surely this man was the Son of God!”

war: May nakadto nga kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Kaupod nira hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy han barobata nga Santiago ngan ni Jose, ug Salome.
en: Some women were watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joseph, and Salome.

war: Nagsunodsunod hira kan Jesus ngan binmulig ha iya han nakadto pa hiya ha Galilea. Damo liwat didto in kababayen-an nga inmupod kan Jesus ngadto ha Jerusalem.
en: In Galilee these women had followed him and cared for his needs. Many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem were also there.

war: Nahipausa hi Pilato han iya pakabati nga patay na hi Jesus. Ginpatawag niya an kapitan han mga sondalo, ngan nagpakiana ha iya kon maiha na ba nga namatay hi Jesus.
en: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.

war: Pakabati niya han sumat han kapitan, itinugot ni Pilato kan Jose hin pagkuha han lawas ni Jesus.
en: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.

war: Nagkikinita hira Maria Magdalena ngan Maria nga iroy ni Jose, sanglit nasayod hira kon diin iglubong hi Jesus.
en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.

war: Paglabay han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nanmalit hin mga pahamot hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy ni Santiago, ug Salome, basi igbanyos nira han lawas ni Jesus.
en: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus’ body.

war: Timprano pa gud han Domingo, ha pagsidlit pa la han adlaw, napakadto hira ha lubnganan.
en: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb

war: Han dida pa hira ha dalan, may hin pakiana ha ira, “Hin-o man in magwawaring para ha aton han bato nga sada ha lubnganan?”
en: and they asked each other, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?”

war: (Kay dako hin duro adto nga bato.) Han pagsiplat nira, ira nakita nga winaring na an bato.
en: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.

war: Sanglit sinmulod hira ha lubnganan, diin ira nakita in olitawohay nga mabusag an bado, nga nalingkod ha may tuo; ngan inalpan hira hin kakulba.
en: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

war: Kadto na, ngan igsumat niyo ini ha iya mga tinun-an, ngan kan Pedro: ‘Mag-uuna hiya ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea; didto makita kamo ha iya sumala han iginsiring niya ha iyo.’”
en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ ”

war: ngan han pakabati nira han sumat niya nga buhi na hi Jesus ngan hinkit-an niya hi Jesus, waray hira tumuod ha iya.
en: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.

war: Katapos hini, nagpakita hi Jesus, hin lain nga paagi, ngadto hin duha han mga tinun-an, samtang nakada hira ha dalan tipakadto ha huron.
en: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.

war: Binmalik hira ngan nagsumat han iba, kundi waray hira tuora.
en: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kadto kamo ha bug-os nga kalibutan ngan igwali niyo an Maupay nga Sumat ha ngatanan nga katawhan.
en: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.

war: Matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga natoo ngan kabunyagan; kundi an diri natoo, paghuhukman.
en: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.

war: Tatagan an mga natoo hini nga mga pangilal-an hin gahom: paiiwason nira, ha akon ngaran, an mga yawa; magyayakan hira hin iba nga mga pinulongan;
en: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;

war: diri hira maaano kon kumapot hira hin mga halas o uminom hin makahihilo; ngan magkakaupay an mga magsakit nga dadapatan ha ira mga kamot.”
en: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.”

war: Katapos ni Jesus makighimangraw ha ira, ginbayaw hiya ngadto ha langit, ngan linmingkod ha tuo han Dyos.
en: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.

war: Nagkalakat an mga tinun-an ngan nagwali ha ngatanan nga dapit. An Ginoo kaupod nira dida ha ira mga buhat ngan an ira iginwali ginpadig-on pinaagi han mga milagro nga ira ginbuhat.] [
en: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.

war: “Pag-iihapon niyo ngan hi Aaron an mga tawo han Israel pinaagi hin mga banay ngan pinaagi hin mga panimalay. Iglilista niyo an mga ngaran han ngatanan nga kalalaken-an
en: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

war: nga 20 o labaw an panuigon nga angay magsondalo.
en: You and Aaron are to count according to their divisions all the men in Israel who are twenty years old or more and able to serve in the army.

war: Hahangyoon niyo hin pagbulig ha iyo in usa nga puno hin banay tikang han kada tribo.”
en: One man from each tribe, each of them the head of his family, is to help you.

war: sumala han iginsugo han Ginoo . Iginlista ni Moises an mga tawo didto ha Kamingawan han Sinai.
en: as the Lord commanded Moses. And so he counted them in the Desert of Sinai:

war: Waray iglista upod han iba nga mga tribo an mga Levita
en: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.

war: kay nagsiring an Ginoo kan Moises,
en: The Lord had said to Moses:

war: “Kon mag-ihap ka han kalalaken-an nga angay magsondalo, ayaw ig-upod an tribo ni Levi.
en: “You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.

war: Kada pagbabalhin niyo han iyo kampo, pagbubulkason han mga Levita an Tulda ngan pagtitindogon liwat ini didto han kada bag-o nga karampohan. An bisan hin-o nga humarani han Tulda pagpapatayon.
en: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.

war: Magkakampo an iba nga mga Israelita pinaagi han ira mga hugpok hin mga sondalo an kada tawo upod han iya kalugaringon nga hugpo ngan ha ubos han iya kalugaringon nga bandera.
en: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.

war: Sanglit ginbuhat han mga tawo han Israel an ngatanan nga iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises.
en: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.

war: Iginhatag han Ginoo kanda Moises ug Aaron an masunod nga mga tugon.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

war: Waray iglista an mga Levita upod han iba nga mga Israelita, sumala han iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises.
en: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.

war: Amo ini an panimalay nira Aaron ug Moises dida han panahon han paghimangraw han Ginoo kan Moises didto ha Bukid Sinai.
en: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai.

war: May upat nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Aaron: hira Nadab nga suhag, Abiu, Eleazar, ug Itamar.
en: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

war: Gindihogan ngan gin-ordenahan hira nga kapadian,
en: Those were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Moises,
en: The Lord said to Moses,

war: “Dad-a ha atubangan an tribo ni Levi ngan tudloka hira nga mga surugoon ni Aaron nga padi.
en: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

war: Magtutuman hira han buruhaton nga ginkikinahanglan para han akon Tulda ngan magtutuman hira hin mga katungdanan para han kapadian ngan para han bug-os nga bungto.
en: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the tent of meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.

war: Paninimangnoon nira an ngatanan nga kasangkapan han Tulda ngan pagbubuhaton nira an mga katungdanan para han iba nga mga Israelita.
en: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.

war: An katungdanan la han mga Levita amo an pag-alagad kan Aaron ngan han iya mga anak nga kalalaken-an.
en: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.

war: Nagsiring an Ginoo kan Moises,
en: The Lord also said to Moses,

war: Didto ha Kamingawan han Sinai ginsugo han Ginoo hi Moises
en: The Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,

war: hin paglista han mga Levita pinaagi hin mga banay ngan pinaagi hin mga panimalay, ngan ginlista an kada lalake nga usa ka bulan o labaw an panuigon
en: “Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more.”

war: ngan ginbuhat ini ni Moises.
en: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .

war: An mga panimalay nira Libni ug Simei amo an mga sakop han banay ni Gerson.
en: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.

war: An kadamo han iginlista nga kalalaken-an nga usa ka bulan o labaw an panuigon kapin hin 7,500.
en: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.

war: Pinapagkampo ini nga banay didto ha katundan, ha luyo han Tulda,
en: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.

war: nga hi Eliasaf nga anak ni Lael amo an puno han hugpo.
en: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

war: May katungdanan hira para han Tulda, han mga tahob ha sakob ngan ha gawas hini, han biray para han agian,
en: At the tent of meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the tent of meeting,

war: han mga biray para han bungsaran palibot han Tulda ngan han altar, ngan han biray para han agian han bungsaran. May katungdanan hira han ngatanan nga pag-alagad bahin hini nga mga butang.
en: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes—and everything related to their use.

war: An kadamo han iginlista nga kalalaken-an nga usa ka bulan o labaw an panuigon kapin hin 8,600.
en: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

war: Pinapagkampo ini nga banay didto ha timogan han Tulda,
en: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

war: nga hi Elisafan nga anak ni Uziel amo an puno han hugpo.
en: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

war: Hi Eleazar nga anak ni Aaron nga padi amo an puno han mga Levita. Tinaporan hiya hadton mga nagtutuman han mga buruhaton didto han Baraan nga Dapit.
en: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

war: An mga panimalay nira Mahli ug Musi amo an mga sakop han banay ni Merari.
en: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

war: An kadamo han iginlista nga kalalaken-an nga usa ka bulan o labaw an panuigon kapin hin 6,200.
en: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.

war: Pinapagkampo ini nga banay didto ha amihanan han Tulda, nga hi Zuriel nga anak ni Abihail amo an puno han hugpo.
en: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

war: May katungdanan liwat hira han mga harigi, mga tungtongan, mga usok, ngan mga pisi para han bungsaran ha gawas.
en: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

war: Sinmugot hi Moises ngan iginlista niya an ngatanan nga suhag nga kalalaken-an
en: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.

war: nga usa ka bulan o labaw an panuigon; 22,273 ngatanan.
en: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.

war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,
en: The Lord also said to Moses,

war: Tungod nga nagsobra man hin 273 an kadamo han mga suhag nga kalalaken-an nga Israelita kay han mga Levita, kinahanglan lukaton mo an sobra nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an.
en: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,

war: Baydi hin lima ka bug-os nga salapi para han kada usa, sumala han suruklan nga opisyal,
